I keep them in my walk in closet by my cat's feeding station. I used to keep the bigger bags there, but then I had 3 big bags of food all open at one time. I would take some kibble from each bag and mix it in the bowl. Inevitably, little pieces of kibble would fly around in the closet and land on the floor and hide from me. It was a mess. With these little bags, I am able to open one and dump the whole thing in the bowl and then, when that has been eaten, they get another flavor. I like this system much better. I just zip open a bag and pour in the contents. Then there is no mess in the closet.I love having my cat food delivered. That way I do not have to go through the routine of putting it in the cart, then out of the cart. Now into a grocery bag, then out of a grocery bag and into the cupboard. Instead it is in the front door, out of the box and into the cupboard (closet). Much, much easier.I think your kitties will enjoy the taste of Filet Migon and you will enjoy the handiness of these little one pound bags. Getting them delivered on a rotating basis is an extra plus provided by Amazon. I love it and hope you will too. Thank you for your time.

column9: Great price, very popular with the cats.
column10: It is the best way to buy pet products.  Having a six pack delivered is much better than adding 6 or 7 dollars to my grocery bill each week.  The cats love it.  We mix their urinary tract pet food with it, and the kitties are happy too.

I purchased these fruit-filled hard candies from Candy Nation and I am very pleased with the product and the company. These are very much like the Italian Hard Candies some of us remember from our youth. You have GOT to try the apricot flavored ones! I had one issue with shipping (packaging)that was resolved quickly and beyond my expectation. The company was VERY responsive. Candy Nation is a "class act" in my opinion!

I normally don't get excited about raisins, but these were among the best I had ever tasted, both in their juiciness and with the taste combination from the three different kinds of raisins. As I continued munching through half the bag, I couldn't help but think, "with this kind of taste, who needs to be eating candy! This is as good as most candy I have had!
This tea as well as the Black tea from Choice Organic is absolutely wonderful! I love the taste with a little milk and stevia and just the right amount of caffeine to give me a boost in the morning!

When I left England in 1997 I think I missed these the most, sure there were parents and aunts and uncles, but that's why they invented the web cam.  Looking at Cherry Bakewells on a webcam never gave me the same satisfaction of actually eating one.  I could get other people to eat them and then describe precisely the sensation, but it was never enough.  I tried to find a US substitute over here, Cherry Poptarts?  Hah!  I laugh at your pitiful attempts at creating a cherry cake.Jump forward about 10 years and these babies show up on Amazon, what a great day indeed.  I ordered a pack immediately and awaited their arrival, they arrived promptly and as I ate the first one (whole) that same great taste I remembered came flooding back.  The soft fondant icing, the almondy crumble filling, the plum jam at the bottom, the firm but somehow soft pastry case and of course the cherry on top.  Bliss :)I don't recommend anyone buy these as I want them all for myself.  All of them you hear? ALL OF THEM!!!!!
Nothing in the world can compare to a Cherry Bakewell.  NOTHING, I SAY!

You know when you taste something you loved as a child, and it isn't half as good as you remember it? Mr. Kipling Cherry Bakewells are not like those things. They are forever delicious, forever exceedingly good, just as the package says. Other customers here would like you to skip purchasing these, so that they may have these all to themselves. Well, I am magnanimous. I would like you to try them, but I am hoping you have odd, malfunctioning tastebuds (possessed by demons perhaps) so that you hate them. Then I can freely purchase and eat more, without you standing in my way. Thank you for your time.

I got the box at work thinking it would be books, and when I opened it and saw the box, I felt like even though they were a bit on the expensive side (with the shipping it came up to almost $13), it was worth it. I went to wash my hands, I closed the door behind me, I switched off the screen of my computer, and I opened them :) I was suddenly in my irish kitchen/living room... the bright grey light over the acres and acres of perfect green meadows that you could see from there... It tasted as if I just came from a quick shopping in the closest Dunnes Stores and I had decided to indulge myself and got a box of bakewells... it was such a perfect moment. I can't wait to eat a second one!!

They never refunded back my money for the third box, nor did a third box come. I lost the customer rep number so I couldn't call themand I'm only getting an invite to review the product two months later
Product was good, fresh, just right.  The cakes arrived uncrushed and in great shape.  Service was quick too, just as you would want it to be.

These little desserts are amazing. A flaky, light crust with a soft almond cake and raspberry plum jam center, with lovely icing and a cherry! Just the right amount of sweet that is perfectly offset by a cup of tea. I was looking forward to trying them and now I wish I hadn't... cause I'll have to order them on a regular basis. They are that good! Seriously...

I used to get these at the Esso station near my house when I lived in England and ever since that first one, I've been hooked.  When I left England, I had to do without until a few years later when a friend who turned out to have parents in England had them send me two boxes for Christmas!  They're so light, perfect when you want just "a little something".  When my fiance assumes I will share them with him, he usually gets a chewing out because some things you just don't share!  I would say, if you can find them locally, that would be a better option.  They are pretty delicate and rarely hold up to shipping real well.  But crumbled bakewells eat just as well! Also, sine they are mostly jam and frosting, they are super sweet (which I love) but some may not like something so sweet.
These are absolutely delicious! I tried them for the first time last year when I got some for the family to enjoy at Christmas.  We all loved them!

column9: Very good gluten free cracker choice
column10: I've got family and friends who can't eat gluten (wheat).  These are very nice crackers that I keep on hand, so I have GF choice for them.  But my son and I find ourselves reaching for these instead of the normal gluten (Triscuit) crackers too.  Very tasty with a nice crunch.

I like these gluten free crackers. I like how these aren't too delicate in texture, these are thicker than some gluten free crackers. The flavor is good, oniony and herbed, and I like these with avocado, salsa, beans, and even tahini. Even great as snacks when you want something crunchy but not too heavy or salty.

I ordered a case of these for my husband who has a gluten allergy.  We had tried them once in a gift basket he received.  They were delicious so we ordered a case from Amazon.  They arrived and we noticed that the expirationdate on the crackers was only 3 weeks away!  I called Amazon and they refunded my money - - but my questions is ........"Why sell food products if you cannot guarantee their freshness"??!!!  That said - - if you CAN get these fresh - they are really excellent crackers!

I'm a notorious cereal addict, so I'll surely try anything once, especially if it's part of the Crunchy Nut line. I'm in love with the Honey Nut flakes version they came out with first recently in the U.S. It's perfect. Then I tasted this crap. It tastes nothing like the honey nut (which I guess is the point), but it's not in a good way. I can't even really describe it to you, it's just not an appealing taste. It's like you're eating burnt toast mixed with molasses or something. It's a shame because I love almost all things caramel too. Avoid this one.
This is a great product for the money.  The flavor really comes through.  It is a nice finishing touch for dishes.
The product was sent quickly and was exactly what I thought it was to be.  I am very pleased with the Dead Sea salt and would reorder from them when I need more.

Linguini and fettuccine are my favorite pasta shapes. For many years I've been buying delicious, imported-from-Italy DeCecco pasta, but I found this on sale and decided to try it. OMG this is the BEST linguini I have ever tasted! It has the most wonderful toothiness. Every bite was better than the last and I didn't have to eat a lot to feel satisfied. I can't pay nearly $7/lb but I will definitely stock up when I find it on sale. I'm afraid I'll have to demote lovely DeCecco to 4.5 stars!

I bought this sea salt grinder a while back at a local super store. The flavor is good and the grinder works well even having a knob to adjust for coarse or fine grind. The knob turns quite a bit so it's not just a two stage choice but allows for a range. Be careful though as I left the bottle too close to the stove one day and the top melted. The grinder cap came off and could not be reattached. I dumped the salt into a container and I use it whenever I need a pinch. The salt is very coarse obviously but works fine for cooking.Overall I like these grinders as they are nice and big and the adjustable grind is a nice touch. Shop around though because Amazon does not have the best price on these and I was able to pick them up for about half this price locally.

Salt is salt. If you like, it's sodium chloride. Or, if you like, it occurs naturally as the mineral Halite (I'm a geologist, by the way). If it's pure, it's just sodium chloride and there's no reason to believe that one type of salt is any different than the other. Thus it is that I have looked at such gourmet products as "Mediterranean Sea Salt" with a great deal of skepticism, and especially when you note the exceptionally high prices associated with such products.Well, my wife obtained a grinder of Mediterranean Sea Salt and I got after her for such a needless expense. I tried it, of course, and I was amazed. The taste is superb, much better than regular salt. It's so bright and fresh and, ahem, salty. Just a little bit is all you need. How can this be? Are other commercial salts somehow contaminated with extraneous ingredients? In any case, give Mediterranean Sea Salt a try sometime and make up your own mind.Gary Peterson

I was hesitant to pay ten bucks for a disposable salt shaker but, boy, am I glad I did.  The salt itself is devine -- truly tasty-- and enhances the flavor of many dishes.  The grinder is large and easy to turn.  With the companion pepper grinder, it is a perfect set to use both in the kitchen at the table.  I highly recommend this product.

column9: Valentine's Day present for my daughter's family
column10: I picked out these chocolates to send to my daughter and her family for Valentine's Day.  They were all very happy to receive them, and the youngest even asked for them to be poured into a bowl and she'd make sure no one ate them all!
These are great and it's a wonderful way to get a taste of chocolate each day. It contains chocolate with almonds and dark chocolate which in a sizeable amount for your daily chocolate fix.

Absoulutely delicious Hershey's Chocolate Candy in a 4 medley variety of nugget shaped form in flavors of Milk Chocolate, Milk Chocolate with Almonds, Milk Chocolate with Toffee and Almonds and Special Dark with Almonds. I enjoy each and every single one, my favorites being Toffee with Almond and the Special Dark ones. Approx. 100 pieces per bag, good value at just $10.00! ... It would be of the brand Sapporo Ichiban! Seriously, it's insane how good ichiban is! Though this review is specifically for the Beef flavour, I would definitely suggest branching out. My favorite is the Miso
This was very good. I enjoy the light tasting broth and the light noodle. I would purchase this product again.

I went on a limb and tried the Beef and Chicken flavors, boy what a mistake. I was introduced to the original flavor by my Korean GF and was amazed at how much better the quality was over any other ramen I had prior.The discount at Amazon was such I decided to purchase the other two flavors above. Even he commented the flavor wasn't great.Stick with the original and you'll be much better off. At least that is my opinion.

My husband loves this mixed fruit jelly.  It used to be available at several stores in my area.  Unfortunately, for some reason the stores stopped carrying it.  Even Smuckers' website doesn't sell them individually. So I went on Amazon.com and there it was! I bought a pack of six so my husband will have his favorite jelly for a while and I don't have to hear, "Honey, can you see if they have my jelly?" every time I go grocery shopping!!  I would definitely buy it again from this vendor when we run out and they still have it.

I purchased this butter flavor for $8.93 in October 2011, which was a good price/oz compared with other offerings.  I used 8 drops in an ice cream called "Savannah Buttermint", and it added a substantial, deep butter flavor.  The ingredient seems perfectly good for home cooking, though since 8 drops delivered so much flavor, I don't see how I'll ever use the rest of the bottle.

I didn't expect Wilton No-Color Butter Flavor to taste like real butter, but I expected something at least palatable.  This stuff doesn't taste even remotely like butter, nor like anything edible -- it tastes like something you'd use to remove paint.  Utterly horrible.  What a waste.

I read some Wilton recipes that called for this butter flavoring.  So, I gave this a try to get the consistency I wanted in my frosting and not use real butter. I will go back to using real butter if I need to have the butter flavor in my frosting.  The butter flavor just didn't taste good....not one person in if my family liked it.  I ended up throwing out the batch of frosting I made with this flavor in it.

For starters, it comes in a clear plastic bottle, not the dark glass in the picture.  Then there's the ingredient list:Water, PROPYLENE GLYCOL, natural and artificial flavors, Phosphoric Acid.  Doing a bit of research, I find that while propylene glycol is what goes into modern antifreeze and hand sanitizers, the US FDA has determined that it is "generally considered safe.  According to the rest of the reading, it would take a LOT to cause a problem.  But my question is: Why are we using it at all?  Is there nothing else that will do the job?  Theoretically, it's an alcohol, but then again wood alcohol makes people go blind, so...Lots of questions, no conclusive answers.  I'll likely try a drop or two, but I wish Amazon had revealed this in the first place.  At $8.xx, it's not responsible to the carbon footprint to ship it back... but that doesn't mean I've go to like it.EDIT: put a couple drops into some oil... it doesn't mix.  Not even a little bit.  So it is being returned.  Not worth buying, IMO.

column9: Best cat food out there, period.
column10: My cat LOVES this food. I did a lot of research before choosing my cat's food for obvious reasons--he's my pet, I'm responsible for what he eats, and I want him to be as healthy as he can possibly be. My cat is on the following eating program, and I swear he looks like he's on steroids--except in a very lean and healthy way. He doesn't overeat, so I always keep Wellness Complete Health dry food in his bowl, and he just snacks on it from time-to-time throughout the day. Every morning, he gets a small can of the Wellness canned food, I switch up the flavors, but his favorite is the Salmon/Beef. Sometimes he eats most of it in one sitting, sometimes he eats it throughout the day. For snacks, he gets Whole Life brand freeze-dried chicken or salmon, sometimes dry, sometimes I run hot water over the chunks. I recommend this program to anyone who loves their cat. My cat is an indoor/outdoor cat and he's in extremely good shape. He seems sharp and alert, his coat is incredibly shiny and silky, and he just looks very, very healthy and happy. I attribute most of this to his diet. The best cat food on the market.

I've been feeding my 2 year old cat Purina One, which he loves, but despite lots of exercise he still managed to pack on a couple of extra pounds.  I figured I would try a premium brand which cuts out all the extra fillers and see if his weight would reduce.  I did a little research and decided to try the Wellness brand of dry food since they got good reviews and seem to use very high quality products without fillers.  I started with the smallest bag they have but it cost nearly $4/pound which is just too expensive for long term use but worth a short term experiment.I opened the bag and it smelled like cranberries which was a nice change from most cat foods.  As per the instructions I mixed the new food with some of his old brand of food to slowly adjust his system to the change and offered it to him.  He LOVED it!!  He was picking the new food out of his bowl and leaving most of the old brand which was great until later when I learned why they recommend mixing the new and old food.  He was curled up in my lap and suddenly I was hit by the smell of kitty gas.  Whew!!  It has been a couple of days and he's been getting some minor tummy issues including loose stool but his system is still adjusting.  I also tried the wet food but he was just not as interested in it eating only half of what he was offered (about a third of the can) before moving to the dry food.When this bag runs out I'm going to try Natural Balance which was recommended by my brother's cats.  It is a another high quality cat food but is not as expensive.

column9: This same box is $10.99 at Costco
column10: As much as I find Amazon.com convenient, this is no deal at all.  I was just at Costco yesterday and bought two boxes of 38 Fiber One Brownies and each box was only $10.99.  For the price they are charging here, Amazon.com should be sending you three boxes.  As for the bars, I am newly diabetic and the Brownie bars make for a nice "dessert" item after an otherwise low carb meal.  They have 13 grams of net carb after subtracting out the 5 grams of dietary fiber.  The item offers a chance for a smaller treat than the Oatmeal and Chocolate Fiber One bar, which I also enjoy to get my chocolate fix in a healthier way.

This price is no deal!These Brownies are absolutely delicious...the problem is, they are so hard to find!!! I have gone to seven grocery store chains, Walmart, and Sam's Club, and none of them carry these. My co-worker told me they are sold at Costco, but I don't have a Costco Membership. So, I told her I found them on Amazon for $20+ per box, and she told me not to buy them. She went to Costco and got the same 38 count box for me for $10.99. I love Amazon, and usually I get great deals here. However, this time around I have to say that this is not a deal!!!

These are really good!! I was very surprised. I was expecting a weird tast given that it is a low cal food but it was very good.  Chocolaty, love the chips!!  Just wish they were a lil bit bigger but oh well!
These are fresh, moist, and super chocolatey. They were a tiny bit smaller than I expected - a little bit bigger/thicker than a saltine cracker - but sooo good.

I just found these brownies this week. They are just fantastic. For 90 calories, you can't beat that. I love coffee, and this is a great sweet to go with my coffee. Put it on the microwave for 10 or 15 seconds and it is to die for.They are definitely smaller than I would think, but have a good chocolate taste, are moist, and look nice, just like a 'real' brownie.It is good to have a packed and easy sweet and healthy option that is not a fruit or bar.

The brownies are tasty, especially with only 90 calories, but this is a terrible price (hence the mediocre rating).I bought a box of 6 at Target today for $2.50, which comes out to about $0.42 a brownie. This comes out to about $0.62 a brownie.If you can't buy them at a bulk store (another review said Costco had them for $10.99, just buy multipe boxes at Target or Walmart.This is a rip off.

I got these after seeing the good reviews and wanting to sneak more fiber into my diet.  They are handy to take with you however the do not taste great. They don't  necessarily taste bad but they are kinda dry and do have an artificial chocolate flavor.  They are edible but if you get them then you should know that their real benefit is the fiber they contain and not just a great tasting snack.

column9: Awesome....just don't buy them from Amazon!
column10: These brownies are fantastic.  Taste great and go so nicely with a cup of tea or coffee.  Great snack...low calorie...high fiber.  However, I paid $11 for this box at Costco.  The Amazon price is a rip-off!
While I like these brownies for an occasional snack, you can buy this same sized box at Costco for 10.99!!
Great frozen....especially with a cup of coffee.However, your price is TOOO  HIgh.  Can buy 24 for 7.99....sooo 48 would be15.98!!!! Not $21.39 for 38 pieces.

column9: Brownies great - price not so much
column10: The brownies are great but I soon learned that they were overpriced. Sams Club offers them at a much better price but that was my mistake for not checking there first.

although a bit too sweet, i like the texture and the amount of choclately goodness in each bite  :) i do wish the brownie was a bit larger, but i like the automatic portion control, and the fact that they make a convenient snack for work or school.usually amazon has great prices on food items, but in this case they are half the price at your local costco. (where i was told by an associate there that they fly off the shelf)!

column9: Delicious low fat, high fiber chocolate treat
column10: These brownies are so good, you will forget that you are eating something healthy.  Even my kids like them and they are picky eaters.  They are light and not as dense as a full fat brownie but I don't miss that or the extra calories and fat.  They have chocolate chips and a chocolate drizzle on the top.  Yum!  The only downside is that they are on the small side but you can always eat 2!  ;)

These definitely have a cakey, chalky like texture, but they taste really good.  The chocolate taste is really good without having the weirdness that some diet bars have.  You can tell there are chocolate chips throughout them too.  I usually can't control myself once I start eating cookies and things like that,  but even though these are small, just one takes care of my craving for something sweet.  I'd say give them a try.

I'm not sure why there are so many grocery items that are way higher in price here than at a local store but that is up to the consumer to chose where to buy. As someone else mentioned, this is available at Target for about 2.50 a box (six per box), the taste is great, only 90 calories, makes a nice snack or dessert, which is why I give it five stars. The product itself is terrific.

column9: I was not pleased with these brownies
column10: I am always on the lookout for good ~100-calorie snacks. Clocking in at 90 calories, they definitely have the right count. Sadly, the brownies themselves are not very good to eat. They are not at all filling (a common thing with snacks with this low of a calorie count), which means they after eating one, you will still want something else to eat. The texture of the brownies is not good, plus they have a very unpleasant aftertaste.And the worst thing is that something in the brownie, perhaps the chicory root extract, gave me gastrointestinal distress - something I definitely don't want at work.I was not pleased with these brownies, and I definitely do not recommend them.

I tried these one day and fell in love. They are 90 calories, 3g of fat, 5 g of protein in a 0.89 oz package. They are tasty, filling and totally curb your sweet tooth with a healthier treat then a candy bar or over indulgent dessert. My boyfriend tried them and he's hooked. They are hard to find on grocery store (usually all purchased) and you only get 4-6 bars for $5.99. So getting 38 for approx $22 with prime shipping and subscribe and save, you are getting  steal! Warning, you will lbe addicted after you have just one!

I buy them from Walmart. Extremely small, nothing like the commercial, but what can you expect for 90 calories and a 20% dv of fiber. I ate one as soon as I got them to my car and was disappointed. It tasted artificial, like hersheys syrup and had a weird texture. The next time I tried it I removed it from wrapper and I heated it up about 20 seconds in the microwave. Complete difference! Moist chewy, the chocolate ribbons were melted and it actually tasted like a delicious brownie. I'll definitely repurchase. Took off one star for the inconvenience of it not being an on the go snack for me like I thought (since I will ONLY eat them heated) I would still recommend.
Great for a morning snack.  I've been eating one every morning.  They taste great and the calorie count is low.

column9: Brownies aren't too bad, price on Amazon is horrid
column10: First and foremost, you should really try buying these in stores because they're over-priced on Amazon.The brownies themselves are...decent. They're not going to taste like an actual brownie, of course, they're chocolate-y and kind of chalky. They're a decent snack, though, for the 90 calories I suppose. They're kind of small and light and not very moist like real brownies. Not my favourite treat, but I still enjoy them.For dieting? I would try looking for other snacks, I wouldn't recommend these for diet snacks since they're small and not "worth" the 90 calories for a couple of bites of a sub par brownie. They aren't terribly filling either..
These have an intense chocolate flavor. They are a bit crumbly. I suggest you eat them with a fork. Otherwise, highly recommended.

I absolutely love these brownies. Great way to curb binging and helps add extra fiber. I didn't buy the brownies here. I buy then from a local Super Walmart. It has 12 brownies for $5 in the granola bat section. Cheaper than here.

column9: Very good low cal brownie but shop for price
column10: My wife and I as well as other family members really like this brownie as a low calorie snack. No, it does not taste the same as the mouth watering chocolate brownies with hundreds of calories that my local bakery sells. But for a low calorie brownie it tastes pretty good. Here is why we like it.1. This has a soft texture, but it's not too crumbly.2. This has a good chocolate taste unlike some of the other low calorie chocolate items that I have tried.3. I disagree with the negative reviews complaining that this is too dry; for me it is moist enough.4. Although this is not a health food bar, it does have 5g fiber, only 8g sugar, 100mg sodium and 1.5g saturated fat. So beside being low in calories, it is not junk food.A number of reviews have lowered the rating on this product based only on price and not quality. However I do agree that you should shop for price. I currently buy this at my local Costco for just under twelve dollars.
These Brownies are great if you are on a diet. They taste great. I wish they still sold them locally.

These are great!  I don't know about the price, but I haven't been able to find them at Costco anywhere, nor in grocery stores.  Amazon may be the way to go for me.  They are a tasty treat and you can forget a candy bar.  I love them.

column9: Not as fudgey as I had thought but it definitely hits the spot!
column10: I just got them today and these are deliiiicious! Fiber One always comes up with great healthy snacks and these brownies will be gone pretty soon! When I opened one it looked very chewy and fudgey but they are on the softer side. There are some chocolate chips in the middle and an irresistible chocolate drizzle on top of the brownie! *yum* Yeah, I wish they were bigger too because they're just a little piece of Heaven!
These bars are great.They really taste like real brownies but i wish the bars were the same size as the Fiber One bars because they taste sooo good..
These contain a type of fiber derived from chicory root.  It produces gas, diarrhea, and gastrointestinal rumbling.  And stomach ache.

First of all these brownies are very small. Much smaller than they appear on the package or on TV. They are pretty filling I suppose and the taste is ok although not spectacular but they are very dry to me. I ended up eating a couple of them and taking the rest to work and giving them away.

As a chocolate lover, I enthusiastically looked forward to trying the new Fiber One brownies. Unfortunately, I was quite disappointed.  The texture is not quite up to that of a real brownie, lacking that treat's trademark chewiness and moisture. The taste was far too sweet, and lacked in chocolate flavor. I don't know why many manufacturers, and even some private bakeries, insist that sweet is interchangeable with chocolate. It isn't. The low calorie count and high fiber are the best things about these bars, but personally, I would rather do without than accept this as a brownie substitute. If you like sweet treats, however, this might be a good alternate snack for you.

Fiber One bars are one of my favorite go-to snacks, so my mother saw these brownies while grocery shopping and bought a box of six for me to try out. They look fantastic on the box cover, but the first thing I noticed was that the box says "chocolate flavored chips", rather than actual chocolate chips. Each brownie is very small, but even worse, they're about as light as a feather, and the texture of the brownie is chalky. The taste is extremely artificial.For what you get, I don't think these are worth 90 calories and 8 grams of sugar added to your daily diet. There are much better quality *real* chocolate treats out there that you can enjoy while sticking to your diet. I gave them two stars because of the fiber and possible kosher benefits (although that doesn't matter to me personally), but these are too low-quality for me to recommend to anyone.

I thought the calorie count was good (90 cal) and the fiber count great as well, but I felt the taste was barely above average.  As a few others have pointed out, the chocolate flavor is rather artificial and the texture seemed somewhat gummy to me.  It did satisfy my hunger, though  (perhaps because they aren't overly sweet?).  Much more than other fiber/granola snacks I've purchased.  until something better comes along I will probably buy them again to keep in my desk for a guilt-free 'chocolate emergency' fix even though I'm not crazy about them. (Note: I too bought this box of 38 at Costco for approx $11.  The price shown here is no bargain, and I would definitely lower my rating to 2 or maybe even 1 star if I was paying close to 70 cents for each one!  They are tiny!)
these brownies are great, but it's true, this is not a good deal. however, once i place one on top of some vanilla bean ice cream, all will be forgotten...

column9: Decent tasting, but got me sick
column10: I found these at my local Costco, so check there if you have trouble finding them.  They are sweet, chocolatey, chewy, but a tad dry.  However, my stomach did not agree with them.  I'm not even lactose intolerant. I thought it could've been something else I ate so I tried them for several days.  It was definitely them.  So I tossed the box.

This is a low calorie brownie.  It's not going to taste as good as Ina Garten's brownies that are made with a pound of butter.  However, it is quite good for what it is.  It is a slightly dry, cakey brownie with a stripe of fudge on top and chocolaty chips.  It has a nice but not overpowering sweetness and enjoyable texture.  I think the people who describe this as "soooo good" are exaggerating a bit, but it definitely tastes pretty good for the calorie count.  These are better and easier than the whole wheat "healthy" brownies I've tried to bake when I'm on a sugar rampage, so it's worth the money for me.  It goes well with milk and coffee.

I was very disappointed in these brownies.  The taste and texture is awful.  Spongy texture, artificial taste, and unpleasant aftertaste.  I tried one and after two bites tossed it and the rest of the box away.
These are awful....very dry and barely edible. Expected something much better!Hope the birds like them!!! Hope they revamp these brownies.

After reading the reviews and seeing the ads on TV, I couldn't wait to give these a try--BUT--I think they are terrible!They are dry and very chemically-tasting.The only reason I gave them two stars instead of one is that they do have 5 grams of fiber each.I will not buy these again and really wish I hadn't wasted my money on them.Hopefully, the chocolate peanut butter variety is better but I haven't tried them yet.

Nobody would expect these to taste as good as regular brownies, but these don't even feel like a dessert.  They're dry and chalky and the chocolate taste is weak.  Brownies shouldn't taste like you're taking your fiber medicine.

These marshmallows are great!  They taste just like non-kosher marshmallows and are a fun thing to have around.  I ordered these to make a homemade marshmallow fondant cake (served at a baby shower where there were attendees who don't eat pork gelatin).  I was concerned that the different type of gelatin would make the fondant behave differently, but everything turned out wonderfully.  I was highly impressed and will definitely buy again.

column9: Best English Breakfast tea I've tasted- organic, fairtrade, too!
column10: I have bought this tea in bulk for the last four years, and I have yet to find any English Breakfast tea that is as smooth and bright as this one. From the first comforting sip, it has helped me wind down from a hectic day - or gear up for one. I love this tea!

column9: Fantastic for those with a coffee sweet tooth
column10: If you love your iced coffee with cream and sugar then this is for you. I seem to drink a couple each time I have one.

column9: Best Gluten Free Cracker I've ever had
column10: I used to think another brand made the best gluten free cracker.  No longer, this is my new favorite.  The crispness and taste are incomparable. It is lightly salted which allows more the the grain flavors to come through.  I'm especially pleased that this cracker has no corn either.I have eaten this product for over 4 months now and it consistently is superb so all I can say is I hope they don't tinker with the recipe because I can't imagine a better gluten free cracker.

This is a terrific-tasting gluten-free cracker and a great value!  My son (35 years old) is a picky eater and he loves them so I ordered him a case for his house also.  They have a mild, but not boring, flavor that goes with everything.

This stuff is a-freakin'-mazing. The best Raw chocolate powder for all of your chocolate needs. It will change your life. There should be a bag of this in everyone's household. I make so many different Raw vegan recipes with this (smoothies, desserts, soup, dressing, crackers, spreads, and more!).Kristen Suzannewww.KristensRaw.com

Hello!This is the best chocolate powder!  The flavor makes it worth every penny. I used it in smoothies, baking, any place where the recipe calls for chocolate powder.  It is more expensive than other powders, but it is also vegan and raw.Vegan is appreciated because I like honoring a business that honors life and raw is supposed to be better for me.  Unsure about that, BUT, they very clearly take care that their powder is comprised of the best product and it shows in the flavor.Oh - if you add this to a smoothie - you should plan on adding some sweetener.Thanks!

This was exactly what I needed to make my morning smoothies.  I was thrilled to find this through Amazon and have it arrive quickly.  I was turned on to this product after hearing David Wolfe lecture.  His books are a great way to learn about raw foods and great smoothies!

We love to use real cacao powder for it's health benefits.  Nativa's is the brand we always buy because it's always great.  I've tried other brands and keep coming back to Nativa's because of the quality, taste, and price.  Amazon has the best price.

column9: In the raw, smoothie maker: 4 star first review. More recipes, and info.
column10: Starting with the blender half full of water.I make 3 to 4 servings of each, use it in 3 days or less.Add water, Hemp milk or Almond milkHemp protein powerHemp seed nutChia seed powder (this will gel if you let it sit)AcaiLucumaGelatinized MacaDulse flakesCamu CamuCacao (strong tasting, you will know if you use too much)Frozen Blueberries or cherries (about a cup)Navitas Coconut Palm Sugar (or YACON to taste)Also I add some goldenseal root.(Today, goldenseal is marketed as a tonic to aid digestion, sooth upset stomach, and as an antibacterial agent. It is considered a natural antibiotic and is most often combined with echinacea in preparations designed to strengthen the immune system. However, only one study found that goldenseal might help boost white blood cells (a measure of the infection fighting ability of the immune system), and it wasn't well designed.Mix the Hemp nut, Dulse flakes and fruit first; on high, till it makes a "milk".Then the rest of each item, you want in itIf it gets too thick. Add some more water.You can add yogurt, take the seaweed flakes out if you like. it will taste good if you work on it.Check the website navitasnaturals. For more recipes, and info.

column9: For mixing with protein and other drinks.
column10: Excellent product. Good size and great quality. I mostly use it for mixing flavorless protein powder for after a workout. It gives a good flavor, I add a little of natural sweetener to improve flavor as this product is not sweet at all, as it should be.

If you are going to bake and have to use chocolate - why use cheap brands that do not enrich the end product.This gives any item you bake a richness - and why settle for less if you are going to put the time into baking

I just bought this from my local whole/natural food store! I have to say it meet and passed my expectations! I use it after workouts in place of whey protein. Normally mixed with a teaspoon or two of stevia and goat's milk.

Incredible robust nutritional content, great value for price, and awesome taste! Cannot ask for more. Vegan and raw are added benefits. Great for my protein smoothies or veggie/fruit juices. I also mix with raw peanut butter and agave for a raw treat.

column9: We love the chocolate flavor and the added health benefits!
column10: We add this to our morning protein shakes with a banana (and sometimes avocado) and it really makes a delicious and nutritious shake!  I add one packet of Truvia sweetner (Stevia) to balance the Cacao powder since it isn't sweetened.  For us, this product has really added some delicious variety to our healthy diet!

I use this for everything, I made brownies with it today and the other day I used it to make hot cocoa. I use it for frosting and cheesecake, smoothies and no bake cookies. It is better than any cocoa I have ever used. The flavor is amazingly rich and delicious.

column9: LOVE this Cacao powder because of our super awesome raw vegan dessert recipe!
column10: So during my raw vegan phase of 17 days, I was trying to find what to have for dessert and I bought this cacao powder. I put it in a blender with some bananas and yuk. It was meh, so-so. So then, I set it aside, in fact, I gave away my extra bag and then one night, in the kitchen, we made this amazing dessert, and I put the whole thing up on my site at prolific living if you search google, and we made a dessert with figs, almonds, coconut powder and this cacao powder and it's like a brownie from heaven. Now I need to buy more of the cacao powder. YUM!!!! You gotta know how to use it and what to get for it. Super yummy!

column4: K. Goyette "A voracious reader and experiment...
column10: I gave up chocolate years ago because I love it TOO much and have no willpower. I used to eat it till it was gone. I resigned myself to the fact that I had to wait till I got to heaven to eat it again. I have been raw/vegan for a year now and have discovered I can use the raw, organic, vegan cacao powder in recipes and I have no issues with it. Raw cacao nibs are also okay for me--who knew? Navitas Naturals makes excellent products! Everything I've tried from them is wonderful! My favorite way to use this cacao powder is in raw/vegan ice cream recipes. I also make nut butter truffles which everyone fights over! Check out the Amazon.com subscribe and save of this product and save a bundle over the health food store prices!
I really wanted to love this for the price but I've tried cooking with it multiple times and it doesn't blend well. Don't waste your money.

I used to buy "Cocoa" powder from the grocery store baking section. My main use for this is to make green smoothies masked as chocolate smoothies and to add to my home made raw energy bars (there's a wonderful mix and match recipe in Practically Raw by Amber Shea right here on Amazon).The 16oz bag lasted me 8 months and recently ran out, in a pinch I bought the grocery store cocoa powder and it just isn't the same.
