I am a huge fan of Navitas brand products.  The quality of the Cacao is top notch and will be the brand I get from here on out.  Love it
Love it, I put it in protein shakes and even made hot chocolate with it.  This product is 13.73 at Vitacost...just saying.
I use this in my protein shakes. I combine this with maca, hemp protein, super green food supplement, and fresh or frozen fruit and it is great.

I ordered this raw cacao powder on the recommendation of a friend.  It is an amazing product, from the health benefits to the awesome chocolatey taste.  I love that it is a raw product with an incredibly high antioxidant content and a large dose of magnesium.  It comes in a resealable package, which is quite handy, and the packing date is always quite recent, so I know I'm getting a fresh food.  Even my local food co-op doesn't carry it, but I know I can always find it on Amazon.
I have been enjoying this product for some time now. I like the taste and the fact that it has no sugar and is organic. Best treat on a cold day.

column9: awesome and totally worth the price!
column10: This is the best! i love this cacao powder! great tasting when i add it raw food recipies or cooked recipes! my husband loves when i use this to make hot chocolate for him. For the price, i highly recommend this to accompany various raw food recipes!!
I purchased cacao and Maca powder and I've been in love ever since i received it! It's great for vegans and vegetarians! I made raw chocolate candies out of them! This is a great product!

After seeing the positive reviews plus having read about the health benefits of organic cocao, I decided to give this a try. What a disappointment! I am a hot chocolate connaisseur - I drink hot chocolate even in the summer. Not only did this powder not taste like cocoa, it made me feel quite ill. There are plenty of other cocoa powders that are far superior re: taste, Valrhona being one of them.

This is good cocoa...But cocoa "powder"....It's cocoa ! the extra 5-6 bucks go to the concocted name and the rabbi...I therefore give this 1 star ... not because it ain't good, but it's overpriced good...several out there are as good if not better! for about 10 bucks
my two Golden Retrievers loved these -- AND they kept them busy longer than other chews.  A bit expensive, so they will not get them often, but they WILL get them again.

My dog (A silken windhound) loves any and all rawhide, any and all bones to be truthful. But she injured a tooth once cracking through a beef knuckle bone, and I have since stopped providing her with hard bones. My dog has no interest at all in toys, unless there is a treat in it, then she pulls out the treat in 5 minutes and ignores the toy from then on. So I sought out rawhides as something to engage her off and on during the day. Though she'll chew eagerly on any rawhide I give her, I worry about her choking or gagging on a large hunk of it stuck in her throat, or a large piece getting stuck in her gut. This piggy twist, because it has such tight skinny strands, does not have that risk. On top of that,she'll take nearly two weeks of picking at it to finally finish it off, in spite of her persistance. I am so glad that she can have the rawhide she enjoys, that it doesn't get devoured in a day, and which allows me to feel safe giving it to her. I do wish I could get the 9 inch in a 3-5 pack.

This is my dogs favorite bone.  She is a Shiba Inu/Labrador mix and loves these bones.  All the dogs that come over all love this bone too!  Even though it's 9" any sized dog can chew on it because of the individual strands.

This product was exactly what I wanted and expected. My plan is to use them for a shrimp cocktail hors d'oeuvre.  Squirt a bit of cocktail sauce into the cup of the bouchee and drape a shrimp over the edge.
Absolutely excellent, moist, wonderful cake and you get a lovely dish towel for the season!  Reminder to go apple picking !

The shipping of this product was very fast. I love this cheese served with port wine, and a pear poached in Burgundy.  Very strong taste. It is hard to find in even high end stores.  I recommend to stock up when you can find it.

I was so pleased to find this delicious Shropshire Blue on Amazon. I first tasted it at traders Joes and then they stopped covering it. It really has so much depth and character. I ordered it with my favorite English Stilton and I have a hard time saying which one I like best.
I happened to taste this at Cheesetique in DC, and it caught my attention immediately.  So glad I took a half pound home with me, and even happier that it's available on Amazon!
Delicious strong blue sharp cheese. Hard to imagine anything better. Way better than what you can get in stores outside large cities. 5/5.
Great Sale, product was shipped fast and was delicious.The cheese was fresh and great quality. I will be purchasing this again with this vendor.
These pistachios were absolutely fresh.  I doubt that I had ever had a really fresh pistachio before. I'll definitely buy again.
Great brand of food and $10.00 item at Foster's and Smith or Big Al's. Don't let this company make a fool of you.

This "tea" is an herbal (decaf) fruit infusion including rose hips, hibiscus leaves, strawberry, and lemon. This is one of the best flavored tisanes I have ever tasted; light, fresh, delicate, and all the flavors come through. It's my new favorite!

I was a little bit hesitant to order this many boxes of potato dumplings without knowing the brand. It turns out that the taste and texture is very similar to the brand names,excellent! For an off-brand the price is too high, but altogether a great product for those who miss their Knoedel on the plate next to the roast and gravy!

Well packaged and shipped quickly by amazon. Instructions in German/English in the back. Real simple way to remind you of the nostalgic moments of Germany. Highly Recommended! The price is great too! I get to have shipped to my front door with a 60% discount!
These packs of Dumplings are a good size and make 12 dumplings each pack. I can't buy the mix in stores that good and that cheap! Absolutely delicious!
Just as tasty as the real made from scratch ones but you save an hours work in just 10 minutes!!

These are big packages, much bigger than the main brand found in the U.S.  They are not as salty, and also have a different, more natural tasting texture -- somewhat more like the fresh dumpling dough sold in Germany. Good deal.
The dumplings are great! Just as I know them from home - Germany....Super fast delivery too!

Potato,half and half dumplings are a staple around my house.I serve them with soups and stews mostly and everybody loves them especially me.They are so simple to prepare that even the worst cook can shine like a professional
Although well made,  this is a rather bland jam.  Neither the apricots nor the almonds stand out in flavor.

I am one of those moms, you know the one. It takes us 4+ months to eat what they get for Halloween and Easter with some disappearing into the trash almost daily. I allow a piece a day. There is no reason for all that stuff to be eaten until you are sick. My sister and I talk about this all the time, when we were kids, there was never a Sweet Police demanding we make the pick a good one because it would be your only for the day. We were allowed to eat until we were sick which is why I think we now eat until we are sick. Hopefully, by allowing our children to partake but with limits, we are setting them up to live a life of enjoying sweets without going overboard.If they are going to eat candy anyway, make it the good stuff!Surf Sweets Natural and Organic Candy was a big hit with the kids and me. We know kids and adults alike, love candy and now you can eat all those wonderfully, fruity gummies, jellies and sours without all the sugar.Inspired by good, clean fun the makers of Surf Sweets, have created products that were inspired by surfing, active and lifestyles, and natural sweets.My personal favorite was the gummy bears and worms while my kids loved the jelly beans and my niece the sour worms.You can totally taste the difference. They are made only with ingredients found in nature.Big plus to all my Celiac Disease friends out there: Surf Sweets are GLUTEN FREENeed yet another reason to shop Surf Sweets? How about this, they are a cause friendly company who support the organizations committed to improving our planet (water and earth).
this product full strength is pretty "wheaty" so use it half and half with regular pasta, and not only does it taste great, but its better for you as well. TRY IT!

column9: Why does healthy have to taste like cardboard?
column10: If you're looking for something to eat without lots of sauce, then you should probably stay away from this.  We've tried it from al dente all the way through to well-cooked, and this stuff is just bland -- almost like eating paste.  It was well-priced, but the flavors just weren't there.  Sometimes you get what you pay for.

I just got my order and I think it's just ok.  I got 50 different K-Cups, sure.  I was hoping to get a good mix of coffee, tea, cocoa and maybe an apple cider.  I was secretly hoping for a brew over ice variety, as well.  No such luck.  I got mostly coffee and a few teas.  Some of the coffees were sort of doubles, even though not technically.  By that I mean that I would get a french vanilla and a french vanilla decaf.  So, there were at least 5 flavors that I got with a decaf of the same flavor.  My biggest issue with these is the expiration dates.  My K-Cups had expiration dates ranging from 3 months ago to 1/2013.  In fact, my batch had 5 expired K-Cups.  The expiration dates for them were early February, so that's not even close to being good.  I wasn't too happy to find that 10% of my order was expired.  Perhaps this is just a fluke or perhaps I'm the only one who wrote a review that checked the expiration dates on every single K-Cup received.  I may try this again in a few months to see if I get the same result.  If I do, I'll add an update to this review.

I read a lot of reviews for different samplers available and am very happy I choose this!  I received 50 different k cups and all were in great condition.  It came with a wide variety of coffee (flavored, regular, decaf), teas, hot chocolate and a couple seasonal.  These came loose in a USPS box but was packed neatly.  This was a great way to try something knew without having to buy a whole box...and I will order again!

column9: Great way to try a wide variety!
column10: My husband and I were looking for a way to try a wide variety of K cups without having to purchase boxes of each variety.  We found said variety in this mix! We received 51 cups actually and were very happy with the selection. We received coffees, flavored coffees, teas, and several hot cocoa varieties. K cups were packaged simply, but well, and they arrived on the same day I received the rest of my order from Amazon itself. We briefly scanned the dates on the cups and didn't notice any out of date or close to being out of date. Only problem we see is that our carousel only holds 30 cups :)

I received a good variety of coffees, a handful of tea, a couple of hot cocoas and one apple cider. I was hoping for more tea selection and was actually shorted by three pods. Not really a disappointment. HOWEVER, I contacted customer service and they were AWESOME in how they handled the problem. In less than 12 hrs I received a reply with a gracious apology, a more than fair refund for the problem and missing items and an offer for express shipping on a reorder of the same variety pak. Mind you this was AMAZON that replied on behalf of the seller. So the KUDOS go to AMAZON!!

I am very pleased that I chose to go with this sampler pack.  It arrived in a timely manner(5 days) and the packaging was as described.  The k-cups were all in good shape and none past expiration date.  The assortment was awesome!!  I actually recieved 52 cups, YAY!  I recieved 35 coffee, 12 tea and 5 hot chocolate.  Of the coffee, 18 were flavored(my favorite). I will definately be ordering this sampler pack again!!

column9: Great selection of what I like!
column10: I really love this sampler pack and the k-cups I received! Packaging was great, all cups are perfect, none past expiration date. There was a nice selection of flavored coffees, which are my favorite, some teas and others. The perfect combination for me. I'm very very pleased and will order from again and recommend to my other keurig loving friends! Thank you!! :)
I bought this for my mother who just purchased a Kurig.  She was thrilled with the variety of beverages included (not a repeat in the bunch).

column9: Exactly what we were looking for!
column10: We received a nice selection of K-cups at a reasonable price.  I also liked the way it was packaged.  It arrived in a small, heavy weight paper bag which meant that I could put the cups we wanted to try first on the display rack and tuck the rest up in the cabinet above.  The bag is smaller than one of the bulky boxes that don't fit in the cabinet (even though they're only half full).

This is my first K-cup purchase and my first review.  This variety mix is perfect!  I got 50, completely different K-cups.  Yes, some flavors were the same but they were from different companies so I do not consider them repeats.  Out of the 50, 5 were tea, 5 were decaf, 3 cappuccinos, 2 hot chocolates and the rest were coffee.  I am very happy and will be buying this pack in the future.

You can get these flavors everywhere but the price is better at Amazon. Using Prime, I don't have to pay for shipping and I get them really fast (next day even with 2 day shipping option).I think it would be great if we could create our own assortment of coffees instead of buying a box of one flavor or a box of assorted flavors that may contain some coffee you don't like. That's such a waste.

I just ordered an Office Keurig for our office to use and I got a carousel and this box of coffee too. I was very pleased with this Green Mountain variety box of K cups. I think I may have had one or two duplicates in the whole box of 50, and I didn't mind at all because the whole box was a good flavor variety. If your looking for a good variety of coffees with a few teas and cocoas, this is the pack for you.  It contains coffees from companies like Green Mountain, Coffee Shop, Brooklyn Bridge, Wolfgang Puck, Van Houtte, Emeril's, Tea from Twinings and Bigelow, Cocoa from Grove Square to name a few.  Everything has been fresh and good. I plan to order another box soon to have a coffee club at our office.CA Luster

I receive my box of samples and was quite pleased with the variety of brands and flavors that were included.  This seemed logical to order since I had just gotten my Kuereg and didn't know where to start with what to order.  There was only one iced coffee cup, a couple ciders, 6 different teas, several flavored coffees and lots of different brands of coffee, maybe too many extra "bold" fo my taste, a hot chocolate or two and a couple decaf.  Overall, I have to say I was pleased with the variety.  I would recommend to anyone who likes to try different tastes, flavors and intensities.

This variety box of 50 K cups is the perfect item to purchase if you like a variety of coffee either for yourself or just to have on hand for company. There is an array of flavors so there is sure to be one that will suite any ones taste buds!

The 50 K cups I received were of a diverse variety.  I did not get one item that was the same.  I received about the same amount of flavored coffees as the regular coffees. The rest include 1 Cider, 1 hot chocolate, about 3 or so decaf coffees and 6 teas.  This is a true sample pack! I did not check every single cup, but the ones I did check were not expired.  The biggest problem I have from this order is trying to decide which to try first.  AWESOME!!

Wanted to try a bunch of different types of coffee when I first got the machine so I could see which one I liked and which one I didn't.. Can never tell until you try them all.. Can't take other people's word for it, you have to try it for yourself, especially something so special as that first cup of coffee you have in the morning!!!!
I received this shipment yesterday and was very pleased.  There were no expired cups like other reviews had reported.  The selection was great.  I would highly recommend this to anyone!

column9: great way to sample Kcup coffees
column10: I had a friend who recommended that I buy a sample of coffees for my Keurig from Amazon.  She had checked out and found Amazon had the largest selection at the best prices.  I had purchased some Kcup coffees from Walmart, grocery stores and I hated the flavors that I bought.  I am too cheap to waste the coffee, so I am going to drink them until they are gone.  With the sample pack, you only get one sample, then you taste & decide whether to buy it or not.  You will not be stuck drinking coffee that you hate!

I'm so glad that I tried this variety pack.  There were no two coffees or teas alike.  Also, none of the k-cups were outdated or even close to outdating.  I received about 10 decaf coffees and teas, 5 regular teas, 1 cider, and the rest were caffeinated coffees of varying flavors and strengths.  It has been a lot of fun trying the different types of coffees and teas - it feels like a different little treat for myself every morning.  When I'm finished with this, I know I will order a variety package like this again.  It was also a good value!As always with Amazon, the product arrived when they said they would!  Thanks!

I felt it was Christmas morning while we opened up the box and looked at each cup.  We received 50 cups with the earlest expiration date wasn't for another 3 months.  Even with that it was only for a 5-9 cups (seasonal flavors).  Most of the expiration dates were at least 6 months beyond.

I was very pleased with the variety received in this shipment.  A great way to try lots of different blends and brands.  I love looking forward to trying something different every day.  I note the ones I like best and want to purchase more of.  Will definitely purchase this again.

I really couldn't be happier with my purchase.  I wanted a variety pack to check out different flavors/types/brands of K-cups so I could make better purchases when faced with buying a whole box of the same kind in the future.I got 51 cups (I guess I got lucky) and only two of them were decaf.  Not a single duplicate k-cup.  Some teas, standard roast coffees of different brands/types, but the majority of them are flavored coffees...wolfgang puck, green mountain, donut shop, even a Kahlua coffee.  No issues with expiration dates, all seem to be well within range (earliest I found was October 2012, which is 4 months from now).I really think it's the luck of the draw on the type you get, but I was glad to see there weren't any duplicates.  If there were two of the same "flavor" they were at least different brands.  I'll probably buy another one of these when I run out.

Love all the different coffee samples. The variety had different flavors of coffee and a few teas. No 2 were the same. Thinking about ordering another one just because I like variety. But great way to find which flavors you like the best.Fast shipping. Good service.I would recommend this product and seller.

Received my 50 K-cups. Was a great variety, even had some expensive star bucks cups in it!  Came well packaged and arrived quickly with Amazon prime shipping.Thanks again and will definately be ordering again.

I am very happy with this. Came simply packaged and shipped before it said to expect it. I did not receive double or even x this, x decaf this. I received about 30 coffees (maybe 4-5 are decaf), 10 teas, 5 cappuccinos, and 5 hot chocolates. Love the variety. Definitely ordering again altho now I noted that the price has increased by $5!! :(

This sampler pack came with a great variety of K-Cups; regular coffee, extra bold, decaf, and some teas and hot cocoa. I always like trying new types of K-Cups and I was very pleased with the selection included within. Definitely recommended for someone new to K-Cups who's still trying to find what they like.

column9: Good price for mixture of coffee flavors.
column10: Got this mixture as the description mentioned a variety of not only coffee types but cocoas, teas, and cider.  The box arrived in great packing condition and there were actually 51 cups in the box (4 were limited edition flavors).  Overall 22 were either teas or decaf coffees.  So not a bad mixture, all were in date range and not expired, and no duplicates (two hazelnuts by different companies is not considered a duplicate, for those that would argue it is - different brands bring different tastes and experiences)The only reason I cannot give this a 5 star review is that we did not receive, not even ONE, hot cocoa or apple cider to try - needless to say the wife and kids were disappointed.  That was really the main purpose of getting this package, otherwise I would have just bought a coffee variety pack and would have saved me from drinking decaf...oh well.

I got 50 different flavors of hot tea, brew over iced tea, decaf, flavored coffees, regular coffee and cocoas. Many of these I've never heard of. I love that I can try all of these different flavors without being stuck if I don't like them. I am like a kid in the candy store. None were past the expiration date and I felt that they were a great variety.  I can't wait to try them all!Thank you SO much! Will definitely order from you again!"

It is hard to believe how many decaffinated coffees are in this box. There are tons of flavors too, only 17 non-decaf coffees without flavoring. Had 3 English Breakfast teas, with 1 being a decaf one. I was excited to see one iced tea and one hot cocoa. Will never purchase this again!

This is some good stuff, a thick red paste that is hot but not flaming, it has a rich taste that adds to whatever it is put on. I've used it on eggs, chicken, rice, just a little goes a long way. (These types of chili have the "delayed burn effect", the heat gradually builds up, so go easy at first). This will be great for camping trips, a way to brighten up boring food. Will order again.

I have bought Bamboo all over the web. It was in my wedding flower scene and each of our guest received their own personal bamboo tube. This makes me somewhat mad, since I found THIS bamboo after!I used 4 different Bamboo websites in the past and they do have nice bamboo, but THIS bamboo is the BEST I have bought. The color, the leaves, everything about it impressed me. Even the way it was shipped and delivered!I WILL ONLY buy my bamboo from here in the future!

The bamboo arrived alive and green (unlike an order I received from a different company). It is over a month later and the bamboo still lives. Shipping was quick and I received a helpful email from KL imports explaining how to care for the stalks. Very pleasant interaction.

I brought these after buying a bundle of 6" Lucky Bamboo for my fishtank then realising that the poor lucky bamboo was way too short! (I was drowning it...) BUT! I was still able to use them and make a handful of beautiful arangements; which when these came half was added to my tank (my tank is short) and the other half went into improving the shorter arrangements I started! - Ohh! and I got a free bottle of plant food! If I ever need more Lucky Bamboo I'll know where to go!Side Note:One thing although kinda bugged me when I got this set of bamboo compared to the last one, the center and the roots where covered with this werid clear-jello looking stuff. It kinda creeped me out, and took a while to wash off, I assume it was something to keep the lucky bamboo from drying out, but after a good wash it was gone, and it didnt kill my fish, so all is well! (and the lucky bamboo surivied the wash)

We have ordered this a few times and given it as gifts. It is relatively mild tasting and good for salads and drizzles on finished foods. For the price, it cannot be beat. Some of the artisanal olive oils may have a more complex taste, but, this one more than serves the purpose for us. An added plus is that it's organic. Important for those of us who want to cut down on ingesting pesticide toxins.

This salmon roe caviar is both affordable and delicious.  Each little pop of salty roe atop a blini or water cracker is devine.  Also good paired with raw quail egg, ponzu, sake, scallion, sea urchin roe and tobiko for an "uni shooter"...Yummmmm...

I have very much enjoyed the blooming teas recently.  In addition to tasting good, they are a good way to stop and watch the flowers, as it were.  Taking a few minutes to slow down, watch the tea bloom, enjoy the magic of the moment, is good for the soul.

A beautiful example of display tea at a reasonable priceThis vendor's pictures are very representative of the brewed tea.Its a great, unique conversation piece for parties and individual tea balls make great gifts or party favors.Highly recommended for invoking a sense of suprise and wonder.
This syrup does not have an after taste like a lot of sugar free syrups do.  It mixes in great and adds mild flavor to any beverage.  I will buy this product again, very pleased!
The coffee is delicious and the perfect blend for a morning cup of coffee.  Unfortunately, it is taking over month to ship (I still don't have it), so I probably won't order again.

column9: Makes the Best Coleslaw and Potato Salad in the World!
column10: I've been using Marzetti's Slaw Dressing for years.  In fact, it's the secret ingredient in my coleslaw and potato salad recipes.  (Don't tell!)  Anytime my husband tastes potato salad that's made by someone besides me, he whispers in my ear, "Yours is better."  Same with coleslaw.  That's how I know that Marzetti's dressing helps me make the best coleslaw and potato salad anywhere.  My only fear is that the company will stop making it since it's been around for so long and so many companies tend to create "new and improved" versions of favorites that might be new, but they're definitely not improved.  This one is perfect just the way it is!I'm glad to find this product here on Amazon since sometimes it's hard to find in my two local grocery stores.  Just today, it was missing from the shelf at my favorite store and I let the manager know that I was looking for it.  He promised to try to get it again and I hope he keeps that promise.  I'm getting hungry for potato salad and my last jar is just about empty!UPDATE 5/5/2012:  The ingredient list from my jar of Marzetti's Slaw Dressing (The Original, All Natural) is as follows: Soybean oil, sugar, corn-cider vinegar, water, egg yolk, salt, mustard seed, xanathan gum, natural rosemary extract.  There is no high-fructose corn syrup in this.  Always read labels!

column9: Was great to find this here
column10: My mom used to use this brand of Slaw Dressing when I was a kidIt is hard to find here on West Coast California.So I was happy to find it on AmazonIt tastes better than most restaurant Slaw Dressing
Wonderful! Best melt in your mouth chocolate you can find anywhere! Fast shipping as well! You have got to try this chocolate

I have been a fan of these since I was a child in Canada.I live in the States now and have a hard time finding them. On a recent trip back to Canada I introduced them to my son and now he's hooked! If you can't trust the refined palate of a 40 year old ask a connoisseur of candy, a 7 year old.His rating is more than 5 stars.:)

I actually found Aero bars in the specialty area of our grocery store.  I had passed by it a few times, but tonight I thought I would give one a try.  It was very good, the air bubbles gave it a nice texture and the chocolate is very good for a candy bar chocolate.  Give one a try, it is worth it.

Aero is one of the more popular chocolate bars in the UK.  It has a really nice chocolatey taste.  In this bar there are about 6 sections and the centre is all chocolate bubbles.  It is also available in flavours like Mint, Orange and Coffee. It is well worth trying.

I have a personal problem with this product.. Oh don't get me wrong, I love the taste of it. I picked it up at the checkout line yesterday. It is not the delicious taste I have a problem with.My biggest problem is that this product seemed to have set a trend to "aerated chocolate" I had a problem with it in the seventies when this British product came out. The concept is really old, dating back to the thirties (a process patended by John Todd & Rowntree Ltd.)OK.. for those not following where I am heading let's think about this. A process that pump air into 50% of the chocolate bar. A 3.6 oz bar can now be manufactured with 1.8 oz worth of chocolate. That's right folks.. the air bubbles occupy space, space which otherwise could have been occupied by real chocolate.If you don't mind paying for two bars of chocolate and only getting one, this product is for you.

column9: Tasty but not a chocolite bar
column10: I purchased this Aero bar thinking it was similar to the now long-gone Chocolite bar that I enjoyed as a kid in the 70's/80's.  It has air bubbles in the bar and although it is tasty, it is not the same as the Chocolite bar was.  The taste was ok but hard to eat, as it kind of falls apart where the bubbles are.  As far as the shipping, there were no problems.  In fact, it arrived very quickly and in great condition.  Hope this helps.

I read that the aero bar tasted similar to the choclite bar. Upon trying the aero bar I came to the conclusion that the chocolite bar is the better candy bar. Nothing comes close, I wish they would start making the chocolite bar again.I'm deeply saddend :(

column9: Works wonders for my cat plagued with hairballs!
column10: My 10 year old cat has thick and long fur that causes him to throw-up hairballs often. He doesn't overly clean his fur, but he just has so much he ends up with in his stomach, even with regular bushings.Meow Mix has always been his favorite brand of dry cat food, but the Hairball Control formula has been a tremendous help with his issues. I tried the Indoor Formula first, but that actually seemed to worsen it. He went from couching up a hairball every few weeks to getting sick every few days. He has a bit of a sensitive stomach and something in the Indoor Formula did not set well with him.The Hairball formula however, has worked wonderfully. Now he coughs one up on every few months or so. Much better than the weekly or by-weekly hairballs he was suffering from. This works even better than the hairball medicine we bought him that we had to feed to him every day.He loves his Meow Mix, and always comes to let us know if his bowl has gotten low on food. He never likes it to ever totally run out, so he starts meowing to get us to add more to it once it starts to get towards the bottom.

Just got back from France and didn't see this product when I was in Arles, near the Camargue.  Later, in Nice, it was served at a restaurant (Vin Sur Vin -- recommended) with my grilled bass.  It added such wonderful flavor to the fish, and to the accompanying vegetables.  I had no time to go looking for some there, so I'm thrilled to be able to order it on Amazon. There is a really special taste and texture to it.  The container on my table even had the signature of the man who had gathered the crystals.  It would make a wonderful gift to dinner hosts.

We bought this salt in the south of France where it is available in every supermarket. It is crunchy and delicious. It has been consistently rated as the number one gourmet salt.  Sprinkle on anything and your meal will be transformed. Yum!

I found this salt at local high-end grocery stores and loved it.  It is the best finishing salt I have found, and I've tried many.Then the local stores stopped carrying it - so I found it on Amazon, ordered five containers.  It was cheaper on Amazon than the local stores.I gave it to foodie friends as a holiday gift - and they loved me for it!!The order was delivered when specified, in great condition - everything I expected.

I just got back from being in Paris for a delicious month and was turned on to Fleur de Sel de Camargue by Ina Garten in her book "Barefoot in Paris", which I took with me, and it changed the way I cook and how I experience the process and the end result. I found this product abundant at La Grande Epicerie de Paris at 38 rue de Sevres, where every thing can be found in abundance!! I brought back a dozen containers! Who knew I would be able to get it on Amazon!! Thank you Ina and thank you Amazon!!!

This is a very fine salty salt - strong, toothsome, and delicious.  Don't use it for cooking - that's a waste - use it a a 'finishing' salt - sprinkle over your food just before eating (and remember to reduce the salt used in cooking) - I particularly love it on freshly cut tomatoes.  This is a luxury item for me, and I wouldn't be without it!

This salt is very fine -more powdery compared to other rough sea salts. This makes it so that when you cook, you might not have to sprinkle (or grind) it in as early, and you can throw some uncooked without grittiness. And it is so good. How can you describe salt? Salty? You'll have to try for yourself, but it is very fresh tasting, and sprinkle it on the worst cooked food, and it will still be edible because this fleur de sel is of such high quality. After eating any dish with this salt, it makes me seriously crave more of food in general with this salt, like what MSG does, but without the thirsty, dizzying effects of an MSG laden meal.The top sticker is even signed by the salt harvester, making it more personalized if you're looking to send a gift for someone. And, for those who are curious, it is not stored in very thick packaging. Just some light cardboard feeling material as the base and a lightweight lid similar to that of a wine corkscrew.Note: this Carmague fleur de sel is essentially the uppermost layer of the bed of sea salts laid out to dry under the French sun, and is the most clear. If you're just looking to go buying French salts in general, this isn't going to look like some Britanny sea salts which can be wet, dark grey, or light grey, but instead will be dry, fine, and whitest of white.

This is my first purchase of fleur de sel, and I love it.  I use fleur de sel for finishing.  This is not salt that you should mix in to a cake or as part of a recipe.  It's delicate flavor profile will be lost.  I sprinkle it on at the end of cooking - on top of steamed veggies, on top of a steak, on top of a salad with homemade vinaigrette.  This salt is not cheap (considering the price of kosher salt and the extra premium paid for shipping for this stuff), but it's something I look forward to using and tasting every time I pull it out of the cabinet.

I wouldn't say this is my favorite salt or even my favorite flur de sel as their are many.  It is a quality product and great value though.  The crystals are a little small and lack the crunch of some other flur de sel's I've tried.  Definitely worth keeping in the collection though.

I bought this with the intention of making Fleur De Sel Caramels. I have used it many times and even lent it to friends for their caramel making and there is still a ton of salt left. Don't let the price deter you because it will last a very long time.

I first had Fleur De Sel De Camargue in the Camargue region in the south of France, and the Fleur De Sel I ordered from Amazon is a nice reminder of that trip. Some restaurants served the salt on the table directly from the container, with a tiny spoon.  The salt literally melts in your mouth, providing a pleasant saline flavor to the food with no chemical aftertaste.

This is an intensely flavorful sea salt that enhances the flavor of whatever it is added to.  It is best to sprinkle this product on your food that has been prepared.  I am thrilled to be able to get it locally because I buy it by the trunkfull when I am visiting Paris. Thanks for saving me a trip!!!!!

column9: The best salt I have ever tasted!
column10: I've tried others and even did a side by side taste comparison with other sea salts and this one is definitely the best. Other salts just do not compare.

This is excellent salt.  I really enjoy the flavor and enjoy my food with this product.  It's a bit pricey, but a nice treat once in a while.  It wasn't as finely ground as I thought it would be, but the flavor makes up for that minor detail.

This is the best fleur de sel I have found so far and I was sad when Amazon could no longer include it in the Subscribe-and-save program but happy to see it is still available.  You will never go back to harsh table salt once you experience this salt.  I carry a small container of it in my purse so I am never without it; it's that good.

I purchased this Fleur De Sel and am very, very happy with it. It is deliciously salty and crunchy. I do not use it for cooking, but rather at the very end of creating a dish, cold or hot, to add delicious salty crunch. And the salt taste is just right. Wonderful.
For years, I have used only sea salt for flavoring.  Sprinkle a few flakes on an unsalted butter square for an elegant touch at a dinner party, then enjoy the flavor it adds to an artisan bread!!
but, I will admit, I bring my home from France where I get it for a fraction of the cost in the local grocery store.

as a finishing salt.  Never have tasted a salt with a subtle almost sweet flavor.  I put it sparingly on most finished dishes-- tossed salad, fish, edamane, winter squash, potatoes sweet & white.  It truly is a gem...first tried it a few years ago, ran out an couldn't find it anywhere.  Bought 12 to give as gifts!  Thanks!!!!
This is such a good sea salt. Use it for so many things when cooking and also have one with a small spoon on our table.
I am amazed at how much brighter the taste of this salt is compared to common salts. There is a difference.
I found this salt in a TJ Maxx a few years ago.  I love the flavor.It's good on everything.
I have a hard time finding this salt locally, and getting it so quickly was a pleasure.

I received this as a gift from my wish list.  I love fancy salts, but when I opened the jar I was overwhelmed by a musty smell.  It has not gone away.  I've never had this brand before, but that doesn't seem normal to me.  Has anyone else had this experience?

I read a review and was excited to try this salt. I didn't think it was anything special and would highly recommend Morton's Kosher Salt which is far superior and more flavorable in my opinion. It is available at any grocery store and much cheaper too!

column9: The BEST TERIYAKI BASTE & GLAZE Made
column10: This is the best tasting Teriyaki Sause to put on any meat. Delicious on Chicken, beef, Meat Balls. Not being able to locate it in any store, we went to Amazon and found it and it shipped to us quickly. Very, very good.

Can't find this item (Kikkoman Teriyaki Baste & Glaze with Honey & Pineapple) in the supermarkets anywhere on the East coast anymore so I'm very lucky that I can order it through Amazon.com.  It makes chicken taste so good.
I like Kikkoman's teriyake glaze because it is thicker than most sauces. Great for meatball glaze. Yum.

This is these best teriyaki sauce I've tried since tastefully simple's version.  If you like to grill, you need a thick sauce to really grill on the flavor - and this is it!  I used to use tastefully simple's teriyaki sauce, but they don't make it anymore.  I tried at least 6 other ones until I found this.  It's perfect for grilling and it works well for stir fry too - just add a can of pineapples to it - the juice waters it down just enough and it tastes so good!!

column9: Good stuff price is a ripoff though
column10: This is a very tasty and thick teriyaki sauce. You can get this at many grocery stores for about 2.50 a bottle.  So be sure you check there first before you order here because it's gonna cost you three times as much.

The other review (entitled 'Fruit and Branch Mangler) is dishonest. The reviewer wrote negative things about ALL the fruit pickers except his. In fact he has written countless negative reviews of MANY different products. He is a dishonest marketer who is gaming amazon for purely selfish reasons.I don't know a THING about this fruit picker, but I feel an obligation to go to places where the reviewer has done his damage to warn people that the review he wrote can't possibly be true.

I went fruit picking the other week and the place I picked at had one of these for me to use. My friend and I LOVED it! We both were carrying babies on our backs and this made picking the apples SO MUCH EASIER. We didn't have to climb any ladders and risk falling. I loved it so much, I'm purchasing one for myself as I generally pick fruit a couple times a year. I would definitely recommend it.One thing I loved about it was that I could pick quite a few apples with it before having to bring it back down to dump them in our bucket. It was easy to use and worked great. The telescoping pole was so easy to use as well, and we were picking from a VERY LARGE apple tree.Great price and great product! I purchased just the basket in the store for $13. After seeing the pole AND basket for $20, I returned the basket and will be purchasing this item which is the exact one I used at the place I picked apples from.

I think they only issue I have is that these type start rusting as the rubber coating gets ripped by the branches and etc. They should make them out of a high grade Stainless Steel. Then they would not have to be replaced so often. Even still this did exactly as I bought it for and worked great.
The concept is fine. The fruit picker worked great. The handle is made of fiberglass, and I had splinters in my hands. You should either wrap the handle with tape or wear gloves.

We bought this Lawn and Garden Fruit picker to replace a 10 year old woooden model.  Ths fruit picker is telescopic, very sturdy and perfect for the peaches, apples and figs.  We received it in a couple of days and are very happy with it!  Thank you Amazon Prime.

This picker will get the fruit, but it usually gets some of the branch as well and sometimes rips off a whole branch. It pulls the fruit off. If the fruit does not come off easily, which my oranges usually don't, I have to pull hard. When the fruit finally comes loose, the back snap of the branch sometimes causes other oranges to fall to the ground and get bruised or broken. The wire hooks can damage the fruit unless you are very careful.The wire basket can be difficult to thread through the branches. It is also difficult to grab a single fruit in a cluster.Get the TwisterPicker also available here on Amazon. It beats the wire basket hands down. Read the reviews there before you buy here. Here's the link:Fruit Picker, the TwisterPicker

Recieved only one of each and not what is listed.For the Emerald Cocktail Peanuts, 12-Ounce Canisters (Pack of 12) - I received one 4.0 bag of Diamond Chopped PecansFor the Emerald Sea Salt & Pepper Cashew, 10oz Canister (Pack of 4) I received one 4.0 bag of Diamond Chopped Walnuts.What's the deal here? Now I can't return them, but they are not what I ordered. This isn't even close to what was ordered.Please fix.

I'm 33 and I don't have the energy for my day that I did a few years back.  I work in a restaurant and am constantly moving around.  This particular energy shot works better than any other one I've tried.  $19 on Amazon is a little higher than what I've been paying.  These individual shots cost $.99 at my local grocery store (Cub Foods).  Great product though, no jitters, no skin-crawling effect 10 hours later, and a nice boost of energy.  Just a jolt of B12, that's really all it is.  Works great!

column4: Chris Kim "Shoes are my best friends. ;)"
column10: I usually get these at Dylan's Candy Bar, but it's too expensive for a small bag. I think around twelve dollars or so a pound? These are at a great price here on Amazon. These are also really difficult to find. Usually you find the strawberry ones, but not the strawberry banana ones (which is the best fruit combination ever). They arrive in a big plastic bag in a cardboard box. I put the belts into several ziploc bags so they wouldn't get hard and they lasted a very long time. I'm very happy with my purchase. I'm tempted to ordering more but they're so bad for you. But they're so good! Oh, the dilemma! Who am I kidding? I think I'll order some right now!
No bourbon flavor, all sour BBQ flavor. Would not buy again.Buy a cheap gallon of bourbon, boil it down, mix if your favorite BBQ sauce (or just cure) and marinade.

Had used the Regular Jerky seasoning before and liked it.  I thought the Bourbon BBQ would be a nice change.  Product does not have much flavor (bourbon or bbq)- end up with mild jerky flavor with a slight hint of tomato at the end.  Next time I use this I will add some sweet baby ray's bbq sauce to the mix and maybe a shot of bourbon.

I stumbled onto this product at a speciality store.  It was $10.99 which seems a bit expensive for a little box of biscotti but it was 40% off because the store was going out of business so I bought one to try.  The cookie was pretty delicious.  It was not too sweet and had the right amount of crunch.  I ended up buying two more boxes -_-

Imagine crunchy little almond pieces enrobed in silk made of Nutella and you have the wonderfulness of a Giamanda chocolate. These are so amazing, if/when I have a kid, I plan to name them "Giamanda"...
A friend brought these when he came to visit from Belgium they are so delicious that I'm ordering more.  Literally the best chocolate i have ever ate.

I have been ordering these chocolates as gifts for my Mother and my Mother-in-law for a couple years. I tried them myself first. These are so good and decadent I have had nothing but thanks and praise from all who have received them. These are not cheap, but you get what you pay for. Smooth, delicious, the only problem they disappear too fast unless you hide them.

column9: A fabulous dog treat for potty training
column10: I used this high reward treat to potty train my dog. He loved the flavor. This made it very easy to quickly train my dog to go outdoors for potty.  Standard delivery was quick had the product with in seven day from the date I ordered.
This is my dog's all-time favorite treat.  I've tried to coax her into treats that last longer, but this is her favorite.
our "kids" like the apple wraps much better! Like the fact they have the glucosamine in them!

I keep experimenting with different brands and flavors. This is one of my and my family's favorite. Lately I've been making it with lean ground turkey and it has been the best. Very sweet flavor, definitely recommend.
Bought the product for my son who eats jerky like it is going out of style, and he really enjoyed the chance to make his own.  Thanks for supplying a fantastic "gift" idea!
Used with ground deer meat. I made six pounds and followed their directions.....but, I added about a half cup of Teriyaki sauce to the meat.

The cure taste is too strong. The instructions they have can't be correct.I've only tried it with cut meat, no ground. I let it marinade for about a day and a half.Next time I'm either going to wash the marinade before I dry it or use ground beef and a jerky gun.The flavor is alright but definitely not better than something almost anyone could make themselves.

column9: These are excellent authentic cheeses from italy.
column10: We just tried this excellent cheese sampler package...The quality is superb,  and i have just ordered their 4 pound package...The cheeses are of excellent quality..You cant go wrong...An excellent buy..5 star rated.
This is beyond a doubt a "must try" sampler that goes beyond what you are likely to find in any gourment shop. From the sweet to the sharp, a tasty treat for any cheese lover or for the curious.

column9: Truly authentic cheeses, great customer service, fast
column10: Fast and easy communication. Great customer service, and most importantly - great authentic selection of cheeses. After tasting this one, I've immediately went on to try more and could hardly resist all the quality selection they've provided. Highly recommend!

I bought this item with a gift certificate.  I used the cheese in a cheese tasting party with good friends.  The cheese arrived quickly and in good shape.  There was a substitution in my order which was fine since there was a disclaimer about substitutions if the exact cheese wasn't available.  My only complaint was that there was no information about the cheese.  For my tasting, I had to do all the leg work to get information so I could tell my guests what they were eating.  Thank goodness for the internet!  Nevertheless, I would buy this again.  This was the perfect combination, I believe, for the cheese novices I had at the party, nothing too strong or stinky.  Each had a distinct flavor and it was enjoyable to get everyone's reaction on the different cheeses.
I was pretty wary to order cheese over the internet and to see how fresh it would arrive, but this stuff was great.  A wonderful assortment of fine cheeses at a very nice price.

column9: Wonderful and different - We loved it.
column10: This is one of the nicest samplers I have ever received.  Each variety was excellent. I served it at a party and received rave reviews. The quality of the cheese was excellent, well packed, and for the price, worth every penny.  Like another reviewer here though, I would have appreciated it if the cheese had been accompanied by an explanation just what it was, what area it was made in and that sort of information.  I am certainly not an expert on cheese from this country and was rather clueless as to what I was eating.  Other than that it was great and I am not going to mark down the rating simply because of my own ignorance of the subject as there it is all taste matters.I plan to order several of these samplers for friends this year.

My husband and I ordered this sampler as a special treat, and now we are hooked!  The cheese was incredible with our favorite wines, and made for a fun and beautiful late dinner (i.e. the kid was in bed) with warm olives a baguette and some prosciutto!  We also ordered some asiago to go with it.  DELICIOUS.
the choices were outstanding, the taste was great for each sample and i was extremely pleased with the product, the delivery and the price.

My wife and I buy this as a Christmas gift every year for several of our friends, and it's a big hit.  Always delivered fresh, and the cheese selection is very good.  The price is fair for high quality cheeses, and we're very satisfied with the product.  Highly recommend it.

We had a tasting party and everyone enjoyed all of these cheeses.  The assortment was varied and interesting ranging from mild to an excellent pungent Gorgonzola (my favorite).  All were excellent.  The packaging was also first class.  My only complaint is that there is now none left.  However, I've solved that problem by signing up for iGourmet's cheese of the month club!
Bought this for my Italian in-laws.  It was delivered quickly (considering this is a few days before Christmas) and they LOVED it! Perfect gift for them.
I was on a buying spree and I picked this up, if you have a good gourmet grocery store nearby you would be better off just going there, I paid for shipping and I regret it.
42 dollars for 2 lbs of cheese ? Sounds like a wonderful deal ! I'll take 2 !

I like this better than standard pectins for several reasons, you can make 2-3 recipes with only one Box, and you don't need sugar for the recipe to work.  It can be substituted in your favorite recipes very easily.

column9: Good value - Our Labrador pup loves likes them
column10: These pork chomps mini knotz are of very good value. For the 21 count, I purchased it for $10. Other products with similar size and weight was in the $20 range.Our Labrador pup likes these bones and definitely keeps her occupied. Give it as a treat or hide it, either way it keeps them busy.The knotz are about 2 - 3 inches in length and about half an inch wide. The size varies, but that's the rough size of the bones.Overall, I'm satisfied with the product. If my dog could, she would say so too.
My dogs "itch" when they eat the beef version of this product, so when I found the Pork Chomps, I've got some really happy poodles.  Love the value and product.

I have 2 small chiwienees who love these.  I've tried many different kinds for them and this is their favorite.  Seems to be a consistent product that has never made them sick.  They love them, and I'm glad there's no mess left behind.  Not greasy, and nothing remains when they are done with them.

column9: Who Cares About The Trans Fat In Gardetto's Roasted Garlic Rye Chips!
column10: So what if the trans fat in this product is extremely high and unhealthy! I just love these rye chips! Reminds me of the rye chips that were sold in the old Hickory Farms Of Ohio stores in the 1970's. If I die of a heart attack, I hope my mouth is full of these delicious rye chips! ;)
Seriously, is there even a point to buying Chex Mix since these are available separately?
Crunch, wonderful taste!  Use on salads, soups, chowders, snacks.  One of the best little flavor additions you will ever eat.

I tried this product in a bag with a combination of other breads such as pretzel sticks + others. What I REALLY liked was the garlic rye rounds. When I found that they were sold by the bag without all the other breads, I was very pleased. Amazon is the only place that I can find them now. Love this product!

This is the closest thing to European beer snacks in the US! I used to buy Gardetto's Mix just because of those rye bread chips! Finally, they make 'em separately now. Thank you! Contains MSG though, which I'm not really fond of. Try 'em with milk too! You may like it. Quite addictive, be aware! Once you opened a bag - you just can't stop. Be careful if you have very sensitive gums. Publix got 'em in smaller packages. But Amazon has the best price if you buy 'em in bulk. Highly recommend!
This is good stuffs (stuffs, as they say in Hawaii)Hard to find in grocery storeds so I bought 3 boxes of 12.
It was great to find the Gardetto's rye chips that are part of the normal snack mix.They arrived quickly and they weren't crushed :>)))
Great product for what you what-The rye chips are the only thing that i like in the chip department and it is good to just get thoes at such a good price

I used to buy this at Target but I didn't find it there anymore! I was thinking was it just that good, it sold out each time or is it discontinued. I looked no further and decided to type Rye chips on Amazon and wah-la!, it popped up! I quickly bought it and I would say it's decent priced for a 12-pack for $30. I do wish it was cheaper but this is hard to find, so it makes up for it. Great salty snack and would buy again. If you haven't tried it, give it a go! It's a very crunchy snack so you'll find yourself chewing a lot. Exercise for the mouth!
I love the Gardetto's Garlic Rye Chips.  I am so happy I found a web site I can order direct from.  I will be buying on a regular basis.

My Husband and I love the Gardeeto's Snack Mix, but never thought they had enough of the rye chips in it. So we buy just the rye chips and mix the 2 together. That makes a better  mix as far as we are concerned. We are not able to find just the rye chips locally so we went to Amazon. Great service from them at a very competitive price. Will buy them again when we run out.
Gardetto's Roasted Garlic Rye Chips, 8.0-Ounce Bags (Pack of 12)  Crunchy, salty (not too), great for dips or just snacking, perfect for parties...yum.  Arrived quickly...free super saver shipping.

column9: PURE Gardetto's Roasted Garlic Rye Chips!
column10: I used to eat all the garlic chips out of a bowl of Gardetto's Snack Mix, which pissed everyone off. Then one day at one of Love's Tuck Stops, I found these Gardetto's Roasted Rye Chips hanging on the rack with all the other chips, and bought a bunch. Knowing they exist, I started looking everywhere else, but never did find them in any of the stores I happened to be in. The closest Love's Truck Stop was 75 miles away, so the last time I bought a few bags, I scanned them with my iPod, and found that Amazon sells them. Plus, Amazon also has them in 8 oz bags at a lower price than the 4.75 oz bags from Love's with free shipping on a case of 12 ($29.52 = $2.46 per bag, where Love's was around $2.59, or $2.69 per bag). I see this as a win-win situation, except my wife has discovered my cache, since 12 bags are a little hard to keep secret. It's a good deal, is what I'm passing along.

5 stars for taste, 1 star for the trans fat content.These are one of the best tasting, addictive snacks I've ever had, but it's a good thing they're not easily available. Their trans fat content is surprising and disappointing; it makes this snack a treat to be enjoyed only very occasionally. I look forward to them, hopefully, adjusting the recipe to eliminate the trans fats.

I've given these Gardetto's Roasted Garlic Rye Chips 5 stars based on their taste, but after reviewing the ingredients list the 5-star rating should be taken with a grain of salt. I just bought a bag of these from the grocery store after seeing them for the first time and I was so excited because they are my favorite part of the Gardetto's mix but it never has enough of them. Now I know why. I never realized just how bad they are for you, for just 1/2 cup you get 10 grams of fat, 3grams of that being Trans fat (the bad stuff), and while others have pointed out that it also contains MSG (Monosodium glutamate) studies have shown that it is perfectly safe [...] I'm more concerned about the high trans fat content and the overall high fat content, as well as the extremely high sodium content (320mg per serving). So while these rye chips are delicious, they aren't exactly the healthiest snack, far from it in fact. I'm not really sure why they are so high in fat, I mean you'd think baked rye bread chips wouldn't be so bad for you, but these really are terrible as far as health is concerned. It just isn't worth it for me because I already need to drop about 30lbs and these will not help matters, so I need to find a healthier snack. Having said that, they are REALLY tasty. I guess you just need to decide whether they're worth it, but if you do decide to buy them then please be sure to enjoy in moderation, your arteries will thank you.

These rye chips are not for people with brittle teeth or sensitive gums:  they are very crisp.  The rye chips are a great snack for a taste and texture that is something different from potato/tortilla chips, pretzels, crackers, puffs, etc.  I see that the price has more than doubled since I ordered them:  I hope that this price doesn't remain:  I would like to order these rye chips again, but not at this price.
The best tasting Garlic Rye chips.  Used to be carried by Wal-Mart, but they stopped carryng them.  Found them on Amazon and immediately purchased them.  Great price, fast delivery.

I love these chips! Usually I mix a bag of these into each bag of the regular mix to get a better ratio. Then the idiots at my local store stopped carrying these (getting rid of great products seems to be their speacialty). Now I have an Amazon subscription set up so I'll get a regular delivery of tasty chips!
These are the best chips and can't be found a lot of places so this is the easiest way to go and they came in so fast in great shape.  Don't have to pick through a bag with just a few of these in it.

I always buy the Chex mix and everyone goes for the Rye chips.  So I found these and they are the best.  I'm on my second box of 12 bags...I give them to everyone!!! Thank you for having them Amazon!!!
they are good but for the size you get im giving it a 3 start very high priced for the size of the bags but very yummy

When a bowl of party mix is out, by the time I get to it some SOB has already eaten all the Rye Chips out of it. Halleluiah, we can now buy just the Rye Chips, without all that other stuff. Oh so tasty, I cannot stop eating them. Probably bad for your health, but what can you do?
I felt like I got a great buy for my money. The product is hard to locate in most grocery stores in the package sizes I received in my order. My family loves this stuff.

column9: A bit like burnt bread, very unhealthy
column10: These taste a bit like burnt flatbread, but if you like the taste of MSG, you'll probably enjoy them. Also, they are not healthy whatsoever, containing 10g of fat per 1/2 cup, 2g is saturated and a whopping 3g trans fats per serving, and consider that one bag contains 4.5 servings.

The current description states "Healthy snack."  I agree that these are definitely delicious, but they are in no way healthy!  They contain 2.5g of Trans Fat!!! (The 2nd ingredient is Partially Hydrogenated Soybean Oil.  They also contain MSG, BHT, caramel color, and some other questionable ingredients.The taste may be 4 or 5 stars, but the nutrition is negative 10!  At least they are honest with their labeling.  Most companies would reduce the serving size so that it came to less than 1/2g of trans fat per serving and slap a "trans-fat free*" label on the front to deceive the consumer.I stumbled upon these while searching for organic ingredients to make my own "healthy" snack mix.  These used to be one of my favorite parts of the mix...so disappointed!!!

This is the second purchase that I have made of this same product, from you, in the past six months. The first purchase went without a problem. The second, however, arrived with one of the bags being opened. There were chips in the box and oils used in the preparation of the chips had soaked into the cardboard box used for shipping as well as the other eleven bags. Apparently, more care needs to be exercised when packing the box for shipping or more careful examination of the product needs to happen prior to shipping.

It's expensive, obviously, but if you're looking for black truffle oil, this stuff is fantastically good. It's cheaper than I was able to find locally, and had a lot more truffle flavor than the last truffle oil I had purchased (locally from the place that has two dollar bottles of wine). You don't need a lot of it!At this price, do make sure you can't get it local to yourself for less. But don't hesitate for quality issues. Drip it gently over scallops and you'll be a believer!

column9: Fantastic taste. Well worth the money.
column10: Fantastic taste. You only need a very small amount to get the FULL truffle flavor. That is great since it is pretty expensive.If you are looking at truffle oils and see some that are less expensive, pick this one. You will be disappointed otherwise. This one has real truffle shavings in the bootE.

I have bought truffle oil in the past, and had this brand which is much more expensive in my local store. I love that this is 2 bottles which I use the oil about twice a week, and you really only need a few drops, so this should last me through the year, if you use it less, this will last a while, and will stay if kept sealed. This is a wonderful deal on a wonderful product. DO not let the smell get you, it is to die for once it hits your taste buds. If you have thought about it I would suggest that you find a local place where they offer tastings and try it because it is a tad much money to buy it and not like it. this compares to the $20+ an ounce oils and even beats some in taste and value!!
Great quality and excellent flavor, along with a good price makes this the best value I have found for truffle oil.

I had truffle oil in a califlower soup, and also once in an omelet, both at restaurants,  -- and it tasted AMAZING -- so I was wanting to try it out in my own food.  I decided on the black truffle oil even though reviewers say it's "stronger" than the white.  So it's okay, I like it well enough.  I don't think I would buy this again though. Didn't hit me like the kind I had, so I'm still looking... I'm interested in trying other brands and also the white truffle for my "Truffle Research". :)

My first experience with truffle oil is a real pleasure.  Very pleased with this product.  A "finishing" oil, not a "cooking" oil, just a few drops sprinkled over, or stirred into prepared foods just before serving, adds a whole new level of delicious taste.  Have enjoyed trying it sprinkled on eggs, fish, NY Strip steak, potatoes, tossed into hot pasta, tossed salad, hot vegetables ...outstanding on mashed potatoes!I have two 3.4-ounce bottles and before opening a bottle, telephoned Roland Products to confirm that the small shaving or two that I could see floating in the bottom of each bottle was, as I suspected, actual black truffle shavings.  That impressed me.  The ingredients on the labels are: extra-virgin olive oil; black truffle (tuber aestvum vin); black truffle aroma.  Product of Italy.

This was a great price and I lurve anything truffle. This was just ok. It's truffly, but also has something else I can't place my finger on, but that I don't like. The white truffle sea salt is a better investment.
Good price, came quickly and since there were two, I kept one and gave one to my mom . She added some to some sauteed baby portabello mushrooms and they were delicious.

column9: The best truffle oil I have tried.  Amazing, delicious and sensual...
column10: I received this oil as a Christmas gift and I couldn't be happier!It is hard to put into words how amazing and absolutely wonderful this oil is, what it does for food and how it seduces the taste buds.I recently ordered a different highly rated truffle oil and was so dissappointed that I have no other choice but to get rid of that oil and order more Roland truffle oil.My only complaint is that I can't order a larger bottle that the 3.4 ounce 2-pack.  Hey Roland, how about gallon bottles of this stuff?Love it, love it, love it.Thank you for such an amazing and pure truffle flavored oil.
use this on pasta or toasted fresh breads!  Alittle goes a very long way!!

I received my oil and did not realize how small the bottles were.  Cannot be returned so I will savor them when I use them.  I know truffle oil is very expensive but this is a joke.  I will not buy these again.

For those hazelnut lovers out there, you MUST TRY THIS!!!  I had no problems with the product as far as separation.  A good thorough mixing remedies this and I put some that was a little more solidified in the microwave for a few seconds to soften and then it mixed up just fine.I used the recipe on the label to make the filling for a brownie torte I made over the holidays.  People RAVED over it.  Someone even said it would win contests if I entered it into a baking contest.  And I HATE TO BAKE!  I plan on purchasing the 2 pack next time and can't wait to make the full cake recipe from the label, ice cream and other deserts with it!

column9: Even more delicious than I had hoped...
column10: Yummm!  We ordered the plain dried cherries and the chocolate covered dried cherries a while back and they were both delicious!But these are so good!  Upon opening these, they have an aroma reminiscent of white chocolate with maybe a faint hint of vanilla.  They are soft and delicious, with just the right sweetness.What a terrific healthy snack - Moms, I recommend them for your children!

We have purchased both the Traverse City dried cherries in plain as well as the yogurt-covered and find the quality to be the best of any similar offerings we've come across elsewhere in our travels.  We highly recommend if you enjoy dried fruit. The cherries are actually quite moist yet in their dried state and not tough and chewy as much dried fruit turns out to be . . . .

This product is worth every cent spent. If you like cherries not sweet but tardy then this is the product for you.I put them in my oatmeal while still hot and they plump up and taste so so good and they are healthy for you too.When I have a sweet tooth I grab about a cup of these and I'm satisfied instead of eating something that is loaded with sugar and not healthy for you.I also purchased their other dried fruit..cherries, cranberries and chocolate covered cherries. All are just yummy in the tummy!!!!

column9: Not a Cherry fan but with these I can't tell I'm eating cherries
column10: I ordered the dried cherries with no yogurt before Xmas and they were so good!  Amazon was out of stock, so I ordered the yogurt covered dried cherries. column9: The most bang for the buck for your daily cuppa
column10: Lipton Yellow Label is CTC (crush, tear, curl) processed black Indian tea. Lipton makes it for the UK and India markets where folks take their tea with milk and sugar. CTC tea looks a little like coarse coffee grounds, and it brews quickly into a dark robust liquor that can stand up to milk and sugar. Some tea drinkers say the process gains heartiness, but at the cost subtlety and perfume.  CTC makes a stronger brew than leaf tea or (ewww) tea bags. Start with ¾ tsp of Yellow Label per cup, and steep for just three minutes, and adjust to taste next time. I find a second extraction (six-minute steep) to be quite drinkable. Again, a matter of taste.  I settled on Yellow Label for my daily cuppa after trying several kinds of leaf tea over the years. I also tried Tetley, another CTC blend, but found it one-dimensional and heavy. Single-estate leaf teas still delight my Inner Tea Snob, but their cost makes them occasional treats, not daily tipples.  And it's on the scale of value for money where Yellow Label is a clear winner. I know of no other tea in its price range that tastes as good. Yes, you can find teas that offer more complexity, subtlety and bouquet - for a lot more money.  If you're looking for a daily cuppa that delivers real tea satisfaction for just pennies a cup, it's hard to go wrong with Yellow Label. Start with the one-lb box (about $11). Two two-lb boxes ($35) are even better value, but that's a year's worth of tea in my house.

I have been drinking Lipton Loose Leaf Tea my whole life.  The tea in this large box is not the same as the tea in the 1/2 lb. boxes. I thought it would be more cost effective to order the larger package, but now I have to figure out a way to get rid of this tea and re-order the smaller boxes.  Maybe I can add it to my compost pile!  I just wish I had known.
I'm very pleased with the taste and I like the round instead of the leaves.  I will definitely continue to purchase again.

I normally use PG Tips and Twinnings brands and  Red Rose when I  can get it, and love green and herbal teas also (let's face it I love TEA-- and even coffees too for that matter, though not so much of that nowadays) but bought this Yellow Label based on reviews here at Amazon and elsewhere on the net and am glad I did. I'll drink even more tea now, because of both the excellent taste and the value.

If you are just trying to cut back on salt, again this soup will work fine.  I personally feel that most of our food has way too much salt and sugar in it so I thought I would give this product a try.  I like the convenience of it being ready to serve but I must admit, it has very little flavor.  It's almost like drinking water with a slight mushroom taste.  Truthfully, I miss the salt.  I think that soup, generally, needs salt but as I stated, most are much too salty, however, this soup is just too bland.  When I added a little bit of salt, that made a big difference.  Also, I noticed that the soup is very watery and thin.  I like my mushroom soup a little more substantial.  I do think this soup would work very well in casserole recipes.  I probably will not purhase the low sodium variety of Campbell's Mushroom Soup but I do like many of their other products.  However, and this is important, if it is an absolute necessity that you cut back on salt for health reason, then this soup would be perfect for you. Some non-salt seasoning could make it more flavorful.  I give Campbell's credit for trying to make their products more health conscious.  More companies should do the same. We do not drink this hot, as we usually choose herbal blends for hot tea.  The reason I choose this one over Uncle Lee is pure economics--it's a better buy through the Subscribe and Save program.  Thank you Bigelow and thank you Amazon!

I've been waiting for ages for this product to show up on Amazon so that I can review it.  I've been enjoying Mrs. Renfro's Mango Habanero salsa for quite a while, enjoying its fantastic heat/sweet ratio, and just wishing it was chunkier and a bit hotter.  Then along comes this stuff.  They must have been listening!I'm pretty sure this is the hottest salsa Mrs. Renfro's offers, and I think it's the perfect level for those of us who really enjoy some heat with our salsa but don't have a hot foods shoppe nearby.  I'll take this opportunity to kvetch that I have seen some reviews out there--video reviews--of people opening a jar of this stuff, dipping the corner of a chip in it, eating the whole chip, and going, 'Oh, it's not that hot.'Yeah, duh.  It's not hot sauce, people.  It's SALSA.  It's meant to be enjoyed in moderate SCOOPS, not in tiny little dollops like Blair's Sudden Death (excellent, btw).  SCOOP the stuff onto a chip the way you're meant to, and have yourself about five chips in this manner.  Now stop.  ...  Yeah, I *thought* you'd be reaching for the tissues.  Welcome to chips and salsa.  That's how you eat them.Onward: This salsa has a great texture--it could be chunkier, it's true (all the Mrs. Renfro's salsas have this issue), but it's chunkier than many of their others, and it's still thick enough to stick to the chip.The flavour is almost a head-scratcher.  When you get that first bite, right before the heat smacks you across the face, there's this moment of, 'Ooh.  Hey.  What's that?'  Some have called it curry-like, others chili-like (not as in pepper, but as in a pot of chili).  I realize this makes me a bad reviewer, but I'm honestly not sure *what* it is.  I think it's part garlic, part roasted tomatoes, and part... part... oh, I don't know.  Liquid deliciousness?  Yeah, that sounds right.Upon first bite, this salsa became my current favourite.  (I'd spell out the happy moan I let loose when I first tried it, but this is a family site.)  In the course of a month, I have finished four jars of it.  That is not an exaggeration.  I have been driven to unexpectedly have chips and salsa for dinner more times than a person should (should they ever?) for the love of this salsa.My local grocery put it on sale.  Oh, bad move, people.  I cleared them out.  Thank the chili gods that they restocked.I have tried a lot of salsa in my life.  Most of the really good spicy stuff is only available in chilihead specialty shoppes or online with massive shipping charges (but hey, the stuff is heavy).  To my knowledge, this is the hottest salsa (I repeat: NOT HOT SAUCE) that you can find in a regular grocery store.I've already recommended it to all my friends who enjoy hot foods or have people in their family who do so.  Now I recommend it to you.  Enjoy it!  I know I do.

Brutal stuff, but still edible.  The salsa itself is a bit tangy, average taste for a salsa, but you won't care about that after a couple of minutes anyway, because your face will be melting off.  Just kidding.  This is a great option for anybody who wants to partake of the bhut jolokia, but without the fear of the hotter concentrated sauces (or the evil evil evil "extracts").  The pain is only temporary, hold milk or an ice cube in your mouth if you overdo it (water will not cool chile burn).

I have enjoyed Mrs. Renfro's Habanero Salsa. Last time I went shopping, I noticed that the salsa section in the store included this--the ghost pepper in a salsa.If you don't like heat, don't try this. If you like heat, be judicious in how much salsa you put, for example, on a tortilla chip. I just had about 6-7 chips a half an hour ago. I was spare in how much salsa I put on each chip. WOW! The burn was pretty good, and the taste of the salsa, despite the heat, was fine. For most of the past half hour, I have had a lingering burn in my mouth.So, if one is interested in a hot salsa, this is terrific. But be careful in how much you use. Too much and this would be inedible for most of us. The right amount? You have a spicy (yet still tasty) condiment.

If you happen to like Road's End "cheese" sauce then you will like these.You need to add more liquid than the directions call for though or these turn out gummy and dense.  Increase water to 1 & 1/2 cups and increase "milk" to 3/4 cup or even a little more.  I add Earth Balance margarine too and they turn out so much better.Update 6/23/10:  I've now tried both the Roasted Garlic and Homestyle varieties and I love both.  Just make the above changes to prep directions and they are perfect.  So the problem was the Road's End "Chreese" sauce they used for these.

People's tastes vary for sure, and I'm not really big on cheese substitutes, but I found these to be really good! A fellow vegan recommended them, which prompted me to try them, and I wasn't disappointed. I make them at home sometimes or take them for lunch, but I especially like to take them out backpacking. column9: A solid deal for a good-tasting cereal that won't inspire eater's remorse
column10: Honey Bunches of Oats is not the sort of cereal that a fitness enthusiast will eagerly endorse. The fiber tally is a bit low at 1.4 grams and the sugar total is a bit high at 6.5. There are certainly much worse offenders, but whole-grain and 'no sugar' alternatives are inarguably better for your waistline.On the other hand, they tend to taste much like you'd expect. Honey Bunches of Oats with Almonds is a nice mix of crunchy textures and pleasant flavors. With a bit of banana or some fresh berries, you'll actually enjoy this bowl of breakfast. If you are really watching what you eat, you'll want to focus your attention elsewhere, perhaps staring fixedly at the superior nutritional content of your oat flakes as you munch away with steely determination. If not, and if you actually prefer to enjoy your meals, Honey Bunches of Oats (HBoO for short) is a fine choice. This particular variety boasts almonds, which normally would be enough to possibly perk up the calorie counters, but not in great enough volume to push the health food needle. They merely add a pleasant complement to the palate.My 4-pack arrived relatively intact, with just enough crumpling on the base of one of the boxes to merit that bit of equivocation. Shucking the plastic sheath to liberate the cereal itself was easily done without any further damage done along the way.

I am voting based on two things. One: I already liked this cereal, a lot. Two: they had a can't miss price on it. I would say that the boxes are a little small if buying in bulk. I'd rather have less packaging for the same amount.
