column10: Bought this because other reviewers highly rated comments and it is as close to the real thing but make sure you mix it good and a blender works best,chill it and its awesome!Add more or less to your liking.
I have been using this for over a year now. It is so much more convenient than using UHT and in my opinion, it's the closest you will get to the taste of real skimmed milk from a powder.
Pro-small packages; easy to pour-reasonable price-quality greatCon-would be great if there is a more secure of closing the bag once opened

column9: Bob's Red Mill Non-Fat Dry Milk Powder
column10: It's true what others are saying, that you have to mix it up in a blender.  But it take a few seconds to do that so it's not too bad.  Though it's a bit of trouble to make it is well worth it.  The taste is remarkable.  You would think that it had fat in it.  I took the autoship on this product as I didn't want to be without it.  I highly recommend this.  The taste is great!

Does not mix well by hand, but my sweet wife has a hand-held electric shake mixer to do the job.  She uses 1/2 cup less than recommended per gallon and it still taste rich and great.  She also uses it to make yogurt and it works great at this also. So far the 'SS' price has been steady (not risen) for the past 4 or 5 months that we have been receiving it.  Thanks Amazon and thanks Mr. Bob.

I make yogurt from our fresh goat milk.  It requires some dry milk.  Our local supermarkets have all switched to instant, it does not work, it is an inferior product, made for the "Instant" world.  The Bob's Red Mill is just what I had been searching for.  It smells and tastes good.  The 4 pack sold on Amazon brings down the cost of my yogurt.Even thought the milk has been heated before adding the dry milk, I sometimes have had difficulty getting the small limps out.Maybe in cold milk this doesn't happen, but in hot, boiling, it does.  Other than that it makes a great product.  before finding this product on Amazon, I was ordering non-instant dry milk from a dairy in Wisconsin, from there to the PNW, the shipping was very expensive, so, way to go Amazon!

I have bought all kinds of powdered milk over the years.  I just like to have a box on hand.  Well, this looked different in the photo and I decided to try it.  I couldn't believe how good it taste.  It doesn't taste like other powdered milks.  I bought one and then turned around and bought a box of four.  I love it.  I didn't know powdered milk could taste so close to the real. I will definitely keep this on hand.  Sometimes I don't make it to the store and I do love my milk.  I can make this and not feel like I am being cheated from drinking the real thing. I think it doesn't take as much to make this as it does other brands.  But regardless, it is worth every penny to me due to its real-like flavor of milk.

I love this milk powder.  I have never had any trouble mixing the powder into water, I use a whisk and it blends perfectly.  We purchase local, organic milk for our milk drinking needs and then I supplement our milk baking/cooking needs with this powder.  This powder helps to make mac n cheese, muffins and other baked goods more affordable while still avoiding the hormones added to most milks.

It tastes good but is difficult to dissolve even in cold water. It needs to be stirred/whisked for quite a while before the powder dissolves. It is best dissolved in cold water as it clumps up even if the water is lukewarm.

column9: Bob's Red Mill Non-Fat Dry Milk
column10: I really like the taste of this milk, but find it too expensive for my everyday use.  I am returning to SACO.
I have a dog treat business in NM and I use this ingredient in my recipes.  It is incredible and you don't have to worry about the properties of it being a live product.  Very dependable!

I have no use to reconstitute the milk, which is clearly states can't be done on the package, but I use it in baking breads with fantastic success! Simply weigh (or measure) the appropriate amount into the other dry ingredients, and add water when the recipe calls for milk. Perfect and tender crumb every time!
Mixing takes a few minutes, but time worth spent. Tastes great---definately superior to "fresh" skim (non-fat) milk. Love it!

It's almost impossible to get the lumps out of this short of using a stick blender.  Also, the bags that the milk comes in are very weak.  I dropped one from my counter top and milk power went everywhere.

Unless you use a blender to mix your milk powder, this does not incorporate well by spoon. Even with a blender, it tended to cling to the sides of the blender. I have never had a problem with any of Bob's Red Mills products, except this one. Sorry!

This milk powder is too fine. With your average supermaket dry milk, you can just sprinkle the powder into your oatmeal and it will dissolve. This stuff, on the other hand, turns into chewy clumps unless you reconstitute it separately with a whisk. As a result, there are still three bags of this milk powder sitting in my cupboard, unused.This milk tastes fine. It's just too much of a pain to use.
Mix with little cold water then boiling hot water add sugar as desired and I'm good to go. Also it is free from HORMONE GROWTH treated cows, it's NON FAT ,ORGANIC and taste great.

This milk has an excellent flavor and we are satisfied with it in every way.  It makes very good yoghurt, and is indistinguishable from fresh milk.  It needs to be reconstituted using a blender and warm water, then it is done very quickly.  We have ordered it for monthly delivery.

Amazon has since removed its description of this dried milk as an "excellent" source of vitamin D, but alas vitamins A+D are still lacking. Unless you take a multi-vitamin I suggest the Saco brand, which is properly fortified and in my opinion tastes better.

column9: Bad aftertaste, but easy enough to blend. Doesn't taste like normal milk.
column10: I used to drink several cups of bottled 2% milk a day.With this powdered milk, I can barely manage to drink a cup a day. Ew. It's not tasty.This Dry Milk Powder tastes a little off, and has a bad aftertaste.I'm happy it's available with Subscribe & Save, though I regret spending the price on something that just doesn't taste like normal milk. I've tried different variations on water/milk measurements. I've added ice, sugar, everything I can think of. Still, I can't manage to drink a whole glass of this stuff. And, I've tried tons of brands of bottled milk over the years and never found one I couldn't tolerate.... until this stuff.Maybe I'll use this for baking. I would only drink this as "normal" daily milk if I was very desperate. This stuff just doesn't taste right, and leaves a gross non-milk aftertaste.I'll reluctantly give it 3 stars because it's on Subscribe & Save, because it's easy enough to blend, and because it doesn't make me gag. But, no, it doesn't like not "normal" milk and I really don't care for the taste at all. Ew.

column9: Made For The Customers Not Insects
column10: This taste good and comes In a strong plastic package but where the milk comes from I have No Idea, I hope It comes from healthy Cows that are naturally feed. Many companies are more concerned with making a package that will burst open easy so Insects can get Into It and becomes a waste of money to The Customer.

column9: Creamy but pain in a** to mix
column10: Creamy but very, very difficult to mix- even w/ hot liquids. If not for "no-return" would absolutely have returned for refund.

column9: Packaged in Oregon but where did this milk originate!??
column10: I use this milk powder for baking and am very glad to have it on hand since we often did not finish a carton of milk and it took up valuable space in the refrigerator.It does smell nice but I am concerned about Bovine Growth Hormone and will switch to Organic Valley milk powder when I run out.This item was one dollar cheaper last year.

column9: Mostly it's just salt, still not bad!
column10: Not quite the same as the cheese powder in your box of Kraft macaroni. This topping is a fine alternative to salt, but does not add a great deal of non-salt flavor. This is very similar in taste and texture to, for example, Reese Popcorn Salt, which is finely pulverized table salt, but Kraft adds whey and powdered milk and a ton of orange coloring to make this salt seem more like cheese. It gives it a slightly sour taste, which might sound unpleasant, but actually does the trick beautifully compared to the much plainer "salt with dye" cheese sprinkles I've tried in the past. Still... If you're truly interested in cheese flavor, use finely grated cheddar (lightly sprinkled, it will melt like butter on piping hot popcorn) or go for something like grated parmesan cheese (or the powdered version, which, when sifted finely, makes the ultimate cheese topping, since it is, of course, actually cheese) for a fuller flavor. Another popular alternative, if you want to stick to powder, seems to be Barry Farms dried cheddar cheese, although I have never tried it myself. :)

When I was a kid there used to be a grated American cheese product that was put out by Kraft.  I don't know if it was available everywhere, but it was always at the local A&P in my town, and I came to like it better than any of the fancy grated Parmesan or Romano cheeses.  It came in the very same 3 oz containers like here on Amazon.  Something of a pain for I liked it so much I didn't care how much it cost, I just wanted it all the time. (It would have been nice if it came in larger sizes). There was simply nothing like its flavor on pasta.  It was easily distinguishable by its yellow/orange color, and its much tangier, richer cheese taste.  My father, along with many others considered it junk compared to grated Parmesans, but I didn't really care what was in it.  I only knew it gave pasta a whole new flavor that was as deliciously cheesy in a grated form that was available.  A long time ago it disappeared from many local stores.  My father used to tell me that they stopped making it because only two people would buy it.  Me, and the guy that invented the stuff.  But according to the reviews here I see I am not alone.  This product is essentially the same thing as the grated american cheese of my youth in the very same small 3 oz containers.  And I am happy to report that it is just as fabulously delicious as I remember it.  Ordering 12 at once will not see it go bad here.  We have spaghetti at least once in a week in my house and I load it with this stuff.  I am a self confessed grated cheese fiend, but nothing compares to this  topping in my opinion.  It's not pure, it's not really healthy, it's not aged all that much, it's just plain delicious.  It can  be compared to chomping down a hot dog smothered with mustard and ketchup and enjoying it immensely, and someone telling you there is no real food in it, or good for you. You don't eat hot dogs everyday, and you won't eat this that often either.  If you like grated cheese like I do, I would strongly urge you to try this grated american cheese product.  Its the most flavorful grated cheese topping around, and I recommend it.  My only reason for taking one star off is the price.  With shipping its a little pricey, but still worth every cent.  It's really hard to find in stores, and even when you do they tend to run out.  It seems to be always here on Amazon, and I say give it a delicious try....

column9: If you love lamb you will love this glace
column10: Lamb is one of my all time favorite meats.  At this time in my life I am more interested in the quality of my meat versus the quantity.  Instead of those huge porterhouses of my past I now relish in the delicate, complex flavor of lamb chops.  Although I am not religious I usually buy my lamb at a Halal butcher shop because I find Kosher and Halal meat to taste better.Whether I am serving a rack of lamb or slices from a whole leg nothing compliments the dish better than a well crafted sauce.  I own many cookbooks dedicated to the making of sauces and most recipes call for is either a reduced stock, a glace or a demi-glace.  More Than Gourmet's Glace D'agneau is a classic lamb/veal stock reduced 20 times.  The glace can be added to a stew to produce a thick, flavorful gravy or it can be used to make a lamb-flavored version of one of many classic brown sauces.I have used almost all of More Than Gourmet's glaces and I can't imagine cooking without them.  They are available in 16 oz. tubs or these little 1.5 oz. pucks.  Each unit comes with a sauce recipe and more are available on their website.

Teenie Genie is actually Eugenia species, one that even as a bonsai guy for 25 years I find difficult to keep alive. Care for bonsai trees is generally difficult enough with daily watering and continual pruning, but one that crisps at the first missed watering is one I call problematic. For anyone willing to follow the watering requirements, this may be a fine tree. I just wish it came with a stronger warning against neglect. While I usually find Brussel's to be a fine company to buy from, the pruning of my tree was considerably less refined than what was pictured. I would recommend Kingsville Boxwood over this Eugenia both for it's fine leaves and sturdier constitution, but it will likely be from a different source within Amazon.

column10: Brussel's DT0117ALW Hawaiian Umbrella Tree in Water Pot Bonsai:  I received it as a gift from my daughter.  It was easy to set up.  The only problem was when I first placed the white stones, I put them in the water area instead of in the drain tray.  The drain tray with the white stones in it allows the water to be slowly absorbed thus protecting and prolonging the life of the tree.  I have had it for a month and it didn't loose any leaves as reported that it might.  I bought a little misting bottle for daily soft mists and monitor the tray's white stones.  If I can't see water in the stones I add a little water.  Love the plant!

I have many bonsai trees and am a true lover of the art of bonsai.  First things first, when I ordered this tree it arrived quickly but was literally frozen.  Needless to say the tree died within 2 days of arrival since frozen roots are bad for plants.  Amazon was fairly quick in sending out a new tree and thankfully the new tree arrived UNfrozen.However the disappointment didn't quite end.  I'd like to point out that the second tree is completely healthy and still thriving after 3 months of my care, so kudos to shipping a healthy tree.  However, anybody with an appreciation of the art of bonsai will be very disappointed by the training this tree received.  It looks more like it was completely untrained and just allowed to grow naturally.  This is antithetical to good bonsai and leads to a pretty ugly (read: normal/average) tree.  It's just way too ORDINARY.Another nice note, since I hate to leave on a sour note, is the pot the tree comes in.  This is a very nice pot and would probably retail by itself for $15 or $20.  Nice quality and aesthetic that would compliment a properly trained tree if only it were..Cheers

column9: Okay plant.  Don't order in cold weather.
column10: I ordered this plant in February as a gift.  The ups driver left it on my porch and by the time I got to it,it was dead.  Within a week every leaf fell off.I contacted Amazon and was sent a replacement plant (weather was warmer when it shipped) which is very healthy.The negative side is that the first plant I received had a really cool shape and had moss growing over the dirt. The moss helped the dirt stay in place on the other one... the newer one is hard to water because the dirt and stuff gets in the water tray no matter how careful you are.  The first one I received looked old in a good bonsai way.  The new one I received looks like a young tree (not 5 years at all) and has no interesting shape.  It just looks like a tree.  It is pretty and we decided to keep it because it was healthy.Another con is that even though the pot is very cool looking, it has a water hole on the bottom so you need a tray or else water gets on your furniture.  By the photo I thought the water drained into the water pot... some of it does, the rest ends up on the furniture.  We went to a bonsai store and bought a tray which is black and doesn't really match.My advice is go to a bonsai store and pick the one you like and works for you.  With this bonsai, it's the luck of the draw.

column9: The tree dried out in two days
column10: I purchased the tree for our 5 th wedding anniversary for my spouse. It the started drying out from the next day on. It's a waste of money and worst kind of gift.

column4: Cool Life in AZ "Nuts for Brussels Griffons"
column10: I have a small Brussels Griffon and he has had terrible skin problems for 7 of his 8 otherwise wonderful years. He has been constantly on and off prednisone, antibiotics, antihistamines, and Atopica -- they work while he is taking them but in 10-14 days he is again covered by all kinds of sores and rashes. It has been diagnosed as dermatitis which gets worse with stress. Stress is if no one is home - he is home alone at most for 2-3 hrs/day. The infections are secondary due to his immune system being compromised with the skin broken, crusted and inflamed. The itching has been at times terrible, and only prednisone or topical ointments have helped with that.I switched him to this Avoderm Trout food and 4 lbs later I counted just two tiny irritated areas on his skin today!! I cannot believe it - I'm in shock - how is this possible?? While taking this food he has not been medicated - except for 2-3 times a week getting a 1% cortisone skin conditioner after a short wash which he has been getting for over a year now and it has helped a little but never stopped the rashes.I don't know if his great skin is all due to switching to this food because I started to give him one drop of Oil of Oregano, and mixed some "Doctor's Best Curcumin C3 Complex with BioPerine (500 Mg), Capsules, 120-Count" and Now Foods Quercetin with Bromelain, Veg-Capsules, 240-Countin his pumpkin treats about a month before switching his food. I will now stop the herbal supplements and see if he will do this well just on this food!! I will update the review in a few months...

I live in a very rural area. There is a store about 15 miles away that sells Alvita teas. The last two times I have been there they have been out of Valerian Root Tea. i find this product very effective in helping me sleep. This seller was inexpensive and responded very quickly to my order. Thank you!

column4: Jennifer Trump "A conclusion is what we come ...
column10: These are delicious little chubs of well-flavored meat.  We used two of them in my authentic cassoulet dish that took me five hours to create - and we were not disappointed.  They were fresh and still cold upon arrival.

column9: Fine Chai Spice Tea---Without the Caffeine!
column10: ****This is a decaffienated version of Stash's chai spice tea, made from blended black teas, ginger, cinnamon, allspice, nutmeg, cloves, and natural flavors of cinnamon, clove, and cardamom. Many chai spice teas (which I drink plain without milk or additional sweetener) nauseate me, but this one did not---I loved it! The numerous spices are a unique taste sensation, and enjoyable cup of tea. I brewed the tea as I always do, leaving the tea bag in far beyond the 3-5 minutes recommended brewing time, and the tea never turned bitter, just got stronger and tastier! Tastes exactly like the caffeinated version, but you can drink cup after cup because there is no caffeine!****

I really like the Nuun tablets. They are not as sweet as others and they have a little fizz, not too much, but enough to give it a little zip and keep it from being too sweet. The orange is my favorite flavor. They dissolve easily and provide the optimum electrolytes needed to sustain me on long rides. I wil use 1 to 1.5 (they are scored and you can break them in half) in a 24 ounce water bottle and it works out great. They have recently come out with some new flazors so I will be trying more.

column4: Tommie "An expert is a former drip under pres...
column10: I had bought my first container of Dynasty Five Spices to smell. I love the aroma! Then I started using it in my marinated cucumbers 'n' onions. Well, it doesn't last forever that way. I tried another brand of five spices but it didn't even begin to compare to Dynasty. There isn't anywhere around close where I can buy it so I was glad to find it on Amazon. True, the shipping is a little steep but I pay more than the total for spices in stores. This was worth it!
The product was such a great price, and it made my food taste so good.  I had a hard time finding this product elsewhere.
If you're looking for an unexpected way to spice up lots of dishes, this is a great start.  Makes Asian inspired dishes a breeze and adds flair to all kinds of dishes from salads to pastries.

I like Dynasty Chinese Five Spice as a product.  I use it in stir fry.  It is a strong flavoring that works well for me since I reduce my sodium intake. I wasn't able to find it locally when I ran out, so I decided to buy  the 6 pack choice thinking it should last for a year and a half or so.  In this case, the spices all came with a best used by 12/15/12 date.. 4 months only. I got.. old(er) spice.  Disappointing.

These breadsticks are the real deal. They are exactly like the ones I remember growing up with. The only downside is they don't travel well so expect about half of them to be broken in half. Nevertheless, I don't think there's a better breadstick available online.
I ordered these a while back... been eating them a few times a week.  They are really good.  Would recommend this product to others.

Have now tried all Auguri oils (Basil, Lemon & Orange) and they are wonderful.  All these oils are good to saute, marinate or drizzle on fish, chicken, beef or salads.  I particular like the Lemon on salads with a splash of white vinegar - yummy.  Try them with confidence and enjoy the unique flavors.
I'VE PURCHASED THIS PRODUCT BEFORE AND USED IT IN A VARIETY OF DISHES. FOR EXAMPLE, SALADS, FISH AND EVEN IN CAKES THAT CALL FOR OIL. THE PRICE AND QUANTITY IS A REAL DEAL.
This is not just a beautiful product in appearance but also in quality.Enhances the flavor of foods and is natural and unprocessed, too!
The tea didn't take long to ship, and was packaged well. The little gift box it came in was great and holds everything nicely. Great tea too.

This tea chest arrived quickly and is boxed nicely enough to give without wrapping.  I have not tasted all of these teas flavors but I do know that for myself all of the Wissotsky teas I have had have tasted wonderful and Wissotsky has definitely been the best brand I have purchased.  This gift is for someone who is Jewish and I know he will appreciated that the tea is from Israel and also Kosher.

column9: The best of the best! A+++++
column10: Wellness Core grain free is the absolute best wet food you can feed your dog. To my knowledge, it has the highest amount of protein of all canned dog food. My dogs love it, and I mean they go crazy for it and devour their dinner whenever I mix this stuff with their dry food. This product is also suitable for dogs of all life stages, including puppies, which is not the case with most canned dog food. It is expensive but worth the money. Wellness is a fantastic brand, free of by-products, bad preservatives and animal digest, which anyone in their right mind would not want to feed their dogs. A+++++

I have 2 boxers and mix a 1/2 a can along with their dry food for each...  They just love it!  I tried using one can each but it's too high in protein and they get the runs, so be sure to experiment with the right mix...

I give this food five stars because it is the best food for my Yorkshire Terrier. He was a very picky eater before I discovered this food but he's never picky with this food. I give him half a can of the small can in the morning and another half in the afternoon. Yorkies are prone to diabetes (everyone is) so to avoid his blood sugar from dropping, I feed him twice a day with a few healthy snacks in between and make sure that he gets exercise. This food is grain free so he looks lean and strong.

column9: Not the favorite, but still a good choice.
column10: This is the canned food that my dog(miniature schnauzer) has eaten the longest.  I began mixing it with the Core dry food, and it did well for some months.  Gradually, she lost interest, and I had to try other flavors.  I still present it about once a week, and can get her to eat it with some persuasion.  It seems to be one of the better foods for her, but not as readily accepted.

I switched to this food when my cocker spaniel was having stomach problems and vomiting often. I found that the Nutro Ultra had gluten in it and other foods we had tried had a lot of grain. She is thriving on this food and has no problems anymore. She is a high energy 3 year old and her coat is beautiful since we switched. I do not give this food to our 10 year old cocker. I think that the protein level and calories are too much for an older dog, although your vet would be better able to help you make that choice.

Have been using Core products for several years.  I supplement dry food with a little canned food and I prefer grain free for my dogs.  I've priced compared in several locations and I have not found a better deal anywhere else.

This is a great, grain-free canned dog food.  I have two small dogs who loveto eat and was trying to get their weight under control.  They've made bigimprovements with this in their diet, plus the dry food made by Wellness.The cans show up without any major dents, and the food itself actuallysmells relatively appetizing (for dog food).  Good for picky eaters, as well.

I have a 3 year old that can eat pretty much anything, but I have a 15 year old that has a very sensitive system.  I was feeding them Neuman's Organic Turkey and brown rice and realized that my old guy was having issues pretty often.  So, I have been mixing this in to transition them to just this grain free food and they LOVE it and he has had no issues at all so far.  It has been well over a month, and all is swell.  I am glad I made the switch.  And ... I just remembered, the reason I bought this was because a friend's dog was staying with us and that Golden is super allergic to grains, but was not really eating her food.  I mixed in a small amount of this with her regular dry food and she gobbled it all up.  I could not have her lose weight under my care.  I told her family and I believe they bought it to mix in her food now.  I am glad we switched!

I've tried many different dry foods with my chihuahua mix. She does okay with them for a little while, but then won't touch them. Even when she'll eat them, she takes her time and is not enthused at all. I decided to try a canned food to see if it might be more appealing to her, and since I like Wellness I tried this first. I started by mixing it with her dry food, but she went straight for the wet food, picking around the dry. She would eat some of the dry food at the end if I stood there and watched her. I kept this up for a couple weeks, then switched her over completely to the canned food, since my cat was eating her dry leftovers. She still gobbles it down after about a month, and still licks the bowl clean every night. I was concerned about switching her over to a completely canned diet, as I've heard not feeding dry food can cause problems with the teeth and gums, but I think brushing her teeth and giving her dental treats will be sufficient. It's nice that now she eats her whole meal within a couple of minutes, so I don't have to watch the bowl and make sure the cat doesn't eat it for her. I'm sticking with the turkey recipe for now, but if she starts getting picky again, I'll try the fish recipe.

My picky dog has never taken to a wet food so readily as Wellness Core. She really springs to breakfast with this stuff. We have put her on about a quarter-can a day of this along with a grain-free kibble. We're getting all grain-free in an attempt to address her flatulence. Yeah, it's worked like a charm. No more barley in my pup's diet!A couple cans were dented. I hope Amazon picks up direct selling of this item so I don't have to deal with Marketplace vendors next time.

Get what you pay for when you buy dog food, Wellness CORE is one of the few canned foods I will feed my dogs.  I lost my Airedale to melamine poisoning, thus am a rabid label reader. When you feed canned and dry, why have non meat items in the product? Less grain is better IMO.

Wellness foods, in general, seem to be as fine a quality as you can give your pet short of a completely homemade diet. A grain free diet is helpful to my golden retrievers (food allergies) and Wellness Core offers several protein options in a grain free formula. I think its important to feed canned along with kibble (and some fresh veggies - usually green beans - as well). There are many fine ways to feed dogs and cats, but this works for mine. Wellness Core is a consistently excellent product and the doggies love it.

this graiin-free food changed my dog's life for the better.  his system with dog food containing meat by-products and grain was stressed.  he now runs to his food bowl and clean his plate every meal.  i have recommended this food to friends along with the equivalent kibble.

column9: Buyer Beware - These Chocolate Almonds are not worth the price
column10: Based on the four 5 Star reviews, we purchased two tubs of these on Amazon.  While the chocolate outside is flavorful, the inside nuts are stale, and very old tasting.  They do not compare to higher quality and more expensive name brand nut products.  Imagine a several year-old opened can of peanuts, and that is what these almonds taste like.  Buyer beware - these are Costco low ball priced chocolate covered almonds being resold by a distribution company.
I could eat these all day. Being a diabetic makes this a huge no-no, but the coating compared to the size of the almond makes this a great choice for a once in awhile indulgence. I love them.

These almonds arrived in a clear plastic bag closed with a plastic tie.  There is no original packaging or brand name on them.  It is as if some person took a container of chocolate covered almonds out of their cabinet, tossed them in a plastic bag, and sold them to an unsuspecting person on the internet.  What company sells unmarked food items in a plastic bag that could have been tampered with at any point of the process?  I will be returning and would not recommend this company...at all!

Everyone in the office loves them.

I bought these about a month ago, and i'm about half-way through the tub. This is ONLY because i kept them at my girlfriends dorm, and we ate them in moderation because we both knew that these little almonds are so delicious that we would eat them until they were gone. Great taste, but you might find yourself craving a lot more than you think you will.

I am so happy with the speed, efficiency & quality of this order & can't thank them enough for the great customer service.

Well, on my last trip to Costco, I found a three-pound (48 oz,) plastic jar of Kirkland Signature Milk Chocolate Almonds. Well, the almonds are good food and the chocolate  contains a lot of anti-oxidents, doesn't it? Hmmmm. Maybe I ought to just try one batch of these. Mmmmm. They were excellent! Nice and fresh and good tasting. Yummy! I'm going to have to watch myself and not eat too many.In any case, I went to review these delicious little wonders and couldn't find any listed as Kirkland Signature, but I did find these Milk Chocolate Roasted Almonds (48 oz.) and the photograph looked exactly like my Kirkland Signature ones.  In fact, if you then read down into the description, you find that they are Kirkland Signature. And if you read some of the reviews you find that they have been repackaged into a plastic bag. What goes? I have no idea. I'll rate the product as very good and give it five stars. I'll let you buyers decide on what to do.Gary Peterson

A little disappointed that they didn't come in the box as shown in the picture but for the price, quality and quantity I think its worth buying.Note: I was going to leave seller feedback & noticed that the seller profile gives accurate info on the nuts' packaging. I really enjoyed this product. The price was right and the shipping was good. I really recommend this item. My children enjoyed them as well

I was shocked to find these chocolate covered almonds in a huge plastic bag and not in tubs like it is pictured on the website.  While the chocolate is tasty and the nuts are fresh, I'm not sure what I'm supposed to do with a big plastic bag of candies.  I wanted them in tubs to give away.  I"m very disappointed.
PRODUCT WAS FRESH, VERY TASTY AND PRICED RIGHT. I NOTICED IT WAS THE KIRKLAND BRAND WHICH IS A COSTCO BRAND.
It's just okay nothing extraordinary or unique! I wouldn't order it again. Chocholate was okay but some almonds taste old:(
I got the package from the mail guy open it and half of the of container was melted the reason i keap it is that my kids said that they will eat them ........

The product comes packed in a nicely sized square container, easily opened which allows for a quick handful of a very tasty chocolate covered almond. Based on my experience with Koppers, whose packaging is poor (plastic 5lb bag)and can be damaged during warm weather sitting in a non air conditioned UPS truck (My own personal experience)Kirkland's Milk Chocolate Roasted Almonds 48 Oz is a good and tasty product
Omgosh, I sooo looove this tea.  It has a nice-fruity flavor & a slight strong green tea after taste- even so, it still tastes great hot or cold..have purchased two cases!!

All of these cookies are individually wrapped, I presume to preserve freshness, which was the case, at least for the box that I tried.The "surprise" was that these cookes are light and very, very good.Not qualities usually associated with tasty desserts.A perfect gift!

I recently purchased (grocery store) this brand and type of coffee, and I must say it was really delicious.  Went online to see if I could save money with Amazon.com and saw the review here that really wasn't fair to mark down to 2 stars just because they didn't like the hazlenut flavor. column9: has too strong of a hazelnut taste and smell
column10: Those who like hazelnut will probably really like this,but I think it's flavor isn't very good.  I prefer Don Francisco's colombia coffee, it tastes much better like real coffee.

column9: Made in the US version, not the same recipe as Imported from Austrailia version
column10: I thought, wow, bulk Lucky Country Red Licorice, sweet, but alas no, it is a mass produced Americanized version from Lucky Country's new US manufacturing plant.  The recipe is completely different from the Lucky Country Red Licorice (same brand, same name) that is Imported from Australia.  The original recipe has more real licorice despite being a red licorice, and is much softer.  The Made in US version is your typical chewy waxy candy licorice with barely a hint of licorice, just pure sweet.  Shame on Lucky Country for taking a high end sophisticated product and watering it down like every licorice sold in every drug store in the US.  I'm heading back to Target or Trader Joe's for the real thing.

column9: Better in the Bags than in the tubs
column10: I received Old Country licorice in a gift basket for Valentine's day and fell in love. I ordered it in the 4/ 1 lb. tubs shown here and received it this past week. It is not soft, in fact it is a bit on the tough side. If you are considering making an order, wait for the bags. I do not think that the tubs are airtight.

I have been buying Lucky Country Licorice for about a year now. When I quit smoking it helped to have some to chew on. Great flavor and texture. The strawberry is impossible to find in the stores around here so was real excited to find it at amazon.com.
This product was chewy and had a good flavor.  I first tried it at Cracker Barrel but Amazon is cheaper and you get more product for the buck.

I like Licorice...but Lucky Country Aussiie Style Licorice I love. It comes in different fruit flavors. Doesnt have that platic taste like the flavored twizzlers do.In fact these are a bit different than regular licorice. Theyre better. They come thicker and pretty solid they are not hollow. The texture is a cross betwen a regular licorice and a fruit snack. I love these things.
My son loves this Aussie licorice and I couldn't find it anywhere EXCEPT on Amazon. It was shipped very promptly (in time for Xmas)and it disappeared all too quickly.
This licorice is sooooo good. Soft, very flavorful. Hard to find in storesnow- this flavor- black cherry- so I would recommend.
This is my second time ordering this Aussie Licorice - gave them out as gifts to my friends who also love black licorice. Very soft and flavorful - happy they were back in stock!

We really liked this licorice when it was sold in the store. It was the same exact brand, but a different container. We ordered some online when the store didn't carry it anymore. It was a little hard, stale and the flavor was off. Didn't taste the same. Seemed a little pricey as well for the product we received.
This is the only place where I can find the pineapple flavor. The product is great!
Good - but not as good as the Australian licorice that actually have strawberry seeds in it.
This Lucky Country Licorice is some of the best we've tried. It's rich tasting, soft and not too sweet. The 15 pound bulk container was a great buy and arrived fresh at our door in just a few days.

column9: Good, but not as good as the last time....
column10: My order arrived on time.  I bought this for friends at work.  It was good, as far as taste, but this time the licorice was a bit harder than usual.  What always got me about Lucky Country Licorice was the soft texture, but this time I was disappointed that it seemed a bit hard.
It just doesn't have the amount of licorice flavor as the Aussie made product.  Or, for that matter, most other quality licorice products.  I am still enjoying it, just not as much as I had hoped to.

I bought this as a gift for someone who likes pineapple. I'm not a huge fan, but tried a piece. It is soooo good. Tastes just like pineapple, plus is soft and chewy, not like hard licorice at all. Highly recommend this product.
As the licorice goes this is pretty good stuff. If you haven't tried this one and are debateing it, give it a shot.

My neice was visiting from California and tried some pineapple licorice ( not available in Calif. ). She absolutely LOVED it ! I sent her the 12 6 oz. packages for her birthday and now I am the greatest auntie on earth !
This stuff has no distinguishable flavor to it, just a stagnant sweetness.  It is just terrible.  Black cherry, my arse.  Yuck!  And, these are its good points.

I was given a sample of this licorice from a friend who bought it at Bed, Bath, and Beyond.  With so many of the standard brands having little flavor, this was an immediate standout.  I have only tried the strawberry flavor, but it has a rich taste, and is a "soft" but still good and chewy licorice.  I love it.  When it wasn't available at Bed Bath, and Beyond, I found it on Amazon, and of course, it is considerably less expensive.  The only downside is that you must buy 12 6 ounce packages at once.  For me, that's not really a problem.
Lucky Country Licorice, Black, is the most like old fashioned black licorice that we've found.  We were very disappointed to find it was no longer available in the Costco stores where we shop.

column9: These are always voted the best black licorice
column10: I have purchased these several times.  They are always raved by everyone as the best black licorice.  It's hard for me to find in the stores but Amazon makes it easy.

column9: Too good can't stop eating them
column10: This is a very satisfying product.My wife and I have been looking for a licorice product that we could graze on. This is it!
My favorite licorice. Glad I can find it here. Keeps getting sold out at my local warehouse store. Thank you.

column9: Lucky Country Licorice, Black Cherry 16 oz tubs (pack of 4)
column10: Lucky Country Licorice, black cherry 16 oz tubs (pack of 4)... This candy is the best I have ever tasted, my last order was my third (3rd), it is realy good and may be habit forming to your tast buds.There are several items to choose from, which can be confusing. The best value is the 4-16oz tubs,4 lbs total vs the 1.5 pound package, they are both the same price. I found this to be wrong, on the part of Amazon to allow this to happen. I did not send the 1.5 lbs bag back, it wasn't worth my time, and I do like the candy...I live in Gainesville FL, not Zoe KY.

column9: I LOVE the Black Cherry and the Black!
column10: Yummy, chewy, filled with flavor in every bite.  I've also had the Green Apple and while good, not quite as satisfying.  The Black Cherry is devine!  The Cherry flavor pops with the first nibble; rich and full.  Now I need to try the other flavors.  Lucky Country is sometimes sold at Walmart (Black only) and used to be found at Costco....but is generally difficult to find.  Amazon has a great selection!

column9: Aussi Licorce made in the USA
column10: Does not seem as soft or as intense with flavor as the black licorce. However,some guest and friends prefer it over the black.Quite different than the traditional Strawberry---seems to have more of a multi-berry/cherry flavor to it..
I'm a big fruit flavored candy fan and this is wonderful!! Really good flavor and nice and soft, great texture! I loved it - I only wish it came in more flavors! I recommend it highly!!
I ordered Lucky Country Licorice Black Cheery 16 oz tubs (Pack of 4) and that is not what I received. I was sent Black Currant which is awful so now what do I do?

I had purchased the Black licorice and thought it to be some of the best I'd ever had, and I do love licorice.  Ordered this only because the Black was not available, but found it tastes more like Grape, of which I am not fond.
My favorite. Soft, just chewy enough, and very flavorful. Not sure how this price compares to Costco.

column9: did not taste like the one we bought in Costco
column10: this candy was ok, but it had a different taste than the one we had previously bought at Costco, even though it was supposed to be the same flavor. But, the one in Costco said "new improved recipe" perhaps this one was the old recipe. I was disapointed. But the quality of the candy was fine. Just not the same as the one I already had. So, this candy is not being eaten any nearly as fast.This candy was a brighter red color, and not as soft. However, this candy did have a stronger strawberry flavor.
For a licorice addict this will do, but it isn't any better than Twizzlers, and might be worse.

I was not satisfied with this purchase.  The advertisement was for a bulk container and the licorice came in 5 plastic bags.  2 of the bags were torn open as a result of the shipping process.  The licorice itself is an excellent product but the item identified was not as ordered.I will not purchase this item here again.

column9: Picture not correct, there are no green ones in the package I received
column10: I had looked through all the available candied/sugar-coated fennel seeds and ordered these mainly because the photo shows some green ones are included. But there are only white yellow, pink and orange.  I'll update this review after I have used the seeds in the ice cream I will be making soon.
Crunchy, light and low calorie. A perfect snack in a convenient size pouch. Great for work or on the go!

Perfect balance of soy sweet and seaweed salty- with a great crunch.  I was very happy with these snacks.  Often I find similar crackers that don't have enough seaweed.  The 2 ounce bag is perfect for snacking, so that the crackers never get that chewy stale taste from the bag being open too long.
This hapi Nori Maki snack is delicious.  It is hard to find where I live so I am more than happy to order by the case from Amazon.

There seem to be few true malt vinegars available, but this one is outstanding.  A good acidic balance and a robust malt flavor.  We favor it on roast potatoes, in salads, and it makes an intriguing vinaigrette.  Let me suggest (1/4") thick slices of zucchini ... tossed in a little olive oil with freshly ground salt and pepper, and then grilled in a panini press) ... dressed with a bit of this fine vinegar and some chopped fresh basil.Bon Appétit!

My 3.5 yr old loves these things - they are a "special treat" for him in leiu of chocolate and candy - he does pour them directly in his mouth so they arent messy at all - I wouldnt give these to a younger child though, pieces are too small!I tasted them and they arent my cup of tea but my son sure does love them!

I recently discovered this product and my kids LOVE it! It is such a new and innovative format for my 4 year old.  When she was younger, she loved yogurt melts but now that she is a "big kid", she refuses to eat those melts because they are for babies.  Yo'Drops are crunchy, flavorful yogurt drops that feel like candy but are super healthy.  They are individually packed so I can throw a few packs in my purse when we are on the go.  I also keep a box of these in my car when my kids are are cranky and need a light, healthy snack in between meals.

column9: Whose idea were these?  Nice in theory, but...
column10: The plus first.  (Notice I only have one.)*These are individually packaged.Great for a snack on the go, you'd think right?  Not so much.Onto the drawbacks:* The pieces are tiny.  I'm talking like "nerds" candy sized.  Now, my 18 month old DD is right on track with her motor skills, but she cannot manage these by herself unless we are at home and I put them in a bowl and give her a spoon.  The pack we tried to eat on the go ended up mostly all over the floor (sorry Target!).*They aren't as tasty as the "baby" yogurt melts.  Now it may be that these are healthier (I did not compare labels) but my DD just doesn't get excited about them like she does the bigger yogurt melts.I saw a reviewer say that she gave these to her 4 year old.  I haven't given them to mine because I bought them for the baby, but I'm guessing there wouldn't be enough in one pkg. to suffice as a snack.I wanted to love these but I just can't!

These are awful!  Do not waste your money.  My 2 year old daughter is a semi-picky eater so when she wouldn't eat them I tried them.  Ugh - I almost spit them out.  The taste was almost sour/bitter, and the texture was not good either - think stale rice crispies.  I threw them all away.  Its a shame because she likes all of the other Revolution Foods that I've ordered, but I will be more careful with ordering in the future.

The sweet taste was excessive and unpleasant.  I thought it was not fresh tasting.  The picture is deceiving because each fruit is cut in half and you get the top half only.  Other Marzipan is the entire round shape of the fruit. I am glad that I only bought the small size since I ended up throwing this purchase in the trash.

I fell in love with marzipan while in Spain, and was hoping to experience it again state-side.  This marzipan was way too sweet, while lacking the depth of flavor we'd come to expect.  I will not purchase it again.

I sent for this box of Marzapan fruits for a surprise for  my husband who is German.  He often tells of enjoying these as a boy in Germany.They arrived in quick time and in excellent condition.  Fresh and delicious ,  enjoyed by all.Excellent !!Thank You

I purchased this product today from TJ Maxx.  They just got it in, and it was only $5.99 so I thought I'd give it a try.  It was a bit too sweet and it tasted of almond extract instead of the natural gentle taste of real almonds.  My sister in law always brings the most delightful marzipan from Peru when she visits.  I hoped that this marzipan would be similar, but it wasn't.  Although it wasn't perfect, it was still good.  Unlike a previous reviewer, I didn't throw it in the trash--I nibbled until I ate the whole box.  It's also true that the fruit shapes are only painted on top--it's flat on the back.

column9: I kept going back for more!
column10: I bought this same brand and type of marzipan from a candy company in Santa Fe, New Mexico. It was so delicious that I went back the next two days in a row to get more for myself and my friends and family! I had never had marzipan before but was told that Biermann's is the best! I had another type as well recently but did not like it as much! Be careful though - this stuff is so delicious that it is addicting! Anyone want my address? Christmas is coming up and I'd love some more!

column9: Brand doesn't taste as good as it used to
column10: I'm a long time fan of Biermann marzipan candies and when I bought a box the other day, I was disappointed with the taste and wondered if they changed their recipe since last year. While the candies were fresh (not dried out), the almond taste wasn't very noticeable and they had a bit of a tang to them. I probably won't buy this brand again unless they go back to making it with a strong almond flavor like it had before.
I've lived in Europe--and I know good marzipan.  This was the best.  It is calling YOU!  Get some--you won't regret it.  AG

After spending three years in Germany, we became fans of the fancifully-shaped marzipan that was a staple for major holidays.  It's not easy to find these wonderful morsels in the average U.S. shops, and when you do see them, the flavor is not that special.  This assortment is just as we remembered, and family members are delighted to find several pieces in their Christmas stockings.  It wouldn't be Christmas without them!

column9: Great service ... even when USPS screwed it up!
column10: Product is great, and I ordered this a long time ago, for Xmas, and apparently the USPS returned it and said I had moved!  I've lived here for 30 years but the USPS has always be horrible.  This was a new one!One email to the vendor and they sent another via UPS!  Service with a smile I'd say!

After trying Popcorners on a recent trip I had to try more. These are great, so far I have tried the cheddar, cheesy jalapeno, butter, and sea salt, so far all have been tasty. Having a good gluten free snack food can be tough and these are a nice addition to the gluten free chips available.

I thought I was purchasing ground flaxseed because I read you only get the full effects if it is ground up. ( your body will digest the full seed it will only take longer i just put it n my blender until it was like coffee grounds) I put it in everything and I can really tell a difference. It has curved my appetite. I recommend buying this product if your trying to lose weight or just eat healthier. I've lost 36 pounds and with working out and adding this to my diet I've never felt so good

I love most of Stash's green teas.  LOVE them.  Most of them are grassy and flavorful but lack the bitterness of many other brands of green.This is the exception.  Blech!  It is incredibly astringent, something even more common in Jasmine greens than in a straight green.  I recommend trying it from a grocery store before committing to a large Amazon purchase unless you happen to like bitter tea.  That sounds absurd to me, but I do have friends who prefer their tea with a bitter bite.The Yamamotoyama Jasmine Tea Bag (which stash also sells, but I couldn't find it here) is flavorful but NOT bitter.

Stash is by far the best company for jasmine tea. I love this stuff! The only thing I would say to a new customer is don't reuse tea bags. Other than that, enjoy! It doesn't get better than this!I don't understand why you would buy it from this vender though. The shipping is outrageous! You can get this tea at many grocery stores, and there are many places online were you can get free shipping.

column9: Horrible to deal with, bad warranty, unpleasant, many are hard to chew
column10: We ordered a large sampler of most of their products and some other items from this company's brochure. The cover says "Harvest Fresh taste". So we thought it was like fresh fruit. It wasn't, and, being middle aged, we could not chew it, it stuck in our teeth, and most was drenched in sugar. We tried it all. No one wanted to eat any of it. We were dissatisfied. They also did not send a free item their brochure promises for purchases above 79 dollars.No fear, the second page says "100% guarantee. All our products are unconditionally guaranteed. If you or your gift recipient are not satisfied, please contact us for an immediate replacement or refund. It's important to us that you are happy with your order."So I did and asked for a refund. So far, not on your life. So far they have had roadblocks and stalling, like requests for data on the bottoms of tins, when most items, and there are a lot, are in  small cellophane packages in a large sampler with no tins. A mess and a time consuming, aggravating horror to deal with.Unless you are addicted to candied type fruits, many heavily sugared and tough and hard to chew, and cannot do without, keep away from this firm or find what you like elsewhere. Especially if your teeth are not the youngest. These people do not honor their guarantees and are really no fun to deal with. I emailed many times and called. Both ways were unpleasant. I probably will have to contact my credit card for help.

Frontier Pumpkin Pie Spice is the best I have ever tried. It beats McCormick's by a long shot. The fragrance is strong but not overpowering and the flavor comes through perfectly. I really cannot praise it enough. One of my favorite things to do is add a teaspoon of pumpkin spice to baked goods at the holidays - especially chocolate chip cookies. Pumpkin pie spice is not just for pumpkin pies.

I had been drinking millstone swiss chocolate coffee until they took it off the market a few yrs ago and had difficulty finding any other replacement until I came across this gourmet coffee online.I had never heard of Pears Gourmet coffee before but I took a chance and I was glad I did. I became addicted to this coffee and now have it delivered every 3 months.

I used to purchase Millstone Chocolate Almond from Dillons / Krogers, but Millstone stopped making that flavor.I've been purchasing this Pears flavor for many months, and it's very good.  When I fix this coffee for guests, they frequenlty comment on how good it tastes.

column9: Larks Cakes and Candy is a great seller!
column10: I am very pleased with the products and service from Larks Cake and Candy Supply. They have a large selection of many products that I have been unable to find anywhere else. Their prices are great. They package the order carefully and ship immediately. I do quite a lot of baking and am always trying new recipes, so it is really satisfying to have a resource to go to and find whatever it is I need. From ingredients to decorations I know I will find it at Larks. And because they always get the order in my hands -usually sooner than promised- I can plan my schedule with confidence knowing they will come through every time. Larks is my go-to for all of my baking needs. I highly recommend them any time, and especially if you can't find what you are looking for anywhere else. Go to Larks first - you won't be disappointed.
Really nice, strong flavors.  I ordered both the anise and orange oils. Shipment was very fast and efficient.  Would order again
This is the exact sauce used by Starb**** Delicious & it has saved me loads of $$$ will order more.

My Husband used to work at Starb**** and wanted to recreate his favorite drink (iced white mocha americano) at home with our Barista machine.  This is the exact same stuff as they use in the store and his drink turns out perfect every morning.  It lasts us about a month with a drink every day and it looks like this will be a regular buy for us from now on.

column9: Wow this stuff is dangerous to have around if you're on a diet, it's so good!
column10: I picked up one of these large containers of Fontana Caramel Sauce to use when making espresso drinks. It's sold at Star Bucks website, so I figured it was the same kind they used in their stores. The taste of this stuff is incredible! This is be far not just for drinks. This would taste amazing on ice cream, in a bowl for dipping apple in, etc. It's probably the best caramel topping I have ever tasted. It's just right in every way. Deliciously sweet, but not in an overpowering artificial way. I figured the jug would last forever, but this stuff is so good, it's hard not to sneak a spoonful of it to taste on it's own, ever time I'm near it making a coffee or tea. We will go through this container long before the expiration date ever gets near. The pump works really well, producing about a big spoonful with every press. I've had no issues with clogging or dripping, and when I received it, it had just been bottled about 2 weeks prior. So it wasn't sitting on a shelf for very long. It's a delicious topping that I will definitely be ordering more of when I run out!
Great!!! Tastes exactly like Starbucks! It is really nice because I do not need to get dressed to drink my favorite drink!
Tastes exactly like white chocolate mocha from Starbucks. I keep mine in the frige, because after awhile it starts to smell funny.
I love Dunkin Donuts coffee and mocha lattes,  now I can make them at home and it doesn't cost me anything, I have everything right there.
love it. i love getting the white chocolate mocha at starbucks but i cant afford to get one everyday so this works perfectly to make home. thank you

Awesome product! Just like you get at Starbucks. Fast and prompt delivery too. Overall great experience with vendor. Very happy with my purchase. The only thing I would suggest is to make clear in the description of the product that the item does come with a short pump.  I was a little worry I had to go out and buy one or order one on line. Keep up the good service! Hopefully you would make the creme brûlée sauce available for purchase as well. Thank you very much!

I was expecting a syrup similar to the one at Starbucks (since this product is sold through Starbucks). I was very sadly disappointed. The consistency was wrong, and the flavOr was horribly artifcial and "off". I asked for a refund.
This chocolate sauce was good but I prefer the Toriani White Chocolate sauce. It mixes better and has no high fructose corn syrup, it was better than the Ghiradelli one though.

column9: Very good, but odd in a way
column10: I purchased this sauce after figuring the saving on iced coffee would be almost $1200 over the course of a year. It is delicious with fast shipping and is easy to use. Just two pumps and it tastes just like Starbucks. The only thing i have against this is when you let your iced coffee sit for a few minutes, a clear grease-like substance will form into globules. I imagine as coconut butter is one of the main ingredients that this is merely a byproduct of the process. Still i will purchase more of this product when i need some.
This is my new addiction! The best white chocolate sauce there is. I have a standing monthly order. Now I can enjoy my favorite white chocolate iced coffee everyday, instead of once or twice a week.

column9: Fontana White Chocolate Mocha Sauce, 63 fl oz
column10: The product was awesome, better than having to go to Starbucks.This is the same sauce they use in your White Chocolate Mocha so you canhave your favorite hot mocha for a fraction of the cost..
This is the same as white mocha in Starbucks and I rarely go there now that I have my own espresso machine. Good stuff!

column9: Very close to in-store caramel sauce
column10: I was surprised at how good it is... and how close it is to the in-store sauce. However, I worked at Starbucks for 4 years and really know how to make drinks consistent at home with how I used to make them at Starbucks, so my caramel machiatto's are almost exactly like they are from the store. Now I'm happy the caramel matches (not 100%, but close).
I like to make iced mochas the most with my keurig. I pump 2 chocolate squirts in the coffee then poor over ice and mix in up to 1 cup of milk and it is delicious!

This is the same one used at Starbucks! I use it instead of cream and it adds a wonderful creamy and rich flavor to my coffee. Highly recommend. My only issue is that the pump doesn't always cooperate. No wonder they sell pumps separately.

This is the same mocha sauce as they use in that chain store. Make your own espresso add this and some almond milk....SO GOOD!! One downfall is that the pump only reaches halfway down the tub, so you have to end up pouring it out by hand. Well worth the money though...buy it! It lasted about a month...waiting on my second tub to arrive any day now!
With this great product I can make my own Iced white chocolate mocha at home. Saving time when I'm running late and saving me money. Taste just like the Starbucks. I love it.

column9: Delicious but too pricey from this vendor
column10: This is the caramel syrup used by Starbucks for drinks such as Caramel Machiatto and Caramel Brule Latte.  It is very delicious but you can get this syrup for less on the Starbucks website.  I love this stuff!!
This stuff tastes terrible. It is absolutely nothing like the kind you get at Starbucks. It also expired about a week after I bought it. Please don't waste your money.
I never tried the original Starbucks mocha powder, but I really would like to.  This product tastes good and makes good frozen coffee drinks.  Pretty good in my opinion.
I HAVE BEEN WAITING FOR STARBUCKS WHITE CHOCOLATE TO BE SOLD TO THE PUBLIC. THIS TAKES THE CAKE. I WILL ORDER ANOTHER ONE BEFORE THIS ONE GETS TO THE HALF WAY MARK.
We purchased this because they stopped selling the white mocha creamer by international in my grocery stores. It does not taste like the starbucks white mocha at all.

This is my sauce.  I claim it.  You all stick with your tabascos, franks and whatever else you like - this is mine.On a serious note - delicious stuff.  I have a long history with hot sauces and I have tried a wide variety.  I keep coming back to Matouk's Flambeau though - it isn't the hottest sauce out there but it is the tastiest. I am not sure why it tastes so damn good, but if you can put up with the heat it will take the place of ketchup in your house.I think the key may be the use of pickled peppers.  That seems like a rare choice in the hot sauce world.Taste - 10/10  The Habanero is one of the best tasting pepper's and this sauce is full of it.Heat - 6/10  This is the hottest of Matouk's line.  I have seen others mention they felt other Matouk sauces were hotter, but for me (and heat is a personal thing, some sauces will hit different people differently) this is easily the hottest.  That said, it is still a habanero based sauce and those will only get so hot.  This won't have the kick of a Naga or Butch T Pepper type sauce. It also won't hold a candle to the extracts, but it is still hotter than average.  If you find Franks red hot or Tabasco really hot then this might be too hot. Id estimate that this sauce is 5x ashot as Franks Extra Hot.  Total guess really.

column9: Best Hot Sauce on the Planet!
column10: This is a great tasting hot sauce with some intense heat. Scotch Bonnet peppers give it the intensity. I had a tough time finding this hot sauce after having it on a vacation. The price for 4 bottles was pretty reasonable. If you are timid about intense hot sauces, this will be too hot for you, but if you like a great flavored sauce with heat that numbs the mouth...This is it!
Good coffee at a great price, what else would one desire?  Not your everyday java but good for a change of pace.

I just bought a coffee maker that uses coffee pods but I was having a hard time finding flavored decaf pods. I tried the Wolfgang's Puck's Hawaiian Hazelnut Decaf Coffee pods and I love the flavor of this Hazelnut coffee.  I think it's the best one that I tried so far.  I plan to order more in the future.
Coffee has a great flavor, but not very strong. You may have to use two pods if you like a stronger brew.
The pack of 3 for about $20 is a great buy.  I drink this on weekends as a special treat to calm my nerves.  The aroma is better than Folgers. ;)

Makes my mom happy, at 86 :)My mom is diabetic, and one of her treats is coffee from her "1-cup" at a time machine.She drinks a lot, I think....so is always asking for replenishment of her supply.I shop Amazon for quick service...Usually, I purchase the Senseo when available for a decent $rice, but lately, it has not been a great deal so I resorted to some Wolfgang Puck instead...With Senseo, I was able to get an assortment she like in one shipment.Cannot do the same with the Puck for what I consider a decent $rice.She is on a limited income, as am I with today's economy...( I won't go there!)So I buy the most reasonable that she likes.  I also look for selections where I can use the AMAZON PRIME free shipping!And, thus she is drinking a LOT of Hazelnut ( I think this time) until I order something else.Arrived timely and well packed.
if following a low carb diet and needing something sweet, these are the candy bars for you...full size, great chocolate taste, liquidy carmel inside, it is well worth the price...

I bought this when it was on manager's special and deeply discounted.  The instructions work perfectly.  I travel frequently and have these as back-up food or for when I have access to hot water but won't be able to wash dishes.  This meal is flavorful but a little thin on the veggies. If the price were lower, I would but more.

So my wife is pro-organics. But at $4 a pop for these snacks at whoelfoods... she never bothered to give it a try. Of course the packaging has a duck on it, so my 2.5yr old daughter wanted one bag. We tried it. Tastes good. The 2.5yr old and 1 yr old daughters down them in about 5 minutes. So I am on amazon trying to find out if I can buy these things in bulk for cheaper. I guesss they are out of stock for now.

The Maxwell House French Roast is the perfect morning coffee.  Dark and full-flavored, but with no sharp after-taste.  The Gevalia Dark Morning Blend is good also and comparable. It makes a fuller cup. I like them both, but I find myself reaching for the Maxwell most often.

OK, I admit it, I'm a coffee snob.  For my home coffee maker I use a blend by a local high quality roaster.  I was pleasantly surprised by the quality and taste of this Maxwell House French Roast for Tassimo.  It's great.  I'll buy more.  Recommend you give it a try.  You won't be disappointed.

column9: Maxwell House Cafe Collection French Roast, 16-Count T-Discs for Tassimo Brewers (Pack of 3)
column10: I ordered this mainly because of the price, $0.31/disc w SuperSaver shipping.I like this coffee. I gave it 4 stars and not 5 because I am new to Tassimo, andwant to leave room at the top of the list for brewsthat I might like better.
Although this French Roast is not as good as Gevalia, it is well worth it for the price. Robust flavor, holds up well to the flavored creamers I like to use.

column9: great full bodied taste, reasonable price
column10: I love a bargain and I think purchasing Maxwell House French Roast coffee t-disks qualifies as one. In my opinion, it is a coffee with a great full bodied taste at a reasonable price

column9: French Roast, but not the Best Roast
column10: SUMMARY: If you're looking for a dark roast with full flavor for your Tassimo, keep looking. Hey -- it's Maxwell House after all. Check out the newer Gevalia Dark Roasts.DETAIL: After Starbucks severed its relationship with Kraft, I was looking for a decent brew for my Tassimo brewer. The Maxwell House French Roast was Kraft's early attempt at this, and it disappoints. It's OK if you stop the brew short, but it's a bit weak if you let it go full cycle. It's arguably the best Maxwell House offering, but it's no Starbucks.CONCLUSION: If you miss Starbucks, but want to keep the flexibility of the Tassimo, check out the three Gevalia Dark Roasts (Breakfast, House, and Italian), as these more closely resemble Starbuck's Breakfast, House, and Verona blends, respectively. These three form the core of my one-cup brewing, supplemented by a number of espressos and cremas available (Mastro Lorenzo being my fav).

column9: The best enchilada sauce available anywhere!
column10: Started using Hatch Green Enchilada Sauce while living in New Mexico.  It Is the most mellow, complete green chili sauce that we use on Enchiladas, egg and sausage filled tortilla bowls, New Mexico Ranch Chili, home-made tamales and any other Mexican dish we make.  We were pleased to find this at Amazon.
This oil is really superior in quality and taste!  If you haven't tried it yet what are you waiting for?  Fsntastic for your body snd so yummy!

I have been ordering from one particular company and they are very pricey however ordered this and I.must say its the same but my fave thing is the label actually had a hemp oil vinagrette recipe. I was shocked haven't tried it yet, but the place I normally order from just has a generic label. So that was a plus for me. Cheaper and you get a lot. My family has another hemp provider
Bought a case of these for my dogs (yeah, I know, I'm one of those people!) and the quality was great!  No added sodium too!  Perfect! Will definitely buy again.

Ian's Whole Wheat Bread Crumbs are by far the absolute best bread crumbs money can buy.  Ian's Bread Crumbs are  more coursely ground, allowing more flavor and texture to your recipe.  It has been my experience to use lessor amounts of Ian's Bread Crumbs in my recipes than the other more finely ground bread crumbs.  Ina's has been a staple in my household for many years with it's great taste and no fail recipes and will likely continue this disposition.

column9: Taste you can feel good about!
column10: I love these whole wheat panko crumbs. They give you whole grain, good taste & the crunch you sometimes miss when you are oven frying chicken & fish.Update 10/23/12 - Still loving these whole wheat panko crumbs. I use them all of the time.
So glad they made the Panko in whole wheat. Adds more fiber, crunch, taste,lower glycemic and higher nutrients to any food you make with them.Thank you Ian!!!

column9: Amazon bought-sellers didn't say true ingredients
column10: This fudge TASTED GREAT-but because it had ingredients not listed-corn syrup-I could not eat it so it just sits in my fridge.I do not think it is fair to those if us trying to be careful of what we eat, to be misled-even when Amazon says "ingredients may be different". Alot of people avoid corn syrup, and it makes me angry this is probably why it was not listed.
I love cinnamon, specilly this one. I sprinkle practically everywhere, such as soup, bleakfast cereal, making bread, apple bake and chocolate dessert.
Very good and great on toast. My grand kids liked it also. Cooks very well too. Will buy it again.
This also is Dr. Oz recommended. Cinnamon is great for you & beneficial for your health. This is a very different cinnamon. It has a strong flavor.

This is a delicious Earl Grey tea, the Bergamont really stands out.  It's a full bodied tea lovely to drink any time of day...it has become my standard "go to" black tea particularly at Breakfast time.

I just got my order and made a cup of coffee to see how it compared. I usually use 3 packs of splenda in a 16oz. cup. I used 5 drops of liquid ez and it tastes just as sweet. The texture of my coffee is smoother with the liquid. I like it alot so far.Added note Jan. 21, 2012: We just finished the first bottle and had no problems with it clogging like other reviewers did. My sister and I keep one in our purses and one by our coffee makers. We still love them and I'm ordering another 6pk of the .75 oz today because it appears to be the best value.

column9: Love the product, but not this bottle.
column10: See my review of the little bottles (and what I say there also goes for the larger sizes), but I've used three of this size and they have all jammed up while they are still 50-75% full. Very annoying.EZ-Sweetz is awesome stuff and I totally support the company and their product, but this size/bottle sucks.  Avoid it and go for the little ones instead.

column9: Least expensive path I've found  to this 0 carb sweetener
column10: I have been using the 2-oz. EZ-Sweetz bottles, but this .75-oz packaging is currently a better deal on Subscribe and Save.There is some confusion in reviews about whether this comes in the same strength as the larger bottles. The packaging clearly states that 2 drops = 2 teaspoons, which is identical to the strength of the larger bottles. My subjective experience is that this is correct. EZ-Sweetz comes in .2-oz and .5-oz bottles also, so perhaps the confusion comes from some other version.There have been complaints about the bottles also, but I have not had any trouble so far. I have found it's possible to open up the bottle and transfer its contents into one of the larger ones if desired.All in all, a good deal for low-carbers who don't want the ghost carbs of the powdered versions.

It's strange but these bottles are much flimsier than than the larger 2 oz bottles of the same product. You can't really  dispense just one or two drops with one of these. The slightest pressure streams way too much sweetener.

Pros: This is a great solution for cooking without sugar.  It mixes easily and the taste is great.Cons: It's a pain to count the drops if the amount you need is less than what you'd need for a teaspoon of this product.

The 'zero' calorie packets actually have 4 calories each and take up a lot of space.  This liquid sweetener is truly zero calories and dissolves better than the packets. Among other uses, I use this for sweeting carbonated beverages made with a Soda Stream machine. I think the taste is great. I've signed up for Subscribe and Save -- a better deal.
This is by far the best sugar substitute on the Market.  There is no aftertaste.  I use it in cooking and baking constantly

column9: Good product, but half the strength
column10: I've been using EZ Sweetz for about a year.  It is a great product - very convenient for traveling (I keep one in my purse) and when cooking it doesn't suffer from the reduction of sweetness that you get with powdered sucralose.  It has no carbs and no effect on blood sugar levels, so its great for low-carb diets and diabetics.I couldn't believe the deal Amazon offers on this, but when I received my order, I discovered 0.75 oz bottles offered here are half the strength of the same size bottles sold on the EZ Sweetz website. It's still a great deal, coming in at about 1.5¢ per serving, but its not what I thought I was ordering. I feel a bit cheated as a result.Re: the clogging tips: just stick a needle in the tip.  You will get some of the product building up on the tip (and in the lid) over time, but it will break off.  The resulting powder is very concentrated, so dissolve it in a bit of water before using. I am a coffee drinker of the first order. I used to drink a couple pots a day, but now I've cut way, way back, so now that I'm not into quantity, I'm into quality. I really enjoy, really savior a good cuppa joe. I've given up my Mr. Coffee and now have a Keurig Home Brewing System and I make my coffee a cup at a time and I really love it. It only takes a minute to make a cup and each cup is different, depending on my mood.I've been drinking K-cup coffee for a couple years now and have more of these little cups in my house than you can shake a stick at. For awhile I used a Chrome Carosel, made by Keurig, but I had to keep filling it and also it was kind of clumsy for me. Besides, my coffee affliction is way to huge to be held down to a little spinning coffee merry-go-round.For the first few months my coffee problem went spinning out of control. I had boxes and boxes of coffee in my pantry, refrigerator, cupboards, garage, even in the trunk of my car, but now I've sort of got my gourmet coffee disorder in hand and down to twenty-eight flavors.For Breakfast I have my favorite seven and they are: Timothy's World Coffee, Extra Bold Fair Trade Nicaraguan, Timothy's World Coffee, Midnight Magic, Bold, Timothy's World Coffee, Kona Blend, Tully's French Roast Coffee K-Cups, Coffee People Bold Black Tiger Dark Roast, Timothy's World Coffee, Morning Blend and Coffee People Coffee, Wake Up Call Bold.For Lunch I have my favorite seven and they are: Gloria Jean's Coffees Hazelnut Coffee, Emeril's K-cups, Big Easy Bold, Gloria Jean's Coffees, Black Gold Extra Bold, Timothy's World Coffee, Private Blend, Timothy's World Coffee, Extra Bold Parisian Nights, Timothy's World Coffee, Colombian La Vereda and Gloria Jean's Coffees GJ Special BlendAnd for dinner, yes I drink coffee in the evening as well, but that's not so bad, considering I don't drink alcohol, don't smoke, don't eat sweets and eat very little meat. Sometimes I'll eat meat, but not often, so a cup of coffee with dinner doesn't seem so bad, considering. If it kept me up at night, well then that would be different, but it doesn't.Anyway for dinner I'll drink one of these seven: Tully's Full City Roast Coffee, Gloria Jean's Coffee, Mudslide, Timothy's World Coffee, Italian Blend, Green Mountain Coffee K-Cups Dark Magic Extra Bold, Green Mountain Coffee Nantucket Blend, Timothy's World Coffee, San Lorenzo Dark and Gloria Jean's Coffee, Classic Reserve.And then there is my absolute favorite, number twenty-two and that is Extra Bold Rainforest Espresso, a Timothy's World Coffee.I keep my k-cups in three large assorted tupperware tubs, marked in red sharpie, of course, Breakfast, Lunch and Dinner. So when I reach into the breakfast tub for example, I never know which of the seven flavors that I'm going to wind up with. I don't drink coffee during my meal, but afterwards, instead of desert. It's a quiet time for me. I think and reflect over my coffee as I delight in each and every sip. I know for some, having twenty-two different flavors of coffee in my kitchen might seem a bit much, maybe even a bit quirky, well everyone's gotta have their quirks, besides, I've cut way down.Now, about that twenty-second flavor. When I absolutely have to have an extra cup during that quiet, coffee drinking them, then that's the flavor I go for. How often does that happen, when one cup isn't enough? Only about once a day. Still, from two pots a java a day, down to four cups, is a pretty good thing, I'm not as wired as I used to be, but let's face it, I'm still running on coffee. That's not so bad though, better a coffee crutch than something else.In my opinion these are the twenty-two best cups of joy in the whole wide world. At least the best twenty-two flavors I've come across in the hundreds I've tried. But please don't take my word as gospel, everybody's different. You have to dive right right in, take a chance, try several flavors till you find the one or the twenty-two that you like best.
