column9: We're both happy at long last!
column10: I have two dogs, but only one of them eats Cesar chicken "in meaty juices" (it HAS to be the "in meaty juices kind!) and she GOBBLES IT. after years of searching for a food she'll eat to enjoy, not just eat to survive, we've finally found a winner! Gigi is a 9-year-old Papillon mix who is both dainty, firecely independent, and plain fierce when she's disturbed, while 1-year-old Mini-Dachshund Sophie is a happy, bouncy, and utterly addicted to attention. Gigi spends her time under the bed, Sophie is wherever I am. What Sophie eats is actually still TBD. This is Gigi's review.Both of them have been picky eaters. Gigi went years on starving herself until she couldn't hold out any longer, then deigning to eat the dry food we supply between wet food dinners, even as we tried all kinds of different foods to tempt her. Beneful Dog Food Prepared Meals Beef Stew Dog Food, 10-Ounce Plastic Containers (Pack of 8) used to work now and then, and though it was expensive, we could get 3 servings from it. However, even though it had a lid, it would often grow moldy even before the next meal. So even though she liked it, it was wasted and really too expensive anyway.When Sohpie arrived, we'd been serving Mighty Dog Hearty Pulled-Style Chicken Dinner In Gravy, 5.5-Ounce Cans (Pack of 24) with the longest sustained success yet, about a year. Only chicken, mind you, and it had to be the chunky in sauce kind, NOT the pate kind. Well, along came the puppy, and Gigi expressed her distaste by wasting food again.Finally, I've found Cesar. And oddly, now it has to be the pâté kind, I.e. "in meaty juices" NOT the chunky kind! But AT LAST we've found a dog food that The Mrs. will absolutely SNARF ON. She doesn't come up for air when I put any chicken-based "in meaty juices" Cesar dinner in front of her, which I cube into bite sizes.The added bonus is that I can hide pills in the cubes. Gigi's been diagnosed with congenital heart failure, and she's on 3 different pills, 3 times a day. Dinner is the easier dose, because I just push the little pills into the soft pâté, and she's none the wiser because she swallows the cubes almost whole! Sadly, we won't probably have Gigi with us for the fourteen or fifteen years I've been blessed to have spent with my previous dogs. But I'm determined to make sure she's as healthy and happy as possible in the time we have. She may be feisty, prickly, and a loner, but when I *can* catch her, she does love to snuggle with her mama.Cesar "in nearby juices" dog food might just give me a few month's more snuggled than we'd otherwise have.

column9: It's Corn. Cats can't live on corn.
column10: This food is primarily corn: ground corn and corn meal. That food pyramid above the cat's head definitely doesn't represent what's in the food. I don't think most people would knowingly go out and buy corn for their cat. We associate cats with eating fish or poultry or mice. Definitely not ears of corn.And most of the meat is a byproduct, which is a low grade and questionable ingredient. So is "animal fat." It also contains wheat, which cats can easily be allergic to. This brand may be better than the bottom of the barrel cat foods, but it's still something to totally avoid. Purchase a cat food that is low in grains/carbs or has none at all. If it contains any then they should be wholegrain, like brown rice. No corn or byproducts.Your cat may seem fine on this food, but like a person eating fast food at every meal, you have to know there are healthier options out there and such poor dietary choices will catch up with you sometime.

I fed this to my three cats. Within a month one of them began getting sick, throwing up his food once a day then every meal. Eventually he began throwing up blood and was passing it from his bottom. We thought he was going to die, these symptoms all happened over a few days time.We took him to the vet, they ran tons of tests found nothing wrong and gave him a hydration IV and sent him home with instructions for a diet of puree chicken and rice. Days later we gave him a little bit of the dry cat food with his special food. Hours later he was terribly sick again. It was then that we realized the food made him this deathly ill!DO NOT BUY GOODLIFE it almost killed our cat!

it sure is hot straight from the bottle.stuck a toothpick in it to taste and so i knew how hot it actually is.the tip of my tongue was numb and my lips turned red.it lasted a few minutes and that was about the size of a pinhead of sauce on the toothpick.once i added it to my bbq sauce,about a 1/2 gal used 1/2 of the bottle it was still very hot there were other ingredients i added to make it hotter.

These are the best vanilla wafers you'll ever eat! They're super crunchy and hold up well in banana pudding, a staple of the South!  I can't get them where I live now and I've been really disappointed about that. Try them if you can, you'll love them!
Luscious caramels, sugar-free and as good as sugared.  Great for diabetics (which I am) or for those wanting to avoid processed sugar in their life.

I have been forced into a sugar free lifestyle for health reasons and have been trying to find a decent toffee / caramel SF candy for a while. I was skeptical with the malitol on the ingredients list. So far nothing with malitol tastes "RIGHT" to me. But Judy's Candy Co. smacked one out of the park on this. I picked up Vanilla Almond Caramels, Butter Toffee, and Triple Treat today and OMG so so good!!

I too am totally hooked on this biscotti. I always like a little cookie with my tea and these are a healthy guilt free treat. I order them by the case from manufacturer (worldpantry.com). My only complaint is that sometimes there are a few broken biscottis in each pack. They taste like pound cake to me.Here's the nutrition info...I always find this helpful...4 cookies per serving:info per serving:133 caloriesSat. Fat  0.3g  2% of daily valueTrans fat  0g  0%Cholesterol  0g  0%Fiber  1g  5%Carbs  21.5g  7%Protien  3gSugars  10g

I got addicted to these while on vacation this past summer...and they are made with healthy ingredients....egg whites,lightly sugared etc...that's what I really liked about them besides the numerous almonds...they are very thin slices,not overly sugary and they do have RAISINS, so if you don't like them too bad :-)...the cookie is amazing...I bought a CASE from the manufacture ...and it came to about $3 each...but that was about $75 I spent..you have to know that I sit down and I'll eat through a package at one time...THEY ARE ADDICTING!!..I've made my own biscotti,tried others and this is a whole other type of cookie, since it's so thin...no matter how you get it, there's a chance that some may crumble because they are thin...but they are still DUNK ABLE in my tea...I love the crunchy,nutty,vanilla flavor.I LOVE THIS COOKIETony(nyc)PS: NEVER tried any of their other flavors, cause I like the vanilla of the original.

column9: Delectable, Filling Cookies With Low Calories Make a Healthy Snack
column10: These are are crunchy, delectable cookies that come in a variety of flavors, of which, I find The Original & Gingerspice tastier than others. What I find very puzzling is that Amazon has different flavors under Amazon Prime at different times: last week it was The Original and now it is Gingerspice and Almondina Almonduo with Pistachio Biscuits, 4-Ounce Packages (Pack of 6). Almondina also makes an assorted 8 cookie flavor giftbox but for some Amazon does not carry it, as of February 2010.Each cookie has 35 calories and the package lists the serving size as 4 cookies. For me, usually 2 cookies are filling enough and satisfy my hunger. Cookies have roasted almonds and resins. Each cookie has 5.5 gm carbohydrate approximately half of which is sugar, but the company claims it to be "All Natural". I guess they consider sugar to be natural!Biscoff Family Pack are also delicious cookies, with 25 calorie per cookie and roughly the same amount of carbohydrates and sugar per cookie as Almondina, but they are't as filling and you end up consuming more calories. May be it is not possible to make delicious cookies with any less sugar. To give you perspective and comparison, Oreo Cookies have double the sugar and carbohydrate and each serving has 160 calories; and they are not filling so you end up consuming a lot more than one serving at a time. I have't found any other delicious cookies with as low carbohydrate content as Almondina. For me, they make a very healthy snack that satiates my hunger and craving for food.

I ordered these for my sisters baby bird themed baby shower and they were perfect on cupcakes!! I got sooo many compliments about how beautiful and brightly colored they were. The kids also loved them and they weren't too sweet even though they are probably all sugar. Also, not one was broken when I received them due to the amazing and secure packaging. I would definitely order again from them.

column9: Don't be afraid of the dark...
column10: Ok, I'll come out of the closet and admit: I've tried to get used to it, but will never completely embrace a love for very, very dark chocolate. So sue me. It's just too bitter. Too lacking in that luxuriant creaminess which makes me adore milk chocolate -- which for afficianados of "real" chocolate, really ain't chocolate at all. Oh, and don't forget the whole cause du jour of the "MUFA's" thing...monounsaturated fats. The stuff that's good for you, I've heard.THIS stuff is the next best thing. The chili adds a wonderful bit of heat. Just right. The chocolate is slightly less than 50% "dark", if I get the gist of the nutrition label. For me - the perfect blend: enough dark to please someone who eats it for health reasons (like THAT was ever why we fell in love with chocolate)...while retaining that lovely, melt-in-your-mouth-feel only something with enough fat can offer.Heaven in small bites paired with something I relish as I write this: an equally non-snobular red table wine -- Kendall Jackson's deeeelish "Summation" (heavier than my beloved Chianti, lighter than Merlot. In short, luscious perfection and balance. When I'm not sure what wine to bring, I can always rely on a KJ!)Afraid of the dark? Fear not. Lindt's Excellence Chili Dark just might tempt you away from the light.

I am not a fan of dark chocolate. In fact, I usually do not eat it but I was intrigued by this flavor. So I got a bar and it is awesome. The chili flavor is slow but brings a nice constant heat especially as an aftertaste. I highly recommend this flavor to people who like food with heat. Even those who may not like dark chocolate.
I enjoyed this bar of chocolate.  Never thought chili and chocolate would go together, but I was very pleasantly surprised by the good flavor and taste, could feel the chili just right.

This is one kicker of a drink. My mother bought this for me as a present because she knows that I like both spicy and vodka. Well, her intentions were true, and it is a thoughtful gift, but I just cannot handle the flavor. I need to find a few good recipes for this to drink it, as anything I have mixed it with leaves it too spicy. Straight is brutal. I took a shot straight, and the vodka stripped away my saliva (my spicy protection layer) and the capsaicin dug in deep. It tastes so good, but the spice is like a sucker punch right in the jollies. Buy this if you don't plan to use it as a main feature in your mixed drinks, or you need a good spirit for doing bets. I hope you enjoy it!

I recently purchased some unsweetened Belcolade chocolate in place of the usual Callebaut that I order. I love Callebaut, but it is very difficult to cut due to the thickness of the giant bars. The chipped version available through some vendors is an inferior product. Thus, I tried Belcolade. It is much darker than Callebaut and has a more earthy flavor characteristic of "Dutching." However, it is better and more complex than other dutched chocolates like Lindt. I would rate it as high as Callebaut and Valrhona and certainly better than Ghirardelli and the expensive Sharffenberger. Best of all, The Belcolade is delivered in small wafers and required no cutting, just measuring in a cup. It saves me a great deal of time and mess. Also, the price is right and less than virtually every other ultra premium brand.

column9: My Little One loves this food.
column10: My kitten loves this food.  It was the food that she had when she was at the shelter and my vet carries the Hill Science Diet Line for both dogs and cats.  She rushes to her bowl when she hears the dry kitten food falling into her bowl.

Healthy food and kitten gobbles it down.  I personally like the approach Science Diet takes to balanced nutritional, even if the food is not all organic or natural.  Good product, great price, and kitty loves the food!

column9: Approved of by all my felines!
column10: I bought this for an elderly cat with health problems who needs to gain weight, coincidentally I have a new kitten as well. All 4 of my cats love this food, none like the wet food. This is now their forever food.

column9: Pretty Good, there are better choices for some.
column10: This food is much better than cheap store brand type kibble, however while a cut above most it still has ingredients that I would not see in the Premium Brands such as Wellness, Ivo and such.For the increase in price from the cheap stuff it is much better for the little sweeties. It is a very good compromise.I foster kittens all the time and most of them love the stuff and their coats are very shiny.
My two kittens have sensitive stomachs so my Vet recommended Science Diet. It helped them and I could not be any more pleased. It is worth the price to see the results of happy pets that are healthy.

We have a somewhat finicky 5 month old kitten.  He hates most of the canned kitten food available, including other Science Diet canned kitten food. Until he's a year old, we want to feed him appropriate kitten food.  Our vets tout the benefits of Science Diet food for cats, so we thought we'd try the Salmon.  It comes in a small can, which is perfect for one or two kittens, and he absolutely loves the taste.  Win-win situation for us! We bought two cases which will last for several months.

column9: Lots of vitamins, but not filling
column10: I fed this to my kittens by recommendation of my vet. They gave me several coupons that made it quite inexpensive.It's packed with a lot of vitamins. My childhood pets were always fed it, and they lived to 14 years or so, and so I thought it would be good for my kittens.Their fur was glossy and they appeared healthy, but they were always hungry after eating their assigned portion. I switched to an organic human-grade kibble and the kittens were contented after their portions. This told me that the food must have been filling the cats up, but not substantially enough to keep them full. Just as a human could fill up on rice and chicken nuggets and vitamins (the human equivalents of some of the ingredients) and be healthy, but not really feel contented in their bellies.This is less expensive than the organic food I buy them now, but they want to eat more so I don't know what the end cost really is. I like the idea of all of the vitamins in there, just as I would take a multi-vitamin, but I just wish that their bellies could keep full after eating. I probably won't go back to this kibble. I wish I could rate it higher for the vitamins, but these corn meal and by-product ingredient listings really explain my kittens lack of feeling full.PROS:* Lots of vitamins* Left fur glossyCONS:* Always begging for more food* Corn meal and chicken by-products near the top of ingredient list (poor quality, not human grade)

column4: Shana "That's my opinion- I could be wrong!"
column10: Fortunately, my kittens have had no ill behaviors while eating this food like the previous reviewers cat. I mixed this in with my Purina Kitten Chow that my kittens were eating and the kittens seemed to really love it. My other two, one year old cats were also fond of "stealing" the kittens dry food instead of their usual Iams (where real chicken is the main ingredient), so this must be tasty. Usually, I just feed my cats dry food on a free choice basis and supplement with canned cat food and boiled chicken meat. My only gripe is this isn't a dry food that someone on a strict budget could likely readily afford on a regular basis for a number of cats. Otherwise, this is a good quality kitten food.

My view of this product has changed since we have been feeding Halo; the cats seem healthier and happier.  The kitten's coat was getting very rough and now is smooth and silky.  I'm told that you should feed the best you can afford, and this food is expensive, but not very high-quality, as far as we could tell.  Plus, our kitten gained too much weight on it.

column9: Filler food is empty, leaves your cat always needing more
column10: This review will make me sound really stupid, but whatever. I don't really care as long as people find out what's real and can avoid my mistakes.I got my wonderful little sweet Bella Bean when she was a few days shy of three years old. She had been bounced around from house to house and eating whatever was cheap. I have had cats around me my entire life, for about twenty-five years now. My mother always just fed them whatever, the kinds of food you buy in the supermarket - Friskies, Nine Lives, Kit & Kaboodle, stuff like that. And our cats were always fine, at least in terms of their eating habits. They would eat in the morning, stop when they were done, come back, and eat some more when they got hungry.My housemate at the time was working for Hill's and assured me that this was the best food ever made, so great, so on and so forth. I now know that she is an utter buffoon, but I initially trusted her judgment, which is so unfortunate because she doesn't think. She also had plenty of coupons for free or deeply discounted bags, which made it a much more attractive choice.I first tried feeding the little Bean an unmeasured amount of Science Diet in a bowl, but that didn't work, as she would devour it in one sitting. So then I took to measuring it, and she did the same thing. Then I started parsing it out to twice a day. That didn't work either, because she would start going crazy in the middle of the day, running around, intentionally destroying things, deliberately spilling her water, crying, etc., until she got more food. So then I split it into three servings. Same thing. Then it got to be four servings. That was a little better, but it was too much maintenance and unrealistic to be around every day to feed her four times. So then it went back to three. All the while, I was trying to reduce the amount of food I was feeding her to less than 3/4 of a cup because she was a little chubby. Reducing was hell. She became even more hungry, but I figured she would get used to it. Not really.For over a year, she would wake me up every morning looking for food in a serious way, knocking things off my desk, ripping up any paper she could find, scratching at the door and committing general acts of mischief. As soon as she got food, she was back to her sweet self, but only for three or four hours.We thought she was bored, we thought she was a little nutty, and maybe even had a kitty eating disorder. She always wanted food. It was kind of funny but in the end it was just sad.A few weeks back, we took her to a new (good, non-money factory) vet for her second checkup since I've had her. I talked with him about her being always hungry. He asked what she ate, and I told him the adult indoor Science Diet. Without saying as much, he basically told me that this food is garbage and I should look for something else. He said cat food should have a protein followed by a carbohydrate as the first two ingredients. Science Diet does, in a very loose, by-product kind of way - ground up slaughterhouse leftovers and corn dust. Then they put a bunch of vitamins in it to make it "healthy," instead of just using good ingredients from the beginning. Not that I care about spending money on the Bean, but this food is way too expensive for what it is.So we began transitioning her onto Wellness indoor formula about two weeks ago. She is still eating 50 percent Science Diet with 50 percent Wellness (you really shouldn't just give a cat different food one day out of the blue) but SHE NEVER FREAKS OUT ANYMORE. It's amazing. And it's 100 percent because she is eating real food now, along with that sawdust and chicken hearts I still regrettable have to feed her. We have her down to eating twice a day, only 1/3 cup in TOTAL. She was eating three times a day, 5/8 of a cup in total. Now she eats some in the morning, walks away, eats some more a few hours later, and then looks for dinner about twelve hours after her initial feeding. No more knocking things over, no more trashing Dad's papers on the desk, no more howling, no more deliberately spilled water on the floor. It's incredible.I feel so bad that I was doing this to her for so long. We really thought she was just being dramatic or whatever. But no, she was genuinely hungry because she wasn't eating any real food.Do your cat a favor - buy her or him so food made with real ingredients, things you would eat - Wellness, Halo, Innova, Evo, whatever. Figure it out for yourself, but please don't feed your cat this. It's garbage.

column9: Addictive, empty filler, but my cat went anorexic without it
column10: My older cat, 4 years, got "hooked" on Hill's Science Diet Kitten formula when I brought a new kitten, along with a big bag of free S/D, home from the pound. [Prior to that, my well-adjusted cat would eat raw chicken, high quality canned foods, organic kibble--all the "good stuff"]Both cats thrived on S/D.  So much so that the kitten grew and grew and grew, into a hefty 9 pounds at 7 months. The 4 year-old cat began ignoring her own food and started eating the kitten's food.  She filled out, also, but to a nice adult weight of 6 pounds.Okay, so 2 months later the kitten is up to 10 pounds and can barely walk without panting.  She cannot stop eating this S/D stuff.  She's enormous, way bigger than her 4 year-old housemate.  I decide to switch back to the healthier food--like Innova Evo, which is 88% meat protein and grain free.  I also augment with superior wet food (the 100% organic, human grade stuff, along with raw chicken, etc).Kitten is okay with that switch--like a tiger she tears away at the raw chicken, gulps at the premium can food--but the older cat doesn't like it, although I do it very gradually over 3 months.  I sit with her, pet her, calm her...Yes, she does eat, just not much--a few kibble crunches, or a tablespoon of wet food.  [Cornell has over 300 studies on anorexic cats].A couple months go by and the kitten is looking better, not panting as much (and  2 pounds lighter) but our 4 year-old cat is now down to 2.9 pounds!  All her ribs show and she has bones where her shoulders are.  She looks like a cheetah that's been deprived of food.  No mater what food I put in front of her--dry, wet, kibble, shredded meat--she will only nibble bits and pieces, here and there.  Her fur has lost its glossy coat.The vet tells me I have to do something, anything, to stop the decline in my cat's health, even if it means feeding the crummy Science Diet Kitten food, Original Formula.I am two days into feeding the cat the S/D Kitten food.  She is wolfing this stuff down as if there's no tomorrow.  It makes me sad that she's become another S/D addict--it's that darn corn filler, converts to sugar and cats love it.  I know, I'd rather have her alive and eating this crud, then wasting to nothing away on more nourishing food.  At least I can console myself that the kitten KNOWS she's a feline and eats like one.

I was sent a bag of this with a litter of kittens I am fostering. At first I thought perhaps the kittens were just more interested in wet food, because they wouldn't eat this stuff. Then they discovered my own personal cats' food (a much, much less expensive brand), and they were grubbing on it! My own cats turned up their noses at the Science Diet, too.It may be fabulously nutritious, but that doesn't really matter if my cats refuse to touch it.My dog liked it, though.

Saw it on the news and knew I had to try it. I'm a real peanut butter lover. Found it in Walmart today and bought a box. Immediately tried it when I got home. Yum yum! Tastes better than PB Captain Crunch. Headed out to buy a few more boxes now!

I got these thinking they seemed like a more respectable stand in for Peanut Butter Cap'n Crunch which is my guilty pleasure cereal which I will hide from the kids and eat by the bucket once they are in bed.  The flavor is not as intense, and if you really compare the label, a 3/4 c. serving of each has the same grams of sugar.  The cheerios has 1 gram more fiber and none of the bad fat that the PPCC has but I feel like, given the trade-off of weaker peanut butter flavor, the increase in healthiness is very marginal.  They're also kind of pricey, for the box being so small.  (They're actually cheaper at my grocery store than on Amazon, but still have the "how small is this box???" thing going on)They're all right and I will buy them again if on sale or I have a coupon - but for what I hoped them to be, an honest to goodness healthy alternative to PBCC, they fall a little short.  If they could just oomph up the PB flavor a bit...If you really want a healthier version of PBCC, I think Peanut Butter Bumpers is the way to go - but they never seem to go on sale, grrr.

I don't eat cereal very often, but I love peanut butter. I noticed these only had 9 grams of sugar (per serving) so I bought some to try. This is the best cereal I have ever tasted! LOVE IT! Please do NOT stop making it :)

Big fan of regular Cheerios. Ordered the Multi-Grain Peanut Butter Cheerios to review for the Vine Program. Love them! Great taste and I have been eating them with milk and as a snack.I think my niece and nephew are coming over to visit more often because the first thing they ask for is a bowl of Peanut Butter Cheerios. Haven't seen them in the grocery store yet. Will certainly buy more when I do. Yum!

Blech. Peanut butter flavor was very weak and artificial - proving once again that the very best Cheerios out there are the plain ol' yellow-box variety (with Honey Nut running a close 2nd). Try again, General Mills.

My dog loves these Jerky Treats. The purchase was fast and easy. However, in retrospect I believe they were too expensive and the price is much better at Costo. But if you can't make a trip to Costco ... or if Costco is out of them ... then this is the place to go!
My dog loves these jerky treats. My grocery store stopped carrying them. Bought them here in the large economy pack which is great. Love the container, can see how many are left and it seals itself.

After eating Jerky Treats from Costco for a couple of years, my dog died at the age of 6 1/2 of cancer. I do not have evidence naturally, but after reading numerous posts on BHA, this could have been a contributing factor. BE CAREFUL.
These Jerky treats are my 2 dogs favorite dogs treat. I found that if I reward them with this treat, I can motivate them to learn or do anything!

We have a St Bernard .  I buy these treats and she loves them.  She will sit and bark when she wants one. I like that I can get them locally and the package says they are made in the USA. I only wish they were either a little cheaper  in  cost or was bigger like a bag of dog food at a  good price.  I like the fact that they have beef and lamb although my dog prefers beef she will eat lamb too.  They are made in the USA put America to work  I recommend these treats.
My dogs loved this product.  Unfortunately I will never order it again because the ingredients are  so unhealthy.  Big mistake not to have read them before ordering.

column9: Sour Patch Kids kicked up a notch
column10: I'm a huge fan of Sour Patch Kids and when I saw that they had an extreme version I had to try.  Although not crazy sour, these are much better than the original.  A must try for Sour Patch Kids Lovers.

column9: I'm the proud new "owerer" of a beautiful new fence thanks to Dr. H.
column10: And i get bags of this candy at the convenience store i frequent . This size bag . You really should try these out if you like the brand . They're soft and chewy as advertised . they're also pretty darn sour and are dusted with sugar . They're sweet and sour . One bag has 190 calories . 0 grams of fat . 35 milligrams (1 percent) of sodium . 47 grams (16 percent) total carbohydrate . 33 grams sugar and nil protein . A swell treat from time to time . Lick into it....Ben
This company has excellent. Customer service very nice to do business with i emailed them and they got right back always with kindness like they really did care
These are just like the duck and rice balls only in a bar shape, can be broken up or fed whole.  The dogs crunch them happily just like the balls.

column9: Fromm's is the best, my cats adore it!
column10: My cats have had a go at every canned cat food on the market. While they liked some canned foods one week, they left the same brand  untouched the next week. I am tired of throwing away uneaten cat food!! The only brand all three cats eat right way, and keep eating until the plate is empty, is Fromm's. Fromm's costs more than other foods, but since the cats eat it all up, I am ahead money-wise. As if that weren't enough, the ingredients are healthier than the grocery store cat foods. The fact that I can feed all three cats a healthy, grain-free food they love is terrific. Try a can and watch your cat enjoy a great meal!

This is my 3 cats' favorite food.  The like all of the Fromm pretty well, but they go crazy for this one.  Well worth trying for finiky kitties. It is a pate type food and some kitties don't like that, it's all mine will eat.
I love this product.  It is exactly what I wanted.  I didn't want something flavored or colored.  The scent is very soft and natural, but better than the original acent.

I received the tea today and it has a very pleasant jasmine taste. It is equally good hot or iced. When it goes on sale again I will definitely reorder. I ordered 4 other flavors by this brand, but haven't tried them yet.

This is a fine, fine California bay leaf that stays wonderfully aromatic when used in dishes that call for bay leaves.  I cook a lot and look for top quality seasonings.  These are as good as any I have used and I recommend them to friends all the time.  The price is good as well at Amazon.  Four jars last a long time.  As long as you don't open one jar before you finish up the previous jar the product stays fresh for quite a long time.

My owners have been giving me(Scout)Veggie Life Vitality Sweet Potato Dog Chews for over two years.  I love them and they are good for me.  It is not a typical treat that most owners give their dogs, which are gulped and swallowed many times without chewing. The Veggie chews take me a long time to chew and I am always satisfied with just one (well, most of the time). My owners have been buying the smaller size bags in the stores but found the larger one on Amazon.  Thanks Amazon ...
This is a great alternative to rawhide or any other animal chew. They are best for smaller dogs because the pieces are smaller, but larger dogs (boxer)love for treats as well.

Not only are these fruit snacks organic, but they are sooooo good! I don'tthink that I have ever had a more perfect pack of fruit snacks! I would definetly reccommend buying the big packs like this too because it saves money and these can be kind of hard to find! Plus, don't worry kids love them too! Thet're a great and delicous snack for any moment of the day!

Since going gluten-free casein-free over a year ago, we've tried ALOT of snacks only to be disappointed by most! THEN, we tried these.. my boys (4y & 2y) fight over these fruit snacks! They absolutely love them! And I love that they're getting a nice dose of vitamin C :) I recommend these to any parent looking for a great tasting organic fruit snack for a picky child! You will not be disappointed!!!
These organic fruit snacks are fantastic and enjoyed by the entire family. The packet is small, but contains just enough to get one's fill of these sweets.
These are great! Maybe a little pricey but they are fantastic and I feel I'm giving my daughter a treat that won't destroy her good eating habits.

column9: yummy but i wish there were more in each package
column10: My kids love these, however I wish there were more in each package.  sometimes they end up eating two and that just wastes packaging material.
Not the healthiest snack of them all BUT certainly a tasty treat every now and again. Love the fact that Annie's makes an effort to use great ingredients

column9: The puny pouches were a shock!
column10: At $13.34 for an 18-count box of pouches, you would expect a real snack.  Annie's products are usually very good.  But when we pulled a pouch out of the box, we were in for a shock!  The pouches are microscopic!  There must have been five gummies in each one!  How is that supposed to be a snack for an active five year old, let alone some of the ?adult? reviewers who claimed these were great?  We really felt ripped off...

I like having a low calorie snack, it helps keep me happy while I am dieting.  I open this package up right away, 70 calories per pouch.  These were the best gummy anything I have ever had.  Bonus they are organic so no chemical after taste like I get with some brands of gummy bears.  They may cost a little bit more but I have to say worth every cent and would recommend them to anyone (except my sister she is allergic to strawberries).  Having this sweet snack in the afternoon is going to help get to dinner without cleaning out the pantry.

column9: Food Ref put down your whistle! Annie's Snacks save you from calling FOUL! @ snack time
column10: I'm always looking for healthy options when it comes to snacks for my children. My choice would apples and peanut butter or red pepper strips and hummus.  Unfortunately picky eaters with food allergies and sensitivities along with ongoing health issues can make snack time seem like a wrestling match.  When kids want to tear into the unhealthy snacks and mom is stuck being the referee; Annie's Organic Bunny Fruit Snacks Berry Patch are a reasonable compromise.  While they won't come close to the nutritional benefit of a truly healthy snack they do manage to provide 100% Vitamin C.  They are labeled as naturally gluten free, made with real fruit juices, no HFCS and are organic. We have tried the tropical treat flavor but my children prefer the Berry Patch.  We purchase them through the Amazon Subscribe and Save for a reasonable price.  Have your kids pin down a couple of small cheese cubes and a couple apple slices along with Annie's Fruit Snacks and mom feels as she wins too!

If you like candies that resemble sweet-tarts AND if you like really sour candies then you will like Cry Baby Tears xtra sour. I would say that these are not quite as sour as warheads but they are close to it. They are hard tear-shaped candy pieces and except for the extreme sour taste are very similar to hard candies like sweet tarts. I think they are great! Yum.

It took a lot of trial and error but this BBQ sauce is the ONE! I searched high and low for BBQ sauce without sugar but with great taste.Not only does this sauce deliver super taste but there is the surprise kick of heat at the finish. Bought two bottles and gave one to a friend then after I finished mine in record time I was sorry I had given it away.

column9: Mustard is terrific, packing is not
column10: I can only eat mustard made with apple cidar vinegar, but would choose this mustard over any other because it is outstanding.  It is creamy, smooth and flavorful, with a warm, smooth mustard bite.  Not harsh or over-vinegared.  Unfortunately, all three jars that I ordered came with broken tops.  They need to improve the packing.
I love a Vanilla Latte and this is a pretty good version, I do add a little sugar to make it "just right" but certainly my favorite Dolce Gusto flavor.
I love this new flavor. I love all of their "special" drinks, I'm not too fond of the regular coffee, but this new flavor is by far my favorite.
I am a Dolce Gusto user for a long time, and this was the best price I could find for this product. So, I would recommend that due to that.

column9: Nescafé Dolce Gusto Brewers, Vanilla Latte Macchiato
column10: This flavor is ok bur it is not my favorite of all the dolce gusto flavors. It has a faint vanilla flavor that I wish would be a little stronger, similiar to the mocha or caramel latte maccchiato. Still, it is pretty good and the milk still foams up well.

This too is very nice along with the caramel flavored one having a nice aroma. It is not too strong so for those who like a very strong flavor should add more but I can smell it when I make it and taste it just the right amount. Just wish they were a little bigger!

There isn't much vanilla flavor to this. I even tried increasing the milk ratio since that's where the flavor is, but it still didn't come out with any distinct vanilla-ness. It also is not as sweet as I like, so I'm doctoring every cup. Not sure if I would buy these again. The caramel latte is better.

My husband has tried almost every flavor available for the Nescafe Dolce Gusto cofee makers.  This is one of his favorites.  He doesn't change a thing for his coffee - he follows the directions.  Since we got the Dolce Gusto Genio which lets you customize the amount of water, he makes my coffee weaker and adds sugar to mine for me.  =)

This really does make a great latte.  I am a big fan of Starbucks and Dunkin' Donuts, and for the price of what a cup of this costs it is really worth it!  It doesn't taste EXACTLY like Starbucks, but what do you expect for $1 or less per serving?  Add a little sugar/splenda and you are good to go!

column9: Coffee tastes superior over the Keurig coffee.
column10: I really like the taste of these coffee pods.  The packaged arrive nicely packaged and quick.  The value was great considering subscribed to "subscribe & Save" and free ship with my Amazon Prime.  I paid only $22.90 for a package of 3 boxes of 16 pods per box.  So, that's $7.63 per box.  I was shopping at Super Walmart today and they offer these kind of coffee pods.  Every day price for this store is $9.84 per box.  So, Amazon.com does offer the better value!  However, I found a box of "cappuccino Ice" coffee pods on clearance for $2.00!  They were on clearance because the box expires 07/2011 and today is 08/02/2011.  I just brewed a glass and it tastes great!  I am happy to save money in tough financial times.

column9: tasty vanilla latte at a tastier price
column10: great flavour without being overbearing.  easy to use like everything else in the dolce gusto line.can't really go too wrong with any flavour in the lineup.

I am so happy that I purchased the creativa nescafe dolce gusto from Krups. It is by far the best coffee maker ever.The coffee variety is great and the taste it's amazing, better than a coffee shop. I've had a few friends that own a keuric taste this latte and they're amazed by the richness of the flavor and they even switched after that. I'm in love with all the flavor varieties and most definitely recommend this to everyone. :)

i recenty bought the dolce gusto coffe machine and i thinks this is the best falvor, i love it, i add a little bit of more sugar but is perfect, and if you have the clear cup you can see the layers in the coffe exactly like the picture in the box
Really like these and you can't beat the price on here!! Have learned that if you stir them after you mix the 2 capsules together that you get better vanilla flavor!!!

column9: I'm the envy of my coworkers
column10: I have the Nescafe Dolce Gusto machine in my office (I have a regular espresso machine at home).  Since I don't usually sweeten my coffee drinks I wasn't sure if I would like this, but I bought 3 boxes anyway.  Turns out it's delicious.  It's not nearly as sweet as the Vanilla Latte at Starbucks, which is good.  The vanilla flavour is mild but still noticeable.  Smells great while brewing.  While I don't drink this every single day, when I do feel the urge for a treat, it saves me a long walk in the cold to Starbucks...but I find my coworkers just "happen" to come around a lot more when I'm making a latte...they need to get their own supply!

column9: Light hint of vanilla, smooth easy flavor
column10: We've been trying all the different flavors for our new Dolce Gusto machine and this one is pretty darn good. I've never been a vanilla fan per se, but I really like the Vanilla Latte flavor. It has a very light, a mere hint really of vanilla in the milk. When the machine is steaming & applying the pressure to the milk pod, you get a faint aroma of vanilla as the mug fills. The flavor is delicate and doesn't overwhelm the rest of the coffee. I like a sweet drink so I have to add a hit of sugar to all of coffees, so while it says it's a lightly sweetened latte, they really mean LIGHTLY. The main thing I do like is that Nescafe is not using fake sweeteners (like splenda etc)so you don't get a funky aftertaste with any of the flavors. This Vanilla Latte is one we'll be ordering from Amazon in the three packs. (we've been buying each flavor in single boxes at the local W-Mart)

Although I have been happy with every other Necscafe Dolce Gusto flavor that I have tried, I wouldn't order this particular flavor again. The vanilla Latte is just too weak.The regular Latte Macchiato is better. You can taste the coffee flavor.

I have only had my machine for about a month but I ordered the 3 pack of these vanilla latte macchiato because I kept adding vanilla flavoring to the cappuccino drinks.  I had very high expectations for these and I was disappointed.  My favorite drink is a skinny vanilla latte from Starbucks but these taste nothing like it.  They do have a weird processed vanilla flavor to them.  I LOVE the cappuccino drinks for the dolce gusto machine.  Don't order these if you want a vanilla flavored drink, just order the cappuccinos and some different flavorings to add to them.  My boyfriend, whose idea of coffee is QuikTrip Cappuccino loaded with sugar, likes these with a couple tablespoons of sugar dumped in.

I bought these for my dad who was gifted the coffee machine for Christmas.  He likes the really sweet cappuccino that you can buy at the gas station.  Based on the sounds of this, i thought it would work but this coffee is not at all sweet. It still tastes good but beware if you want a sweet coffee

column9: A box on the table keeps my jimmies stable
column10: You have no idea how many times people ask me how I can stay so composed. When I tell them that it's because of my breakfast cereal, they just shake their heads in disbelief and continue to dog me for the real answer. But it's because of this cereal that I can accomplish anything. Not only does it have that zesty taste that people love, it's also got a gorilla. A GORILLA. You tell me when you last saw a gorilla on a cereal box. Look at that calm gorilla. He's composed, he's cool, he's confident, he's in the zone. He's not here to impress you, he's here to eat his cereal and scratch himself. Don't YOU want to be like that? Don't YOU want to be a gorilla?You have jimmies? You want them to keep from getting rustled?Gorilla Munch is your answer.Keep a box on the table, and you'll keep your jimmies stable.
before I bought this I was having problems with my jimmies. They were constantly rustled and I would have died if I hadn't bought this cereal. It's now always within reach to keep my jimmies stable.
A great value for those who need to eat gluten free. Not just for kids.

my kids eat gluten-free & gorilla munch is an absolute essential item for me to have in the house.  not only do they enjoy it as breakfast, but it's great to include in a g.f. snack mix (popcorn, peanuts, gorilla munch, m&m's).  when i open the 3rd bag, i place my next order so i never run out.

My boys are gluten free and we love this cereal.  I also love the big bag, using less packaging (we keep it in a cereal saver with a pourable lid).However - my 15 yo son grew 5 inches in the last 18 mo and i'm sure he's got another 4-6 left in him.  He had been eating a box every 2 days, and there was only one place in town I could buy the bags.  With subscribe and save, its cheaper, I dont have to make a specail trip, and we dont run out - i love this!
I first purchased this cereal because my son needs gluten free cereal.  I come to quickly find out that a bag doesn't last very long in my house!!  I LOVE this cereal!  It is SOO tasty!

3 of my 4 kids have severe food allergies and finding healthy cereal that they can eat is always a challenge. We've always been pleased with Envirokidz and Gorilla Munch is no exception. They enjoy eating it, and I know I'm not putting any genetically modified food into their bodies or preservatives. I know I'm making a healthy choice for them. I'm just thankful that amazon offers this cereal at decent prices.

My now-grown daughter used to love Captain Crunch-type cereal, and gluten-free seemed to be all about rice cereal which she hated.  Anything else was honey-sweetened..another of her severe allergies.  Her GF shop got this in and she is in love, this is as close to the childhood favorites as she has seen in years! I'm now hooked on it too, as a snack right from the box!
The taste of this cereal is great, tastes like Kix. It very sweet and delicious. My only complaint is like it has little to no nutritional value in it.

When my daughter and I switched over to all-organic food, the price and lackluster taste of most of the cereals were a shock.  However, this cereal is truly great.  We both consume it in large quantities -- a great comfort food.  A little crispier than cocoa Rice Crispies, but very similar.  In bulk, from Amazon, we can afford it.
This is a very tasty non-wheat cereal for the kids.  I think it's the healthy version of Captain Crunch.  My kids love it.
good cereal very addictive tho could eat half a bag in one sitting!had a problem with one bag arrived cut open, amazon promptly sent out a replacement shipment.

My kids LOVE this and they are really hard to please. I love how healthy it is and I must admit I sneak a bowl or two without feeling bad, taste just like captain crunch without all the junk in it. Go for it!

This cereal is very good; it is lightly sweetened and the kids love it. It is also gluten free. Great price on subscribe & save. The bags come carefully boxed for shipping. It arrived quickly and in perfect condition, hardly any crumbs.

column9: Great organic and gluten free cereal
column10: Organic and Gluten free and it tastes good, can't get much better than that. They are sweet so I think kids would like them as well, but not so sweet as you feel like your eating a kids cereal.

I also bought this at Marshall's. I made homemade bread today and served the tapenade with the bread. So delicious. The flavor is wonderful. I like good olives, and I feel this has good olives in it. Try it.  If you like olives, you'll love this.

I just happened on a jar of this in our local Marshall's.  So happy to have found it on Amazon and know that I can always buy it.  We've eaten it with chips, crackers and on Italian bread.  It's got a wonderful consistency and taste.  Haven't tried it mixed with anything else because I only had one jar until now and never found another until looking on here.  Try it, you won't be sorry!
Used this for a recipe and then with the leftovers, I warmed it up on some cream cheese and dipped with crackers. Very yummy!
Brandini Toffee twopound Two Pound Box Brandini Almond ToffeeThis is the best toffee I've ever had! Seriously good, sweet and salty. It melts in your mouth. Mmmmmmmm :)
If you have never tried it, you must. Its the best popcorn ever. Reminds me of my days living in Hawaii! So glad I can order it online.

I made the popcorn with the butter and the mix. I avoid using butter on all foods for the pure fat content. I thought the butter packet was actually some type of caramel or sweet flavoring - but it was just butter. I used less than 1/2 of the butter packet after realizing it was not a flavoring and chucked the rest int he trash. The other packet tasted like seaweed and rice snacks. I tried it, won't try it again. Not impressed with the flavor, calories, or the snack in general.
Product was as advertised and received in good condition and in very good time.  Would recommend and will use this vendor in the future.

column9: Putting the ginger back in ginger ale!
column10: I know, I know. These reviews are nothing but memories, but I can't help it! If I can drink a tasty drink that is good for me, gives me energy, and makes me think of happy things, well, why wouldn't I? This one is all my grandmother and my father. Every Thanksgiving, my grandmother would let us drink cranberry juice mixed with ginger ale, and we felt so grown up. So grown up! It's still my preferred way of drinking cranberry juice, and when the cranberry ginger ale is released around the holidays, all I do is think of her. Her son, my father, is a ginger ale memory for me too, it's his favorite soft drink. Vernor's, if you've got it, or Schweppes, but Canada Dry will do in a pinch and make him think of me anyway. When my wife is ill, it's ginger ale, if you please, not lemon-lime anything. You know that old adage that girls always search for someone like their father? It's so true in my case...my wife and my father are amazingly alike. So when I spotted it on the Red Leaf tea website, I had to grab it for my campaign to get her to like ginger ale. Who knows, I might convert my dad with it when he comes up to visit next!This is wonderful. Ginger and I are not the best of buddies, but I'm coming around to it. This reminds me of a local ginger ale found only in Middle Kentucky called "Ale-8-1". It's full of ginger flavor, but in a very good way. If you get this one, don't be put off by the overwhelming ginger smell, it's not nearly as strong as it smells, which is a good thing to me. It would definitely be a matcha I reach for when I'm headed into work with an upset stomach, but need a pick me up. I don't think it's one I'll keep in stock, but it's not one I'll be actively trying to swap away either. I'm excited to try it with the cranberry. If you're familiar with ginger ale brands, it's more of a Vernor's than anything else. Lord have mercy, I spend way too much time with ginger ale, apparently. But if I can talk my Dad into trying matcha, this will definitely be the one I lead with. Who knows, my father in law greatly enjoyed the French Vanilla matcha from Red Leaf Tea, maybe my dad can be won over as well!

I had previously used faerie's finest liquid raspberry flavoring with good results.  As many of my recipes require a low amt of liquid, I opted to change to a powder.  The powder is much less flavorful than the liquid.  The smell is not obvious (expected for powder).  However, this same effect carries over into the product.  The powder and liquid measurements are supposed to be equivalent.  However, putting in 1/2 tsp of powder resulted in minimal scent and taste.  I ended up using twice as much powder as liquid to get an equivalent effect.  The powder is a much weaker flavoring product than the liquid.  The taste is OK but does taste a bit more chemically than the liquid.

I have a couple of dogs, one of which, loves to chew on bones. I gave it to my dog as a Christmas treat and it went to town. But later I found little splinters on the floor. It did not register to me at first since it had lost the meat flavoring color and it was pure white. Still being oblivious at the time, I tried to give the same dog another one, seeing how he loved the first one, and he just walked the other way. Then after my dog threw up, the bone splinter riddle was solved.Later, my daughter, who works at a dog adoption organization, told me that I should have never given my dog pork bones... at least not the dried out variety. Perhaps this won't be a problem for your dog but my dog can really chew thru bone... so maybe that was it. In any case, lesson learned for me with my dogs. And perhaps a heads up for you and your dog if you have any concerns.

My dog almost died from this product. The bone splinters and the company knows it. They have a liability statement on their product because I am sure I am not the first dog owner to have gone through the hell that I went through. I bought a smoked bone from the grocery store because I thought it was big looking, met the size required for my dog and I thought since it was American made it was a quality product. It is far less than quality. Would anyone give arsenic to their dog, absolutely not. So don't spend your money on this killer product. After 3,500 dollars in gastronomy surgery, emergency care,I spent a sad and scared Christmas tending to a poor puppy whining and whelping in pain from their defective junk. Please take this review to heart, I want to spare you what I went through.
While my large dogs loved these, they finished them off in minutes.  The picture really makes the buyer believe these are large size bones, but in fact, they are about 3.5" long.

column9: DO NOT BUY THESE - THEY CAN KILL YOUR PET
column10: Absolutely DO NOT BUY these bones! I bought a 3 pack, gave one to each of my 3 dogs and had to have emergency gastric surgery for all 3. The bones will splinter when they are eaten and can perforate the stomach or intestines.
im always in need more of these...keeps my dog busy and away from chewing stuff he shouldnt,i have couple stocked up

I used to get these bones locally, but the store I got them from no longer carries them.  I have tried the same type of beef bones from other manufacturers, but a large piece always cracks down the middle of the bone.  These bones by Hartz are great.  My 90 pound dog chews on them for months.

column9: Splinters & Dog Just Vomited Undigested Pieces
column10: The aroma of the Hartz Smoked Pork Bone is just downright memorizing-even tempting the taste buds of humans. That's about the extent of the reasons I like this product. This splinters BADLY!! My 75 lb Dalmatian ate one last night @10pm and today @ 5pm he vomited shards of the bone (which was a lot) and everything else he ate that couldn't pass as a result of these bone fragments blocking the passageway of his intestines. Please do not purchase these bones for your dog! If you care enough about them; then find something else!
this is a great product that will keep your dogs busy for a couple of days. mine can eat a large rawhide in 30 minutes, but not these bones. highly recommended, made in USA too!

My dog loves these bones. I only let her have them when I'm watching.She actually can eat them now and get sick. I have purchases these bones at Walmart cheaper, these were a little pricey. I will most likely just get them at Walmart from now on.

column9: GREAT product that encourages HEALTHY chewing!
column10: A co-worker recommended that we get a knuckle bone after my complaints of our lab puppy wanting to chew on EVERYTHING.  We bought the first one at Petco, Petco brand, and she loved it and eventually broke it in two (prob a month or so after having it), and she was needing a new one.  I decided to go with this one on Amazon and she LOVED it!! She spent an entire hour chewing on this just during the first sitting.  She carries it around the house with her and it is FANTASTIC because she doesn't try to chew the wall anymore (or carpet! augh!!).  Highly recommend. :)  Thanks, Amazon.

column9: DON'T DO IT!  MY DOG THREW UP A POOL OF BLOOD!
column10: Gave my Dachshund this Hartz "Premium" bone for "aggressive chewers" on Sunday afternoon.  By dinner Monday she was not eating or drinking.  By Tuesday morning (this day) she was throwing up bright red pools of blood!  I had her to the Vet within an hour and $354.32 later learned that this Hartz "Premium" bone for "aggressive chewers" tore up her intestines.  She is now on 3 medications and a special diet for the next week.  The vet advised me to contact Hartz to let them know what happened.  I plan on doing that AND sending a copy of the bill.  I don't expect them to pay it (they'll likely file it in the circular file) but they need see it and hear about it. I purchased these Hartz "Premium" bones for "aggressive chewers" from Walmart so did not have the advantage of the WARNING reviews on Amazon. You do.  Don't do this to your dog.

I purchased this bone at a local supermarket and gave it to my boxer. I walked in the house to literally make a cup of coffee and my dog devoured the bone. What a surprise, when the packaging clearly says: "...this long last chew satisfies your dog's instintive urge to chew." I didn't think anything about it until 2 hours later when after a walk, my dog regurgitated twice! I checked the vomit and sure enough, there was shards of the bone inside. This stuff was so sharp it actually cut my latex glove! BE CAREFUL. If it could cut my glove, it can damage a dog's stomach, colon, intestines and/or esophogus. THIS PRODUCT SHOULD BE TAKEN OFF THE MARKET AND NOT SOLD! There is a disclaimer on the product packaging, "This is a natural product and may be prone to splintering." Are you kidding me!? I have been monitoring my dog, whom regurgitated two more times since. Still not sure if I need to go to the vet yet. Gave her 1/3 can of pumpkin to coat her stomach and 3-slices of white bread, which I read will gum up and help her pass any shards in her stomach. Why any company would sell such a product is beyond me. This american made item, lacks the quality to sell in america. I am appalled it is even being sold on the shelves. STAY AWAY. Read the other negative reviews. $3500 for stomach surgery and chances of fatalities. Is it worth it to risk the life of a loved family member over a $3.00 bone! Absolutely not. DO NOT PURCHASE, IT IS UNSAFE.
You people arn't going to believe this but.... My dog likes flavored bones, go figure. Why are you reading a review on dog bones?.... A better question:... Why am I writing one?

I bought this product today hoping to amuse my chew-loving dog. But after unwrapping the packaging, I was disappointed. Not only did the bone have a weird, unnatural oil all over it but it also smelled like chemicals. I offered it to my dog, who after being so excited at the sight of the bone, smelled it and walked away! I tried to wash off all the meat and other particles outside but even the inside smelled like chemicals and my dog was not buying it!

column9: My Lab just ate the whole thing!
column10: OMG, I gave this to my 1 year old, 110 lab and he ran outside with it. I got distracted and when I went to check he had already eaten the entire thing. The only thing I could find were two horrible splinter pieces!! Now I'm at this moment terrified!!! It's only been a hour since it happened and now all we can do is wait and watch. I've given him some bread and he gets pumkin every night anyway. Plus he had already eaten his dinner so I'm hoping his "full" tummy will help the bone to pass. Needless to say my husband is mad at me for not showing it to him before I handed it out. But we've been going through some major life issues the last couple of weeks and I'm not thinking clearly as it is. I soooo wish I could turn back time and have never given it to him!! Please stay away from this bone and please, if you are reading this and have any good thoughts to help while I wait, I'm open to them as I am worried sick!!! I've already lost my 14 year old lab in Sept and this one we got in Oct and he his my Angel!!! I would die if anything happened to him!!!

My dog recived these for christmas this year. and he loves them! he doesnt like any of the fake bones or made treats he loves real bones of course what dog doesnt! Hes been chewing them up for hours and hours since.

Been working on it for about 3 months now and it is still the same size as when we bought it.  Recommended for very large dogs only.
