Having never tried Oolong (Wulong) tea before I blindly purchased this particular one with the most reviews. There really aren't many green teas on Amazon that have more than 2 reviews if that.Anyways, I tried this first and it was very tasty and had a very distinct peach flavour. The day after I received it and sampled it I went to my local farmer's market (not like a Harry's this one is a local and very decently priced organic farmer's market) and I purchased some plain Oolong. I looked up information on how to tell if the Oolong that you have is good quality and comparing the 2 they both came out to be good quality. The Oolong I bought at the farmer's market was excellent quality actually (by the guides I'd found on google) but this Peach Oolong is still pretty good quality. The only thing it didn't do to deem it excellent is unfold. The dried leave/roasted leaves are supposed to gain some of their (green) colour back after being steeped, and unfold (i.e. look like full leaves). But aside from that this Peach Oolong matched every standard I found for good quality Oolong.Also, for any potential buyers. One uses 1 tablespoon of oolong to brew a 8oz cup of tea and that one tablespoon can be used 5 times in total without losing strength or flavour. Just make sure to keep the leaves covered in water (leave some tea in your cup, just enough to cover the leaves). They need to be kept moist in order to keep their strength and not dry out. I tended to leave a bit in the bottom of a cup with the leaves or leave a tea ball with the leaves in another cup of water (it doesn't steep and brew more, it just keeps it moist :)...I used cold water but I don't know if temperature of storage water matters). I hope this helps and I hope you guys enjoy the tea. It's tasty. I'm enjoying it at my office right now :-D.
I bough some from France and the quality is super! The one I received is very disappointed... It does not smell good and it is even worst after cook!

column9: Great price for more than a pound of yellowcake!
column10: Amazon has it all! You can get aluminum tubes (Aluminum 6061-T6 Pipe Schedule 40 2.5" nom. (2.88" OD x 0.2" Wall x 2.469" ID) Cut to 12" for example) for your nuclear power plant, and the yellowcake too (this listing, and in bulk in DH Classic Yellow Cake 12ct as well).You may ask yourself, can I get the guidance section for a ballistic missile? Can I get anthrax? I say, use the amazon search feature and find out.

column9: So delicious and loved at party
column10: I purchased these for my 3 yr olds dessert table at her party. They are more of a light purple color than pink as it looks in photo. There were delicious and many of the mommies loved them too. Shipped fast and were yummy, would buy again!

I received my order pretty quickly.  These chips are AWESOME.  If you like the red hot Cheetos, you will like these.  I think THESE are better.  They have that EXTRA kick!  You will NOT be DISAPPOINTED with this item.  I have my friends HOOKED.  I bet you can't eat just one!

These are really good. My two little cousins came up to visit me from Texas and got me into these. I don't like it when the hotness of a food over powers what I'm eating, but these are perfect. Also, the powder/dust tastes PHENOMINAL on fresh watermelon. Yummy!:)
It was ome of my mother's christmas gifts. I felt that it was pretty small for the price. Had I seen it at a store, I would not have purchased.
Necco wafers are one of life's simple pleasures. The price on these is significantly less than when I find them in stores, and they're packaged in more serving-size packaging.

column4: Eric R. Hale "Just a regular guy"
column10: Yummy chalky wafers that you used to get at Grandma's house.  I know she used them to pay the tolls.

I bought this as a birthday gift for my dad; Neccos were his favorite childhood treat.  Now he's got lots of Neccos to enjoy!  This size is a bit much for a single person, but the tub and the individually-wrapped servings make this great for sharing.

People either love or hate NECCO's, whether the roll candy available at checkouts for 50 years or the Valentine and Xmas hearts and treats.  I love them, except the tart versions which are quite bad.  The normal NECCO candy is sweet and elicits memories of penny candy back in the day.
THIS IS AN OLD TRICK FROM MY CHILDHOOD...SHATTERING TARGETS. WE USED TO SHOOT THESE THINGS WITH .22'S, THEY ARE BIODEGRADABLE AND ANYTHING YOU MISS CAN BE EATEN. TASTY AND FUN.

column9: Product is spoiled with a no-return policy
column10: I have enjoyed Slim-Jims for many years and was looking forward to having a case of them shipped to me.  I recieved them yesterday and tore into one only to find a whole box of old spoiled ones that our dog wouldn't even eat.  Please take this as a warning if you are about to order this product.  I came on line to find out how to return this product and it tells me that it is non-returnable.  I guess I am out $14.00 for this product.  Can anyone tell me short of contacting the Slimjim co.  if there is a way to get a refund.  This was my first and last time ordering food from Amazon.  I am glad I didn't order more.

Okay, actually, half this product isn't bad. The mild beef sausages are tasty little pencils, if greasy. The "cheese", on the other hand, is like pastel crayons, having the magical property of being a stick of wax that powders and crumbles when you have the misfortune to bite it. It's really disgusting and tastes a little like ear wax.

I thought that the first reviewer may have been overexaggerating, but this one really does taste bad. I believe the only way to come close to enjoying the cheese part of this is to store the box, in its entirety, in a humid environment so the cheese can, well, get soft. Other than that, it's horrible and you should simply discard it. The Slim Jim, on the other hand, is "so-so" but may taste better with a dip or something. This is not the same as the skinny Slim Jims (you know, the addictive ones) so if you don't want to ruin your taste buds with so-so beef and horrible cheese, move on.

column9: Slim Jim Beef & Cheese Twin Pack, Mild, 18-count Box
column10: Yeah they were old. It's ok to offer these just make sure they are fresh! Please get new ones cause I'd love to order more! But put the expiration date somewhere so we'll know what we're ordering! Do something!!!
THIS WAS THE WORST PRODUCT, THAT WE HAVE EVER GOTTEN, IT WAS OLD AND OUT DATED. I WOULD NOT EVER BUY THIS PRODUCT AGAIN.

I guess everyone has their own tastes. I like these for quick snacks. They travel well, and keep well. However, they are not the best combination of sausage and cheese one can find if they have a refrigerator and time.

After reading a lot of reviews on puppy food, I settled on Nature's Variety Prairie puppy food.  It has high quality ingredients, no by-products, and lots of vitamins and minerals for my little guy to develop into a healthy adult.  The food has made my dog's coat super lustrous; he's an almost 5 month old Pembroke Welsh Corgi.  Since switching to this brand (we were using Authority puppy food before), his coat has become super shiny and soft.  He loves the taste and it makes his poops relatively small and hard.  If switching to this brand, be sure to switch slowly by integrating larger and larger amounts of this food while decreasing amounts of the original food.  I highly recommend this product, and the price is cheaper on Amazon than at Petco!
Naturade Total Soy Meal Replacement powder was as advertised - the taste was very good and was beneficial in eliminating some extra calories, without feeling hungry.

...this is not their best product.  I have been an ardent devourer of Mestemacher breads ever since my trip to Germany 3 years ago. This was my first time ordering the Rye & Spelt (to shake things up) and while it is enjoyable, it's definitely not my favorite. It's on the drier, more crumbly side (vs. the 3-Grain, Fitness and Sunflower varieties)and the flavor is decent.

I love this bread as an alternative to wheat bread.  It is very thin and dense, but is still moist.  I like to toast it in a toaster oven.  I use to buy it at the store,if I could find it, but was paying about $4.00 a loaf.  Buying it in quantity on-line saves a lot of money. It stores well in the refrigerator or freezer. Handle carefully to avoid breaking the loafs. There are a number of different kinds.  Some have wheat, so read the labels, if you are avoiding wheat.

This delicious, nutty-tasting bread is great for those who are trying to avoid the bloating that can come from consuming too much wheat and/or carbs.  Although traditional sandwiches are out of the question (the bread tends to break up a bit when pressure is applied), it's great for open-faced sandwiches.  I like to toast it and spread it with almond or peanut butter.  It makes a delicious, healthy and filling breakfast.

I LOVE this stuff!  I used to buy the pre-made hummus in my local Trader Joe's market, but when I discovered Harmony Valley's Hummus mix it gave me the freedom to make as much or as little as I'd like.  Not only that, but as an international traveler, it's wonderful to be able to take it traveling with me because I don't have to worry about it leaking or spoiling.  I'll be stocking up!

column9: Vegan dish served in Buddhist monasteries
column10: The food label Companion sells a line of vegan foods made of wheat gluten and tofu, many with vegetables like mushrooms, carrots, string beans, bamboo shoots, baby corns etc., seasoned with soy and/or chili sauce.  The company is based in Taiwan.  It is said that these foods are dishes served in Buddhist monasteries in China.  This Vegetarian Sausage With Chop Suey Morsels is one of these Companion foods.  It is made of wheat gluten, straw mushrooms, and bamboo shoots in soy sauce.  It is delicious over steamed rice.  It adds variety to a vegan diet.  See my comment below for other buying options.

I love this chocolate. The Lindt bittersweet is great, and the larger size has a nicer bite when you eat a chunk. It's not always in stock.4 bars tends to last me a few months, as I am a casual chocolate eater.

There is no finer chocolate in all the world, in my opinion. After I went vegan, I found myself pining for chocolate. Like an idiot, I tried the only thing I could find in the stores, Baker's. Then I discovered Lindt... The thing is, even though this is technically "dark" or "non-milk" chocolate, it tastes like the most divine of milk chocolates. Truly, truly worth the price!

I have purchased Leilalove's cookies numerous times I have to say that I get so addicted to them I can't stop eating :) There's nothing more amazing then those heavenly cookies melting in your mouth! I am 110% pleased with the quality of this product in comparison to other gluten free boxed cookies that I've tried. I would have to say these are my favorite!Enjoy the taste of heaven :DNatalie Yankova
Very yummy.  The Macaroons are soft and very fresh tasting.  I would buy again.  Cute packaging and original flavors.  Would make a great gift.
I purchased these macarons because I've always wanted to try them and I was very satisfied. I absolutely loved the way they were packed and they tased great!

Sent these to my Dad as a get well after surgery; he really loved them. He and I both have celiac, so it's hard to send the typical box of chocolates. Great opportunity to send something unique, and safe!

First of all, the positives...The packaging is gorgeous; totally a reusable box for any gift in the future that you want to give someone, if not gifting the Macarons in the first place (wouldn't recommend THESE though).The yellow colored one was by FAR the best tasting in the box- Absolutely delicious.And the texture was PERFECTION- At least on three of the four.And then the negatives...I know that this listing didn't list the flavors in the box, however color is usually a good indication of what's to come...  At least that's what I thought.WRONG!!!  :(As I said above, I really enjoyed the yellow one (which was the last one I ate, thankfully)- The other three though?  Not so much.I literally have NO IDEA what the flavors of ANY of them were...  Once the package arrived, there was no guide, no clue, no nothing.Gotta admit, that was kinda surprising, considering these are hardly a "cheap" dessert, if you catch my drift, especially since so much effort had been placed upon packaging as well.And then, the fact that one of them arrived crushed was quite disappointing...Especially since it was pretty obvious that it was due to mishandling before shipment, considering the box was lined with peanuts for added protection, with no dents or damage visible to the cardboard packaging, or the inside box.Ultimately, disappointing.I really wish your next customer has a good experience.

I had never had a macaroon before ordering these, and I will definitely be ordering specifically from LeilaLove again. Her customer service is fantastic, shipping is quick, packaging is beautiful & high quality, and the cookies are DELICIOUS!!
This product is FANTASTIC! It is so delicious and appropriate for any occasion! I would recommend this to anyone I know.

I ordered these for a friend's birthday.  She declared them beautiful and delicious!  As an added benefit they arrived at my friend's house within 3 days of me ordering them.  I was very pleased and will definitely order them again.

column9: I love the mix of coffee and chocolate!
column10: Scharffen Berger Mocha (Dark Chocola with Freshly Roasted Coffee) Chocolate Bar (62% Cacao)I am not a big fan of chocolate, nor am I a chocolate connoisseur, but I really like these Mocha chocolate bars. First, they come in the old school chocolate wrappers that use a paper outer labeling with foil for the chocolate itself. There are 400 calories, 30 grams of fat, and 32 grams of sugar carbs in each bar. The bar is labeled as being 62 % cacao. It is mainly dark bittersweet chocolate mixed with Sumatran coffee beans. When chomping on the chocolate, it tastes a lot like dark coffee mixed with dark hot cocoa, and a hint of sweetness. The texture is slightly gritty, not nearly the same as a Nestle Crunch, but you can definitely taste some of the crushed beans.I really liked the packaging, and the fact the chocolate isn't too sweet (although 32 g of sugar per bar is fairly significant).Overall: 5 out of 5 stars, doesn't taste overly sweet like the milk chocolates you buy at the local store.

column9: Compares with the best of Switzerland.  MmmmmMMMmmm
column10: I am fortunate enough to have a daughter who fell in love with a brilliant, dashing Swiss national, and ran away to Live Happily Ever After with her One True Love in a rustic love-nest tucked away amongst the pines of the Snow-Covered Alps. (Well, actually, in an apartment on Av. de Riant-Mont in Lausanne, but whatever...).To ensure my continued forbearance with this situation, I am routinely bribed with the best of Swiss chocolates.  And I am here to tell you that Scharffen Berger holds its own against the best of the best.This chocolate bar is heaven for the lover of bitter-sweet chocolate.  Glossy, dark, aromatic, the texture of this bar is smooth and silky.  The flavor is exquisite, the coffee adding a decidedly interesting punch and a slight crunch to the experience.And I can get this from Amazon???  OH! Thank you, Gods of Chocolate....  No more pining away on the steps of the local Post Office, shivering in the cold, waiting for the next shipment of fine chocolate to arrive from Switzerland...  I can now die a happy woman.  Amen.

column9: Artisian Chocolate: Deep Flavored Dark Chocolate with Strong Coffee Bean Bits --- Delicious!  -- No Chemicals - All Natural
column10: This is a delicious gourmet chocolate bar of dark chocolate with small bits of Sumatran coffee beans in it. The dark chocolate has great flavor and the coffee is a strong taste but it does not overpower or cover up the chocolate's taste. Very nicely balanced!This bar is all natural having few ingredients: cacao beans, sugar, cocoa butter, cofee, non-GMO soy lecithin and whole vanilla beans. This product is gluten free.Scharffen Berger is an American company founded by two California men. Using artisian chocolate making methods they craft chocolate in small batches using the best ingredients from around the world and with vintage European chocolate making equipment.I have seen this company and their methods profiled on television food shows in the past, and what I recall is the committment to high qualiy ingredients and how the founders travel around the world shopping for the best ingredients offered in specific regions.For years this company's chocolate has been used by chefs to make high quality desserts. Scharffen Berger sells many different products now, some for baking and some for savoring as gourmet chocolate candy. Be sure to read the label's product information to learn what that bar is.Knowing the work that went into producing the bars explains and justifies the price.I rate this 5 stars = I Love It.

I had not heard of Scharffen Berger chocolate before, so I was looking forward to sample of their Mocha Dark Chocolate with Freshly Roasted Coffee to review.  After trying this product I must say that I really enjoyed it and look forward to eating the rest of the batch.  :)Scharffen Berger Mocha Chocolate is 62% cocoa, which is higher than most mass produced chocolates American eat but not as high as the 70% and 80% cocoa bars I have tried in the past.  As such, this is a dark chocolate but not quite a "bittersweet" chocolate to me.  Those used to consuming milk chocolate may find the taste strong, but I think it is wonderful.  The key differentiation of this product, however, is the introduction of ground fresh roasted coffee to the mix.  The ground coffee adds a bit of graininess to the chocolate and a strong hint of "mocha" flavor, though I don't think it overwhelms the basic chocolate flavor at all.  To me it is a great combination, and I highly recommend Scharffen Berger Mocha Chocolate to dark chocolate lovers.Note: According to Wiki, Scharffen Berger was an independent chocolate producer in the San Fransisco Bay area that was acquired by the Hershey Company in 2005. Scharffen Berger continues to produce chocolate under this name, now at a plant in Illinois.

I am a chocoholic.  I've had it all (well, a lot).  This is the best chocolate I've tasted since my first bite of Belgian chocolate IN Belgium in 1973.  The ingredients are basic and natural...even uses non-gmo soy lecithin...and the consistency is crispy perfect.  Wish it wasn't quite so expensive, but I just ration it and enjoy one bar many times.
I am a big fan of scharffen berger and the new mocha is a nice twist on the original dark chocolate.  Definitely worth a try for any coffee lovers out there.

column9: Assertive coffee flavor makes for wonderful baked goods
column10: I first tried Scharffen Berger's Mocha chocolate when a relative sent it to me in an overseas care package. Normally, I walk right by it in the store due to the high price tag, but it was a much-needed taste of home. I've always loved chocolate-covered espresso beans, and that's pretty much what this bar is: bittersweet chocolate with rough grains of coffee. Because of its texture, I use this in recipes calling for melted chocolate; it makes fantastic mocha pots de creme and is divine as a brownie base (I used this while reviewing The Fearless Baker: Scrumptious Cakes, Pies, Cobblers, Cookies, and Quick Breads that You Can Make to Impress Your Friends and Yourself's mocha cream cheese brownies, and it really added a coffee-packed punch). It's also good as an out-of-hand snack, although as previously mentioned, the ground coffee adds a slight gritty texture that may not appeal to all. The chocolate is visually beautiful; the smooth sheen and clean snap speak to perfect tempering and storage (I was a little afraid that my chocolate had melted during mailing, but it arrived in perfect condition). This one is a winner in your special occasion baked goods (due to the high cost, I use this for holidays and birthdays rather than everyday baking).

Silky smooth dark chocolate with coffee bits mixed within.  These are fantastic as they are, though I could never eat a whole one in one sitting - breaking off small bits at a time makes an exquisite little snack or reward.  I also took one of the bars, broke it up and added it to some nestle toll house cookies before baking... it wasn't awful, but it also wasn't something I would do again... the coffee made the cookies gritty and gave them a rather burnt flavor.  That has nothing to do with the chocolate bar itself though - I highly recommend them to be eaten as the chocolate bars they were designed to be.

column9: Better than most Dark Chocolate I've tried
column10: Normally I'm not much into dark chocolate, but the mocha caught my eye.  This one isn't overpowering or bitter like many dark mochas I've tried.  It seems the hint of coffee nicely balances the chocolate, and there's even small bits of coffee bean inside the chocolate.  I could totally see chocolate and coffee lovers getting addicted to this bar. It's really quite good, and high quality too.

I didn't move fast enough to secure the flavor of chocolate I really wanted (you have to be fast in the reviewing world), but this one - Scharffenberger Dark Chocolate With Freshly Brewed Coffee - was a worthy second choice.These varieties of chocolate cater greatly to those who prefer dark chocolate, which, after all, is better for you if you are to believe the experts. Luckily for me, my mother instilled a love of bittersweet/dark chocolate when I was quite small, and while it is a scramble in some circles for the best bits of dark chocolate out of gift boxes or at parties, I generally manage to find my surfeit of the stuff. I'm always looking for new chocolate experiences, however, and some brands are much better than others. Scharffenberger makes an exceptional chocolate, in all the other varieties I've chosen at the store (the ones I'm most familiar with come in small 1 oz bars),so I was happy to try this one.For lovers of chocolate with a shot of coffee, this is the real deal. Little crystals of coffee crunch in your teeth, and the dark (62%) chocolate melts lusciously in your mouth. This is a flavor I will buy again. Very recommended.

column9: Melds two of the world's greatest flavors
column10: Scharffen Berger Mocha (Dark Chocolate w/Freshly Roasted Coffee) Chocolate Bar = !!!! Keeping the superlatives constrained proves a futile task here. Scharffen Berger has melded two of the world's greatest flavors into one amazing confection.The first impression comes from the dark silky chocolate which tantalizes one's taste buds with its rich, silky flavor. Next comes the sensation of Sumatran coffee beans, a taste that lingers a bit longer than the chocolate, rasping gently across the tongue, as both flavors then intertwine in a jolt of goodness.If you have every enjoyed dark chocolate-covered espresso beans, the Scharffen Berger Mocha takes that experience to a much higher level. At about $4 each, these chocolate bars are a splurge. Sometimes a bit of a splurge is good for the soul.

I have never had Scharffen Berger chocolate before, but wow. I have read a lot about it on food blogs, and as a native Californian have heard a lot about the shop in San Francisco. The hype is well-deserved!Every bite of this dark chocolate has ground coffee, which can be off-putting for some but very pleasing for this coffee lover! The roasted coffee flavor is strong, but not overwhelming and the chocolate flavor still shines. Although it's dark chocolate, the 62% cacao means it's not incredibly bitter, and is sweet enough to nibble on throughout the day. Delicious!

I dare you to eat this candy without involuntarily saying "Um-m-m" as each bite dissolves in your mouth.  It goes without saying that I'm addressing those among us who appreciate very dark chocolate.  This is THE BEST of that breed and, in addition, these bars contain just a hint of coffee, barely detectable, but enough that it adds "that little something."  As a matter of fact, besides their delicate flavor, the ground coffee beans also add a little crunch.  Different, but a winner!

While eating this bar, I compared this with two other dark chocolate bars with coffee beans that I regularly eat: Endangered Species Dark Chocolate with Espresso Beans (72%) and Chocolove Coffee Crunch in Dark Chocolate (55%).My first impression of the Scharffen Berger is that the coffee more finely ground, so it's not crunchy like the Endangered Species or Chocolove, but it's not smooth either. It's more similar to the Green & Black (which I didn't have with me to compare while eating the Scharffen Berger so I don't entirely recall). It ends up just making the chocolate feel gritty in my mouth.My next impression is that the bar itself is significantly thinner than other bars, which gives it a softer, smoother texture, but ultimately just ends up emphasizing the gritty texture of the coffee.I also felt like the chocolate itself was a little bit sweet which I attributed to it being a 62% versus the 72% of the Endangered Species. However, the Chocolove is a 55%, which should be too sweet for me, but that chocoloate holds up much better and seems smoother than the Scharffen Berger.My final issue with the Scharffen Berger is that it has a lingering, bitter after-taste that I don't get with the other bars, providing a less-than-satisfying experience that makes me want to go eat or drink something else.Overall, I think the Chocolove and Endangered Species coffee and/or espresso chocolate bars are far superior.

I love Scharffen Berger chocolate and this bar is no exception. The flavor is rich and deep. If you don't like coffee, it has a strong presence, though not masking the dark chocolate itself.This is a great snack on its own, and good in desserts as well. I recommend it!

column9: For serious coffee fans - you'll love it or hate it
column10: I am a serious coffee lover. I would give this bar five stars, as I really liked the smooth dark chocolate mixed with the slightly bitter coffee taste. I had a hard time not scoffing an entire bar down at once! However, my kids and husband did not share my enthusiasm. The kids felt it was too bitter and not sweet enough.  The husband made a comment about chocolate mixed with old Starbucks grounds, and left me to consume the rest of the stash alone. To me, these bars are far better tasting than the typical waxy American fare, which contains little actual cocoa and too much sugar.  If your tastes run similarly, you will love these mocha bars.

It's hard to go wrong combining chocolate and coffee, and this Scharffen Berger Mocha combination is great. This doesn't taste like a super-sweet candy bar, but is instead a rich dark chocolate with scattered bits of roasted ground coffee beans. It's satisfying enough that a small amount eaten at a time is perfectly sufficient, so each bar tends to last a little while. Recommended as a morning (or any time of day) pick-me-up!

column9: Nice blend of semi-sweet dark chocolate and Sumatran coffee
column10: This is tasty semi-sweet dark chocolate with grounded Sumatran coffee beans blended in. You definitely crunch the taste and taste the crunch but it is a very mild crunch. The taste is great if you like dark chocolate, coffee and sugar. It has 62% cacao. I liked it!The six-pack of individual bars is wrapped in see-through material as an extra layer of protection but it is easy to open. The color of the paper wrapper looks nice and earthy, it makes it look more fancy in a good way.Nutrition-wise, well this is a dessert. The whole bar is 400 calories. The label has a serving size of half a bar. However, if you have self-control you can easily turn it into eight servings or so.The chocolate bar itself has a design of its own, with the Scharffen logo in the middle. It is not the usual row of squares. This can be a little bit of a challenge if you are planning to share with other people, since you can't just break a square or a row. The design pattern is made of triangles with a trapezoid (parallelogram?) in the middle. It might be easier to try to break it along the grooves of the patterns, resulting in triangle-shaped pieces.Dark chocolate is good for you, but make no mistake, this is a dessert, with 400 calories total, and nearly equal parts fat and sugar :) The whole bar has 32g of sugars, 8g of dietary fiber, 6g of protein, 30g of fat (20g of which are saturated), and 16% iron. A very bright spot: 0% sodium and 0mg cholesterol! (this is by multiplying the serving size by two; actual numbers may vary slightly since they label numbers are rounded)The list of ingredients is so short: cacao beans, sugar, cocoa butter, coffee, non-gmo soy lecithin, and whole vanilla beans.So if you have the discipline to eat only a triangle every time, this is very reasonable nutrition-wise. I do not :)

Do you want to make the most divine brownies in the world?  Use the Scharffen Berger Dar Chocolate Mocha bar instead of your usual chocolate and you'll get a new depth of flavor and richness.  The coffee taste cuts the sweetness and it melts easily in a double boiler.  If you are planning on just eating this chocolate, know that it has flavor nibs -  itty bits of coffee - which may or may not work texturally for you.

column9: THIS is what dark chocolate should be!
column10: I don't know if I have ever tasted chocolate as delicious as Scharffen Berger Mocha! The chocolate is smooth and creamy, and the coffee adds a delicious crunch. This is chocolate to savor!The price is a little steep at just over $4 per bar, but that's pretty comparable to the "gourmet" chocolate bars you can find at Walmart, and this is so much tastier!I'll be buying some to give away at Christmas ... and some to keep for myself! If you like the coffee and chocolate combination, give Scharffen Berger a taste!

You can never get enough chocolate and this rich, luscious bar more than satisfies both the chocolate lover and the coffee lover.  It's made in Illinois with quality, all-natural ingredients and has a subtle, sophisticated taste that is both interesting and more importantly, delicious.  The chocolate and the coffee flavors come through vividly but without the cloyingly sweet taste and waxy feel which is so common to commercial candy bars.  The finely ground Sumatran coffee gives the bar a nice, slightly crunchy texture which contributes to its appeal.  This is candy for grown-ups.Scharffen Berger has created a bar which is equal to the finest European chocolates and of which they can rightly be proud.

Let's face it, once you reach a certain age mike chocolate can taste just a little too sweet.  I think sometimes that's why dark chocolate was invented.  There's been a boom recently in the availability of dark chocolates with high cacao content.  I have never really tried one until this Scharffen Berger bar (I stuck with the ones that came in sampler boxes or brand names.)  I loved the bitter and slightly sweet of this bar.  The addition of the roasted coffee was a pleasant twist from your average "coffee flavoring."  If you like your coffee strong and your chocolate strong, you can't go wrong with this little gem.  Children beware:  mine frowned at the taste.  Of course mom and dad loved every bite.

Scharffen Berger is American Chocolate at its finest. These are about as removed from your typical Hershey's bar as possible (even though the company is now owned by Hershey's). The taste is less sweet and more refined than your typical chocolate. Although I don't have the vocabulary to describe it's taste as well as I'd like, I will make an attempt. The chocolate, at first bite, is subtle and not very sweet at all, but then once the you crunch the coffee beans, the chocolate, along with the beans, give a nicely sweet but not cloying taste that is both delicious and unique. My guess is that most premium chocolate fans will fall in love with this tasty treat like I did.

column9: Well balanced Dark Chocolate and Coffee
column10: I love dark chocolate and especially the trend to use high levels of Cacao. I also love coffee, perhaps even more than chocolate. Scharffen Berger Mocha is a balanced dark chocolate. It is strong, but not painfully strong to any dark chocolate lover. A fair amount of ground coffee is in the chocolate contributes to the bitterness, but is also not over the top. It might not be for anyone that doesn't like the texture of coffee grounds, but I enjoyed it. Finally, it is worth knowing the process and that it is made with a minimal number of ingredients. Now I just have to try not to eat all six bars in a week.

column9: It's a good chocolate bar, but a bit pricy for what it is
column10: This is a quality mocha dark chocolate bar.  The bar is a good size, the ingredients are decant quality and the coffee beans aren't too much, except for the fact I don't like the little grounds still left in my mouth after chewing it up.  I also like their logo and the way the chocolate bar is sectioned.  Yet these bars are a bit pricy for what they are, but maybe they are only pricy because of their tie in with The Bigger Loser, hoping to cash in on that name.  I haven't tried it in cooking, but I would assume if you need a mocha bar for a dessert recipe this one would work well.  I like the wake up feeling it gives me too, like having a cup of Joe, but not.Oh yeah, I forgot to mention I get a before taste that I don't like it this bar, like I am eating old coffee that's been sitting around, like that weird oily cold coffee taste...it's enough for me to drop it down a star.  The chocolate part is great, since I love dark chocolate and I like that it is a small company...but I think the coffee in this bar could be smoother overall.

column9: Coffee lover and chocolate cravings satisfaction in a bar
column10: I am an admitted coffee junkie and I also love the taste of dark chocolate so this candy bar intrigued me but I feared it would disappoint as so many other coffee infused bars have. This one was a GREAT surprise for my taste buds and I loved the rich coffee taste with the creamy dark chocolate melting on my tongue. The light crispy crunch from the crushed coffee beans was a NICE surprise and made it enjoyable.  I have savored a bar over several days as it is very rich and I can only eat so much at a time and my craving is satisfied. I HIGHLY recommend these for the coffee/chocolate lovers in your life.

column9: I would not pay for it
column10: I was very excited to receive this chocolate. I love dark chocolate and I love the smell and flavor of coffee. However I found taste and especially texture of this chocolate to be average and not superb. Chocolate is very plastic-y and coffee grinds are too large - they get stuck in your teeth and you just keep spitting them out 30 minuted after you had a piece of this bar. I understand they were going to rustic artisan feel, but this is a miss. There is better dark chocolate out there, including the ones that are made out of high quality ingredients, including coffee.

column9: Dark, dark chocolate.  Coffee.  Absolutely perfect for me.
column10: I love dark chocolate.  I love coffee.  So a product that mixes the two?  Oh, yeah.  Sign me up.My verdict?  This is fabulous.  I thought the combination of flavors was about perfect, and loved the somewhat gritty texture of the coffee beans.My biggest concern was that this is outrageously expensive... $4 for one candy bar, based on the current Amazon price.  However, this is easily broken into eight triangular pieces, and *I* found that one of those pieces was exactly perfect as a serving, leaving me feeling far more satisfied than a drug-store candy bar ever does.I shared ONE bar with my husband, who also really liked this.  He said it was like eating dark chocolate while breathing in the aroma of an excellent cup of coffee.  He didn't feel it tasted like coffee exactly.  He felt it tasted as wonderful as coffee smells...I refused to share with my kids.  They probably would like this as well, but this is MY treat.If you don't like dark chocolate, you probably want to look at a different variety.  But this is a quality product.

Gourmet chocolate is everywhere, and I try as much of it as I possibly can.  I have a bias toward dark chocolate, and I am a big Mocha fan.  However, if you think you are going to get a Mocha Frappuccino in a candy bar, think again.This is serious dark chocolate with little bits of coffee beans in every bite.  Do not eat it before bed (I learned the hard way).  I would say taking a bite of this chocolate is every bit as stimulating as a cup of coffee.The taste is great, not too sweet, with the smoothness of the chocolate providing a perfect counterpoint to the slight crunchiness of the coffee.  To me it is much more satisfying (and less dramatic) than munching on chocolate covered coffee beans.  It is, in fact, the best combination of chocolate and coffee that I have found, in any format.

column9: A Win for Dark Chocolate Lovers
column10: 4.5 stars out of 5The flavor of this dark chocolate bar with coffee is fabulous.  It isn't very sweet and it doesn't need to be because the chocolate and coffee flavors stand on their own. The chocolate is smooth, rich, melt-in-the-mouth delicious.  The coffee flavor is strong, but the chocolate is so good that the coffee doesn't overpower it as it does in some other coffee/chocolate bars I've tried.  Some of the ground coffee beans felt just a bit too gritty (or perhaps crunchy is a better choice of words) for my tastes, but I've had other bars that are much grittier/crunchier than this one.  A small piece of this high quality chocolate is much more satisfying than a large piece of a sugar- and additive-laden alternative.  I'm a fan!

I LOVE me some good chocolate, and you simply can't go wrong with good, dark chocolate. I was surprised however, to note that this is not in that category. Some people may be fooled by the name, Scharffen Berger which at first sounds very European. However, flip the package over and note: made in Illinois. I have never found American chocolate to equal anything found in Europe or Russia. But anyway, regarding the taste: It is very strong. The coffee beans easily overpower the nice, dark chocolate flavor, leaving your taste buds somewhat confused. It is only 62% Cocao but it feels more bitter. I am not a coffee fan at all, but I've always loved mocha-infused anything in my chocolate, but this is just way too strong. It could also have to do with the vanilla beans. The flavors just don't add up as nicely as I imagined. Oh, and another thing to note: If you eat one entire bar, you have reached your entire saturated fat limit-for the whole day! Two servings in a pack= 400 calories. And it's not even that good of a chocolate bar to indulge! And lastly, at $25 for 6 bars- So not worth it.

column9: Better shipped in smaller size container:

(I leave dog treat bags in this spot regularly and they've never tried to take them before.) We were gone for the afternoon and the dogs decided to go counter surfing for it this time and ate a bunch more right out of the bucket. column9: Green Mountain Caramel Cream K-cup Portion Packs for Keurig
column10: Great tasting coffee full of flavor and smooth. I would highly recommend this to anyone with a Keurig. It tastes even better with a light flavored creamer like white chocolate mocha.

column9: Good, but not what I expected

I have found my heaven in this light flavorful coffee. It satisfied my craving for a tasteful coffee that is not overly sweet or too weak. If you like vanilla, you will like this coffee. I also like the price I pay per cup which is less then you pay at any convince store.

It makes our kitchen smell like a coffee house each morning.I have only found 1-3 types of non-flavored K-cups that I would buy again and this one is probably atop my list.
I was trying to find a decent colombian coffee and stumbled upon this gem.  And with Prime, shipping is freeeeee. Awesome.  Great flavor, smooth, not too bitter.
Had been looking for a Columbian coffee for the Keurig. This is a great morning coffee and makes a pretty tasty iced coffee for those warm afternoon.  Good price for 24 count box.

not as impressed as I had hoped. the standard blend is still my favorite. the is wroth buying but there is better out there. to each there own.
I drink one cup of coffee in the AM so I really want a good one......not too strong....not too weak. This is perfect!

I used to go to Caribou at least once or twice a week to get my coffee and then just have Folgers the rest of the time.  When I made my first cup of coffee with the Caribou Colombian I told my boyfriend and son that I would never have to go to caribou coffee house/shop again.  This is the best of all caribou coffee.  It's smooth and delicious.  If you like mocha or dont like coffee black it is also delicious with sugar and cream or milk.  I make mine with a dash of chocolate milk and 2 heaping tablespoons of Swiss miss hot cocoa for a 14 to 15 oz cup.  Very good!  I have not had any other kind of coffee since.  This is the perfect coffee!
This is my husbands favorite morning coffee blend. Not too bold, just the perfect jumpp start to the day !
My Mom and sister love this coffee.  I purchased it, just for the heck of it.  And received big thank you's after they tried it.  My sister is a coffee snob, so high marks for Caribou.

I've had their original "blend" on multiple occasions as its one of my favorites in k-cups. Very happy with this Caribou K-cup.  It's exactly what its supposed to be...with just right amount of coffee flavor and aroma.  (I like smooth light-to-medium coffee with no acid taste)

The only reason this gets a four and not a five is that it is pretty cheap and easy to just go to your grocer and pick up the beans required to make your own multi-bean soup, then toss them in a Rubbermaid and use them at will.  Red Mills, however, has incredibly high quality products, and I confess that when I'm in a rush, or know little about the quality of the food choices before me, I tend toward this brand.  I'm picky about the nutritive value of foods, and the way they are grown and processed, and this has been a safe place to go for that.Making a soup with this particular mix is as easy as falling off a log!  If you're nervous and don't have a recipe, just cheat the first time out of the gate by tossing in onion soup mix/your favorite homemade broth and some veggies.  You also can't go wrong with chunks of ham and some ham broth or bouillon.  Add a chunk of crusty bread with butter, and a nice spinach salad, and enjoy a truly great and simple eating experience!
Tried this soup mix for the first time and it was absolutely delicious! Recipe on beans package is great! It was even better the second day! Will buy often.

column9: Bob's Red Mill Soup Mix  13 Bean

I have purchased this product several times and also shared it with friends who like it very much as well. I would highly reccommend this product to anyone!

I used this item after i received it soaked the beans overnight then made it with tomatoes and vegetables and telapia fish it was great very flavorful of course you have to add your own favorite seasonings but you have many different soups or stews with this and it makes a lot the other three bags i placed in the freezer i will be making a chicken stew next my family loved it there are a lot of beans though but we all liked it.

column9: A lot of beans in this soup
column10: Yes, Bob's Red Mill 13 bean soup mix is more expensive than if you were to assemble the beans yourself.  However, this mix conveniently puts the 13 beans together and offers recipes on the back suggesting how to prepare it.  The mix doesn't come with spices - it is beans only - so you will have to come up with everything else yourself.This is a good product if you are cooking for a crowd, or if you really, really love beans.  One bag makes a large pot of soup.  But if you are cooking for a smaller crowd, you might find yourself getting tired of bean soup pretty quickly.I liked the soup the first time I made it.  But one package filled my bean quota for a while.  The remaining packages have remained on the shelf.

I've frozen the extra beans and will use them later.

these are great, good as a soup, in chili, as baked beans, a side or in vegetable soup
Bob's Red Mill Soup Mix, 13 Bean, 29-Ounce Units (Pack of 4). A complete meal in itself. In these tough times here is a real delicious money saving and nutritious delight.

While you could buy these beans separately and mix them together yourself, I think Bob's Red Mill got the mix spot on. This soup is downright tasty, especially with the Bean Soup Seasoning Mix that Bob's also makes. In addition to the Seasoning mix I also add some diced tomato, onion, and whatever other veggies I have on hand (potato, carrot, celery). I also add about a tsp of ground fancy mustard when I make 1/4 package. This soup is very versatile - you could add whatever seasonings and veggies you like and get a good fit.Having the beans pre-mixed is also easier. I measure out 1/4 package in the evening and let them soak overnight. In the morning I toss the beans, veggies, seasoning, and some water in my small crock pot and dinner is ready when I get home! I would say it takes about 20 minutes of prep and clean up time and I get enough soup for 4 meals out of it. You should definitely try this soup!

column9: If you are on a diet, these are great. You MUST eat them slowly.
column10: I was introduced to the Blair chips by a friend. I mostly ignore potato chips because I really don't like them. However, these I DO like. I will eat these but only one at a time and I need a few minutes before having another. They are wicked.

I have tried a couple of different yerba mate teas and this is by far my favorite. It consists only of freshly dried yerba mate leaves and nothing else-no additives, no artifical or natural sweeteners. Just pure yerba mate. I use my french press to brew myself a fresh cup. The taste is very green and has the familiar slightly bitter taste of yerba mate. Since this tea is neither smoked nor aged you will get all the vitamins and minerals that get lost in other brands. If you are looking for a coffee substitute this tea fits the bill. It provides a nice boost of energy similar to coffee without giving you the jitters after one too many cups. I discovered this tea when I needed to reduce my own coffee intake and I can only recommend it. I love that it is energizing as well as healthy for you. That's a combination that can't be beat.

Yerba Mate is my drink. I've sampled many brands, all organic, and Mate Factor shines brightly above them all. Their packaging is one indication of the care and attention they bring to ensuring the freshest mate available. The clean, fresh aroma greets you as you finally cut through the seal. Put the herb in your gourd or cup and let it exfoliate in cool water for several minutes. Then add hot (not boiling) water. Smell it again as you watch it bubble to life. If you are already a mate drinker you will be delightfully surprised as the infusion rises through your bombilla into your mouth. This is like no other mate. It is rich, fresh, well balanced and full of life. On the "circle of drink" website, their reviewer describes it as the hot chocolate of mates. If you are new to the world of yerba mate, I invite you to try this brand. It will be your standard from which you can then experience the vast world of yerba mate, with so many distinctive flavors. Salud!

column9: The Best Yerba Mate on the Market
column10: I've tried quite a few Yerba Mate brands and Mate Factor is the best. Yerba Mate in general is an acquired taste and unlike most traditional teas, primarily because it's grittier, more "raw" (if that makes sense) and looks less refined. This brand gets the right consistency and it is quite good after you adjusted to it. Add a bit of lemon and it's a great morning alternative to coffee or traditional morning teas. Yerba Mate is a morning staple for me and I wouldn't use any other brand.

For family members who just will not eat their vegetables, this is a welcome option.  From the Campbell's website, here are the ingredients in the strawberry banana variety: RECONSTITUTED VEGETABLE JUICE BLEND (WATER AND CONCENTRATED JUICES OF SWEET POTATOES, CARROTS, TOMATOES, BEETS), RECONSTITUTED FRUIT JUICES (WATER AND CONCENTRATED JUICES OF WHITE GRAPES, ORANGES, APPLES, STRAWBERRIES, CLARIFIED BANANAS), CONTAINS LESS THAN 2% OF: NATURAL FLAVORING, BANANA PUREE, VITAMIN C (ASCORBIC ACID), MALIC ACID, CITRIC ACID, VITAMIN E (ALPHA TOCOPHEROL ACETATE).With each can comes one serving of vegetables and one serving of fruits.  A grab and go way to get a little more nutrition into the hands of those who would otherwise be drinking a carbonated beverage or other nutrient free substance.  I have found several people who will not touch a traditional V8 will drink this one.  Try the Pomegranate blueberry variety too.

column9: The best of the Fusion flavors
column10: After a few years away from the V8 Fusion flavors, I decided to try them again when I got a coupon for a pack of cans. After trying this, I tried a couple of other flavors and instantly regretted it; while this is palatable and easy drinking on a hot day, all of the rest are syrupy and fake-tasting to the max, as if they're trying to emulate Mountain Dew. Here you can actually taste the strawberry and banana, unlike the other flavors, and it's got a smooth instead of syrupy texture, but it still basically tastes like mostly-flat soda pop rather than a juice box. I will either finish mine or bring them to a party for the kids, but I won't be ordering them again. You can get significantly more nutrition and the same satisfaction by popping a small multivitamin with any generic soda.On the other hand, if you love the others, then this one might be too watered down for your taste. Try a small bottle at the store before you commit to a large case.It's also no healthier than regular soda pop: Although they can claim "no sugar added", the claim of "full serving and fruit and vegetables" is extremely misleading because a serving of either typically consists of a large amount of fiber and a small amount of protein, and in this drink everything but the sugar has been mostly removed. Real food also has much higher vitamin and mineral content. I'd consider that false advertising, since having this will only give you a sugar rush and make you crave more, not feel full, but your mileage may vary; as a parent, you should put it in the same category as regular soda pop, not a veggie substitute. I should have checked into the nutritional information before ordering.Since it's difficult to find the nutrition info online:Calories: 120Total Fat: 0 gCholesterol: 0 mgSodium: 70 mgPotassium: 250 mgTotal Carbs: 28 g-Fiber: 1 g-Sugars: 25 gProtein: 1 gVitamin A: 70%Vitamin C: 100%Negligible amounts of other vitamins and minerals.

I am NOT a big raw veggie eater, but at the same time, I try to eat healthily. V8 fusion (in these handy individual cans) are my favorite way to add one juice and one Vegetable to my lunch. I throw the can in the frige at work, and since everyone just sees the V8 part, they don't steal it on me.But honestly, the Strawberry bannana is good enough to make into a smoothie - it's that delicious.The big bottles are a lot cheaper at my grocery store, but these are a lot handier. It's a balance ... money or convenience. (For recyclers, these cans are recyclable).They come in 6-packs in the store, and I suggest you try them that way first.
This is a great drink. I cant even taste the veggies in this. I am also able to get my toddler to drink something healthy by giving him these.
I love this and have a can after my breakfast every day.  It is a great supplement for me as I am not a big fruit eater and this way I can get it in.

column9: Surprisingly enjoyable - perfect blend of nutrition and sweet flavor
column10: I've always heard about the many healthy drinks that V8 has made in the past. Many of the vegetable drinks (particular with tomato) made me go "blah." But, the V8 fusion is a brilliant selection of nutrition drinks. Now, I can snap open and enjoy a refreshing drink, but also have a full serving of vegetable and fruits in every can. I am thoroughly impressed at the improvement that V8 has made. I'm convinced, and so are my family and friends whom have tried this drink at gatherings.Some other thoughts:* No Sugar, not preservatives, just 100% vegetables and fruits.* Actually tastes good. I feel this is in part with the fruits. In the past, putting vegetables in drinks alone didn't work for me. The fusion of vegetables and fruits is a perfect match.Be careful with how many you drink! Before you know it, you'll be chugging these things like water. But, that's not such a bad thing anyway. Highly recommended for craving for a sweet drinks, parties, and a drink with nutrition on-the-go.

I am super happy with this product. I am currently deployed to afghanistan and I am a very big health foods person. Any one who has deployed knows the chow hall is not so healthy and frankly not to good of food. The price of this product was amazing as well as I got it in 7 days. I will def order again and I have already recommended this product as well as amazon to multiple people here. Love it

This is absolutely my favourite of the Yogi Teas I've tried.  It's got a lot of body without being bitter, and works well with and without milk.  Having stevia means that it doesn't need sugar, but isn't too sweet.  Rather than tasting like a typical herbal tea, this makes a good, caffeine-free substitute for standard tea and coffee.

column9: One of the best teas I have ever tasted.
column10: If you like a robust, but not overpowering, tea without caffeine, and one that has a complex medley of flavors you could love this.I generally don't add milk to my tea, but I find this brew goes fantastically with a bit of dairy.Another benefit of this tea is that no matter how many times I have it it doesn't get boring.

My wife and I both love coffee, and tea to a lesser extent. I've realized over the years that my preference for coffee is largely due to two factors: the strength of the flavor, and the 'thickness' of the drink. This is one of the few teas that rivals coffee in both departments. That's not to say it tastes anything like coffee--it is strong and aromatic, but sweet and almost nutty, not acidic or tending towards bitter. The hazelnut and vanilla flavors mingle quite nicely in this dark, expressive tea. Yogi makes some really fine teas, including this one.If you like substantial flavor in your teas, give this one a try. My wife and I both really enjoy it.

column9: If you like your tea spicy...
column10: This tea should be more accurately called "Tahitian Ginger Ginger" tea.It tastes like ginger and cinnamon and....that's it. No hazelnut or vanilla that I could detect. If (like me) you are really not a fan of ginger you will be disappointed. In my case, after choking down the first cup, I had resolved that I must throw the rest of the box away because it was just way too spicy and gingery for me. Very unpleasant.However, I decided to give it another try. I steeped the tea only briefly, less than 30 seconds, as opposed to 3-4 minutes, and I added two splashes of milk (instead of my usual one) and also, I added a little more stevia than usual. Anyway, the result was... a nice cup of tea that I enjoyed. I've had the tea a few more times in this same way and I actually do like it now and might even consider buying it again. Still the advertising for this tea is so strange (the main flavors are not in the title), and the tea is so strong and harsh that I feel the need to warn others. If you do try it, and dislike it like I do, steeping it for less time will go a long way....

column9: Not what we expected but very nice and grows on you
column10: We thought this was a vanilla hazlenut *tea* (with black teas), but it really is a vanilla hazlenut herbal (no actual tea leaves) chai.  That said, it is quite nice, we make a pot with a black tea bag and a vanilla hazelnut tea bag and it is very good.

If you want great vanilla, hazelnut flavor DO NOT BUY THIS TEA. It taste good, but has such an overpowering cinamon and spicy taste that the vanilla and hazelnut is lost. It also is not good for people with acid reflux. I take prilosec everyday and usually can eat almost anything without suffering, but 3 tums later and I still hurt.Like I said it does taste good and I will buy yogi products in the future, but I will read the ingredients first.

Overall I like this tea...but I was going out on a limb buying it on Amazon because I had never actually had it before...I had waited for Celestial Seasonings Vanilla hazelnut tea to become available again, but it never did...for a Vanilla Hazelnut tea this one has a little more spice than I'd like...but overall I like it.
Didn't taste too spicy or cinnomy in my oppinion. I agree with other reviewers, it didn't taste than vanillay, but still tastes very good to me. Enjoy it very much. Would buy again.

column9: surprise!  i really like this stuff.
column10: i'm not usually a big vanilla or super sweet-tea fan but with the colder weather i've found myself gravitating to heartier, sweeter and more dessert-like beverages. i was craving hot chocolate and decaf coffee a lot but didn't like the chocolate tea i bought and am too lazy to make a good cup of decaf most of the time.  i thought i'd give this yogi tea a try, although it's not technically a tea as it's chicory based, no tea leaves (green, white, black or roiboos-red) hence the name "herbal supplement."  not being able to tolerate caffeine i've become a bit of a connoisseur of decaf teas.  usually i prefer black tea decaffeinated (like earl grey or irish b'fast) and i steer away from herbal infusions/supplements, especially the sweeter or fruiter kinds. however, i'm a big spice fan, just about any spice (pepper is one of my favorites and even that's in this tea.)  i'm not finding any of the flavors in this tea at all overpowering.  and it's not sugary sweet either.  the stevia is a nice touch, not too much.  it reminds me of celestial seasonings "bengal spice" with a little bit of sweetener.  checked the ingredients and the only difference is that the yogi tea also has the stevia, hazelnut and a bit of butterscotch.  i like that many of the ingredients in this are organic, and none taste fake.  i like it with milk, soy milk especially cause it's just a tiny bit sweeter that way and i really don't feel like i need to add anything else.  since i like this yogi tea a tad better than bengal spice but i'm a sucker for the pretty tiger illustration on the bengal spice box, maybe i'll keep their cute box and put these teas in it!

One of my favorite herbal teas is Celestial Seasonings Roastaroma, and one reason I like it is because it's about as full-bodied as an herbal tea can be. But I wanted something a bit sweeter and lighter to drink in the evening, including before bed and on occasion as an after dinner beverage, so I decided to try Yogi Tea Tahitian Vanilla Hazelnut Tea. The first four ingredients of Roastaroma are roasted barley, roasted chicory, roasted carob, and cinnamon, and it is the chicory that gives Roastaroma it's coffee-like full-bodiedness, as chicory is often used as a coffee substitute. Tahitian Vanilla Hazelnut does not have barley in it, but its first three ingredients are roasted chicory root, carob pod, and organic cinnamon bark, and I assume this accounts for why I consider it to be in a similar herbal tea category as Roastaroma. Some of the sweetness of Tahitian Vanilla Hazelnut comes from stevia leaf. I'm drinking a cup now, sweetened with half a packet of Truvia Natural Sweetener and cooled with a dash of fat-free milk. Sometimes I sweeten it with a little raw sugar. And I find it delicious and satisfying, with a nice, mildly spicy aftertaste that I assume comes from the organic black pepper, clove bud, and organic ginger root that are among the ingredients of this fine tea.Tahitian Vanilla Hazelnut also contains organic cardamom seed, and thus this tea contains the five traditional Ayurvedic spices, cardamom seed, cinnamon bark, clove bud, ginger root and black pepper, which were among the ingredients in the prototype "Yogi Tea" that Yogi Bhajan shared with his students after he arrived in America in 1969. (It wasn't until 1984 when the Yogi Tea Company that brings us Tahitian Vanilla Hazelnut and other fine teas was formed.) One can get a sense of the care with which Yogi Teas are made by visiting their website and/or YouTube and watching the video of Yogi Tea's herbalist, Guru Hari Khalsa, explaining the Yogi Tea philosophy.I purchased a pack of 6 boxes of Tahitian Vanilla Hazenut tea bags through Amazon's easy to manage Subscribe & Save program on 9/25/11, and each box arrived with a "best by" date of June 2013 on it, which is a good long time from the time of purchase. (16 bags per box x 6 boxes = 96 cups of tea, a little over a 3-month supply for someone who drinks one cup a day.) One of the most satisfying herbal teas I've had, and I speak as someone who worked in the natural food industry before it was an industry and has been drinking herbal teas for 4 decades.

column9: Searched high and low for this tea
column10: Love the flavor of vanilla and hazelnut. Very hard to find this combination in an herb tea. Very flavorful. I have been sharing with lots of friends due to the quantity I had to buy. Everyone has liked it. Definately worth giving it a try. I have gone through my first box already!
I really enjoyed this tea, but I noticed that Amazon.com has gone up on the price even though I have it on subscribe and save.

I know that Yogi sells a chai rooibos (that I have yet to try), but to me their Tahitian Vanilla Hazelnut reminds me of a sweetened, heady and subtle chai. It's delicious and I love that it needs little to no sugar. This has quickly become my favorite herbal/caffeine-free tea and my first choice for an afternoon spent curled up with a good book.

column9: Not so much vanilla, but a great spice tea
column10: I really like this tea.  As other reviewers have said, the vanilla taste is not so prominent.  However, I really like spice teas and this one is a good one.

column9: Sooooo soothing, tastes and smells like fall!
column10: I purchased one box of this locally so I could try it first, but I'll begin getting it here by the case since it's so delicious! I'm trying to cut back on caffeine/sugar and have been drinking a few cups of coffee daily for years. I can't drink it w/o sugar so I was looking for a tea that would be close enough for me to not feel deprived. This is fantastic!! The flavors are so warm and spicy that I can easily drink it w/o sugar. I add just a splash of vanilla almond milk, and for me, it soothes me in the same way that coffee did, maybe even more so. It's still in the upper 90's here, but sipping this makes me feel like it's cloudy and 55 degrees outside. That feeling alone is worth the price of this tea. Love it!!

column9: Yummy tea!  A favorite for students.
column10: As a yoga teacher I offer Yoga Nidra sessions and Restorative Yoga workshops.  This tea is offered at the end of each of these classes and on occasion in the winter months to the students that come.  They love it!! They say the smell of it takes them right back into bliss.  I have never had anyone say it is too spicy and I don't add milk or stevia.  Give it a try.... you will love it.  Wonderful tea!

This tea is absolutely delicious! I try to stick with loose leaf teas, but for some, I make an exception.. this is one of them! Because it comes in a pack of 6x 16 bag boxes, I'd recommend trying it first before diving in. But if you did make the splurge for any of the yogi flavors, I'd say go for this one.
I love this tea!  I make a cup almost every night and with a touch of milk it's the perfect substitute for snacking after dinner.

If you like vanilla and hazelnut, you will like this tea.  The flavor is robust but not overpowering.  The ingredients are fresh and smell tantalizing! I have this tea in my pantry year-round.  I buy it because of the quality ingredients, excellent taste, and healthful benefits.  Yogi is the BEST in herbal teas.
Yogi Tea's  Tahitian Vanilla is in a word scrumptious, a deep rich aroma followed by a taste that matches.I find than  if you use honey as a sweetner if you use one is a perfect compliment.
Only purchase if you like the taste of clove. This tea contains clove and is very strong. I hate it.

I am almost certain this stuff is really bad for me but it is rich, nutty, sweet, and creamy.  Wonderful with apples.  heat gently and use as an icing. Add powdered sugar and make truffles.  Or grab a spoon and just dig in.  I know why the nutritional info is so small, they did it to keep me from feeling bad.

column9: I'm hoping for a restock on this....
column10: My local supermarket carries Armella in different combinations.  My favorites are the ones with Chocolate/hazelnut and Vanilla cream, they also have the variation of vanilla/hazelnut.  It is hard to choose which one is best really.This spread beats the boring Nutella brand chocolate/hazelnut spread any day.  I used to like Nutella a lot, unfortunately it does get old.  If only they made the vanilla plus chocolate kind it would be much better.Also unfortunate is the fact that, Amazon carries Nutella but not Armella.

This was an impulse buy at my local Turkish grocery store. I dipped strawberries in it! Yum! Great fruit dip. I dipped some ginger snaps in it and it was yummy. It was even better on top of graham crackers. It would also be great on top of hot cinnamon rolls instead of the sugar topping, which is my next experiment (I'm going to go the lazy route and use the pre-made ones from the grocery store). It would also be delicious as icing on a pumpkin roll, on top of a carrot cake, on a spice cake, on cupcakes, between layers of cake - do you see a cake theme? Also, it would be a great filling for any of the homemade pop tart recipes that are going around the internet. Also, a great filling for doughnuts. Or as the filling for one of the stuffed french toast recipes. Or, spread on top of Ritz crackers. I could go on, but I think you get the point. Buy it, it's versatile, it's yummy, it begs you to experiment with it.EDIT: Oops, I just realized that I have the Ulker Golden brand and not the Armella. I'm sure that they're extremely similar. They're both labeled "Findik Ezmesi."

I have to say that they were helpful in this regard.  Although it took them several days to respond, they sent me a UPS label so I could return the Wii dispensers.  I was not happy, however, with several things.  First, they told me they could not do an exchange because this item (Nintendo Kliks) was out of stock.
