I think this company might have lied to me about them being out of stock b/c they didn't want to pay return shipping on the Wii dispensers and then pay again to ship the correct item to me.  I'm VERY disappointed. I DO NOT recommend this company, at all.

I purchased these items for my special education students who were big into Mario characters.  They worked great as motivators for controlling student behaviors in my autism classroom.  Good quality product, colorful pieces, with true to character workmanship.

I bought these for a Super Mario themed birthday. Just as pictured except the packages that I got only included 2 donkey kong, 4 links 6 marios. Arrived quickly it was cheaper buying directly from the online candy shop than through them via amazon. A dozen for $11.88 vs almost $18.00 here. Amazon is going to hate me for this.

I bought this tea for my husband and he loves it. We make tea by the pitcher and with Lipton we needed 4 bags but with Twinings we only use 3 so it's more economical with a better flavor.This is a great buy for anyone looking for the benifits of green tea without the caffine.

I usually love anything from twinings, but this is the worst green tea I've ever had.  I bought a box of this because my grocery story was out of what I usually get (Stash decaf green tea).  I saw that twinings carried a decaf green tea, and since I trust twinings, I thought I'd give it a try.It is GRITTY, BITTER, SOUR, and nothing like what green tea really tastes like. I can barely get a good strength of tea from one bag.Do not buy this tea.

I'm a big fan of Twinings, so when I saw that they sold green tea, I jumped at the chance to buy it. Honestly, this has to be the worst green tea I've ever tasted. It tastes absolutely nothing like it. I was sorely disappointed at the thought of having to throw away an entire box of tea, but it had to be done.

This product has no resemblance to green tea, in color or flavor. I tried it once and threw the rest out. I know and love Japanese style green tea, and decaf green never tastes as good as regular green.  Even so, Bigelow's decaf green is much less offensive than this one. Perhaps if I didn't know this Twinings was supposed to be green tea, I wouldn't dislike it so much, but it's not worth suffering through the whole box to find out.

After drinking Twinings Green Tea for a while I decided to give the decaf a whirl. While Twinings have always pleased me with flavorful teas, I found this decaf to not be quite as good as regular Green Tea. Though some may not notice the difference, as it is slight, it is still quite good.

I originally tried this tea, and found it somewhat bitter - until I learned that green tea cannot be steeped in boiling hot water. Let the pot or your cup of water sit for 5-10 minutes, THEN add the tea bag for no longer than 2 minutes. PERFECTION! Best green tea ever!

column9: Good Tea, Flavor not as Strong as Regular Green Tea
column10: I have been drinking Twinings teas for years.  Twinings teas are consistently good.  Each tea bag comes in a sealed envelope which helps to keep it fresh.  Over a period of time, I have settled on two favorites.  These are the Darjeeling and Green teas.Twinings Darjeeling Tea: At one time, I used Twinings China Black Tea.  Unfortunately, they stopped selling that variety.  I tried others, but chose the Darjeeling tea for an afternoon tea and snack break.  It offers a nice strong flavor and deep color.  There is enough caffeine in this tea to provide a nice lift.Twinings Green Tea:  There are quite a few varieties of green tea offered by Twinings. I prefer the pure green tea.  Interestingly, according to the product blurb, green tea is made from the same leaves as is black tea.  The difference is in the processing.  Green tea is lighter in color and has a more subtle taste.  In general, green teas have less caffeine than the darker teas.  I find that the Green tea is good for early evening.  It has just enough caffeine to provide some energy but not too much to keep me awake at night. For later in the evening, I like the Decaffeinated Green Tea. The tea is good, even though the flavor is not as strongs as the regular green tea.I recommend both the Darjeeling and Green varieties of Twinings teas.

I am very satisfied with my Twining Green Tea purchase the price is right and the tea is fine. I will continue in my recurringTwinings Green Decaf Tea, 20-Count Tea Bags (Pack of 6) automatic saving price.

I ordered this Tea twice and they kept sending Twinnings Breakfast Tea....So thats why I rated it zero...I would like to try it But I am through trying to order it because they cant seem to correct the Problem...

I was looking for minimally processed mulberries at a reasonable price, and this product fit the bill.  I was willing to pay a little extra for the organic label, however you have to take their word for it because the certification is not listed on the package.  The mulberries themselves are not overly sweet, are slightly chewy and still have their stems on in some cases - which to me indicates minimal processing and that they likely came right off the tree! Don't worry, the stems aren't a bother, I just eat them whole with some almonds or in a ground coconut and almond meal porridge in the morning.  Some more information about their origins would be nice (i.e. given their origins in Turkey, do we know they are not irradiated etc?), but otherwise I'm quite happy and would order again.

This is such a great sauce to make a quick primavera.  We use Lundberg brown rice pasta, veggies cooked in butter stir fry fashion, and chicken.  A little extra fresh grated pamesan, and voila.  A quick but favorite family meal.  Try this sauce!!
This is basically a cream sauce; there is some garlic taste, but very little cheesy flavor. It's a good base for adding your own flavors to, though it's kind of expensive to use it for that.

column9: Makes a great quick Tuna Alfredo
column10: LMAO at these reviews. One guy says the "cheese and garlic are overpowering"and another guy says you cant taste any cheese or garlic. Hilarious.Anyway, Bertolli makes a good product and this is one of their most versatile.Its got a mild garlic flavor that wont offend anybody, and if you want morecheese you're gonna add it anyway... they do at restaurants you know! You caneven make Cream Chipped Beef on Toast with this stuff, and that makes a greatsurprise breakfast with poached eggs.And to anybody that grew up eating "Tuna Helper" and is just too embarrased tobuy that box, this sauce + frozen green peas + fettucine and a can or two oftuna and you are all set. Its better than it sounds.Course this stuff is also great for making a classic Alfredo. Impress your friends,tell em its homemade.

This is a creamy sauce, with a mild but pleasant flavor.  It has just enough garlic to enhance the flavor, but not so much that it overpowers it.  I had it with spinach and cheese ravioli, which it complemented very well.  The pasta it would suit best would be fettuccine, which should be coated with the sauce by thoroughly mixing it.In addition to going well with vegetable pasta dishes, it would be good with shrimp, chicken or chopped ham.  With any of those, adding onion and mushrooms would help it along, and black pepper would top it off nicely.There is a slight but distinct garlic aftertaste, so you might want to be careful about socializing afterwards with anyone who has not shared the meal with you!
This alfredo is so good! I always add a little sprinkle of granulated garlic and onion and some pepper and its PERFECT! Mmmm
My wife totally hated the sauce. It's garlic and cheese flavor is over powering and was not a hit on our pasta dinner. She will not allow me to ever purchase this item again.
These turkey sticks are great and low in calories and fat, for anyone that are maintaining their calories these are the way to go!

I love those Turkey sticks, I find the beef to be too fatty, I do wish the turkey sticks were more lean (still better then beef IMO), I always wish I could pay less but they are damn good and will buy again.
the links were delicious.  ordered several different kinds and liked them all.  the price is a little steep, but worth it and probably will order more in the next holiday season.

turkey... it is delicious once you get used to the smoked taste of the turkey stick. it took me a week to get used to it. now i love snacking on them all the time. there are about 40 turkey sticks in each package. they are not greasey or nasty tasting. they do not leave a greasey taste in your mouth. old wisconsin turkey snack sticks are ready to eat. after you open the package you want to put them into the refrigerator and maybe into a zip lock bag. they come in one bag and it is not re-usable or re-sealable. their website is [...] if you would like to read up on this or other products. it is a good protein source and it has very little carbohydrates in it. freshness date for example from mine was: may 24 2013. i hope i was able to help someone to give these snacks a try.

column9: These don't taste like sticks at all!
column10: Very misleading. They do taste like turkey though, and from that perspective they're quite good. I really like things that taste like sticks, so they weren't for me.

I'm a choc-a-holic, have been for many years. I'm also curious how chocolate is used in a variety of foods. The Choco Lot is the best cookie I've ever tasted! For real. My neighbor is a cookie maker of the highest quality and this beats ANYTHING I've tasted so far. Even my 8yr old nephew who only like mac & cheese and Chips Ahoy loves this cookie. I wouldn't dare tell him how healthy it is. It's a little packet of pure pleasure.
These things are the perfect sweet tooth fix without being junk food..Only Agave Nectar for sweetening; vegan, gluten free, soy free and some of the products are even raw!  I buy them by the dozens!

I'm seriously addicted to these.  The Chocolate Chip is amazing.  The Choco Lot tastes a lot like a brownie, especially when a bit warm.  I was concerned initially by the amount of xylitol (a sugar alcohol) as I'm sensitive to most sugar alcohols. And this has quite a bit (19gm). BUT one cookie doesn't seem to affect me - too much.  Love that they have protein (8gm in a cookie?!?!?) and fiber (2gm).  But mostly I'm hooked on the taste.  I prefer chewy cookies (vs the crunchy kind) so this is perfect for me. AND it's vegan. (Whole Foods bakes a mega-yummy vegan chocolate chip cookie but I know it's packed with sugar, certainly more than the 10gm in a Kookie Karma.)  The only suggestion I would make is to make them just a tad less sweet.  Guilt free indulgence :-)

I'm really particular with what I feed my dogs.  One of mine has a sensitive GI system and only eats salmon-based dog foods.  I mix this canned food in with his dry food and he LOVES this.  It is good quality and has chunks of fish and potato and green peas and carrots.

Extra virgin olive oil completely replaced salad dressing in my house. This is such a great alternative to the hydrogenated oils that come with common dressings. The quality of the ingredients is so much higher. And the benefits are amazing - good quality fat and Omega oils. What I love the most about a good Extra Virgin olive oil like Filippo Berio, is that it doesn't take away from the taste of food, it compliments it. It doesn't replace the taste that comes with fresh produce - it adds to it. Love it! Bravo!
This package is a good deal if you use a lot of it. The cost is far less when purchased in this bulk manner. One must consider freshness when buying in such quantities.

column9: Tea smells & tastes like Dirty water
column10: We liked the tea for first 3 orders and last order it is smelling and tasting like foul water. Suprise, there is no option to return on Amazon websit
This is very nice tea. Delicate flavor, and decaf. Also, it's nice to be able to get it in bulk.
I've ordered several davidson's tea and they have all been exception. Except this order of decaf green tea tasted like rotten tea, maybe I just got a bad bag.

column9: Davidson's Decafe Green Tea...Bulk 16 OZ package
column10: I love Davidson's loose leaf teas. We have purchased 5 varieties so far. All good!This tea has a great fresh green tea taste. We drink alot and love the loose leaf tea leaves freshly brewed.Tastes good even after you re-brew it a second time.It came on time and is a very good value!
Buy it if you like cinnamon. I find the flavor strong and spicy. It makes for a strong tea, yet, without caffeine. Excellent if you are trying to kick a coffee habit.

column9: Consistently good, consistency of availability not so good
column10: I have this product on auto-delivery monthly for 4or5 times. I insist on organic and it's nice to know it's certified organic & kosher. (Can't hurt!)I have an iced-tea brewer - put 3-4 tsps and end up with a pitcher of tasty tea. Flavor has been consistent. I sweeten it with Stevia. It comes in a resealble bag that is quite secure - nice feature.Only complaint is that stock is unpredictable at times. I'm haven't gotten a shipment in 6 wks and it says it will be shipped early September. (So I will be ordering a back-up bag in case this happens again)Great price, particularly with Subscribe & Save discounts.

This is the only place I have found bulk, loose, decaf green tea, and I mean locally or on-line.  You'd think that the health benefits would make it a more available item.  It is a great quality and a good price.  Thank you, Davidson's and Amazon!

column9: More for slaking thirst than for titivating taste
column10: Not one of the better tasting green teas I have tried. Somewhat bitter or tannic on the tongue, in some ways more like a weak black tea than a green tea. Orange/tan in color and lacking that grassy taste that most green teas carry.Having said that, it's good value, arrived promptly, and will do just fine as an everyday drink - I just wouldn't serve it to company.Seems to work best with the water at no more than 160 to 170 degrees, steeped for only 1 minute. Will yield multiple 4-cup carafes during the course of the day. Just don't let it sit in the carafe /thermos for more than 3 hours - it gets bitter, as do most green teas, I have found.

This is quickly becoming our favorite green tea. Almost as soon as I've enjoyed drinking a large mug, I make another. Unlike other decaf greens we have tried, my wife doesn't ask for peppermint leaves or hibiscus blossoms or other natural flavorings in hers to offset unpleasantness. I have been searching for years for an unflavored decaf green with a good leaf and mouth feel. This is it.  It's organic and CO2 (non-chemically) processed to boot. According to the tea company's site, "Our organic decaffeinated teas utilize a carbon dioxide rinse process to remove the caffeine, a process we feel leaves more of the tea flavor and leaf structure intact.  This process is also USDA approved for certified organic tea. 98% caffeine-free, these teas maintain much of the body and character of their caffeinated counterparts, and can be enjoyed all day."  I certainly agree and gratefully tip my cup to Davidson's for making this healthy tea (as well as other loose decaf and regular teas) available to all. I also appreciate Amazon's subscribe/save program which is convenient, economical and user friendly. This is a tea I will be reordering ahead of schedule.

I'm pleasantly suprised with this tea... not being a big fan of decaf and all... This tea brews up nicely, tastes pretty good ad it's green tea, so the benefits are there. Oh... this is a great value, as this is loose leaf tea... but you get a whole lot of tea.

column9: Great for iced tea - fantastic value
column10: I make gallons of iced green tea every week, and this bulk tea is perfect. The price is unbeatable, and for iced tea, the quality is excellent. I brew up a gallon at a time with a little agave nectar and refrigerate it. Beats powdered drink mixes for health and cost hands-down.
Best price out there to order through Amazon, much cheaper than the companies website or other brands. Good quality, happy with thier products.
This tea tastes terrible. i have ordered this tea direct from davidson's and it was great. do not buy from this site

3 stars is probably too generous for this tea, but I've had good customer service from Davidson's. Also, it is wonderful that they offer not just decaf green tea, but organic teas and especially in bulk--all at a good price.As green teas go, this one has not had a great flavor, but it's drinkable.  I agree with another reviewerer that I wouldn't offer this to guests.  I drink green tea for its presumed health benefits.  Since a family member was diagnosed with cancer, I have learned (1) in general, Japanese green teas are much higher than Chinese in the cancer-fighting compounds (catechins) that most of us associate with green tea, and (2) in order to release those compounds, the advice is to steep tea for 7 - 10 minutes, and (3) decaf green has a lower amount of the compounds than regular.Davidson's decaf, at least the 6 or 7 pounds I have drunk, are drinkable after a very short brewing time (1 - 1 1/2 minutes, which is the company's advice).  Anything longer than that and it is too harsh and bitter for me.Just know what you're getting at this good price.  I have nothing against this tea, and I am delighted that Davidson's offers organic teas in bulk, but I have switched to a tea (exorbitantly priced) that is specifically blended for maximum catechin content.  Maybe it delivers, maybe it doesn't.  It is, however, delicious, as it should be at its price.  More info at [...]Also -- again if you're drinking green tea for the anti-cancer benefit, it may interfere with some chemotherapy regimens for blood-based cancers;  see [...]  All things are subject to more and more recent research -- I'm not a physician -- enjoy your tea and good health to you!

I got these limited edition during the Halloween week and they are so yummy! I love the unique flavor of the original flavors available year round but the grape, cherry and blue raspberry are a delicious nice change up. They have a burst of flavor that melts in my mouth. I would've given it 5 stars but I don't like green apple flavored anything and there are a few in the bag so I'm picky. I'm kind of addicted so I'll probably be ordering again shortly!
I ordered 3 bags and they all came melted.  $24 of wasted money.  It is only 40 degrees here so it happened either in storage or in transit.
This plant arrived in great condition and it looked very healthy...I cant wait to put in a new planter once it gets established in its new home.

column9: Allergy Girl Finds Something She Can Eat !!!
column10: I have Celiac AND I am allergic to soy, potatoes, corn and dairy.  I can tell you that this is one soup that I can eat without having a reaction!  Thank you for making this; it's a life saver...literally!

column9: Gluten Free Cafe Chicken Noodle Soup
column10: I was looking forward to this gluten free soup because the picture looks great.  It does have a starchy taste which happens when noodles are not rinsed after cooking, they are probably cooking the pasta right in with the soup from the start rather than cook and rinse first.  It's hard to find any canned chicken noodle soup gluten free so this is a good start, with canned soup containing pasta starchy soft pasta is probably hard to avoid.Particularly because rice pasta is extremely starchy I have been partially cooking pasta separately and rinsing and keep in fridge, when heating soup or broth I just add the pasta at the end a couple of minutes prior to eating and it works best.  I got the idea from a restaurant serving soups as a gluten free option - they do not put pasta into the soup until just before serving to prevent mushy pasta.  I will probably go back to this method for soups with noodles but will definitely try some of the other Gluten Free Cafe soups that do not contain pasta.

The broth is a little too thick and heavy on the pepper.  Over all, the taste is good and I like the noodles.  Buying it in bulk from Amazon saves TONS of money compared to the off-the-shelf price of $4 something per can.  Give it a try!
this soup is really good, and sooo convenient! I really can't remember what Non GF chicken noodle soup tastes like it has been so long...but this HAS to be close.

My daughter loves noodle soups.  Since going gluten free, we have been without the convenience of canned soups for her.  We first found Gluten Free Cafe soup while traveling and she was thrilled.  It tastes great and good for you too!!  It doesn't have all the extra additives.  She'll even eat it straight out of the can if we're on a trip and can't heat it up!!So glad Amazon started selling it on the subscription plan!
the worst ever please try another business maybe toilet paper about two grams of carots chicken as  hard as rock

I was so excited to see GF chicken noodle soup. It's one of the "regular" foods that I've missed. Unfortunately this "soup" is terrible. The noodles were a very strange consistency (this coming from someone who has tried a LOT of GF noodles). The chicken was more like mystery meat, and there was very little of it. The overall broth didn't even taste good. I had a few bites, and literally dumped the rest down the sink. Don't waste your money.

My wife bought a couple cans of the gluten free chicken noodle soup month or so ago.  She tried two bites from one can and dumped the rest. Said it was terrible.  I ran across the second can on a shelf today and thought "It's chicken noodle soup.  How bad can it be?"  Well, it was really, really, really bad. Broth had an off taste and the chicken pieces were hard; almost like dried out but still crumbly.  Very strange texture.  Wouldn't give it a single star, it was that bad, but had to enter something.  Would have expected much better from a Hain product.
I suggest to be warmed up on slow heat and at the end add few drops of lemon and a pinch of pepper.It's a really good soup

This soup is awesome,my granddaughter says "your the best cooker grandma". It was so nice on a busy afternoon to be able to fix something quick, nutritious, and tasty. I mix both the vegetable noodle and the chicken noodle together to create a super hardy veggie packed soup, this way I'm able to feed three of us. My granddaughter loves it! Thank you this convenience was long over due.

My son has been on a gluten free, casein free diet for a few months now. He absolutely LOVES this soup! While I haven't tried it, it does look and smell delicious when I am fixing it for him. The only bad thing is that we found out he has several food sensitivities, one of them being onions (and possibly celery) :(. I wish there were more options out there without the onions in it...they are so hard to avoid unless cooking from scratch.

Missing chicken noodle soup badly, I was delighted to find this! It is tasty, fairly priced and makes a great lunch on these gloomy cold days.  It is a bit more broth than noodles and chicken bits though, would be 5 star if it had more "chunky" to it!

This soup is just wonderful!  Incredibly tasty, with a rich broth that's not overly salty like many canned soups, with big chunks of chicken, veggies and great tasting noodles.  It's better than ony other canned dhicken soup I've ever had in my life, even before I found out I had celiac disease.  I'm so excited to finally find a gluten free canned soup that compares to homemade for those times when I can't or don't want to cook.  The vegetable noodle and black bean are great too.

I foolishly bought this whole case because the reviews were so good and I could not find 1 can in a local store to try.  It was the WORST canned soup I have EVER tasted, it even smells sickening, like rotten garlic.  The noodles were complete greasy mush.  I had only 2 spoonfuls and have thrown the rest away.  Do not be fooled by the picture on the label, the contents do not even come close to looking like that.  Celiacs have enough trouble finding decent food, stay away from this product.

column9: I'm sticking with Progresso for GF soup
column10: If you took a bunch of chicken broth, cut up one baby carrot, cooked 10 fettuccine noodles and cut them up, and cooked 1 small chicken breast, threw away 90% of it, and threw the remaining 10% in a pot with the aforementioned ingredients, you'd have a better version of this soup.  It's nearly all broth.  The chicken tastes way over-processed and rubbery.  And it costs about twice as much as a larger, heartier, tastier can of Progresso soup.  Trust me, I wanted to like this, as I haven't had chicken noodle soup in the 10 years since I've been diagnosed as a Celiac.  Well, I'll never crave this stuff again, so the only chicken noodle soup I ever eat again will be made by myself.The flavor isn't absolutely terrible (well, the chicken is), but for what you pay--even with the Amazon discount--it's a ripoff.  I'm glad I bought one can as a test before jumping into buying a 12-pack, because I'd have a hard time making it through 11 more cans of this stuff.  Step it up, Gluten Free Cafe.  And the picture on this can is hilarious-- I think if you took the whole 12 pack, boiled off the broth, and threw all the remaining ingredients into one bowl it may come close to resembling the picture.
This soup was a gift for a family member. She is so glad to have Noodles in her chicken soup! She was surprised I found this soup for her.

I often have a pot of homemade soup or stew on hand.  For those times when I don't, or when I'm traveling, a prepared soup is sometimes just the answer to a quick, tasty, and hopefully nutritious meal.The picture on this can piqued my interest, and into the cart it went.  The broth was thin and watery, and there was a slightly 'tingy' aftertaste.  Ugh.Not a repeat product for me.(Kettle Cuisine makes an excellent product.  All varieties are very good.  It must be kept frozen though.  If you've never tried it, keep an eye out for it.  It tastes like you made it yourself.)

I was amazed when I first tried this soup.  It was gluten free, and it was GOOD!  I was amazed.  It was also outrageously expensive at my local store, hence my online search.  Finding it here was a tremendous boon.  I can have it delivered to my doorstep for about half the cost of going to pick it up at the store.

For a gluten-free chicken noodle soup, I think this is the best on the market. I've tried some frozen kinds (mushy noodles and carrots, very little chicken), and this is a good, decent chicken noodle soup.  If at first the noodles seem hard and crumbly out of the can, heating the soup to a near-boil takes care of that, softening the noodles till they are nice and slurpable, just like "normal" chicken noodle soup.  The chicken portions are generous, to the point where I think they could have made them smaller, but it's tasty.Seasoning wise, at first it may seem peppery, but it actually isn't. If you're expecting it to taste as salty and metallic as Campbell's, you'll naturally be disappointed. Think of this as tasting halfway between the canned condensed kind and your Grandma's soup.  This is one of my staple pantry items, a go-to meal when I'm out of time or inclination to make a "real" meal. And calorie-wise, it's not too shabby---a whole can is just 180 calories.

This soup is not so bad!!! Really for a canned soup its the best gluten free chicken noodle ive tried so far and it so nice to be able to pick it up of those days when i just cant cook or something....the only draw back is the chicken is fairly dry when eating it i do think the noodles stay well in-taked for gluten free rice noodles i was rather impressed with that!! I shall continue to buy this when i need it for sure!! :D thank u gluten free cafe (Hain foods)

column9: Delicious and my gluten free 4 year old LOVES it!
column10: My son has been gluten free for 2 months now and convenience foods are a god-send.  He has been craving soup and we were running tons of errands today and got home late.  I picked this up at a store a few weeks ago to have on hand for just such an occasion.  I broke it open, popped it in the microwave and he inhaled it!  It is expensive for soup, but if he loves it, it is super easy, and good for him too, I will definitely keep them on hand.  I tasted it too, and it is very tasty.  I didn't find the noodles soft or starchy at all.  They tasted like regular old noodles, and the broth was super tasty too.

column9: Canned chicken noodle soup is a comfort food.
column10: Canned chicken noodle soup is a comfort food.  And I haven't had any in years. This is great! Very much like I remember, but it doesn't make me sick.  This doubles my variety in canned soups.

column9: Delicious Gluten Free Soup At Last!!!!
column10: Ever since I have been diagnosed with Celiac Disease I haven't had any soup, especially not chicken noodle. So when I spotted this in the store I was thrilled. The chicken was a bit dry and hard to chew, and there was more broth than chicken, veggies and noodles. But it was so good! The noodles were so soft and delicious and the broth was very flavorful. I'd buy it again and I can't wait to try more gluten free soups!

I make my own and freeze it. Thought this might be good in a pinch or traveling, but it is not. Progresso makes a great gluten free pea soup and others however;)Progresso Rich & Hearty Soup, Gluten Free New England Clam Chowder, 12 - 18.5-Ounce Cans

I couldn't even get this soup past my nose it was so bad. I did try it though and after three bites threw the rest away. It smelled and tasted horrible. I will never purchase this product again, nor any other soups under this label.

I just recently switched to a gluten free diet and boy was I highly disappointed. I ordered this soup based on the comments of other users stating how tasty it was... don't believe the hype. It's quite disgusting.  First off, it's not set in broth but more of a creamy substance.  It was very salty so beware if anyone has high blood pressure.  The chicken bits tasted like rubber which I had to throw out... I guess for people who are solely on a gluten free diet, they don't have that many choices... thank god I'm not one of them.  I even gave some to my mother-in-law thinking maybe it's just me.  She didn't like it either.  I'm going back to my normal Campbell Chicken noodle soups.

My son  absolutely LOVES this granola!! It's full of flavor and just the right consistency. If you don't have time for a bowl full of granola, you can just grab a handful and go. This company makes several flavors of granola and all of them are tasty, but first place taste goes to the apple cinnamon!
The only difference between this and easy mac... the noodles and the green speckles they call broccoli.It filled me up, but didnt really satisfy.. it made me feel like I was 10 again.
It's a microwaveable instant pasta bowl. the broccoli bits never quite soften up, the cheese has a strange aroma. Its food and that's about all one can say.
bought this for taking to work, it taste better than I thought it would for one of those just add water type meals.

column9: Hard to find, but really good
column10: Out of all the Betty Crocker Bowl Appetit varieties, I like this one the best.  Unfortunately it is hard to find so I bought a case on Amazon.  I gave it 4 out of 5 because it isn't the healthiest option.  (The one thing I don't like about these is that you have to microwave them for 5 1/2 minutes in order to get the noodles done, so it makes this really hot.  Personally I don't like my food at very high temperatures, so I end up putting these in the fridge to cool them down.  Just an FYI.)

Tastes nice enough but isn't amazing. I bought these for my husband for the days that I don't get up early enough to pack a lunch for him. He doesn't like them enough that we'll buy them again. Instead I'm buying some other microwavable meals for him to try. These are good for those times when you just want something quick and easy and not too expensive. A little classier than Easy Mac. One of these might not be quite enough to fill you up.

Creamy, cheesy and filling...you can really taste the broccoli as well. I'm addicted to them for lunch...prob. wouldn't let these enter into the dinner zone but quite enjoyable sitting at your desk in an office

column9: Excellent Source for Instant Broccoli and instant pasta
column10: You'll love it, and you can taste the vitamins.  Make sure it cooks a little and follow directions.
I have used this for some time and the sambar comes out tasting good. I would recommend this to anyone wanting to cook sambar quickly and easily.

I bought couple bags of these a while back just intended to use them for Sambar soup, the south Indian breakfast soup. But I have been using it in many other types of dishes, whether they're pan fry dishes of any meat of fish or soup dishes to spice things up here and there, even to spice up canned chilli. A little sprinkle per dish goes a long way. And the two bags lasted more than a year now.  It tastes better than just typical curry powder. If you use it sparingly, it doesn't just make the dish completely like a curry dish, but adds more depth to the dish flavor.

column9: It is a very good thing I need to mail order these chips.
column10: I was introduced to the Blair chips by a friend. I mostly ignore potato chips because I really don't like them. However, these I like the most among all the chips in the Blair line. They are savory and can be eaten rapidly. The hot chips are good because they are so hot, I cannot eat them fast. I am so happy I cannot get them at local stores because I would eat them all the time.
These are one of the best pistachios I have ever had and there are only a few per container that cannot be opened so you don't have lots of waste.

column9: VERY flimsy containers, arrived all smashed up
column10: I ordered one of these cases (packages of six) to give as Christmas presents to multiple people.  Sadly, upon arrival, every single individual container was smashed open. The external box was not mangled - I have to believe this was a byproduct of the brittle, thin, flimsy individual plastic containers, in combination with having been shipped along with giant cashew tins in a large box with minimal packing materials. Although I think had the container packaging been sturdier this would not have been a problem. In any event, it was a disappointment that none of the packages arrived intact.

I picked up this spread in my local grocery (which carries a lot of Italian products) on a whim  It is less oily/fatty than Nutella, and has a richer chocolate flavor, which i can easily detect the hazelnut in.It's also slightly (ever so slightly!) lower in calories: 160 calories/2 tablespoons versus 200.  Definitely will be buying again.

I was never a fan of Merlot until I tasted this wine.  The thought of chocolate and Merlot together had absolutely no appeal...until I tasted Truffle Merlot.  Last year I bought two cases of this wine from World Imports right before Valentine's Day. It quickly became my birthday gift of choice.  Everyone we shared it with raved about it.  Unfortunately, it was only sold seasonally at World Imports.  I have searched everywhere for this wine. I even went to Monterey,California in hopes of purchasing more Truffle Merlot, but was not successful.  As you can probably tell, this is my all time favorite wine.  Imagine my excitement when I did a search on Amazon and found out that is going to be available soon.  I can't wait to start shipping it to my friends.
This is a great treat=excellent taste and I just let it melt in my mouth.
This was a good and easy way to mix up the variety for the mornings I feel like something different. I haven't tried the iced coffee yet but everything else is great.
My daughter and I shared the "tins" of these.  We both like them, very refreshing!  Would buy again if I get in the minty mood.

I really like "Chicago Style" popcorn. This brand is pretty good. Big fluffy kernals and well coated, no old maids. It's not exactly the treat you get in Chicago at Garret's, but it's fresh and very tasty. Garret's 2 gallon bag costs $56.00 compared to $13.10 here. It's a great treat to eat while watching a movie. I think I have to try the flavors too!
These are the best lemon bars you can get.  They are better than homemade.  I adjust the water portion by using half lemon juice and people cannot believe they come out of a box.

column4: Eileen C. Covino "book lover of oriental fiction"
column9: Lemon Bars are a Real Crowd Pleaser
column10: I had not been able to find Sunkist Lemon Bars by Betty Crocker in any local grocery stores. When my neighbor said that she would love me to bring my lemon bars to her party I didn't know where to turn. I found them on Amazon, and know that I will use every last box. They're that delicious.

Boyfriend had been hinting about these bars and telling me how wonderful they were but couldn't find them anywhere. So for a "just because" item I thought I'd surprise him. He had been trying to find them around here but no one carried them. Only makers like krusteez or some other brand that just didn't taste right. So his face lit up when he opened the box. Thoroughly satisfied. He made some that night and they were great!

These are great! The crust is light and flaky, and the lemon filling is "to die for." I was always afraid they were horrible, and never bought them until I saw the great reviews. They taste as good as the freshly baked bars, that I love, and are super easy to make.

It was so nice to find these mixes on Amazon.  I have used them for years and over the past few years have had trouble finding them in my area.  Other mixes I've tried are nasty/artificial tasting.  The Betty Crocker-Sunkist mix is great!  They are easy to make - taste great and are easliy modified - Key Lime Squares, Lemon Cheesecake bars, etc.  Peggy (SC)

love this mix, as well..they are absolutely delicious and taste like "from scratch"..my minor adjustments are that i grate the skin of one lemon into the mix and i use 1% milk, rather than water..i also bake the crust for about 8 minutes, then brush melted butter across the top, and continue baking for 4 more minutes, until it starts browning..makes a crispier and buttery crust.

These are "to die far" lemon bars, especially if you substitute lemon juice for all the water in the instructions. They are excellent with water, but much more lemony with lemon juice (bottled is all I've ever used).

column9: If you gotta use a box
column10: Use this one. This is the best bar none (pun intended)I'm not sure about the prices. But They don't sell this brand widely in Atlanta, GA so I have my parents ship me some down from the north.

Thank you for having these bars available for purchase.  This brand is no longer sold in the stores in my area and my coworkers and I just decided to pitch in together, get a case, and split them up.  They are MUCH better than the other brands in the store and the bottom of the bars don't burn in the oven (as long as you cook them properly).  The real bits of lemon are a treat and the best thing next to homemade lemon bars. We love them!!

I love lemon bars and when I came across this at an Independent grocery store I was thrilled.  I didn't even know Betty Crocker made this product.  I do not like the "K" brand that is out there.  I had to try BC!  They exceeded my expectations!  Very easy to make and taste great.  I wish they were out there more on the grocery self.  I am on auto delivery now (subscribe & save). Thank you Amazon for this service!

column9: Great Product  - Glad to find it!
column10: I am so happy to find Betty Crocker Sunkist Lemon Bars!!!  We love them.  People expect them at the picnics we go to.  None of the stores in my area carry this any more.  Will order again!

This is a great product.  It is as good as homemade, without all the work. I add a little extra lemon juice to make it even more lemony.I am not able to find this product locally, most stores no longer carry..I am grateful to find this on-line from Amazon.
Excellent product. Became unavailable locally. The ordering and delivery process were easy and fast. Super Saver free shipping a great plus considering the weight of the product.

I bought a pound of this salt and I love it.  It is a great finishing salt, very delicate and flavorful.  Gets lost in the pan, so save it for the final splash.  It comes in a zip top bag for storage.  It is medium fine grain and small flakes, moist and white to slightly grey.  The package says Premium, Fine, No. II by Le Tresor.  I have had better salt direct from Guerande, but it cost more.

column9: Confident giving this to my dog
column10: After careful research on the best dry food for my dog's diet, I chose Wellness Core Reduced Fat. My mixed breed dog is low energy and has a tendency to put weight on easily. It was very difficult to find a dog food that does not compromise quality ingredients to make a food low fat. Since my dog is low energy (by no means a sled dog), her diet does not require her to have extreme protein intake. This food is the prefect balance of protein, quality meat sources, fat content, as well as important sources of fruits and vegetables and fish oils. Her eyes are bright and coat is shiny. While she hasn't lost any weight, she hasn't gained any either, which is a good thing!You get what you pay for when it comes to dog food. column9: Great food to keep an older dog healthy!
column10: Our dog is very healthy and happy on this food! He has no digestive or skin issues and he is never sick. He's an 8 year old American Eskimo Dog. We walk him a LOT, but he still doesn't need to eat as much as the package indicates. He eats the "weight loss" amount, but he's not losing weight, he's maintaining his weight. This isn't a complaint at all, but if you're going to feed this food to an older dog or a dog with a slower metabolism, monitor their weight carefully and make sure you're not feeding too much!

A grain free diet is the best you can do for your pet. Wellness Core has a great ocean recipe that I would highly recommend if you have a terrier because they do better on ocean based diets. I have a yorkshire terrier and she loves this food. Her coat and digestion have improved dramatically. Something else to note is the quality of the ingredients. Overall great food!

I have a portly beagle, who is beyond cute but 2 lbs over weight. However, keeping her weight down as she gets older was very important. We'd been using the normal Wellness Healthy Weight and she seemed to enjoy that. We changed her to the CORE after she started to get red skin on her belly. After switching, which had no effects on her GI, the redness went away. She also had has no tendency to want to eat this after it was digested (if you know what I mean!) which can be an issue with many weight management foods.I did my homework online and read a lot of online sites before switching. I can say hands down, Wellness CORE is a great food and if you can afford the small increase in price, I think you and your furry friend will enjoy its benefits.

I got this at a great price and fast free shipping. My miniature schnauzer is liking it ok so far, not as  well as she liked the other flavors of Wellness CORE. Would definitely recommend Wellness CORE to anyone, especially if your dog has a sensitive stomach and has skin issues/allergies.

Search no more for high quality dog food.This high in protein dog food and is among the best there is on the market.  My 1.5 year old papillon loves it.  I feed him about a small cup per day to keep him full while keeping the fat down.What's the selling point for me?**Contains no meat by-products, wheat, corn, soy, artificial colors, flavors or preservatives**Buy the 12 pound bag and save your money.

I have two golden retrievers with hearty appetites.  Feeding them regular dog food makes them overweight.  I switched to Core Reduced Fat when I began to worry about the quality of the food I was feeding my dogs.  I had fed my dogs expensive dog foods which I got at the grocery store.  When I read the ingredients, I decied to look for something better quality.  From my research I learned that high quality dog foods prevent illness and disease and increase life-span.  Core is made with ingredients like real chicken--not chicken by-products or lots of grain.  Afterall, dogs are carnivores.  Since my dogs have been on Core they have not had the usual ear infections, skin allergies and irritations; their coats are beautiful; they have lots of energy and are overall very healthy.  The extra money I pay for this high quality dog food I definitely save at the vet!

column9: Great food for a great price!
column10: This food works for my dog.  She has some serious gas (boston terrier), and this food helps.  Granted, she still has gas, but it isn't as, well, stinky.  Two thumbs up!

column9: My dog loves the food and I love the price!
column10: We have small dog (Pug/ Boston Terrier)and his weight got a little out of control, so we switched him to this. He loves the taste of the food and he can be pretty picky. He has lost some weight and I feel better knowing that he is getting well-rounded nutrition. Best of all the price here on Amazon is the best I have found. At other retailers I have seen this bag of food cost $10-15 more (sometimes even more than that). I will keep buying this from Amazon for as long as my dog wants it, and I am pretty sure that is going to be a long time! :)

column9: Portly Bagle Loves It! I know it's healthy.
column10: I have a portly beagle, who is beyond cute but 2 lbs over weight. However, keeping her weight down as she gets older was very important. We'd been using the normal Wellness Healthy Weight and she seemed to enjoy that. We changed her to the CORE after she started to get red skin on her belly. After switching, which had no effects on her GI, the redness went away. She also had has no tendency to want to eat this after it was digested (if you know what I mean!) which can be an issue with many weight management foods.I did my homework online and read a lot of online sites before switching. I can say hands down, Wellness CORE is a great food and if you can afford the small increase in price, I think you and your furry friend will enjoy its benefits.This smaller 4-pound bag is nice for taking to grandma and grandpa's for when she visits. We usually pick up the 12lb bag for our day to day feeding at home. I did notice more and more local stores starting to carry this, so I think the Wellness CORE is starting to pick up market share.

For what it's worth, my 9lb. yorkie-poo loves this food, more than the other types of Wellness. The local Petco carries every flavor but this, so I have to order it on-line, but it is really worth it. Whenever I read about a dog having "..re-newed energy", or "...a shinier coat", I always scoff because that has never been the case with my dog. Even with the foods he loves, but with this particular type of dog food with this particular company, I have to say it's true. I tried all of the various Wellness foods, and he was okay with them, but this is the only one that he's ever really emptied the bowl, every time. That includes the Super 5 Max, or whatever it's called, the food for smaller dogs that somehow finds grains acceptable.

The pieces are VERY hard.. in fact, too hard for my 12+ year old to eat dry. I have to soak it in some beef or chicken broth in order for him to be able to eat it. I have never purchased grain free dog food, so I don't have any real comparison and it may all be this way. I do however always buy low-fat food. I tried the grain free because my dogs get dry, itchy skin and thought it might help. I have no idea how the taste is, because I don't eat it, but I did try biting into a piece to see how hard it was and it was. My dogs seem to like it as long as it's softened for them though.

great food choice for those that are looking for alternate protein source. Our dog is allergic to chicken and beef. This is the first food that didn't smell intolerably fishy (even the lesser quality wellness ocean smelled nasty). Believe me, it's still fishy, but tolerable.  After a few weeks on Wellness Core Ocean, her coat is super shiny and soft.  Would purchase again!

I got this dog food at a great price and fast free shipping. My miniature schnauzer LOVED it and so I was very pleased with this product. I would recommend wellness CORE to anyone who has a dog with sensitive stomach, skin issues/allergies, etc.
Even though this product is more expensive the than original recipe, my dog doesn't like it as much. I personally think it smells really fishy too!

Tried this brand for the first time.  We are used to giving our dog Baneful.  But she started to itch a lot and we didn't want to go to the vet at this point.  So after reading reviews of this product we got it, and our dog LOVES it!!!!! What a success.  It doesn't leave her hungry and wanting more. Awesome product!!!

column9: The Pooch gives two paws up!
column10: My dog loves this food.  It is great for him and helps him maintain his weight.  Other dog foods have made him sick in the past.

column9: great for dogs with grain allergies

Oh my gosh, has his hair gotten thick!! a real fur ball now. His sister, without allergies likes it too. First food they can agree on.

I have two basset hounds and they tend to have weight problem especially since they have a mommy that dooesn't like to see them go hungry.  I feel good giving my babies this food because this company has a good reputation and they are consistently on the many lists of good pet food by independent raters.  I feed my babies half dry kibble and half home cooked chicken, turkey, beef fresh meats, and they also get daily multivitamins.  Jake actually host 2 lbs so he will get to keep the same amount bMy problem is that they get too much treats, mainly because I give them treats every time I have to give them medication or clean their ears.  So I decrease the food amount at breakfast and dinner to make up for the daily treats.  I also add some warm water to the dry kibble and let it soften the food, then add probiotic powder when cooled, and home coooked meats and vitamins. I like this brand as well as the Blue Buffalo and the Simple Life brands.  I wish Simple Life will make weight management foods.  I like the foods that are kept in special type of metallic zip lock bags to help keep it fresh.  Make sure you check the expiration date and odor to ensure the foods are not expired or have "off" odors.
I BOUGHT THE OCEAN FISH,MY DOGS LOVE IT AND THE ICHEY SKIN IS NOT AS BAD.I MIX DARWINS RAW MEAT TO IT. THEY REALLY LOVE THAT,YOU SHOULD TRY THAT YOU WOULD NOT BE SORRY.

My middle poodle, Tucker, (the almost 4 year old) is a few lbs. overweight.  Tucker LOVES this food.  I feed my baby poodle, Milo (the almost 2 year old) and my oldest poodle, Bosco (the 13 year old) the regular Wellness Core with Chicken.  Everyone is super satisfied!  It also oddly helped with itching/scratching as well as allergies.  Did I say..  they LOVE this food?!  *smile*  HIGHLY RECOMMENDED!

column9: Wise switch from Iams Low Residue Formula
column10: When my Rhodesian Ridgeback-mix developed mild pancreatitis two years ago at age three, my vet suggested Iams Low Residue food.  Over the last year, however, she's also developed severe skin allergies (but mostly air-borne, I think)and was losing hair in small patches so, after some research I added MSM to her diet and decided to eliminate grain. Wellness CORE Grain-Free food was the perfect choice because it is also low-fat (too much fat aggrevating her pancreas).  In the month she's been on it--both dry and wet formula--her coat has improved and she even seems perkier!
I love that I no longer have to haul big bags of dog food home from the pet store.  This is the only food that seems to agree with my westie's digestive system.

column9: Great dog food. Palatable & good ingredients!
column10: Few things good about this product:1. Made by Wellness. No recalls of any kind thus far. I am really paranoid about having a sick pet with a 3-4 figured vet bill, so that is something I look out for a lot.2. Ingredients is a lot better than most foods.3. Palatable. My dog kinda hates Wellness but would eat down Wellness Core products literally right away.4. High Fiber. 7% if I am not wrong. What made me try this food was that my dog had constantly soft stools at one point in time. So I saw the high fiber percentage, and I decided to try this out. My dog had really solid poop after that! It helped a lot for me so hopefully will be the same for you.5. Relatively reasonably priced. About $1.80/pound.6. No ethoxyquin preservative used.Way(s) this product is "sub-par" compared to the "very top" products. (This is really no biggie at all, but I just decided to write this because for some it might be an issue)1. Dried varieties of certain products as opposed to fresh ones, such as dried ground potato instead of fresh ones.2. Canola oil used instead of salmon oil which is a cost cutting measure used by the company. Dogs can't digest canola oil so the omega levels provided by it are pretty much just for marketing purposes only.Overall, I wouldn't really be concerned with the "cons" of the product if you even consider it as a con to start with.This is a really good product that is priced pretty reasonable for its quality.I would feel safe about feeding my dog this based upon the manufacturer's reputation of not having any recalls in its history.Hope this helps!

Got a shelter dog back in November... Bichon Frise.  We have been thru 7 different brands of food and also boiling chicken and rice for him as well. His digestive system is a mess, and recently we learned his pancreas  numbers were off as well. This is why we decided to go low fat.It has been 12 days and the improvement is remarkable. We finally have good poop. It's a miracle!  PLUS he liked it right away as well.I researched dozens of dog foods over the last 6 months, and recently at least 6 low fat dry foods. This one appeared to be the best, and it is definitely the best for our dog!  We are VERY HAPPY with our choice. Plus it magically comes to the door via UPS.

My dogs liked this food and they did quite well on it. Only drawback I don't like the smell. I normally feed them the chicken variety. Overall, my dogs have done great on all of the Wellness foods. I saw a difference in my lab puppy's behavior within a day! My senior dog seems to have lost a little of her extra weight and she has a lot of energy for a 13 yr old.

This is wonderful food, and would recommend it to anyone with a dog needing to lose weight, with a sensitive stomach, or allergies.  I had my toy poodle on Iams for 7 years.  I never did research on dog food, the breeder I bought her from had started her on Iams, so I continued on it.  She steadily put on weight over the years, & I switched to Iams Weight Control.  After continuing to gain weight, and just generally have no energy at all, I thought it's time for a drastic change.  At this point, I did A LOT of research on dry dog food.  I wish I had done this years ago!  I came to find out, that a lot of the well know brands, do not have quality ingredients.  After lots of research, I decided the Wellness Core Reduced Fat Grain Free was our best option.  She's been on it now for 5 months, and has went from nearly 8.5 lbs to just barely over 7, and still counting.  She seems to feel so much better.  AND...she loves the food too!

Though I don't know if this particular one is recalled.But I just thought I'd try to give a heads up.So, this is not a true review about this products features per say.....but I feel that everyone needs to know that this company has recalled their products and it is going on right now.To begin with, I want to say that I know that unfortunately there are plenty of human products that get recalled too and that is the most important thing. And yes, I know that every time we go eat out or buy any type of store bought food.... that it is a gamble too.But, my family considers our dogs as part of the family and this is very important too.Many years ago I did research to find the best priced grain free,no dye or by product food.I found that some of the food made by Diamond Pet Foods had the first ingredient as being the actual real meat.Plus,the grain free ones made my baby girl look so healthy and shiny.Also,since it had no fillers and quality ingredients it actually made her stool smaller and less stinky.She has less allergies and it stopped most of her constant itching/biting/licking at her paws and less tear stains.She actually loved the product, by the same maker, named "Taste Of The Wild" in Bison the most.But,I am saddened now because Diamond Dog Food has now been RECALLED for "SALMONELLA CONTAMINATION"This company makes various products that have been recalled.Such as:Diamond Naturals, Wellness, Natural Balance, Taste of The Wild, Apex, Chicken Soup Soul, Canidae, Country Value, 4Health, Natural Balance, Kirkland Signature, Natural Balance, Premium Edge, Professional and Solid Gold.I am saddened that we actually spend more money on these "better than store" dog food and they keep getting recalled!So many families have unfortunately lost their fur babies babies and have spent thousands of dollars on Vet bills....when all we are trying to do is buying the "better" which are higher priced, dog food ingredients.I am pretty thankful that I had signed up online,for emails about the latest dog food recalls last week.My hubby and I was devastated to see that Diamond Dog Foods, Taste Of The Wild was on the list now.I am sickened by these companies being so careless. When the reason we buy their higher priced food is cuz they are suppose to be healthier!I just wanted to write this and try to stop another baby from getting sick or even worse dying

I have tried many varieties of chai tea, both powdered and liquid.  This chai is full-flavoured with a bit more of a kick to it than other chai teas.  This is a good thing because I can use less powder to get a satifying drink.

This chai latte mix is weak and not creamy.  For Starbucks like taste, try the Big Train canister.

column9: Great at first but something went wrong
column10: I'm a chai enthusiast, so when I first tasted this, I was excited. It's not "authentic" but it was milky and sweet with a kick. After the 2nd canister, however, the taste changed and it just wasn't good anymore. I don't know what happened. I had to trash the entire pack.

We really like this Pacific Spice Chai Latte mix.  It is very hard to find in the stores where we live.  It is delicious and in fact is the only tea my husband will drink.  It is very econimical purchasing the 6 pack as my husband goes through a canister in under 2 weeks.  We would recommend that anybody who likes good tea to buy this tea.

Amazon is the only place I have found to purcahse Pacific Chai Latte. I especially love that I get it auto delivered to my residence. I am definitely hooked on this Chai Latte. (And much more reasonably priced & convenient than going out to *bucks...)

Greetings:I want to say I LOVE Pacific Spice Chai Latte.  It is very hard to find in the stores.  If you have had a tiring day, try this tea.  It just makes me feel like I have spent a few moments sitting in a rocking chair in front of a crackling fire. I am thrilled Amazon sells it and at the very best price.  Thank you Amazon.

I add a bit of milk to mine to make it even richer.  The price, however has steadily increased over this time, and now I think Walmart has it cheaper, still under $4.00 per canister.  Good stuff though.

Pretty good Chai Tea.  I saved plenty of money from Starbucks by simply making myself a cup of Chai in my home or office.  Would recommend to anyone!

I regularly hear customers say "yum" on their way out of the store.  You can use it at home as well because all you need is hot milk.

Pacific Chai is everything a Latte should be -- smooth, creamy, NOT TOO SWEET.  It's my morning picker-upper and my after work comfort.  Love it!

column9: I love Betty Crocker Warm Delights-Hot Fudge Brownie
column10: I received my order in a timely manner. The quality of this product is excellent. I would strongly suggest purchasing this product and I plan to purchase more.

column9: Nothing Says Lovin' Like a Microwavable Brownie...Well Sorta
column10: Leave it to Betty Crocker to resuscitate the kiddie concept of the Easy Bake-Oven to produce their Warm Delights Hot Fudge Brownie. The serving size seems to remain the same child's portion as the old 1960's toy since it barely covers the bottom of the plastic bowl that contains the dry powder mix. The directions specifically state a tablespoon plus a teaspoon of water to moisten it, and knowing how temperamental baking can be, I would not try improvising this part or else you will get chocolate mush.Forty-five seconds in the microwave and then you squeeze a packet of sugary Fudge Topping on the top. It's not bad but just seems like skimpy gratification for the 370 calories it contains, 110 of which are fat. There's also 2 grams of trans fat, 270 mg of sodium and 61 grams of cholesterol. In other words, this is not a Weight Watchers treat by any stretch. But if you are in need of a quick chocolate fix, you could do worse. As an alternative, I suggest the much tastier Fat-Free No Pudge! Brownies you can get at Trader Joe's. Without the elaborate packaging Betty Crocker seems to think is necessary for an individual serving, you can bake a dozen and then allocate them as you wish.

The only thing that impressed me was the speed to prepare---the so-called brownie was like a piece of kids chocolate cake with the choco syrup--you can do better at the Little Debbie shelf at the local supermaket.  The price was absurd if it was on a half price discount and then I would be looking for an ice cream coupon.  Sorry folks, not worth the money .

These are the best tasting brownies I have ever eaten. You would not believe how easy they are to make. column9: Dry, Hard, Crunchy, Crumbs and Crumb Dust.
column10: I ordered these cookies to send to my daughter who serves in the US Navy. She is out to sea for six or more months at a time.
