column10: Not all that much to say here. It's just what you get in the store without the trip to the store. If you like jerky, You'll like this......mmmmmmm jerky!
This jerky was satisfying but not as flavorful as I would have liked.  I liked it but certainly it was not outstanding.

This was a nice pack to bring on a family trip, though do wish they had sold more then 3 per pack since the kids and both Adults loved this snack. maybe next time will have to buy either a smaller pack multi pack so everyone could have their own package. otherwise a fairly good deal. and worth the price. will buy from again.
My daughter loves beef jerky, so I bought her this pack for her birthday. She loved it! Will buy again.

I have been using Olewo carrots and beets for about a year now. The difference in my dogs is like day and night! Their coats are now shiny, luxurious and soft. Color and pigment are vibrant. I love the deep reds and dark blacks on my German Shepherds. Olewo also helps regulate the digestive system and their stools are better than ever. No more anal gland or digestive issues. Very simple to prepare and extremely cost effective as well. To top it all off, Olewo is very palatable and the dogs LOVE the taste. Bowls are licked clean after Olewo!

Olewo Dehydrated Carrots Dog Food Supplement, 5-1/2-PoundI have now used Olewo Carrots on all my dogs for about 10 years! I depend on the product to add fiber to their diet and shine to their coats. We have 4 breeds in our home (Boston Terrier, Lab, Great Dane and 2 Greater Swiss Mountain Dogs) and they have all seen the benefit of using the Olewo Carrots. I have mentioned this product to numerous breeders and all agree that there is nothing else like it on the market! With litters on the ground, I love sharing my Olewo Carrot product with the new puppy buyers! Thank you for making this great product available.

My wife and I have included Olewo carrots and beets in our Bearded Collie's diets for over six years. All three have beautiful coats and virtually never have digestive issues. They love the taste and wait patiently for each meal. I know of many friends that started their dogs on these products and feel the same as I do about their value. I like the products so much that I order extra so I never worry about running out.

As a breeder and exhibitor of Great Danes, our dogs are always on the go. Utilizing Olewo Carrots, our dogs have firmer stools, easily handle stress of traveling & showing weekly, and are rarely ill despite the multitude of dogs they come in contact with. They have amazing shiny coats which require no additional products. We wean our puppies adding in Olewo Carrots to their kibble to aid in digestion, boost immunity and to naturally worm. We share the benefits of Olewo Carrots with everyone we can and believe every pet owner should add it to their pet's diet.
My dog loves this stuff. It is very easy to prepare and store. I feel good feeding my show/working dog this because he needs the extra vitamins and he thinks it's a treat!

As a breeder and exhibitor of Great Danes, I am thrilled with the results I am seeing with adding the carrots and beets to my dogs food. I am seeing shinier, softer coats, and the 2 that I have with some skin irritation have improved as well in just 2 weeks. Stools are also firmer and my picky eaters love the carrots. With traveling alot and being around many different dogs I am happy that the products also help boost their immune system.  So many benefits of adding just a couple Tablespoons a day.

I have 2 dogs of my own that I use to feed dry food only.  A friend of mine recommended adding in Olewo supplements to my dog's food. I hadn't really heard of supplements for pets but I did a little research and liked what I found. My dogs love to carrot supplements in their food! I have a smaller dog who is a picky eater and would refuse food sometime. After adding in the carrots to her food she went crazy and finished every bite. I am also feeding my dogs the Olewo Dehydrated Red Beets Dog Food Supplement, 2.2-Pound. If you are going to try the carrots, get to red beets too!

column9: Works - if you take it consistently
column10: I've been taking a scoop of this every morning for about 3 weeks now. The first 10 days or so, I didn't feel any different, but now I do. More energy, can hit the weights harder, and it feels like my libido got a boost. The key is to take it consistently. This could be a problem for some people, because it tastes like sheet. I mix it with water & force it down, but for the people with less masochistic tendencies you might want to look into capping it. It works, though.

We are heavy coffee drinkers and love to try different types all the time. I was hopeful that this would be great quality and we were turned off by the strong, heavy flavor with almost a musty tone to it. Perhaps it was old, I didn't see any date on the bag. We will finish it and with enough creamer in it we can tolerate it but wont purchase again.

I bought these oats to sprout for my raw oatmeal, but they do not sprout. I believe they are treated with heat or some form of steaming - so they are not raw. Very disappointed. I wish the product description would have explained that these oats are treated and are not for sprouting.

I fell in love with Jamaica Blue Mountain coffee (where else?) in Jamaica! I love the rich, deep aroma and the smooth non-acid taste. This is one of the only coffees that doesn't irritate my stomach. Yes, it's expensive but well worth the treat. I tend to give this as a gift to friends and family and it's become so popular that I even get requests for it by name! I buy it in both ground and whole bean.
Perfect!  If you're looking for genuine Jamaica Blue Mountain, this is it!  Don't just settle for your average cup o' joe, splurge a little and try Regie's Roast!  You won't be disappointed.

As I sit in my home in Chicago the morning after an all day/night ice storm enjoying a cup of this wonderful brew, I pause to thank both God and Reggie for this perfect moment.  Outside, all is beautifully coated in crystal.  Inside, I am savoring this perfect cup of coffee.  I'll be back!!
It tastes like what I brought home from Jamaica.  Blue Mountain coffee ain't cheap, but it's worth it to me- full flavor without the shakes that go with regular coffee.

To my mind, "Blue Mountain" and "Blend" just didn't go together. But the price was certainly lower than what I'd expect to pay for the real thing. Feeling flush or maybe just lucky I ordered some. Wonderful! It has the well-rounded flavor and complete absense of bite that I look for in Blue Mountain. It's appropriately light, and with just a hint of the sweetness that in my opinion defines the best of Jamaica. Very, very worthwhile experiment. Until I can make it back to the Island, this will do just fine.

column9: Don't waste you money on this - zero stars
column10: I ordered this and some Kona coffee at the same time. I was very disappointed in the Kona. Today I opened this and tried it, I was again very disappointed. This coffee has absolutely no flavor. I would give it zero stars if I could. I have heard from so many people about how good Jamaican coffee is I can only hope this was a bad batch or what they swept off the floor after grinding. I think I am finished buying coffee products from Amazon.

column9: No instructions on how to brew
column10: This came with no instructions on how to brew the coffee, per the amount to use.  I will not buy this product again.  TC

A friend of mine brought this cheeseball dip into work and it was wonderful.  She bought the mix while vacationing in Gatlinburg.  I looked online and bought 6 packages because I loved it so much.  I make one a week and take them to work with me - they do not last long!
Just got the Masia Extra Virgin Olive Oil, amazing taste!! Recommend it to all good tasters out there. This one is a must. Thanks!
Just recieved my 2 bottles of Masia alter duo, they are amazing!!! I really recomend this high quality product to anyone!

I was looking for a less expensive alternative to Weruva and decided to give this a try based on the good reviews.  Sadly, the quality of this isn't anywhere even close to Weruva - this comes with a few identifiable flakes of fish on top; the rest looks like dark fish guts (including gut contents), grainy and clearly unpalatable as my kitties refuse to touch it, even when fed nothing else.  I gave it to a friend I visited over Xmas to try with her cats, but they also rejected it. She is planning to donate it to her local shelter; I hate waste, but think it might be better if she just tossed this.  Bottom line, I cannot recommend the Natural Value and will keep away from this brand in the future.

All four of my cats really like this. I even spoke with the company manager, as I had a concern about it being made and canned in an Asian country. He was most helpful, and sent photos of his cats enjoying this. He wanted photos of mine eating it too, but I have not fully entered the 21st Century. He must wait until my film is developed.Thank you

After I fed this to my cat for the first time, he refuses to eat anything else. I just got a 2nd cat, and same with him. They both love this food and gobble it up! It is grain free with a low ash content which is good for the cats. It has a fishy smell which attracts them to eat it. It has real fish pieces and is not Pate. My cats don't like the pate food for some reason.All in all, it is extremely well priced, grain free, healthy and my cats love it. 5 stars from me!

column9: Cats have loved this since it first became available!
column10: Both of my cats love this cat food, they eat their plates clean.  I also give them dry food to help keep their teeth clean.  I buy nearly all of the 5.5 oz Natural Value cat foods and this past Monday showed all the labels to my vet. He said it is a great food and my cats, both in for checkups, look wonderful.  One is eleven and the other is seven and they are totally indoor RV cats, beautiful coats, bright eyes, perfect weight.  Their teeth are also in beautiful shape, meaning no expensive cleaning bills.

I tried this because it was more natural than some other brands. My cat vomited when she ate it, and I know cats just vomit sometimes, so I dealt with it and kept feeding it to her. Each time I fed it to her she vomited. When I gave her other food like dry food or other canned wet food, she was fine. Then I gave this to her again, and she vomited. Not sure what's wrong with it, but we tried. Sorry, won't order again.

I tried Natural Value chunk mackerel, and my cats refused. I thought this one might work out, and they do eat it eventually. It is hard to find a relatively pure product with a minimum of dangerous additives. Am still working to win them over, but may have to switch to solid tuna, which they do like. At least they don't get sick on this, as they did on the chunky mackerel. Having been owned by cats for many years, however, I know my chances. This is a good product ... minimal additives, simple presentation, and simple ingredients. They do enjoy the tuna with crab, shrimp or albacore. Wish I could be so fussy.
This is getting harder to find and it's a pity. It is my absolute favorite soda.  Just sweet enough, without being too sweet, with a lovely vanilla-like aftertaste.

This powdered cardamon is fragrant and flavorful. We use cardamon when we make our Chi Tea and being able to buy a larger quantity at such a good price was very desirable. There is nothing tastier than a cup of Chi Tea using fresh ingredients. Being Certified Organic was a plus. I recommend it to anyone who uses cardamon often.

For all you organic cardamom lovers out there, you will not be disappointed with this!  The flavor is top-notch & the price is the best we've seen.  We use our food saver to store the bag once it's been opened, keeping the flavor as fresh as the day we opened it.  This is a great product!

column9: Daughter asks for it every morning!
column10: This is my daughter's absolute favorite breakfast food!  She is 3 years old, but has been enjoying it since about a year & half.  She also likes the Maple & Brown Sugar variety, but definitely prefers this one.  I use organic milk to prepare it, just enough to soak the oats, put it in the microwave for about 45 seconds then top it with applesauce as the mix in (to cool it off quicker).  She loves it!

My 1-year old daughter and I both LOVE this oatmeal.  It has just the right amount of sweetness, and it's not gloppy and soggy like some instant oatmeal.  This is the only instant oatmeal we eat now.  Of course, my daughter loves that Elmo is on the package...

column9: Earth's Best is simply the BEST Instant Oatmeal !!!
column10: I have been buying this cereal for my two little boys since there were one and now they are almost 3 and they still love it just as much! I mix it with organic milk and it is a really good healthy breakfast for my kiddos. If you buy it from ToysRus or BabiesRus you will pay about 3.49 per box, which is the cheapest I have found.Here is a link:  [...]

Have tried many warm cereals in the past, and sadly haven't had much luck. That was until we found this product. It's a very good tasting breakfast product. We the patents don't even mind eating it. If your child is a difficult eater try this. They may enjoy it.CWDaly

i love this oatmeal porridge. my son is a vegetarian with numerous food allergies and is a picky eater.  he is now almost two and religiously eats this cereal every morning (sometimes i even make two packets!).  he LOVES it!  it fills him up and i'm really incredibly pleased with his eagerness to eat it ;)  a lot of cold cereals actually have more iron (i give him quaker oatmeal squares as a snack which probably has the highest amount, and which he onlyrecently started to enjoy); however, if you are looking for a hot tasty meal for your little one and are concerned about iron intake, i highly recommend this oatmeal. he has been eating this for breakfast almost every morning since 6 months, and it seems to be his favorate.

Finally, a cereal that I can get my two year old to eat on a regular basis!  We just add milk and nuke it for 45 seconds and add a little applesauce as one other reviewer suggested and he usually gobbles it right down.  He's a very picky eater too.  I've tasted it as well and it doesn't have that stale taste a lot of baby & toddler foods have.  I don't think a lot of companies making those products recognize that hey, little ones do have taste buds too!!!  Good job Earth's Best!
I have been buying this oatmeal for over a year now and my daughter loves it!  However, the price just went up, so I might as well get it at the store. Way to go Amazon......

I am very pick when it comes to selecting brands/products for my son. Earth's Best is a great brand, and their oatmeal is excellent. My son loves it!  We are very happy with this product, and highly recommended it!
A great organic oatmeal for kids of all ages. Mixes nicely and the Amazon price can't be beat!

Since my daughter was 18 months old until now (she's almost 3) she has loved this oatmeal and eaten the whole bowl (when I add organic raisins).  She's a picky eater, so the other review is a surprise to me.
Excelente producto, excelente presentación. Cada uno de los sabores tiene un encanto especial y un sabor delicioso. Para las ensaladas son complementos maravillosos.

I absolutely love this coffee. This coffee is a perfect start to my long days. I look forward to trying other flavors that Jeremiah's Pick has to offer. Thank you for also helping me to get through some of those long nights as well!!
Love coffee and always looking for one that has no acidity and no heavy oil, yet sooooo tasty.This is it!! I no longer have to hunt and order this on a regular basis.
Coffee is very good, wakes me up, and does not give me the jitters.  Very satisfying!

Jeremiah produces some smooth coffee, some of my favorite, so I decided to give the Organcic PowerCaf a try. It doesn't taste bad, but it does not taste like coffee either. It's different. If you're wanting to drink coffee in the morning, try Jeremiah's coffee beans, not this stuff. My favorites: Jeremiah Kona or Jeremiah Jamaican Blue Mountain.

this company has excellent products and service.the cress are different than my usual alfalfa and clover, because you need soil. i usually do the jar sprouting method, but these cress sprouts are decorating my window right now and i can't wait to munch on them! delicious, slightly spicy (but not very, because i don't like that) but delicate and crunchy.

column9: Alfalfa Honey with Bee Pollen GREAT!
column10: This product is very difficult to find and this product is not only affordable but it tastes wonderful. The seller ships promptly and ships at a fair price. It IS ALL NATURAL and I will be a return customer for sure! Much better taste than just Clover honey in the grocery store. Eat it plain or in baking. IT"S WONDERFUL!

column9: This flavor is horrible and you can't return it!
column10: I've bought other flavors (cinnamon raisin and cinnamon) of Jacobsen's snack toast in the past (from a grocery store) and loved them.  I have year old twins and I give them the snack toast to help with teething and as a treat.  The cinnamon and cinnamon raisin flavors are all natural and taste great.  This blueberry flavor is NOT all natural.  The blueberry flavored bits are made up of: sugar, corn syrup, corn cereal, modified food starch, partially hydrogenated vegetable oil, artificial flavors, and artificial colors.  Not only are the ingredients bad, the toast itself tastes bad - like a cheap blueberry flavored kids cereal or something.  Not appealing at all.  Since I couldn't see the ingredients list before buying, I now have 6 boxes of blueberry snack toast that can't be returned and will be fed to the birds (hope they like it!).  Wanted to warn anyone else considering this flavor to get the cinnamon or cinnamon raisin instead!

These potatoe chips are now an addiction!  I bought my first bag at a local BevMo store when they had a 1/2 price sale.  We went back before the sale was over and bought a case of 12. These are not too salty and very nice tasting. If you are a fan of Kettle Cooked by Lays or Hawaiian Kettle Cooked, you will probably like these chips even more.  Highly recommended.

I bought these expecting to fall in love with them because I love malt vinegar and potato chips.  On the outside of the original box packaging there was grease all over the place and when I opened up a bag to try them, there was a very foul, rancid oil type smell and also the same taste when I took a nibble off of the chips.  I opened more bags and every single one smelled and tasted the same.  I think the ones I got must be a bad batch but they are awful!  I got a sick stomach just from taking tiny tastes off of a couple chips.  I hope everyone else has better luck.

column9: THESE ARE THE GREATEST POTATO CHIPS OF ALL TIME!!!
column10: Short and sweet, if you like salt and vinegar chips, you should definitely give these a taste.  The only bad thing about these is it's nearly impossible to stop eating them.

The malt vinegar gives it a slight and I mean slight sweetness to the vinegar taste.  These are amazing.  Crunchy, thick, just the right amount of sea salt.  Better than regular salt and vinegar chips.  Actually most of the Boulder Chips are truly gourmet and tasty.

Despite not liking a lot of salt, I have an occasional craving for chips and salt & vinegar is a favorite variety. These are the best of the bunch, period. As a previous reviewer has noted, the use of malt vinegar gilds the lily that happens to be an already excellent chip--thick, crunchy, golden, and just salty enough. Pucker up and enjoy (but try not to become addicted).
The malt vinegar really stands out in these fresh thick natural chips.  I'm order these on a regular basis with ship and save !

column9: Best potato chips I've ever had!
column10: After trying many different types of thick potato chips, this is one of the best.Other brands of 'kettle' chips usually has a lot of dark discolored chips.  I'm not sure if that is from overcooking or using poor quality potatoes.  An example of that is a certain popular name brand that has the word 'kettle' in it.  In contrast, Boulder Canyon's Totally Natural potato chips are usually bright yellow throughout with consistent potato flavor.The only issue I've ever had is sometimes you get a rancid batch.  When this happens, it usually affects the entire batch (with the same batch number).  Because of those previous experiences, I now sample one bag.  If it tastes normal, I'll usually collect the entire stock (that has the same batch number).  It's kind of funny when a few customers start staring at my shopping cart full of potato chips at the checkout counter.If buying online, please buy from vendor with decent customer service, such as Amazon.I have purchased these from Whole Foods Markets and Fry's Electronics in the past.  WFM probably does not stock them anymore.Some close alternatives (in case you can't find Boulder Canyon):Lay's Kettle Cooked OriginalFresh & Easy's Kettle Cooked Original SaltedI have purchased well over 100 bags of these Boulder Canyon Totally Natural for my family's consumption.  They are definitely a family favorite!

column9: Best Salt & Vinegar that I've ever tasted!
column10: These are amazing! They're intensely craveable! I just adore them. Give them a try using Subscribe & Save, and save money while treating your mouth to these great chips. That way, you can have them sent again whenever you want, and never pay shipping, and still enjoy the 15% discount! This is the ultimate in convenient scrumptiousness!

column9: Too much like Regular potato chips
column10: I think the texture is more like lays potato chips than kettle chips. They are alright obviously taste is subjective
I didn't care for the chips very much, but I took most of them to work and the group thought they were like Tim's and they were a hit with them.

The Boulder malt vinegar & sea salt potato chips are very good, the flavor is different and very tasty. It is a good snack, maybe a bit too much salt, but great for something to eat between meals, to satisfy a craving. Try them, you'll like them.

I tried these because I can't find no salt/reduced salt in my area. These are so good. It amazes me that they have 50 percent less salt but still taste good. After eating these, its impossible to eat full salt chips again. Just wish the bags weren't half filled.

I bought these because I saw other ratings, and I wish that I just stuck with the Kettle chips I knew I loved.  Now I have 35 bags left and don't know what to do with them.Taste was almost buttery... rather than salt and vinegar.
vinegar and sea salt chips are the absolute favorite in our office. We were surprised to discover that the ones we recieved from you are much fresher than the ones we had been buying.

If you want a lot of "pow!" in the way of salt and vinegar....this is not your bag of chips.  By that I mean that the malt vinegar flavor is fairly subtle.  It has a slight sweetness like you'd figure from malt vinegar.  The chips are nice and crispy, however smallish, which is fine for a small bag as such.  Overall...good flavor, salty enough, slightly tangy/sweet.  I shall very much enjoy the remainder of the case I bought, but may try a case of something else in seek of something with a little more bang.  Having said that, I appreciate that they use real malt vinegar solids and sea salt. Unlike some "kettle type chips" that use cheap acid variants that simulate the salt and vinegar flavor, but leave your mouth and tongue feeling like you swabbed your mouth out with sandpaper.If you like Salt and Vinegar chips, they are certainly worth a try to see if they fit your taste.
Reviews on this site!  says malt vinegar and sea salt. Watch out! This is only reduced salt in gray bag.Taste is good.

These are the best chips ever made, hands down. I dont buy them by the bag...I buy them by the box... soooo good... these are great at parties because wont have to worry about people not liking the food... they will love these...excellent for movies instead of popcorn...

The malt vinegar flavor is a nice change from typical vinegar chips, but it's unfortunately overpowered by the salt. My husband tried these and agreed they were too salty. We did enjoy the chips and had no trouble finishing an entire 10 oz bag, but I wish they'd cut the salt a bit. It's just unnecessary and really detracts from the vinegar flavor.

My fiancee and I discovered these chips at a Whole Foods in Denver last summer.They are literally the best tasting potato chips I have ever had.I can't find then where I live in Maryland, so I ordered a case of them from Amazon.They are just as good as I remember!

column9: Salt & Cracked Pepper Canyon Cut.  OMG The Best Chips I've Ever Had By Far. Delecious
column10: These chips are/were Delicious, I wish I had ordered more while they were on sale. These chips are similar to ruffles but better seasoning. the salt is just right and the robust pepper gives it a "umph" that tantalizes your toungue but not spicy hot. These have a built-in overindulgence system, too much and the pepper becomes overbearing thus limiting your intake. I tripped the system many times.Only complaint is my chips were all broken up, I really do like a whole chip rather than scraps in bottom. they were like that in many bags. If Boulder can't fix that maybe they should package in cannisters like pringles.But taste is SOOOO Good, You won't regret ordering these. I would say these are for adults rather than kids due to sophisticated seasonings.Seems like this flavor is discontinued or out of stock. Sea salt & cracked pepper may be similar.
This is now the 2nd time that I have ordered this product & I have enjoyed the tast of the potato chips. If you are looking for something different to try then consider this one.
Delicious and tasty potato chips .. love the malt vinegar flavor.
The 'Malt' Vinegar is what sets these chips apart from other Salt & Vinegar chips........ These are the best...... Will Buy Again!!!

These are the best chips on the market, there hardy and very flavorful. The MALT vinegar adds an extra zing,but best of all there not to salty.  The kids even like them, they can't wait to get more in the mail.  Best eaten after a nice Hike or run, you won't be able to get enough!  Chomp away!

Good chips, i will purchase them again but they are kind of weak on BBQ floavor. it could be kicked up and still have great flavor. but still a good chip and kind of small for the price, but still good.
Very good crunchy potato chips.  Haven't tried the other flavors yet but this one is a winner!

column9: Best Salt & Vinegar that I've ever tasted!
column10: These are amazing! They're intensely craveable! I just adore them. Give them a try using Subscribe & Save, and save money while treating your mouth to these great chips. That way, you can have them sent again whenever you want, and never pay shipping, and still enjoy the 15% discount! This is the ultimate in convenient scrumptiousness!
As a fan of ruffled potato chips, these are more than acceptable, and our household went through them very quickly.

I've been a fan of kettle chips for over 20 years--and have always remained loyal to the original Kettle brand.  I've sampled many other brands but never found one I liked as well.Well, now I've found a new favorite.  Boulder Canyon kettle chips are even better than the original!  They're very crisp & crunchy, with a delicious taste, and best of all, they have a lighter touch on the oil as well as the salt. And, there are no overcooked chips.  The only way they could be better is if they were made from organic potatoes.Try them; you'll like them!

column9: Crappy chips, deflated bags, no kettle texture
column10: chip bags were deflated (may be altitude issues during transportation?)and just overall crappy.  These were the flattest bags of chips I've ever seen and I'm not sure if they're the greatest ever usually, but the way I received them, there was no kettle crunch or crunch of any kind.  Boulder does make good kettle chips and I'm pretty sure it's just the canyon cut that sucks so bad.

These chips are the best barbecue chips I have ever had the pleasure of devouring.  Boulder also make great salt and vinegar chips.  This brand and Kettle chips are the best.  They arrived to my door fast and were devoured by my friends and I almost just as fast.
These were so greasy that they bottom of the bag was stained from the oil.  Also, they didn't taste like Jalepno/Cheddar.  They tasted like old bacon.Don't waste your money on these.

I am a big fan of rosemary, so I was excited to order these chips.  They are good, but you taste the balsamic vinegar, not rosemary.  Another positive:  My picky eater (6 years old) liked them too, and I do anything I can to get him to try new flavors.

This picture is misleading. I bought thinking it would be the sea salt and cracked pepper chip like pictured. However, I received a box of canyon cut salt and pepper. I like the canyon cut, but not nearly as much as the sea salt and cracked pepper. I'm waiting for amazon to have them in stock.

These are ok,  it's more of a sweet with spicy flavor.  I can taste the jalapeno and a sweet/sugar flavor, but I don't taste any cheese flavor.  It's closer to a barbecue flavor.  These chips are ok tasting, but nothing special.

I had the same experience, except that I do not like the canyon cut variety.  I did not receive a clear answer as to when  Amazon will know whether or not the chips in the warehouse are canyon cut vs. original cut.
This spice was not to my taste. I have never used it before, but to me it was bitter and I could not find a use for the spice.

column9: A Great Spice For Specialty dishes
column10: Whole peppercorns are a great addition to some gourmet dishes, so when we found this smoked pepper, we decided to try it. It definitely has a pronounced smoke scent and flavor, making it a great addition to smoked meats or pasta served with aouthwest vegetables. There is wnough pepper in the container to allow for a number of uses, and we loaded a grinder with some to experiment with all the ways we could add flavor to brisket, ribs, pasta and seafood. If you are an adventurous cook, or just like different flavors in your cooking, try this. I don;t think you will be disappointed.

never had smoked pepper before- it will be used a lot more now that i have tried it. it is subtle but adds a nice flavor to anything that needs regular pepper. great in recipes, soups, dressings and sauces, and a whole lot more. it has opened me up to trying a lot more smoked spices which i will gladly try in the future!
This set included a nice variety of teas and only gave you 2 of each kind so there were many teas to try.  I was also happy with the quality and taste. I would definitely buy this again!

I was happy to find the Pepperidge Farm Stuffing. The shipping was fast. When I opened the box I discovered that all packages were STALE DATED. Expired 12 months ago. Yes I double checked the date. I threw them in the trash.

Lion Bars have been a tradition in our family since our first trip to Great Britain.  We bring them back in our suitcases to share.  How marvelous to be able to order them in the United States.  They are a crispy, chewy, chocolate bar.  These arrived fresh and in perfect condition.

column9: One of the Best Chocolate Bars
column10: One of the best chocolate bars I have tasted.  This was recommended to me by friends and I highly recommend it to you.  Similar to a Kit Kat, but richer in flavor.

Admittedly it has been a while since I've had an actual Nestle Lion Bar, but what I remember is that it is almost exactly the same as a Cadbury Mr. Big bar which is available in North America, except the Lion Bar is about 2/3 the size, and doesn't have peanuts.Here's how Wiki describes the Mr. Big bar: The standard bar is made of a long, layered vanilla wafer, coated in caramel, peanuts and rice crisps, which is then covered in the chocolate coating.Here's how Wiki describes a Lion Bar: It consists of a wafer, caramel and crisped rice covered in milk chocolate.I like both, but I can get Mr. Big for about 1/4 of the cost. There's not much difference between the two in terms of taste and appearance, in fact I can remember being fairly disappointed when I got one in England, I'd made a point of only getting candies I couldn't get at home, ones I remembered from childhood in England before emigrating.Oh and Nestle who make the Lion Bar, also make the ice cream version of the Mr. Big bar.So the bar itself gets a 5, but buying it at import prices, that gets a 2, since there is a much cheaper almost identical local product available.

I think the ratings for Mori-Nu Tofu would not be so high if more people were actually aware of what's in it. Mori-Nu's tofu contains soy protein isolate, a highly processed form of soy. As a busy student cooking for myself most nights, I'm always looking for grocery products that will make putting dinner on the table more convenient. But while I was intrigued by the shelf-stability of Mori-Nu Tofu, I'm definitely not counting on it as a staple-- Tofu is considered healthy because it is a fermented soy product, but the soy protein isolate in Mori-Nu's tofu puts it in the category of processed soy, the kind that will mess with your endocrine system if consumed it regularly. This means if you're eating tofu for the health benefits, you may as well look elsewhere. What I've learned is that most tofus packed in water have expiry dates two months ahead (unopened) so you'll only need to replenish your supply every 1 1/2-2 months. Sure, this would save me space in the fridge and I could stock up on a year's worth of tofu if I really wanted to (and I might want to, but a year's worth of tofu is hardly a necessity). But the bottom line is I'm just unwilling to make this highly processed food a staple, particularly when versions that are truly healthy are readily available.

column9: Pacific Natural Foods: Poblano Pepper and Corn Chowder
column10: Wow, this was surprisingly good.  I didn't hold much hope for it since it came from a box, but figured it would be good in a pinch if I forgot to pack my lunch.  And I'm glad I forgot to pack my lunch today and had this as an emergency backup, this is worthy of an occasional meal.Since this is vegetarian it has to rely on the spices and vegetables that make it up.  In this case corn and potatoes were the main vegetables, but there were some peppers and onion as well.  They were cut in small pieces, which I like as they fit on the spoon and in my mouth, and while there weren't a ton of them, it was still enough to make me feel like I was getting my monies worth.  The spices were really good as well, it was kind of spicy, but there was a touch of garlic and pepper that I could tell in it.  And it was nicely salted, but not too salty as a lot of soups seem to be.  I could taste the cream and at times it even tasted a little cheesy to me.  Which is great because I love cheese (although there is actually no cheese in this soup).The ingredients were great for a soup.  All pronounceable and it was just the vegetables, water, cream, and the spices.  No weird chemicals at all.  Corn was the predominant vegetable, but there was still a good amount of potato in there too.  The whole box is actually two servings, at 190 calories a serving.  I went ahead and ate the whole thing for lunch, but if you have a refrigerator nearby, the top of the container can be sealed up to save the other serving for another time.  Although it should be noted that the container is not microwavable.  The fat was high on this soup, 10 grams a serving, but at least it's probably healthy fat.  Sodium is also high at 700mg a serving, but as said before, it didn't really taste that salty.  There's even a few vitamins like calcium and Vitamin A in this meal too.I will definitely be getting this again and am eager to try out some of the other flavors by Pacific Natural. this tortilla has a really weird smell so I couldnt even eat it. It would have been great if it smelled better.

These are definitely not the best allsorts I've ever had - but they might be the cheapest.They are kinda bland. The bag looks beat up and the candies are dusty like the bag was shaken a lot and stored for too long. The textures aren't as good as I remember allsorts being.They are plenty sweet though.

column9: Not as fizzy as the smaller bottles, or the glass bottles
column10: I'm pretty much addicted to sparkling water. Perrier is my favorite because it has the highest fizz quotient. It is super bubbly compared to the other brands.However, for some reason the water in these 33 oz plastic bottles is only fizz-lite. I noticed that the caps don't seem to be on quite as tightly as the caps on the smaller bottles or on the glass bottles, so perhaps this is why. The other option is perhaps these just don't travel well and lose their fizz on the delivery truck. Either way, I cannot recommend the 33 oz plastic bottles of Perrier because they're missing their most vital, super fizz.The big glass ones are fine. We've bought those locally with no problems, and we buy the smaller bottles both locally and here on Amazon and they're all super-fizz. So if you're like me and want extra-fizzy, go with an alternate option rather than these 33 oz bottles.Summary: Not up to usual fizz levels, buy the little bottles or glass bottles instead.

Purchased item to fill a jar as a gift.  They came all stuck together as if they were previously melted.I'm sure they taste the same but as you can imagine...doesn't look appealing.I did talk to customer service and they did give me a refund.
Okay, we're talking about Milk Duds.  These are in a carton and they're for people like my who love Milk Duds and don't want a tiny package with only 12 Duds.

Sadly these arrived melted beyond recognition. I will NOT purchase again from this vendor. Either they are stored improperly or shipped improperly.i have now discarded ALL 6 of these boxes AND discovered that I can buy properly stored and shipped Milk Duds at a lower price.
If you like Indian spices and peanuts, you'll love these. You'll have to work hard on portion control because they aren't exactly healthy. But they are addictive good.

Very flavorful and gives amazing taste to salads and food in general. Just a pinch make a huge difference in the way your food tastes like.  This is the only type of salt I am using since I discovered it. I put it on meat, fish, veggies, salads, soups,etc. Everything tastes better with this salt. I wish they would offer it in bigger sizes. I usually order 4 at a time so they last for a while since the size is small. You will not be sorry for ordering this salt.

column9: Can produce very good soy milk
column10: I made soy milk, tofu and kinako (powdered roasted soybean) and all of them are very tasty. I will buy again when I use all I have now.Update061612:I did order again and would like to update something may be useful...The name of the beans I got was "Laura's SoyBean" both time.I could not find statement "organic" on the package etc, so I do NOT think this is organic.I am still enjoying the beans now.

I have used this product on multiple times and found it to be of high quality. I did notice being here in massachusetts in the winter I keep my house temperature at 69 degrees the beans produce the best soy milk when left to soak for 2 days in cold water. I would purchase again
Beans arrived very quickly, properly packaged, in excellent condition.  I have been using them to make soy milk for a couple of weeks now and they are great.  I am very happy with this purchase.

column9: These beans are tasty and ORG / non-GMO is important.
column10: I ordered a big can of these beans in order to make natto at home.  They are medium sized, tasty soybeans.  Organic and non-GMO is important to me and it can be difficult to source beans that have a high standard of purity and quality locally.

I purchased these a few months ago and while the packaging was excellent and the beans came in a timely manner, I've noticed something strange. When I rinse these beans off, there is a chlorine-ish smell and soaplike bubbles are created on top of the rinsing water. These bubbles are easy to skim off but I'm left wondering where these bubbles are coming from. After two or three rinsing the bubbles stop. The milk resulting from these beans tastes excellent, I'm just a little concerned what these bubbles could be and what residues are on the beans.

If you love French roast coffee, then you may like Hula Girl more than I did. My position is that if you want a single region coffee, and are willing to pay a bit more, you should have a roast that lets the unique quality of the bean shine, not one that buries it in the aroma of charcoal. This really could be any bean, as far as flavor goes once the coal black roast is finished. Buy a French roast or a Sumatra and save yourself a couple bucks.
This is an excellent cheese ball, easy to make. Delicious with animal crackers or graham crackers.
This is a wonderful candy, not to sweet, you can taste the raspberry flavor unlike some candy where it is sickening sweet.  I thought these were great A+++

I prefer the taste of this Soy Drink on cereal in the morning! It's the best in my opinion. I use it in every recipe that calls for milk. It does tend to make mashed potatoes taste like Vanilla, but I can live with that. When my co-ops stopped stocking this particular flavor/brand I panicked, but I found it on Amazon and have been very happy, especially since I order a couple of cases at a time. Amazon delivers this quickly, and I have never had a problem with their service.

This is an excellent, easy-to-make sidedish for chicken with a slightly nutty and tangy flavor.  (The sesame is balanced with the ginger.)  It is also a nice starter for a quick chicken dish with an Asian flair...think bite-sized chicken pieces with thinly sliced vegetables, briefly sauteed, on a warm bed of rice.

It took some time to find a "classy" cat stocking, but I'm so glad I kept looking!  The mice are nicely detailed, but not overwhelming, and the fabric is a pretty shimmery white.  A nice change from the typical stockings with a generic cat picture on them.  A great choice for a kitty who is a family member, not just a pet.

I absolutely love this kitty stocking.  I visited several sites looking for something unique for my new "grandkitty".  I wanted something different from the run of the mill stockings--not red or green.  This was the perfect find.  The embroidery mice really give it a unique flavor and the price was right. column9: "Redbarn chicken jerky items are manufactured in a Chinese plant"

This is the smoothest, most delicious, and richest tasting chocolate powder I've had so far. I love chocolate, so I'm always comparing. I thought Green & Black's was the best until I tasted this one. But Green & Blacks gave me a caffeine buzz that kept me up all night and this one did not. I learned there is a chemical difference between processed and raw chocolate. Raw chocolate is actually healthy... and FAR more healthy than processed cocolate. It's full of calcium, magnesium, and is actually a nutritionally complete food with little to no caffeine because it is not processed the same way as conventional chocolate or cacao powder. I love this raw organic cacao powder and am buying more today!
We made raw chocolate truffles with this product and the results were outstanding.  Ours were just as good as those selling for a small fortune at our local health food store.
I used this product to make a raw chocolate cake - it great!Very rich flavor

column10: I had been using Raw Cacao Powder - 5 oz - Powder but then I tried the Pacari Cacao powder from RawFoodWorld and this is so much better.  The flavor is so much more powerful that I have to cut back on the amount of chocolate I add or it is overpowering.Here's a tip for any chocolate/cacao recipe, always add a pinch of himalayan salt and vanilla to optimize the chocolate flavor; you'll be so glad you did!  : )  Take it from a chocoholic.

Hands down, this is the best cacao I've ever tried - smooth and flavorful, with no chalky after-taste.  Spend the extra money on this and don't even bother with the brown stuff in the can at the grocery store.

I have tried several raw cacao powders from different companies and this one was the worst. When mixed with moisture it becomes like mud. It was impossible to get a smooth dessert or cream using this powder and the flavor seems muted as though the intense chocolate flavor is missing. It was also more expensive than the other brands I tried. I won't order this product again. Very disappointed.

I could actually eat this cocoa powder dry -- it's that smooth and silky!  This raw cocoa is not de-fatted like the stuff in the grocery store, so it tastes silky.  It's bittersweet, but not acrid like dutch process cocoa stuff.  Lovely!
I love this product. It is a great price also. I will continue to order this chocolate.

It's grainy and lacking in real cacao taste - instead it has some nasty after-taste that's really intolerable. I absolutely love this tea. It is smooth and complex; a nice mix of earl grey and jasmine teas. Even members of my family who don't like tea love this with some cream and sugar. Enjoy.

I looked forward to receiving this tea and my wait was not in vain. The tea is smooth and perfect for an afternoon tea. I surely will be ordering more of this brand and the other flavors listed. It does not have the bitter taste most store bought teas have.

Good flavor & they actually make a swirl pattern in the bread.  I'm still not able to reproduce the cinnamon burst bread in my bread machine, but I like the cinnamon bread anyway. (It just doesn't have the bursts in it.) I tried the chips as well as ground cinnamon, but it affected the yeast.  So now I just use the chips & no ground cinnamon.  The flavor is the same & the bread rises better.

Instead, I set my machine to dough setting & after it has risen, I roll it out & sprinkle these on top, then roll it up for a loaf.  Turned out very yummy without the melting problem.  Very tasty!

They are not waxy like the ones you can buy from the grocery store. You have to think ahead though because they won't ship these during the summer months. My pantry will never be without them!

Excellent product in Gift presentable packaging!  This Gift package has something for everyone!  Herbal teas, flavored teas, and Decafienated teas, all with the most appealing aromas!  You won't be sorry giving or recieving this collection!

VERY good broth. I took a pouch for my mom to try and she couldn't get over how much it tasted like how her mom's chicken soup broth... I bought this without tasting it first and am very pleased.
This is the best broth I have ever tasted. It's as good as homemade and a lot easier to make.  I can't wait to try the the beef broth.

column9: The saltiest sock I've ever made soup from
column10: Looking at the reviews here you'd think these were straight out of Star Trek- just put the packet in the inflate-a-lator 4000 and out pops a chicken.Kidding aside I *really* wanted to love this product. I typically use canned broth or make my own from scratch, a time consuming process. Savory Choice Chicken Broth Concentrate is not vile by any means but has what I can only describe as a "sweaty sock" taste to it. I've tried to adapt to it but keep coming to the conclusion that my palate simply finds it offensive. The sodium content is also outrageous: one packet, equivalent to 1 cup of broth contains 770mg of salt- ouch.I'd still consider this in a pinch instead of a bullion cube but it's not as good as canned broth.

column9: Blind taste test confirms it: This is insanely good!
column10: Chicken stock from little gel-filled concentrate packets sounded too good to be true, but after reading all the positive reviews for Savory Choice Chicken Broth I decided to throw caution to the wind and give it a try.Mixing a cup of hot water with one packet revealed an enticing aroma and a beautiful chickeny-beige color stock. The taste was phenomenal: enough lip-smacking gelatin to give it body but it also had rich depth and a full flavor profile that screamed "CHICKEN".I pitted Savory Choice against my own broth (long simmered carcasses with fully intact wings and plenty of meat and connectives, carrot, onion, celery, and bay, de-fatted overnight and re-heated to a simmer), as well as Swanson Organic. Amongst my family (admittedly, a too-small statistical sample), the Savory Choice beat the Swanson easily, but surprisingly it also edged out my home-made broth.Combine that extraordinary flavor with amazing shelf-convenience and you got a winner. I'm a total convert!

column9: Not for everyone, but for me!
column10: Having read the other reviews, and having talked to my mother, I feel the need to share my own experience.  I absolutely LOVE this broth.  I find it far, far superior to bouillon cubes in flavor (more on the salt content in a bit).  I rarely eat it on its own however, and I probably wouldn't use it as a base for chicken soup, for which I make homemade broth.  I do enjoy it on its own, but the salt content is high.What this product is ideal for is when you have a recipe that calls for a few cups of broth - risotto, saute, couscous, etc, etc, etc.  When I use it I usually omit any other salt my recipe calls for, and the saltiness of the final dish comes out perfectly.I noticed some of the less than positive reviews don't like the taste of the broth by itself.  I will say, the flavor is very different than many/most store bought stocks and bouillon cubes.  It is very rich and meaty, and tastes like a roasted chicken, WITHOUT vegetables or spices other than salt.  This is just pure chicken flavor, and some may be off put by that -- my mother for instance isn't a big fan - she likes her chicken stock to be very vegetabley.So, if you like a full, meaty chicken (and only chicken) stock, I highly recommend this.  If you want something with more vegetable flavor, look elsewhere.  Personally, I love it.

to using bouillon cubes once you've used and tasted this great product.You'll also wonder why you've been taking pantry space for years with cartons and cans. column9: Has Maltodextrin - Avoid if You are Human
column10: I was diagnosed with type 2 diabetes in January 2012. I managed to reduce my A1C from 11.7 to 6.5 in three months.Right after I was diagnosed, I was getting NOWHERE. I couldn't figure out why my blood sugar would frequently shoot up to over 200 at times even though I was avoiding carbs and sugar. I would feel terrible when my blood sugar jumped like that and my vision would get blurry. It was extremely scary.Due to the meds I was taking, I was having some gastric distress so my physician put me on a liquid diet that consisted of sugar free jello, low sodium, MSG free chicken broth and water. Still my blood sugar would frequently shoot up to almost 200. I thought it had to be that my blood sugar meter was not working correctly. During this time, I had to have another lab test so when I went to the lab I asked them to test my blood sugar using an actual lab work up and at the same time I would test using my meter.The lab test showed my sugar as 186 and my meter said 183. The head of the lab said that's very accurate for a home meter. By this time I'd been on that liquid diet for almost 2 days so my blood sugar shouldn't have been fluctuating like it was and if anything, due to the medication I take, it should have been on the low side.I later found out it was from the sugar free jello I was eating. Though it says on the nutrition info that it has zero sugar and zero carbs, the reality is that it's full of maltodextrin and because of the way the law reads, food producers don't have to list maltodextrin on the nutrition information, they only have to put it in the list of ingredients.If you look at the label on Splenda (the kind that measures like sugar) you will see that the first ingredient listed is maltodextrin which is a filler product. It can be made from grain but is generally made from corn and it reacts every bit as strongly on the pancreas as table sugar and white bread.As per my endocrinologist those with diabetes, pre-diabetes and a family history of diabetes should avoid maltodextrin. It's hard on your pancreas and even if you are not prone to diabetes but are dieting, ingesting maltodextrin adversely affects appetite because it reacts so strongly on the pancreas. If you eat something sugar free and notice that you are soon very hungry after, it's from the maltodextrin that's most likely in the product as it's added frequently to sugar free things.My endocrinologist said to avoid sugar and maltodextrin but he said if you can't help yourself and feel you must eat something with either one of those in it then choose the one with table sugar because it's effect will be shorter term and less strong on your body than the maltodextrin.I wish I'd have known this before I was diagnosed with diabetes and maybe I could have avoided it or at least held it off longer.There are chicken flavorings out there that don't include maltodextrin. Buy one of those instead.

This is the next best thing to homemade chicken broth.  I've used this product to make soups, risotto and heighten the taste of gravy.  You may want to use a bit less water than is called for in the instructions
this is just the best broth ever.  it disolves in no time, making it a great quick addition or fix for a dish that is a little blah.  and it tastes great!
This product, as well as the beef broth, tastes so much fresher than canned broths and smells better too.  Another great advantage is that it takes up so much less room in the pantry.
I don't like any chicken concentrates but this is the best one and I like to have it on hand for when it is called for in recipes.

column9: Incredibly convenient, especially when cooking for small number
column10: Surprisingly good broth, even if not made from scratch!  It's weird because it comes in a tube and you squeeze it out, but once you mix it with water, you'll see.  I love that each packet = 1 cup of broth because when you're only cooking for 1 or 2 people, you just don't use enough broth.  I used to buy boxed broth but it was expensive to get the ones without MSG and I ended up not using it all before it spoiled.  With this stuff, there's no worry about spoilage.
I have tried countless different chicken flavorings such as bouillon, canned broth, every brand I can find but this IS the best.  A true natural chicken flavor.

The best I have ever found! Great chicken flavor with the convenience of a small box full of small packets filled with concentrate. Each packet makes one cup of broth - or use it undiluted to enrich the flavor of any sauce or gravy. It's a bit pricey, but well worth it.
The only better broth I've had was homemade by my hubby! My daughter will even heat it for a quick snack, I love it!

This is the most delicious chicken broth I have ever tasted in my life--addictive! It smells heavenly and tastes just like it smells--you know how sometimes you're disappointed by the lack of taste to back up an enticing aroma. These are great. Just enough spice to savor the flavor and not ruin the taste. Put them in a bowl and microwave for two minutes. BAM! You're ready to rock.

column9: Best morning tea, with great flavor, and no jitters
column10: I have appreciated this tea for over 20 years now, but I have been having a very hard time finding this product for a very long time.It is no trouble finding Celestial Seasonings brand at grocery stores and other places that sell tea bags, but it is a terrible time finding this fine quality tea. If you want it, I have found it difficult to even have the grocery store get it from their suppliers (some grocery stores don't usually buy direct from the manufacturer, but from a grocery supply wholesale companies).Morning Thunder Tea is based on the South American Mate that is drunk in a way that is not easily understood in North America. With regular Mate (I am NOT now describing this product and how it is used as Morning Thunder comes in a regular tea bag) you pour hot water over the unbagged "tea" mix in a gourd cup and then sip the "tea" through a silver straw that has a strainer at the end and you keep adding hot water to the cup for a long time. The "tea" mixture is not used up and can make quite a bit of tea over and over from the same teaspoonful of "tea."This flavor of Morning Thunder contains Mate and blend of black tea in a convenient tea bag in just the right mix. A very flavorful, in my opinion, basic tea. Notice I use the word tea without quotes, as the mate is not a real tea as per definition, but black tea is.Having had a hard time finding this certain tea, I have purchased a plain mate and mixed it with loose leaf Lipton Black Tea for a similar result but certainly not as good a mix and it is far less convenient than this product in a simple tea bag with no string attached.As far as the tea itself, it seems to have a very nice flavor and it gives you the stimulation in the morning without the jitters. It is a nice start to the day. A good alternative to strong coffee. Overall, I love this product and hope that Celestial Seasonings doesn't decide to discontinue since it doesn't seem to be a very well stocked item in most places. I highly recommend it.

We spent a few weeks in Morocco last year and bought ras el hanout in six different places--in Fez, Marrakesh, Rabat, and Meknes, at spice stands and supermarkets. The name means "head of the shop"--it's a blend of up to 100 spices and every place has a slightly different formula. With all six, we got a mild, aromatic, subtly perfumy seasoning with a tremendous depth of flavor. We love it on steamed lamb shanks. It has an outstanding affinity for whole roast chicken: brush melted butter all over the chicken, then coat generously with ras el hanout and a little salt and pepper. Roast at 365° for 1 hour and 45 minutes, turning it over after the first hour. Fabulous! Ras el hanout is about the same color as cumin. (See the article in Wikipedia for info on the main ingredients.)We were sorry to find out that this product is nothing like the real deal. We bought it because our Morocco stash is running out. It looks and tastes like ordinary curry powder, including a fair amount of hot chili pepper, not at all like ras el hanout. We threw it out. Don't waste your money.

All in all, an oil I would buy again for taste and safety!

column10: I started using quinoa as part of healthier eating plan. In calories it is similar to brown rice but with a lower glycemic index. It contains all nine essential amino acids, making it a complete protein.I like eating it in different ways:1)  A like quinoa as a side dish. It takes sauces very well.2) I  like it cold to add bulk to the salad.  My favorite is to mix it with spinach with tangy dressing.3) I like as a home-made cereal in the morning. I add frozen fresh berries which I defrost in the microwave just until they are slightly warm.4) Quinoa has fiber to bulk up stool, and phosphorus to stimulate bowel movement. If you combine it with prunes as your morning cereal you get a real cleansing effect!Here is my favorite recipe for this treat - tasty and effective.1 cup of water1/2 cup quinoa1 pinch of nutmeg1 tsp graded ginger1/3 cup of chopped prunes1/4 cup rice milkBring the water, quinoa, nutmeg and ginger to boil. Reduce heat and simmer covered for 10 minutes.  Then stir in the prunes and rice milk. Cover again and cook for 5 more minutes.Quinoa naturally grows with a bitter layer of saponins, to remove the bitter test Quinoa is pre-washed before packaging to remove the bitter shell. I was pleased with Ancient Harvest quality, I did not detect any bitterness in their quinoa.Amazon deal on the 12 box of quinoa is very good but you get a lot!  If you are thinking of trying it for the first time I recommend trying one box at a more expensive price to see if you like and if you like it go with the 12 box size order. I have bought different versions of Quinoa at a local Trader Joe's and Whole Foods at about $4 a box.Ali Julia review

Quinoa cooks rather quickly and easily; it is tasty and there are many recipes, ways to fix it, and ways to season it; it is healthy, has lots of protein and iron; and I have heard that it is a "wise old grain".1) Quinoa cooks rather quickly and easily.  From what I've read, the harvesters or processors have to remove an outer bitter "shell" from it and wash the Quinoa really good.  Therefore, I guess it looks as if they do most of the work; all we have to do is cook and eat it!  And it only takes about 15-20 minutes to cook, which isn't bad at all.2) It is tasty.  There are many recipes and ways to fix it.  It can be eaten hot (as a side dish or as a cereal), or cold as a salad.  There are many ways in which it can be seasoned.  At the natural store, I ate some quinoa that was cold (in the form of a "salad"), it was seasoned with mustard (and I'm sure other seasonings as well); the mustard could be tasted and made it really tasty!  I mentioned it could be eaten hot as a side dish - it can also be eaten hot as a main dish.3) It is healthy.  It has lots of protein and iron.  You can the nutritional facts and see how healthy it is.  It is also considered a "complete protein", which is very uncommon among the plant foods.4) I have heard that it is a "wise old grain".  I know that it is several thousands of years old.  I have heard that it has a natural resistance against pests (which I guess means no pesticides are needed).  I would like to find a good, informative book about Quinoa and read about it, as I have heard that it is a wondrous food.I could be wrong, but I don't think it is something you can grow in your own back yard.  I think it has to have a certain type of climate, from what I remember reading about it.Anyway, this particular brand, Ancient Harvest, has good Quinoa; I've had no problems with it.  I plan to look and see what other products this particular brand has to offer.

If you have not tried this product, you should.  It is a perfect protein, tastes great and the most important thing is this brand has already been pre-washed and rinsed.  We purchased another brand that wasn't pre-washed or rinsed and it kind of tasted like soap....Ancient Harvest does a perfect rinsing job and it tastes delicious.  I usually mix it with some elk or deer [lean hamburger would work great also], fresh and canned diced tomato, onion, brown rice and black beans.  One box makes ALOT and my neighbors are also enjoying the large portions that it makes.

I've been through many boxes of Ancient Harvest Quinoa, since I love quinoa and for a long time this was the only brand I could find. It suffers from two main problems.First, quinoa naturally grows with a layer of saponins, which are bitter and indigestible. Most brands of quinoa, including Ancient Harvest, are pre-washed to remove the saponins. However, Ancient Harvest doesn't do a very good job. Unless you rinse the grains even more, they'll still taste bitter. (If you cook it in a lot of water, as you would pasta, it's okay. But cooking it like rice requires more washing.)Second, and much worse, Ancient Harvest does a terrible job of sorting their grains. Every bag has little pieces of stem or other detritus. Even if you spend a bunch of time picking through the grains (and who wants to do that?), expect a couple of unpleasantly crunchy mouthfuls as you bite into a twig. This makes it unsuitable to serve to company, unless you like embarrassment.There are better brands out there that don't have these problems. I'd recommend Bob's Red Mill, which so far has had consistently good quality.

I loved quinoa once I tried it, and it works great with so many foods from veggies to fruits and meats. Just making it early in a week, and dinners are so quickly done with left-over foods. It is a great way to add protein to a meal, and I like it better than rice or pasta for casseroles. Purchasing this case means I will always have it available. These boxes are easier to store than the bags that some stores carry. I just wish I had known about this great food years ago!

I found it tastier than other brands.

column9: My Husband Swears That This Muesli Helped Him Win a 5K Race!

If you don't like #3, just try a couple others, you're bound to find one you love. I also love that it's all natural. Take my word - no american brands compare!!!
