I'd rather eat WHAT I want in smaller portions than this substitute junk ever again. Can I have my $3 back?It's not that it tasted bad, there really wasn't any flavor. The liquid it's in IS fishy but I rinsed it several times in warm and cold water. I also boiled it for 3 minutes.It's the texture. It was gelatinous. It was firm yet squishy in the middle. I managed to swallow it down. My mother spit it out instantly. My aunt also swallowed it.It's "interesting" and I'm definitely not hooked on this product. This is strike 3 for HG, really. The VitaTops aren't worth what you pay, although they are OK and most of the flavors are good. However, the shipping is ridiculous. Her "buffalo" wings reminded me nothing of the buffalo wings I get.Buy whole wheat or whole grain noodles instead. Just eat a smaller portion.
i was so excited to try this, as it was recommended by Hungrygirl.com....i'd rather starve than eat this again. This goes down as one of the most disgusting "foods" i've ever had in my life.

Yuck, yuck and yuck. I did not approve of these "noodles".  Smelled awful and the texture was chewy and tough...really disgusting.  Did not matter what type of sauce or soup I put them in, they were still gross.  I wasted my money on a 20 pack and expensive shipping.

I am glad that Amazon carries this product. I am addicted to it!  I do not drink cow's milk and I  was drinking either soy milk or rice milk.  However, concerned about my cholesterol I switched to oat milk.  Not only is it delicious and naturally sweet and creamy, my cholesterol numbers are showing that it is helping getting them down.  With the monthly automatic delivery from Amazon, I always have a good supply at hand.

I'm a vegetarian slowly cutting dairy out of my diet and milk and cheese has been a hard one for me to get away from. I hate the after-taste of soy milk, rice milk didn't do it for me either. I'm allergic to almonds so almond milk is right out, and hemp milk was just "ok" - but only the vanilla flavor, and never by itself in a glass...I picked some of this up at my local grocery store and have been buying it regularly since! It is good enough to drink by the (large) glassful and EVERYONE I've had try it has been surprised at how good it is. My meat-eating-dairy-loving co-worker said "I think this tastes BETTER than milk!" And she has bought some for her own family. Her grand-daughter pointed out the similarity between oat milk and the left over milk in a bowl of sweetened cereal. It isn't QUITE that sweet, but I can recognize what she was talking about.If you're looking for a milk alternative that actually tastes GOOD, I highly recommend you give this a shot.  I wasn't kidding with my title. I poured a little for my cats out of curiosity and they lapped it up like you wouldn't believe.

With a toddler who is dairy, soy, and nut sensitive. Oat milk has been a great discovery. She loves both the original and vanilla flavors. And Oat milk has at least 4x more protein per serving than the rice or coconut milks i have found.  But I do have to agree with the other reviews the prices here are high. I never have paid more than $2.70 at the local natural grocery store.
This is a great milk like product my baby loves it.  But this price is outrageous.  You can get it for about $2 to $2.50 at King Sooopers, Vitamin Cottage, or Whole Foods.

This is a great alternative... it feels more like whole milk and tastes like oatmeal.  I prefer the vanilla flavored one but they don't sell it on Amazon, at least as of now.Shipping from these sellers is crazy.  If you have a local Whole Foods, just buy it there for about three bucks each.
The title says it all, this is a great addition to any meat that goes on the grill. Makes it much easier to keep up with all the lies being told by your friends while you're cooking ! ! !

My mom wanted to try it in her cooking based on a friend recommendation. I'm writing the review because I liked the price and the big size jars compared to what they look like in the photo. There are 4 jars, each is about the length of my hand. I hope it taste good though!

Although these spices are commonly available in most supermarkets, the Dean Jacobs "Blends" are out of this world!  I can't seem to duplicate them.  Sometimes I use as a dry rub (rub it in well) on steaks, and I sometimes use when making up meat for burgers.  Depending on your tastes, there's a spice for everyone in the Dean Jacobs' line.  Great for chicken or pork as well.I was bummed when we first ran out because we originally found it in the seasonal aisle of one of those large retail "Pharmacies" that sell a little bit of everything.  However, my daughter checked Amazon, and once again, they've come through for us!  We're sold!
My wife and I love Snappy popcorn-we've yet to find better.  My kids love it also-they asked me where I got it.
This was delicious. I have Japanese Curry when I go to LA all the time but this is the next best thing. The only problem I have is $6 shipping--$6? How is it coming by Next Day Air? Jeez!
While this product is easy to use, the taste is inferior to the original seasoning brick.  If you want easy, use this product.  If you want better flavor, use the original.

column9: Betty Crocker Angel Food Cake mix
column10: I made this for a BBQ last year and it was great. I haven't tried to make it homemade, but looking at the recipes I see that you need 12 egg whites... which would be tedious and expensive. Why waste time and money when the cake mix does the job? Amazon has this at a great price too, I think one box is about $2 at the stores where I live.

I don't think I will EVER make another Angel Food cake from "scratch".  These aren't quite the same (nothing beats a "scratch" cake) but for the price, this mix makes a wonderful dessert.  I made up a pretty dessert with chunks of this cake, fresh strawberries & blueberries and Cool Whip mixed with crushed pineapple and French Vanilla instant pudding.  Layered everything into pretty footed clear glasses.  Lovely and oh so good.  Also tried it drizzled with Carmel ice cream topping..very good.  Good just plain as well.  Soooooooooooo easy.  I have a little trouble getting it out of my pan, but I think because it's an "antique" should buy a new one :-)  Recommend this product.  Much cheaper than in the store WHEN you can find it there, even when it's on sale.

Using the Betty Crocker Angel Food cake mix is cheap and easy. The mix almost guarantees a 100% success rate of baking a light and tasty cake. To make baking the cake even easier try purchasing and using the Calphalon angel food cake pan sold at Amazon. The cake pan is easy to clean and bakes up a light golden cake.

column9: Best in taste testing - all the kids loved the cupcakes!
column10: I spent several days trying recipes for angel food cake from scratch, separating out and whipping egg whites, sifting confectioners sugar, sifting flour, adding vanilla extract, etc.  We did 2 different recipes, then a batch of cupcakes using Betty Crocker cake mix, and Betty Crocker was the best.  Wow, what a time saver.  I still don't know how they did it, and how the mix could be better but it was.  All the kids at my daughter's 3rd birthday - 30 of them gobbled them down fast.  I put a small pool of fudge icing in middle on top with sprinkles for decoration.  I was worried a little, as each cupcake looked different and not identical at all, but kids didn't seem to mind.  It melts in your mouth!  Delicious mix.  Now I know not to waste my time with home-made.  Other moms advised me of this before saying they use cake mixes, but I didn't understand until now.

column9: Delicious Angel Food Cake- Fat Free, Fast, and Easy
column10: I bought a case of the Betty Crocker Angel Food Cake on Amazon.com grocery. The price was cheap, the shipping was free, and the cake is easy to make (you just add 1 1/4 cups of water to the mix). What more could you want for a fat free snack? Right after I take the cake out of the oven, I like to put it upside down on a wine bottle (just like my mother used to do!) and pull off and nibble little hunks of the sweet crust part while it cools. Sigh!
The Betty Crocker Angel Food Cake Mix was an excellent buy.  The price was great and the delivery excellent.  Recommend this product and Amazon.Patricia Tubb

column9: Allergens Must be listed about each food item
column10: I was extremely dismayed when I received the product only to read on the label that it contains WHEAT starch as well as honey. I was looking forward to using the powered form for baking and being allergic to wheat and other gluten products I can't use this. Also it cannot be returned due to some kind of laws about food products. PLEASE, Amazon and all sellers LIST allergens on the description of your product for the thousands of us who have food allergies.

After receiving a very timely shipment I also was very dismayed to find out that I cannot use this honey powder because it contains wheat.  I had specifically checked the ingredients before purchasing; saying it is powdered honey is not accurate -- that's not the only ingredient!

I ordered this SO CALLED Honey Powder from BARRY FARMS ~ it is a FRAUD !! It is not HONEY POWDER.  It isWHEAT with something else mixed with it.  It does not dissolve, it DOES NOT have HONEY in the mix.  On topof their frauding the public, they make sure you cannot return it and get a refund.  They should bereported for the fraudelent manner they are operating.I THREW  both bags in the trash.

I bought this product to use in my tea. I normaly buy Honey granuals, but I decided to try this product instead. I used two teaspoons in my tea. What I got was no sweetness at all, no honey taste at all, and a load of sludge in the bottom of my cup, that when I accidently got a mouthful of it tasted like old cardboard. It was absolutly disgusting. To make it worse after I put it in my tea, I mixed it with the rest of my honey granuals in my container, so now I have to throw it all away. This product is straight up disgusting. DONT WASTE YOUR MONEY!!!!
Don't surprised if they mess up your order, then give YOU a hard time about it.

I bought this as a gift so I have not tried it. But it was delivered in an extremely timely manner and came packaged as pictured. The shipping was a little steep and I would not spend on a regular bases.

I have not tried the product yet but I was pleased with the Shipping I had received, we will be using the powder in coffee, Hot teas and cooking, so for now it is tucked into my Food Storage ! I didn't give 5 stars due to not having tried the item yet ! but we will this weekend.

column9: Don't ask me why it's so good
column10: Yeah, this stuff is amazingly tasty. I don't know why it beats other pancake mixes like it does, but it does. The consistency is perfect, with a kind of vanilla finish on the palate. My wife turned me on to Snoqualmie, but it's only available widely out West. If you're trapped back East, mail order is the only way, it seems, and hoo-wee are the prices steep for pancake mix... But when you've found the right thing, well, you know what to do.

Like other Snowqualmie Falls products, this one is of high quality.  The Nurta Rich variety of pancake mix isn't as sweet as Snowqualmie original mix and tastes "healthier" than their regular pancake mix, but is still delicious.  With AMAZON free shipping on larger orders, it is cheaper than from the Snowqualmie Falls website.

This mix produces pancakes that have a great taste and texture. Although "Nutra Rich" makes the product sound very healthy, it actually contains one ingredient that is dangerous: partially hydrogenated oil. Partially hydrogenated oil contains trans fat, which greatly increases the risk of coronary heart disease for anyone who consumes it. It is estimated that between 30,000 and 100,000 cardiac deaths per year in the United States can be attributed to the consumption of trans fat. In addition, the consumption of trans fat has been linked to obesity, Alzheimer's Disease, liver dysfunction, infertility, and depression. Don't assume that a product is healthy just because it is marketed as such. Read the ingredient list carefully. If the manufacturer would omit the partially hydrogenated oil, I would definitely be a repeat customer. Until that happens, I'll never buy the product again.

LOVE THIS STUFF!  We used to live in Seattle and since moving to Atlanta cannot find this anywhere except online.  It is not cheap.  It isnt cheap in Seattle either.  But the flavor and themakeup of this mix is not to be matched anywhere.  There is simply not anything else like it anywhere.  I am a diabetic and because of the buckwheat and other whole grains in this mix - I can eat pancakes.  My family loves it too.
not sure what it is, but this pancake mix is the best.  Well worth the price.  don't believe the bad reviews

THIS MIX WAS NOT AS EXPECTED, FOR I THOUGHT I WAS BUYING THE 'ORIGINAL' MIX WHICH IS EXCELLENT...THIS MIX WAS SATISFACTORY, BUT NOT NEARLY AS GOOD AS THE ORIGINAL...LOOK FOR THAT ONE AND YOU WON'T BE DISAPPOINTED

This coffee filter works very well. The instructions are easy to follow and it makes a great cup of coffee. Some of the metal parts seem thinner than they could be but I believe with reasonable care it will last a long time.

I remain unimpressed and still waiting for the product to be delivered as a Christmas gift to my elderly parents.  While I paid for an expedited delivery date ($22.00)  the product remains stagnated in Maumee, Ohio (Toledo).  The commitment was for this product to arrive on the 21st or 22nd.  It now will not likely appear until the 27th.  I would not re-order from this vendor, World Wide Alaska Smokehouse Leila Bay Gift BasketGourmet foods.I guess I can wait until the Spring and drive up to see the Mud Hens play.  Unimpressed!

My wife heard about this ramen a couple weeks ago, and we picked up a box based upon the rave reviews in Korea.  It's ok - not great, not bad - but certainly not worth the premium over Nong Shim's Neogori or Kimchi Ramens.Taste:no strong chicken taste, no strong spicy smell.  The ramen is spicy, but more like a jalepeno spicy instead of a kimchi ramen spicy.  The difference is in the...sharpness...if that makes any sense.  Other ramens have a low and nice hot burn, this one has a quick hot burn.Noodles are ok - nothing particularily special.Basically, I think people wanted a ramen where you don't smell too much after you eat it.  This delivers.  You can easily eat this, have a beer, and noone would probably notice - no dragon breath.  If that's what you're looking for, then this will fit the bill.  No exceptional taste, but nothing which will repulse people if you go to a public place later.Would I order this again?  Probably not.  Personally, if I want ramen, I want something with powerful flavor, because I'm not going anywhere after I eat it.

This pancake mix is totally awesome.  I'm not a big pancake eater because I try to watch my diet and stick to eating healthy stuff. You cant go wrong with this mix.  It is good for you and you don't get that full weighed down feeling after you eat it.  In so far as taste, it cant be beat.  The pancakes are fluffy and very tasty, not grainy or anything else you may expect from a 10 grain product.  Also, I can mix up a batch and store the left over in the refrigerator for a few days if I don't cook them all the same day.  All in all I am very satisfied with the bobs red mill products and especially this pancake mix.  It will become a staple in my home.  Lastly, although I ordered on line I found that many stores around my area sell this product so you may want to check your local grocery to avoid shipping charges.

Bought this first at Costco, my Costco no longer stocks it -- I usually make all my own soups, but find this a convenient addition if I'm out of potatoes or want to thicken some gravy.  Wouldn't use it as is out of the container -- too salty.

My husband bought this at our local Costco and I have to admit I turned up my nose.  But then I prepared it and wow was it good.  I use this as a base for corn chowder and have also added shrimp and chicken.  Always quick and always tasty.

column9: Excellent, if you can actually get some
column10: I used to get this product at Costco in California. Now, in Kentucky, I was happy to find it at Amazon. However, it is not always available, even when Amazon states there are x number of cans available. Best, if you can, to buy several cans to have some in storage if you really like the stuff as much as I do. And besides, it is a supersaver on shipping after the $25 minimum!

I was not a new customer to Inn on the Creek, having ordered potato soup mixes, cheese/broccoli soup mixes and assorted pasta mixes from them often in the past 5 years.  I always considered their products superior in taste and quality.  However, when I received these (several) potato soup mixes, I was disappointed in the taste, quality and amount. The cans were about half full and the potatoes were skimpy.  I use their soup mixes as a base for larger soups and found these so different from what I have received in the past.  To top it all off, when I went to Costco shortly after receiving these, I noticed the price was very much lower for the very same product, same can, etc. than what I paid for the product and shipping.  Very disappointed.

I bought this soup recently at Costco.  You get 24 servings, so as long as you're paying less than $20.00 for it, you're getting a great deal!!  I highly recommend it and it's so versatile that you could easily add extra to the soup... For instance, next time I make some I will be adding some diced cooked potatoes and some more onions and some other kind of cheese as well.  They'd be better off making it a 3-4 cheesy potato soup.  No matter the extras though... if you're pressed for time, you'll be mighty surprised with it.

I used this product for a wedding cake and it turned out fabulously. No one could believe I started with a cake mix. I did add almond and butter flavoring to the mix, and it really was delicious when baked.

I used this for my cupcakes for my cake decorating class. I wasn't disappointed, it's inexpensive and makes a really nice fluffy cake. I really liked the flavor in this one. It doesn't come through as a cake mix, it's a really nice rich vanilla flavor. Sometimes I add an extra 1/2 teaspoon of vanilla extract to make the flavor really pop
this is a perfect vanilla cake I like it better than just a yellow good alternative to a classic white cake!

column9: Nice hazelnut flavor. Works in Melitta One-to-One
column10: I own a Melitta One-to-One single-serving coffee maker and purchased several flavors of Java Podz in order to have more flavors available than the limited range offered by Melitta.This hazelnut pod produces a full-bodied cup of coffee with a distinctive hazelnut flavor that is, perhaps, a little stronger than the Mellita version.Java Podz are apparently intended for the Senseo coffee maker and other models that use a larger-diameter pod.  I had successfully used Senseo pods in my Melitta in the past by carefully compressing and shaping the pod with my fingers as I place it in the Melitta pod holder.  The Java Podz, however, appear to have a little more ground coffee in each pod than the Senseo, so it takes a little more care to get it to fit completely in the pod holder.  (The Java Podz is about the same weight as a Mellita pod, but is larger in diameter.)  The Java Podz work well in the Melitta most of the time, with only an occasional small leak if I haven't positioned the pod just right.

I placed an order with you on 4-11-05.  that was 11 days ago. Tracking only showed it traveling around the United States but not to my state.  Now Amazon says there was no order.  You have my money debited from my checking account. I plan to repeat negative reviews as long as it takes.

Hazlenut from JavaPodzWe kicked off our pod tasting with the Hazlenut 10gram pod. A breaking open of the foil revealed a nice hazle nose, and we put it into the Senseo and pushed the double cup button.The "crema" was pretty thick as it brewed, and the coffee appeared to have a nice dark color. We got a nice strong aroma of coffee and preceded to add some milk (1%) and sugar.- good flavor- a nice cup of coffee.

I hate sport drinks. This one is different. It is beyond awesome. The taste is fantastic. The only way to buy it is by the case. Or it is very expensive. it is not cheap, but worth it.I used to drink 6 to 12 diet cokes a day, no more.
I usually don't like Sportsdrinks... Gatorade's okay... but this one, I love the taste... no sugar, I miss the taste already
Not a success at my house.  A gimmick to say the least.  The flavor is to sweet and there is way too much citric acid in it.  I purchased a case from Amazon, but will give it away.
I have been buying Activate for almost a year!  I usually drink at least 3 bottles a day.Berry, Orange, and Fruit punch are my favorite!
Very tasty-a friend recommended it to me and I bought twelve pounds.  My family loves it.

Charlee Bears are small and low calorie, so you can use them en masse for training.  We use them both for standard training (sit, stay, drop it, leave it) and behavioral training (no bark).  They're not stinky or messy, so you can put them in your pocket, purse, or car without worry.  We keep a small bag in the car for travel to reinforce when our puppy doesn't bark at people walking by, one by the door to reinforce when she goes to the bathroom outside, and a bunch of treats in a treat bag for travel.The one downside to these is that because they're not as stinky, it can be harder to use them to get your dog's attention if he or she is distracted, like at the dog park or if you have a bunch of visitors.  Our trick to get around this is that we put some stinky treats in the treat bag with these, and they'll take on some of the scent (We use Pro-Treat Beef Liver, Freeze Dried Dog Treats, 21 Ounce).Our dog loves all flavors.

This was not available in any local stores, so I got  the 18 boxes , planning to share it with friends. I tried making the Jello  with pineapple juice as the cold liquid and adding pineapple chunks after it started to harden. YUMMY! It actually tastes like pineapple and coconut. The colada Jello is a slightly different texture than regular Jello --less "gelatiny" and more creamy. Made with just plain water,  this still tastes of coconut and pineapple. I understand you can make it with bottled pina colada mix --that would be fun for a party, especially if it had a few maraschino cherries and a bit of rum .

3 boxes of pina colada jello3 cups of boiling water1 1/2 cups pineapple rum1 1/2 cups coconut rum....this is the best, everyone that we go camping with LOVES them !!!!!!!!!Too bad they are seasonal and you can't get that jello anymore....got the last 2 cases on Amazon....thank you
Unable to find this flavor in my area, purchased off Amazon, great price (only downfall have to purchase by the case) but that is okay it is in date till 2010.
If you like pina coladas and jello you will love this!  great taste same jell-o quality you expect.  easy to make
I'm so glad that I found this and am able to have it auto-shipped.  I use this for various cakes, pies, and drink recipes.
This is a seasonal flavor in most grocery stores, after the summer I could not find it anywhere other than Amazon! Big hit as jello shots!

This flavor of jello (shots) was a huge hit at a Halloween party.  Tasted just like the drink.Only observation is the jello itself is a little cloudy, but that was all good to differentiate between the Island Pineapple flavor.  Also a great flavor!Happy with this purchase.

I was hesitant about purchasing 24 boxes of jello in the same flavor, but this stuff is great!We both love pina colada flavor and it's a quick, easy treat that we don't have to feel guilty about having.
My nutritionist friend says this is a great way to get Pomegranate into your diet!  Very tasty on another healthy item -- asparagus...

column9: Imagine spray painting your salad with awesome flavor!
column10: I was extremely pleased to discover that the very same product my weight-loss program was selling for an arm and a leg was available online through amazon.com! I initially made a rather large order for this product, and am almost ready to do it again. I've found so many ways to prepare my meals using the mister. It's so convenient too.I love the idea of being able to stay stocked up via the internet. No traveling to the specialty shops to get this product. It's sent right to your front door.I'm thrilled with the Gourme' Mister and with amazon.com.I would highly recommend this product to anyone, not just to those of you who are dieting. It has a great taste and is fun to use. You can't go wrong.Gourme' Mist Pomegranite Balsamic Vinegar Mister, 6 Fl Oz. Bottles (Pack of 3)

column9: Only thing I use on salads now.
column10: Love this stuff!  Great flavor, easy to put on your salad.  Plus, benefit of vinegar and almost no calories.  I also have the raspberry flavor and the olive oil mister.  Both are great products as well.Recommend, Amazon has a good price.  I am unable to locate in local markets.  Very glad to see here.

column9: Excellent Quality - Flavor on the Weak Side
column10: I'm on my third 5 pound bag of this CO2 Decaf Colombian coffee.  I obviously have enjoyed it.  The aroma and freshness of the coffee from Coffee Bean Direct is absolutely wonderful.  For some reason the beans also grind terrifically without any static electricity that usually sends other grounds scattering.  I like that.  However, after buying my third bag of the Colombian beans I think I will move on to another decaf.I don't know whether the Co2 process yields a weaker flavor or if it is just this particular roast.  I have found that a normal portion of ground beans in a drip coffee maker produces a rather watery and weak coffee, not nearly worthy of the amazing smell of the beans.  I keep using more and more coffee to get the most flavor out of the beans.  This seems to work ok for now, but I now use almost 50% more coffee than is normally called for.  I still like the brand though and look forward to trying another CO2 decaf roast from them next time.

column9: Wonderful aroma, perfect color and great taste
column10: I was ambivalent about trying this or any non brand name coffee on the internet but decided to take a chance.I have been buying coffee from web sites for years with great success, but increasing prices and lesser quality started creeping in. I also blend 50/50 decaf and wanted a chemical free decaf to use. This product was just the answer I was looking for. Big bag , yes. But when opened the fresh roasted aroma filled our house. As with anything worth having it is a little on the pricey side, but how many cups of bad coffee can you really stand?Great product, great delivery and a definite buy again.

We have been using this decaf coffee for quite sometime and are very pleased with the consistent quality of the product with each shipment.  We find this a great alternative to Swiss Water Process at a very affordable price.
It is Co2 decaf so no chemicals are used in removing the caffeine, just carbon dioxide and we all breath that out. We find it to be a smooth coffee.

Have tried other black rices but they have not been whole grain nor organic. Plus the others don't have the slight nutty taste that this does. Because it is a whole grain you must cook it like brown rice - a little more water and a little longer cooking. Additionally this brand isn't sticky or as sticky as some normal black rice. Yes I know there is a Thai sticky black rice and that's OK but this brand isn't sticky so is nice for stir fry, have even used it in gumbo. Will be back for more soon.

column9: Whole Grain Food for great Health Benefit
column10: I love the taste and ease of cooking this rice.  The reason for making the purchase was because of the fact that is is a whole grain food item with a great deal of health benefits.  Made the puchase for a diabetic because it is a low glycemic food item.I must say that everyone who I have shared the Black Rice with enjoyed it the most when it was cooked in a broth.I like the texture and taste with or without broth.  I must say that the health benefits of the rice is what I was seeking and have found in this rice.  Worth every penny that I spent on it.

I don't much care for rice. White rice tastes like paste and brown rice tastes like nothing. I cook it frequently only because my family loves it. This black rice is really good though. I add a little olive oil and salt and the result is the best rice I've ever had.

I had some of these when I went to Germany. They amazed me with their  taste. Inside the little balls lies a core of a smoothly malty goodness that has my mouth watering as I write this. I got mine for around 2 euros, if I remember correctly, but $4 for these is definitely worth it. These are great. If you have never tried one, I strongly urge you to either travel to Europe or get these. You will not regret it, that I guarantee.

column9: Very tasty and for a good internet price.
column10: I find these Luna Bars are very tasty and very nutritious as a snack or at any time. I would highly recommend these bars.

If you're a fan of the little shakers of McCormick's fajita seasoning, this isn't it. It's mostly salt, has little cumin, and the end result turns out twitchingly salty with no real flavor. You'd be better off concocting your own recipe for it.

I'd been holding on to the last of this marinade, waiting for Costo to get it back in stock... Never happened!  Finding it here, was fantastic, tho' I think a little pricey, but it qualified for free shipping.  Two pack is a bonus, I can give one to my sister as a 'treat', we both love using it.

I purchased this seasoning thinking it was the same as the McCormick fajita seasoning you can purchase in the little packages and I thought I could save some money by buying in bulk. Unfortunately it isn't even close to being the same as what you get in the little packages, the other 2 star review was right, it comes out just tasting like salt with no other real flavor. If you like the way the mix tastes that comes in the packages then stick to the packages, if you want your meat to taste like salt buy this or save some money and just use salt!

column9: Tastes good, convenient, and fairly priced.
column10: Although I don't disagree that there is a lot of salt in Fajita seasoning, I feel that this is what it is supposed to be.  We use it on beef, chicken, and other items we are putting into Tex-Mex and similar cooking.  To us it tastes good, is in a convenient package, and is reasonably priced.  We used to buy similar bottles of it from Sam's Club, but they don't seem to carry it anymore.Food products are difficult to review, because people's tastes are so subjective.  All I can say is that this spice is what we expected when we ordered it, and we are happy with it.  I don't doubt that people who make their own, from scratch, are able to suit their own tastes better than this bottle can.
This is, by far, my favorite coffee.  Dunkin Donuts Cinnamon is a distant second.  Just enough cinnamon flavor and the perfect roast.  Just GREAT coffee!
Love most of Gevalia coffee but the cinnamon one is super special, heavenly. And at the cheaper amazon price, not much can compeat.
This is the favored coffee for my husband & me. Gevalia coffee is soooo smooth. I don't care for all their flavors, but cinnamon is great!

column9: Bought it for a friend, she loves it.
column10: I love coffee, and Gevalia makes some of my favorite coffee. I bought this as a gift for a friend who had done something nice for me, and she absolutely loves it. I wouldn't touch flavored coffee myself.... but she's a regular consumer of this particular bean now that I've introduced her to it.

column9: Nice unique natural flavor, High Quality beans
column10: I am always looking for a coffee blend-- I don't like dark roast or any roast that is designed to cover the inferiority of the beans. This is a good one, because although I don't like flavored coffees (like hazelnut), I do enjoy cinnamon in my coffee every now and then. This roast is quite good, and perfect for anyone who likes a flavorful coffee and drinks it black, like I do.The cinnamon flavor is a delicate note, although when the coffee is actually brewing, the smell is powerful. If you put a lot of sweetener or other additives in your coffee, you may not be able to enjoy this coffee's natural flavor.I feel like this coffee is high quality, with excellent flavor. I don't get an "acidic" stomach afterwards, either. It would have been better if the beans were not ground, but I understand the convenience factor. The cinnamon flavor is natural, not artificial, so it actually tastes more like a cinnamon stick is in the coffee. A huge plus.Recommended!
I love the quality and taste of Gevalia coffee.  For years now I have been purchasing Gevalia Cinnamon Ground Coffee.  Guests that come to my house look forward to my coffee.
I love trying different coffees.  This one was on sale so I gave it a shot.  It smelled great brewing, but the flavor was "meh" and had a bitter aftertaste.  I will give two of the bags away.

column9: Saved my pre diabetic cat from insulin
column10: I started my cat on this food after he was showing signs of diabetes. I wanted to stave off the insulin roller coaster if possible. My cat has two cans of this every day, one in the morning, one at night. It has no brown rice or wheat or berries or anything else that would throw off his sugar. His symptoms went away within a couple of days, and it's been over a year since. Thank you Avoderm for saving my kitty!!

column9: Looks like human grade cans of chicken
column10: I got some canned chicken for humans at a discount store and I swear this looked and smelled the same.....hmmmmmm. Cats enjoyed it; has lots of liquid so was able to smash up the chunks for the picky kitty in the au-jus - so all were happy.

column9: Our cats are crazy for this!
column10: Our two cats go crazy for this stuff! It's basically just pure chicken chunks with a clear-ish "gravy."We feed our guys both wet and dry food, and usually stick to the Avoderm pate-style wet food. We give them this every once in a while instead and they go bonkers for it. Their bowls are licked clean every time.

My cat Otis was showing signs of aging-especially a very ragged coat. After using this food for a short while i noticed a marked improvement overall,and his coat is soft,and very healthy looking. He loves this food and it is all he eats.I can't say enough good things about avoderm chicken with the pink label.I truly believe it is giving him extra good-quality years. Love that exceptional kitty.This food is a bit pricey, but worth it.

I've been cycling my cats through a few different kinds of wet food, based mostly on convenience, and they devour them all. I ended up buying my cats some avoderm dry food, and they had no objection, so i was a little surprised when i plunked down a can of this wet food and they refused to eat it. After staring at it and glaring at me for a while, they finally deigned to lick the gravy off, but left the meat bits there until i cleaned them up.Honestly, i almost gave this a five-star review, because i've been wanting to wean my cats off the wet food for a while, but they love it so much. Since i started offering them this, they've stopped even asking for wet food anymore.

column9: Unless I'm a dog, how accurate can my review be?
column10: All I can say is that my sis' Shih Tzu eats this & only this when it comes to non main course.  This doggie is so spoiled.

The price was really good but the grinders are poorly made.  After just a few uses, the collar started to crack and eventually the lid didn't stay on the jar anymore.  I bought a decent salt mill so now I just fill that one instead of using the grinder that's integrated to the jar's lid.

Something is off about this syrup, it doesn't taste like your typical Lemon-Lime slush mix, and has an unpleasant after taste. However, that doesn't mean that the brand is bad, I also ordered the Cherry flavor which was pretty good.  Paragon isn't all bad, but this flavor is a bust.

column9: Better then going to the store
column10: I had a lot of problems finding this cat food at the store in the big bag.  It only costs .40c more to have it delivered.  Can't beat that.  It has helped with the problem of my cats throwing up from hair balls.  I think it's a great product.

I have always been a big ketchup fan all my life. I eat it with pratically every type of food, ranging from corn on the cob, to stuffing, to the original french fry, to steak. Well, as you can imagine, I have tried pretty much every brand of ketchup and one brand that is always way over the top than the others on my ratings is Heinz Ketchup. What's even better now, is that Heinz 57 now has this easy to squeeze bottle. It is also very handy at getting that last ounce of red delight out easily. If you haven't tried this product yet, I encourage you before you waste another squirt of another brand that may leave your french fry tasting, well, tasteless!

column9: Tasty, but this bottle drives me crazy
column10: First of all, there's no better condomit for anything than Heinz Ketchup. column10: First off, the hype that Toxic Waste candy is more sour than Warheads is simply not true. Warheads are covered with a pretty thick layer of malic acid that isas sour as you can get. The initial "sour shock" only lasts for seconds, but then the sweet flavors creep in along with it making it much easier to handle. The flavors of the sweet part of the candy are far better than Warheads are. I also love the hollow centers filled with a sour powder. The powder is not overwhelming, but very tangy and good, especially mixed with the flavors of the last remnants of the sweet part of the candy. column9: Toxic Sour? NOT! 100% of random test subjects ate them
column10: We bought the Toxic Waste candy, based on the entertaining label, promoting the extreme difficulty in eating them. (Indicating it is nearly impossible to keep it in your mouth more than 30 seconds) Warnings abound on the label, severe discomfort, "don't eat more than one", etc. I am used to super-hot hot sauces, where warnings are justified, so expected extreme sourness.We set up a Christmas eve game, with 35 adults and kids, with a video camera, to record the event. Most of the people either never eat, or hate sour, so this was going to be fun! First person was an adventurous woman "guinea pig" ... Ate it without a wince. Next person, a young boy, who easily ate it and proclaimed, "warheads are much more sour".Some people winced for a few seconds. Only 2 had problems getting past the initial sour. After a few seconds, the sour goes away. Another discovered, if you chew the candy, it is hardly sour. Even a 6 year old boy, who absolutely hates sour, ate one. Several people said the flavor makes a difference, speculating that the green apple was more sour than other flavors.While we had fun, it was very disappointing. I was expecting super-extreme, Umeboshi plum kind of sour, or worse!With a room full of people, from age 6 to 84, 100% ate the entire thing, with the kids eating them like candy. This may be sour candy, but it is NOT "Toxic Waste" sour.On the plus side, those who love eating sour, (mostly the kids) liked this candy, but it is just candy, not an adventurous challenge for the strong-willed.Sorry, guys, fantastic marketing label, but poor execution. I have no idea why our results were so different than expected, but we went through 3+ cans in an evening. We will try again next year, but I will try to find something *really* sour, something that at least 2/3 of the people cannot eat!

column9: The Drippings of Fermented Rotten Anchovies...
column10: ... were a basic flavoring ingredient in the cuisine of ancient Rome and Etruria, used as widely as The Chinese use soya sauce or the Americans use catsup. It may be something of a surprise that the same fish sauce is one of the necessary elements of the Southeast Asian cookery, from Burma to the Philippines. The clear pungent liquid is called 'ngapi' in Burmese, 'nam pla' in Thai, 'nuoc nam' in Vietnamese 'yu chiap' in Chinese, and 'patis' in Tagalog. Tiparos is a good brand, and this is a proper price.The Thais serve "prik nam pla" as a condiment on the table for every meal. It's simple 'fish sauce' with chopped Thai chilis, those little hot devils, and chopped coriander weed, commonly called 'cilantro' in parts of the USA. It's indispensable. You can judge the authenticity of a Thai restaurant by whether you are served prik nam pla automatically, or have to ask for it, or can't even get it. In the latter case, you are ethically authorized to walk out without paying your bill.Likewise, any Thai or Vietnamese cookbook that doesn't discuss the uses of fish sauce would be better reserved for starting campfires.As I said, the Romans used the same stuff, which they called LIQUAMEN. My guess is that as the Empire was transformed by immigration from the north, especially via Gaul, fish sauce was replaced by sea salt and rock salt. The Haida, Tlingit, and Kwakiutl peoples of the Pacific Northwest used the oil squeezed from candlefish for a similar taste treat. That oil was so valuable as a trade item that wars were fought over it.Soya sauce is NOT an adequate substitute, whatever your Betty Crocker cookbook says. But now you can get fish sauce anywhere you choose to live. I'm still getting accustomed to the implications of internet shopping. Imagine this: I can get a novel by Roberto Bolaños, a DVD opera by Monteverdi, and a bottle of Tiparos nam pla, all in one package delivered to my door by the US Postal Service.

Here is a common recipe that shows the possibilities of fish sauce, Chicken and Holy Basil.  This is my favorite version, there are many others.Ingredients:The proportions of ingredients are strictly to your taste.  My wife and I will use one large chicken breast, a whole bell pepper and a medium onion.  Too much chicken makes the dish too meaty for my taste, but as long as it cooks uniformly there's no right or wrong.1-2 boneless, skinless chicken breasts, cut into about 1" strips pieces.  I prefer all natural or organic, never frozen.  It costs more but tastes much better.  You can also add another chicken breast or two to scale up the recipe.  If you prefer, you can also cut the chicken into julienne pieces or even 1-2" cubes.  It tastes great however you do it!1 bell pepper, seeded and cut into thin strips. I prefer yellow, as it's sweeter than green.  If you want more vegetables, add another pepper or more onion.  Just increase the sauce a little bit.3-4 cloves of garlic sliced thin1 small to medium onion cut into thin slices1-2 jalapeno peppers, seeded and sliced thin.  You can use Thai peppers or even serrano peppers if you like it more fiercely hot.  The amount of pepper controls the heat.  You can omit these if you don't have the palate for spicy.1 cup fresh basil leaves.  If you can actually get Thai basil this is best, but any will do, the fresher the better.  Feel free to add extra, particularly if you are increasing the amount of chicken and vegetables.Sauce (this can be doubled or tripled quite easily, to increase the amount of sauce with your dish):1 tbsp black soy (in Asian specialty shops)1 tbsp sugar1 tbsp white vinegar1/2 to 2 tbs Tiparos fish sauce - The amount you use really controls the flavor of the dish.  If you want it more authentic, use the higher amount; if you want it more tame, the smaller amount.Directions:1.  On medium high heat, heat about 2 tbsp cooking oil in your wok until hot2.  Add peppers, garlic and onion.  Saute a few minutes until they soften3.  Add chicen.  Saute until almost cooked through.  If you use previously frozen chicken, or over cook at this point, the chicken will be tough.4.  Add sauce and saute until chicken it is just cooked through.5.  Turn off heat.  Add basil leaves, and stir until they wilt.6.  Serve imediately with freshly cooked jasmine rice.

column10: 'A hazelnut is the nut of the hazel and is also known as a cob nut or filbert nut according to species. A cob is roughly spherical to oval, about 15-25 mm long and 10-15 mm in diameter, with an outer fibrous husk surrounding a smooth shell. A filbert is more elongated, being about twice as long as it is round. The nut falls out of the husk when ripe, about seven to eight months after pollination. The kernel of the seed is edible and used raw or roasted, or ground into a paste. Hazelnuts are also used for livestock feed, as are chestnuts and acorns. The seed has a thin dark brown skin, which is sometimes removed before cooking.' WikipediaI bought these hazelnuts/filberts to use for a recipe, and I could not find them readily available. (GUS is my favorite so far).Therefore, upon seeing that Sprecher Ginger Ale has only 60 calories per 8 ounce serving, I was optimistic.  Unfortunately, while the dryness is there, and is pleasant, it's overpowered by a flavor which I can't quite figure out.  I can only describe it as 'musty', and it may have something to do with the 'hint of oak' referred to on the bottle's label. It's apparent from the first sip, and is quick to emerge and re-emerge.  Whatever it is, it overwhelms everything that is good about this ale.  It's too bad, because with it's dryness and sharp carbonation, this could be a really good brew.

column9: I'm not sure what kind of judgment this tea sampler is making of me.
column10: I ordered two of these, since for five dollars, how can I really go wrong, right?  Even if I had gotten 22 cups, as many other reviews had, five dollars would still be a steal.  However, I got each and every one of my 24 cups in each sack.Now, of my 48 cups, 7 contained caffeine (so about 4 caffeinated, 20 noncaffeinated in each of my bags).  The rest were herbal or decaf.  Each bag contained about six varieties of tea, and they were generally the same (basically, If you buy two bags, you're likely to get a lot of the same six teas, rather than a bunch of different ones in each bag).It wasn't a bad assortment, but I wonder if these sacks of assorted teas are saying something about me.  I mean, I didn't think I was getting too much caffeine, but now I'm wondering.  A lot of them are things like "Camomile" (great for knitting quilts), "Decaffeinated Earl Grey) (why decaf?  and why Earl Grey?), and "Sleepytime Herbal Tea" (why is Burley Brew trying to calm me down?)Also, these assortments are pretty much as pictured.  While writing this review I've been staring at the picture to the right of the box, and it pretty much pictures five of the seven breeds of tea I received, though it omits the one I received the most of.  That's right.  I nearly forgot.  One quarter of my tea is peppermint.  Who even likes Peppermint?For five bucks, I give it four stars.  For any price over ten, I'd advise you to pre-evaluate your tastes for peppermint and earl grey.

column9: I love kale chips... but hate these!!!
column10: I'm an experienced kale chip eater, and usually love them.  And I usually like Indian food.  But I *hate* these Bombay Curry flavor kale chips.  First, I dislike the spicing.  A lot.  I also wasn't a huge fan of the kale itself: the leaves strike me as somewhat small, and there seemed to be a high proportion of spines (which are hard, and not tasty).On the plus side, it was organic kale.  Which is really nice.  I'd probably just look for a different flavor.  I think some of the others are cheaper too, like Rhythm Superfoods Mango Habanero Kale Chips, 2-Ounce (Pack of 4), which is also available as subscribe & save.  (I've never tried that flavor, but it sure sounds good!!!)Or, try Kale Krunch, Cheezy Chipotle, 2.2 Oz Organic, which I find is a really good brand, and I find is the best Kale Krunch flavor.

This snack is the ultimate compromise. The chips are super tasty, very filling, and sport spectacular curry flavor. Even if you are not in search of better health, any curry lover would devour a bag of these. Order up, so that the price will come down!

Okay - I have to start out saying that I really love this company.  Having lived in Austin and loved Daily Juice, my heart wants them to win. However, this product is really terrible.  It is so caked on with goop that it is heavy and fatty and you might as well have a dorito instead!  I LOVED their original recipe..it was so light and yummy - it tasted good AND it was actually healthy - what a concept!  I now eat Lydia's - because those kale chips are at least a tad bit lighter.  Again, I wish them success - but they gotta get back on the health bandwagon with these puppies.

I purchased a bag of these chips these a month ago and the nutrition label on the package matched that on the Web site--101 calories, 4 g fat for 1 ounce. Ordered these from Amazon--12 bags--and the nutrition label has more than twice the calories and fat--210 calories, 9 g fat for 1 ounce. Since protein and fiber have also doubled, I'd like to think that the nutrition info is now for 2 ounces (1 bag). However, the nutrition label says this is for 1 ounce, 2 servings per container.This happened previously with another flavor of these kale chips, and I submitted a query to Rhythm Superfoods, using the contact form at their Web site. Weeks later, have received no answer. Submitted another query about the current situation, but am not optimistic about receiving an explanation.This is marketed as a healthful snack--accurate nutrition information matters.

column9: Packed with care, shipped quickly, and EXCELLENT customer service!!
column10: After my order the seller sent an email with tips on what I needed to prepare for my plant when it arrived. The shipping was fast and the plant was packaged with great care. Overall, extremely good service and an excellent product.

NOTE:  SORRY FOR AN SPELLING/GRAMMER ERRORS, THERE'S NO SPELL-CHECK ON AMAZON!!!This is my second buy from Joel, and I can officially say this is the BEST service I have seen on the internet in while.  I did a lot of research (as always...) before buying, and I found out somethings that I think you might want to know.  For starters, this is sundew that is almost impossible to kill, because once well established, it is just generally more difficult to kill than other sundews.  Another, it will arrive green in color, but it will turn a vibrant maroon when exposed to the correct amount of light.  You actually recive THREE plants, not one, but mine arrived in a clump, growing together.  DO NOT TRY TO PRY THEM APART!!! they are supposed to come like this.Also, if you want a pot FULL of these plants, you just have to let them flower and produce seeds, and they flower so often and produce so many seeds that some growers consider this species as a weed as the baby plants colinize any pot they can grow in, and like i said before, they are pretty hard to perminately kill by carnivourous plant standards.I will update when major events happen (i.e.: The sundew changes color, ect)12/29/2011---'Stickly' is getting a "tan"(green turning red), and new dew drops are forming on his little tenticles, and I fed each sundew (they are growing in a clump) a ant.
I would highly recommend this product came with pots and sphagnum moss and a big clump of sundews (mine even came with flowers!) if you are planning to order don't hesitate!!!!

I got my sundew a couple days ago.  It was nicely packed with a little less than twice as much potting material as the plant needed (so now I  have some extra :D).  It was very bunched up and quite small, and still is, so I'll post pictures when it looks more exciting.  It is quite green with little red-tipped hairs; from what I can gather if you want it to be as red as the picture you have to put it under grow lights.  When it came it was not dewy at all, but it had a little stock with what appears to be little seed pods, so I imagine it is a fairly mature plant if it is trying to reproduce.  I have been moving it to different windows around the house so it gets the most sun, but it went a couple days without getting any dew at all.  Today I tried putting a clear bowl over it to increase humidity, and now little drops of dew (digestive goo) are visible on some of the hairs.  This plant seems to be progressing so far, and it is 78-79 degrees F in here with a humidity of probably 40-50%.  It may or may not need a little help from a bowl for humidity, but other than that it seems just fine in a normal house on a window sill.  The plant is small, maybe as wide as a thumb is long.

column9: Be careful of putting your plant in direct sunlight
column10: The plant I received shipped very fast. It arrived in a little plastic bag to keep everything moist which was nice...I planted it in a large mason jar with a venus flytrap and a pitcher plant. The plant is growing fine and I am very satisfied with the speedy shipment. I would be careful with following the growing instructions from some other users. All carnivorous plants need some sort of humidity which would be sealing it in some sort of container with a few holes on the top and I would be careful of placing these plants in direct sunlight, the plants will barely produce or stop producing the sticky dew drops in both cases.

The extract arrived on time for me to make my root beer float cupcakes.  They came out perfect. I would definitely use Cook's brand again.
Used this to make a batch of homemade root beer with the kids.  I force carbonated in the keg since bottle carbonating sounded too dicey.  They loved it and we will do that again!

column9: Can't find Peter Pan Peanut Butter in Southern California Stores!
column10: I've seen studies where Peter Pan Peanut Butter won the taste tests...and wanted to try some.  BUT...I can't find it in ANY Southern California Store that I go to so....Amazon....THANK YOU for making it available.  It IS Yummy~...Not as 'stiff' as some other brands so in warm weather it can drip a bit but still yummy!

Amy & Brian's Coconut Juice with Lime is pure cool. It takes a couple of swigs to acclimate to the taste, if you are used to the regular Amy & Brian's Coconut Juice (sans lime). Sourced from the USA with low fat yet rich in protein.  The big tub is well worth it with free prime shipping.

She loves it so much that when I open the can she stands at my feet and meows until i put it down for her! haha.She also seems to be picking up a little weight in a good way! Im glad she likes it and ill defenitly order her more. My daughter and I had so much fun discovering what was in the box.  It arrived in a timely manner, the products were fresh and we enjoyed sharing not only the candy but our stories about our favorites.  Next time I will try another decade just for fun!!!

A convient carry along food. I also have some in my emergency food supplies. It has good flavor & the water doesn't bother me. Actually in an emergency situation I would drink the water & eat the tuna. This is my favorite of the pre flavored tunas. Very good.

It's easy to use this size can as a base for a small meal, or as the base for a snack, with cheese and crackers, or a piece of fruit.  My personal favorite (actually the only flavor I like) is the lemon pepper.  No fishy taste, which I did get with the other flavors.

Not too good. May be good if squeezed dry and added with mayo + crunchy veggies into tuna salad. I had this + crackers and the flavor was quite overwhelming. Very lemon pepper?!!?? Ha ha ha. I know, it is very lemon pepper but it is quite intense. I'll try as the base of a tuna salad, it may be better, but I think I'll sick with my plain ole' tuna. They taste like Goldfish but are less salty and not quite so cheesy in flavor, nor do they crumble as easily into orange crumbs.All ingredients seem to be organic, even the annatto extract used for natural color.  However, this product is made on equipment that also processes egg and soy products.A serving is 50 crackers (30g) and yields 150 calories, of which 60 are from fat.  Total fat is 11%; saturated fat is 5%.  Sodium yiels 250mg or 10% and total carbohydrate is 19g or 6%.This is made in the USA.

The product labeling in my mind is a little deceptive considering these crackers contain a forum of MSG. MSG's most active ingredient is free glutamate. Free glutamate is the active ingredient of mono-sodium glutamate, or MSG. Yeast Extract contains free glutamate. In my opinion, the only reason this company is using the term "Yeast Extract" is to conceal the fact that this products contains MSG.
i love these as an alternative to goldfish. they are natural and more healthy so im a happy mommy! they taste like basic golfish.

We starting purchasing these a couple of months ago as a snack for my one year old daughter.  I know she loves them but I think my wife and I eat more of them than she does.  We have a bad habit of leaving the box out and when we walk by we stop and crab a handful.  The cheddar flavor is much better than the goldfish.

My son enjoyed eating these bunnies until I realize that they contained "Yeast Extract", which contains free glutamic acid...another term for, or type of MSG!I checked the back of the box because I had begun reading a book called, "Excitotoxins" (great book for moms by the way), which lists the many forms of MSG and explains what they do to the body.  It is associated with reproductive disorders, damage to the brain, damage to the endocrine system, obesity and other disorders.  Companies use such additives to food to make them taste better and make them more addictive.  Yeast Extract is harmful to everyone, but particularly little children.  I was especially upset that this additive showed up in an "organic product" and one for children!  Many of the other companies out there that produce organic products do not use such additives.Here's an article about Yeast Extract:[...]Here's another site with a listing of all the different forms of MSG:[...]

These bunny crackers are wonderful.  This is our second shipment from subscribe and save and we plan on continuing to purchase them from this purchasing opportunity.The fact that the pieces are small make it nice and you feel like you are getting to eat a lot of them at one time.Great taste!!!!!!!!
I knew my kids already loved these so when I had a chance to buy them on Amazon, I was thrilled.  Good buy.
These little cheddar bunnies are both delicious and organic.  A one-two knockout punch, if you ask me.  Give 'em a try.
They are lighter, crunchier, less salty than Goldfish.  Plus it is organic, simply PERFECT.  My 3-yr old loves it.
These are yummy and earth friendly!  We all love them and I feel better about giving them to my family!

I just want to say that any company who touts how organic it is while adding MSG to their products (Yeast extract = MSG) is lying, straight up, and has no problem with how hypocritical their entire shtick is.  MSG is poison.  Feed that to your kids and tell them how healthy they are.  Yuck.

column9: Would you feed your toddler MSG?
column10: If not these organic crackers are not for you. These taste so great in part because they contain yeast extract which acts a lot like MSG in the body. Please research yeast extract before feeding these to children and if you choose to use this product watch for behavior changes. We learned very painfully just how harmful this ingredient can be for some kids.

We're eating organic. We're eating whole wheat. We love to snack, too. This product allows us to fulfill those goals and, surprisingly, delivers a better taste than the conventional alternative. We're happy!
These have a similar consistency to goldfish, but we think they taste much better.  I put these in my daughter's lunch, but I also snack on them myself.

These are a HUGE hit with my kids. I don't know what it is about cheese and crackers - it's like kids are born loving them. These are great because they don't have all that artificial, preservative, etc stuff in them. There's not much better than having toddler snacks delivered STRAIGHT to your door, and enough to last weeks as well.These are great snacks for the little ones at a great price!
These are the best snacks you can buy. I think the price is reasonable and they taste way better than goldfish!
This is Excellent Product. Good alternative to Gold fish,plus it is organic also. my picky kid loves it. Only problem is I have to buy 4 big boxes which too much for my small family.
I'M IN LOVE!Not too salty but great cheese tast, crispt and chewie, but not hard. What's not to love?

column9: Kids love them and can't keep them in stock!
column10: I like these the best out of all the cheese crackers marketed to kids. The ingredients seem to very decent and my kids love the taste. I pack these in my children's lunch boxes regularly and the only problem is that their friends always end up begging for them! So now I pack twice as many. A really good find and I love so many products from this company. I look forward to seeing their new products when they come out.
These were great! My 3 year old and my college-aged baby sitter both loved them. We even got our baby sitter 2 boxes to take with her back to college. Great snack!
among the favorite treats for my daughter when driving in the car. I like them too, as I can store an opened box in the car for several weeks, and the cheddar bunnies are still tasting well.
These crackers are great. If you want a bit of a healthier alternative to some of the other cheese crackers out there, try these on for size.

I bought this for my daughter.  She loves the cheese flavor.  I like it too because it's not overpowering. It is good for snack at home and on the go.  Also, I was not sure if they will be damaged during shipping, but they arrive fine.  I am happy with the purchase.
The whole family loves these crackers. I like that they aren't very salty. My kids love them - we eat both the bunnies and goldfish and they've never mentioned that they can tell the difference.

This really is a yummy cracker.  My kids love goldfish crackers and hubby loves cheezits.  In my quest to more healthy eating, I found these and they really are a good alternative to both.  They have the small fun shape that appeals to the kids, but they taste more like a cheezit, only with all natural ingredients.  I signed up for subscribe and save every two months and I may have to change it to every month.  We got the first shipment less than a week ago, and we already opened the second box.

As another reviewer notes, these do taste a bit different than goldfish.  In my opinion, the cheese taste is not as strong and they definitely taste less salty.  My kids noticed and didn't want to eat them the first time they tried them.  However, they've gotten used to them now and ask for them regularly.This box size seems to be good, but could be slightly larger.  We consume them quickly enough that they don't go stale once they've been opened and there is less waste than the single serving packages.

column9: Great tasting, healthy snack for daughter with several allergies!
column10: There are no other cheddar snack crackers on the market that I know of that my DD with food allergies can eat.  These taste great and the whole family loves them!  I just discovered the subscription program...even better prices!!  I'm thrilled and my kids will be happy to have a steady supply of one of their favorite snacks!  Not quite as good as Goldfish crackers (for those who are new to natural foods)...but I think it's worth the small taste difference to get the healthy, earth friendly ingredients in this box.  And they do taste very good.

I wont buy this simply for the fact i seen this @ the local 99 cent store.. I purchased this as an organic alternative to the imported Basmati rice my kids are used to. I'm hoping to eventually wean them off white rice and replace it with wild rice or brown rice, but for now, I was looking for something organic that would give them the taste they're used to without pesticides and whatnot.Taste-wise, my kids are satisfied. I was slightly more picky and found this rice neither as fragrant, nor as easy to cook, nor as agreeable in texture as my standard basmati. The texture was slightly more soft and sticky. I found this to be true every time I cooked it (and I've been preparing it 2 - 3 times a week for about a month).Bottom line, they only detriment is texture (slightly more sticky and soft). Taste wise, it's fine, and for the price, I'd say the product has fair value for an organic item.

column9: Not great but can be made so...
column10: Came out very flat and eggy which I cannot stand.  So I played and discovered if you add to the recipe one of the dixie bakesquick inner packets and a tsp vanilla to the mix (no additional fluid) you get real pancakes that are nice and fluffy and taste whole grain.  The batter will still be runny.  It ups it to being 3 carbs a pancake instead of 1 but that is still super low.  Also, you do not have to add heavy cream, the instructions give alternatives with egg beaters and sour cream to lower the calories.  I would suggest these but only if you get bakesquick too.

I just finshed having these pancakes for breakfast. What a treat. Of course I didn't follow directions, but then that's what enjoying food is all about. Just added an egg and fat free half & half with just a touch of vanilla. Will definately be buying this product again.

I never expected to encounter such cheating on Amazon and this gives me doubt about continuing to purchase on Amazon - especially groceries - unless I know exactly what it is I am buying. The pancakes have a horrible after-taste, and the initial taste is really bad.  This is the first time I've ever reviewed a product on Amazon, but I dislike this product so much, I felt like I had to write it.  I ate one pancake, and threw the rest out.  Even the dog wouldn't eat them.Don't buy this mix!  You'll be sorry.

In past years I was able to buy chew hooves at Petsmart.  They smelled awful, but actually cleaned the tarter from my dogs' teeth.  This was important as I had  a dog with a severe heart defect who could not undergo traditional cleaning from the vet.  Then Petsmart discontinued the sale of this product.  When I found these chew hooves I had hoped for the same result and have been extremely disappointed in them.  They shatter and splinter causing a health hazard for my dogs.  I don't know if it is the way this brand has been processed, but I have had to  discard the entire bag.  Never again will I trust this product.

column9: My Favorite Food in the World
column10: Dominosteine is the best treat ever, and Lambertz makes the absolute best.  If you enjoy German desserts and cookies, you MUST try these.
I bought this for my wife - I don't drink coffee at all. In her opinionits pretty good stuff. So much so that even though the price is a bithigh I get her a bag every few months as a treat.

I keep trying the caviars available on Amazon and this is another good one.  Yummy with a good bit of that "pop" I'm always looking for.  A lot for the money too.  I'll be ordering this one again.

stocking stuffers.....whole family loves the taste...slightly like french vanilla chocolate.  will definately purchase again.  shipping was great as well---packaged tighty

Good texture, and meaty.  I only have one criticism and that is the slight fishy smell when opened, not strong, but its there.  However, there is no fishy taste and seem fresh right out of the can . Overall a great product if you like sardines. I highly recommend them.

These sardines are very clean and mild tasting, not "fishy" or rancid tasting. Nice texture, not mushy nor dry. On the large side.Sardines are rich in omega-3 fatty acids and are extremely low in contaminants such as mercury.  They are also a good source of vitamin D, calcium, B12, and protein.As stated on their website, "BELA Sardines are sourced from traditional local fisheries along the non-industrial Portuguese coastline which have existed for centuries. BELA and these family businesses have forged strong relationships and friendships that lead to the freshest and best catches of the day becoming BELA Sardines"The olive oil is much better and healthier than cheap cottonseed oil or soybean oil.  I buy them in bulk.

column9: Made in China....if that matters to you
column10: I have made every effort to NOT buy/feed anything made in China to my pet. I researched these duck/sweet potato treats before finally deciding to buy them. Nowhere on the amazon product page does it tell you where these treats are made, so I searched for the Smokehouse website which claimed that ONLY some of their CHICKEN treats contained chicken from China, but all other products are made in the USA. So, I felt safe in purchasing these duck/sweet potato treats. After opening a bag, and giving them to my dog did I glance at the product origin. Needless to say my dog likes them very much, but I was NOT happy to find PRODUCT OF CHINA on the bag.Boo hiss to amazon for not putting the product origin on the product page, and to Smokehouse for misleading consumers on their product information website. Why do they do this, because there are customers just like me that care where the product originates. Many of you may not be concerned about this, but I am, and I think it's very misleading not to provide accurate, and complete information about the product when purchasing from an internet store. At least the product doesn't smell like plastic like the Dingo products.I won't be purchasing these again. My dog seemed to like them, but she won't be getting anymore of them. I took a star off due to the lack of complete information from amazon, and misleading information from Smokehouse.UPDATE: Big thumbs up to amazon for great customer service. When I called to return this item they were very helpful in processing a refund, and because it is considered a grocery item I didn't even have to return the items. I had also purchased the Smokehouse duck chips, but they too are made in China. I suggested the addition of the country of origin to both product pages. Just another reason why I don't hesitate to purchase from amazon. They truly have great customer service....rare these days.

column9: DOG SAYS: DELICIOUS -- MOM SAYS: MADE IN CHINA!
column10: Like a previous reviewer, I, too, am concerned over the product being made in China. It looks like a very healthy product and my dog loves it but I only care to feed my dog US-based products so that I can ensure the high quality that he deserves.

As others have noted, these treats are made in China as clearly stated on the bag. I didn't like that, but the news gets worse.On the back of the bag is a statement: "Not for human consumption. Wash hands with soap and water after handling."If I have to wash my hands after handling these things, I'm sure as hell not going to feed them to my Yorkies!As expected, Amazon graciously accepted a return.

The FDA has issued a warning about pet treats made in China.  You have to look for the small print on the back of the bag, but these are not made in the USA.  Please don't trust the health of your pets to Chinese-made treats.  I have personally lost a beloved pet.  I didn't know about the FDA warning.  Educate yourself before purchasing these.
This company has removed these from store shelves as they may have been making dogs sick.  Go to Pet Food Tracker on the net for lists of food and treats to be wary of.

I've been trying to find treats that have no sugar, are low in fat and made in USA for my diabetic yorkie-poo. Thought I'd found them. Search Amazon with made in USA dog treats and see this product appear on the list. Go to Smokehouse's website and red that only SOME of their CHICKEN products have product of China on the label. So by omission I think, OK it's duck, NOT chicken so it's made in USA. I order them. My dog loves them. I come back to Amazon to buy more and notice something I missed the first time: someone has written a review saying they're made in China. I check my package and sure enough, it days product of china. I don't know who to be more angry with: Amazon for listing it as USA when I search. Smokehouse for misleading me on their website, or ME for not reading the label after it got here.

My dogs loved these treats.  They are bigger than what I had originally expected.  I thought they were a tiny strips of duck meat wrapped around a sweet potato fry, which in a sense they are.  They are actually a whole breast or at least half of one wrapped around a sweet potato fry.  Much more meat than I expected.  These take my dogs a few minutes to gobble up instead of just a few seconds with other treats.I like the fact that the ingredients only state duck meat and sweet potato, no harsh preservatives you tend to find in most treats, especially ones that come from China.The cost compared to the amount you get is well worth the price I paid.  My dogs go through about 2 of these each a day which a bag will last me about a week or so.  I definitely plan on buying more of these, its to bad they don't have the automatic delivery for these as they do for coffee because I would definitely sign up.I highly recommend these treats.

My dog loves these treats, but I can't think of any treats my dog doesn't love.  The treats are hard but only takes my 70 pound lab a few seconds to eat.  Based on the other reviews, I will look into this treat containing product from China.  If it does have any product from China I will never buy from this brand again.

column9: Dogs don't like the Sweet Potato
column10: All 3 of my dogs love these treats. I've never seen them go for a dog treat as they do these.However, each of them only eats the Outer Duck portion. What they do is pull the sweat potato out and then eat the duck. Pretty cute, aren't they!

I typed "Made in USA" healthy dog treats in search box. These treats were first in list.  I understand they are Made in China!  Is this true?  if it is,this is completely false advertising.  I add this comment a few months later, I may have been a bit harsh with my comment about this product. I was frustrated with not being able to find quality American made dog food or treats. My dog had become sick by eating a dog treat (not this one) that was made in China. I did not nor did my dog try this product named and should not have left a review. That is what this site is for, but that said... I do believe the company is misleading consumers with their advertising. What happened to ethics in this country? It seems there are ways to get around having to tell the truth. It has become a way of life and is pervasive in all areas of society- even in dog treat advertising.  In the meantime,  I have found dog treats that are wholesome, fresh and even made in the USA.  You just have to look around but there are some good new products out there.
Don't buy these.  They are made in China.  I found them on a "made in USA" page on Amazon but that is incorrect.
WOW this dog treat is great. I have three dogs that just love this treat. I order 10 bags every couple of months. Also love the free shipping.

My dog loves sweet potatoes.  She has sweet potato dog food and her hands down favorite treats ever are duck and sweet potatoes with a close second and third being salmon and sweet potatoes and frozen blueberries. column9: Before and After We Got Our Paws  on the "Duckies"
column10: Everyone is giving these such a great review. I just ordered my first bag for my Scottie to replace the brand that he normally goes crazy over that is stopping making his "duckies". These are the best dried, ready to eat beans I've tried.  You need to add some spices to most of the styles and I have saved bean juice from beans I've cooked myself to give them a bump of flavor, but it's not necessary.

I prepared these for the first time today.  I was surprised to see that the instructions say to put 3 ½ cups water and 1 ½ cups beer (equals one can or bottle) in a 3 quart sauce pan, bring to a boil, then add the beans.  You let them simmer on reduced heat, covered, for 25 minutes, stirring occasionally.  Alternate suggestions are provided on the package if you don't want to use beer, including wine, other non-alcoholic brew, or just additional water.  I recommend the beer.The only remaining thing to do is to add salt to taste, although not much is needed.  I added none to the pot, but sprinkled some on my serving bowl.It was excellent.  Nothing else, spice wise (as mentioned in other reviews) is necessary.  Unlike some of the other packs which contain only the dehydrated beans and salt, the ingredients here are:  Dehydrated Pinto Beans, Tomato, Jalapeno, Onion and Garlic, Spice, and Salt.  Each package serves 8.One package of these Borracho Beans is included in the sample pack.  I'm back today on Amazon to order the 8-pack of these.  Yes, they're that good.Update 10/03/2012:  I have started a new way to prepare these.  I've browned about 2 lbs of ground beef (with some chopped onions and dusted liberally with chili powder), drained, then put it into a lock 'n lock container in the freezer.  When I start a batch of Borracho Beans, I'll microwave the browned ground beef for no more than a minute -- to loosen it a bit -- and put about a quarter to a third in with the beans, beer, and water.  Much faster than making chili, and very good!  Freeze leftovers in single-serve containers, and I'm good to go.Serve with saltines and a cold beer - it doesn't get much better.  (Did I mention I'm a bachelor?)  ;-)

column9: the lemon could be kicked up several notches

It doesn't have "high fructose corn syrup" for example.Word of warning to the super food conscious:- these are not super healthy (better than regular candy bars though)- While it lacks high fructose corn syrup, it has high maltose corn syrup- Various soy derivatives (not organic) like soy lechitin and soy protein isolates- The always vague and all inclusive: "natural flavors"I am not a big fan of Nature Valley granola bars, but these protein bars are great.
