column9: TASTY, HIGH PROTEIN, HIGH VALUE, BUT READ MY REVIEW FIRST . . . .
column10: My friends, I must admit up front that I'm not normally a big fan of Nature Valley products. This is because there usually is not much "natural" in (or about) them. (I'm not sure if the company has any relationship -- topographical or otherwise -- with "valleys" . . . . LOL!)In any case, Nature Valley -- in this instance -- has changed my mind. They've got a winner on their hands! I picked one of these bars up off a colleague's desk (I asked her first) and munched on it for lunch. It's at least as good -- if not better -- than most of the high end "natural" stuff out there. Tons of fiber (20% USDA RV), tons of protein (18% USDA RV) and not a huge amount of sugar (6 grams; your average Snickers bar has 28-30 grams, depending on who you read; the "#1" protein bar from MET-Rx has 26 grams of sugar).And let's not forget about price. While these bars are 30% (or so) more expensive than an average candy bar, you don't want to put that crud in your tum-tum anyway. And they are *half* the price (and sometimes a *third* the price) of "top shelf" protein bars.From my vantage, it seems like a big name bar maker is beginning to realize that we actually give a damn what we put in our bodies. We've still got a ways to go (these still have corn syrup, for example) but this is definitely a step in the right direction.FINAL WORD: YUM! GO FOR IT!4.5 STARS

column10: I'm trying to lose some weight and have fond that the 'light' fiber or granola bars do not satisfy my craving or hunger - but these bars do! Granted, the calories are not super low. Each bar has 190 calories. But, if I eat one of the wimpy, low calorie bars, I find myself snacking on something else a half an hour later.The Nature Valley Protein Bars, with a big glass of water, will fill me up for at least two or three hours. Just what I need to keep my fingers out of the treat jar or doughnut tray at the office.

I found this product to be a delicious and it satisfies the mid-morning and afternoon munches.  The bar delivers a nice punch with lots of nuts with just the right amount of chocolate. My favorite is the Peanut Butter on Dark Chocolate. It tastes so good you forget it's a protein bar. Great job Nature Valley!
These are the best granola bars I have tasted.  Satisfying with lots of nuts, filling and not cloyingly sweet.  I keep a box in my office at all times--keeps me out of the candy jar!

I had the Lap-Band surgery 6 months ago and have since been on a high-protein diet.  I have tried numerous protein bars but all have left me unimpressed.  Many had awful aftertaste and a less than pleasant taste and texture.  Most were also a bit pricey.  I stumbled across Nature Valley protein bars one day at my local supermarket for $1.99 compared to $5.99 for the other box of protein bars I had previously selected. I decided to give Nature Valley protein bars a chance and was extremely pleased with the texture, taste, protein amount (10g), and the overall value of these protein bars. My favorite is the almond and dark chocolate but the peanut butter and dark chocolate is also very good.  These bars are very moist compared to other protein bars that make you feel you are chewing on cardboard.  I have recommended these protein bars to several other individuals and would highly recommend them to anyone.

I was pleasantly surprised at how good these are.  I am always looking for high protein snacks, and for about the same amount of calories as their traditional granola bars, you get 10g of protein, 5g fiber and less sugar.  These are a good mix of crunchy and chewy.  They do taste a little like protein bars, but they are the most delicious protein bar I've had in a long time, much like a candy bar.  I just wish they made a variety without peanuts.  Many people have peanut allergies.  Compared to the price of most protein bars, these are a good value.  Look out if your digestion is sensitive to fiber, you might get a bloated stomach.  Overall very good and I will keep buying these.

While I am not expert enough to rate the health content of this product, I will say that it tastes like neither peanuts nor chocolate. The all-natural ingredients include 'Soy protein isolate', 'whey protein concentrate', 'vegetable glycerin', and of course 'high maltose corn syrup'. The soy part in particular I could taste, but apart from that it tastes roughly like that part of the ingredient list sounds, like isolated concentrated extract of something.I'm sorry, but I don't feel healthy eating something like this. I'd rather have some real peanuts.

These bars with 10 grams of protein taste pretty darn good. I especially like the chocolate frosting. And I like nuts. They are just the right sweetness for me, which is to say only moderately sweet. They are gluten-free.What I don't like is that a lot of small shards of I don't know what (maybe coconut?) fly around in my mouth and stay there after swallowing. For some reason I have noticed that I had to be careful not to aspirate (breathe) these light-weight tiny pieces; twice I began to choke while eating one of these bars. The little pieces kept staying in my mouth, all around and between teeth so that I had to carefully and repeatedly rinse. I am disappointed and do not plan to buy these again because this problem means I can't safely eat them.Here is the list of ingredients from my package:Roasted Peanuts, Almonds, Soy Protein Isolate, Chicory Root Extract, Sugar, Vegetable Oils (palm kernel, palm, canola), Roasted Sunflower Seeds (sunflower seeds, sunflower oil), Toasted Coconut, Whey Protein Concentrate, Tapioca Syrup, High Maltose Corn Syrup, Fructose, Cocoa, Vegetable Glycerin, Rice Starch, Rice Maltodextrin, Salt, Soy Lecithin, Dextrose, Baking Soda, Natural Flavor.Some people I know are concerned about the food giant Monsanto. This, I am told, is a Monsanto-owned company.

column9: Great product, but watch the price!
column10: I LOVE these bars - very tasty, lots of protein, not too much sugar, and relatively simple ingredients.  But I can buy one pack of 5 for $2.49 at my local grocery store.  Why would I buy 4 packs for over $20.00???

I was so excited when I got a coupon for this product since it had my two favorite ingredients, dark chocolate and peanuts.  My excitement quickly turned to disappointment when I tasted the bar.  It was very bland and had the same distinct whey protein aftertaste that most of these high protein bars have.  I could not eat an entire bar and my husband refused to eat the remaining claiming it was the worst.  Although I applaud Nature Valley for stepping up with more high protein options, they missed the boat on taste.  There is no dark chocolate or peanut butter flavor in these bars whatsoever.

Although high in protein, these bars lack anything that can be called a pleasurable experience. I eat a lot of different protein bars and I will not buy these again. They are just plain awful. Very little taste and what there is it leaves a terrible after-taste in the mouth. Try one first at the grocery store before buying a 4 pack.

How can something that looks this delicious fail to have any taste? There's dark chocolate but almost no discernible sweetness! SO disappointed. For the 190 calories and plenty of protein AND great taste, I would recommend Zone Perfect Sweet and Salty Cashew Pretzel -- 1.58 oz Each / Pack of 12-- out of this world!  Won't be buying the Nature Valley ones again!

column9: Taste like nothing with an after taste.
column10: Just bought this product for the first time and I would not buy or recommend it to anyone.  It taste is very bland with an after taste that is not complementary. The chocolate taste like no flavor wax while the peanuts or whatever nuts they are putting into it is stale.Hope this helps you to not buy this product.

column9: I'm sorry but I couldn't finish the can.
column10: Bumble Bee typically gives the consumer more "bang per buck", at least in sardines.  I'm a budding sardine connoisseur so I decided to try all the brands I could, and not just buy one or two that I liked over and over.So, I picked up a can of these and all I can say is that I must be a spoiled sardine brat because these tasted oily and synthetic, and the sardine meat was a bit greenish rather than the beige and pink color palette that greets me when I open my favorite brands.Now, sardines are a matter of personal taste, and I do respect the Bumble Bee brand, but by all means I recommend buying a can and trying them before you commit to buying in bulk.

I get these for less than a dollar at Walmart.  I compared them with King Oscar and others from two to three times the cost.  I honestly don't feel that the extra money paid for those is particularly worth it.One minor correction from the description shown above is that it is stated on the can that these have "natural smoke flavoring" and not artificial.  Others including myself like the small bones.Soybean oil is not supposed to be as good for you as olive oil, but that doesn't bother me.

I am saddened to see such a low mark given to such great product. I have bought pack of 24 twice now, and still love it! It is simply delicious especially with mayo. You might say everything tastes good with mayo. All I can say to that is: so?
I buy these at the store because I don't like the other brands.  I think they're good for the price.  Firm with good flavor with bones (I like the bones).

It took a little getting used to, at least a couple of bites, but it was well worth the effort. There's the obvious difference in shape and size and a slight increase in saltiness, but the Wheat Thin Stix are just as tasty and addictive as their little biscuit cousins. Luckily Mrs. Spudman keeps an eye on my portions; otherwise I could finish up a box of these in one sitting.For those who like to dip their Wheat Thins, the Stix are perfect. This newly shaped Wheat Thin won't break in the thickest of dips and its length precludes getting any dip on the dipper's hand.If you like the Wheat Thin crackers, you'll like the Stix too. The biggest problem with these is knowing when to stop and then doing it.

column9: Great Tasting Low Carb Bars - Recommended!
column10: The "Atkins Fudge Brownie Advantage Bars" are a great tasting, low carb snack. These tasted better than some candy bars!Being diabetic, I have to watch my carbs and the Atkins bars are a great way for me to have a late night snack without sending my blood sugar levels too high.Highly Recommended!
What a special treat to be able to order this when it is not a holiday season.  Thanks for having this item available.

My wife is from the Philippines and after moving to the U.S. the only place we could find rice sticks for her favorite dish called pancit involved a drive of 50 minutes to an hour round trip.  After finding them at Amazon we save time and money by buying a larger quanty (rice sticks can be stored for quite awhile) and having spent over 25 dollars we got free shipping. Who could ask for more?  Although we had never tried this particular brand before. We noticed no difference in the quality and it is a product of the Philippines!  Excellent Rice Sticks are excellent!

All of the spices that I purchased from this company were stale and old. Some of them even had bugs in them.  Star Anise is supposed to have a wonderful licorice like flavor.  This had no smell and tasted like old cardboard.

These are a wonderful treat for any dog.  Basically a peanut butter OREO for dogs.  But be careful which cookie jar you put them in because they can easily be mistaken for people food.  Every dog I've seen loves them and they crumble enough where choking isn't an issue (unlike some other biscuits I've tried).
My dog LOVES these cookies.  They smell just like a peanut butter brownie.  I got an entire package of these for a sample from Walmart website.  I will buy these if the price is reasonable.
I buy these, box marked 13 oz for $3.98 at Wal Mart.  Buyer beware and check the price at your local Wal Mart.  My dogs love them, but I sure don't pay that much for them, thus the 1 star.

column9: Lowest protein snack on the market
column10: My dog was in early kidney failure and I was told to keep her protein low as possible.  Most dogs treats that she loved were high in protein.  After searching the supermarket isles I never found one that was very low.  I checked out the Three Dog Bakery and they told me these were the lowest they had which is 4% protein for the vanilla flavored.  After changing her dog food to lower protein, and also her treats she was retested and found to be back in the normal range.  Not to mention, she eats them up!!!!  I think they can also be purchased at Walgreens.
They are good, but cost quite a bit; but you have to know that Tanner (The Cocker Spaniel) is well worth the treat.  Could not find locally after being given a bag.
Uhhh, since these treats state right on the front of the bag that they do not contain peanut oil or paste, what DO they contain?  There is NO PEANUT BUTTER in them!
Our dog loves them and keeps her entertained for a good hour. She is very picky so I was glad to find something like this.

my daughter is a busy college student who doesn't have time for breakfast, so she grabs a granola bar on her way out the door.  At Christmas time we got her a large box of g.bars from Costco, but she was running out.  I was pleased when I discovered I could order just the flavors she likes best on Amazon....  We live in different countries now, so it's wonderful to order special things she enjoys and have them quickly delivered to her at college..
Walker's Shortbread Triangles are so buttery and delicious.  I ordered them for a friend who had been searching for a great Shortbread Cookie.  He was thrilled!  Thank you.

These are fantastic.  The tin is great for future use.  I love Walkers shortbread, it reminds me so much of Scotland when I have them with a great tasting cup of Scottish tea with real milk and raw sugar.  The price wasn't bad either for the size (more expensive at wal-mart and doesn't include a tin), but be warned there are not many cookies in the tin.  I plan on buying more shortbread in bulk and using this tin to keep it in.

i really like this product.  often times weave in cheesecloth is much too large resulting in loss of the items you are straining particulary flaxseed. this works just fine.  in order to appreciate the weave just hold it to the light and you can see how tightly woven it is, glad i found it here.  people are really getting into the nut/seed milks that are really more healthy for you than milk which contains hormones, antibotics and steroids- and forget soy. also, the fat content is not from animals and more accessible to the body.  ty

I love making nut milk!  I'll make nut milk everyday if I could.  Maybe even three or four times a day, but who has energy?  It is just, the best feeling.  When you've worked so hard and want to relax.  There really is nothing as centering as making nut milk.  It makes me feel good knowing I'm making plenty of healthy and low calorie nut milk to drink later.I used a strainer and cheese cloth but it was just to messy.  I searched the internets looking for a solution and found these nut milk bags.  They are great.  The whole process is allot less of a hassle to clean up and it's reusable.  Unlike the cheese cloth.  I can fit the entire bag, nuts and all into a one gallon tupperware and just let it sit.  I wrap the edge of the bag around the rim of the tuppper and put a rubber band around it.  Then loosely put the cover on.  It does everything else.

I chose this brand of nut bag based on the other reviews.  I am glad I got the 2 quart size since it leaves plenty of room to squeeze out the milk without having it overflow the bag.  I have been using it to make almond milk from my Vitamix. The milk is so creamy it is perfect for coffee and cereal.

This product has taken my juicing experience from so-so to absolutely wonderful! I wish I had purchased one of these years ago when I first started juicing. I bought a Breville Elite juicer but my juice still came out with too much pulp in it. After trying cheesecloth with not much improvement, someone recommended that I try a nut milk bag and it makes my juice just as good as the juice I would buy from one of those high dollar organic juice bars that use commercial sized juicers. My juice is pulp free and just delicious now. My kids also enjoy homemade juices more because the juice isn't pulpy at all. I've only had the nut milk bag a few days, but it seems durable and it's easy to clean. Just flip,rinse, wash and dry - I do it my sink. To dry it, I just roll it up in a kitchen towel and wring it.  I think I'm going to buy another one just to have more than one on hand so that I don't wear the one I have out too quickly.

I make 3 batches of soymilk every other day (family of 5) and this is so much easier than cheesecloth.  I found that I do not even have to prestrain it before using the nutbag (but I have a SoyQuick soymilk maker, and I think the filter that holds the soybeans helps).  I've also noticed since using this bag, that I do not need to rub off the outer shell on the beans after they have soaked...the bag is so fine, it strains it enough so that it tastes just as good without that extra step.  I am planning on getting a second bag, so that I do not even have to move it between my two containers when I make my 3 batches.  Great buy, and heavy duty! Highly recommend
The nut Bag works great, i have used it four time now and still work wonderfull.Strong Resistant and great quality!

column9: I Never Knew I Needed This So Bad
column10: I just started making almond milk and I thought I would be all prepared. I had a very highly recommended fine mesh strainer and lots and lots of layers of fine cheesecloth. First it was such a pain to get all the milk out using both methods together, it was very time consuming and I had to do it in stages. I also don't feel like I got every last bit of milk out. Afterwards, my milk was still a bit gritty. So I looked up other solutions and found this product. Used it when it first came on my current bottle of almond milk, and boy did it do a great job. It was so much easier to use, I got so much extra milk out, and the milk after was silky smooth. It was also such a breeze to clean this bag after use. So amazed by this product. It feels really solid and feels like it will last through many uses. Highly recommend this product.

I have been making almond milk for about 6 months and it has taken me a while to dial-in how to make it the way I like it.  While I was able to get the taste right, I had issues with consistency.  I had been filtering the milk through a jelly strainer bag to some good effect, but what a pain that was.  I decided to try this nut bag on a whim and it cut my workload by half and gave great results.  Now I do one quick pour of the hot milk through the strainer that came with my soy-milk maker and I pour the results into this nut bag and give it a good squeeze.  The holes seem to be just the perfect size for the job.  I am glad I decided to give this product a go.

Love this bag! Perfect size. I've been using it to make a 1/2 gallon of fresh almond milk every 2-3 days for the last 6 weeks and it works great. Super-fine mesh makes a super-smooth milk, and it rinses clean in a snap. The seams are very well sewn (unlike others I've seen, where the thread is already unraveling) so I expect it will hold up for a good long time. I bought 2 more to give to my mother and my sister.

This was very dissapointing especially after reading all the other great reviews. The problem with most nut milk bags is the material and seams are too weak to handle the wringing of the slurry. I gave it the tug test before I tried to use it and it was literally coming apart. So I returned it right back the next day to Amazon for a refund.
I make my own nut milk taste better than buying the ones at the supermarket. Forget almond breeze make it yourself and you can add vanilla extract for flavor.

I have used it 3 times and each time has been a success.  The material is very light but seems to be sturdy for its use.  It also rinses and dries readily and is ready for the next use.  I really like it.

I had been using cheesecloth to make my nut milk. While that worked well enough, it is so much easier with this nut milk bag! Easy to use, easy to clean, and definitely worth the price if you're going to use it often.
The cookies are beautiful & delicious.  We needed them in time for an event & the folks at Beautiful Sweets made it happen.Will definitely order from them again.

I find most microwave popcorn very salty.  But Pop Weaver is not, even the extra butter kind.  They are available at discount store including Walmart.  Walmart sells the 24 pack for $5.  Excellent price and quality!
my friends and i really enjoy this. 4 minutes in a 700 microwave and almost all the kernals pop. nice flavor. not too much salt. 270 calories per beg. what more could you want.

I bought this locally and am sorry I even tried it, as it was relatively expensive and hasn't worked well for me. I've been doing microwave popcorn for years, other brands. This I found quick to turn into charcoal, not as tasty as others and basically a big unpopped mess. And I'm sorry to have to report this, as I want to like any product of a family firm supposedly using "real" ingredients - I LOVE butter - and located in Indiana, one of my favorite states.

Pop Weaver popcorn is a privately owned family company in Indiana that has been around for over 80  years and is more popular than any other popcorn. They produce roughly 30 percent of the world's popcorn using a specially bred corn. Their hybrid corn is grown on the farmlands of the U.S. and Argentina. They have attempted to make their popcorn as healthy as possible. This whole grain popcorn is gluten-free, soy-free, egg-free, hydrogenated oil-free, trans fats-free, GMO-free (genetically modified organisms), and Kosher certified. Real butter and dairy ingredients are used. Although this popcorn has extra butter, you will not get extremely greasy hands eating this popcorn like some other popcorn brands. A bag of Pop Weaver Microwave Popcorn can be popped in approximately two minutes, and few kernels will go unpopped. This item can be purchased at discount retailers like Wal-Mart for one-fifth the cost and has a shelf life of 18 months. A "Freshest Before" date can be found on each box. I gave this popcorn only three stars because I prefer the old-fashioned taste of popcorn popped in a stovetop kettle. However, if you are a big fan of microwave popcorn, I give this product two thumbs up.

I bought this mixed Turkish delight Pistachio,Almonds & Hazelnut ,I took it to my sister's house for my nephew 5th birthday among his gifts everyone at that party they all loved it they said it wasn't too sweet and the nuts inside are moderate perfect portion.I myself loved it too and I plan to order more in the future it is the perfect sweet to serve your guests after serving them espresso coffee.amazon thank you again as always for bringing us the International flavors to our home without spending a lot of money for traveling to get these sweets,

This tea is great to serve guests that dont care so much for caffeine or even tea lovers. it was affordable on amazon compared to our local stores. i would definately recommend it for anyone looking for an anytime cup of tea

Yes, I got the product (all 60, I counted) and none of them were melted! This was a concern for other Lindt chocolates ordered online. This may also be because I ordered it in December. It tastes just as I remembered from eating them in-store.Tip though - it is cheaper ordering them online at 0.31 per candy than in-store, EXCEPT during the holiday season. I went to my local CVS during the Christmas season and got those two 5 ounce packages of Lindt chocolates for 5 dollars, 2.50 each. With 12 candies in each, it comes down to 0.21 for each candy. So stock up during the holidays!
I bought these for my husband, they are so delicious. They were cheaper on Amazon than anywhere else. I will buy these again.
Lindt makes great chocolate and these truffles are no exception. They're probably the best truffles I've ever had from Lindt. The only problem with them is that it's hard to stop at just one :)

I'm not a big chocolate eater, but these babies are like heaven in your mouth. They are so good when they sit at room temperature and the inside filling is just smooth enough to send your taste buds soaring. Chocolate has got to be the best chocolate I've ever tasted. Be careful because you cannot eat just one.

sent them for my birthday, received them and they were delicous. All my friends keep asking me to bring them more.Even though they said it was going to be shipped cool, when i got them the cool packs were room temperature, nothing melted or was messed up. I just put them in the fridge and went about indulging in them . :) happy, they've lasted for three days so far and still got plenty left. :))
I love the Lindt Truffles but had never tried this flavor. I was really missing out! Definitely my new favorite!!
I don't need to say much.INCREDIBLE!I absolutely love all the flavors, but this flavor and the regular white chocolate are the best. Of course peanut butter is right up there.Just awesome.

As much as we liked Lindt chocolates, I am very disappointed that I need to leave this kind of review.Those of us that come from Europe know what good chocolate should taste like. It seems that Lindt is getting too americanized.... chocolate is too sweet and no flavor. Too bad!

mis ordered because of the same/simlilar name as item wanted in ability to retorn because item classes as grocery oh yes you can put it up for sale discusting gav it to neighbors dogs Merry ChristmAS wit myself eating up the cost

column9: Made in China and my dogs got sick
column10: Maybe what the box claims is true, no additive, no coloring, etc. However I did not notice it was made in China until I have looked at the bottom tip of the bag. Using tiny font size (more like 6pt), it states the product is made in China. While I appreciate the honesty, I could not trust the quality of the sweet potato itself. And I found that out after feeding a couple of them to my dogs. I am not stating all Chinese products are bad. However, most of produce I have dealt with came with great disappointment. To make matters worse, My two little dogs got sick. I have stopped feeding them and now they are ok. I still have 4 bags left but I plan to throw them away.
Beware...these are made in China.  I personally would never purchase a food product from China, and it was obvious on this listing that this are in fact Made in China.

My two schnauzers absolutely love the apple/chicken Chews fromVeggie Life Vitality.  I was having a difficult time obtaining themfrom our pet store so I ordered them from Amazon.  No after ordering12 packages and trying to return them because they are defectiveI am told they are non refundable.  Very unhappy.  $50 in to thetrash.  Dogswell Veggie Life Vitality Sweet potato/chicken and  and Apple Chicken chews.

column9: Look out for mold!! Poor response from Customer Service.
column10: I bought 6 of these in Jan 09. They had an expire date of 2010. I opened up one of the packages and I found two moldy pieces. I didn't want to risk mold in the other packs so I tossed them out. I email Dogswell for a replacement, I asked for a different product and they wouldn't do anything unless I shipped them. Not a huge deal, but really you want to ship back dog treats that were moldy. I use Amazon Prime to save time, not waste it.

column9: Shelter Dogs Wouldn't Even Eat These
column10: I bought these for my dog and shelter dogs where I volunteer.  My dog snubbed them.  And, even the shelter dogs did not like them. They are of no value to me now. :(The dogs love the chicken strips though!

column9: Product does not maintain its softness
column10: My dog seems to really like them, but the sweet potato gets very, very hard once the bag is opened.  My concern is they are about and inch and half long and do not want to have my dog swallowing something that size and  hardness.  As canines are gulpers, I am concerned.  The same product with the the chicken and apple is much softer.

I didn't realize when I bought these that they were made in China.  In fact, I fed them to my dogs until someone looking at the package pointed it out to me.  I'm a little leery of buying dogs treats from China and other developing countries since the melamime incident.  Who knows what oversight there is on the production.  So, now I order *only* Snook's sweet potatoe dog chews from Healthy Happy Pet (through Amazon).  These are organic dried sweet potato chunks made in the US and my dogs **love them**.  I also get Sam's Yams but the Snook's are nice and crunchy.  I got a small bag for my sister's Shih Tzus and they loved them as well.  If Dogswell would find a place in the US to make their products, I'd be willing to buy.  But as long as they are made in China-- won't do it anymore.

I will admit at this moment I have no hard data to back up my suspicion, but we have been feeding these to our two dogs, one of whom is diabetic. Due to the fact that the chicken and apple treats boasted such bona fides as "no hormones" and "no antibiotics", we felt good about serving these up.The other day, the diabetic dog began throwing up, and I took her to the vet yesterday. The vet called with the results of the blood work and said the dog's liver enzymes had spiked. She asked me if we were feeding her chicken jerky treats which might be made in China. I knew about the Dogswell treats, but I was certain they weren't of Chinese origin. When I was at the store later, I picked up a package and found to my amazement that they are, in fact, Chinese.The vet will run tests on the remaining treats in the package to see if there is any melamine in the meat, but the change in her liver coincides with her getting these treats. I wouldn't advise anyone feeding these to their dogs without first checking the health of their dog's liver and the chemical composition of the treats.Rated One Star, only because Zero Stars is not an option.

i ordered these from wag.com not checking reviews first. wish i had.i gave these to my 6 months old puppy, and he's had horrible diarrhea for a day and a half.just came back home to a puppy with diarrhea AND BLEEDING. yes, bleeding. not 'some' bleeding, but significant bleeding (not a hemorrhage either).my puppy is very healthy otherwise, and i haven't changed anything else on his diet, except for these new treats.i am typing this review from the vet's office.

I like the simplicity of this treat--an ingredient list I can understand.Our puppy, a 1 yr. old Coton de Tulear, has loved these for months now.  He is normally a somewhat finicky eater, but he will perform his whole arsenal of tricks when he knows you have one of these in your hand.  He loves them so much, we buy this on the "Subscribe and Save" option with Amazon.

I have a little Jack Russell and a Chihuahua/Daschund mix, and they both go crazy for these.  I feel good giving these treats to my dogs because they're all natural and it's good stuff they're eating.  They don't last long though....they chew them up in about a minute.  They also love the banana/chicken and apple/chicken.  The banana ones are probably their favorite.

"Sweet potatoes?! My dog will eat sweet potatoes????"Yes, you may be surprised!!  I've fed my English Bulldog pup more treats than I care to mention and these are his favorite.  An especially a good choice for dogs with allergies!  From a taste standpoint, if he had his way he would eat the whole bag.  This is the closest thing to "scraps" that I've intentionally fed my dog.  From a health standpoint, bullies are know for their skin problems.  Kingston's coat is very shiny and his eyes and nails look great, too.  Due to his breed's susceptibility to hip dysplasia I also plan to try the Dogswell Veggie Life Happy Hips Sweet Potato Chews Dog Treats (15 oz.).  But with 6 bags, each holding 10- 15 treats, this has lasted me a while.  RECOMMENDED!!!

I have two 13-20 pound dogs (Yorkie-Poodle and Chihuahua-Doxie mixes) and these treats are perfect for their size.  The look and smell like dehydrated apricot with banana.  If I didn't know they were dog food, I could be fooled.The only thing that wasn't mentioned in the description is the place of manufacturing.  I would feel more comfortable with their claim of "natural" and "healthy" if I knew where they were made.Edit:  Once you open the package, you should put them in the refrigerator, as a previous reviewer stated.  I found that one of the pieces had gone bad (which, in turn, shows that they have very few preservatives).

column9: Look so healthy but made in China!
column10: I liked these treats for my dog and he seemed to find them very tasty.  Then I read they were made in China -- given other pet food product issues that originated there, I threw the several bags purchased away.

column9: A favorite for every dog that has had them !
column10: I have several adopted dogs and in my circle of friends, we have over 25 dogs combined (mostly rescues and adoptions).  This treat is everyone's favorite !  And, while they are "not for human consumption", I will admit that I find them very tasty also.If you haven't tried them, I encourage you to do so.  The price is right and the babies can't get enough !

column9: Al sweet potato chews mot created equal
column10: The Dogington Post issued a warning about Dogswell sweet potato chews.  This product comes from China.  The Veterinary Information Network lists four such products as implicated in the poisoning of dogs eating them.  This product is one of them and should not be given to our pets.
Had an issue with the chicken breast treats, so would not use these, since they are produced in China as well.
I wish I read the reviews closer before feeding these to my dogs.  These are made in China and you can draw your own conclusions.

I blended it very well using a blendy bottle, which is a 28oz bottle that contains a coiled circular spring inside that slices through the water, stirring with every shake.  While I can't comment on how well it tastes if you mix and let settle for long periods of time, I never had an issue with clumping or not having enough flavor.As for flavors, all I bought were pretty tasty.  I ordered cherry, orange, lemon-lime, strawberry, and grape all at once when there was a decent sale going.  this was in september 2009.Even though you don't need much powder to get a good taste, the company doesn't give any estimation as to how much you should use or how much a bottle makes.  With that in mind at the price its at, I find it hard to give this product more than 3 stars.  If it was four dollars I'd think it was a steal and easily give another star, as I estimate each jar will make upwards of 2-3 gallons, maybe more if used sparingly. at $9.95, sorry, I just can't.  I'm back to my old ways of using a touch of stevia from packets to sweeten my water and topping it off with whichever citrus fruits are on sale (a squeeze of lemon, lime, or orange for flavor).

I couldn't figure out what may be causing this in my diet till I realized that the only thing I was doing different was the drink mix. When I stopped taking it the symptoms lingered for a few days till the product was out of my system. I would not recommend this product to anyone.

column10: My favorite meal of the day is breakfast and I absolutely love cereal.  I was diagnosed with Celiac disease 5 years ago and have been a on a gluten free diet ever since. I have tried pretty much every gluten free cereal out there and I have not been satisfied with any of them.  This is by far the BEST cereal I have had in years. If you read the ingredients, the strawberries are NOT organic, however the title and description lead one to believe the product is organic.  Strawberries are at the top of the list of pesticide containing fruits, and it is a shame that a company that prints on their cereal boxes "Since 1966, Erewhon has led the organic revolution and we remain passionately committed to providing the purest organic foods...", would cheap out and put NON-organic strawberries in their cereal.  If you don't care about eating organic, then enjoy; the taste is okay. column10: I am a big fan of hearty oatmeal.  I use Quaker oats for baking, but for a winter's breakfast, I want substance and flavor.  I've been eating and loving McCann's Irish Oatmeal for years. This product is labeled for the U.K. market in which every kitchen has a scale, apparently, so you are on your own to figure out the best water-oats ratio.  It cooks quickly, so it may be similar to McCann's quicker-cooking oats (in the box; I've never tried those).  This bag is not resealable, so you will need a separate container or self-sealing bag to store it.  Several months later, most of my package is in my freezer and I'll probably end up tossing it.  If you are interested, this package weighs 1 kg and here is a price comparison:  Alford Organic Pinhead Oatmeal $7.99/35.27 oz. = $0.227 per oz.  vs. McCann's Irish Oatmeal (in package of 4 handy cans) $25.07/112 oz. = $0.223/oz + free shipping.

The Oatmeal of Alford's Organic Pinhead Oats are almost as good. They cook way faster than McCann's and have more flavour and a better bite. I would recommend these oats if you like Haemlyn's and can't find it. I also like that the Alford's Oats are organic. I add flaxseed meal and nuts and berries and it's quite a delicious nutritious breakfast. I don't feel hungry until lunch and I've got plenty of energy.Organic Pinhead Oatmeal of Alford Stonecut Oatmeal by ChefShop.com

column9: Precooked was not the way to go...
column10: I really wanted to love this item. I have ordered from Burgers before. Their precooked smoked turkey is excellent. But I did not enjoy this prime rib. Why? I bought the 4-5 lb roast for Christmas dinner. I let it thaw in the refrigerator for 4 days and then set it on the counter for two hours to bring it up to room temperature so it would reheat evenly. I followed the instructions that came with the roast, preheated the oven and let it cook for about an hour at 350 degrees. As I was busy preparing the rest of the meal I felt confident the prime rib would turn out fine since it was already cooked. As I was finishing up the rest of the cooking in that last dash of chaos to get everything out on time I finally checked the temperature of the meat and was shocked to find it was only 80 degrees in the center!I know for a fact the entire prime rib was thawed so there is no way it was still cold in the middle before I put it in the oven. I didn't panic. Since my guests were waiting and everything else was finished I had to get this meat up to temperature quickly (to at least warm) in the center without ruining the perfect red color of medium rare. Unfortunately that meant putting this beautiful and EXPENSIVE piece of meat in the microwave. I had to run it on high for 1 minute intervals, constantly opening and closing the door until I got the center to 110 or so - at least so my guests thought it was warmed through. Because of how big the roast was, that process took about 10 extra minutes. Obviously it is impossible to cook a prime rib evenly in the microwave so I ended up with overcooked ends, well done second and third slices and a slightly pink center.As for the taste...what were they thinking? I tasted like it was injected with highly concentrated au jus. Each bite was too salty for my taste and there was a heavy flavor of beef broth and rosemary. I wanted to taste the beef, not the seasonings. It reminded me a little of carved roast beef you get in a cheaper chain buffet restaurant or cafeteria like Golden Corral.Are there any positives? Yes, I can't say I hated it outright. The meat itself was tender as a prime rib should be and the flavor while a bit overpowering, was edible. In fact, my in-laws said they liked it a lot (but maybe they were just being nice). Also, it was much bigger than I thought - that's a good thing. It easily fed 6 people and there was enough left for another 5 or 6 more slices.But for the $115 I paid I probably could have had the same results from my grocery store meat case. Sorry Burgers. I like your products but you blew it on this one. I won't be buying a precooked prime rib from you again.

I won't kid you there is nothing better than a real hot dog.  I love hot dogs but because of health reasons my husband &I had to cut back.  We tried linketts and found they are an excellant substitute.  Now we can have hot dogsdogs any time we want& during foot ball season that is all the time. Kraut dogs you can't tell the difference between linketts & the real thing. I 'am happy & so is my stomache.  GramaMP.S. You can freeze them & take out as needed.

I was buying this items at my local health food or grocery stores but the price went up so much that I looked for an alternative way to purchase them.  I found them on Amazon and I'm much happier with the price.  My family has enjoyed this product for years.  We love the flavor and texture...more like the real thing.  I've tried other meatless hotdogs but I prefer the taste of Loma Linda Linketts.  We like buying them in the large, economical cans and then freeze them so they remain fresh.

These Linketts are awesome! We used to have these in school. Even though the linketts are somewhat small,you get a bunch of them in the 96oz can. The smell of these things cooking will make your stomach start growling and your mouth watering.
Finely found where I can get theses, I love theses Vegan hot dogs I was introduced to them from church family when I was a little kid, this is the only place around here to find them, thanks!!!

column9: Perhaps the worst "hot dog" I've ever eaten
column10: First, these "hot dogs" are basically tastless but, on top of that, they are like biting into mush-ECH!Since a medical problem three years ago changed my diet, I have tried lots of "vegan" product substitues - hamburgers, beef and chicken bites, ham and more but this is by far the worst substitue product I have ever tried.I have no idea where the people reviewing this product are from (usually, a compamy only puts one or two "ringers" on the review page) but they have to have no taste what-so-ever.Maybe if Loma reduced the water content of the product, a firmer texture would definitly be an improvement.The only reason I gave it two stars is that, being vegan, I'm sure it won't kill me.
I love the bumble bees.  They are very cute and look great on my bee hive cake.  I hope that I can get more of these in the future when I run out of them.

The sugar bumble bees are so well made.  I am a beekeeper and used them on a cake that I brought to our county beekeeper meeting and of course they loved the bee decorations. I used the extra bees to decorate cookies for my grandchildren......and now I have to buy more.  I highly recommend these sugar bees because they ar eso well made, shipped superfast, and so well packaged in a case container.
The little bees are adorable and exactly what I had expected.My two year old grandson was really excited when they arrived he can't wait to eat them.

I was very pleased with the packaging and the arrival of the product!  They are great and were just what I was looking for to top my daughter's beehive birthday cake!  Thank you!! I will definitely buy again.
Cute product and went nicely for my bumblebeecupcakes. Toppers were easy to chew as well andnot hard as a rock
ordered these for my giveaway cake-toppers, and they were a success. tasted much as sugar, nothing chemically weird about it.

column9: so cute - created lots of buzz
column10: I loved these and ordered more for future baking.  I baked a bee hive shaped honey lemon cake, drizzled with honey glaze and put these bees all over the cake and then placed the cake on green coconut with more bees in the "grass"...kids and adults loved it at my church dinner...this cake created lots of BUZZ!
Came in good timing and made my blah cupcakes look cute! Used them for a Baby shower bumble bee theme!
very cute little bees to decorate the cake I made for my 1 y.o. birthday party.everybody was making nice comments on them...ah! they taste really good too:-)

These crackers aren't meant to eat naked; they are too dry and aren't salted.  They are sturdy and rather thick, which is exactly what you need in an hors d'oeuvre cracker.  The rosemary taste is subtle, but still comes through with other toppings.  None of the crackers broke while I smeared stiff, cold, un-whipped cream cheese on the top, although a few were already broken in the box.  I prepared mine with a basil cream cheese and smoked salmon; I received rave reviews from my friends.  With 2 grams of protein in 3 crackers, they are quite filling.  Try some at your next gathering!
This product is tasty while at the same time is healty and satisfying as an alternate for junk food.  I would recommend everyone to try it and it also comes in other different flavors.
The cookies are out-standing,made in Canada. Not available in Texas. Will be ordering more soon.Made with real maple syrup.  Thank-you.

Being a baker, I really don't like many prepackaged cookies with the exception of Nutter Butters and now these.  The cookie is delightful--deliciously smooth maple cream sandwiched between slightly sweet (with a hint of salt) wheat cookies. And they're pretty too! I could seriously eat the entire box in a day....which is why I only buy them one box at a time!

Do not buy these if you don't like the taste of maple.  Open the bag and the scent of maple wafts through the air.  The leaf shaped cookies are crisp, the cream filling moist, but more importantly, all are flavored with maple. Not scented,  flavored, it comes through and melts on your tongue in a most delicious experience.  You only need one or two to satisfy your sweet tooth.

column4: S. de la Haye "The Texan Canadian"
column10: I may be biased, being a relocated Canadian, but these cookies are wonderful.  They are always moist and flavourful, but not too sweet.  I highly recommend them!

column9: Peanut free; Tree nut free; DELICOUS
column10: The DARE line of cookies that I have found so far are DELICOUS!  I have a child who is anaphylactic to peanuts, tree nuts, sesasme and shellfish.  These cookies are a GIFT!  I don't always have time to bake with a very busy household.  I learned of these Canadian cookies and decided to try them.  I purchased one bag at the supermarket before investing in a package of 12 Maple flavor from Amazon.  We all love them!  I wish there was a variety pack that I could purchase as they have many other flavors; lemon, fudge, coconut, cinamon.  DARE also has a brand called Bear Paws which are pre-packed in pairs and are great for the kids' lunches.  We also use the Bear Paws to make icecream sandwiches.  I wish Amazon carried DARE's Bear Paws.  Please always read the label if you live with food allergies!  These are a winner!

These are not as pictured on the box. They are not full of creamy white filling. The filling is dark and very thin, no where near the edge of the cookie. The maple smell and flavor is very light. No real maple taste either. I bought these after the Dollar Tree quit selling the REAL original Manning's Cookie Shop Maple Leaf Creme Cookies. These are about like the cheap knockoffs that Interbake Foods produces and sold for a short time at the D.T. These were packaged excellent. Processing was very slow. 8 days for processing, 2 for shipping. ALSO had attempted fraud problems with my c.c. after this order. I would not recommend this product or the related companies (Dare foods,Foodservice Direct) to anyone.
Same wonderful taste as those sold in the Canadian providences, however, MUCH cheaper!!  I will purchase these for special memories of a great vacation.

A great way for a Canadian company to get the attention of US folks at a US based trade show.I put out these cookies when I was recruiting for my school in Canada and I tweeted the attendees.  Tons of people came by to check it out and enjoy some real canadian maple cookies.
They have an authentic maple taste. These cookies were a great value. Most cookies arrived intact despite the shipping. What more can I say?
I adore Dare's maple leaf cookies. They're a real treat if you like maple, which is my favorite flavor for absolutely anything :) I highly recommend these!
Cookies are delicious and make a nice after dinner treat. They really have a maple flavor and are nice and crisp.

The cookies have been and always will be delicious.  Amazon sent 12 boxes to me so I could Share The Love!!  They came in a secure and timely fashion.  I would certainly buy from Amazon again and would buy these cookies, without a doubt, again!!

We discovered Dare Maple Cookies in Canada and ordered a case when we returned to Michigan.  The cookies were great, even though several boxes were less than fresh and crisp (they were soft).  Another problem was that many of the cookies in each box (all the cookies in some boxes) arrived crushed.  Packaging needs to be addressed.

These cookies are ok, Not much filling and maple flavor.  There is not as much maple flavor as I had hoped for. The Turkey Hill brand is still by far the best maple cookie I have encountered. But one can only get this product directly from Canada as amazon does not carry this brand.
I have tried these when I visited Canada before and the Maple leaf cookies are very delicious. The flavor and taste of fresh maple leaf is unbeatable!

These are truly delightful cookies, but happily they are not addictive because this manufacturer (family owned or not) is pricing themselves right out of existence. In 2005, one could find them for less than $17/12 pack. In June of 2010, I bought them from Amazon for about $32 for a 12 pack. Now (Sept 2010) they are listed here at essentially $60 for the 12 pack. Almost a 4x increase in price in 5 years and doubling in a few months is beyond the pale. They've become a caviar that I will live without.9/10/2010 - to be fair to the company, the huge delta on price is because Amazon no longer carries this item but it is now through a seller. I discovered a local supermarket will provide them at $32.50 for 12. Dare Co is not culpable.

My only complaint is that the cookies I ordered on June 19, 2010 are separated from the cream.  I love the taste, but I have to piece together the cookie with the cream in order to eat it.  One side of the cream is attached to a cookie and the other side is not.  I shouldn't have to piece the cookie together in order to eat it.  This may have been the result of a bad batch of cookies, or perhaps occurred during shipping--in any case, I am reluctant to re-order them.

I used to eat these a lot when i lived in the UK and am eagerly awaiting their arrival here in the states. You can order them from England and Canada but the shipping is 20x the cost of the packets.These taste great -- a hint of prawn, or something -- and melt on your tongue. Please hurry up and stock them already.

column9: Lousiest chips you can ever have
column10: My favorite flavor of chips happens to be Jalapeno. I have sampled dozens of different brands of Jalapeno flavored chips. This was my first time trying out this brand, and I can tell you that these were the worst jalapeno flavored chips I have ever tasted in my life. They smelled and tasted of stale oil and there was not even the slightest taste of jalapeno in the chips, whatsoever. They were excessively salty and greasy. Needless to say that I dumped the entire bag in the garbage bin after the first handful. Oh, by the way the one-star rating is only because it is not possible to write a review without selecting at least one star. They don't deserve any.

Amazing - our puppy won't touch his dog food for three days. We had been spoiling him with treats.  Once we sprinkled the Liver Biscotti on his dog food he finished his bowl every time.  Problem solved and greatly reduced treats.
The dogs will do anything for this stuff.  They love it.  I have to put it up so they don't treat themselves.

A FEW SHAKES OF THIS DOG TREAT ON THE SAME OLD DOG FOOD GAVE RENEWED INTEREST IN EATING. MY GOLDEN RETRIEVER IS VERY ILL. HE WAS NOT EATING WELL. MY SON USES THIS AS A TREAT FOR HIS DOGS.  WE GAVE MY OLD BOY A DISH OF GOOD QUALITY KIBBLES AND BITS AND HE ATE EVERY BIT EVERY TIME WE DID IT.

This is it, the holy grail of dog powders to convince dogs that they can work!I pour it on dried hotdogs and it works! clients complain that the dogs love me. The dogs love this stuff. Happy to find on A, hard to find item. One bottle lasted3- 4 years.Buy it, it works great. doglady oregon

i remembered how GOOD this tasted now yuumm worth trying folks !!!  mmmmmm i had missed it !!! the only thing i take issue with that is that with this price for shipping i will have to spare my mantis that i buy on here because the shipping is costly, if i'm not remembering wrong we used to buy these from stores back in the country like 3 bucks for the most depending on the store, sale stores were selling like 2 a package.....i think that price is SUPER good for what this tastes like. Cook it up with some garlic yogurt and some sizzling butter with red pepper and mint seasoning mix....and enjoy !!!

Living with Celiac Disease can be tricky when I'm away from home, but at home it's not so bad.  I was never a big fan of bread or other baked goods - I seem to have instinctively avoided them my whole life.  But I do love spaghetti and I really missed it.  I discovered Pastariso about twelve years ago in my favorite health food store  and used to buy it for my son.  It was so good, I could serve it to the whole family without complaint from anyone.  When I was recently diagnosed with Celiac myself, I couldn't find it in any of the stores in my area.  I am so glad I found it on Amazon.  Pastariso is just as good as I remember.  It is delicious with even the mildest-tasting sauce or even just garlic butter.  And it even has a lower glycemic index than wheat spaghetti and is more nutritious.  You just can't beat that.  By the way, I got free shipping by buying two cases (that's only twelve packages in total), so it ended up costing much less than anything I could find in my local stores.

I have bought many brands of Gluten free pasta and this brand is one of the best. You cook it in less time otherwise the pasta is gummy. The price in the grocery stores for a comparable Gluten free pasta is very expensive. I like this brand and the price is very inexpensive.

this spaghetti is our GF favorite, at a reasonable price to boot.  It is a throw back to the white pasta i grew up on.i only gave it four stars, b/c we don't love it, but we do like it.  in our book, thus far, there is no substitute for the texture and flavor of whole wheat pasta.

column9: A Very Different, Very Interesting Tea
column10: Up front, I will say that this tea type is one that you'll will either like a lot or not at all. I would suggest that you try it in a small quantity. This tea has a very deep flavor. Dry, in the package, it smells for all the world like BBQ sauce. Brewed; it still retains a smoky aroma. The tea benefits from sugar. It is a very robust, very exotic, deep-tasting tea that could replace coffee as a wake-up beverage.

column9: Adds a touch of class to ice cream
column10: This product adds a touch of real flavor to normally bland ice cream. The flavors make a real fruitflavor come alive and add excitement to any dish.
The product was delivered very quickly. I really like good chocolate and Dove chocolate bars are much better than regular Hershey or Mars or other regular (cheap) chocolate.

McCann's Irish Oatmeal has more texture, fiber and flavor than your garden variety oatmeal; I think it's the best. I like to add dried fruit and raisins to it sometimes, or you can throw in brown sugar, cinnamon and nutmeg if you like. By the way, I can verify that it's true what they say about oatmeal's ability to lower cholesterol; my total cholesterol dropped some 30+ pts this winter (yes we had winter here in FL). Thank you McCann's, for a great product!

This product is great. You get the benefit of the fiber in the steel cut oat with only a 7 mintues cook time vs. 20+ minutes. I think it needs just a pinch of salt added, but this is great to because you control how much salt is in it vs. the traditional oatmeal that is full of salt. I was able to purchase it once at the store then they quit carring it. So I found it here on Amazon.

Quite simply, after trying many healthy oatmeals, McCann's is the best one I've found.  The "Quick & Easy" on it's label tells the truth.  And, the health benefits of this product absolutely work for me.  It's a terrific breakfast food.

column9: Favorite Breakfast of a Lazy Cook
column10: I love a healthy nutritious breakfast but hate spending any time on preparation.  I was delighted to find McCann's Steel Cut Irish Oatmeal, Quick and Easy since I prefer steel cut to rolled oats.I have this every morning (I posted a picture of the nutritional label) and prepare 3/8 of a cup of oatmeal with 3/4 cup of water in the microwave for 5 minutes but at 40% power to prevent over boiling.  It gives me a really good consistency and I add Splenda, lots of cinnamon and canned pumpkin puree along with whatever fresh fruit I have around.  It's delicious and for just over 300 calories, prepared this way, I have a breakfast that doesn't play havoc with my blood sugar and keeps me satisfied till lunch.I will admit that my little dog stands in line for her fair share of a couple of spoonfuls in her dish.  She loves it and I think it is a nutritious way to start her day too.

My McCanns Steel Cut Oats arrived in great condition and a day sooner than expected.  As for the oats...I hesitate to even call this oatmeal.  I do not like regular rolled oats...to me they are mushy and icky.My mom was extolling the virtues of steel cut oats and to silence her I tried some.  Ohhh, they were wonderful - nothing like normal oatmeal.The texture is different and it has a slightly nutty flavor...great!!And, after a month of regular oat eating my cholesterol has dropped a couple of points.

column9: Best of Both Worlds - Steel Cut but Quick!
column10: We LOVE steel cut oats, but I have a preschooler who doesn't like to wait for his oatmeal to cook 35 minutes.  This is a wonderful version of it that cooks in 5 min.  My whole family likes it as well as guests we've had.  Steel cut oats have a "nuttier" texture than traditional oats.
I will NEVER go back to the thick, tasteless rolled oats we get here! I add a little honey and a dab of butter, and this is the absolute best!

I just tried this for the first time today.  This is the best oatmeal ever.  The texture reminds me of grits almost.  Just a dab of brown sugar and it's amazing the taste! It is so easy to make.  It beats rolled oats by far!

This is a very good oatmeal.  I normally eat steel cut oats and noticed these have a quicker cooking time than the original style oats.  My wife picked this up for me, and after trying it, I can attest that it does cook quickly.  It has a little different texture than regular steel cut oats, which are crunchier and nuttier.  These are cut a little finer than the regular steel cuts, which would probably account for the quicker cooking time.For the consumer who has previously tried steel cut oats and Scottish oatmeal, the texture of these oats are in between the two.  They're not cut quite as fine as Scottish oats, but they're definitely cut finer than regular steel cuts.Overall, these are definitely worth a try.  I would still prefer the crunchier texture of regular steel cut oats, but these are definitely worth giving a try, especially if you don't want to have a long cooking time.
All the benefits of slow-cooking real steel cut oats combined with getting your cereal in 5 minutes rather than a half hour.  Really!!

I love this oatmeal, and eat it daily with hot pure maple syrup and whole milk.  I gave it 4 instead of 5 stars because if one cooks it according to instructions, it cooks to the pan.  My successful proportions are 1 cup of water to 1/3 cup oats - bring water to boil, add oats, turn to lowest heat (should still bubble) and cook uncovered for 7 minutes.  I use a stainless steel pot on top of the stove.  I would suggest to anyone not familiar with this oatmeal and just trying it to eat it for breakfast daily for 45 days and see if you begin to notice a dramatic positive change in your system after the first 30 days.  That is what I did, and it made me decide that this would be my breakfast indefinitely.

I like oatmeal, simple as that. I love steel cut Irish oatmeal the best, but mostly didn't use it as it takes 30-minutes to cook... until I found this! Yahoo! 5-minutes and Bob's-your-uncle! I've found that for my wife and I, recommended oatmeal portions are a bit too much so I cut back:0.5 cup McCann's Quick & Easy1.5 cup waterBoil water, add oats, bring back to boil, turn fire way down and almost completely cover pot (leave some open space!), 5-minutes later off with the gas, 1-minute later stir and serve. Consistency like grainy Cream of Wheat.Best with honey and cream, but great alone!
Buy this product.  It's healthy.  It tastes great - so much better than rolled oats.  I lost 15 pounds by eating oatmeal every morning for 3 months and my cholesterol is now lower too.
This oatmeal is the best we have found. It's always GOOD and cooks great! Love the 5 minute one. We soak it overnight and it works great and tastes wonderful! Good price too!

I eat these occasionally and I think there OK, but I'm not a oatmeal aficionado.  However, my wife loves McCann's, particularly in the winter.  The best thing about these is that they are relatively quick and easy to prepare compared to the regular steel-cut oatmeal.  It makes it practical to eat them during the working week since we both work.
Great aroma, great texture, great taste, great to take the chill out of a cool autumn morning. There's something unique in McCann steel cut oats. Why haven't we met before now??

No need to stir McCann's for 30 minutes anymore. This product maintains the same quality as the original in a fraction of the time. The taste and quality are excellent and I fully recommend it to anybody who loves oatmeal.
The steel-cut oatmeal has the best taste and texture, and the Quick & Easy is exactly that!

My husband and I have eaten McCann's steel cut oatmeal for years but with the original long cooking kind, we had to plan ahead to have it. This quick & easy variety makes it easy to have this oatmeal in just a few minutes. We love the chewey texture of McCann's. This oatmeal can be used any way the other oatmeals can. Try in oatmeal & raisin cookies, the best ever!
This is the best oatmeal ever!  I love it!  It isn't %100 instant, but it cooks quick and it taste great.

Trying to watch blood sugar and this is one of the good carbs that is a slow burn instead of grits in the morning.  I ignored oatmeal my entire life because I am not into sweets for breakfast.  Then someone suggested I fix this "savory" instead of sweet.  So after cooking, I add a little healthy olive oil margarine, a little salt and break up a Morningstar Spicy Veggie Sausage patty into it.  Just fabulous!
Love the roughness of these Oats.  The price is amazing as compared to in the regular grocery store.  Very happy with this product.  Always in my pantry.

I had tried several other McCann's Irish Oatmeal products and decided to go healthy and order the 6-pack of the Canisters.  Pretty good but didn't seem to be quite the consistency and flavor I remember enjoying from the boxed Quick Oats or the Long cooking variety.  I'll hang in there and keep cooking it.
The Oatmeal is great but when you go to put in the microwave it has a tendency to boil over, so use a bigger bowl than you think you need or you will be cleaning up a mess.

I first heard about this cereal 3 years ago and have eaten it EVERY morning since then! A delicious, filling but not bloated breakfast that gets me started every day. I take a little more than a third of a cup and place  it in a DEEP dish rectangular microwave safe bowl with about three quarters cup of water for 6 minutes and 10 seconds. Make sure the bowl you place it in is DEEP or it will bubble over and cause a mess. My bowl is over 3.5 inches deep. You will get to experiment with how much oatmeal you want to eat and how much water is right to mix with it but it will come out great for sure! As soon as it is out of the microwave I mix some sugar free hazelnut creamer and stir it up and I am ready for a great breakfast. I will sometimes mix in blueberries or raisins but this oatmeal is the best I have ever eaten and will have this the rest of my life;..it is THAT good!! Enjoy
Great product and worth the extra money.  McCann's steel cut oatmeal gives you energy longer than typical oatmeal on the market.

Steel cut oats are a great slow carb - even better for you than microwave or quick oats. And this 5 minute variety by McCann is a good compromise between their 3 minute quick oats and the 30 minute traditional slow cook oats.  Easy to make.  I use water, not milk.  Just heat your water, add your oats, stir occasionally for 5 minutes, and you're done.  You can even cook more than you need and microwave the leftovers.  Add some wheat germ for extra deliciousness and fiber.  And maybe some fresh cut strawberries.  If you need sweetener, honey and cinnamon are tasty additions.  I ordered a six-pack of canisters online through Amazon, because I have not been able to find these at grocery stores in my area.  These are a great value on Amazon.

McCann's Oatmeal is delicious. I do recommend taking the time to setup a slow cooker and cooking it overnight. The taste is much better and if you make a batch at the beginning of the week it can last all week.Tastes great and is healthy!

I have used this product before and then I switched to the long-cooking product (30 min.).  The long-cooking oatmealwas not as good as the fast-cooking.  The consistency was better and the quick-cooking method fit into my busyschedule.
Great Product!! takes 5 minutes to make..and I have a hearty breakfast :)My cholesterol levels have fallen by 150 points since I started this eating this.

I don't have the patience to cook traditional oatmeal for 30 minutes.  When I saw McAnn's 5 minute oatmeal I decided to try it and I have never purchased any other brand since.  This oatmeal is several levels of flavor better than any other oatmeal I have eaten.  It is so good I am now wondering if the 30 minute oatmeal if worth trying.

Great oatmeal. THIS is the oatmeal(steel cut) they speak of when referring to "oatmeal" reducing peoples cholesterol. I use to buy at Wal-mart......but they stopped carrying it and now stock ALL the shelves with Quaker. Guess THIS product was taking Quakers market-share. SHAME on Wal-mart for bowing to pressure from the giant food conglomerates. HOORAY for Amazon.com!!!
Healthy, good tasting, quick and easy to make... does it get any better than this? And I forgot to mention, they were a great price by buying them here!
Great taste now able to enjoy quickly. Cooks fast but the same taste as the slow cook kind. It actually takes about six minutes.

Fundamentally different from the Quaker-type oats you're probably used to (at least, if you're an American). More nutritious, better-tasting, yet no more trouble to make than 'Quaker instant' or other 'instant' hot breakfast cereals. Get some genuine maple syrup to sweeten it (Amazon sells it) - it goes well with this product. Add a bit of butter, cream, and some fruit.
I use a tad more cereal for the same amount of water than called for in the directions. It is really very tasty, a nice nutty flavor.

McCann's steel cut oats is a delicious product, far removed form the "ordinary" rolled oats, and quick cook variety.The time to cook the oatmeal is an investment in eating enjoyment. Add a bit of ample syrup, fruit & nuts ****  well just try it.

You have to know that this is not the traditional, instant oatmeal. If you buy this and are expecting Quaker oats, don't purchase. That said, if you want a natural, wholesome oatmeal, this is what you should buy. The six-pack is a better deal than buying a single container at the grocery. It is rather bland on its own but I suggest adding some dried fruit, jam, or sugar and cinnamon. This oatmeal is very good and a great way to start my day!
This is an excellent way to start the day.  I love oatmeal.  This, by far, is the best I've had.

This wasn't all that easy for me to get made properly.  I have a 1100 watt microwave and it took me some trial and error to get it to work right.  The first try using the instructions resulted in big overflow, despite being in a very large bowl.  After a few trys I found one and a half minutes at 60% power stir and repeat works reasonably well.  It is pretty flavorless, so I throw in some cinnamon to add some flavor.

column9: Different from old fashion oats, but still good!
column10: I've been having oatmeal for breakfast for years. Since my cholesterol is not excitingly high, I take oatmeal only on most weekdays, and have heartier breakfast on weekends. After reading some great reviews about Steel Cut oatmeal, I decided to give McCANN'S Steel Cut Irish Oatmeal, Quick & Easy, a try.Well it sure is different from the old fashioned rolled oats. It's quicker to cook (claim to take only 5 min). However, since I don't want to spend time watching oatmeal on the stove or microwave, I cook the McCANN's Quick & Easy version the same way I cook the old fashion oatmeal: in the previous night, add oatmeal and hot water to a pot, bring to a boil, them turn the stove off and cover the pot. The next morning reheat it in a bowl in the microwave for 2 min. This way it's quick, and it never boils over. The Steel Cut oat has finer but crunchier texture than the old fashioned rolled oats. It also tastes nuttier. Some people prefer the steel cut. I actually prefer the old fashion because it is gummier and mix better with some sweet addition such as fruits and jam. But since I usually just add maple syrup for a quick breakfast, the steel cut irish oatmeal is almost just as good. After all, one needs some change when having the same oat 200 days a year.

column9: McCann's Steel Cut Irish Otmeal Quick and Easy
column10: McCann's Steel Cut Irish Oatmeal, Quick and Easy is the Best Oatmeal Money Can Buy.It is Healthy and Very Good For You. I eat it every day for Breakfast!I highly recommend it.

I REALLY love oatmeal, not the creamy style, but al dente, nutty, crunchy style.  Based on all the reviews, I was sure I'd love the McCann's.  I experimented with the McCann's today, and I have to say that I don't like them at all.  Regardless of proportions or how I cooked them, they seemed to my taste to be gritty (they are chopped really fine) and not very flavorful.  Sad to say, Amazon won't accept returns of Grocery products.I much prefer the WalMart generic Old Fashioned oats, measured 1 to 1 with water, and cooked quickly until the water is gone.  Let them stand (covered) for 5 minutes and there it is:-)
Great Product.  Cannot go wrong with buying this bulk kitchen condiment.  Great addition to any kitchen - and being a Tones product you know the quality is good as well.

I have some of this Tones Garlic and Pepper Blend in the house that I bought elsewhere online.  I am a self confessed garlic fiend, and I use it in just about everything its possible too.  I also have some regular granulated garlic in the house as well.  I decided to try this when I came across it at the spice place that I was shopping at.  This blend is very zesty, spicy, and remains garlicky even with all the other ingredients.  It's really good, and frankly its the best I have tried in a garlic blend of any kind.  If you like garlic like I do, it's my opinion that you will like this alternative on occasion.  Just remember to use it a little more sparingly than your regular garlic powder.  With the added pepper and other spices, its got a definite punch.  And one last thing, this goes for a couple of dollars cheaper at the spice place online I picked it up at.  However order two or more canisters at once and you get free shipping with Amazon at the time of this writing.  The best deal around considering that.  Recommended for the garlic lovers in your family, who want a little extra punch...  PS:  One more thing I feel I should mention about this blend.  It has a much heavier dose of salt in it than any regular garlic powder, or garlic pepper spice I have used in my opinion.  Tasty as it is, it should be used sparingly, or not at all by those concerned about sodium in their diet.  It's part of what makes the blend so delicious, but not so good for you either...

I tried these cookies at a GF expo.  The are delicious, especially the orange zest flavor, but very expensive.  Packaging was small and many of the cookies were broken.  I don't think I will be ordering them again.
I get these from our local Costco. At Costco they sell for $9.99 for 6 cans.Buyer be ware.

column9: A Welcome Addition to My Pantry.
column10: I found an interesting product at my local Costco Warehouse store. It's cans of Kirkland Signature premium chunk chicken breast packed in water. The individual cans are 12.5 ounces and the entire packet is six cans. I couldn't resist. I like to have things like this in the pantry because they can yield almost instant meals without the need to run to the market. Today, for example, I made up a batch of chicken with rice soup using a can of this chicken along with the seasoned water packing, some cut up baby carrots, celery and a brown/wild rice mixture plus a few spices from the kitchen cabinet. The whole thing was done in an hour and made up a delicious meal. So easy. Tasted great. Economical, too.This is excellent chicken and will lend itself to all kinds of dishes. It's tender and tasty and has a nice chunky appearance. It comes with a little starter recipe book and improvisations are welcome and easy. It's an excellent addition to my pantry.Gary Peterson

The chicken breast is part of my standard kitchen supply.  Although it is not like just cooked chicken, it is a good product...free of fat...tasty with curry etc over couscous or rice...makes a decent chicken salad sandwich.  I feel secure with it as part of my emergency supplies too...especially helpful when we were  without power for 5 days last OCTober.
Re: Durkee Liquid Smoke, 32-Ounce Packages (Pack of 3)Excellent service! This item arrived on time and as ordered. Will purchase again.
Checked prices of various liquid smoke products at various places/web sites and this was a great bargain for a name brand.

column9: just as good as beef ravioli
column10: The cheese ravioli are just as good as the beef, plus they come in the perfect size. one bite, no mess. Plus the Ravioli is great! I bought these thinking my kids might like them, but i am hooked. I eat at least 3/week. quick to make, delicious, cheap, nutricious, what more can you ask for. now if i can just get the kids to TRY them

Canned and jarred "cheese" ravioli are very hard to find in the stores, so I picked up a case from Amazon.  Although it does have an unexpected meat sauce (if I wanted meat, wouldn't I buy beef ravioli in the first place?), it's quite good.  I find I have to heat it a little longer than the package reads, but overall it's a great little snack or hold-me-over that can be carried in my purse or stored in my desk at work.  Good stuff.

Great product in easy to reheat packaging. I send these to my college daughter and they are always a hit on her dorm floor, especially for late night study sessions! Free shipping with Prime an added bonus! Thanks Amazon for making Mom a hero!

These are perfect for lunch and not bad in the calorie dept. I hate red sauce but, for some reason I like this one. Maybe b/c of the extra flavor meat adds to it. However, b/c it is in a meat sauce I only gave it 4 stars and not 5. I would prefer not to eat meat.
this cheese ravioli is my familys favorite! great tasting,has plenty in bowl for a quick lunch! would buy again.

WE RUN A CATERING AND EVENTS COMPANY AND USE THESE MOSTY FOR CHILDRENS PARTIES...THEY ARE EASY TO SERVE AND THE CHILDREN LOVE THE BOYARDEE PRODUCTS. WE CANT GET THEM FROM ANY SUPPLIER FOR WHAT AMAZON SELLS THEM FOR IN THE SUBSCRIBE&SAVE PROGRAM...AND THEY TASTE GOOD AS WELL.
I was disappointed with the item because I thought ordering the cheese Ravioli meant that it was a meatless product. The lettering for meat in the sauce is to small.
if u want a fast snack without cookin or makin a mess this is it for instant ravioli.

Chef Boyardee was a childhood favorite but I didn't remember ever getting plain cheese ravioli so I snagged some. I am not sure what kind of cheese it was but it over powered everything and not with a cheesy taste. I had 12 of them so to finish them off I gave a few of them to my cat and mixed a few with beef ravioli which worked out great.

Yea, thanks alot Amazon. I thought this was the cheese ravioli I buy in the store. WITHOUT MEAT SAUCE. Way to screw over the vegetarians, Amazon and Chef Boyardee both. :PI'll be thinking twice (and reading more) before I buy any other food on Amazon.

I bought this product because I thought it was CHEESE ravioli, but it has MEAT sauce in it. We are vegetarians so we were not able to use the 15 bowls of these I bought on Amazon. I had to give them to a charity. Amazon should clearly state in the product description that these are Cheese Ravioli's in MEAT sauce!

These are hard candy lollipops that are so yummy you just can't stop eating them. The flavor is very similar to actual cotton candy. I have ordered the variety pack as well, and those are also just as good. A few may come broken, but that is almost impossible to prevent due to the fact that they are being shipped. I still eat the broken ones, i just open them up and put them in a bowl, they are still good. They stay in the wrapper even if they break, so they are still clean. 12 bucks for 48 lollipops is a really fair price, so I don't think it's that big of a deal if a few come broken. I have ordered them about 3 or 4 times, and there's usually only about 5 or 6 that come broken. I have never seen them in any of the stores I shop at either. It's hard to find just good old fashion candy. They ship very fast and come in the manufacture box, with bubble wrap around it, in an Amazon box. I can't imagine there is much more they could do to prevent breakage anyway. I would recommend them for sure, you won't regret it.

These are yet another great sucker from Charms.I'd never had these before, (I usually pound down Blow Pops) and decided to give them a shot to keep some variety in my diet. I eat a lot of candy to deal with medication-induced nausea, and nothing beats it down faster, (and I do mean nothing) than very sweet candy. The sweeter the better.How do these taste? They are definitely cotton candyish. I say "ish" because they aren't exactly like it, but are close enough that you can taste it in there.
