This tea mainly tastes like mint and hibiscus--neither of which is particularly soothing in my book.  As compared to the wonderfully complex African Red Bush or the dazzlingly subtle Lotus, this one is not in the same league!! A middle of the road herbal tea.

My nutritionist suggested taking chamomile tea, and while searching the web I came accross this brand. unarrguably one of the most original teas you will taste. it gives a different feel and flavour then the traditional tea brands. The fact that its organic is an added benefit and there are no artificial additives. I would recommend this to everyone.

I love my single serve Kurig, but couldn't find a k cup to brew a STRONG 6-8 oz cup.  This is the strongest roast I've found with the best flavor (closest to a triple shot americano I can find), plus it's decaf, so you get all the best experience of the coffee with less caffeine!

If you are wanting  a strong coffee to make cappuccino, this will do the trick.  I use the 6 oz setting on my k-cup machine and froth my milk with an automatic milk frother.  Once combined, it is perfect!  Delicious!  You will not know it's decaf...very strong and flavorful.

column9: BEST cup of coffee I've ever had!
column10: I thought I'd splurge and try this coffee.  It costs much more than other decaf K-Cup options.  But I hoped that meant it was better coffee.  It IS better coffee.  I've never had a better cup of coffee than this.  It is excellent when compared to any other decaf or regular coffee I've tried.If you like BOLD, FLAVORFUL decaf coffee try this coffee and you'll really like it.

column9: A little harsh for my palate
column10: I love Italian roast coffee and wanted this in K-Cup pods to use in my Keurig maker. I have used San Francisco Bay's French Roast but could not get Italian roast in that brand. This brand is a close second to other, smoother brands of Italian roast and works well as a basis of my Latte's made with my HIC milk frother. My order arrived on time as expected with Amazon Prime.

column9: Over the Moon for these pies!
column10: My best friend is very, very ill and when I went to visit her in South Carolina she said she would loveeeee an orange moon pie...since we could not find them I went immediately to Amazon and there they were. I had them shipped to her and it made her smile, which is a very good thing. Thank  you, thank you, thank you.

I saw them and thought "Gasp!  Popcorn balls!  I love this time of year!"I bought two.I think I just chipped a tooth.These are really delicious, but they need about 50% less sugar-coating, as they are, they'll be tough for adults, and near impossible for kids.  I was hoping for better, but these missed the mark.  They're 1/2 popcorn, 1/2 clear jolly rancher.

I've been using Satin Ice for a year now on my cakes.  I purchase it from local bakery supplies stores as well as online.  It is nice and smooth, soft and pliable. It doesn't require much kneading and tastes like vanilla, a bit on the sweet side though.  If old (over a year), it will taste rancid and be a bit hard but can still be rolled out.  Wilton brand rolled fondant is gross tasting and not as soft and pliable.  Marshmellow fondant is more pasty tasting and gummier.

Satin Ice is the best tasting fondant I can find on the market.  It's a little more sticky than other types of fondant but you can keep it from sticking to your hands by rubbing some crisco on your hands before working with the fondant.

column9: Quick Delivery and Very Easy to work with!
column10: I had to complete a wedding cake and needed black fondant. I was so happy when I found Satin Ice. It was black, tastes way better than white fondant and was very very easy to work with. Awesome item and highly reccommended!

I have been using Satin Ice for many years, but lately, the quality has diminished. Cracks appear almost immediately. There is little to do but to start over and pray. That is unacceptable. I will be researching alternatives for my business. [...]

Oh man. These little cans of goose liver pate...oh man. Cheap in price alone. Great product, brilliant taste, excellent for parties. Great for beef wellington. Just a damn fine product all around.  I love this stuff. Can't get enough of it.

column9: Great for what it is made for
column10: First of all, these little cans are NOT fine dining.  It is, after all, a $2.50 snack.  That said, for $2.50--I love these things.  Great on a chip or a cracker for a little snack or pre meal appetizer.  I love the review that said to use it on Beef Wellington--which is a GREAT idea.  If you think you are going to get a fine piece of French Foi Gras, do not buy this.  If you want a great little Grocery Store quality can of spread that is fine to serve at parties or for snacking with a glass of wine, some cheese, and various things on crackers--This is perfect.  My wife and I like to have what we call "pick up dinners" where we buy some meats (like Cappacola) and cheeses and make some hummus, and get some french bread (cuban bread) that we make into crustini and maybe some olives or tapenade and set them out on ice packs on the counter and just nibble all evening.  I love to have a can or 2 of this for this type of meal.  It is great when watching a movie on a slow night!  Sometimes I just eat it out of the can for a low carb snack, light lunch, or even a midnight munchie.

column9: Not the best taste in the world
column10: Would not recommend this product - out of all the multiple brands of goose pate I've tried so far this one tasted the worst.

Nestle Instant Hot Cocoa Mix. I really like the convenience of the Packets, 50 of them 1 oz.each. I mix it with hot Milk or with boiling water, for a rich, smooth sweet tasting Hot Cup of Chocolate, they are very easy to prepare, healthy and with no mess at all, just pour and stir into your hot Water, and it's a terrific option for people like me who do not drink Coffee. You can take it to work, to your office and it makes any time of the day a Great Break from your daily routine, I have it all the time, one taste and you'll be hooked, because the Taste is so Terrific! Thank You
These hemp seeds taste very good with toast and butter.  Definately a thumbs-up without question.  A really good source of fiber also.  Yeah, these hemp seeds are great.
Very poor imitation of eggs. They had a tough,leathery texture andno flavor. The only semblence to eggs was their yellow color.

I have used Medifast products for four months and lost quite a bit of weight.  These southwestern style eggs are the worst Medifast food that I have ordered next to the regular flavored eggs.  No matter how you prepare them - microwave, stove top, oven - they taste horrible.They are rubbery and smell like spoiled eggs.  Skip these and try some of the better tasting Medifast products like the Cinnamon pretzels, Chocolate Crunch bars, and Chocolate pancakes.

On the whole, Medifast foods are fairly tasty.  These eggs (all their eggs) are just awful.  I tried them cooked and seasoned every which way, and could never force down more than a forkful.  I threw out the rest of the box.  If it's a breakfast food you crave first thing in the morning, stick with the pancakes, or oatmeal.  They are much, much, better

I ordered 15 lbs. of these M&Ms.  They were packed in 5 lb. increments and place in ziploc bags, then just placed in a flimsy USPS box.  When I received the shipment, the M&Ms were broken and the box had taken a pretty harsh pounding getting to me.  I am VERY disappointed in the whole experience.  Would not recommend.
I received my order of Pastel M&Ms as promised. My shipment was received in good condition.  Yes, I would order from this company again.

column9: OK, I can die a happy man now.
column10: While shopping my local Indian Grocery, I had robotically reached for a tin of Rajah HotCurry Powder and when I took my armful of treasures to the register, the owner looked atme sort of weird like, shook his head and motioned me back down the aisle where I had foundthe curry powders. He then took the Rajah out of my hand, and replaced it with a tin ofBolst's. I always feel like an invading army in that store, so I didn't complain.In summary, I have used Rajah, Ship's, Crosse and Blackwell, and others and by far this ismy all time favorite. The aromatics are wonderfully savory, and this blend morphs into abeautiful orange gravy that is a pure blessing to shrimp, fish, or chicken. This curry doesn'thave the full out blast of heat that Rajah's has, its there just not as intense. The flavoris more complex, and the sweet savory aftertaste provides a nice buildup to the warmingsensation you feel all over your body about 5 minutes after scarfing down your first 6-7bites. Its highly addictive.If you are unfamiliar with the healthy side benefits of eating curry, they are many and legend.Turmeric, often the main ingredient in curry that gives it a yellow or orange color, is a stronganti-inflammatory which cleans and restores the liver. As a result of these qualities, it is alsohelpful in treating arthritis. Turmeric has also been touted as a possible cure for Alzheimer'sdisease, cancer, lowering cholesterol, and heart disease. Additionally, chilies are a documentedhealthy heart agent by cleaning out plaque in the arteries. Brits even believe curry blocks hangoversby absorbing alcohol in the stomach. This is the primary reason English curry parlors stay open afterthe pubs close to accommodate the after-hours crowd.This 3.5oz tin can be had for under $3 locally. If you are a fan of this style of cooking I imploreyou to toss out that jar of stuff you found at the chain grocery, and seek out something moreauthentic. You'll be pleased for your efforts.
This is by far the best curry powder I have ever used.  When I was an adolescent we lived in India for 2 years and this is what our cook used.  Amazing and easy.  Love it.

I am "subscribed" to this product to receive a shipment monthly. The first two were fine, the cookies were soft and tasty. The last shipment had mold on every cookie. There are other complaints of mold on here, which shouldn't even be a problem if they are STORED CORRECTLY. These cookies are all natural and need to be refrigerated. I guess no matter how many times people complain to Amazon about getting moldy cookies, they still aren't correcting the storage situation!! So that really bothers me, and I don't think I'll be ordering any more of these until they fix the problem. It's quite disgusting.

I bought these several year ago and am glad to find them on Amazon. I keep them in the freezer so if I'm running late I can just grab one and go. It makes a very filling breakfast and its good for you. The chocolate is wonderful.
So far, these are my favorite flavor.  They are "chocolatey" without making you crave chocolate all day.  Very satisfying.

Bought these because they had the extra promotion and since i was going back to school, i needed something for the mornings when i'm on the run. These cookies are great. They taste great, i haven't had any problems with them crumbling ( i heat them to 18secs in the microwave) and for someone who eats every 3hours because of a high metabolism, these do fill me up till lunch time. I prefer these to cereal. I tend to eat them when i'm driving and they pair up great with milk. So instead of running to class because i'm late, i pop this into the microwave and unwrap it in the car. These double chocolate chunk ones and and the apple cinnamon ones are my favorite. i'll be ordering more of these.

These cookies are tasty and filling enough for a breakfast meal.  However, they crumble pretty easily, making them difficult to eat when walking or even sitting in the bus or train.  Don't even think about eating one when driving.I've only tried the chocolate flavor so far.  It has a strong chocolate taste, which is great if you like chocolate.  Don't be tempted to eat one of these as an afternoon snack, though, since 300 calories is a lot of calories for a snack.

I just purchased these for the first time on Amazon and I was really impressed! I freeze them and then just pull one out in the morning while I'm gettin ready for work. I've also discovered you can toast them, even if they're frozen. Just pull it out of the package and stick it in the toaster, comes out like a fresh baked cookie! Delicious! I would definitely reccomend this product especially if you are looking for a healthy meal and don't have a lot of time. I also keep one or two in the car in case I get hungry while I'm running errands, keeps the junk food temptations at bay.
I am a teacher and we start quite early. This is the perfect breakfast to eat between classes, and it keeps me full until lunchtime, and sometimes beyond. I don't always take a lunch break. =)
I send these to my boyfriend once a month when they are in stock - he just loves them. He's a big guy, and one is enough for breakfast.

Wow! I did not expect to enjoy these cookies, you never know when you find "healthy" snack food to also find one so filling and delicious. I have them on auto-ship now I don't want to run out. Great snack in the afternoon for that pick-me-up crash.

column9: Healthy? Yes.  Tasty?  Not so much...
column10: I bought this product based on reviews that I read here on Amazon.  Generally, this method for buying products has proven beneficial for me.  However, this go around I was a bit disappointed (not completely though).  I had been looking for a tasty, on-the-go replacement meal for breakfast as I usually do not have time to sit down and eat before I leave the house in the morning.The cookies arrived in their individually wrapped packages, enveloped in a clear plastic wrap with a tie to seal them in.  One morning, I unwrapped one, placed it on a paper plate and heated it up in the microwave for a good 20 seconds.  The cookie came out warm to the touch.  I wrapped it in a few napkins and took it with me to eat while in my car.  The first bite left me feeling duped.  It tasted less like a cookie and more like a slice of whole wheat bread.  I was waiting for the double chocolate chunk (real belgian chocolate) taste to hit my buds, but it never happened.  I did manage to finish eating it and I have eaten over half of the initial twelve in the pack over the last few weeks.  This is because I do not want to waste them - they are healthy - and I will bear with the fact that they do not taste great in my opinion.Sufficed to say, I was disappointed after reading glowing reviews.  However, I would not venture to say that these cookies are disgusting.  They taste wholesome and healthy.  They are filling and do give me a full feeling for around three hours.  For those that are health conscious and are not picky about taste, look no further.  As for me, a person who loves chocolate, I would not purchase another batch of these cookies and will be looking for other breakfast alternatives.
I am pleasantly surprised as to how good these taste.I usually have one for breakfast ... what a treat !!The price is economical, too.  YUMMMMMMM !!

Yum.  These will keep you full for hours.  The texture is chewy and awesome.  The taste is chocolatey, but not too sweet.  I just ordered more of the Double Chocolate Chunk and the I'm trying the Caramel Apple for the first time.  I do not expect to be disappointed.  Love Love!!!

Yum! These are quite tasty for being so healthy! One cookie satisfies for a long time (3-4 hours). The product is everything it's promoted to be and the description matches the quality received.It reminds me of Clif Bars but much fresher. I'm ordering these "cookies" again! I'd like to try the oatmeal ones because, even though these are double-chocolate, you can taste the underlying oatmeal flavor and it tastes fantastic!Makes for a nice small meal ~ especially with tea and a piece of fruit. True, they can be crumbly when eaten so keep the wrapper or a napkin handy.

column9: Quick and easy:enjoyable snack with enough calories to satisfy
column10: I have always been quite a picky eater, and at times have trouble upholding myself to a certain eating schedule, which results in me not eating enough. While trying to change this around, I started to think of possibilities that I could use in order to assure I sustain myself in a healthy way. This lead me to searching amazon for suitable snacks that are somewhat healthy, and provide enough calories to get you going for a little while. Erin's Baker's breakfast cookies is the result of this search. With a good 300 calories, these cookies provides you with a good balance of calories and the needed nutrients (especially coming from the whole grains) while at the same time being a pleasurable eating experience. I have not tasted anything other than the double chocolate chunk, however I can safely say these did not disappoint. I have been ordering them for a few months now, and have now signed up for the monthly subscription option.These are highly recommended as snacks, especially for the mornings where you couldn't help but stay in your nice warm bed a little bit longer, and do not have enough time to make a proper breakfast before having to head out for work or class.

These cookies are fantastic.....I work long hours at my Mac,  so these are great at around 4pm with my Bustelo Instant coffee, combined they give me energy for about 4 to 5 more hours of work,  and their so satisfying,  that Im fuller by dinner time,  so I eat much less at night,  which is a plus, at .99 cents a piece delivered you cant go wrong (I subscribe so I get 12/$11.90) another excellent deal by Amazon.
This product provides nourishment and a wonderful chocolate flavor, add the  whole grains and you have an unbeatable combination, healthy way to start the day.

column9: Taste ok, other flavors are better!
column10: So I have had several flavors of these breakfast cookies and have to say this is one of my least favorite flavors.  I think the flavors that are built on oatmeal are better because they taste like they should, like the oatmeal chocolate chunk with raisins are better than these because they taste like an awesome oatmeal cookie with add-ins and not like a oatmeal cookie trying to taste like a chocolate cookie.  The peanut butter ones are three stars too for the same reason.  The oatmeal flavors are all 5 stars!

Yumm.  These taste like a slightly more substantial chocolate chocolate chip cookie, but they are delish and heat up 30 seconds in the micro and you've got a treat.  These are a life saver quick snack (mini midday meal) for me when I'm on the road, quick breakfasts, whatever, they feel like a treat but are substantially feeling like a meal.

I got hooked on these last summer. They really hit the spot when you'd otherwise be skipping a meal - it is quite filling for its size, with its first ingredient being rolled oats.  I have a constant supply on hand.

column9: These breakfast cookies were a wonderful surprise!
column10: I happily stumbled upon Erin Baker's Breakfast Cookies while browsing around on Amazon. I had never heard of them before. Studying the comments, I ordered the 3oz cookies, two packages of double chocolate chunk and one of candied apple. They arrived in a flash! Both flavors are excellent but I am a dyed-in-the-wool chocolate aficionado, so those are my favorite treats. I have been looking at other so-called "diet cookies" and "breakfast bars" since my boxes arrived. I now know that I am getting the best cookies, the best value and the best breakfasts that I have ever known! Would that my mother had been able to buy these during WWII--I could have escaped the horrible Spam, the too-crispy eggs and the watery mush.Erin, I am so glad I found ye!
The cookies are a great chocolate fix early in the morning. Delicious way to start the day.
This is a very rich tasting cookie, it is one of my favorites for dessert not breakfast. This can be made into a very delicious ice-cream sandwich or served crumbled as a dessert topping.
I loved these-- they are the perfect blend of delicious cookie and healthy-quick breakfast! I will definitely be ordering more (though I think I'll go with the chocolate again! IT was soooo good!!)

YUM, YUM, YUM.  And chocolate cookies for breakfast. What could be better?  These are not your super-sweet cookies that you may be accustomed to.  They ARE a healthy breakfast alternative, they fill you up and keep you satisfied till lunch time.  I love these things.

I love these things for mornings where I don't have time for breakfast and want something I can grab and eat while driving or once I'm at the office.The chocolate is very good and doesn't taste like most "healthy" chocolate products, though you can tell that what you're eating is healthier than a brownie. :-)

This item is not like any cookie I've ever met.  I am not sure what to call it.  It's large, 3 oz. and 300 calories.  It looks like a thick patty.  It is dense and chewy.  I bought the double chocolate chunk flavor.  It has a mild cocoa flavor with notes of prune and bitter coffee. It is only slightly sweet, and has a hint of medicinal quality.  Though listed in the ingredients, I could not find a single chocolate chunk that was large enough to differentiate from the rest of the heavy, soft patty.  Most of the doughy thing is chewable but there are small grains of something that are distinctly harder and got caught in the cusps of my molars.If you are too busy to enjoy your food or can't taste anything anyway, maybe these are for you.  For me, when I spend 300 calories, even on the run, I want something that makes my mouth happy.  Half a whole wheat English muffin, a tablespoon of natural peanut butter, half a banana sliced on top.  All around better! And no messier to eat because these patties are crumbly and a slightly sticky.  You'll have bits on your upholstry and traces on the steering wheel.Reformulate, Erin!  Food should be a healthy PLEASURE.

I received some cookies that were not so fresh from Amazon. I talked to a rep at Erins Bakery and they were great! They stand behind their products and made sure I was a satisfied customer. I have loved these cookies (as well as the oatmeal raisin, morning glory, and mocha cappuccino flavors) for a long time and will continue to support this customer oriented company. These are delicious cookies and have really helped me lose 25lbs after having my baby.

The absolute best chocolate cookie with wholesome ingredients. Fills me up and satisfies my craving for chocolate. Easy to throw in your purse or pocket for a quick snack. Love them with a green ice tea or mocha.

column9: Rich, Yummy and fills you up!
column10: I'm very happy with these Breakfast Cookies. They are very rich and filled with lots of delicious chocolate chunks. They fill any Chocaholic's cravings! I plan to continue purchasing this item through Amazon's Subscribe & Save. I hope you give them a try. I love them!

Love this product! We are such a busy family that no matter how hard we try, we are on the go almost every waking hour so this cookie is a life-saver. My 6 year old and my 2 year old eats this and loves it. I always put a few in my purse just in case we are out and about and feeling the need to snack.

My husband and I have tried to change our eating habits this year and part of that has been making sure we have something for breakfast.  I don't know about everyone else, but we are not friends with our alarm clock.  We have a slap fight every morning with it until we realize we must obey if we want to keep our jobs.  Needless to say, there is no time for breakfast before we rush out the door.This is where these cookies come in very handy.  The first time we bought them we kept them in our pantry (I think we bought 60 that time to try a variety of flavors).  Unfortunately, by the time we reached the last dozen, they had gone bad and were a bit fuzzy.  Now this is actually a good thing!  Mold can't grow without moisture, so this tells you the cookies are moist!  Because they are all natural and are not made with preservatives, it is only reasonable that they would have a shorter shelf life.Next order we popped a weeks worth in the fridge and put the rest in the freezer.  We did this because my husband likes to eat them in morning traffic on his way to work so frozen cookies wouldn't work for him.  I on the other hand work in a very small office so I brought a variety to work and put them in our freezer.  In the morning I just pop one into the microwave for 45 seconds and I have a warm, tasty breakfast.  I especially like the gooeyness of the melted caramel and chocolate from those varieties.At an average of 300 calories it is a good meal alternative and is very filling.  It is a nice alternative to drinking a slim fast for breakfast, though I do sometimes still do Slimfast for breakfast and have a cookie for lunch.I would like to see them come in a variety dozen.[...]
To me these are good cookies. To my husband, they are super delicious!! They are his favorite, so I buy them for him.

column9: A great way to start the day!
column10: I ordered these after seeing them on Food Network. They really fill you up and keep you going for the morning. I recommend them if you don't have time to fix breakfast and they are much better than "fast food".

column9: Good, but I didn't receive what I ordered
column10: After seeing these featured on a tv show, we decided to try them since we're sick of protein bars and other breakfast bars.  We ordered the oatmeal raisen and the double chocolate chunk.  Instead of the chocolate chunk, I got cherry chocolate chunk which I probably would never have ordered.  We have been eating them and they are decent tasting although fairly high calorie so it's just something to be aware of in case you thought they were a diet food.  I was disappointed that my order was wrong, especially since I only bought two flavors.  I am not a fan of the cherry-chocolate flavor, but the oatmeal raisen is ok (maybe a little too sweet).  Personal preference.  I'd buy them again in some other flavors to see what else is out there.

This is gross. The calories are very high and the product does not taste good. If anyone has had odawalla bars, this cookie has that taste. This could be worse than those bars. For something with 300 calories, I would expect it to have a decent taste. Don't waste your money on this product.If you look at the ingredients, they are the same for almost all flavors of this cookie. So basically, all the other flavors will have a similar flavor.If this product is improved, maybe more people will buy it.Expect to use the bathroom more when using this product. This is a plus and a negative.

column9: Cookies great, Amazon not so great.
column10: I love these cookies and have ordered them before, but never from Amazon.  Because I was eligible for Super Saver Shipping, my order came crammed in a box with my other items that ended up completely crushing almost half of my breakfast cookies.  I would not recommend ordering these from Amazon, unless they are the only thing you are going to order.  I have ordered on Bakers Box in the past, and will do so in the future.......Cookies get five stars, Amazon gets one!

I was looking for something quick and healthy-but after seeing that each cookie has 22 grams of sugar, I was appalled that it was called "healthy"!  We aren't supposed to have more than 15 grams of sugar for a whole day, and this had 22 grams per cookie!  Ugh!  Pureed prune, evaporated cane juice, and more, made it very Unhealthy.  Healthy would be stevia (which also lowers your blood pressure) and xylitol as they have a "zero" count for sugar but taste sweet.  Sucralose is Splenda and is really bad for your body as it contains chlorine, and can damage your organs and reproductive functions.  If stevia or xylitol was used, you'd definitely have another customer.  :)
This tastes HORRIBLE!!! COMPLETE waste of MONEY!!!Contacted company to try to get a refund but no success.

When I recieved the Breakfast cookies they were covered in white hairy mold. I assume that this was due to trapped condensation in the packages. BUT EH GROSS! I have ordered these cookies from here before and had no issues, and Amazon was quick about refunding the item, but I don't think I'll purchase them again.

I did not realize how large this would be when I ordered it. It barely fits in my refrigerator. For the price it's great, if you can handle the large quantity. There are some better tasting vinegars, but at a much higher price. I got tired of running out of balsamic, since I eat a lot of salad, but this monster may last me over a year! The biggest problem is figuring out how to pour it without a lot of spilling. I have been using a funnel.

column9: Good quality vinegar; here's how to dispense it
column10: This is a good quality vinegar. Concerning how to dispense it from the 10-liter jug, I wrote the following as a comment on another review:"I just purchased this from Amazon after using the Roland 5 liter pouch, which is not available. How to dispense this? Here is what I came up with, and it seems to work. Buy a spigot: I purchased a Carlisle 2212, but Amazon has a Tomlinson Ceramic Crock Lever Faucet, which seems to be the same. They have a 3/4 inch threaded shaft, rubber washers, and a nut to seal the spigot. I drilled a 3/4 inch hole in the cap, cleaned the hole with a file and sandpaper, and installed the spigot onto the cap. Then I screwed the cap onto the container and put it in place in the basement, where I will fill smaller bottles from the spigot. It seems not to leak and should work fine. I hope this helps others."Now, a couple of weeks later, I have dispensed two bottles from the jug, and the spigot works fine without leaks. I punched a small hole in the top of the jug to let in air.
I have been a fan of Roland's Premium Balsamic Vinegar for several years.  In my opinion, it is the best.

This vinegar is great because you can buy it bulk and save. I can't even find Balsamic at Costco in this quantity and at this price.This balsamic is perfect for making your own dressings, vinaigrette and marinades. It's also wonderful if you like to make reductions for glazes or if you just want to concentrate it and put it in a squeeze bottle for garnishing dishes.Flavor is very good so you're not getting some bargain brand balsamic vinegar taste. You know the kind I'm talking about where it's basically red wine vinegar with food coloring and caramel color added in order to make it look like balsamic.You will not go wrong with this purchase if you use Balsamic vinegar frequently.

Very reasonable price and the quality is high - ten liters is too much to buy at one time, but I knew that when I bought this size - they have a five liter size but it hasn't been in stock for some time. Still a very tasty vinegar.

column4: Desert Gypsy "A Brooklyn Girl Out West"
column10: I've been making/eating Japanese rice for over twenty years. Having lived in NYC most of my life there were many places to source fine Japanese goods so I've been a little spoiled by access to the best ingredients; having moved out west a couple of years ago sometimes ingredients are harder to find. There were no reviews on this rice on the day I purchased it and I'm so glad I took a chance; this is hands down the best Japanese rice I have had in a very, very long time. Unusually fine short grain.  I made a batch the first night it arrived intending to pair it with some leftover chicken curry. When the rice was done, I went to take a taste and sweet Jesus!, was that good. Firm bite yet tender yield. A bare hint of sweetness. In a word - delicate. Another taste, then a bowl. Needed not a drop of shoyu or anything - naked perfection. I wound up forgetting all about the curry.

After living in Korea & Japan for 8 yrs, was jonesing for perfect rice - this is it! Short grain, firm, delicious unadorned right out of the rice cooker, perfect for  chopsticks. Heaven.Worth every penny, especially with amazon Prime (15 lbs free shipping, yes!)

I normally didn't eat much rice before this but I wanted something cheap and good to eat that I can take with me to school and work.A 15 lb bag lasted me about a month.The rice is good enough to where indeed soy sauce is not necessary. The white rice I was eating before was Botan rice and I didn't really want to eat that rice by itself, I would always use some soy sauce.I can say that this is good cheap rice. Made Onigiri with it too. Etc but just all around good tasting rice. I want to try the Tamanishiki but that is a little more expensive as there is no Free Super Saver Shipping with that at this time.

This was our first order of rice through Amazon.  We were disappointed with the quality of this rice.  It cooks yellow, doesn't retain moisture and was rather "pasa-pasa" (wasn't sticky).  It might work well for a pilaf, but isn't suitable for Japanese cuisine.

Short grain rice is the best tasting rice there is. Delicious. Arrived quickly, and was soon in the rice cooker. Quite certain I coul feed an army with the size of this bag! Guess that's it for buying rice in 2012. I am set!Steam it, dash of soy sauce and enjoy!
Its actually better than regular koshihikari that I got from NYC rite before we moved to TX. Lol. This is very delicious and healthy. I highly recommend it.
This is best rice I found in America.  Taste so good like I ate in Japan. My daughter loved too. She said she will order for herself.

column9: Green Mountain Colombian Fair Trade 96 K Cups
column10: Excellent product and customer service. I enjoy morning coffee and found this flavor the best so far. Green Mountain has maintained a fresh product and love the wide selection of flavors from coffee to tea.
You can but this product in boxes of 80 for $38.00 which therefore costs 0.47 each.  this offer is a full 0.20 per item more expensive. Shop around. Don't get taken.
Buying the 96 cup supply lessens trips to the grocery.  It is as though the coffee fairy leaves my husband's java on the front pourch:)
this item was ok just as I expected I wish you didnt have to comment here on every thing, one two three four five six seven
I love this product.  Best K-cup coffee in my opinion.I've tried other flavors but the columbian coffees are the best.

column9: Pleasant, rich, and more than worth the trouble
column10: I long assumed there was no meaningful difference between whatever pepper came pre-loaded in a salt & pepper shaker set and the little tin boxes of pepper in the spice aisle and either of those couldn't be far behind any freshly ground pepper. There's probably some difference but basically pepper is pepper, right? Well, turns out that's a bit like saying "Coffee is coffee, right?" More accurately, basic grocery store pepper flavor-wise is like the decaf instant coffee of the world, and these peppercorns are like a fresh roast from a favorite coffee shop - their quality is so different they're incomparable, one an unflattering caricature of the other. If you are even remotely tempted then get a grinder (I'm very happy with this Kyocera Ceramic Fine Mill, Black Top myself) and get this pepper. You will not regret it! And you will be re-paid many times over by the faces of those who taste your food!This pepper is rich, soft and pleasant, but still assertive. My wife and I agreed on the first bite that the pepper we had been using (and always just thought hey that's what pepper is) was not only bland but also sharp, even acrid, by comparison. I cook enough that I made it through my last pepper tin (about 3 oz) in about 5 months, so it wasn't brand new but it's not like I'm comparing this to something I found in my cupboard dating back to the Carter administration.Make no mistake, I'm no expert, but I have a feeling many of the people checking this out are in the boat I was in last week, maybe can't imagine spending more than $3 to $5 on pepper, maybe can't imagine it will be worth the extra step of grinding to use, and that's why I'm writing this to say yes it totally is worth the extra step and more. But if by contrast you're already a pepper connoisseur then I can't really give you any insight comparing this to other "real" peppercorns (though I hope to try more in the near future!)

Prior purchases of all spices from popular spice website, but I only needed pepper this time & did not want to pay the freight.  This was just as good, if not better & competatively priced.  Bag well sealed & peppercorns went into my 3 different grinders just fine.  Like the flavor, bold, but not overpowering.  Now on my favorites list for re-order time.
This pepper has a great scent and flavor, and the value is incredible compared to buying a similar product at a local "gourmet" grocer.

I bought these peppercorns in reliance on the other user reviews. Like the others, I have found this pepper to be delicious. Although I never had a problem with Costco's Kirkland brand, I do find this pepper to be more flavorful and aromatic.
Great product! It's hard to find quality pepper in bulk. The right size bag to last a few months for a household of 2 that usues a lot of it

Open the package. Take a whiff. You'll never look back! It is more than just a smell. It is an aroma - a bouquet!I suspect that tellicherries are a bit softer than other black peppers, and don't work as well in all standard grinders. None-the-less, they are worth the extra effort. Amazon is, by far, the best way to make this purchase.

I read the longest review on this page, and it is right in every respect. One area I can add on, however, is that I have used black peppercorn grinders for a while now. I refuse to use black pepper any other way. Previous to me getting this stuff, I had used McCormick's from the grocery store. McCormick's was around $4 for a 1.5 oz jar! This pepper is far and away superior to their pepper, and much cheaper for the size of the bag. Even though it was "fresh" ground, the pepper doesn't taste anywhere near as complex and flavorful as the Tellicherry. I recommend this to anyone who enjoys black pepper, and especially if you cook a lot. The only drawback for some may be that you also have to purchase a grinder of your own, but once you take that step, you'll never use pre-ground pepper again.

I saw a cooking show when he was trying to crack KFC's secret recipe. Someone revealed that this Telecherry pepper was in the Colonels secret stuff. I had to get some and run it through my pepper cracker to see if it was all it was portrayed to be. Well, it is! Very tasty yet not overpowering. Being sealed in this airtight bag my first sniff made me sneeze. Good stuff and fresh!
A real sensory stimulating peppercorn. Tasty and with a bit of heat too. The local stores are nowhere near this price point.  Recommend this product to all.

P.S. Do not forget the TELLICHERRY PEPPER__ It goes well with the Himilayan Pink Crystal salt. If you love pepper as we do, then get the pepper also, and you should consider the salt and pepper mill grinders!! They work beautifully, and measure just the right amount of seasoning on your food. Go ahead!! Jump in and enjoy!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
This is very good pepper and, considering the price of black pepper corns in the grocery stores, it is an excellent value.
These are small peppercorns but the flavor is good.  Good product for the price.  I would buy this pepper again.
...but surprised by the complex flavor of this pepper.  It is better than anything you can get at the grocery store and I would probably order this again when it runs out.

I bought this for my pepper grinder and steak/pot roast events.The pepper lacks some bite and appears almost flavorless at times. I was somewhat disappointed because the merchant normally ships great products.Maybe I should simply bite into a few pepper corns without any food to dilute the flavor. ;)
Excellent product I don't have to do anything it's already been grinded for me. As with most great value products, it exceeds quality of most of the name products. Suggest everyone to buy product.

I ordered these peppercorns because I was displeased with the regular peppercorns I had been using.When I received them I put them into my pepper grinder and used them right away.Then I noticed a bitter taste in most of my foods and I couldn't figure out why.  I finally realized after almost two weeks of use that the peppercorns were bad.I suppose I could've gotten a bad batch, but I am leery of this brand for future purposes.Amazon was super helpful though and refunded my money without even having to return them.
Peppercorns are not harsh or overly spicy.  Nice blend of soft but just slightly peppery notes.  Good product.  This is my second purchase of this particular brand.

column9: PRETTY GOOD, BUT COULD BE SPICIER
column10: BOTTOM LINEAs far as pepper for my pepper grinder goes, this is way better than the stuff you get in the supermarkets.  It's not as good as some of the more expensive stuff I have found, however.SPICINESSAs an everyday regular use pepper, it's great.  I just wish it were a bit spicier.AMOUNTThere is A LOT of pepper included for your money's worth.  Don't forget to store what you aren't using in an airtight container.

This Tellicherry pepper was very fresh, aromatic and packaged well. This grinds up beautifully and adds an incredibly complex, delicious flavor to savory dishes.To get the most out of your pepper-mill (if you have the wooden kind with the screw-top lid), loosen the screw for a very course grind (like you would do for a 'rub') and tighten the screw for a fine grind.Excellent quality spice. Spicy World has not ever disappointed me!
I use a grinder to grind this pepper. as anyone wouldgood value and consistant pepper corns.steve from bayshore would approve

This seemed like a large amount of peppercorns, but the tellicherry peppers are so full of flavor that I'm using much more pepper than before.  There is no comparison between these and supermarket peppercorns. I'll order these again!

i was little worried that i was going to get half broken peppercorns with sticks and twigs in the bag. but i received a whole bag of whole, pristine peppercorns.i wish they offer mixed peppercorns and not just black, since i want the extra aroma/flavor that the other type adds.but i am happy. received it very quickly, even shipped one for my mom. super happy and would buy from them again.i have a picture and will try to add it once i find out how.
this has got to be the best pepper! I am a self taught cook/chef and this is a wonderful product to have in the kitchen.

column9: Worse than 2 year old grocery store pepper
column10: As a Prime member since Amazon started Prime in 2004, I buy hundreds of items per year.  This product cannot be returned.  The quality is--bad.  I can barely tell it is pepper.  My two year old grocery store pepper has better pepper taste and smell.  Bad luck?  Don't know, since I can't return the product and certainly won't ever order this product again.

Nothing special about this pepper...at least compared to Costco's. It tastes good, for sure. However, I'm not sure the taste is worth the extra $$$ compared to typical peppercorns. However, the convenience of having delivered makes it a viable option for a good pepper taste.

I love Amazon for their wonderful prices - most of the time. Unfortunately, I found out the hard way this time. Bought this and it cannot be returned, and it is almost three times more expensive than the same amount of Costco Tellicherry Pepper. Live and learn.
this is the only dog food he will eat.  when it is supper time, he comes to get you, so he can eat.

column9: great dog food,cost of shipping too high
column10: These are great dog food, my 2 dogs only ate Cesars, nothing else.But... Wel-Mark sell it at $16.50 case of 24and Petco charge shipping at high price !
Shipping was in a timely fashion. Package was not damaged. Product was fresh and affordable. Would prefer to have smaller package so I could get a variety of flavors.

These crackers have nice Flavor. They can be used to coat chicken for frying... so many of them were broken anyway, I just crunched them a little bit more... and problem solved. Not enough of them fit to present at the table.  This is second time ordered with this outcome.
Just my opinion but these are the greatest with there light taste and crispness. I do reccomend that you request extra packing as these are fragile. There are none better.
I so enjoyed both cooking and eating these and so did my mother and I plan to order again :)

I've bought several small bags of different types of food, and this is my puppy's favorite.  It has a slightly fishy odor, but whenever she catches a whiff, she gets excited, like I'm giving her a bowl of pure cookies.  I notice that my dog seems to fill up on less of this type of food, so it may almost be worth the expense.  I may still try to vary this and a few other types of food, but I plan to always have some salmon Spot's Stew on hand.One caveat-- this food gives my little pug ATOMIC FARTS.  Last night I brought her to a party, and gave her a small container of Spot's Stew to munch.  On the way home, I had to leave the windows of the car rolled all the way down, as my adorable little puppy, so cute curled up on the passenger seat, was erupting wave after wave of nostril-burning, noxious, silent-but-deadlies.  Her actual poop isn't so bad-- solid and easy to pick up.  But I will not be feeding this to my dog before sharing a small space or meeting in-laws again!

column9: My 9wk old American Eskimo puppy likes it
column10: I got my American Eskimo puppy when she was 8 weeks old and just weaned off her mom. This is the third brand that I've tried and she seems to like it a lot. First, it was 1lb bag of Iams Smart Puppy. She ate it but only when she was really hungry and I had to hand feed her if I wanted her to eat the whole serving. I tried adding a little water to soften the crunchies and then she would eat it with some coaxing. Second brand is the 6lb Wellness Super5Mix recommended by other puppy owners I met at Petco. She reacted the same as she did with the Iams food. I think my puppy doesn't like the hardness of the food pellets. Maybe it bothers her growing teeth. Both Iams and Wellness have the same size food pellets and about the same hardness.I did some online research and narrowed down on some other natural dog food brands. I liked one of the previous reviews on Amazon on Halo Spot's Stew, Wild Salmon Recipe for Puppies. Petco has a sale on a 3lb bag for $8.99 so I decided it's worth the try. Upon opening the bag, I noticed the food pellets are significantly smaller than Iams and Wellness AND the smell actually smelled like food! Both Iams and Wellness wreaked of vitamin supplements that my puppy probably didn't like.I still have the 6lb bag of Wellness Super5Mix that I mix in with the Halo Spot's Stew. When she feeds, she's excitedly eating the food up instead of running away from the food! I wish that pet stores had small sampler bags to try before you commit to even a 3 lb bag of dog food.

I did a great deal of research before trying this product at the recommendation of a family member. We both have yorkie puppies and they absolutely love it. If my pup doesn't finish her bowl my Doberman takes care of the rest for her :) Great product, good price, and healthy!

This chili is pretty tasty (but only a little spicy).  It's easy to take with you.  There are two good size servings per container.  Each serving is 220 calories, with 9 grams of fat, 18 grams of carbs and 16 grams of protein.  I've only eaten it as is, but I think it would be great on nachos or chili dogs.

I love hormel chilli whether it does or does not have beans (I love beans). Has the right balance of solid food & liquid. I like this this with garlic bread or sticks or grilled cheese. Oh! That is very good. Still not very fond of the lid system.

I've been a fan of Hormel Chili since I was a little kid but these microwave bowls bring a new level of convenience to this classic comfort food.The serving size is perfect for lunch (served along with plenty of saltine crackers) or at dinner time as a topping for hot dogs or burgers. I've even had them for dinner, poured over a baked potato or on top of freshly cooked macaroni... any way you dish it up, these chili bowls are perfect for a delicious, hot, FAST meal!

Just right to heat up for Chili Dogs or to make queso dip. Love the fact I do not have to pick out the beans as I did with other chili. Find it even mixes well into a pot of Mac n Cheese.Reorder when running low.
The Nonni's Biscotti Cioccolati is exceptional in taste; love dunking it in hot tea!  I will be buying more of it!
I am glad I ordered this sampler. It's an excellent way to sample what is available on the market. The only problem I have is making a decision since all the samples are pretty good.

Super way to find what you like! Such nice quality and flavor that I purchased a second sampler pack (and an espresso maker) for a gift! These flavors will remind you of traveling through Italy :)De'Longhi EC155 15 BAR Pump Espresso and Cappuccino Maker
Cheerios is my favorite cereal. I eat it every morning on some blue berries. I have eaten Cheerios since I was a little boy and I am now 72!

column9: Don't make the same mistake I made
column10: This is only the equivalent to two boxes of Cheerios. It is NOT bulk, which is what I assumed, given the price. I should have read the quantity data more carefully. Don't make the same mistake!

According to packaging, these candies are imported from Holland.  Natural ingredients but for artificial yellow coloring.  Very good flavor, especially as the tart interior suffuses the sweet lemon taste.  I'd prefer the outer candy be less sweet, but it's a delight nevertheless.  I'll probably try the Napoleon Bon Bon Sours from Amazon next time, after I've shared the huge 7-lb bag just received very fast from United Overseas Food Corp.  Would recommend two things to seller:  a better, fuller description on Amazon, and selling in smaller than 7-lb quantities.
These candies are the best!  I bought them as a gift and they were "sweetly" received.

Purchased these for work.  Work in outpatient chemotherapy unit and these are perfect for those who need something to get a taste from their mouth but don't feel like eating.  Just make sure they know the center is liquid/sour--which is the best part.
Have loved the Napoleon Lemon since I used to buy them with my Dad.  How come they change what they looked like?
Thrilled to find these candies at Amazon - the one and only place I could purchase them locally no longer carries the item.  Delivered on the day they promised!

I first tasted these hard candies when I went to college in New York, and have been a fan ever since.  The sour center hidden in a sweet coating is great.  It's about the only candy I like.  I hadn't found a place to buy them in the Washington DC area, so I'm glad they're available on line.  I wish there were a package smaller than seven pounds, which lasts me several years.  But it's worth allocating closet space to store it, in order to have one of these treats when I'm in the mood.
These were super fresh and really delicious. The carmel was really soft and enjoyable. Melt in your mouth. The best.

We love these candy bars. The caramel is so smooth. I am glad Amazon is selling them because the only place I can find them at the movie theater I like the little rice crispy pieces like the regular nestles bar that gives it the extra crunch.

I have been buying this dog food for 6 years now. I feel good about giving my dogs a high quality lower cal food .I researched a LOT of dog foods. This one came out on top for me. And my dogs love it!

I wasn't sure how my lil pup would take this, but he loved it since his first whiff. He hadn't even tasted it yet, and he followed me around shaking just for a little bite!Great taste, great ingredients, and even the smell is genuine :)I'll definitely be stockpiling these for use as training treats, food mix-ins, and anything else I can think of!
My shih Tzu dog loves this treat and the ingredients are so much better than others.

The chocolate arrived melted and reformed into a cracked crumbly lump with white spots.The taste seemed alright, but I would hesitate to order this product again because of the condition it arrived in.

I am satisfied with the product for its spicy delicious taste that reminds me of the delicious foods of Korea I tasted in Korea and its side-dish, the Kimchee. No Korean dish is complete without Kimchee. All I have to get is the Napa and/or the Bok-Choy or both to make the dish.  On ordering the product the delivery is always on time and quick and the packaging excellent.

My puppy was losing hair and itching like crazy on the dry dog food from the grocery store. I bought one bag of this based on the reviews here and Ellen's participation in the product. Within two weeks he was eating half as much food, but gaining muscle mass and had a thick shiny coat. 2 bags later and I decided to change to some other fancy brand that was supposed to be as good but much cheaper. The day after starting to change my puppy's food over, the new brand was recalled. Halo is expensive, but I lost a dog due to the '06-'07 recalls. Never again.
We had a hard time getting our dog to eat any kind of dry food and she really likes this.  And it seems like it's on the healthier side of dry dog foods.

column9: Halo Spot's Stew Adult Dog Wholesome Chicken
column10: This used to be called "Halo Spot's Stew Natural Dry Dog Food," but they recently renamed it and added "Purely for Pets."  But, hey I disagree! These are very tasty in milk.Oh, and my dog loves it too; she daintily consumes it (she is a lady).  When she is done she often licks the bowl (note: un-lady like).

column9: Didn't do well with my dog
column10: Halo is a good product but this flavor didn't do well with my dogs.  My older female had an upset stomach and lots of stools.

column9: The best food we've ever fed our dogs!
column10: My dogs love this food! The kibbles are very small, so all sizes of dogs can manage it well. We wet it down, as three of our littles lost some teeth, and they gobble it up every meal. I would recommend that you ask your vet for exact feeding amounts for your dog, so that you are not over feeding. Labels tend to list larger than necessary amounts.

My dog ate this food from the time we adopted her until shortly before we moved to a town where I couldn't purchase it locally, (about 6 years) so I switched her to Wellness. That went well for about eight months and then our dog developed bouts of diarrhea that lasted for weeks. At that point, I switched her to yet another Wellness formula and we got another seven months before the diarrhea came back. I tried to switch her to yet another formula of Wellness, but couldn't even complete the transition without the diarrhea coming back. A light bulb went off at that point and I looked on Amazon for Halo spots stew. Nowadays it can be purchased with FREE shipping. I never would have switched if that was available when we moved!  She's been on the chicken spots stew for many months now without any digestive issues whatsoever!  The whole family is much happier and healthier because of Halo.

column9: Great Source Found for Farro at Amazon
column10: Loving everything Italian, I started cooking with farro when I first saw it, but my local, reasonably-priced imported supply was undependable or way too expensive when they got in a different brand.  When I went on-line to find a good, well-priced source, this product was the answer to my search.  The price to buy two 3-lb bags of Roland Farro plus the shipping was very much in line with the reasonable price I had been paying locally.  The grain is absolutely delightful and of the highest quality.  I just made one of my favorite Italian recipes,a soup,using this brand of farro and it is delizioso!  I'm so happy to be able to count on getting this regularly, delivered speedily to my door and am looking forward to summer farro salads and exploring other recipes using this beautiful, healthful product.

I had been reading about Farro for a while and was very curious to try it.  I purchased the 3 pound bag because it was a great price.The first thing I did was make a Farro Mac and Cheese that was featured in Rachael Ray's magazine.  My husband went insane, he loved it so much.  Its a very hearty grain, but is also very creamy....almost like barley....making it a great addition for soups, salads and casseroles.  I froze the leftovers and they held up very, very well.My only complaint was in the packaging...there wasn't instructions on how to prepare it.  Just a specific recipe using Farro as an ingredient. However, I looked it up online and was able to find a lot of basic preparation recipes.It seems like whenever I read about a new ingredient and can't find it at any of my local grocery stores, I can always find it at Amazon.I will definitely purchase this again!

Easy and fast to cook up, nice substitute for brown rice, barley, bulgar, etc...mild tasting and high fiber.  Good hot as a side dish/pilaf, or used room temp/cold in summer salads. Has 3 grams of fiber per 1/4 cup dry.
This is a wonderful grain to add to your diet.  It is chewy and has more protein than most grains. It's a good substitute for orzo, rice, etc. in salads and good alone or in hot dishes.

column9: Hard to find tasty, healthy grain
column10: We have enjoyed this grain in very limited quantities for years finding it only in one Italian specialty store where it is quite expensive.  This larger quantity is more reasonably priced and it stores well in a glass jar.  I prepare it occasionally using the recipe on the back of the original bag but increasing the ground meat to one pound to serve more people.  Farro has a wonderful flavor prepared this way or just simmered in chicken broth.  It is good served along side a meat or grilled Italian sausages or as an accompaniment to grilled veggies for a vegetarian meal.

There is something wonderfully addictive about farro and Roland's product is high quality and delicious.  I've loved farro since childhood (a much-loved, traditional grain in the region of Italy where my family is).  A simple bowl of farro cooked in a broth of garlic and pepperoncino with a drizzle of olive oil and dash of parmigiano on a cold winter's night, oh there is nothing more soothing and satisfying. Buon appetito!

The farro  arrived promptly and was much less expensive than my local specialty foods store.  I first tried farro in a little restaurant in Newport Beach and fell in love. It is a lot heavier than pasta, so it keeps you full for hours. Most recipes that I found use it in salads and soups; however, you can use it in place of pasta. Goes well with tomato sauces. Has a texture similar to that of cracked wheat.
Farro is a wonderful grain, easy to use, great texture and flavor.  Wish I would have known about it years ago.

We're relatively new to farro, but after just one taste, we're completely hooked on this delicious little grain. It's super easy to cook, and it has a wonderful nutty taste and chewy texture. It's high in fiber, and it doesn't need much added to make a complete dish. I cook 1 and a 1/2 cups (dry) in 6 cups of water for 30 minutes on medium high heat, drain, and then add 1/2 a jar of Trader Joe's Bruschetta mix and a can of white beans. Voila! 6 servings made, and it tastes great cold, room temp, or warm. I've tried some other brands, and Roland's is the best. I buy and use a 3 lb bag monthly; we love it THAT MUCH. It's great for picnics since it doesn't need to be refrigerated, and it can be used as a side dish or main dish, depending on the size of your appetite. Try it; you'll like it.

I love this stuff.  I use it in a pilaf, or soup and I've even tossed it in Beef tacos to cut down the fat and boost the nutritional value.  Has more protein than barley and great tasting.  And we don't need to get into the benefits it does for your internal plumbing!
It is impossible to find this product in my area.  I was pleased to find it, and for such a reasonable price.  I will order it again.
Good product....you can add anything to this high protein kinda chewy and looks like brown rice but much better.  Serve room temp or cold.  Delivery time was fast.

column9: Great quality at the right price
column10: about 6 months ago I decided it was time to eat healthier and while doing internet searches on different whole grains I run into Farro, I initially purchased a small batch at a local health store ($10.99 x #) cooked it in many different ways and immediately fell in love, very versatile great in earthy soups, excellent addition to salads but my favorite way of cooking it is risotto style, literally if you have cooked risotto (with arborio rice) you can do the same with Farro. What I love about Roland Farro is that the grains a fairly big, uniforms and very little cleaning is required in fact I just give it a quick rinse and then cook. Google for recipes and you will be surprised

I am so glad I could find this on line. I first purchased this at Costco and they no longer carry it. It is much better then rice and I think better for a person. Thank you Amazon for carrying this item.
It's not really about the Farro, it is always good.It's about the price, the best I have found online, but twice as much as I paid at Costco during it's short appearance there.

Farro is fantastic. this was my first time eating it and I loved it. I cooked this in my electric pressure cooker and it came out so good- nice separate kernels. I just put a little honey on it and ate it for breakfast cereal. Then I put some in a loaf of bread I made from Chef Brad's web site. It was wonderful and so chewy.

I ordered this Farro not quite knowing what to expect, but I am overwhelmed with its fantastic flavor and freshness.  It's an ancient grain, the actual precursor of our modern wheat, but with many more nutrients and more fiber!  So far, I've used it as a substitute for ground beef in a tortilla soup recipe, a side dish with steak, and a replacement for toasted nuts in a bread recipe...........wonderful results in all!!  I'm not a big fan of rice, but this product is an outstanding replacement in all situations I've encountered.  If you simply want to try it alone, pour some into boiling water, cook for about 10 minutes, drain in a colander, and then melt some butter (or substitute) into it..........you'll be amazed!!  Happy eating!!Loren in Big Cabin, Oklahoma
hard to find this in stores. the product arrived fast and was fresh.i dont know much else to say about a bag of grain. i've never had any problems with it

First time I tasted farro was at a family reunion last month, as a lime vegetable salad.  After this purchase, I have tried it in soups, casseroles, as well as a variety of salads and it is always delicious.  Highly recommended.

Farro tastes good.  Gives whole grain goodness. Good for salads or hot side dishes - wonderful texture!  So glad that the larger size is finally available.  Try farro for tabbouleh - be sure to cook it first.
I tried this grain twice at a friends house and finally decided to order some . My family all loved it so I will be a return customer.
Terrific product.  Very tasty, high in protein & fiber.  However, it may be available @ your local Costco for about half the price.

I really love this stuff!  I just discovered this from one of those cooking shows on TV and wanted to try it.  It is difficult to find Farro in regular grocery store, and not everyone has an Italian grocery store close to them. It's just really convenient to order from Amazon with free shipping. It arrived very quickly.

if you don't know faro------you have to try it. This is unpearled (the husks are not ground away----kind of like brown rice). Be sure to soak it over nite, drain, rinse and cover with water or broth and a little salt. Cook covered over low heat for about 50 minutes. I like to add some sauted mushrooms and leeks with lost of hot chiles. A good diet food  and when prepared this way it lasts a good while in the fridge.

Farro is an ancient type of wheat, one of the oldest known to man, mainly used in Italian dishes.  I bought some to try, and we enjoyed it so much that I plan to always have some in the pantry.  I soaked it overnight, as suggested by a website I found.  It cooks faster after soaking, although it stays chewy after cooking.  It also takes somewhat longer to cook than wheat, brown rice, spelt or barley -  30-45 minutes.Farro can be used in soups the same way barley is used, or it can be made into an oatmeal type breakfast cereal (yummy with honey or maple syrup), or it can be used as a seasoned side dish the way you would serve brown rice.  It would also be good in cold salads similar to tabbouleh.  It has a nutty, wholesome flavor and is very filling without being heavy.It's an excellent source of complex carbohydrates, and it has twice the fiber and protein of wheat. Farro has has low levels of gluten, for those with dietary restrictions.  It contains healthy amounts of iron, niacin, magnesium and zinc.Roland Farro is a great product at a great price. It will ship free if you use Amazon Supersaver Shipping (orders over $25), and you'll save 15% on the purchase price if you use the Subscribe and Save option.
This grain is rather hard to find.  Amazon was my  only source.  The over all transaction and product were ver good.

I had never tried Farro before, but had a recipe that called for it and could not find it locally.  Our family is trying to eat healthier and so I am trying various whole grain products. It liquifies when brought to a boil for A FEW minutes and solidifies when cold. The first time I was too quick and not all the agar had disolved, leaving some unpleasant crunchy bits. So, just make sure you keep the agar agar boiled long enough so that it completely liquifies. Doing this will produce great solid mousse and jellies. It is a great product because it is really tatsteless. It only does the job of solidifying food but does not alter its taste at all.

column9: High Mountain Gourmet.  Food of the Gods.
column10: Even though I write reviews mostly on my favorite types of escape novels, I was sparked by Amazon's enthusiasm, to take part in the grocery store and gourmet food expansions here.  My first purchase (of products beyond books) included a grain called QUINOA (Keenwa.The product arrived in very good order and within perfect timing.In that maiden purchase I also added lavender and clove essential oils to my shopping cart, along with powdered cloves, and lavender tea.  See my Listmania on Essential Oils (which indicates which items I've reviewed) for info on the values and uses of lavender and cloves, available from various vendors here.I consider Quinoa to be the most valuable food available on the planet, a food which meets my standards for luxury gourmet in flavor (and culinary versatility), in addition to being baseline healthy with full-spectrum nourishment.If I had to be limited to only 4 items or food groups (in addition to water, of course) to eat or drink, those would be Quinoa, Coffee, Dairy Products, and a variety of greens, spices, & nuts.  Yeah, okay, dairy products; and greens, spices, & nuts may be considered more than 2 items, but, for me they're two categories.I'm not a vegetarian because I love meat, chicken, and fish, but if I'm working with limitations, I'm making do with the most basic of basics, while still having enough food items to concoct satisfying flavor (yeah, yeah, and nutrition, too, though according to my beliefs, "nutrition" dims and deteriorates, unless it's in the living presence of "yummy.").Quinoa, I believe, would take care of all (or at least many) basic nutritional needs.The way I simplify my use and preparation of Quinoa is to think of it either as rice or oatmeal, and then to "gourmet it" accordingly.-- As "rice" I add savory herbs like parsley, basil, marjoram, garlic, onions, etc.  Actually, most types of herb concoctions or side foods which could be blended with pasta would also work with Quinoa.  Think of what Lidia's Italian Table does with "noodle heaven"; then substitute Quinoa for pasta (I like pasta too, of course).-- As "oatmeal" I add sweet or rich ingredients like fruit (including raisin and date types), brown sugar, molasses, maple, creme, that type of thing.As far as cooking instructions, to me they're basically the same as rice:- Add water or liquid in a 2 to 1 ratio.  2 cups liquid ( water, broth, vegetable, or fruit juices) to 1 cup Quinoa.-- Instructions are given on the bag for boiling the water then adding the Quinoa, covering the pot, and simmering for 12-15 minutes.-- I've also successfully prepared Quinoa in the microwave.  You can heat the water to boil in a bowl then add Quinoa, cover, and cook.  Normally, a microwave cooks 4 times faster than "outside-the-waves" cooking, but, of course that time varies with larger amounts of food.  For example, 1 potato cooks (on average) in 4 - 8 minutes, 2 potatoes require double that, or 8 -16 minutes.-- For a single serving cooked quickly in the microwave, I might use 1/4 cup Quinoa with 2/4 (½) cup liquid.I have actually simplified the process for myself by placing those single serving amounts (Quinoa and water in a bowl) in the microwave, and cooking it on high, maybe 3 minutes, till the liquid bubbles.  Then I cover the bowl with a plate "lid"; zap it for another minute or half, then let it "steep" in the microwave, without opening it, for another few minutes.  (Since microwave ovens and tastes for texture differ, you'll have to experiment with your own microwave processes to get results which work for you, or just use the sauce pan method described on the bag.)In the microwave, Quinoa seems to cook easier than rice.But, I also cook rice in the microwave in a similar method.  I don't use minute rice, since my microwave method works easily and fairly quickly, and if I cook it in a serving bowl with a plate "lid" I can just place it on the table for family style "digging in."I love the nutty, barley flavor of Quinoa.  Thankfully, so does my husband!In the past I've purchased Quinoa from Bob's Red Mill, and White Mountain Farms in Colorado, in the San Juan mountain area (have always been satisfied with those sellers, when/if the products are available on Amazon).  Having used many different Now Foods products, I'm very confident in ordering any item from them.Recently Berry Farm and Angelinas have been added to my list of healthful, gourmet food purveyors.  The reviews on Angelina's and Quinoa Red were helpful. In addition to the most common golden grain, I've only seen black Quinoa, which is also appealing, and is reportedly the oldest variety. Well, actually all the reviews I've read on Quinoa have offered something of value to the info I've already gathered. (I used to sell Quinoa in my CITY CHEF kitchen store, which is no longer open; I spend all my time writing now, with a little cooking on the side.)Quinoa has an iteresting history, including the development of a saponin coating on the grain:--  The genetics in the Quinoa seeds, after eons and ages of growing, had developed the saponin coating as a very effective protection against insects and burrowing varment's, like worms or parasites.-- Knowing what saponin is and does, I began a habit of saving some of the water used to rinse Quinoa for watering my plants, or pouring on the ground where I might want to discourage insects.-- Once the saponin is removed, I'm not sure how long the "naked" grains will be able to protect themselves again parasitic invasions.  Certainly, Quinoa (being a very strong, wise-old-grain with high integrity, for many reasons) would be able to do so longer than other similar, eons-younger food offerings.  I'm not concerned about this, and will usually order either pre-washed grain or saponin coated, whichever is readily available.Quinoa grows only above a 7,000-foot-elevation and requires a certain growing climate, which can be found only in certain areas of the world.  Some parts of the Rocky Mountains are one of those areas, not tested until fairly recently (in terms of the eons and ages associated with this ancient grain from the Incas).Interesting stories about Quinoa's long history are bountiful, but I won't get into those.  A large assortment of books and pamphlets are available to read on it, and of course, many are offered here on Amazon.I remain ever thankful for magical foods (which are both gourmet and healthy in quality), especially in our era of being told by some authorities that we need to remove the life, magic, wholeness, and flavor out of most everything.  For the sake of "health"?Here's an interesting question to ponder:Why and how, for a while (eons), did we lose Quinoa seeds, which had "lived" long enough to develop saponin.  Why and how did we find them again?For an easy, exotic recipe using Quinoa, see my review of Virgin Coconut Oil (Certified Organic) 12 fl.ozLinda ShelnuttAuthor of several books, including:Molasses Moon
