column9: great smooth clean matcha tea but what will the Amazon price be?
column10: This morning I reviewed 2 ORGANIC matcha teas, side by side:1.  The first one was: "2nd harvest Organic Domatcha" tea that I purchased at a local farmer's market, and I paid $37.99 for this 2.82 oz tin. Result = 4.5 stars (greatest taste and foam, organic, very expensive)2,  The second one was "SerendipiTea matcha culinary grade organic green tea" which I ordered on amazon.com, paying only $17.99 for a whopping 4 oz. bag. (twice as much for half the price).  Result = 5 stars (great taste, good foam, organic, terrific cost)**NOTE: see another review of SerendipiTea by me, beside 2 other brands.  It won in that review as well.I made the 2 cups identically, using soymilk and water 50/50, using the Blaney method (described below):"Blaney" Method for making Green Tea Latte:You need 2 small sauce pans on a gas stovetop, latte foamer device, bamboo whisk, soymilk, water, teaspoon measure, ½ cup measuare, and matcha powder.  (many prefer sweetener and I suggest Agave syrup but I did not use it in this test since I enjoy the pure unsweetened tea flavor.  Cheaper teas may require the sweetener to mask any fishy tastes, but not these two high quality brands.)1. Using the latte foamer device, please foam 1/2 cup (cold or tepid) soymilk, then heat it gently while stirring (this personal "Blaney" method of mine makes the best foam)2. heat 1/2 cup water (in separate pan) til boiling3. add 1 level tsp matcha to 1/2 c. heated water and wisk with bamboo wisk about 30 seconds in zig zag motion  until matcha powder is dissolved4. add the heated, foamed soymilk to the matcha/water blend5. pour this mix into latte device, pump 20 or so times, then pour entire foamed mixture into large mug.For this test I made the two teas simultaneously so the `foamed' structure would be nearly identical (one is supposed to drink the latte immediately before the foam dissipates). I did, however, rinse the items with filtered water before pumping the second tea, so as to not to contaminate #2 with #1.For photo of the 2 teas and boxes, see:  [...]Result:>>>Taste and texture:DoMatcha won for a (very slightly, barely noticeable)  cleaner taste, and better 'foam'. However, the SerendipiTea was still very yummy.  I have the most sensitive taste buds on earth (other than my son) and I detected a very mild "ocean" taste with the Serindipitea, but I attribute that to the fact that my SerindipiTea had been opened a week prior.  The DoMatcha had only been opened the day before.  Newly opened teas always taste best. I would love to repeat this test in the future with two newly opened teas so that oxygen exposure won't be a variable as it was here.<<<Price:Well, the DoMatcha 2nd harvest organic costs 4 times more, and is only ever-so-slightly better, and if I re-test with two new, unopened packages, who knows? Maybe they will be the same. I am giving the SerendipiTea organic  5 stars for being such a cost bargain, being organic, and tasting so great...  and I am giving  the DoMatcha 4.5 stars for also being organic and tasting great, even fantastic, but being such a high cost.Carol Blaney, Ph.D.

I wouldn't call myself a connoisseur or anything but to me this one has the best flavor and price combination. column9: Brilliant green!  Worthy substitute for more expensive 1 ounce tins...
column10: I felt like I was taking a leap of faith when I decided to try this. I have been a long time buyer of Eden Organic Matcha, but it was just getting too expensive for me to drink daily using 1/2 to 1 tsp per day.  The first replacement I tried out was a "culinary" grade tea by SerendipiTea.  I wasn't sure what to expect from it, but figured I would at least be able to put it into smoothies if I totally hated it.  I totally hated it.  The Eden Matcha was a beautiful, vibrant green while the SerendipiTea was almost brown.  Blech.  And the flavor....I couldn't even handle it in a smoothie, it tasted like dirt and made everything I put the tea in taste like dirt.  I was a little gun shy after that because Matcha is just so expensive and very difficult to find organically grown.  The DoMatcha seemed to be my only other option.  I am glad I finally took the plunge because it is a good substitute for the Eden brand.  I get almost three ounces for a similar price as 1 ounce of Eden.  I was happy as soon as I opened the bag inside the tin....the powder is a gorgeous emerald color.  It doesn't taste quite as good as the Eden (a bit more pungent and grassy), but it is good and I feel the same sense of vitality and cleansing I got from the Eden tea. I am a happy camper.NOTE:  I do not prepare and drink this Matcha in a traditional way. While I love green tea (and tea of all kinds), I drink Matcha specifically for the health benefits of consuming the whole tea leaf and don't muck around with water of a specific temperature and bamboo whisks. I add 1/2 tsp to cool water first thing in the morning in a shaker cup and shake vigorously. To me it is a lovely, frothy way to start my day.  I also put a bit in my smoothies.

column9: Not real jerky and high in sugar
column10: First of all, this isn't real jerky - it is reconstituted beef sticks (similar to the products labeled as "beef steak" by the national jerky brands). Second of all, it is high in sugar - 7g per 1oz for Original. I was extremely disappointed with this "jerky" - both for its deceptive labeling and for its lackluster taste.

It says "made from premium strips of beef steak" on the bag, what they do not mention is that this beef steak is then ground up and reconstituted into these strips.I very carefully inspected some of it and could easily pull it apart, there was no protein webbing and when given the standard jerky dryness/readiness test of bending/twisting it to see these lovely protein webs... it just snapped... but it is NOT dry... it is reasonably moist.The taste is passable, but i would never buy this companies jerky again.
Meat is in nicely cut strips, but...there was too much unchewable stringy material.  Flavor OK but I don't see it as outstanding.

I've never been a beef jerky fan.  But suddenly, in college, I found myself craving beef jerky!  Because I didn't have my dehydrator, I had to buy some from the store.  One of my roommates said that Hi-Country tasted great and was priced the best - and he was right!  Now I can't get enough of this stuff!It's made from strips of beef steak, as opposed to ground or super tenderized beef.  So it is a little tough after a few days, but it's really not that tough.  You can bite right through it in one direction, or you can chew on it for a while the other direction.The seasonings and marinades are just right and super tasty.  You can't go wrong with the original recipe, or you can go for an extra kick with the peppered.  I'm not a fan of Teriyaki, so I can't comment on it.Now for my only complaint: sometimes you get a hunk of fat that you just can't chew through.  It happens maybe once or twice per 1 lb. bag, but it's still there.  Otherwise, the jerky is just right.Give this beef jerky a fair shot.  Chances are you'll like it and you won't be going back to your old brand any time soon.

The High Country Jerky is very good, not overly spiced, not overly dry, and tastes great. Most jerkies today are made with so much salt and soy that you can't taste the meat for the spice; not so with the HC Original. Wow, I don't know what to say about the "bad idea" review, and it's interesting because the company actually claims the lava salt has positive health effects. For what it's worth, we haven't noticed any change in our health, good or bad, since using this product.About six months ago a friend gave us some Palm Island Salts (black, red and green) as a housewarming gift and we really love them all. He works in one of those hippie/dippy health/organic foods stores down near Santa Cruz, owned by some very health-conscious people. I'm a meat-lovin' (grass-fed only), organic-produce-eatin' moderate, and it's the taste that causes me to buy this salt and the organic produce I eat, not the health claims.It's true this salt has activated charcoal as the third ingredient, behind "Natural Pacific Sea Salt" and "Premium Hawaiian Sea Salt," and ahead of "Hawaii Kai Ocean Essence," a trademarked blend of "ocean electrolytes, trace minerals, and elements." Sounds like health-nut market-speak to me, but it sure tastes good!Our favorite is the black, which is just amazing, but the red is a close 2nd. It's incredible what a difference it makes in the food we cook, compared to other sea salts we use, and all our guests take notice when I use it! We like the green too, but don't use it much. We still use Redmond Sea Salt for day-to-day cooking, and it's very good too, but whenever we want to add something special, we add the black or the red.We use it very sparingly, as it is quite strong in flavor. A single 6-ounce pouch is only half-empty after 6 months, so a little goes a long way. We actually use the red a little more, as it is nearly as good in taste and much better in appearance.Not that I doubt the above reviewer about the danger of activated charcoal, but it seems a safe product to me just judging from personal experience, and it is put out by a company that actually seems to have a conscience. You can check out their website at [...]If you have concerns about the charcoal, try the red!

column9: Bringing Zingy To an All New Level
column10: My first impression is not the initial taste on the tip of my tongue as first expected, but the powerful, almost peppery taste at the back of my throat as I sip this one down. On the second sipping, more on the tip of my tongue this time, the tea's more subtle qualities come through: the mellow side of the lemon and ginger combination--then wham again with the peppery snap at the back of my throat. This is no mildly flavored herbal, but one directly infused with ginger root, lemon peel, lemon grass and blackberry leaves. One other interesting ingredient is linden, a plant with many medicinal properties and used for such for many centuries. It would be interesting to know if it is the linden flower that is used (and most probably it was), since this is a diaphoretic, a very mild fever-inducing part of the plant when taken as a hot tea. This naturally enables the body to help fight off infections according to some sources I looked up on the web. Not to worry though--this is not a fever that will keep you from work! It's one that will make your body work for you instead.I bought this one for some relief from a sore throat and it definitely helps ease my sinus induced problem. As with any lemon-flavored beverage I've tried, it does leave a slight aftertaste of lemon, but not too strong or unpleasant. I imagine it would be quite good with honey, which I will definitely try once I get home from work. For now, a slight bit of sugar seemed to compliment the flavors nicely, even bringing them out more. This is a strong flavored herbal, not a mellow one as I've come to expect a lot of herbals to be. Drink with caution if you like your herbals on the softer side. This one's courting the wilder side of the tea experience.

Of all the Lemon & Ginger teas, this, by Twinings, is the best!!  Amazon sells it at a muchless expensive price than the grocery stores sell it. In the winter, I buy one box (of sixpackages) a month.  I hope this helps you make an affirmative decision to purchase TwiningsLemon & Ginger tea.
I prepare a cup of Twinings Ginger Tea every morning. It helps settle my tummy and my mind. I'm so glad I found it!

Ginger is good for getting the damp and cold out of ones body, and this tea bag has a mild ginger flavor which doesn't offend the drinker's taste buds. But it also lacks overall taste one is yearning for in a cup of hot tea. Also, where is lemon in this Lemon & Ginger tea anyway?
One of my favorite herbal teas - and perfect for cold weather.  Lemony and gingery.  And getting this in bulk - whats not to love?
This is one of the best types of lemon teas you'll get in the market.  I love the zing the ginger delivers with every sip.  I just can't get enough of it ;-)

I love this tea.  It is fantastic all the time, but really great for a sore throat.  I am lactating and can not have caffeine. I drink a cup every time I feed my baby.  Now she is 5 months old and I have been back to work for 2 and half months and we have not had a single sick day.  Buying on Amazon has been the most cost effective way to purchase this tea.

column9: Stir up some goodness with this mellow tea!
column10: I've been drinking this forever. It's so good. I use it as a soup base by adding chicken stock to a pot of tea. Nom nom.

I love this tea.  I combine it with a Twinings Breakfast Tea Bag and it's a great way to start the day.  I love mine with 1 tsp of organic sweetner and a little milk.I sometimes have trouble finding it in the groceries so having it directly shipped from Amazon every 2 months, I never give out.  It's also a better value thru Amazon.

Good lemon & ginger tea. I like mine slightly sweet - helps to meld the lemon and ginger flavors. Has a strong peppery bite. My favorite so far is Tea Forte - I really like that one, but it is out of my acceptable price range. Twinings is a good substitute.
good product for my everyday health. I am using "subscribe and save" to get additional discount and free shipping.

I love ginger, and I love lemon. This tea is a perfect combination of both. It easily makes two cups, the second not as strong but still a good way to drink fluids. If you aren't interested in reusing, try empting the tea bag into the water. The resulting tea is much stronger, for some odd reason. But they you have to worry about chewing pieces of ginger and lemon, which doesn't bother me. It really is the best I've tried. Others are weak and kind of pathetic compared to this.
Twinings - Lemon & Ginger Herb Tea - 6 Units / 20 bagThe flavor of this tea is OK but not outstanding.
Great flavor.  My friend from England introduced me to Twinings products and they are by far a superior product.
Tea has quite strong lemon essence smell out of the box. That makes me wonder how much "natural" vs. artificial flavoring is there. Ginger is way too strong. Some people might like it...

column9: Lentils w/Onion & Bay Leaf, all Organic. YUM!! Soy? Ugh.
column10: This is one of the most heartful, hearty presentations of a healing comfort food I can imagine eating [definitely slurping with glee]... though I have one issue with it which won't immediately bother others as it unfortunately will me. I'll attempt to explain...My Aunt Mary's homemade lentil soup, saged and simmered with near religious grace at the opening of each new year, was beyond description, so when I saw this canned soup my soul drooled in thanks!Reading the ingredients noted on the buying page, I was thrilled that the soup was composed not only of organic lentils, but with a list of organic ingredients which to me, well versed in herbs for heavy healing as well as high flavor, read like a literal Godsend for my needs for delicious sustenance. Even the label reeked with super yummy culinary art. I couldn't wait to get my hands [and taste buds] on that concoction.The unfortunate part for me is that when the can arrived in good time and condition, and was in hand; I read the ingredients. Indeed each on the list was certified organic. That to me means no GMO's, no genetic modification of any type, nor excess additives are involved within the product. The unfortunate part for me was that "organic" soy was included as one of the beans in the soup.I need to stay away from any type of soy, as much as possible, and I honestly have a hard time believing that any type of soy these days could be called organic, especially in the sense of having no GMO or genetic modification. But, even if there is such a thing as a truly organic soybean, I would still be compromised by other aspects of that seed's purpose, which, according to some scientists, was not intended to be a human food.If you want to background on this, feel free to read THE DARK SIDE OF CINDERELLA by Dr.s Mary Enig and Sally Fallon. That article can be read on Dr. Mercola's web site.A larger part of this "Why NO SOY for me" is that I've had a magnesium deficiency and liver debilitation for most (if not all) of my life. That deficiency and debilitation means that I am much more vulnerable... [having shown symptoms earlier and and with more serious and varied consequences which are not only severely painful but life threatening and accelerating of aging ailments]... than the general population would be, to the toxic and mineral blocking facets of soy, along with its estrogen effect being forced into overdose, due to the predominance of soy products [included as ingredients in other foods] having been pushed into the food marketplace so many ways since the 60's [see above article for background].Even if not for the health difficulties I've suffered from soy products being included in so many foods for decades [I'll turn 63 this year] through various ways; I can't stand the taste or smell of soy, except in fermented soy sauce, or except when it is dramatically masked or enhanced.This won't be an issue to those who believe soy is a healthy vegetable if produced by organic restrictions, or even if it's produced with GMO scientific enhancement. And the other ingredients and the caring way this product has been produced and presented would indeed be akin to God Food, IMO. That is why I'm giving this product a 5 star rating.For those who seek organic presentations and organic soy, this soup would indeed be a product of highest appeal.But I needed to include the warning about its soy presence, for those like me who might already be limited by soy related allergies, intolerances, or debilitations; or who would like to be informed on the buying page ingredients notations that soybeans are included in this otherwise richly luxurious soup.I wish there were someone young and healthy who likes soy to give the two cans I purchased with joyful anticipation.  I don't dare eat it, even though many foods I get at the grocery store and restaurants are impregnated with soy or cooked in soybean oil. So, what's one more soybean?The point is that I've been gradually building a stock of 100% certified organic, no soy foods, focusing these cautious purchases from a level of health and survival at risk. I would not have guessed that this type of soup would have added soybeans to its recipe.  It represents to me a food with an historic and near religious significance from a cultural soul-set which would have been inimical to adding soybeans to its long revered ingredients. [See the article noted above if you want to know what the ancient Orientals believed about the soybean seed; I would have been honored to eat their revered foods.]All the issues for me could be remedied if soybeans would have been disclosed on the buying page as an ingredient.Each of the other ingredients were listed. Why not mention the soy?What hurts me most is I was SO looking forward to slurping that soup! I honestly envy those who would be able to comfortably enjoy it as it is, with soy.With respect to those who believe soy is a true nutrient, I apologize and have no desire for your choice for soy products to be limited in the marketplace. Even if those who believe soy is potentially harmful with long-term input are wrong, I want the presence of this [IMO] toxic anti-nutrient to be clearly disclosed, especially since so few products in the marketplace are free of its presence.I'm still hungry for a truly organic soup precisely like this one, with NO soy of any kind, but thankful that I still have a yummy good supply of Wolfgang Puck Organic Creamy Tomato Soup, 14.5-Ounce Cans (Pack of 12), and Wolfgang Puck Organic Chicken with Egg Noodles Soup, 14.5-Ounce Cans (Pack of 12).I have a growing stock, purchased from Amazon, of the type of organic presentations I need, and hope to be able to review those, but health issues are making my supply of reserves at low ebb indeed. Thankfully, many products available on Amazon are clearly marked for ingredients, so most of us can find what we want or need, by preference or necessity.Thank you very much, Amazon sellers who give a clear, full disclosure of ingredients,Linda Shelnutt

column9: Good dog food/reasonable price - even the cats love it!
column10: I switched my dog to the Iams Healthy Naturals chicken food about 2 months ago. Previously, she was eating Science Diet for the past 2 years. I didn't have any big issues with Science Diet, except for the fact that it was fairly expensive and I could only buy it at one of the local pet stores. Due to work schedules, it is sometimes difficult to get to a pet store while they were still open.The reason I picked this Iams product is because the first few ingredients are actually meat, not wheat or rice, etc. I switched my dog over to the brand slowly, and she seems very happy with it. I realize there ARE better quality dog foods out there, such as the Blue Buffalo brands. However, the dog really didn't care for it, and the cat that did try to eat it had an allergic reaction, so we stopped buying it. That is more expensive - if our dog liked it more and we could keep the cat from getting into it we would have dealt with the cost, but it just doesn't work for us.Our two cats LOVE the Iams dog food as well. We feed them Iams Proactive chicken flavor cat food, but when I fill the dog dish, they will run to it and try to eat as much as they can before the dog gets to it. I think it is a good product for a decent price.

I have been feeding my 2 dogs this Iam's for several months now and definately noticed they are more spry. They are both 7 years old and act like younger dogs again! Happy to get it on Amazon delivered with free shipping! Ordered it originally when I had an accident and couldn't go shopping but not only is the price lower than the store now I don't have to lug the bags into the car and the house.

I just bought a 29lb bag of this that was on sale for $15 just for a trial. I have four dogs including one with unkown food allergies/intolerances, an overweight beagle dog, and a nine year old senior. I have just been feeding straight gravy train canned food due to prior problems with other dry foods mixed with The Honest Kitchen food. The honest kitchen is Great but pricy for feeding four mouths and I go through six cans of gravy train per day so wanted to get them back on a dry food to cut down on costs. This is one of the few dryfood options that has meat ingredients which is why I've picked this.  It is by one of the well known petfood companies that I usually stay away from but with the quality of this food, I may sway towards iams for more of my pet needs. My dogs love this and I'm gradually transitioning them to it. It is readily available at my local WalMart so thats a plus and I know that my pups are getting the nutrition they deserve! FYI-Ive had problems with Taste of the Wild dry dogfood! It almost killed my dog, just a caution, don't be fooled by the great reviews and ingredients like I was! It made the dogs breath smell horrid as well as their waste and body odors too!

I usually feed Three Dog Bakery but ran out while on vacation. I bought this instead and to say they loved it would be an understatement. I had to pull them off of it because they just got so fat! If you have a healthy and very active dog, this is great as far as them eating it. I can't really tell if they just ate more because they liked it so much, or if they ate the same quantity and got fatter on it.

This is the worst thing you could possibly feed your DOG. The second ingredient is chicken by-product meal, a dry rendered product of slaughterhouse waste. It's made from what's left of a slaughtered chicken after all the prime cuts have been removed.In a nutshell, chicken by-products are those unsavory leftovers usually considered "unfit for human consumption".In addition to organs (the nourishing part), this stuff can contain almost anything -- feet, beaks, undeveloped eggs -- anything except quality skeletal muscle (real meat).[....]

This is beautiful black finishing salt.  I have used it several times at family gatherings, and it ALWAYS starts conversation!  Very flavorful without being too salty.  Tastes great on anything.  Only con is that it will make your hands, clothes, and teeth black if you get it on there.  No big deal, though, just blow it off!

These are excellent!  The raisins are plump & the chocolate is nice & sweet!  Chocolate covered raisins are by far one of my favorite treats since I was a teen.  Back then I was gobbling up Raisinets; I knew nothing about what the food companies do to our food.  When I got into my early 20's & discovered that just because it's allowed to be sold in stores as food doesn't mean it's safe or food for that matter!  That ended my chocolate covered raisin eating for many years.Later I found Wood Stock Farm Organic chocolate covered raisins.  They are good, but sometimes I would get bags that were not as good as the others.  On top of that they cost about $10 a bag.Now we have SunRidge Farms Organic Milk Chocolate Raisins & I have to say, they are simply the best I've had so far!  I am in heaven!  To add to my joy, they use ORGANIC Soy Lecithin.  I am so frustrated by USDA Certified Organic products (esp. chocolate) that continue to use non organic soy lecithin in their products.  GMO no thank you!The ingredients per the delicious bag I have right next to me: Organic Milk Chocolate (organic evaporated cane juice, organic milk powder, organic cocoa butter, organic unsweetened chocolate, organic soy lecithin[an emulsifier], organic vanilla), Organic Raisins, Pure FoodI hear all the time how organic is too expensive.  I think having to go to the Dr. gets pretty expensive too.  I guess it's up to the individual how they want to spend their money...

I spotted these at my local Fred Meyer and decided to give them a shot. The chocolate is so smooth and the raisins are so plump that I have to exercise incredible amounts of control to not eat the whole bag in one sitting. These are some of the best chocolate raisins ever. Well, that's just my opinion though. Opinions may vary.

I reviewed the non-organic version of these as 4 stars and said that it would have been 5 if the ingredients were organic.  I have since tried this organic version and am disappointed to say that I don't think they taste as good as the non-organic versions.  The chocolate is sweeter and less chocolaty.  The non organic version is just the right blend of sweet and bitter-sweet.  This version is just too sweet.  The raisins, while they may be organic, taste inferior.  They seem a little crunchy.  I don't know why.  Good organic Thompson raisins taste much better than the raisins in these.  I hope the manufacturers can improve these so they are BETTER tasting than the non-organic version, not worse.  Not worth the extra price.  On the other hand, if you like them sweet and less chocolaty, you'll like these.

column9: Surprisingly good taste and not overly spicy!
column10: I purchased a bag of this mix in the airport a few weeks ago in New Orleans.  I cooked it the other night and added shrimp and it was surprisingly pretty good that night.  However, since it has been in the refrigerator for the past two days, it tastes great!  I can really taste the seasonings in it and I love the flavor.  I am definitely going to purchase more.  Definitely recommended.  But it is not too, too spicy but has a nice kick to it because I can't really handle spicy food.

I've bought these chocolates in Germany.  There are several varieties of these, but the "Obstbraende" is definitely one of my favorites.  The chocolate-nut-alcohol combination is simply fantastic.  Word of advice:  do not bite into the chocolate in half.  You have to put the whole piece in your mouth, or the liqueur will just ooze out and you'll miss the whole fun of this chocolate-y goodness.

column4: A Research It Maven "Just the facts please"
column9: Not Roasted! - Natural Hazelnuts (Filberts) so great for baking!
column10: Great Value! Same quantity (60 oz) of Bob's Red Mill toasted hazelnuts (on Amazon) is $20.00 higher! Plus, you can get the Amazon Subscribe & Save price on these! Keep them frozen up to a year and they are real easy to toast in the oven yourself. It's hard to find natural, raw hazelnuts, and Diamond brand is the highest quality. For baking, raw nuts are best so they don't get overcooked and bitter. Recommended.
The nuts were fresh and very tasty. I bought them for baking, but also ended up toasting them just to snack on.

Opened a pack and roasted them on the day of package arrival. Fresh, right? Not at all! 1 in 3 taste stale (the expiration date reads Oct 2011). These are going right to trash can!Amazon service was great though. Ordered on Sunday, arrived Wednesday. Packing was impeccable.

Packaging, price and quick service are all terrific.  I have had difficulty finding hazelnuts in local stores, so I'm very happy that Amazon has them available.  Extra packages store easily in the freezer until needed.
This is a great way to stock up on produce from out of area. Good deal at a great price.

I was put on a waiting list when I purchased these nuts so when they arrived I was a little concerned about the expiration date of Sept 2012 on the bags.  After opening and chewing a couple I was really concerned about the freshness since they tasted a little dried out.  I called Diamond Nuts and inquired about how long nuts are good for after they're packaged.  I was told by their company rep that nuts are good for two years after packaging so that meant I was sent bags that were 1 year and 7 months old.  Now how do you get put on a waiting list for a product and then receive old , almost out of date product?  I'll tell you how, companies think if you're from West Virginia then you have an under 50 IQ and they can send out of date items, factory seconds and merchandise that had been in the recycle or junk bin straight to West Virginia and us dumb-ass hillbillies won't know the difference.  I have no problem with Amazon because they made it right by issuing me a refund.  A word to the wise, always check the expiration date on any thing you buy.

column9: The price is great but the nuts are stale.
column10: I have been buying these nuts from Amazon for about a year now using the autoship and they have been hit or miss from the very beginning. One bag is fine and the next is stale, which means half of the 6 bags they ship out each month are bad. I've been continuing to buy them because the price is so good and they are loaded with lots of good fats. Also, I am allergic to almonds and this is a great alternative, but after buying some hazelnuts from a local store I realized just how much better they were compared to the Diamond ones here and have finally cancelled my subscription with Amazon and decided to just pay more for some fresh and much better tasting nuts. I don't know if its the brittle plastic packaging that Diamond uses or if the nuts are old to begin with but unfortunately I now have to pay almost double at the grocery store. I did use the nuts for baking and the slightly stale taste is definitely masked when you grind them up and put them in chocolate chip cookies or something similar but if you plan on eating these raw like I was doing on a regular basis then prepare yourself to be biting into quite a few stale ones and a few downright rancid ones in every bag.I also just want to mention that I also order the Planters pecan halves and they are delicious with never a stale nut in the package and Amazon has them at a great price too!!

column9: Perfect size package for making nut milk
column10: 2 cups is the perfect size to yield 1 quart of hazelnut milk the way I make it. The nuts are smaller so I suppose that makes them filberts ... but 2-cups is 2 cups. The two I have used have been fresh and tasty so when we get down to 1 left, I'll order more.My recipe2- cups hazelnuts4-5 organic dates4-5 cups of water (how thick do you like it whole or skim consistency)Blend on soup setting (not to where it's hot, just totally emulsified. Then strain through nut milk bag. Refrigerate and enjoy. Use left over "cheese" to make hazelnut cheese...our son loves it.Update (7/1/2011): I have since move to using Amazon's Subscribe and Save option and get a shipment of these once a month. Also we no longer use dates int he milk, just the nuts and 34oz of water.
I love hazelnuts but can hardly eat these for being concerned about getting an old nut.

These nuts are completely inedible. They arrived stale and had a strong plastic taste - from being in the bag so long, no doubt. The expiration date includes the month and the day but not the year. Totally BOGUS! Save your money and your health - don't buy these nuts.
We used at least three bags of the filberts and each bag contained many rancid filberts.  We haven't opened any more of the bags.

The packages has a shelf time of less than few months. it lacks freshness and tasted stale. I was skeptical when I placed the order and reading the reviews. I made sure to contract Amazon prior to placing my order  to further inquire and obtain some sort of information pertaining to the quality and validity of the item. Yet, What I received failed meet my expectation and was not what I was hoping to get. Amazon customer service was helpful and offered me the option of getting a refund or a replacement.
I wish I had glanced at the reviews before I bought these. They're just horrible. They're so stale that they don't even taste like hazelnuts.

column9: Very uneven quality.  So-so customer service
column10: At the beginning (April) the hazelnuts were fresh and sweet.As the time progressed towards October they went progressively more stale.The October shipment had roughly 5-10% of the nuts that were not very tasty.Then they discontinued my subscription without even telling me that they are doing it.Yes, the price is right but it seems to be a case of you get what you paid for
Good price and decent quality.  Decent real fresh like some I have purchased but definitely not the worst either.  US grown is a big plus for me too.

I am not sure how much I can say, they are nuts, and they taste like nuts. So thumbs up for meeting expectation in that regards!The only complaint I have is the packaging... the plastic turns a little weird in the freezer, kinda fragile.. I pulled two bags out of the freezer, and the plastic tore just by knocking against other freezer items. It was a nutastrophy.

What a fabulous thing to find -- hazelnuts already shelled!They were fresh, whole, and near perfect! And my hand was relieved that there will not be any nut cracking in the future!I, of course, order too many, but the guys at the office love the Cinnamon Hazelnut Biscotti!  Got to keep them happy!
there's all those craze about hazel nut and i find i prefer walnuts and almond to this nut.  i guess it's an acquire taste

My husband and I eat popcorn most nights.  Popcorn was on the core food list at Weight Watchers.  We'd rent a movie and have one flavor at a time with 2 tsp of olive oil, and non-stick spray to make the seasoning stick.  They make popcorn so much better.  We went from microwave, to original method in a pot, to a machine, to an air-popper.  Each time we used one of the flavors.  I love them.

Kernel Seasons has the best and most interesting popcorn seasonings. They can suffer from caking and clogging, however. I'm not sure how to prevent this--it seems to be a constant problem with popcorn seasonings--but every one they come up with is delicious!

column4: Emily Davis "Avid Reader of All Non-Fiction"
column10: I can't have popcorn, so I can't speak to how it tastes on that, but I use this seasoning on eggs, in cornbread, and sprinkled on crumbled hamburger while cooking it in the skillet.  It's great - it's cheesey, not too salty, and it makes everything I cook with it taste 'deeper' in flavor.  I'll be buying more of this!

These are my favorite Mexican candies. They have a very distinct flavor and a great balance between a sweet and spicy flavor. Sometimes these candies are too sweet for me, but this brand makes them just right.

These lollipops are so amazing. At first, when I tried it I was completely disgusted by the vinegary chili powder on the outside. However, the more I ate the more I really began to like the taste. It kind of has to grow on you. My favorite is biting the whole sucker off the stick and letting the chili flavor mingle with the mango inside. Truly excellent. Not too spicy, and not too sweet.
My wife bought this candy back from her trip to mexico. I found them on Amazon.com and they're sooo good, try them and let us know what you think :-)

I thought these would be good because I saw kids with them at school. Turns out, I spent $8 for Nothing.  These are an overwhelming amount of chile powder,the only way I could even eat these were if I rinsed of the powder and just have the mango. I strongly recommend you NOT TO BUY THESE. THEY R NASTY!!!

Light and flavorful. Lovely, really. This pasta cooks beautifully and the shape holds the sauce nicely. Try it with Alfredo sauce with fresh peas and prosciutto, that's what I did last night. Simply delicious! Had the leftovers for lunch today, perfect texture even after reheating.Boil them for about 8 minutes for a nice al dente texture.I really hope Amazon will continue to carry this pasta because I can't find it locally and, with the free shipping, it's the best deal I've seen online so far.These straccetti are not as chunky as the trottoloni, also by Marella, which I also tried and liked a lot.

Monin alway produces a great syrup and the strawberry is no exception.  We use it in margaritas.  I would have given this 5 stars but the original packaging containing the 4 bottles was opened when it arrived.  This is the second time this happened when buying from Amazon. I find that a little bothersome.
Love these and can never find them in the stores.  If you are a grapefruit fan you will love these, calms my craving for grapefruit gummy candy with much less calories.

This is a mint type candy packed with grapefruit flavor. Container is thin, small, closes tight enough. Personally I like the design of it also. The candy is full of grapefruit flavor. I also like it that it is free of aspartame (aspartame is the very reason why I have stayed away from this type of mints). It would have been even better it was sweetened with 100% xylitol.

I love chicken breasts marinated in this. It is not at all spicy, so very kid friendly, but has excellent flavor. The packet mixes with 1/4 c. oil, 2 tbsp water and 2tbsp vinegar to marinate 2 lbs of chicken, salmon or seafood. The variation (suggestion) to use the packet with 1/4 c. orange juice, 1/4 c. oil and 1 tbsp honey is absolutely as good if not better. That being said, the price at Wal**** is less than a dollar a packet, so unless you can't find this in your area, the current price is absurd.

column9: I am not a coffee expert.
column10: So all I can tell about this coffee is that it was fairly fresh, makes a smooth, mild cup o' joe. Which has made the wimpier coffee fiends in the household happy, and while I do like this coffee, I really like a stronger bolder flavor.I have been having real problems getting fresh beans lately. The beans I have been buying at the stores available to me locally have been stale the last few times I purchased them. I guess my only recourse is to roast my own or buy directly from a roaster which might be more than my pocketbook can handle. At least the coffees I have been trying out here on Amazon have been much fresher and in some cases cheaper than what I can buy locally.

We drink a lot of coffee in our house, and we're fairly picky besides.  I'm constantly looking for good coffees that are less than $7 per pound.  This one on sale recently by Amazon ran $6.17 per pound with super saver shipping, so it was worth a try.  It is better than I expected, although at the suggested retail price of $10.50 per pound, I couldn't recommend it.  The coffee does live up to its claim about being a breakfast blend, medium in flavor, although some, including me, could wish that it was more full bodied.  Another plus factor is that this coffee will leave no aftertaste or acidic problems, which can be problems for heavy coffee drinkers.
I have been drinking this coffee for quite some time and have come to enjoy it very much. I came from Gavalia of 5 years and try this coffee one day because of the price and I have not looked back.

I am very picky when it comes to coffees. This is a very good one. I didn't give it the very "top" rating because there are very few coffee beans that will ever receive this rating from me. This is a pleasure to savor...at breakfast or at any other time of the day for that matter. AAA+++

column9: Long lasting, and safer in my experience.
column10: My dogs, and many of my client's dogs, inhale regular rawhides.  I was always worried about them swallowing big chunks.And I really hate flavored plastic bones, as well as veggie bones, since I've seen chunks of those being swallowed whole right in front of me a number of times.These have been by far the best solution for me.  It takes the dogs much longer to chew them, and they really have to work at it.  For all my medium to heavy chewers, these are my first choice.Having said that, nothing is 100% safe.  After chewing up most of the bone, a very food motivated chewer could the remaining hard chunk - which could be a serious problem.  That's why I tend to choose the bigger sizes (8" or 10") over the little ones (4"), and take the bone away when it gets to a swallow-able size.  I buy these in bulk.  The value compared to other types of rawhides is huge, even without a bulk discount.These come in flavors also.  This plain style, as well as the the chicken flavored ones, have not been messy at all.  The beef ones are not quite as tidy.

column4: B. Smith "The giant on whoms shoulders your c...
column10: My 6 mo. old large breed puppy really likes these. Its definitely better than a regular rawhide and apparently safer for puppies too. So better value, lasts longer, and safer for your dog. Worth buying.

These bones are amazing and my dogs love them. I have two vigorous chewers so these bones are a much better option than regular rawhides or other treats. They are much more expensive at retailers though, so I love being able to save some money by purchasing them online.

I'm so glad we found out about these. Our 6 month old puppy was going through a bag of chew sticks a day. He is on hour 3 of one of these bones and is only about halfway through it. He has been chewing on it non stop for those 3 hours, too. Off to order some more!
They taste just as they did when I was a kid. AWESOME!!! I wish you would bring this candy back to Alabama stores (CVS,Walmart,etc...)

This Grandma pickles is by a company called Periyar. It is very tasty and is otherwise called Vadu mango. They are smaller mangoes and dipped in salt/spicy flavorful liquids. Very much relished in South India. This brand is reputed one. The picture is not correct, I will upload one soon.
This was a gift and the recipient disliked the product.  Basically, a waste of money, as the 5 remaining cartons were never opened.
don't waste your money this tastes awful I thought it would be a good quick meal to take to work but it has this werid taste and its rubber texture is gross...I can't beleive I paid $12.00 for this

Never again will I assault my mouth with a product from this company. I'd rather eat a box of fermented jockstraps. Maybe that's going a little far, but this... filth isn't fit to feed to my dogs. I think that the federal and state governments need to buy this wholesale and feed it to prisoners. You want reformed inmates? Make them eat this and the US's prisons will be empty.1.) Empty noodles into the box.2.) Gag.3.) Separate noodles with a fork.4.) Pour sauce over noodles.5.) Gag.6.) Heat for 2 minutes.7.) Stir concoction, gag, take a bite, spit it out, swallow your pride, and throw it away.8.) Eat something else."What would you have wanted to know before you purchased the product?" That it tasted terrible. Specifics: the noodles were rubbery, yet tore like parchment, and that the sauce was made from the condensed secretions of dung beetles and slugs.

column9: taste is bad, noodles were all stuck together
column10: The instructions for this meal indicate you should empty the noodles into the box, and break them apart with a fork.  I did that.  Then it tells you to add the sauce (this doesn't taste anything like teriyaki sauce), and microwave it for 2 minutes.I followed the instructions, and when I opened the box, I got a clumped up noodle meal with poor taste.  I threw half of it away.  Out of all the microwave and frozen meals I eat, this one rates as one of my lowest.

I'm not sure what the other reviewers were expecting out of this.  I've had a lot of microwavable noodles, and this is one of the better brands.  If you're looking for Americanised teriyaki chicken or something like that, you aren't going to get that here.  These are noodles with teriyaki sauce.  One of the things I like about Kame is that the noodles are pre-cooked.  They're stored in a moisture pouch with oil, so all you have to do is heat them up.Cooking tip: don't worry about seperating the noodles straight away.  Just remove them from the pouch, push them to the bottom, and pour the sauce over.  Then wait for it to be heated before stiring/seperating the noodles.  It makes it much easier.

I thought it would taste good considering the price and fancy box. I also figured it'd save me time and money on meals for work...WRONG! This is the worst! I don't think I've ever tasted anything this awful in my life. The noodles were difficult to even separate with a fork according to the instructions. Once that was finally done and I poured the dark brown goop "sauce" into the box and heated it up, the office stunk like spicy armpits! Even worse was the actual taste! The noodles were hard and rubbery and the sauce was really salty. I threw it away immediately!!! HORRIBLE!!!

column9: Not great, but good to keep in a desk drawer for a working lunch.
column10: I bought a pack of the pad tai noodles, they have sat in my desk drawer for the last six months and I am finally on my last box.  By themselves, they are completely mediocre, throw a little Asian hot sauce on them and they are pretty good.  For the price they are a reasonable choice for a lunch substitute when you don't have time to run out of the office.

column9: If it ain't broke....please don't fix it!
column10: Well, this is the biggest disappointment that I've had with a food product for quite some time.  The original Propel Kiwi-Strawberry powder was, to me, the best tasting water additive on the planet!  Finally, I was able to drink quarts of water without forcing myself to do so.  The powder dissolved easily in my 16 ounce water bottle and the flavor was just sweet enough.  I have a sweet tooth and this stuff was awesome!  But some dumb focus group participants decided that ten calories per packet were just too many calories to allow in their diets each day. Ten bottles adds up to only 100 calories! Really?  Did they only ask anorexics?  The new version clumps in my water and has a bitter after taste.  I have to add my own artificial sweetener to get it to taste like the old version. That's way too much trouble for something that's supposed to be easy.  I even called Gatorade and begged them to bring back the other version along with the new but they said they wouldn't do it.  I am now looking for a replacement to Propel powder.  Mio Berry Pomegranate is real close and you can add as much or as little as you like.  I still mourn the passing of the original Propel powder but what can I do?  Marketing people are idiots and always will be.

Tastes great and powder disolves with no problem. I no longer drink soda of any kind or caffeine. Just wish the powder was easier to find and more "green" - would be great if they sold it in tubs with a scoop.
This drink mix is the reason I'm able to drink 8-10 glasses of water a day.  It's delicious, and I would recommend it highly!
It has a weird sickly sweet aftertaste. Plus, it has EDTA in it, which is on the FDA's toxicity watchlist

you know after reading the only one review, I was thinking maybe it was just jamie, well this propel just pain out sucks compaired to the orginal one. you know company's resaly dont care about there consumers anymore and it is sad. i have used there products since they come out. so much time to find another water do drink

I'll be honest, I thought this was a bit pricey, but I really like herbal teas with good flavor that can stand on its own and doesn't need sweetener. So I decided to give it a try. I was not disappointed.You read the ingredients, they seem so simple:Organic Lemongrass, Organic Schizandra Berries, Organic Roses, and Organic Clove.It must be those berries because this has got to be one of my favorite teas of all time. The flavor is quite distinct, yet delicate. If you like herbal teas or know someone that does, I highly recommend this as a treat.

column9: Morton & Bassett Organic Parsley, a High Quality Product
column10: I have used their organic bay leaves and was thoroughly impressed. Without any hesitation I decided to try their organic parsley flakes.  Needless to say the quality is as high as I had anticipated. Their organic parsley flakes are a delicious garnish or addition to vegetables, meats, and fish. (For example mashed carrots with parsley topping is so delicious!) It is organic and very carefully prepared and handled so you know that you are getting top quality. I highly recommend this product.
Excellent and something that I really needed in my spice collection. Packaged very well and wxtremely fresh. Item was also packaged very well

This is a perfect, on the go, refreshing beverage. I love the chocolate flavor. It is nice and rich/smooth without being too rich. This is low fat and has only 100 calories. This is easy to chill and throw in a lunch box or work bag. It is enough for a quick burst of energy without a crash mid-morning or mid-afternoon. I feel good about giving this to my kids since they do not ever get soda or any other junky drinks.

column9: Chocolate, Organic, Gluten & Dairy Free light refreshing 100 calorie drink. Portable & shelf stable what more can you ask for!
column10: 2012 and still as taple in our home. Great organic chocolate milk imitation. Not creamy like milk, but a light  chocolate drink like yahoo or chocolate soldier but not as sweet.  Sons want it everyday.  My whole family loves it.  So good  ordered 3 cases of 24 on subscribe and save.Makes great snack by itself, or quick refreshing addition to any snack or meal. fits perfect in lunch box.  Part of any healthy lifestyle even great for vegans. **allergy alert made from almonds / nuts

Wow... talk about false and misleading advertising. Anyone in the know, knows carrageenan is considered carcinogenic... aka a cancer causing substance. And what about this "natural" flavor? Hey, arsenic is also "all natural" as is cyanide. In other words, simply because something is called "natural" does not mean it's good for your body.Sorry Pacific Natural... your products are anything but. And it's a statement about how you try to fool your customers with your misleading labeling. I'll pass.

I'm comparing this to Blue Diamond's almond chocolate drink.  It gets bonus points for convenience as the only size I can find Blue Diamond in is 32oz, and these 8oz packages are very handy.  As far as the flavor goes it's good, but not as sweet as Blue Diamond (which makes sense since it has 25% less sugar).  Initially that turned me off, but I got used to it quickly.  I'm marking it down a star though for it's lack of calcium (even though if you look closely at the photo, you can see that it says "excellent source of calcium"---they must have reformulated.)

I was searching for something for my girls' school lunches and wanted a change from milk or juice boxes. They like almond milk, so I thought this would be a nice change. It proved a tad difficult for them to open by themselves and some boxes did not sit flat on the table as other milk brands do (horizon & organic valley). One daughter ended up wearing her milk as a result and it did not wash out of her clothes on a couple occasions. Although it tastes good and the price is right, we won't be purchasing more for lunchboxes.

This is my second order of this great pack of Pacific Natural Foods Organic Almond Non-Daily Beverage. After doing a lot of research for healthy chocolate flavored drinks that are were non dairy, this was the best of all the findings.PROS: Scruptious. Rich, thick, and pleases the tongue and mouth. Small and perfect sizing (though I drink 2 boxes). If you've had kidney failure or medical restrictions, this was wonderful to find! Often, with kidney restrictions, you can NOT have high protein, which both dairy and SOY drinks have. This has close to zero grams of protein. Also, if you're a vegan, dairy free. Gluten free. cholesterol free, 0% iron, which I have to look out for too. Doesn't have to be refrigerated. Natural ingredients (nothing artificial).CONS: Product is hard to find, at least anywhere locally. Amazon is great since it qualifies for free s&h, where other places charge way too much. If you have healthy kidneys would be disappointed how there is no protein or calcium. Low in vitamins/minerals (which can be good in way that not artificially added). If you write to the company, don't expect a response! I tried writing twice with compliments and questions; never responded to me. Also, straws don't work too well- end up peeling tab at opening and sip/pouring in rest.Overall, two thumbs up. Enjoy!

I'm totally dairy free due to severe allergies.  The Pacific Foods gives me a good option when traveling.  I keep a 4 pack in the car or take one to the gym to drink after a workout.  If you can tolerate soy then the chocolate soy silk is better tasting.  I use the subscribe and save another x%  Amazon makes it easy...

This drink is a tasty alternative to the Yahoo junk drink. It doesn't have a ton of nutrition but if you are looking for something to put in the kids lunch box besides juice everyday, I think they will appreciate it! It does taste just like the Yahoo chocolate drink but is made with much more trustworthy ingredients. Does not need refrigeration but says to serve chilled. The end point is try this for a change and it's something different and enjoyable for any age.

column9: Very tasty alternative to soy milk
column10: Since we are allergic to dairy, the seach for beverages that can be packed in a lunch has been difficult.  These 4-packs are great!  I can store them in the closet and then just pop a pack in the fridge the night before school.  the kids take vanilla most days and I use chocolate as a treat on Fridays.

Decided to try this at my son's recommendation, and really like it. Good alternative for those of us with lactose sensitivity. Just right for taking to work. My son says to try it warmed for hot cocoa.
I send these for my daughter's lunch, she likes them at room temp or cold, they are very portable since they do not need refrigeration
my son loves to take these in his lunch for school.  Since he can't drink cows milk, this is a great alternative for him
This is a great item for your kids who have milk allergies.  My son loves it and it is convenient to take on the go.

I've been drinking regular almond milk for about a year, the plain unsweetened (which I don't enjoy that much), plain sweetened (great) and vanilla, which is great too.  I found that the chocolate almond milk was quite delicious.  One of the things I like most about this product is that it is packaged in an 8oz individual serving.  This is nice because if it came in a larger size, I don't think I'd be able to consume it all in such a short time.  Each container has a straw attached to it and you poke it through a foil cover.  The product description describes the containers as "pouches" but they're the hard cardboard-like "pouch" so they're quite durable.  The milk I received has an expiration date of about 10 months from when I purchased it, so I'll have plenty of time to consume it.  I also had the milk shipped to Italy and it arrived without any damage or leakage.1 individual container, 8 oz (serving) contains:Calories  100Fat Cal  25Sodium  140mgPotassium 130mgCarb.  19gFiber  1gSugars  16gProtein  1gVitamin A 10%Vitamin D 25%Riboflavin 30%

I got this product when i was nursing. Milk proteins are difficult to digest for the baby and so babies vomit and spit up in the early months. My daughter stopped vomiting when i discontinued milk products.This milk is almond based, has no proteins and tastes great too!

I have NO complaints about this product. It's ORGANIC, it's ALMOND MILK, it's CHOCOLATE. So yes, there's sugar in it, but it's relatively HEALTHY! My kids and I all love it. It makes a great lunch drink and drink on the go!

My son and I enjoy a pouch or two of Pacific Natural Foods Organic Almond Milk almost every day. We love the chocolate flavor and I like that it's low fat. Very enjoyable, especially at the end of a hot day.

We buy these for travel (the TSA is OK with them for some reason) and for the kids lunches. I have also been known to crack one open and dump it over ice with the morning's cold coffee and it satisfies that iced mocha craving! We also love the Hazlenut in this brand/size.

The kids had tried some vanilla almond milk and loved it. While that brand did not produce a single serving pack, Pacific did and I purchase their vegetable broth all the time.  I send organic choc. milk in with the kids to school and now can switch it up.

I put these in my 6 year old daughters school lunch almost everyday. She loves them & on the rare occasion that she doesn't have time to drink it, I don't have to toss it when she brings it home since it doesn't need refrigeration :-)

These taste so good they disappeared very fast. If I kept them on hand all the time, I'd drink them by the gallon. I cannot drink milk and love chocolate milk, so I'm glad I found this nice snack. It's one I have trouble resisting.

column9: Great alternative to regular organic milk and organic soy
column10: I can only eat and drink organic so finding this made my life. I love having a little bit of chocolate treats here and there and this is nice to have and you feel a bit less guilty because it's healthier for you. It's organic, it tastes great - not too chocolatey or sweet but just right. It does have a unique taste and I like to alternate between the organic chocolate soy milk I get at the supermarket and this for a change in pace. When I get tired of one, I buy the other. Does not need to be refrigerated before opening but is always great chilled. Usually it disappears before you can even start enjoying it, haha. Highly recommend the try. Over all Pacific Natural and Organic foods are a trusted organic company and I have had no problems with them.

This item is an excellent item.  It tastes better than any of the other non dairy beverages.  I wish it were more readily available in local grocery stores.They carry other products made by this manufacturer, why not this item?  I like it because when I travel, it is easily packed and it is in smaller cartons, thus easy to store for travel.I have recommended this product to many people.

I love this milk!  It's the perfect soy alternative!  It's very chocolatey, sweetened perfectly, and so yummy when it's been chilled.  The size is perfect, and the straw on the side makes it perfect for taking along anywhere.
very good tasting.  My kids really enjoy them as slushies when they take them frozen to school and enjoy them for snack time.
My kids love this. They are gluten, casein free and just love this as an alternative.

We are always searching for milk alternatives, as one of my sons can not digest caesin. This was a nice product that presented itself as chocolate milk...it wasn't too chalky tasting. The texture was somewhat similar to milk....he liked the product but I wouldn't say he LOVED it....

I think this milk is great. I have a 3 yr old granddaugter that is allergic to milk. She loves this stuff. Now I can give her quick and easy "milk" she can drink with out all the side affects. My 5 yr old grandson loves it too.

column9: Good product but what is with the price?
column10: I've purchased the case & my family likes it. The only thing that I do not like is that it is suggested that we are buying it at a 77% discount. If you'll look up the price of it's sister product - plain almond milk you see that it's regular price is almost equal to the "discounted" one for the chocolate almond milk. Both products' prices should be comparable. What is suggested here as a great discount is misleading. I am a bit disappointed because the promotion prompted me to order without thinking it through.

column9: I want to give this a better review
column10: This almond milk tastes great! It has a great flavor that is similar to cow's milk with a nutty flavor. If I think the taste is so great then why don't I give it a better rating? Unfortunately, there is no calcium in this un-enriched version so I can't really use it as a milk substitute for my children. When I can find an enriched version on Amazon, I will definitely renew my Subscribe and Save for that one.

One of the listed ingredients is listed as evaporated cane juice. Sure sounds like sugar to me.Another listed ingredient is Carrageenan which is a known carcinogen. Sorry folks I'm sure it probably tastes great but throwing in a buch of terms like natural and organic does not make it healthy.
It's ok but I didn't really like it.  Thinner consistency that I would like.

column9: Where is the nutritional value? Pretty much 100 calories of sugar & fat
column10: Outside of taste and people with soy issues, I haven't found a reason to drink almond milk. There is only 1g of protein and fiber in it. How do you take almonds which have fair amounts of both and suck them all out to make a drink? There's not a lot of calcium or other nutrients as well. So most of the calories is coming from sugar and fat. I just don't see the appeal. Same goes for rice milk.I'd stick with soy milk if you don't have an intolerance to soy. Just find a brand who's flavor you like. I'm rather fond of Westsoy and Trader Joe's personally.

column9: Good Energy with No Jitters for me
column10: Despite it's juvenile sounding name, this isn't a child's energy drink that's for sure. Each tube packs about 42,000% the recommended daily dose of Vitamin B12. The high from this is extremely stable and hasn't yet given me the jitters.  Everyone reacts differently though so to guarantee 100% that you will not get the jitters would be a lie.  When I take it, I feel very awake, alert, and clear headed. I use it before a workout and several of the ingredients make it perfect for the gym. The let down is probably the smoothest you'll find among energy drinks. And if you feel a cold coming on, downing one of these may help tremendously.The name comes from the interaction the mix has with water. You pour one vile into a 16-20 oz bottle of water and the stuff fizzes like crazy! If you don't get the lid on fast enough, you'll quickly find there will be a mess! I've found using a wide mouthed nalgene bottle is the best way to prevent these types of accidents.In addition to the massive amounts of Vitamin B12, it has a good amount of Vitamin C (500mg), Niacin (10mg), Vitamin B6 (2.5mg), Calcium (60mg), Magnesium (100mg), and Potassium (905mg). It has almost every water soluble vitamin meaning that a lot of the excess that your body doesn't utilize, will be flushed through your kidneys. With that being said, drink a lot of liquid with this and don't over use the product (company recommends no more than 3 a day) or the chance of getting kidney stones exists.It has a 317mg "proprietary" blend blend of L-Arginine, L-Taurine, Caffeine from guarana, Alpha-lipoic acid, Grape seed extract, Green tea leaf extract, Ginger root, and Ginseng root. I don't know how much each compound contributes to the 317mg but they do acknowledge that 100mg of it is caffeine (about the same as a cup of coffee).There are multiple flavors but I'm partial to Grape and Orange Soda. The flavors are very sweet and candy-like but they surprisingly have no sugar. 10 total Calories and only 2g Total Carb.This is an excellent product and recommend it over any other energy drink.

I like this stuff!  Good source of various vitamins (esp potassium) and it seems to give me energy without some of the adverse effects of other energy drinks.  Not a significantly high amount of caffine which I like.  Heck, this stuff might actually be good for you!  Taste is good, better than many other energy drinks and the price is good compared to anything you might buy in a can.  I prefer the orange flavor.  Probably good for hydration during hot sweaty work or sports events.

After using Zipfizz for a year, I've been amazed at what it offers me.  I get sustained mental alertness and energy with no crash or fatigue.  It doesn't affect my sleep, and I find that it is easier to get up in the morning the day after taking Zipfizz.  You don't even have to use a whole tube if you're cost-conscious.  Sometimes, I use a half tube and find I get the results I need.  I will never drink Red Bull or Monster again.  This stuff is great.FYI, this thing is loaded with Vitamin B12 - as much as getting a Vitamin B shot from your doc.  Please avoid taking more than one or two tubes a day, because too much potassium can overload and be detrimental to your kidneys.

column9: Haven't been sick in TWO years thanks to Zipfizz
column10: This drink is just wonderful.  Although it has caffeine, it doesn't have an alarming amount.  The great thing about this drink is all of the vitamins (I'm not good about taking a multivitamin...).  I drink this fairly diluted; with at least 32 ounces of water instead of 16 ounces and the flavor is just right.  The citrus is my favorite and, sadly, they don't carry that at Costco anymore.  I've been drinking only one Zipfizz daily and work in a school -- a huge breeding ground for germs and viruses -- and haven't been sick in the two years I've been drinking this.  Pretty impressive.  And it is WAY cheaper than a cup of coffee at Starbucks :)

I am a 53 year old female who has been working out 6 mornings a week for years and this product is awesome!.  I have taken this product prior to my morning work out for about 2 years. I have been out of it for a week and can really tell the difference. Also, a half a tube in the afternoon will give you a pickmeup at work if needed. This is the only product I have ever used that has no crash associated with it.  A friend of mine is a dietician and she reviewed the ingredients and states that this is about the healthiest energy product out there.  I have recommmended this product to my friends at the gym and my employees at work and they all have give great feed back and continue to use this product.  I love it!

Just tried my first one and this caffeine addict with very high tolerance can seriously feel the effects and I am not even done with it! High marks for flavor too. The packaging will be very effective at keeping the stuff 'fresh' and will allow you to carry it around without the little packets opening in your bag. You can also re-close it if you do not want the full serving. The old stuff I used was a tablet that was individually foil wrapped and did just fine too and was much less wasteful. Each serving is in a thick rigid plastic tubes that will be around in the landfill for eons! They are #5 type plastic which is technically recyclable but is almost never accepted (think tupperware container) at local recycling centers. I hope the manufacturer will find a better solution to packaging this awesome stuff!

I've used this product for a couple of years and it's great!  You get increased energy and alertness, without any jitters, and it's all natural - not a bunch of chemicals.  I do not recommend this before a work out because you tend to use the bathroom a little more frequently.

To be honest, I was at first skeptical about this drink.  In my mind, an energy drink had always been any drink with sugar and caffeine levels as high as seen in Monster and Redbull.  My mother one day brought this home from Costco and told me to try it out.It took me probably 2 or 3 drinks to get used to the taste. It wasn't that it was terrible. I guess the "problem" when I started out was that the taste was just a bit different from what I'm used to.  But I have to tell ya this company did a great job sweetening the drink without using sugar or some other artificial crap that's seen in others.  Once you get used to this drink you find yourself popping one out casually once a day.That being said I've noticed that this drink doesn't have the same type of boost you get with caffeine.  The problem with Red Bull and coffee is that the caffeine, while kicking in a lot faster than this drink, also causes you to crash and burn several hours later just as quickly.  This drink however doesn't have that effect.  It gives me a subtle yet noticeable boost for several hours before giving me a "gentle landing" back to where I usually would be without the drink.Anyhow, that's where I am.  Down to 5 tubes and hunting for any deals on this at Costco and here.

I never liked Monster or Red Bull energy drinks plus they were costly.  I bought a box of this stuff at Costco and enjoy it before hitting the gym.  I stopped drinking coffee so this is helping me get through long afternoons at work.  I can't believe how sweet it is without sugar.  The packaging is small and I keep it in my office drawer.  I wish it wasn't packaged in plastic though.  Anyway, it's worth a try and you get lots of vitamins.

I'm going to try to keep my review simple.I mix one tube with 8-12oz of water.Pros: noticeable energy boost after 2-3 sips.  When I first tried it, i got a "high" or  a awakening buzz... after 1 sip. you just have to try it to understand.  Strong stuff. take it in sips through the morning.  (I don't recommend drinking the whole tube in 3 mins. )  No crash and jitters. ( But i'm sure you will feel weird if you drink it too fast.)Cons: a little on the expensive side, but far better deal than red bull or coffee from a store.  mixing the powder adds 1 or two extra steps in the morning.Bottom line: I like this product. It simply works.

I have to say that this pink lemonade flavor is simply delightful! I started drinking zipfizz to quash my overwhelming addiction to caffeine that had spiraled out of control.  I find that I have received the same pick-me-up that I was getting from 500-600mg of caffeine.  While ZipFizz does have 100mg of caffeine, it does not come with the same 'crash' that caffeine delivers.The pink lemonade flavor is, by far the best flavor I have had.  You can customize the sweet-tartness level by adding more or less water.  I recommend everyone try this product and you will be instantly hooked! Yaaaaay ZipFizz!

Found this product initially at Costco and wanted more of one flavor.  Found it offered on Amazon when the Costco no longer stocked the item and was more than happy with the order of Citrus flavor 20 tube boxes I received.

column9: Great for keeping you on the go!
column10: Zipfizz, Tastes good and keeps you moving all day .Zipfizz is loaded with energy and is great for those who lack the required rest from the night before.

A friend's doctor recommended this to her for weight loss after having a baby.  It is good, better with a little artificial sweetener added.  Note:  Be sure to drink some of the water out of your bottle, when you add the drink mix, it will fizz up some.

column9: Great boost and flavor in a tube
column10: We have been users of ZipFizz since it first came out.  It is not only a good kick up on energy when working out, when you travel it is easy to put a few in your carry-on for a energy boost when on the road.

I have been using ZipFizz for about 6 months now and I love it.  I am partial to the Grape and Orange, the Pink Lemonade was just a bit sour for me.  I only take one a day and right before I go to the gym.  I compare this to Advocare's "Spark" drink and this product is WAY CHEAPER but contains just about the same things!  Awesome for those on a budget.Some may be confused by what seems like an excess of vitamins on the ingredient label.  But any that you dont use up in the day get flushed from your body though your kidneys.  DO NOT TAKE MORE THAN 3 a day it says on the vile, but I only need one in the morning to help me rip though my workouts.I do not drink caffine in any other form because I am very sensitive to it. But with this drink I have not had a problem, I thought that it would make me jittery or feel awful, but this product does no such thing!  After the gym I am good to go though the time I get home and I sleep fine!

column9: Have been drinking ZIPFIZZ for a couple of weeks...
column10: I have been drinking ZIPFIZZ for a couple of weeks now.  So far my favorite flavor is the Orange.  At first I drank it like medicine... just for the energy.  Now I look forward to it.I was usually very groggy in the AM.  I drank several cups of coffee to wake up, and then I was anxious for the rest of the day.  I was in Sam's one day and there was a lady demonstrating ZIPFIZZ.  I tasted it and it wasn't too bad so I bought a box for 18 dollars.  I have been drinking it almost every day since.I drink half a serving every morning.  It works very quickly for me, and I am not jittery afterwards.  I have more energy and I am even more productive.  My mind is even clearer.I would recommend ZIPFIZZ to anyone looking for energy without the jitters of other energy drinks.  And Sam's seems to have the best price so far.

I really like this stuff but was a little annoyed that in 2 of my vials the product had solidified.  I don't know if water got in there or what but I got less than I paid for.  I will still buy Zipfizz I just hope I've seen the last of the solidified product.  It was rock solid - there was no getting it out and still using it.

column9: Great substitute for Pepsi and other sodas
column10: I am a Pepsi addict who is trying to reform. Zipfizz is being a big help in that process. It's easy to carry around, and when I eat out, I ask for an extra glass of water "to mix with my vitamins." I request a separate glass of ice to be added once it is mixed up. Be sure to drink the water down one to two inches from the rim so the fizz has somewhere to go! One of the things I love about soda is the fizz and the "burn" as it goes down my throat. There's just enough fizz in this stuff to give me some of those sensations, and to help me avoid sodas. I don't drink Zipfizz for the energy, and can't say I've noticed any increase in energy, or relief from fatigue, but that's not what I'm drinking it for!  I LOVE the grape flavor. It reminds me almost exactly of the Grapette I loved as a child. I had been craving it for years, but couldn't find any. Zipfizz Grape really works for me. The orange flavor reminds me of Orange Crush. Sometimes I use about half orange juice, half water to mix it with. That makes it taste more "orangy," and mellows it out a bit.  Citrus and Pink Lemonade are decent flavors, too. I usually add a little extra lemon juice to them, just for more kick. Occasionally, I add a splash of Diet 7-Up or Sprite, or other lemon-lime soda just to change it up a little. Yum!!I buy the grape and orange flavors at my local Sam's Club for about $20 per box of 20. Those are the only two flavors they carry. Citrus and Pink Lemonade, I have to buy online.Thanks to Zipfizz, I'm now drinking about two to four Pepsi*s a week instead of one or two a day!I love the little tubes that Zipfizz comes in, and save them to reuse. They are great for carrying aspirin, or other pills. I take the labels off once I've used the Zipfizz, and put on plain labels so I can mark what I have filled the tubes with. Some I use for the powdered CranAloe drink I take. The tubes are also useful for holding little safety pins, straight pins and needles, toothpicks, salt and/or pepper, sweetener, craft beads, etc. I filled one with my favorite seasoned salt so I can carry it to use when I eat out. At Halloween, I don't give out candy ... I give out the freebies I collect all year long ... bookmarks, keychains, pens and pencils, rulers, kid's meal toys, note pads, AND these little tubes. The kids love them!!

This drink makes me feel like sunshine! Some mornings are hard for me to get up; I feel heavy, slow and sluggish both mentally and physically. And if it's dark outside in the winter, it is even more difficult for me to get out of bed. Zipfizz helps me to "wake up" so I can get started on my day instead of conking out under the covers because I couldn't get out of bed fast enough once I've turned my alarm off. I've always used Zipfizz. I didn't know there was a letdown until I tried 5 Hour Energy which kicked in for about 2.5 hours and then I started feeling sluggish again. Zipfizz gives you enough to help your own body to get itself going so that it can keep going.The taste is nothing great though. Don't buy the powdered drink mix. Buy the drink shot (the tubes) instead to get through it quickly.
I've been sipping on this for a couple of years during my workouts, and just love it. It seems to give me a little lift while it's hydrating me. For me citrus is the only flavor I ever want or need.

column9: Best Energy Drink Around With No Sugar
column10: Zipfizz is a great tasting easy to use energy drink.  The price per unit is less expensive than other bottled energy drinks.  Just mix it into a 12 or 16 oz bottle of purified water and shake.  One word of caution, you need to take a couple of swigs from your water bottle before you pour in the Zipfizz, or you will have an eruption of the flavored mix, two or three tablespoons should be adequate.  My favorite flavors are the Berry and Grape.

I've been trying zipfizz lately and I'm very surprised at how well this drink seems to be working.  Gives me steady energy without the weird crash I might get from Red Bull or Amp or something juiced with a ton of sugar.  Seems to have a lot of vitamins as well so it's actually good for you!

Grape zipfizz will not dissapoint. It is the least bitter out of their lineup and gives you a great energy boost that doesn't knock you out in 2 hours. I also like how I can fill up a bottle with it instead of having a shot like those other drinks. I like to enjoy it and sip slowly, not just shoot it down and be done with it. I also feel slowly drinking an energy drink evenly will lead to a longer buzz and energetic feeling with less comedown. A+++ for this product.
