when i ordered this it was the best price on the net for product and shipping on the individual flavor but i have since changed to ordering it from costco because this price went up or they stopped carrying it at least expensive merchant. its a great product i love it i just dont like every flavor so i dont want to order multi paks of it.

I have ordered many boxes of the citrus zipp fizz. This is one of the few places I can get the citrus only (I don't like the combo packs) at a reasonable price. I have never had a problem and I find that I enjoy the zipp fizz in the morning just as much as a cup of coffee.

Ultimately, I think personal preference is going to play the main role in whether or not you will like Zipfizz over any other energy drink.  That said, here is what I have experiencedEnergy BoostFor me it gives a nice boost of energy, equivalent to a full cup of coffee.  It seems to last around 5 hours for me without a crash at the end.  I think this is where individuals will have the most variance, as caffeine reacts differently in different people depending on the product.  For example, I don't like what a Diet Coke does to me but I like this.FlavorThe flavor is great because it is not overpowering and not to subtle either.  Since it is a mix, you can add more or less water to get the flavor you desire.  I have tried grape, orange, and lemonade.  Grape is my favorite, although an interesting twist on orange is to add a bit of vanilla creamer - it makes for a tasty Creamsicle flavored treatZipfizz vs 5-hour energy5-hour energy also has the desired energy boost for me, however, it tends to leave me with cotton mouth.  Zipfizz does not do that since it is mixed with water.  I prefer the added hydration.Lastly, often times I only use half of a canister with 16 oz of water.  This helps maximize the value of the product and for me only half of the canister is plenty of an energy boost.

This product works but the advertising is misleading. Zipp Fizz claims that it's a natural product and on its website says that it is sweetened with xylitol.  Xylitol is a natural sugar made from the birch tree, and used in Europe for over 100 years.  I use xylitol on a regular basis and agree that if it comes from the right source and not from China, where it's made from corn, it is healthy and has very good side effects such as cavity prevention.  But,on the ingredients list, xylitol is the last ingredient, meaning, that it is the smallest ingredient in the formula.  On the other hand Sucralose (also known as Splenda) is very high on the list of ingredients.  That's where the aftertaste is from.  If you don't care what you put in your body then this is a good product as it does work as advertised.  Why add Splenda if the xylitol is in there? Because the splenda is cheaper. So obviously there is no need for the xylitol other than to use it as a marketing ploy.  They know this and have told me that their new product - immune fizz - has no Splenda.  Why not take it out of the regular zipp fizz too and make it healthier too?  I was sucked into the purchase by the xylitol reference only to find the sucralose in the product.  I wonder what else they aren't saying?

I don't feel like I represent the general masses, but the grape is definitely NOT the best flavor out there.  In fact, I'd say it's maybe 3rd best.  The taste was just mundane to me.  I like the fact that the other flavors have a little bit of sweet/tart flavor to them so I don't feel like I'm drinking sugar-free Kool-Aid or Crystal Lite.  I would suggest that first time drinkers go with the Pink Lemonade, Berry, or Orange Soda.

I was afraid at firt to try this- I really hate the artificial grape taste of most grape juices and products. This, however, was light- not too sweet. It was a perfect offset to the already existing flavors of Zipfizz- orange, lemon, pink lemonade. (All of which are very tart!)As for energy, this product delivers! I first tried Zipfizz under skepticism, but I was completely and pleasantly surprised that after a thirteen hour work day, I went to the gym right after work that night, and had a nice little burst of energy that lasted as long as I needed it to. There are also no rapid heartbeats, palpitations of the heart or crashes, as the product is made with all natural ingredients. That in itself is a sheer bonus, on top of the fact that there is no sugar or artificial sources of taurine and caffiene.If you despise the taste and the artificial contents of stuff like Red Bull and Rock Star and want an actual energy drink that works as promised, then try Zipfizz, you'll be glad you did.Did I mention it's also packed with vitamins? Those other "energy drinks" can't say that!>>>>>>>

I normally purchase these from a bulk retailer but I find with some of these vitamin-type specialty items, Amazon.com has the best price.  I'm a Prime member so shipping is quick and cost effective.  I like orange and lemonade the best, but grape is pretty good as well.
Berry is one of the best flavours I have tried.  Just wish it wasn't more expensive then some of the other ones.  I enjoy zip fizz everyday.

i have been clean and sober almost 23 yrs. and never got into energy drinks but the local wal mart was giving free samples, small cups so i took one, i felt kind of tired but after drinking just a small cup, felt 'great' body and mind so, i bought a 3 pack. 4.88, they only have grape and i've never liked grape, anything but it was o.k. but kind of expensive for 3 drinks but i figured if that tiny cup made me feel, 'that' good, each tube would last me a while.  i gave 4 stars because in my experience, when it gets too 'hot', the tube,  on two occasions, i put one in my pocket, pulled it out later to pour into a cold bottle of water and even though i poured some of the water out of the bottle, it FIZZED UP AND OUT and made a mess, i think the GOOD STUFF gets lost when this happens, has only happened when it was hot and i did not feel ANYthing after, NO ZIPP, like it all came out.  i am going to try just drinking the amount i drank in the 'sample cup' maybe drinking the whole tube, is too much for me becasue i noticed i get almost wired and that's something i don't want to be, any more, just feel 'good'

column9: best alternative for caffiene obsessed people!
column10: I discovered zipfizz about a year ago working for a local gym. I LOVE IT! I have to wake up VERY early for work and zipfizz gives me that little boost i need. Not to mention the taste---it is amazing :). Pink Lemonade is my personal favorite, but they are all excellent! I stopped drinking energy drinks because of how bad they are for you and I actually began getting sick (headaches, nauseas) everytime I had one. I started drinking zipfizz and feel better than ever. It is also a good alternative to "pre-work out" supplements. Sometimes those supplements give you too much of a high that makes it hard to come down from. I now use zipfizz before working out too :)!
Although it doesn't quite give me the boost of a Monster or Red Bull, its does have a kick to it and tastes great.

I like that Zipfizz isn't full of a bunch of crap.  It gets me out of my morning funk, and makes me start drinking water early.  I mix one tube with 32 oz of water, and have it in place of a morning cup of coffee.  It's not going to give you a ton of energy or get you wired.  It just moves you from tired to awake.  I like that zip fizz is 1/3 the cost of 5 hour energy.  Stay away from the Orange.  It tastes awful.  Grape and Pink Lemonade taste great.
A great tasty product that adds a level of benefits of exercise by replacing energy and electrolites with no sugar or caffein.

I am not a huge fan of flavored waters or other water enhancers. To me they never have enough flavor. Zipfizz is totally different! It has great flavor and I for get I am just drinking water. Citrus is my favorite right now. I also love orange, grape, and pink lemonade. Great flavor and it is full of vitamins! So much better for you than soda and tastes great too! Love, love, love Zipfizz!
Berry and orange are the best flavors. Great to drink while working out or after a heated yoga class. Flavors the best if you use 16oz water bottles.
I really like this product - have been drinking grape, pink lemonade, and orange for some time and added this to the mix.  Perfect for p90x!

column9: Just as good as my morning coffee.
column10: We got a sample of this stuff at Sam's club and decided to buy a box.=PROS=-Gives me as much of a pick-me-up as my morning coffee. Great for the mid-afternoon slump that a lot of people get.-It tastes great (while it's cold).-Gives you a big dose of B-12.=CONS=-Mix it with cold water and drink it all at once while it's still cold (or drink half and stick the rest in the fridge). The warmer it gets, the more it will taste like the smell inside a bottle of vitamins, which is very disgusting.-It's a bit expensive for what it's intended for and a case of 20 doesn't last long.-If you dump the tube all at once into a bottle of water, it will fizz out all over the place unless you put the cap back on extremely fast. Even if you drink several gulps of water out of the bottle first, it still happens.

column9: love this stuff and delivered FAST
column10: I love this stuff, for around $1.40/day I get a more natural rush of energy than say a Red Bull (sugar free used to be my choice). berry is my favorite flavor and glad I can find it online and get it shipped so quickly.  thanks!

column9: Grape is my favorite Zipfizz flavor!
column10: As I am sitting here at work, using company resources and time to write this, I felt compelled to see if there was a multi-pack of zipfizz in the grape flavor only. I've only been able to find zipfizz in the multi-flavor pack with pink lemonade (my least favorite), orange soda (pretty good), and grape (my fave!). I don't drink coffee, and I'm exploring ways to wean myself from the diet soda teat. I love how drinking zipfizz makes me feel like I'm taking my multivitamin. I add to mix by brewing a strong cup of matcha green tea and adding it to the bottle with the zipfizz. Tastes great! It also keeps me from falling asleep at my computer by 2:30pm. :)Bottom line, if I had to choose one energy drink, I would choose zipfizz. If I had to choose one flavor, it would most definitely be grape. Love it!
I was very impressed that I didn't feel a crash after starting my day with Zipfizz.  It sustained my energy level and alertness.
I like zipfizz because it works.  I have recommended it to friends and it works for them too.  Zipfizz also tastes good.

column9: Pleasant tasting with a nice energy buzz.
column10: As someone who doesn't get nearly enough sleep, I am always looking for an effective and tasty caffeine boost. Problem is, I don't like the taste of coffee, and soda has high calories-to-caffeine ratio. Energy drinks typically have a chemical taste that doesn't sit well with me. The Zipfizz Grape Energy Drink Mix provides an excellent boost of energy, yet tastes pretty good. I get as much energy from one tube than I would from a cup of coffee or Red Bull. If you've had a five-hour energy shot you'll understand the type of boost you get from a Zipfizz. It has no calories from sugar, and is low carb, plus since you are mixing it with water you stay pretty hydrated. One caveat: do not drink one of these in the evening unless you plan on staying up really late; I drank one at about 6pm and was up past 3am. Thankfully, I didn't feel jittery or irritable, just WIDE awake. Also, other reviews have mentioned that this keeps you regular, and yes it does indeed.
Kool Aid type taste. Wakes you up but no shakey/jitters. It goes right through me though, and keeps me "regular."
I like to keep these handy at work for afternoons when I don't really want to drink coffee.  Mixed with cold water, its refreshing and a great pick me up.  I have only tried the grape flavor.
ZipFizz is what I expected.  Energy drink, not too strong, but noticeable energy boost.
I love this stuff! Perfect for  your home and especially travel on airplanes and to use in over priced food courts at airports, and it's delicious, too!

column9: does what it says, decent taste
column10: I drink zip fizz mostly while biking.  With all these products the question of taste is critical and personal.  The product has a decent artificial grape taste- similar to grape soda.  IMPORTANT FACT:  It is much better when ice cold.  Be sure to mix it with ice or freezing cold water- all zip fizz products taste better cold than at room temperature.

Tastes similar to grape koolaid! AND, it makes a great drink mixer (preferrably with Vodka)...with all the b-12 and no sugar, it decreases the potential for a hangover.  I always have this on hand for workouts and weekends!
Love this product in the morning.  It gives me great energy for the day. Grape is the best flavor, but I also like Berry.  Only problem is that it still contains small dose of sucralose.
ZipFizz is a nice energy drink at an affordable price.  The grape flavor is also satisfying to the taste buds, which is not always the case with these types of drinks...
Zipp Fizz was a great idea from its conception.  Brain food plus minerals and a lil kick added for a great citrus drink.  GOT WATER YOU GOT AN ENERGY DRINK.

love this flavor. my other favorite is mixed berry.flavor is not too strong, just enoughfor new users: great way to boost b vitamin intake, does not give you an energy buzz of any kind that ive noticed but ive always taken supplements and eaten healthy, so thats probably why. for me its an easy better absorbing, non stomach upsetting way to get vitamins. pills go right through you and often give you indigestion

I love this product. Zipfizz gives me what I need to make it through the day at work. The flavors are all great. My favorite is the pink lemonaid. I usually drink it down pretty fast. My body and mind feel instantly better, almost more alive. Then later on there is no crash. I never notice when exactly it wears off. I never feel the jitters or have a racing heart. This product works wonderful. I do not ever want to be without it. Yippy Zippy  8>)

I have two small children and Zip Fizz gets me up in the morning.  I first bought Zip Fizz at Costco, but wasn't a fan of one of the flavors that came in the variety pack.  Berry wasn't available at Costco so on to Amazon I went.  The berry flavor is my second favorite flavor after orange.  My shipment arrived quickly which was a big bonus for this tired Mommy.  Buy it, you won't be sorry!

I first started using Zipfizz about 2-3 years ago and enjoyed during that time period HOWEVER, I don't know if they changed something in the formula or what but now I cannot drink it without side effects. It use to give me the extra kick and energy I needed... through the morning... another through the afternoon. RECENTLY though when I drink just a small amount I get 'VERTIGO' which will last for a few days, actually causing me to miss 2 days of work. I fell ok when I am sitting or lying down, but when I stand I am dizzy and it lasts for days. Also, the muscles in the back and on the side of my neck ache, directly behind and below the back of my ears. This is still an after effect that has lasted since I first experienced this. After initially having the dizziness effect, a month later I wanted to put my theory to the test so I bought another box from my local Costco and took just a few drinks and AGAIN the same effects occurred causing me miss work. NOW I HAVE NEW INFORMATION - My 24 yr old son ( who occasionally would use Zipfizz ) has reported the same effect with his latest use of the product. This leads me to believe they have changed something... or there was ONE HUGE BAD BATCH of the stuff made somewhere. Draw your own conclusions, just my experience. Thanks, Don

Well, I like it.  Everyone is different.  I'm an energy freak and have tried MANY, so when I say I like it, it means the energy it gives is good enough no jitters and the taste is so much better than others i've tried.  My boyfriend tried it and the first thing he did was spit it right back out..lol...like I said everyone is different.
Great taste, great alternative to soda and energy drinks. Priced locally is substantially less, go figure. A little caffeine, not really for kids.

column9: High energy, taste is just okay
column10: Zipfizz works for me! I am a busy working mom of two, and some days are definitely properly labeled as "zip fizz days." This product works; I learned the hard way never to take it after 5pm. I couldn't get to sleep until 2am despite how tired I was. The citrus taste reminds of grapefruit juice, of which I am not a fan. It tastes pretty good when added to cranberry fruit juice (instead of water). For my next purchase I will choose a different flavor.

I love this product but I would not buy it online because you can get it much cheaper at Sams Club. It works great without the crash like you would after an energy drink wears off.  I love the Orange because I am a fan of orange pop.

column9: A good energy product needing a bit of caution
column10: I tried this product at a local store and went back for 2 boxes because it is non-caffeine and non-sugar.  As a diabetic and someone who suffers from reflux, this is great.  And the $1 or so each is so much better than the $3 for those 5 hour drinks.A bit of common sense caution however; do NOT drink one close to the end of a work day no matter how much you need a pick me up.  I did that once, just once (never again) and I had difficulty sleeping.Second, if you are going to dump it into a bottle of water, drink about a quarter of the water (or pour it out) before adding.  The thing fizzes and can get quite messy.Third, do not take if you've an upset stomach or feeling nauseous as it can make one gassy.Otherwise, as I said, money wise, health wise, this $1 a pop, no sugar, no caffeine is great!

column9: Grape flavor is horrible; no energy boost at all
column10: I've been drinking 2 energy drinks every morning. (2 for $5 at local convenience store.) I wanted to try something that would be a little cheaper so I bought a case of Grape Flavored ZipFizz.I chose grape because I drink bottled water flavor packets all the time and love the taste. However, the grape flavor of ZipFizz is just awful - its got to be the worst tasting thing I've ever drank. I can get used to the flavor after a while, I'm sure.I'm drinking my second bottle of this stuff today. (84,000% recommended daily amount of B12 anyone?) I don't feel any energy effects what so ever. No jitters, no boost of energy, nothing. Maybe they should scale back on the B12 and focus a little more on energy and taste?Maybe it's just me, but this stuff hasn't worked for me. I doubt I'll finish the entire case, I'm having problems just finishing this second bottle. It's a shame too since I really enjoy energy drinks overall. Having a powered form that I can toss into my bottle waters would have been very convenient for me.I'm giving it 2 stars because I'm generous.

There was this one energy drink I had been buying from Wal-mart.  It was the only place I could find it.  Then one day, it was pulled from the shelf in every single Wal-mart within an hours drive.  And that's a lot of Wal-marts!  This energry drink was quite possibly the best I had ever and will ever taste.  I could get a 10-pack for $1.50.  That price just couldn't be beat and it tasted great too.  The only place you can get it now is from a somewhat shady looking website that sells 10-packs for like $15.  So there I was energy drink-less.  I started looking online for alternatives and I came across Zipfizz.  I figured I'd check some local stores for small packs to sample and give it a try.I purchased this product as somewhat of a "blind buy."  I had tried the orange, citrus, and pink lemonade by purchasing small three packs at some of the local stores.  However, I wanted to try the grape and the berry.  The only way I was going to be able to do that was to buy them online.  So I went for the berry.  About the best I can say is it's not horrible.  Just like the others I had tried, it had a very strong B-vitamin taste to it.  It was very overpowering in this flavor.  Having tried those other flavors, I would have to say this is probably my least favorite.  As for the rest, the orange is definitely top notch.  There's hardly any B-vitamin taste to it as it is masked by the orange flavor.  The orange sort of reminds me more of orange popsicles or an orange flavored drink than it does of an actual orange.  But it's still pretty good.  The same can be said for citrus, it covers the B-vitamin flavor well.  It has a similar taste to the orange, but it tasted like there was some lemon and lime mixed in there.  It was pretty good.  The pink lemonade is pretty good, if you can get past the fact that it's a fizzy drink.  And that's exactly what it tasted like, a fizzy pink lemonade.  It just had a minor B-vitamin after taste to it.  I haven't yet tried the grape, but would still like to.  After my experience with the berry though, I'm not hopeful.  Orange is good enough for me for now and I've actually found it cheaper locally in the big 20-pack.
I would like to see the single flavor Zipfizz available in more than 20 per package.  Although, the item did arrive in in a very timely manner.

I wasnt real impressed with the taste of this mix in. It starts out fizzy but that goes away pretty fast. It starts to taste like vitamins more and more. I dont really feel any more energy either. I really dont think it does all it says it does for you. Most likely wont buy again.
i looked forever for a good, healthy energy drink- thought this would be it but i thought the flavor was yucky and i felt jittery and then just tired.  i love peppod and will be going back to that.

I ordered two different flavors of ZippFizz.  The company accepted payment for both but only included one in the box.  I sent an email and called inquiring the status of the other flavor and never heard a word from them.  My suggestion would be to find another resource to purchase products - pass this one bye.
The product was wet in the tube as if the tube was not seiled correctly.

I had this at a Christmas party and the host said they serve it every year because people love it so much. I just made it and my guests loved it.  Must serve it with a high-quality french or sourdough bread for dipping in the sauce. Don't serve with a wimpy bread that will disintegrate when you dip it.Pros:Louisiana spicy (a "pro" if you like spicy). It's definitely spicy but not off the charts.Ridiculously easy to prepare with this mix.Incredibly delicious - people raved about it.Cons:Messy - not good "date food."High calorie if you serve with the recommended bread. If you don't serve with the bread it's probably not that bad because most of the butter remains in the pan.A little challenging to keep it warm without overcooking the shrimp.

I've been a vegan for almost a year now and I use nutritonal yeast a lot. I use it to make vegan queso for my nachos, mac & cheese, sprinkled on my popcorn and I like to make a vegan version of parmesan using cashews and nutritonal yeast. I use it in a ton of recipes. MANY people love nutritonal yeast but you will either love it or hate it. You really just need to get a few recipes and try them.

One of my biggest challenge when going vegan was leaving Parmesan cheese behind.  As I read more and more books I realized that many recipes called for the very versatile Nutritional Yeast.  Happyherbivore.com had a good blog post about it and my first use after receiving this product was to top pasta with it.  Delicious and I have been using it so often- in so many different recipes - that I am going to have to order another bag.

I am a young adult just starting to try to convert to Veganism and read many good reviews of this particular brand of nutritional yeast claiming it was the tastiest of the bunch.  It is included in many Vegan recipes as a substitute taste-wise for cheese - and after tasting it myself I can't imagine the people who created the recipes have ever tasted any kind of cheese - even bad cheese - because this tastes like sawdust and stale mini wheats.  I can only imagine it being useful as a possible thickening agent for sauces and the like.  I'm sure the company is totally respectable and the product is probably a fine choice, but nutritional yeast was not, I found, all it was touted to be.

We have used yeast flakes for about a year now and my kids enjoy the taste, great on top of burritos or on broccoli . DO NOT BUY THIS THINKING THEY CAN REPLACE CHEESE. I can't even imagine how nasty it would be to try to make this into a mac and cheese mixture or something. It is what it is, don't try to make it into something it's not.
Compare to Teavana white earl grey it is ZERO vs 10. Very disappointed. Also, i didn't know i cannot return it. Now I'm stuck with lots of expensive tea that has no flavor...
So crispy and delicious! I could eat a whole box at a time! They are perfectly baked and the cheese blend is outstanding.

We eat Mrs. Leepers a lot-tuna, stroganoff, alfredo, and lasagna.  it's really quick and easy.  My gluten eating boyfriend even loves them and keeps asking for the lasagna.  it's really good with a little garlic powder and tabasco and some parm cheese on top!!
Compare to Hamburger Helper, but better, without the gluten.  This company makes several other varieties; tuna, chicken, stroganoff.  All are good, quick, & easy.

My family liked this.  The only other Mrs. Leeper's boxed meal we tried was the Cheeseburger Mac and that was like eating a box of salt.  We were pleasantly surprised that the Beef Lasagna meal was quite tasty and not overly salty.  The corn pasta was good (we usually have brown rice pasta) and the tomato sauce had a nice flavor.  I would serve this again on a night we need a quick dinner.

I have been gluten free for over 2 years. I have had the attitude, "If I can't eat it I'm not cooking it", since that time. This is the first time I have tried a gluten free box mix. I made the lasagna (with turkey) and added a bit of mozzarella and parm cheese on top and it is gone!! I can't remember what hamburger helper tasted like, but this was good! I was shocked at how much the family liked it... time to try the rest!!

Mrs. Leepers dinners are a favorite at our house.  My two boys (who have celiac disease) just gobble it up.  It's great with both hamburger or ground turkey.  You really don't have to add anything since the flavor is so good, but sometimes I saute and add diced garlic and onion.  We never have leftovers when Mrs. Leepers is for dinner!

This is a tasty G.F. product. I've been on a G.F. diet for 7 years so have tried a lot of different products and this is one I reorder. My only negative would be that it doesn't reheat well, but that's true of most G.F. pastas. Not a problem if more than one person is eating it. Nice to have some thing quick and easy to make that is still a hot meal and G.F.
easy to make box mix...tastes ok, keeps good in refrigerator after cooking. takes a little longer to cook than box states, but we live in high-altitude.
The noodles were ok but the sauce really had a nasty flavor, kids refused to eat it.  If you are stuck with a bunch of it, cook the noodles but make your own sauce.

Being a woman going through menopause, it's a hard road to travel. Everyone is different, so do and some don't have symptons. For me, the emotional roller coaster is the worst. I had been put on 1 mg. of a hormone supplement,but that just didn't do much. I put myself on lots of vitamins and they did help some. It was not until I discovered I could not drink regular milk (carraganan problem), that I tried soy milk. Well, "Silk" also has the ingredient that I can not tolerate...so..I went to the health food store and found this wonder soy milk!! No only is does it taste wonderful (who doesn't like chocolate), but it help alot with my menopause. I did some research and found out Soy is great to help treat the symptons...of course my doc. did not tell me this!! Anyway, I am not a tri-monthly customer of Amazon and I get a 12 carton case every three months..I am so glad Amazon has it..I also save 2.00 per carton and get FREE SHIPPING!!Now that a great deal!!

I love this product...have been using it for years. It is impossible to find in stores anymore, so I was thrilled to find it online at amazon.com. I have a standing order for it. BUT--only about half of the orders come through intact. Sometimes they arrive to us leaking through the box...sometimes UPS returns it on our behalf before it even gets to us. I have notified amazon about this problem, but I just found out today that UPS returned the latest shipment. This is ridiculous.

My youngest child is lactose intollerant and loves chocolate.  I often buy this brand of soy or rice milk in chocolate because they will not drink the regular or vanilla.This has been a real lifesaver for our family!

My daughter has milk allergies and she loves this stuff...just wish we could get it in the 8 oz size so that we can take them on the go.  (Also, from our experience, the 8 oz sizes of the plain Soy Dream and Rice Dream arrive intact compared to the larger cartons, so 8 oz cartons offered in this would hopefully help with that issue)

I started ordering both chocolate and vanilla soy dream in bulk every few months a couple of years ago. I am a student without a car who uses milk frequently for meals and coffee. I having to walk to the store everytime the milk ran out. Instead I keep a supply of these boxes in my closet and rotate them into my fridge as needed. I've tried other brands of soymilk, ricemilk, etc but I LOVE the flavor and texture of Soy Dream! It spices up my cereal and makes my coffee taste like mroe of a dessert. I highly recommend this product!

I was in a Stonewall store and sampled this Blueberry Cheese Ball Mix (I am not even a big fan of blueberries!). It was so good I had to buy one and when I shared it with others they enjoyed it as well. It is cheaper to buy it from Amazon as it was $4 at the store for one box. Serve with Cinnamon Sugar crackers or grahams for the perfect combination.

I breed Labradoodles and this is the dog food that I feed to my dogs and the dog food that I highly recommend to all my puppy families. I also like it because I can feed this formula to all my dogs and puppies because it is an "all life stages" dog food.Some of my poodles can also be picky eaters but they really LOVE Canidae and I never have a problem with them turning their noses up at it.Read more: [..]

column9: great food made in the usa without chinese ingredients
column10: we moved our dog to this food when all of the dog food recalls happened. I figured if I wouldn't feed my kid the candy from china why would I feed my dog food that also had ingredients from china.  Not enough restrictions on products that come out of their for people let alone animals. My dog devours this food and is very healthy.

These mixes are nice to have on hand quite easy to make I like to add a little vanilla to the basic mix to intensify the flavor  a bit. It is easy to add other ingredients  such as poppy seeds or dried fruit to make flavored pound cakes. This mix is not overly sweet and cakes come  out a bit dryer than some. All in all, it makes  a pretty decent basic cake

I am so disappointed--Betty Crocker changed the recipe. This is not the product advertised. This new recipe can no longer be made with egg whites, and now it calls for the addition of butter! In the old recipe, I had finally found something I could indulge in without the added fat and cholesterol. The egg whites made it so light I could eat cake as a snack or as a dessert without feeling overly full. This recipe is very 'heavy'. I issued a complaint on [...]and was told that it was changed due to consumer poles (?). If anyone prefers the healthier recipe as I do, please contact them and let them know that Change is NOT ALWAYS GOOD! (Amazon, update your description!)
This is the easiest cake mix to work with and for whatever reson it is unavailable in my neighborhood. I am very glad I can buy a supply and make exquisite dessert cakes in a matter of minutes.
I thought the pound cake would taste kind of dry.I was supprised when it was really moist.Now that's a pound cake.

Bought this mix because my hubby loves pound cake.  I normally would make my own but I wanted a mix to make when I do not have the time.  I did add cream cheese and extra vanilla so I don't know what it would taste like without.  But this is a quick and easy alternative to homemade. Will buy again!
I find this to lack flavor--surprising, since I like most Betty Crocker products.  It is easy to store & prepare, however...and does well when served with a highly-flavored sauce.

This was a bargain compared to what cereal costs in NYC. The cereal arrived quickly and tasted fresh. It is pretty good cereal and has a really fruity taste. It is kind of like fruity pebbles, fruit loops, etc. It turns the milk pink and is pretty sweet. If you like that, then you will love this cereal. For me, I thought it was a little too sweet.

Kellogg's Special K Cereal, Fruit & Yogurt, 12.8-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 4)  This is a cereal that my granddaughter loves, the fruit and yogurt make it so that she is not reminded that it is also good for her.

Arrived Fresh, well packaged and as described.Tasty, healthy and well worth the price.Will order again. Lots of yogurt piecesincluded with the flakes. Special K is theway to go if you want all the taste and not thecalories, fat.

I love this cereal but when I bought it from amazon it came with bugs. I don't know if I was just the one in a millionth person that gets a box of cereal with bugs or if its where it was stored before shipment, but it was gross.

I have heard Fry's Chocolate Creams discussed on many, many occasions whenever my Brit husband and other Brit friends remininsced about the "sweeties" they enjoyed as children.Whenever we went to the UK the time was so jampacked I found all of his and his friends other treats but not the Fry's.  Don't feel too bad for them, returning from our last trip we had a suitcase packed full of nothing but British treats!Amazingly, I was checking the British Shoppe (our favorite) fare last wkend and immediately ordered these for my husband's birthday this Tuesday, not knowing if they would arrive in time.  They were in Saturday's post!  I will divide them for birthday and save some for his Christmas Stocking.He will be over the moon!!UPDATED:  11/02/10 He loved the Fry's candy so much it had some with his breakfast coffee.  After seeing the small package of candy, I relented and gave it all to him for his B-Day.  He is one Happy Birthday boy!

I first tried this chocolate bar on my trip to Ireland.  I loved it and had to find it once I got home.Its wonderful that I can relish in the tastes of Ireland all over again when I have one of these great bars.If you like chocolate with that nougat taste, then you will love this bar.

column9: The best nacho cheese chips I've ever tasted.
column10: I saw these nacho cheese chips 2 months ago at a local salvage grocery store and decided to buy a bag just to see if I'd like them. I was so pleased and satisfied with the taste that I needed more of these chips. I bought a grocery bag full of them and they were gone within 2 weeks of my purchasing them. I just couldn't get enough of these tasty chips. What I like about this brand of tortilla chips is that the oil penetrates the whole chip and it makes it crispy, yet moist at the same time. Also, the nacho cheese flavoring is delicious, mild, but very flavorful, not at all overpowering. I also liked the shape of these chips because they weren't the regular shape of a triangle like so many other brands. This brand is a keeper and if the price ever goes down a bit, then I'm going to purchase this product in bulk.

column9: Not made in the U.S. anymore!
column10: A previous reviewer mentioned that they could not get these in Chicago anymore because of the plant closing.  Well, if you read the back of the Easter bags, they're all made in Mexico!  The United States is the largest producer of food in the world yet we can't afford a little thing like sugar to make our own candy? I bought a bag before I realized what had happened and didn't know until I had actually finished them.  Wondered the whole time why they tasted differently than in previous years.  Well, there you have it. We're buying our own name brands made outside of America.  Hope they bring this back - they're not the same and Chicago needs the jobs!

Everything the recipient expected.  Cannot purchase this item in stores anymore.  Brach's factory in Chicago closed long time ago.  This was a gift for someone for Valentine's Day and they were ecstatic.  I was very please.
This shipment arrived in record time.  I was so happy to receive it in plenty of time to use for Easter.
The jelly beans are great!  Anything made by Brach's is wonderful.  The flavors pop out at you.  This may sound strange, but if you are a cat lover, they love to play with them.  Great toys!
I use this on a regular basis, for example, thickening and flavoring stews, adding oomph to sauteed chicken breast, thickening vegetable soup.

these candies are great not to sweat. I purchased these for my wife who is terminally ill, they are geat for dry mouth caused by the medication and chemo. I have also tried them to help with hunger pain. This candy is hard to find in stores but was easy to locate on Amazon.
I love the assortment of colors and scents - they burn cleanly and for a long time.  I am a huge fan of tea-lights and have several holders for them.

column9: What a blessing this cat food is!
column10: The Pro Plan Hairball Management Formula has literally been a life saver for my cat. She's a four year old Ragdoll, and has always had problems with regurgitating her food, regurgitating hairballs, and loose stools. Recently she had a particularly bad bout with hairballs, and I changed her diet to this Pro Plan formulation. It only took her a day or two to completely accept it in lieu of her previous (competitor's product) food. It is higher in fiber, so she does eat more of it.The result has been a complete turn around. No more hairballs on the carpet. No more regurgitated food. No more loose stools, and no more cleaning it from her long haired butt!She had been to the Vet in the past with her 'issues', and the last time I didn't think she was going to make it. She's just fine now. I've got my happy, playful cat back!

I usually buy my cats all natural organic foods, such as Blue Buffalo, Halo or Wellness. Well, all of those are VERY expensive and PetSmart doesn't carry Halo brand. I'm really big on only giving my pets foods that have decent ingredients. Wellness, Halo and Blue Buffalo all have all ingredients that I would eat, and ideally this is all I would ever feed my pets. Sadly, times are tough and this product is much more fairly priced. Though the ingredients aren't all great, the first ingredient is a true meat and not just by-products or corn meal. So, hesitantly I bought this instead. I also had a coupon, which is almost always available on their website- for $3 off. ALL five cats LOVED it. It must be a VERY palatable food. They went from eating one bowl every three days each to one whole bowl a day each. They don't seem to be getting getting fatter from it, and I haven't seen one hairball since. I think this is a decent food if your low on cash, but not great for all the time. I kind of view it as a junk food or snack for my kitties. I would recommend one of the other 3 brands mentioned before this one, but it is still MUCH better than some other brands out there. For instance, Friskies, MeowMix or even some other Purina products out there are just plain garbage ingredients.

column9: Unheathy junk food, no help with hairballs
column10: We have seven cats, one with terrible hairball problems.  The first thing we noticed is that the cats ate easily twice as much of this food as they did of the grain free we usually feed. Like human junk food this food seemed to create appetite instead of satisfying it. This food is as expensive as the grain free.  The cat with hairballs showed no improvement after two weeks of feeding this product. We have gone back to the grain free food we were feeding.

column9: G E V A L I A........I N S T A N T.......C O F F E E ??????
column10: I put up a search for "INSTANT COFFEE" in the Amazon search engine....and this GEVALIA KAFFE BREAKFEST BLEND COFFEE - DECAFFEINATED (CASE OF 100) turned up.  I have been asking GEVALIA to p l e a s e have instant coffee....so far it seeme to me thay haven't had it.  Or have they?  It doesn't SAY "Instant Coffee" on this description....but it DID turn up in my "instant coffee" search.  Expensive?  VERY!But if it's Gevalia Instant, it could very well be worth it!  If this IS INSTANT coffee, Gevalia, my thanks -- only please say so on the label!  (And follow other instant coffees, of your other blends, with it!)  Thanks!  : )P.S.: On furher examination I notice this is 100% Arabica coffee....THE best coffee there is!  However, the "4 cup filter pack" does seem to suggest it is NOT instant coffee. (Then why did it turn up in my "instant coffee" search on Amazon?)PLEASE identify this fine coffee as "ground" or "instant"!  Thanks again! : )

For quite some time, I have been using different types of hot sauce on different types of food.  Before I started doing this, I only ever remember using hot sauce on barbeque sandwiches.  Even though I have tried numerous types of hot sauce during this period, Paula Deen Collection Hot Sauce has set itself apart from the others and has become a favorite.  I made up my mind about this product only after using it once on a particular item of food.  The overall flavor of this hot sauce is pleasing--I like its saltiness and tanginess, for example.  Also, it is neither too hot nor too mild.  Paula Deen Collection Hot Sauce is a product that I can recommend.
I use this hot sauce in everything - It's delicious and the lowest in sodium of all other brands.Go through about a bottle a week - great in bakedbeans and cole slaw!!

column9: Buyer Beware: Only Received ONE 7 oz. Box..
column10: Just wanted to advise those of you who are contemplating a purchase to know that I just received my order today. However, it was only ONE (slightly dented) 7 oz. box of "HimalaSalt", instead of SIX. I just wrote the company ("Presents of Mind"), and will edit my review when I receive a reply.If you wish to check their website, go to: [...] The business card they included in the package gives the name of their general manager, address, and phone- as well.____________"HimalaSalt" Review: I have tried this particular salt in the past, only in a shaker, finely ground. If you're looking for a healthy salt, I recommend this! So for the salt brand itself, I give it a 5 star rating!____________**EMAIL RESPONSE**:My email:"To whom it may concern,I just received my order from your company. However, it wasn't in full.Your item description/page said: "7 Oz. refill box (6x7 OZ); shippingweight of "3.1 lbs. of "Himalayan Salt" (HimalaSalt), but I only receivedone box. I should still be owed 5 more boxes. I would not have orderedyour product, had it only been the one item. Please let me know what isto be done.Thank you in advance!"Presents of Mind RESPONSE:"It seems that there is an error on the product listing as these only come in singles.We can handle this one of two ways. Either we can credit you for the difference in the missing pieces you anticipated and any additional shipping you may have incurred and you can keep the one box OR we can give you a return shipping credit and you can send it back for a full refund. Please let me know what you would prefer and we apologize for the inconvenience.RegardsChrisPresents of MindSent from my Verizon Wireless BlackBerry"_____________________My afterthoughts:So, if this is an "error" on the product listing, then the supposed original price of "$58.50 a savings of "$48.51 (83%)" *don't forget the "$6.04 in shipping*-- must be too! If I wanted to spend that much for a 7 ounce box of salt, it better come in a gold plated box!Also, the fact that this company will take a consumable item back concerns me. How do I know that I'm not eating something some other customer returned?? ..Amazon itself, doesn't even want deodorant sent back-- much less an item that you actually eat!!
We had this coffee in London. It is absolutely divine. No regrets that it is instant. Tastes just like freshly brewed with no bitterness or acidity.
My husband prefers instant coffee. I've purchased this once, and it is clearly a winner. In fact, can't go back to overburned kinds that dominate marketplace.
During our time overseas my wife enjoyed drinking Moccona Coffee, this stuff is exactly the same at a much lower price

I'm not that big of a coffee drinker simply because I do not care for the overly strong or bitter coffee's that seem to dominate the market.I ordered this (my first experience with instant coffee) because I found I like Douwe Egberts after having it at a restaurant.This coffee is simply awesome! No bitterness and very smooth. I am now drinking this at work instead of soda's I used to have.I'm very happy I have found a coffee thats this good. You will not be disappointed if you try this.
This is really good. The coffee tastes awesome!It comes in a glass jar that you close it tightly so the coffee stays fresh longer.
This is the best instant coffee I have ever found.  Good Seller, large jar,will buy again, certainly, as I have never found one this good.Thanks

column9: Great way to start the morning
column10: This coffee is very smooth without any bitterness. Perhaps it is not for everyone but it is a change of pace from the heavy roast coffees currently in favor. I usually drink three cups in the morning at work and this seems to be easy on the stomach as well as the nerves. I usually like Jacobs Meister Röstung fresh coffee at home but at work we use a dark roasted coffee which is too strong for my taste. I keep a jar of Douwe Egberts in my desk. Jacobs Coronet instant is similar but a little stronger.Douwe Egberts Pure G.old Instant Coffee, 7-Ounce Jar

I've been reluctant to leave a review for this stuff, even though I've been buying it though Amazon for over a year. I was if it became too popular, I wouldn't be able to buy it anymore! Seeing all the reviews it now has, I'm hopeful it will permanently be available here in the US.I drank this same instant coffee when I lived in Australia. It's branded as "Moccona" there, but it's the same stuff. This particular variety is called "Moccona Classic", and is the best one in my opinion. I loved it so much that I brought a couple of jars back with me.It's better than Nescafe freeze-fried, although that's also good and I like to change them up occasionally. Freeze dried instant is always superior to granulated instant.Like I said, I hope it sticks around. I think all the instant coffees in Douwe Egberts' line could be very successful in America.

This is easily the best instant coffee I've ever bought and I wish I could give it 10 stars.  I like a strong tasting coffee but that usually just gives me a bitter brew that needs cream to make it drinkable.  This coffee though, tastes thoroughly and strongly like coffee but with no bitterness or overpoweringness.  I've tried various methods of brewing and brands of coffee in the past, and due to current living situation have been using instant coffee.  But since I found this brand, I don't see any reason to ever stop using instant even when I move into my own home.The closest I've found to a con is that it was so wonderful when I first tried it, I kept making more and ended up drinking way way too much coffee.  I was just so happy to be drinking flavorful coffee that didn't make my stomach hurt.  So I got a little wired when it first got here, but seriously - I'm in love with this stuff (and while my reviews tend to be mostly positive in nature, I've never been so over the top before lol).

column9: mediocre, there are far better instant coffees
column10: The reviews made it sound like this was exceptional, but I'm not as impressed.  I've revised this review after a couple more tries, and decided it's better than I initially thought, although still not the best I've had. This initially struck me as largely chemically and tasting obviously like instant coffee, but to it's credit it does have a more subtle coffee flavor than most instants...but overall it's not as good as I'd hoped.  I'm still looking for some instant as good as I found years ago while traveling.
If you like instant coffee, then this is the best in this price - I am a regular customer on this one.

column9: The BEST instant coffee on the market today
column10: I have use Tasters Choice for years, until I went to Europe and found this instant coffee on the store shelves.This coffee is one of or the best instant coffee I have ever had. This instant coffee is a hell of a lot better than the Starbucks instant coffee and tremndously cheaper. I actually wrote Starbuck and told them that their instant coffee was terrible, and they should look at this cofffee as their new standard of they actualy want to sell their instant coffee.This instant coffee is cheaper than tasters Choice, you get more for your money, and it actually comes in a glass jar with a lid that helps seal in the freshness for months.KJ

column9: The Coffee I've Been Searching For!
column10: Prior reviews of Douwe Egberts Pure Gold Instant Coffee were right on the mark. This is one great coffee. I don't think that I've had fresh brewed coffee any better than this. The taste is smooth, no bitterness or bite when drinking it black. I'm in love with black coffee again! If you're looking for a great instant coffee, be sure that Douwe Egberts Pure Gold Instant is on your short list!

I was addicted to a local restaurant's coffee, and learned that they served this brand.  I located it on-line, and decided to try the instant, although my sister said that there was NO WAY I would like it as much as the restaurant's brewed one.  But I do, and now my "addiction" is costing me so much less $!  Have tried other companies on-line who sell this brand, but ended up w/it cheaper @ Amazon!  Will order again!

I have really enjoyed receiving douwe egberts in the mail! It is a wonderful product, just as good as you find in the convenience stores if not better. I can adjust the strength to my personal taste and it doesn't change the flavor of the coffee.

I've been a coffee snob since the mid '80s.  I've done all but roast my own, and was preparing to try that.  However, my stomach is no longer into my deep and abiding love for really good coffee.  After I tried to stick with just tea for a couple of years, a friend from England convinced me that instant coffee is worth at least a taste.  Gasp!  I ordered some Nescafe Gold, on his recommendation, and it was actually... good.  Really good.  After happily drinking it for as long as my pocketbook would allow (those pesky import costs), I found this Douwe Egberts Pure Gold, here on Amazon.  I'm not sure I'll go back!  It's lovely!  I drink it hot, and also cold in the summer time.  I pour about a 1/4 cup of cold water into the grounds and let them sit for a few minutes, give it a quick stir (it even foams a little), and then I add milk to fill the glass, and a little evaporated cane juice.  Although I still enjoy a good latte, made RIGHT... for daily drinking, I don't think I'll go back to home ground and brewed coffee.  Just don't tell anyone. ;)

This stuff isn't bad, but I prefer Nescafe instant coffee. The only reason I went with this one, was because I needed a smaller size that Nescafe didn't provide. But Douwe Egberts is certainly better than your standard Folgers or Maxwell House.

column9: Great coffee, hard to find in USA
column10: My family is accustomed to mildly roasted coffee, and we like Moccona brand of Douwe Egberts. Unfortunately, Moccona is not available in USA so I bought this product. It is great, has rich taste, without burnt coffee taste. Will definitely recommend to any of my friends.

Had this coffee for the first time in Scotland.  While I'm new to coffee drinking, I believe I can appreciate a good cup when I get one, and this brand fits well.  Even my husband, a coffee drinker from way back commented on how good it was.  Don't want the mess or noise of grinding your own beans?  Give Pure Gold a try.  Was pleased to find out I could get it from Amazon Grocery, too.

My husband first tasted this instant coffee when we traveled to England last year. He really enjoyed it so I wanted to see if I could surprise him and find more of it for him to enjoy here in the states.  Amazon to the rescue!  He enjoys the full flavor and the lack of acidity sometimes found in other instant coffees.  He would recommend this coffee to anyone who will listen to him....  Enjoy!

I've been hungering for this coffee since Burger King stopped selling it a couple of years ago -- I havn't back there since they changed to the current mud they serve.  Thankfully I found this coffee available after reading a web site about it.  For the first time in two years I can finally look forward to getting up in the morning and facing the day -- with GREAT coffee!

I bought this hoping to find a cheaper alterative to Via. The cheaper part was true but the coffee didn't have the taste to compare to Via.The best I can say is it's ok.  It taste like an instant coffee with a little more bitter finish than Via. If you don't want to pay for Via this would do but as I don't drink a lot of instant I'll stick with Via.

As a huge fan of Davidoff coffee, I decided to try this coffee based on all of the good things I have heard about it. As some people prefer Douwe Egberts Pure Gold to Davidoff, I thought that, at worst, I would wind up with an equally good cup of coffee if not a better one. Boy was I wrong! Not only is this coffee extremely weak, the taste and aroma are no better than what the Walmart brand offers for $10 less per bottle. I will never buy this coffee again. My advice to anyone looking for a good instant coffee is to try Davidoff. I've tried several instant coffees and Davidoff is, by far, the best.
Acceptable for instant coffee but not not worth the extra cost.  Their brewed coffee is so much better.  I think I've had better instant coffee.Douwe Egberts Pure Gold Instant Coffee, 7-Ounce Jar

I've been a coffee user to the point of roasting my own coffee beans for over a decade now, so I know good coffee.  I was a bit disappointed to see this product is made by Sara Lee (says so in very small print on the label).  They aren't known for top shelf quality.I purchased this to compare to 2 other instant coffees that I use until we replace our recently broken espresso machine.  One is a popular store brand Nes...., and the other is the only organic instant available.  I enjoy both of them equally after tasting side by side.  Douwe Egberts is priced in between.  I use this product either in hot water with frothed milk or in drip coffee with frothed milk when I want something stronger.  It's fine when mixed with milk, sugar, etc.  But, when drinking black against the other two, it is more acidy/tangy tasting.  You think it should be smoother since it is a lighter roast.  Also, something that puzzles me, is the other two brands sink in water, where as this brand floats on top.It is okay, but the store brand tastes better and is a better bargain, so I probably won't order this again.

Starbursts are a very tasty, chewy, fruity sweet candy.  It's hard to stop at just one and usually once I start the whole package is gone in a flash.  Starbursts are definably one of the tastiest candies on the market.

column9: Every bit as good as Whittard's Mango Black tea.
column10: I would consider myself a tea snob, I aquired this trait while living in England.As much as I have tried getting a good cup of tea here in the US, it is very hard.This however is great tea. I dont think that there is a difference between Wittards Mango Black and this tea. BUT I did not compair them side by side.

Purchasing loose tea was a new experience for me, so I wasn't sure what to expect.  I was pleasantly surprised by the taste and quality of this tea; the aroma itself is heavenly!  It is excellent for hot tea in the morning; on a hot afternoon I brew a pot and make iced tea. I would highly recommend it to tea lovers!
One can out of the six was already open and had to be thrown out. Also a couple other cans the powdered seemed discolored so we were nervous to give it to our child.

column9: Whimsical and sweet; look out for the best bargain!
column10: I am a rose junkie. Perfumes, lotions, even jams, they all catch my attention. When I saw *candied rose petals* I went through a serious struggle between my desire and my financial wisdom. These things are 'spensive. I finally caved to myself when I found two for the price of one compared to another Amazon merchant.Thank goodness I got that much, because no matter how prepared you think you are, 0.5 ounces looks mighty puny in real life!That's not to say I didn't like the candied petals. They were crunchy, sweet, rosy but not overpowerfully so, no bitter aftertaste or "earthy" flavor. Still, they were a little mild for my liking. They are also very small. Like beads.I alternated between sucking on the ones that came stuck together and chewing the individuals. I preferred chewing, but had I chewed my way through 0.5 ounces, I'd have been done in ten minutes or less!It's impossible to review these candied petals without focusing on the amount you get for the price you pay. At this rate, it would be quite, quite expensive to use these as decoration on cupcakes or cakes. You'd need at *least* 3 bags, unless you wanted one lil bead of a petal per cupcake. But if you want any sort of impact, you need a lot of these. It adds up.Eating candied roses was fun, but definitely a one-time treat.NB: shop around for the best value! "Value" being a relative term here, unfortunately. Is it that hard to candy flowers?

column9: Greatest cat food aside from raw!
column10: I was excited to try this food for my cats and get them off commercial canned food.  When it arrived and I mixed a batch up, I thought they would not eat it since it was like soup.  They surprised me!  My older cat licked the plate clean and begged for more.  My younger cat took a bit of convincing and mixing his canned food with this food for a week.  Now, he loves it!  And he was quite the finicky eater prior to this food.  Would recommend this food!

I received my first taste of Nora's product as a cake mix from a food blog giveaway. I LOVED it.  I immediately ordered more from Amazon.  I wasn't happy that I could only order packs of 6.  Yikes I thought.  But now I am sad I am down to my last box.  When I received her new brownie product also as a prize from being a fan of hers through Facebook....I was so excited because I knew they would be good.This is the ONLY convenience product I use with confidence for I can READ and KNOW each ingredient!  No hard to pronounce scientific words that I have no idea what they are.  All the same stuff in my own cabinets!

Lovely and luscious! These bake less than pretty in my Zojirushi breadmaker, but the taste is heavenly and the texture is right on. Probably would bake up nicer in a pan, but I love that I can throw everything together and come home to hot fresh chocolate divinity. :)
These are okay they are just not as chocolately as they could be to my family.  Like the ingredients they use but need to add more chocolate or brown sugar and less regular sugar

There aren't quite enough adjectives to describe these simply irresistible brownies -- and to know that they are all natural, too??  Wow!I've started to order this scrumptious mix whenever I need a gift for a mom with young children. (OK, I confess: I double the order so we have some for our family, too.)  These brownies are easy and fun to make as a mom-and-child activity, and everyone eagerly watches the oven timer to see when they can eat the yummy and nutritious snack.  One neighbor told me that her daughter compared the list of ingredients in "Naturally Nora Doubly Fudge Brownies" with the brownie mix they had on the shelf...and it was a real "Aha!" moment when the daughter said she would only eat natural ingredients she could pronounce.Fabulously fudgy brownies and a 'teaching moment' too!Thank you, Nora, for all of your great products and for taking the worry out of my gifting.

Super Yummy and super easy to make.  I can read and understand all products used to create this mix.  The best brownie mix that I have ever used.  I usually make my brownies from scratch as my homemade brownies are so much better than the store-bought ones.  Not any more...These are even better than my homemade.  Unbelieveable

column9: OK for "All Natural" but falls short of richer mixes
column10: Last night, our house was filled with the delicious scent of chocolate as my wife baked batches of Naturally Nora Doubly Fudgy Brownies to give away as Christmas gifts. The mouth-watering aroma was a pleasant accompaniment to the Christmas tree and music.Naturally, when the first batch came out of the oven, my sons (ages 9 and 7) scampered into the kitchen to `negotiate' a nibble before dinner. I waited until after dinner, and after our children had gone to bed. My wife made tea and brought a plate of brownies into the room. I noticed that she wasn't eating."Don't you like the brownies?" I asked."They are OK for organic.""They aren't organic. They are `all natural.'""They are missing something. I don't know what it is, but they're OK for `all natural' or organic."I tried a brownie and couldn't discern the reason my wife was less than enthusiastic about the brownie mix. I'm not a chocolate expert, so I defer to my wife's taste buds when it comes to rich desserts like brownies. I did later learn that the plate of brownies she set down was from the first batch. My wife said she `doctored' the subsequent batches to make them richer.Rating: Three stars.

column9: A new favorite for my family
column10: Our family is a big fan of the Naturally Nora cake mixes, and so we waited eagerly for the new brownie mixes.  Bottom line: they are a big hit with our family (which includes two kids)!  The Doubly Fudgy is moist but not heavy. It tastes like it was made from scratch. We also like the fact that this product is from a small family-run business.

Every brownie is delicious. No one can argue with that! And these were no exception. Yummy, fudgy goodness!They might have stuck to the pan the first time, but after a night's soaking, it was all better. Sadly, our last box is being baked as I do this review. *Sigh* These are easy to make with normal ingredients and, like other reviews have said, ingredients you can pronounce! They taste perfect and the whole home smells like homemade brownies. The chocolate taste is perfect: Not disgustingly sweet, but not bitter. Chewy on the inside, crunchy on the outside, yummy everywhere! Get me a glass of milk!
Had read about Nora products in a magazine and decide to try..not disappointed.  The brownies are delicious.  Will buy again.

column9: "A" for effort, but misses the mark
column10: Like another reviewer mentioned, these brownies just aren't chocolaty enough. I actually ordered the mix with the chocolate chunks (having already tried the regular) thinking the chunks might add a bit more chocolate flavor, but it just wasn't so. It's such a shame because they bake up perfectly chewy with a sugary top, but for all that great texture and presentation they lack that chocolate fudgy taste. They are bitter and have a slight chemical smell that reminds me of imitation vanilla extract. The 2 stars are for convenience and texture, but even after trying to doctor several boxes with numerous substitutions and additions, a huge portion still ended up in the trash. But not to fret, the Naturally Nora cake and cookie mixes are excellent so if you're in the mood for a home baked chocolate dessert, go with her chocolate cake mix and frosting instead.

column9: Excellent Flavor. The Right Mix of Ingredients.
column10: I shared a can of Amy's Organic Chili (Medium) with my boy (3.5 yrs old) for lunch. We had some corn bread crackers with it and a drink (him chocolate milk, me iced tea). The chili was very good, much better than I'm used to coming from a can (14.5 ounces). It cost a bit more but I think it was well worth it. The flavor was excellent. The meat was finely ground and was somewhast granular within the sauce rather than in little chunks of beef. The fat content was fairly low and there was little oil evident when the can was opened, quite unlike other available canned chili. The sodium content was alittle higher than I like, but not bad. The chili had lots of good fiber. It was ever-so slightly spicy, but not nearly as much as the hotter variety. The chili formed a good quality meal and I'll be back for more.Gary Peterson

Great Tasting Natural almond Butter, Please note that this is NATURAL almond butter and it does not contain any hydrogenated oils or other chemicals/additives (like most other major brands), so you will have to stir it or mix it when you get it home since the oil will separate and make it runny on top and very firm at the bottom. I like both almond butter flavors and the 3 peanut butter flavors i got with the same order:)I would recommend buying this product from Amazon.com and not from the wild squirrel website since Amazon.com has free shipping:)

According to Wikipedia, "Alchemy is the art of liberating parts of the Cosmos from temporal existence and achieving perfection which, for metals is gold, and for man, longevity..." Something I had to borrow to help describe what can only be realized through the mix of ingredients found in the Wild Squirrel Nut Butters. Peanuts, almonds, sunflower seeds with just the right combination of chocolate or vanilla makes these a perfect spread, snack or staple. Like most Baby Boomers, I grew up on one or more of the mainstream brands of peanut butter mixed with jam, spread on toast or scooped with a stick of celery. While one or more of these traditional peanut butters can still be found on my shelf, they are slowly but surely being replaced by Wild Squirrel nut butters. While Vanilla Espresso Almond Butter and Chocolate Sunflower Seed Almond Butter are my particular favorites, I would highly recommend sampling them all which has been made even easier with the addition of single serve pouches. If your looking to expand your peanut butter palate or just want something new to replace the majority of over-salted or sugary snacks, Wild Squirrel Nut Butters provide some highly recommended alternatives.

These Robbie Dawg snacks have been rejected to the extreme degree by every animal!I bought them originally for a cat whose who loves Temptations snacks. Not only did she not touch these, but when one of these was in her Temptations snack dish, she wouldn't even go near the bowl, as if this snack contaminated all in its vicinity.I next tried it on an outdoors cat who lives in the neighborhood. Since he lives the life of a homeless scavenger, one wouldn't expect him to be picky. Yet not even real hunger would make the bridge for him trying this.All right, how about dogs then? While this was made for cats, my experience is that many dogs will bascially eat anything you hand them (gulp it down first, and ask questions later). Outcome....My neighbor's dog answer: No way. Next two dogs, same answer. One of those dogs I've known for over a decade and this is the very first time she has ever refused anything I've offered her. We left one of these treats on the dining room floor for the evening, and it statyed there all night, until we resigned and threw it in the trash.Also tried it on a pair of rats. These two rats eat brown rice as part of their daily diet and one of them in particular has a liking for fish. Since those are two of the -alleged- ingredients in the product, I should have been hopeful for this match. But no, same answer from these two as everyone else.Last, tossed some into the backyard, just in case any of the many birds out there might be hungry enough to give it a go. Well? I bet you can guess the outcome.All that is left to check, I think, is whether even the ants outdoors give the same answer....It is a major mystery what is going on here. One thing in my mind is that whatever is stated as the ingredients on the package does not correspond to what is in the product I received. That something went badly wrong at the plant, and it would be for lab analysis to actually determine what these little brown block things are actually composed of.All I know for now is that there is a universal verdict from every animal in the jury: it is absolutely inedible.

column9: Great for storage, iffy for use with adapter for feeding
column10: These VIA containers are great for milk storage.  Easy to clean and easy to stack.  However, I have had issues with using them with the blue adapter top for feeding from it.  No matter how firm or hard I screw on the adapter, when the entire unit is assembled, sometimes the bottom cup will just unscrew and fall off.  After having one too many bottles of pumped milk fall on the floor or come apart on the counter, etc. I refuse to use these for feeding from.I do use these with the Avent ISIS for pumping and then immediate storage.  However, your better off transferring the milk to a regular hard plastic Avent bottle to do feeding from, don't use these for feedings.

I bought these to store my milk in while I pumped at work.  I liked that they hold about 6 oz, and I use Avent bottles, and thought it'd be good quality.  I was VERY disappointed because once you start using them, the lids stop working properly- they become extremely hard to close because they don't seem to screw on correctly.  And once you think it's screwed in well, you push down on the lid and it's still loose.  Many times when I get home, I find that milk has spilled out of the bottles while I was driving!!  And another problem is that when milk gets in the grooves of the lid, it makes it really hard to open.  And when you put it in the refrigerator, and milk gets cold, it's almost like it becomes glue in the grooves. So you're fighting to open the lid, just to have it spill when you finally open it because you're using so much force.  Sure, it's nice that the bottles stack, and it's easy to store the lids together, but at the end of the day, do not use this to store milk.  I'm a working mom and EVERY drop of milk I pump is priceless.  Unfortunately Avent didn't do a good job in designing this for it's primary purpose - to save and store milk.  Oh, I also went to the Avent website and saw in their Q&A section a question about the lid/leakage problem.  The answer in the website was that they didn't recommend using these more than FOUR times because the cups/lids become warped and could lead to leakage.  Really?  Four times?  I mean, did they really expect me to buy a new package each week?

column9: Good concept but the lids aren't
column10: I like the concept that you can pump right into them and feed out of them as well.  The problem is that the blue lids are a pain in the butt to get off but if you don't screw them on tight enough then they will leak. I bought two boxes of them and I am kind of disappointed because I have really ended up not liking to use them because they are two hard to get the lids off and at 2am you don't want to fight with the lids and then spilling it all over the place.
Product works great and does a great job of keeping the breast milk safe in the fridge. The screw cover seals nice and tight to prevent accidental spilling.

EBF family, so a pump is a must! These cups fit perfectly with my pump, and I love how I can keep a bunch stacked with lids in my pump case. This is a huge timesaver.Since we started feeding rice cereal, I use these cups to mix the cereal and breastmilk in, and love that I can use them in the warmer, as opposed to a bowl.To the negatives I've seen in some reviews: most of these can be fixed with a little common sense.1. Lids leaking- just check them! These don't leak if on right. I see if I can push on the lid- if it moves, or makes a popping sound, I re- thread it in while pushing down gently. Works for me.2. You can use them way more than 3x! I've used the same 10 pack for 6 months, still in great condition!3. Writing the Dates- I hand wash these- write date/time in PEN and it washes off! I just use the scrubby side of the sponge, and it comes right off! No need to cross off! Of course, I don't use permanent markers.4. They are a little bulky, but only when full, and not too much. They fit just fine in my cooler pack, and I love that I can pump directly in them, stick em in the fridge, or bring them to the car for a trip! It helps that if we are traveling, when we get to our destination I just wash & sterilize & can re use them the whole trip. Scene they stack in each other when empty, it takes up much less room than bringing 4 bottles!The only thing I'm not in love with is the plastic smell. This has been true across all brands of plastic baby bottles I've come across, so not just Avent - specific. When I heat the milk, I may transfer into a fresh cup which does the trick.For the adapters, I did buy a second pack, and now keep two dome adapters in the pump bag,while I have the other 2 available to convert the others into a bottle or sippy cup.

column9: Good durable product stors milk well
column10: This product does what is supposed to do and fits inside the pump so you can pump and store easily. Sometimes the lids can be hard to open but besides that it is a good product. My son (1 year old) also likes to play with them so it can be a toy once you are done with them.
Perfect product. It's bpa free even if it's not written! Fit perfectly with breast pump. Most convenient milk storage, much better than bag.
those cups fit perfect on the breast pump. they have been so practical! and the don't leak! i also take food in them now that my daughter eats almost everything.

Good product! Glad to have an alternate solution to storage bags! Whoever said "don't cry over spilt milk" must have never breastfed! I like the larger storage bottles better but these work out just fine. I was worried when I read how someone struggled to put the lids on so I tested it out first thing by filling it with water and dropping it on the ground. Didn't have any problems! Sure you do want to pay attention as to not miss thread them and perhaps wiggle it around to make sure the lid is on well but it does just fine. The biggest complaint I have is to how easy it is to over fill it because you may not be aware that it is overfilled until the cap is on and the milk is running over. Overall I'm happy with these things. Don't have an Avent bottle to test out the compatibility but to be honest, I don't even want to try.

Love these. Don't care for the avent bottles but I love my pump and it was a pain to find something to pump into when I started pumping more than 4 oz. These are great. Just make sure you get the 8 oz cups too. I like those better. They are a little iffy to get the top on but you just have to make sure its lined up right.
Be sure if you're purchasing the pump to get this as well.Received pkg promptly and it was packed well.

Just FYI, I checked the nutritional information on this product and it states it has 20 calories per stick.  Each tablespoon of Agave Nectar has 60 calories so each stick is 1 teaspoon.  So you would need three sticks for a tablespoon serving.  Just thought I would throw that out there for anyone thinking about buying this product and trying to figure out how many sticks they need to use in their tea or coffee, LOL!  I'm a two sticker;o)
this ia a good idea; however, difficult to open.  must squeeze/twist pretty hard & product oozes free - usually all over fingers.  also, portion size is a bit too small.  still love agave.

column4: Don't believe it just because someone told yo...
column10: I have used agave for many things and find that it is a better alternative to sugar.  It will not give you the sugar plunge you get from sugary products.  If you are using this product in beverages please realize that it is not going to give you that same sugary, syrupy flavor that some people are used to from regular sugar or substitutes.  It is a subtle sweetness.I have served this product to friends, and those who are used to a sugary taste in their tea didn't care for it as much as those friends who don't use a lot of sugar.  It really depends on what you are used to.  I have no complaints about this product.Agave is also better for people who have diabetes, as it does not spike blood sugar levels.Don't pass up on trying this great alternative to sugar.  It is worth letting your tastebuds adapt to the subtleness.  It is also great for baking.  Also, this is now labeled as organic, so another reason to try it.
The cinnamon honey sticks flavor was excellent. When added to tea it enhanced the flavor of the tea.

column9: Yummy honey in a convenient portion.
column10: I bought this in an effort to help myself quit smoking while watching my weight.  Also, I'd been looking for a smaller honey container to use to sweeten my hot tea when I'm at work.  These honey sticks definitely helped.  The honey was very good, the stick/straw seems to be a great way to package it as it doesn't spill out easily.  Plus, each stick is only 15 calories, so you can watch your proportion if that matters to you. I will definitely purchase this again.

column9: convenient way of taking your agave with you!
column10: I was hesitant about this product based on some customer reviews that said there were difficulties opening the little sticks and that they (the customers, not the sticks) got agave all over their fingers... I wonder if Stash read the reviews and changed their packaging?  I have not had this problem, and I'm usually *awful* at opening packaging! With these, I simply bite off the end (gross, I know, but I am a student and I don't/can't carry a knife around with me in my bookbag all day) and squeeze it into my coffee.  It's a great way to have my agave with me because most coffee shops and cafes have not yet started stocking this alongside their poisonous sugar alternatives (you know, those pink, blue, and yellow packets).  Keeps my blood sugar from spiking, sweetens my coffee--what more could you ask for?

These little goodies are so full of flavor and so good.  I bought these for my granddaughter in Minnesota and sent them to her.  She was thrilled, shared them with her sisters and now they are wanting to get some.Great gift idea!!

These are great to have!  I toss one in my daughter's lunch...have a few in my purse for a "pick" me up, etc.  Tasty, tasty!  Other people are so curious when I whip one out.  They are amazed it's a straw filled with honey.  This is the place to find the best price on these honey sticks.  Thanks for having them on subscribe and save.  Great program!

column9: Smell delightful, taste not so much
