column10: I picked up these honey sticks because I'm in a chai tea phase and thought they'd be nice to add to a simple black tea. Upon taking one from the box, I was treated to a wonderful scent of cinnamon and spices that reminded me of Christmas time.  I brewed my tea, added the stick of honey and stirred.  As I took that first sip, I couldn't much smell the honey I just added.  As the tea coated my tongue I was waiting and waiting for the scent of the honey stick to hit my tongue and it never really did. I could taste a tiny bit of honey, but nothing more than if I added plain clover honey to my tea.  It was rather underwhelming.  My second cup I tried 2 sticks and it was a little better, but for the price, I'd much rather just buy chai tea bags.All in all, don't expect it to taste the way it smells.  Far too weak in just a simple black tea, but smells divine still sealed up!

My mom-in-law had rec'd 1 box of these in a gift box, but couldn't find more when she found she enjoyed the convenience of them in her hot tea & on toast.  She said the straws are just the right amount, they are less messy & the honey keeps longers than in a jar.  A 6-pk was a great surprise for her.  The price was reasonable for a convenience item.
These honey sticks are so nice in a cup of tea.  You can even remove your tea bag with them!

These Chai Honey Sticks are SO good!  I enjoy eating one or two when I have a craving for something sweet.  It also makes a fun non-sugar sweet treat for my toddler.  The straws are the perfect size to add to a 6oz cup of tea too.

I agree with other reviewers about Agave in general and also specifically this product.  Know that I have a pretty big sweet tooth, and thanks to Agave I feel I'm slowly taming it.  I do find Agave to be sufficiently satisfying -- with the right amount.  And it makes me feel very good to know I'm not jacking up my blood sugar level with sugar, and that I'm not putting sugar (which I increasingly think of as poison) into my body.  But you do have to use around the same amount as regular sugar, maybe sometimes less, sometimes more.  Various mfgs. of the product claim you can use less.  I have not found this to be the case.Regarding the sticks specifically, you do have to squeeze fairly hard and repeatedly to get it all out, and inevitably some gets on your fingers.  However, given the above pluses, in the absence of anything better I'm willing to settle for the drawbacks as opposed to putting sugar or -- quel horreur -- artificial sweetners into my body when I'm away from home.
These are straws filled with lemon flavored honey.  I love them.  They taste great and are easy to take with you.  I use them at work- very convenient for quick hot tea without the messy honey.

column9: Great for traveling or eating out!
column10: These are GREAT for carrying in my purse for eating out, or when we're traveling, as most places do not have Agave Nectar!Just wish there was an easier way to open them...I'm carrying a small pair of scissors to open them!

It's great to have agave in a portable format.  But is is difficult to open.  The directions say to pinch to open.  They are not so easy to pinch.  I have found if you bend the tube about 1 inch above the end then pinch the end it helps.  But the agave often gets on your fingers.

I was disappointed in this product, as I had read and heard that this was an excellent sweetner, and it only took a small amount.  NOT TRUE!  I had a 8 ounce glass of tea, and added two "straws" of Nectar, and you couldn't even tell anything had been added.  Expensive if  you had to use a whole pack to slightly sweeten anything.

When I ordered these, based on the description, I thought the honey was somehow hardened into stick-form and thus would 'melt' into a cup of hot tea.  I was surprised when I discovered these sticks were actually thin plastic straws filled with honey!  There is no way I'm going to insert a plastic straw into a hot cup of tea. I'm not sure it would work anyway; I suppose you could cut open each end and then blow the honey in the tea.  Does Stash think you're going to sip on these straws?  I don't know what the company was thinking when they produced this product, other than as a candy to be eaten.I believe the term "stick" does not accurately describe this product and is misleading.  I doubt it's intentional, however.  The Stash Tea Company is an excellent company and has many high quality teas and products.The honey flavored with chai spices is good enough but frankly, it it a very expensive way to buy honey.  Better to buy a jar and flavor it yourself.  I wound up using these Chai Honey Sticks by cutting open one end and pressing out the honey into a tea cup/pot, which was messy and time consuming.I love Stash tea... drink it every morning.  But this product is a bust and I would never purchase it again.
Very tasty. Both the halibut, salmon and trout were delicious. Definitely had that smoky flavor and was miles ahead of what the smoked salmon at Sam's Club tasted like. I'd purchase it again.
A great coffee with deep flavor and smoothness.  However, be careful when buying this coffee that the "use by" date has not expired and the vacuum seal has not failed.

I recently visited Columbia. This seems to be their favorite, national brand, as it is sold EVERYWHERE!  I double-blind taste-tested it against some estate-grown Costa Rican coffe, and the Sello Rojo was MUCH better. It is as good as any specialty coffee out there.  You won't go wrong with this one.As a previous reviewer noted: pay attention to freshness date and package vacuum seal.  There are some retailers that will sell this coffee past its use-by date &/or with vacuum seal broken.

column9: wrong items sent  poor customer service
column10: I have tried to use them twice and had poor experiences with this company.  First of all the accuracy of the orders have been wrong twice.  The second time they arranged return of the wrong item nut kept saying a manager is needed to talk about my order.  3 days later and no calls nor emails back.  Also, they seldom answer the phone.  The products may be good if you get them but way too much stress.
loved it, taste great and came quickly.  Just as it it described, it is bold yet smooth.  It also taste like it was fresh grind

This coffee is VERY smooth and not acidity like some others.I have never liked instant coffee, thanks to a friend I tried Colcafe and loved it, so I decided to give Sello Rojo a try since its from the same family but its NON-Instant.I like my coffee real strong, so this coffee managed to be strong without giving me any heartburn, and that my friend its a HUGE selling point for me since I love coffee but have days when some coffee brands would give me excess amount of heartburn.Overall this bag has 17.6oz of true Colombian coffee for $8.99. I usually pay about $4 and change for 10oz of the local brand *Cough*Bustelo*Cough* and pay around the same $8 for 12oz of "goumet" coffee *Cough* Starbucks *Cough* Khalua *Cough* Godiva *Cough*Cough*Cough*.

The color is that perfect oblong gold - yes should be. But I both the same tea and color is almost black and tea is dry. Not fresh.Before both from Adagio.com - always was perfect. It is better to pay $4-$5 more and get a good stuff.

column9: A lovely Oolong without the tea shop price.
column10: I enjoy loose leaf teas...and this Oolong is lovely.  I can get three pots of tea off of one set of leaves.  (A good oolong should give you multiple pots off of one batch of leaves a lot like high quality grean tea will.)The flavor is delicate and flowery.  The color is that perfect oolong gold.  If you're looking for an inexpensive oolong that doesn't cost $50/lb...I highly recommend it.  Yes...there are better teas out there if you hit the gourmet shop...but if oolong is one of your everyday teas this won't disappoint.

column9: Excellent flavor for an out-of-the-box Pho
column10: This is a great product.  It is fairly convenient to make, and I found the flavor to be very authentic.  I have been eating at Vietnamese restaurants for a long time, and the flavor of the soup is right up there with some of my favorite places.  Having tried my hand at recreating the flavor at home, I can assure you that the soup packet is much easier.  Yes, you do need to add your own meat and vegetables, but would you want that stuff to come out of the box?  I've been using chicken broth and chicken (note that the meat option says to use beef).  I also recommend adding a thinly sliced onion to the broth when you start to get that authentic flavor.This is the perfect product if you have celiac, as it is gluten free and you can control what goes into it.

Happy Pho is fantastic. Delicious, healthy AND easy to make. I've made the soup and I've used the noodles alone in stir-fry. Both were delicious.I traveled to Vietnam a couple years ago and have been a big fan of pho ever since.  When a friend mentioned Happy Pho to me, I went ahead and ordered some.  Healthy Pho I can make at home?? I'm in. Keep in mind that I'm a bachelor and don't do a lot of cooking.The first time i wanted to make it, I realized i didn't have a few of the basic ingredients that it calls for. So I just stir-fried the noodles with broccoli. The noodles are made from whole grains yet only 2 minutes to boil? A healthy bachelor's dream. In fact, since then I figured out that its pretty easy to just cook them straight in the wok. But I digress.. The noodles were delicious! The tastiest noodles i can recall making at home.Ok, second time around I went all out and made the Pho soup. I rarely cook for other people, but i had someone coming over so figured we'd eat in, and I'd cook Happy Pho. I felt like Kung Fu Pandd making my delicious secret soup!  I was a little nervous, since i hadn't tried the spice pack. Well, it was delicious too.  My friend and I both loved it, and it only took about 10 minutes to do everything..Its a keeper! I can easily see it becoming one of my healthy bachelor staples.

OMG-dreams really do come true.  I wished for a product that was healtful, gluten-free, easy and quick to prepare, fun to eat, and tastes amazing and found Happy Pho.  I have made it the vegetarian way each time and even my carnivorous husband loves it!  (I take all the credit, but all i really did was boil the water!)

column9: Love the taste and the healthiness
column10: I love PHO.  I could eat it all the time.  The problem is that PHO isn't so good for those with health issues that require low sodium and low carbs.  In comes HAPPY PHO and I'm happy once again!  This stuff is great.  I could and do eat it 3 times a week.

column9: another happy mo pho (apologies to dr. cohen)
column10: phantasticphabulousphresh!this is an inexpensive, simple, easy to prepare soup or noodle dish. i have added tofu, veggies and chicken and played with different amounts of water or soup base. it's a forgiving mix because it's pretty basic. my 8 year old cooks this with minor supervision. so pleased to find such a tasty gluten-free item.

I truly enjoy this wonderful soup!  I picked it up at my local store figuring it would be a quick and easy lunch when I was in a hurry.  It is that, but it is also an amazing dinner!  I added some bok choy, cilantro, beef and voila..Dinner!  My husband and I thoroughly enjoyed our cheap and delicious dinner. You can basically add any type of meat and veggie you would like or not add anything at all...either way it is really delicious.  The spice pack adds just the perfect flavor. I am now purchasing this stuff by the case!

column9: Great Addition to a Plant Based Diet
column10: We are eating a plant based, whole grain, no oil diet.  I used these for a meal today and everyone in my family loved them.  A great addition to our pantry.

I thought this was one of the best mixes from a box I've had.  It was extremely flavorful and delicious!  I also like that it is low in sodium and doesn't contain any artificial ingredients.  I would definitely make this again!

Just tried your Happy Pho noodles last night. I sliced up mushrooms, zuchini and squash and added it to the mix. I let it stand so the vegetables could soak up the broth and it was great!!Thank you for a superior product.

My husband would eat Pho every day of the week if I had the time and NOW, I do! These are so convenient and very authentic! The flavor is just like it was simmering in my kitchen all day. I love the brown rice noodles as well!  Our family was nothing but impressed. :)

I bought a box of the Garlic Goodness.  It's delicious!  The noodles are as good as or better than the best pho noodles I've had, and I really like the flavors in the spice packet.  Plus, you can add salt to your liking, unlike most other soups which are loaded with sodium.  The directions for cooking the beef, however, will cause it to come out tough.  I recommend using super thin, decently marbled beef (like the brisket at Korean BBQ restaurants) and just put it raw on top of the soup after the noodles have been cooked.  Also, use lots of lime juice and fresh mint!

I love this stuff. If you're like me, you LOVE pho but love being healthy too and sometimes the two just don't mesh well together. No, this does not taste EXACTLY like the pho you'll get at a good Vietnamese place...but it's close enough and a lot better for you. I mixed mine with vegetable broth and tofu instead of the standard beef broth and meat trimmings. I would test this out if you're even halfway thinking about it. If you end up hating it, you can send the leftover boxes to me! :P

column9: A little box of Vietnam in your kitchen! Delicious!
column10: I've traveled quite a bit in Vietnam and found comfort in a delicious bowl of Pho on many a bad day at work or when I have a cold.  I've been looking for an easy and delicious way to make pho for myself but have never seemed to get it quite right.  But this WORKED!!! It is hot, delicious, and oh-so-easy.  Add some veggies and a little tofu or meat of your choice...you have a fantastic lunch or dinner. PLUS, bonus for me, gluten free!! I also have to say, I love that the packaging is 100% recycled paperboard.  If you're a Pho lover, I would definitely invest and keep some Happy Pho in your pantry.

I am beyond thrilled with this product!  It is difficult to find vegetarian pho in restaurants and making vegetarain pho (which I have attempted several times) is a long process.  Happy Pho has solved all of my problems!  It is vegetarian, healthy, quick, and delicious!  I can't recommend it enough!
Great idea to make brown rice noodles so easy to make. Love the flavor. Delicious, healthy, easy: perfect.

I'm Vietnamese and I know how Pho should be tasted. Of course, I don't compare this one with fresh Pho. But compared with all kinds of instant noodle, organic or not, gluten free or not, this one tastes extremely bad. After eating a first few bites, I threw the whole box. I don't even call this one Pho, from the look to the taste!I would rate it 0 star!

I was really disappointed in this product. I eat Pho a lot, and good Pho (I travel extensively, Internationally). While I did not expect this "Pho in a box" to match that of my previous culinary experiences, I did have hope that it would at least taste "ok". This tasted disgusting, reminiscent of bad tasting medicine. As other reviewers have mentioned, the box includes the noodles, and the spice packet. Everything else needs to be purchased. So based on that premise, you are better of buying everything from the store (Asian specialty if you have one), since you will need to go there anyway.Update:I also find it interesting that almost all of the 5 star reviews come from persons who only have 1 single review, and it is for this soup. Coincidence? I doubt it.

I bought this product because of the rave reviews. I should have known better.This stuff is yucky. And on top of it they want you to add vegetables, spring onions, optional meat, etc. And it is overpriced. Won't order again.I'll get my Pho at the Vietnamese restaurant.

column9: There is anise in the actual mix......
column10: The noodles are fine and cook well.  But this is WAY overpriced for a box of noodles.  The sauce mix that is included has anise in it...  I know that's the name of the company, but really, in the soup?????  And they really do want you to add another 5 things to it to make it soup...  I just put some garlic and basil in mine with chicken bouillon.  The mix that is included is thrown away, it is really horrible.  I have celiacs and this is great because it is gluten free, but I can buy cheaper stuff at the local health food store, or giant...

This plant was about 10" tall when I received it.  Six months later and it is almost to my shoulders with leaves that are two feet long.  No bananas yet but it is a beautiful, lush plant, that even my husband admires.

column9: Zone 7 (indoor during the winter, outdoor during the summer)...1 year later.
column10: I purchased this almost a year ago to the day because I wanted something to fill a corner of a room, and because I love banana trees (they remind me of home) and wanted one I could grow and keep indoors during the winter months in the mid-atlantic region.  I was between this and the tiny dwarf variety, but figured I wanted something that would occupy the biggest possible space without being the size of a full banana tree.  It arrived a tiny little plant, and at first I was worried that the container I had gotten for it looked ridiculously over-sized.It grew slowly for the first few months because I tried to grow it using artificial daylight lighting, but then started to pick up a little steam around April and I set it outside from May-September (summer months).  I thought it was gonna die outside with the intense heat and sun (I probably should have acclimated it to full sun a little more slowly), but then suddenly it started sprouting leaves at the rate of ~ 1 new bigger leaf per week. The leaves also went from being thin to being much thicker.  I watered it daily, btw, since it likes humidity.FYI, I repotted after the summer and holy moly does this thing have a lot of roots!  Give it a week or so to acclimate once you get it, but transfer it to a large pot soonish to avoid getting root-bound.  I used well-draining palm soil and apply slow-release fertilizer 1-2x a year.A year later, it is getting close to 3 ft. tall and still going (with the large container, it's closer to 4 ft), and currently is overwintering by a sunny window instead.  It's one of my favorite things to wake up to every day.  I've purchased a few plants from Hirt's and am yet to have a bad experience.  Pretty fast shipping, too!

column9: Arrived fast & healthy, but with broken leaves
column10: The banana plant, along with a Hoya carnosa 'Strawberries and Cream' (rated separately), were ordered together and arrived together just 3 days after ordering, an admirable accomplishment. The only thing that could/should have been done better was in protecting the banana plant's delicate leaves. They were simply suspended in a plastic-foam 'peanuts' that provided very good insulation, but they shifted about in transit resulting in 3 of its 5 leaves to be broken and damaged. I have no doubt that given the plant's overall health otherwise, will recover in a reasonably short amount of time, but is the reason for the 4-star rating. I found the condition acceptable as the plant was ordered for myself, but would not have found it acceptable if the plant was ordered as a gift for someone else. The only other, very minor complaint is that neither plant arrived with a plant tag.In summary, given that both plants were very reasonably priced and arrived quickly and in good-enough health that I would order from them again. I would suggest that if the plants are intended to be gifts that a note to this effect be included with the order.

Arrived perfectly fine and healthy-  just re-pot it, water it, and watch it grow! I've had it for about a month now and it has grown like a weed! One thing I have learned though, is when the bottom leaves die off (don't freak out, your little tree is ok!) don't strip them from the plant like I did. Dumb mistake - it only weakens the 'trunk'. Instead, I just go ahead and cut the dead leaf off when it dies! That way it doesn't effect the strength of the trunk while getting rid of shriveled up, ugly leaves! Overall I'm very happy with my purchase - have gotten many compliments on it :)

column9: arrived in good condition but no instructions
column10: I just received this plant in the mail. It arrived in good condition (a few bruised leaves from the travel but I think it's going to be OK). The plant looks very healthy. My only complaint is that it came with NO instructions. I think there should be something included that lets the consumer know if it needs immediate replanting; what the soil, water and sun/shade needs are as well as when one can first expect it to bear fruit. Admittedly, one can find this information on the web but I think they should have provided it in the box. Otherwise, it seems like a good product.
I really like this little thing.  It came very fast in the mail and I am just waiting for it to produce some bananas.  It came in perfect condition and it looks like a great plant.

My superdwarf banana plants arrived quickly and in excellent condition.  Each plant had about a six leaves on it with minimal shipping damage. I re-potted them immediately and they suffered no transplant shock.  They're now thriving in a sunny window.Another word on re-pottng.  The plants are packed and potted for shipping in shallow, light-soiled, 4" containers, which means that you'll want to re-pot them into a bigger pot immediately.  I can't stress that enough. I honestly wouldn't wait more than a day to re-pot, as in the warmer months the plant could dry out very quickly.

column9: plant was dead when it arrived.
column10: This plant was dead when it arrived,all of the leaves were burned brown,it appeared to have been subjected to too much heat or something. The seller is refunding my money,but I would have preferred to have received another (healthy) plant.

Nice looking plant.  They ( I ordered 2) cannot tolerate full sun!!  Both plants suffered burned leaves after 5 hours exposure.  They came back after 1 week and now, after one month in the shade they are adding leaves.
I left it out in the sun on a warm day, then the leaves got sunburned, so dont let it get full sun!!! set it in a window that doesnt ever see the sun and water it, mist it, and it will be happy.

The shipping on this gave plenty of leeway, but got here within a week.  The plant is GORGEOUS.  Packaged beautifully with bright, big green leaves for a total green height (not including pot) of a foot, which includes the length of the leaves based on packing!  The pineapple I ordered with it is also in fantastic shape.  Based on this alone, I would recommend these plants and this company for the best shipped plants I have ever received.  C'est magnifique!  I will gladly amend this once the plant really gets going in its new home, but I have high hopes.

It arrived OK with some broken leaves but in general a healthy condition. It grows pretty fast, 1 new leaf comes out every 1-1.5 week, new leaves are completely healthy looking with a very beautiful green color. Smaller weak leaves dies off near the bottom but it's OK, not terrible.It is an excellent house plant and got that exotic feeling. The hope that it will bloom and bear mini banana some day adds so much fun! It is really exciting as the new leaves unroll themselves and you will find another tiny one growing in the middle.My only problem is that Gnats are breeding in the soil after 2 weeks because of the moist soil. I am still looking for a remedy that doesn't hurt the plant.
got the 2 plant quickly.both were in good conditionreplanted after 2 days they have doubledin the last 4 weeks.THE ONLY BANANA PLANT I'VE EVER HAD TO LIVE!!!!
It didn't make the trip and died within a month. It came partially brown and I did what I could but it did not pull through.  The other plant I ordered along side did fine though.

column9: Novice Grower, and Plant is Thriving!
column10: I am new at growing plants. I received this plant early March 2011. It arrived and looked nice and healthy. The plant was inside until it warmed up here in Missouri. Then I put it outside on the porch. It did really great until we got all that horrible MO weather. The wind ripped up the leaves, and the hail did the plant a lot of damage. I thought for sure it was a gonner. But this plant came back, and seems to be doing great! It's a bit over 2 feet tall now! I hope it makes bananas! That would be great, but it is very nice looking. Also, there are 2 little babies growing around the base of the plant now, so if this one doesn't work out I have 2 to try again with! I will try to add a picture. Mine is in a yellow container.

The plants arrived well packed and on time.It was planted in a patio Pot with drip line and starter Miracle  Grow pellet.Within a few days the healthy leaves turned bkack and dropped off leaving the center pod to grow.Within a week the leaves there turned black and now have dropped off also looking like one sick plant.I took lots of photos over these days.  Finally I replanted it in the soil near another Banana tree, with a drip line.I have done all I could do and it looks like a loser.  It has not been in direct sun and we have not had a 100+ day.Maybe they will exchange for another Banana?Yuma, AZ.

Plant arrived in decent condition, packed very tightly with a "Song of Jamaica" that I had ordered from the same seller. Multiple leaves were bruised and two of the six leaves were torn almost halfway off. Needless to say, the plant was still very much alive and kicking. I replanted into a 5" pot temporarily, and then replanted into a 10" shortly afterwards. Since it's arrival (just about three weeks) the plant has mended itself as much as possible, and has grown two beautiful new leaves with no sign of slowing down.All in all, I am happy with this purchase.

I was concerned about having a live plant shipped to me. But it was shipped quickly and packaged well. I waited 2 days then repotted the plant in a 12" container. I've had it 3 weeks and it's doing well. It has even grown a new leaf!I did notice, however, you can't place this plant in full sun, no matter how long. This will cause the leaves to "burn". Also, if the plant gets too dry, it will warm you by "curling" the leaves.Thanks, Hirts, for a beautiful plant! Even if it never gives me bananas, it is a gorgeous plant.

The plant was delivered in the coldest part of January and it got a bit of frostbite.  It is slowly coming back.  I wouldn't order this plant in winter or have it near cats that have a tendency to chew other houseplants.

Customer service is great.  When the first plant died, we contacted Hirtz Garden and they immediately send us replacement free of cost. second plant was bigger and it was very healthy.I really appreciate the quick service.  I Highly recommend Hirtz Garden.

"I was very pleased by the service. It arrived before the predicted time. The plant was healthy with some broken leaves at the stalk. It was surprisingly small. Previous person mentioned a 10' plant. This plant was probably 3-4' plant. 4 star was giving for some broken leaves(shipping or the really small box) and knowing that I received a smaller product then previous customer. Order from Hirt's!"

column9: Pretty good shape but still no fruit
column10: I got 2 of these plants, 1 came slightly damaged but recovered. I have them in 10-inch pots on the porch. Almost 2 years later, they are both doing well, but still small (about 1.5 feet tall), and still no fruit. Maybe because they need a larger container. Definitely don't do well in full sun -leaves burned and died, but came back when I moved to shadier spot.

The plant was beautiful and strong, and still is. Planting instructions weren't clear, however, and we used the wrong soil at first. I had to go online to find the correct soil to plant her in. She needed Cactus/Palm Tree/Citrus soil. Other than that, things are great.

Arrived early, 3 days early which was a pleasent surprise! Came in good condition, good packaging. Was the 4 inch pot but the plant was a lot smaller then advertised in picture... its maybe 6 inches tall but with healthy looking leaves so I'm not too disapointed. Hopefully it will grow fast.

The Plants arrived ahead of time (about 10 days earlier). When I placed my order, I requested standard shipping time to save $ but right after, I heard that a heat wave was forecasted for the following week. I was surely worried to lose the plant in transit time. You can imagine my surprise when I received them so early! :)The two little "trees" are growing fine, about a new leaf every 4 days or so. I am satisfied with what I got.Now, I just need to figure out how I can get them to pass winter time...  I will work on it. I promise! :)

This item is everything it says, just don't expect it to arrive as large as the image shows. Mine came with only three leaves but after two weeks is already up to five. Guess its gonna take awhile longer to really see how it will turn out as its a plant and needs to grow...It was delivered in a very safe and protective package without so much as a creased leaf. My only gripe was that I paid for faster shipping and was still sent this item regular shipping.
Plant arrived in great shape.It started a little slow, but in about three weeks has really started to take off.At this point I'm really thrilled with it.

column9: Got a tiny 3 leaf plant, all leaves damaged.
column10: Got a much smaller and less healthy than expected plant based on description and comments here.  Its only been a few days, so it might suddenly explode with new growth.  Currently the 3 leaves on it are either dead or damaged, so unless some new growth happens immediately, the plant is a goner.Updated 4/26/12: Original leaves have basically rotted away or already fallen off, but on the upside 1 large healthy leaf took their place and another on has started coming up.  Looks half dead still, but should make it if enough leaves come up fast enough.Updated 8/26/12: Original plant died off completely, but had faith and put it outside and watered it every day for a few weeks.  Eventually a tiny leaf popped up even though it was half brown.  Since then 8 new leaves have come up even though most of them are up to 20% browned to start.  Each leaf rots away after a week or 2 but they are progressively getting bigger.

column9: Very Nice Fast Growing Little Plant.
column10: I ordered this plant last week and received it in the mail just a few days later. I expected to receive it much later so I was surprised. The only reason why I don;t give it 5 stars is because it was packed in a tiny box and the some of the soil spilled all over the leaves despite being taped, So I had to clean it. Also two of the leaves were damaged because the box was too small. The plant itself was puny, very disappointing if you expect to get something like the picture or the description(This is why it gets 4 stars). It was definitely not 10" long, the stem is not even 5" tall right now and I find it has grown considerably. And it only had about 7 leaves including one in the center that was still curled up and 2 at the bottom that didn't make it during shipping. So now the plant has 5 leaves. The middle one has uncurled but the tip has a few tiny holes which worried me. I checked for bugs but I haven't found any yet.I transplanted this little one to a pretty 8" pot with 4 parts organic potting mix and 1 part perlite and added some organic fertilizer. The first and second day the it was a bit distressed but then after that it started perking up and getting more and more beautiful. The leaves are much longer and it loves my sunny windowsill. I will move it outside as soon as the temperatures are warm enough. I water it lightly everyday, leaves and all in the early morning because the soil dries up quickly in the direct sun. So far my little banana tree is growing fast and doing great.

column9: NIce BIG leaf plant for inhouse
column10: The plant came small and seems weak after the transportation. But now it is 3.5 ft tall with several 18 inches leaves. A good big leaf plant for in house. Highly recommended.

column9: This one is doing quite well now.
column10: I received my banana dwarf on Monday. Two of the four leaves were healthy. One of the others was broken. I hold out hope that it will flourish, but i give it 50/50 odds. I havent watered it since it arrived, and yet the soil is still quite saturated. This gives me cause for concern since the soil should only be moist for this plant, even though it is a tropical. I am leaving it outside for the next couple days to see if that will help, rather than by the window where it has been. I snapped a photo which i will have available here for review. I will continue to update this as things change for good or for bad. Presently, i can only offer three stars on the plant.July 6th: It has recovered and is doing quite a bit better. The broken leaf has actually grown back and looks strong. In addition, a new leaf is unfurling from the top of the plant. Definitely looks a lot better now. I have upped my rating to four stars to reflect the change in status.August 20th: The plant is doing quite well. Each new leaf that unfurls is larger than the last. What i have found is that the plant doesn't like direct sunlight, but does thrive in the heat. So, placing it in the shade seems to be the way to go...at least for my plant...at least until it gets cold, then it's coming inside for the winter.Update, January 6 (2012): This is by far the healthiest and most vibrant plant i own at this point. Each new leaf grows larger than the last. I have it indoors presently for the winter, sitting next to a window. It is still thriving. Some interesting notes....the leaves tend to grow against the window (because it is the light source most likely), and they trap condensation between them and the window, which seems to be beneficial. Also, we have had an issue with gnats, but for some reason, they tend to die around the banana plant, which is really good. We clean up the little bug graveyard every so often, and this benefits out other plants. I will take some more pictures soon, but from what i can tell, if your plant survives its transplant(s), you will have a wonderful addition to your home and/or garden. Presently, the plant is about three and a half feet tall, btw.

this item came well packed, took it out and watered it and let sit out for a day or two, still a good healthy plant 2 weeks later, was about 8 inches tall when received with about 8-9 leaves. needed to be replanted in bigger pot but for about 12 dollars including shipping you cant beat it.

I just got my plant a few days ago, but so far it is doing great! It came really fast, and was in great condition when it arrived. All the leaves were green and the plant was healthy. So far, it has been easily worth the cost.Well, i have had my banana for a couple of months now, and i still like it, but there is a big problem. During shipping, a bug must have gotten into the soil. I had the plant in my room for a week or two, when i noticed these little white bugs on the soil. they were about a centimeter long, and a millimeter wide, and they multiplied like crazy!! i tried using bon-neem to get rid of them, but they just hid underneath the dirt for a day and came back the next day. they seem to be causing the banana trouble because about half of the leaves have died. If not for the bug problem, this would be five stars though.

This and the blueberry plant arrived quickly and in great shape. My only disapointment is that I do not have a green thumb and was hoping there would be some instructions with it. But reading these reviews helped me as to what size pot to use and what kind of soil. Thanks to those who shared that info!

Arrived three days after order, bottom two leaves were a tad beat up, but the plant bounced back nicely after a few shots of Liquid Grow.Waited a week to transplant and it is now sprouting up its third set of new leaves in as many weeks and growing nicely.Pretty plant, for sure keep it out of direct outdoor sunlight.  I keep mine inside where it receives indirect light and it seems happy as a clam at high tide.  It can take daily (yes daily) shots of liquid fertilizer.Another great buy from Amazon for me.

This plant is very cool, but it arrived only 7-8" tall D;. I live in massachusetts, and I am amazed it is still ALIVE after 30 F degrees! It took 11 days total to get here, and in those days it has been in the - degrees, so I can't imagine how clod it was on the shipment here! One of the leaves seems to have frostbite though, but the other 2 leaves are in good condition. The top is a little frost bitten, but I'm sure it will turn out to be good. The over all look of the plant looks lush, but it is a little limp, but it will grow a lot! I recommend this for people anywhere, even in the north, where I am!

I have ordered several times banana plants along with others. First two delivered in a big box without any damage and all the leaves were lovely. Second time I ordered for my friends and I don't know the condition of those.But today, I got the last two plants delivered in a very small box and two banana plants came with all leaves broken. One was very bad and I'm pretty sure because of the box being too small.Sarah Zhang

column9: Plant looked kind of like the photo
column10: Arrived today usps.. a little worse for the wear but have ordered before..and transplanted in the yard and turned out to be beautiful plants..The mail is just kind of hard on the plantsand its a crap shoot if they arrive unscaved  or not.. but these are pretty hardy.. I guess.

Well this was the first time i ordered a live plant online, and i have to say it was a nice smooth transaction from HIRT'S in ohio. Plant came a little bit smaller than i thought it would but, it came in perfect condidtion and took the transplant very well. My plant has grown a inch already, and sprouted 2 new leaves as well. I have replanted in a 12 inch planter hopefull will be large enough for the next 6 - 9 months.

I've had this plant less than a week.  It came very healthy (lost maybe two small leaves in transport), looks very much like the picture on amazon but smaller. Handled transplant to new pot great, even opening up a new leaf already!  I hope it does grow fruit eventually. All in all I'm very happy to have it. Would definately recomend this seller and plant! Thanks!

column9: Came fast but plant looks pale green!
column10: It came very fast and none of the leaves are falling off but they look pale. I repotted them and watered them and put it under a lamp so hopefully evrything will do well. I'll update later on...
Great packing! Arrived in good condition about 7" with a pup 4". Lovely plant =)

I waited several weeks before reviewing this plant because I wanted to see how it would do. I arrived in a small plastic container and had 3 damaged leaves. I replanted it and immediately it began to grow new healthy leaves at at fast rate. Indirect light and watering it about every 10 days has seemed to work perfect. It is a beautiful plant and is growing well. It was packed well but lost most of the soil, I was happy with the shipping speed and price. The plant is doing excellent and I hope by next summer I will have little bananas.

Bought this plant months ago, it arrived promptly, packaged well. It was a decent size and very healthy. It grows very nice and quickly with summer sun. Living in NY it's not inside under artificial lights. Tolerant to some neglect in watering... nice interesting plant

column9: Great plant, Hard to find Fertilizer.
column10: I ordered two plants and only took a few days for shipping with standard shipping.  They were in great shape considering they've been bumped around in the mail for a few days.The Seller recommends using a 8-10-8 fertilizer which can be a bit harder to find in a smaller quantity.  Search Amazon and you'll find one listing for a 20lb bag for over $35 after shipping.  The same product is available in a 4lb bag, but doesn't list the 8-10-8 in the description.Search for 32086 Garden Fertilizer.  It's also Prime eligible.

I ordered this plant from Amazon back in August. The plant arrived in a couple of days and was in perfect condition. I was originaly concerned as I was afaid it would not look like the picture or would be wilted or damaged due to being shipped, but that was not the case. It was packaged well and arrived in great condition. I am very happy with both the plant and the service. The plant is perfect and doing fine. Will definatly order again.

I was very happy when I received my plant.It was over 6 inches,very healthy with new shoots.I received it in just 3 days from CA to NY.It has already grown over an inch and added two new leaves in a weeks time.Look forward to little bananas:)
This is a nice size plant. Looking forward to seeing how it does. Wanted a novelty plant and this is fitting the bill.

My banana plant arrived in great condition, no broken leaves or anything. I re-potted right away into an 8 inch self watering plastic pot and it has been thriving near a window in my living room. I've gotten a new leaf about every week or so. I cant wait to get fruit growing on it, but even just as a fruitless house plant it is very neat. Every leaf that grows is larger than the one before it. Highly recommend!
i love the plant , it came very well packed , and now its growing pretty fast and i like how u give instrutions on how u plant and what to use ,,thanks alot
The plant came packed in a bag and foam peanuts tight in a box but overall looks healthy and I already replanted it.

column4: Banana Farmer "Little by little, grow the ban...
column10: I ordered the Super Dwarf Cavendish along with Musa Truly Tiny.  They shipped them together and gave me a refund on the second shipping.  Although the SDC was smaller than expected(Less than 4") it is a healthy plant it was not damaged in shipping.  It was packed very well(as were both plants).  They shipped very fast. I will insert a picture if I can figure it out.

Honestly, I'm not sure if I have the correct plant.  The plant I received is teeny tiny...maybe 5 inches tall (excluding the pot it's in) with 4 tiny leaves.  I'm hoping it grows quickly into something remotely close to what the photo looks like.  I've owned other banana plants in the past and they have been great house plants!!  I've just never seen one so "young" before.  So, I'm going to give this little baby my best shot and hope it grows up to be a great plant like my others.  I can't say it's a bad plant, but just not what I was expecting to receive.  It's a baby.  :)I'm going to try to attach a photo just so people know what they are getting...

I ordered two of these, and they were packaged together. I would say they were both half the size of the default picture on the product page, however still very nice plants. Only 1 leaf on each was broken/bent, which didn't matter too much. The plants are now on my porch and doing very well. I would recommend this.
The plant arrived healthy and has started growing more leaves. It's very tiny right now. It will be exciting to see what happens next.

I just received the first of two banana plants today and i'm pleased to say it was packaged well and larger than expected. It is about 12 inches tall with 9 leaves, and one sprout.It must have grown when shipping as its roots were coming out of the container.  As it was healthy i transplanted it to a larger pot. This is not reccommended but it was in such good shape.I live in Ma, so we have cold winters, but im going to attempt to grow it in my heated sunroom.Im excited to get my scond banana plant and see how they do.I am very happy with this purchase and would purchase again.

So far it seems like a nice plant, but I was surprised at how small it was.  I realize that banana plants usually grow quickly, but I wasn't expecting the plant to be THREE inches tall.  As others have advised I have kept it out of direct sunlight and it has survived its first week and a half.

I was very pleased with the plant. I wasn't sure how it was going to arive because of the reviews, but the packaging was great. It's nice and green with four nice size leaves at the top and a little one at the base.I only received it a few days ago and it is doing wonderful. I am buying another for my Dad for father's day.

Received the rectangular box quickly. The plant was about 6" tall. Nice green stem. Leaves look burned or black. Portion of stem appears to have suffered a small fracture. I chopped it all off. Re-planted in a larger pot and now I have a 3" green stem. I don't know, time will tell. I wasn't expecting much for the price. It's worth a shot.
the banana plant was a great idea for my husband but not so happy with it it looks sick not doing well at all

After loving Nutiva's coconut oil (great coconutty flavor and SO healthy for you!) I wanted to try the coconut manna.  So I bought it and I LOVE it!  It's got kind of a peanut butter consistency.  It is so delicious!  I take the whole jar and just grab a spoon and snack on it while watching tv or any other excuse I can find to eat it.  It's a great healthy and tasty snack.  I highly recommend it!  YUM!I should add that I am low carbing, so this tastes sweet to me, but may not to someone who eats sugary foods regularly...

column9: Nothing in the world like it!
column10: If you are going primal and looking for a snack that's high in healthy fat, low in carbs, satisfying and delish, this is it. I like to eat it with a spoon!

This is soooo much better than just using coconut oil for baking recipes. Often those come off in chunks and aren't as creamy as this is. It's a staple in a lot of my recipes and it definitely is something I have to buy at least once a month. As long as you use the directions to keep it from separating and blend well while baking, it will work wonderfully.

Yes, this is grainy. So if you're buying it, be prepared for that and you won't be disappointed!  I quickly adjusted to the texture and actually crave it.  It is amazing on scones, biscuits, toast, bagels and pretty much anything else we've tried to put it on.  AMAZING on naan bread when being eaten w/ an Indian meal.

After disliking their Chocolate Hemp shake, I saw the Manna and decided to give it a chance, hoping that creating that shake was a 1 time bad idea and the company has good products.I should have known better! If a company allows such a bad shake to be in their line, then they just don't have a smart or caring management!!The sandy texture never goes away, and it makes your throat itch, and it's just not yummy! Highly not recommended, if you're already having doubts. Will never buy it again :)

column9: O.  M.  G.  Chocolate and Creamy Coffee Center
column10: Ritter Sport was a pleasant surprise to me about a year ago, when my employer introduced me to the Dark Chocolate and Hazelnut Bar.  I happened upon an Espresso Bar during checkout at TJ Maxx a few weeks ago, and can NOT stop craving this out-of-this-world candy bar!!!  I also can NOT find it in any other stores! lolI actually embarrassed my daughter when I first tasted it, making loud "Oh my GOSH" sounds.If you have this in your local stores, you owe it to yourself to try about 20.

column9: Full, rich taste of honey without being overpowering or overly sweet - I like it!
column10: Honey often makes things too sweet for me. I don't like an overpowering taste.I made whole wheat bread with Wholesome Sweeteners Organic Fair Trade Honey. I used the same amount of honey that I usually use, but I liked the result much better. It seemed to add a full, rich, taste, but was not overly sweet or "it is not sickly sweet" as another poster stated it. That means I am happy to use it again and again for baking bread, my main reason for buying honey.I'm very pleased with this brand of honey and would gladly recommend it to those who want a full-bodied taste, but  not an overpowering sweetness
I've used this honey in no-bake cookies, baked oatmeal, drizzled on top of blueberry muffins... it is really tasty and delicious and I've been pleased with it.

Not really, but I guess in principle I'm in favor of fair trade stuff so what the heck.  I'm not a honey connoisseur by any stretch of the imagination, but I thought this tasted good; I mostly eat honey on toast or use it when I make my own salad dressing.My wife thought this had a slightly "off" flavor (she felt it tasted like molasses, actually) compared to the regular honey we buy at the supermarket, but I did not notice that.

This is a dark honey, similar to buckwheat with a bit of a caramel undertone. Very yummy! We drizzled it on homemade cracked wheat bread and it was delicious. I've had a lot going on here lately and when I put a pan of custards in the oven, I found I had left the sugar out of the recipe! Oops. Well, I just squirted a swirl of this honey on top and it was so good I'm thinking of always making them that way in the future.The only thing that would make me hesitate to purchase this product would be that we prefer raw honey for the nutritional value.As far as the fair trade issue goes,it's a nice thought, I approve of the humanitarian angle. However, we have plenty of bee keepers here in the USA selling wonderful raw honey, working very hard. Let's give them a break and a dollar.

Even at Amazon's price, this just isn't worth the money.  I didn't tell my wife what I thought of it, so I could get her unbiased opinion.  We both thought this honey was rather bitter.  It certainly doesn't have a great, sweet taste to it like many domestic honeys.  Plus, the idea of something from another part of the world defeats at least some of the reported benefits of honey if it comes from one's local area.We'll probably use it all, but more out of a desire to not waste it by throwing it away.  It's not awful by any means, but at best a 3-star product, and really just a bit below that (thus the high 2-star rating).  Others may like it - we don't.

This is great tasting honey.  It is thick and a dark amber color.  And like many dark honeys, it is robust in flavor.  I alsolike the bottle.  It sits on the cap which means it is always easy to squeeze the honey out.  Some of the bottles I have bought in the past did not do this and after a while it became difficult to get the honey out of the bottle.  I will definitely buy this honey in the future.

column9: No reason not to award 5 stars - rich, sweet, dark - with a molasses-like after taste
column10: To begin with, I like the premise for the product, and I am more than happy to try out this product from Central/South American beekeepers.I was a little surprised when I first saw the honey.  It is much darker than most honey I've seen and used over the past several years - mainly clover and orange blossom honeys.  I wasn't wary, just surprised.The honey has a deep color (darker than the color shown in the product description) and rich flavor.  It is extremely sweet, and has a distinctive but not unpleasant aftertaste that is reminiscent of molasses.  My college daughter, who considers herself something of a honey connoisseur, pronounced it good and even offered to take it off my hands :-)I also like the bottle.  It is plastic and is designed to stand on its cap that has a no-flow plug.  The honey is dispensed easily by gently squeezing the bottle.All in all I think that this honey deserves 5 stars.  Though the taste is a little different than North American honeys I've tried, it has a very good flavor and comes in an easy-dispensing plastic bottle.5 stars!

We tried this on crackers with peanut butter. It was super-good, along with a cup of tea. This honey has a kind of rich, dark flavor that I can't quite describe -- but it sure is good. If you enjoy the flavor of honey, you've got to give this Wholesome Sweeteners Organic Fair Trade brand a try.

column9: Much richer than typical clover honey
column10: I drink a lot of tea with honey so I was anxious to sample this product. It is much darker in color than traditional clover honey and has a more full-bodied flavor. I love it!

This honey has a strange smell to me, almost like caramel that has been nearly burnt. I so wanted to try this but it came to me with the seal broken and had leaked all over the inside of the packaging. I guess I am a little leary of trying it since the seal was broken, it was probably in shipping but I can't be certain of it. I buy local honey and they all have a very nice honey scent but this one doesn't have a good scent to me, I am not sure what makes this one so much different from the other natural honeys I have gotten.

I like honey and buy orange blossom or buckwheat honey from a local farmers market.  I tried Wholesome Sweeteners Organic Fair Trade Honey, and I am not a fan of it.  I believe the flavor is just OK because I can taste burnt caramel which is not a taste I like.  I am not sure if it is caused by the type of flower this honey is made from or by something else.  I prefer this honey mixed as a sweetener in a cup of tea rather than eating it by itself.

I liked this honey a lot. Great taste and consistency.  The squeezable container makes it easy to use and easy to work with if the honey eventually crystalizes.  The idea that I can buy honey that is organic and fair trade where the money goes to the farms and bee keepers makes me feel like I am making a good choice.  Is it cheap?  Not necessarily, but is it worth it to buy organic and fair trade if you can?  Absolutely.  Great product and I would definitely consider purchasing this item and telling my friends/family about it.

I usually only buy honey from local sources because of the scandal of high fructose corn syrup being mixed in with almost all honeys you find commercially.  I also like that local honey is unpasteurized, which preserves the enzymes and anti-bacterial quality of the honey. We use a lot of honey in baking and on our food, so having a quality product is important to us.I tried this honey just to see if it was a good as the description makes it sound.  I'm really impressed!  I love that it's organic and non-GMO, and of course the fair trade aspect means the people who tend the bees are actually getting paid for the honey. The one downside is that it's been pasteurized.  But the flavor of this honey is the best part. It has a dark, rich taste that reminds me of molasses or sorghum.  It was lovely on toast, much different than clover or apple blossom honey.I wouldn't buy this product for baking because it's rather expensive ($8+ per 16 oz) but as a condiment at the table, I think we've found a new favorite.

column9: Wonderful Honey, Very Strong Flavor but Very Pleasant
column10: This honey is very dark and, as mentioned above, has a very strong flavor. I don't know what flower to attribute it to. It doesn't taste like clover or orange blossom honey, but is delicious nonetheless. This will work great in Indian style teas or any baking goods that need the honey flavor to be robust. I also love the fact that it is not only organic but Fair Trade in origin.

column9: Good for you, good for the planet and tasty
column10: Organic and fair trade are two designations I like to see on products I buy. Together they're nearly irresistible, but of course a lot depends on whether the product is worth buying.  Does it taste good?  Wholesome Sweeteners honey does taste good.  It's a dark amber honey with the kind of slight bitterness you find in buckwheat honey.  It also has an odd flavor, probably because I'm unused to honey produced from South American plants.  Not unappealing, just different.If you can find something like this that suits your tastes and covers a lot of socio-political bases as well, why not buy it?

I use honey mostly for baking.  I tried this honey in a batch of whole wheat bread (and I scooped up some to taste while I was mixing the dough). The color is unusually dark, like molasses. The flavor is distinctive, richer than most honeys.  The difference is more obvious when you just eat the honey, but the baked bread did taste subtly different than usual. I am concerned about mounting pesticides in food and am glad to find a honey that does not contain any. I should care about fair trade, too, so am glad that makers of this honey are doing the right thing. The bottle is a standard plastic squeeze bottle, not very organic but you can recycle it.

I use honey both in tea and on some snacks (crackers with peanut butter and honey, etc.) and the flavor of Wholesome Sweeteners Organic Honey is far above the major brands on the supermarket shelves.  The color may surprise some as it is a dark caramel brown and the flavor is rich and a major treat.  This is a superior product and one all honey lovers should try.  The fact that it is organic and fair trade is icing on the cake.

This honey is dark and rich with an almost caramelized flavor.  Think dark chocolate to milk chocolate or black tea to green.The packaging on this product is a little silly.  I mean, I get that it's supposed to make it easy to pour, especially when the bottle starts to get empty, but if the lid is just a molecule off, you get a sticky puddle and you lose some of the honey!Keep the container with the lid up, and you've got yourself a lovely bottle of honey!

I was so excited to get honey that is not only Organic, but Fair trade!  Other than that, I really didn't expect much of a change from the honey I buy at the store and I wasn't really wrong.I use honey in tea.  For me that is the main reason I buy it (other than the occasional recipe that calls for it).  I enjoy at least 1 cup of tea a day with about 1 1/2 teaspoons of honey to sweeten it.I have to say that this honey is beautifully dark.  I don't mean a shade darker than regular honey, but it was almost molasses colored! I thought that was pretty great because dark honey usually means very sweet honey.  It also has this wonderful, rich scent.For tonight's tea, I decreased the honey to about 1 teaspoon to see where it measured and I don't need any more than that. I don't taste any difference in flavor, though.  I thought there might be a little more clover to it or something to really make it distinct, but there just isn't.So, to sum:Pros: Use less for same sweetnessThe fact that it is Fair trade (no ripping off 3rd-world countries by paying them pennies)Organic (be real, we have no clue what pesticides do to our bodies but are much sicker than our counterparts of 60 years ago)Cons: Price -- but not awful really.  Local honey from vendors tends to be around the same price, though store brands are cheap but no telling where/who they come from.Overall, I would probably buy it again.  I know I feel better about having it to give to my daughter and a little less sweetener in my tea...

This is a very rich and flavorful honey. The taste of the honey comes through very nicely; it is not sickly sweet like some other honeys that are commercially available.In the ideal, Organic Free Trade can be a very good thing. You can read more about it at Wikipedia if you like.Certainly, organic processing does help to insure that our foods are free of harmful pesticides and other by-products.This honey is certainly delicious and has a beautiful color. Very appetizing. Improve the taste of all your foods and beverages with this honey. Works well in both tea and coffee.

These looked better than they were. I am upset I didnt realize how puch I paid for shipping until after the fact. The actual hot chocolate was average..nothing your local DD can't outdo. Box was tiny! Overall very standard and bland taste.

Heat 8-10 oz 2% or whole milk, not quite to boiling, in your microwave. Add ~1-1/4 rounded teaspoons of Ghirardelli Mocha Hot Choc powder + ~1-1/8 rounded teaspoons of Ghirardelli Hazelnut Hot choc powder, stirring to fully mix. Now add ~3/4 oz Christian Brothers VS Brandy. (Optionally) garnish with whipped cream or a small accent of vanilla ice cream and serve.Notes: Not to be a brand whore, but Christian Bros (VS, not the more expensive VSOP) is the only brandy I've found to really have the right profile for this recipe. Exact proportions for all 4 ingredients should ultimately be to your own taste. Non-fat and 1% milk are NOT recommended. The brandy should contribute its flavor but not be so strong as to have an obvious alcoholic note. I've for many years used a 1.0 Mocha + 1.5 Hazelnut ratio, but lately the Mocha product hasn't seemed as intense, so I've adjusted. You'll know it's right when the mocha + hazelnut + brandy flavors are in such balance that none is too dominant -- the result will be a new experience "greater than the sum of its parts."

This is delicious hot cocoa but if you make it according to the packages directions it would be very strong!! I made some for my son with only 2 TBSP and it tasted pretty good but not super sweet. I made it for myself with 3 TBSP and it was like drinking a melted chocolate bar. It was very strong and sweet. Delicious but almost over the top! Later I made it again but I mixed only 1TBSP of it with the cheap swiss miss cocoa I already had. I think that was actually perfect! Creamy but not too sweet. I also think that this is overpriced. I got quite a good deal on it (saved several dollars) and still thought it was a bit expensive and I was suprised how tiny the cans were. I am definitely going to save this for my husband and I! My kids can have the cheaper stuff. :) This hits the spot on a cold winter day when you are craving chocolate though!

column9: Too sweet but good enough for 3 stars
column10: I like this cocoa if mixed with unsweetened cocoa. By itself it is just too sweet with not enough chocolate flavor. I debated whether to give it 3 or 4 stars, but I think I'm going to have to go with 3 stars because my wife also agrees it is just too sweet. Adding some unsweetened cocoa powder, like "Navitas Naturals Organic Raw Chocolate Powder, Cacao Power, Mayan Superfood" increases the chocolate flavor and reduces the sweetness and brings it up to 4 or 5 stars, but that requires additional expense and work.On another note, I did find that adding a spoonful of this cocoa mix to a cup of Keurig coffee and then half and half makes a nice cup of coffee that is just the right sweetness for my taste. So in that use it works well.

We have used this Chocolate for years. Now, by subscribing for delivery on a regular schedule, we get it at a good price. It came quickly and was in good condition when it arrived. Try it. I think you will like it!

Used to buy this locally, but now none of the stores carry it.  So, I started ordering it online.  It makes a great cup of cocoa if you like hazelnut flavor and it dissolved readily in hot milk.  A teaspoon added to a cup of coffee adds a nice accent, too.

I love this Hot Chocolate, and how great that it's from this wonderful company!  Used to be able to get this flavor at my local supermarket, but for some reason they no longer stock the chocolate hazelnut, so I'm happy to at least be able to get it online.
Best. Hot chocolate. Ever.  Seriously.  Especially if you like your chocolate with a little hazelnut mixed in.
Not much to say other than this is the best hot choclate mix I've ever tasted.  If you want any better, you're going to have to make your own from scratch.

I ordered this hazelnut chocolate mix for my wife, and the double chocolate mix for myself.  I prefer the hazelnut to the regular chocolate. It has a really delicious flavor nothing like any other mix I have tried before.

Ghiradelli does it again.  Creating a wonderful tasting hot chocolate mix with the faint taste of coffee.  This makes for a great cup any time of the day during the Winter.  I have tried many different hot chocolate flavors and this is my favorite.  A must try for cocoa/coffee lovers...

Ghirardelli makes the best hot chocolate out there. This hazelnut flavored chocolate is really great. It is very smooth once mixed thoroughly and doesn't separate as it cools like many other brands. Its flavor and consistency is very good.It also mixes really well in milkshakes!

It is a good hot cocoa mix. Some reviewers said that it is too sweet but I think you can customize the amount you put in a serving as you wish. The directions on the box said to use 4 tbsp (3 tbsp here on Amazon description). That amount looked too much to me. So I used just 3 teaspoons to get the taste I want (I should mention that I don't like too strong chocolate taste). Obviously, by adding less powder you are decreasing the sweetness as well as the chocolate taste. So if you like strong chocalate with less sweetness, this product might disappoint you.Only thing I was really disappointed about was the lack of hazelnut aroma. It was very subtle. It almost tasted like plain hot chocolate. I love hazelnut so I wish it'd be richer.  I still enjoy it.On the box it says 12 servings per box. Each box contains 16 oz (1 lb, 454 g) and you get 4 of these in this order, 4 lbs total.

I love Ghiradelli's Double chocolate hot cocoa and was excited when I saw that they have a Hazelnut flavored hot cocoa (huge Nutella fan). Unfortunately, this does not taste like Hazelnut to me at all. It almost seems like it's a fake maple flavor instead. I tried it twice and then had to give it away. Sad!

Once you've tried various Ghirardell chocolate flavors, you can't go back to the cheap stuff. I, too, don't understand stores not carrying more Ghirardelli. If they would promote and give it time to develop users, it would be a winner. It's uncommon for my wife and I to go a day without an iced, blended Ghirardelli mocha. About 12 to 16 ice cubes (in a good blender), fill to top of cubes with milk, add about 2 to 3 heaping teaspoons of mocha mix. Sometimes a little cinnamon. Mix until well blended. Add a little instant coffee if you like in a cup with just enough water and about 10 sec in the MW. Yum! We have recently discovered hazelnut iced blended mochas, adding coffee. We're hooked :-)

It's good hot chocolate, but it does taste more sugary than chocolate which is slightly disappointing given this is premium hot chocolate. There is a slight hint of hazelnut, but yeah I think it is marketing to sell sweeter hot chocolate, which is what most of the cheaper hot chocolate companies do.

This is one of several brands of higher-end hot cocoa.  I don't know that it's the best, but it's pretty good.  We have a lot more hot cocoa in the evenings when we have this stuff in the house than when we're down to the more generic instant cocoa.

I'm a big fan of hot chocolate, and this is the best mix I have tasted.  I read the other reviews and decided to give it a shot, and I was not disappointed one bit.  It got shipped to me from Amazon super quick, I love their subscribe and save program

column9: Wonderful warm hazelnut flavor; goes well with the smooth chocolate.
column10: This is a great "comfort" food and wonderful to drink while relaxing on a cold day.

I had really high hopes.  I really enjoy Ghiradelli chocolate and I love hazelnut, so I thought this was perfect for me.  But honestly, I thought it was just ok, so I was really disappointed.  I'll definitely finish it, but I wouldn't buy it again, nor would I recommend it.

I've tried tons of different K-Cups to make iced coffee. None compare to this product. If you're in the market for undaulterated iced coffee that isn't "girlie coffee" (flavored with stuff and things), you won't go wrong here!

I have used both the liquid and powder versions of Coffee-Mate non-dairy creamers.  I like them both, but the liquid version is easier to use because it blends instantly when added to coffee unlike the powder, which clumbs together and sometimes is hard to desolve.Use Coffee-Mate Liquid Non-Dairy Creamer and you will never switch to the powder version.

I have been using Coffee-Mate creamer, bought from grocery store's refrigerator section for the past 12 years. Since I was moving to Berlin, and you cannot fine it in Germany I bought 6 boxes of these and took them with me. I could not use even one, since they taste nothing like the ones you buy from the store. I was very disappointed, and will not recommend you to spend your money on this item.

The bears were sticky and not edible. I realize they were ordered during the summer season; however, I brought them immediately into my home and there should not have been an issue with humid weather. Very disappointed. I have ordered this product before and was satisfied with the quality.
Bears were soft and tasted great, would order form this site again. great price for the product. 5 lbs of bears will last a while.
Got these for my wife for christmas (thats been about 5 days ago) and they're half gone already. I guess they must be tasty.

My 13-year old ShiTzu had to be put down due to diabetic seizures...in her mid-life years, she developed a bad skin disorder (hot spots, Seboriah) and after hudreds of dollars worth of treatments, this product was the ONLY one that worked! And when I say only, I do mean ONLY!!!It did not irritate her (except for the taste - done on purpose to keep animals from licking the infected area & causing it to spread), and the alcohol-medicine smell was tolerable.When (if) I get another dog that is prone to skin disorders, the remaining 4 bottles (yes, I bought this stuff in bulk because the price does fluctuate!) will certainly be used!

My wife and I were looking for a cracker that would work with our Weight Watchers program. This one is our favorite. Large enough to handle any spread, cheese or meat. We first found these at Costco but when they ran out searched until we found them on Amazon. A great celebration when they arrived.

When i first tasted these i feel in love with them, then i notice that I could get them by the dozen which was very very good my only problem is that several of my packages had a whole in it, it wasn't that bad because it did not spoil, I would probably order again but ask that you check to make sure there aren't any whole in the opening of the package
I love Suzie's flatbreads!  I had some from another store and they quit carrying them, so I ordered them through Amazon.

I bought this thing after a recommendation from a pet store rep. My dog hardly touched the stuff, and then I looked at the ingredients: one of the first things on it was corn-a grain known to cause allergies in dogs. As a matter of fact, corn might be the most allergy-prone food amongst dogs. Not to mention, thanks to our friends at Monsanto, it is almost always Genetically modified (GMO) or a franken-food, unless it's organic. Real "premium" dog foods brag that they've no corn.Right at the top of the list of ingredients is chicken-by-products, another no-no among real "premium" dog foods. This means all the waste that it is usually thrown out from the chicken since it's not real meat. Cheap dog foods put this in their food simply because it's cheap, but it's not real meat. A little further down you will notice BHA, an artificial preservative, which again real "premium" dog foods do not have.In short, BilJac is a joke. It is basically, insanely overpriced Alpo, with no organic ingredients whatsoever, and uses all the shortcuts, filler, and chemistry that the cheapest dog foods on the market use. Don't be fooled by the old-fashioned appeal of the company's 60 years in business. There is nothing but modern chemistry in the bag, and all the folksy appeal will not make up for cheap, lousy ingredients. Calling this stuff premium dog food would be like calling a Kia a Mercedes. For nearly the same price as this overpriced Alpo, one could buy organic dog food, free of preservatives, corn, and cheap by-products!

column9: BEST DOG FOOD FOR YOUNG AND OLDER DOGS
column10: was in line at Petsmart and the man in front of me was buying Bil Jac dog food. That was about 6 years ago. I asked him about it because I had never heard of it. He happened to be a Scientist who had been on a dog food study team and said it was the best of all they rated. I have 12 toy poodles ( I use to breed them) and this dog food they all loved immediately. The best part is it is the only small kibble I have found that isn't so hard. I have tried so many of the more expensive, better brands and they always turned their noses up at it, but would eventually, reluctantly, eat it. Bil Jac crumbles more easily for these little guys. For Picky eaters as well. It works well with dogs who have teeth problems and older dogs as well as it does not hurt their teeth to break the kibble. In a pinch I have had to buy other food for them and they never like it. The other kind I had to soak in water before feeding them because it was so hard. I promise your dogs will love this food and it's so good for them too. I have always let my dogs "graze" ( I am a big believer of that) and leave food down all the time and they never over eat with this or get fat. Normal BM's too. Can't say enough good stuff about this dog food. Once your dog gets a taste of this, they will never want another brand! Oh, it is for big dogs too!

My neighbors ask me if they could try the beer I just made and they loved it. Now they want me to make this beer for July 4th.The directions were very easy to follow and the package was delivered on time. If you like smooth beer with great taste, try the nut brown ale, you will only make this beer from now on.

I'm very pleased with the results, after 2 weeks in the fermenter and 1 week bottle conditioning, this tastes good. This was my first attempt at homebrew, and it was rather easy. I am excited to see how much better it is after a few more weeks.

I just opened this nut brown after 1 week in the primary, 1 week in the secondary, and only 2 weeks in the bottle. The flavors are already deep and complex, I get chocolate, toasted nuts, and just a hint of coffee(I don't even like coffee). Very simple to brew,and it comes with great easy to follow instructions. I would brew this one again.

Easy to brew, and fun to do.  This was my first try at homebrew.  This kit turned out great.  This beer has a nice deep brown color, and perfect malt taste.  Not to bitter, with almost a coffee aroma to it.  Give it a try!

I purchased this product for my husband who has been home brewing for a few months now. Thebeer had a good color, smelled & tasted great. He proudly passed it around at a recent party and everyone loved it, a truley great lager!

column9: The best tasting vanilla bean paste out there
column10: I love this stuff. I use so much of this stuff I have to buy the 32 oz jug. It dissolves easier in fluid than just the powder. I also use their extract. Between these two products and my raw vanilla bean powder, I eat vanilla like it's a food group.I've had some other vanilla bean pastes. They were okay. This one's the bomb.

This is fantastic! It is more of a syrup than what I think of as a paste, but is easy to use, has a rich vanilla flavor, and lots of vanilla bean specks. I'll never go back to using extract. I did no purchase it from Amazon's source, so I cannot comment on the supplier aspect.

column9: as close to fresh vanilla bean as you can get
column10: I buy this by the quart, so obviously, I LOVE it!I used to use vanilla beans exclusively.  I found this through a cooking school class.  It is cheaper and easier than harvesting the seeds from vanilla beans, BUT you still get seeds in final product, and the taste is excellent--a triple win.  We now use it almost exclusively when vanilla is needed or wanted.  We've also begun spoiling ourselves by adding a bit to our coffee for vanilla latte.

Best vanilla extract product I've ever tasted.  Yes, it has sugar in it, 8 grams for a whole tablespoon, much more than you would use for a recipe.  The vanilla beans add a fantastic texture to yogurt, the flavor and aroma is amazing.  I highly recommend this product.

column9: Absolutely the BEST Madagascar Vanilla Bean Paste!
column10: I own a cupcake shop and make all of my cupcakes from scratch. My Very Vanilla cupcakes are top sellers because of the vanilla I use.There's no such thing as "plain" vanilla cupcakes when I use this product. Customers can not only see the flecks of vanilla in their cupcakes but they can taste it as well. This product doesn't "bake out" as others do. It holds it's true intense vanilla flavor throughout.I've tried many other vanilla flavorings but nothing holds a candle to this one.

I did my research before deciding to spend $30+ on a bottle of vanilla, granted a very large one. After reading all the comments, I expected the pleasant aroma of vanilla wafting from the bottle upon opening, but what I got instead was this murky, smokey smell that doesn't even remotely resemble vanilla. There is absolutely no vanilla aroma when I added it to my custards, even with additional amount. Sure, the vanilla specks are there, but what good would they do if they give nothing to the flavor of the dish? I must have gotten a bad bottle or something (is that even possible, for vanilla bean paste to go bad?). I'm quite disappointed, looks like I'll just have to stick with Costco vanilla extract from now on.
I have purchased this vanilla in a smaller quantity from a retail cooking store many times. This is a much better value and I use the vanilla in all my baking. YUM!

Most pleased with the vanilla paste (I have always used pure vanilla extract and thought there was no better, except for the vanilla pod itself).  I got four 4-oz bottles for Christmas gifts for foodies, and a 32-oz bottle for ourselves to enjoy at home!  Saw this first on the Jamie Oliver 30-minute Meals show, and finally tracked it down here.  Give it a try - you won't regret it.

I actually ordered this by mistake. It was on my list, but I meant to order the vanilla which I use all the time. I've been using this to make my usual vanilla cake extra flavorful. I love the specs of vanilla bean throughout the cake or frosting as well. I use other Nielsen-Massey extracts and I love them all.

column9: I wish I thought of it sooner.
column10: I have searched all over town recently trying to find vanilla paste.  I have purchased it in a couple of different stores previously.  No one had it.......... I use it in all my yummy receipes and they didn't taste the same without the paste.  Thank goodness, I still had a bottle in the refrigerater so I could look for some.. had I known I could buy it in bulk........... thanks.

I love to make homemade yogurt and ice cream. I have to remember that when I use vanilla past not to use the same amount as vanilla extract. This product is more concentrated and should be used in moderation for the same flavor. It is like using vanilla beans without the hassle of the bean. I love this stuff.
This is a really great product !!  It's great for cakes, filling, and frostings!  I use this for pastery cream's as well.  I love to see the vanilla bean seeds, and it taste great !

Adds great flavor to my pound cakes. I have also found that i can use less of this than the regular Vanilla  This size is very economical. The bottle has a squeeze top which makes it easy to measure the paste. Will definitely continue to purchase.
