column10: stab a hole, twist the knife some to pour a bit of the dry powder into each as you go along, do a hole about every 3/4" everywhere possible. use the rest and maybe another pack as a dry rub and bake, covered or bagged.yeah it'll be red-pink "odd looking".. oh well!its also great for marinating slabs of turkey with,and ham, baking and flipping as normal.dont take my word for it, try it!
Quite good.  I would definitely order this again.  Nice sized roe. A little soft, meaning, not a lot of "pop", but still quite good for the price.

I have used these to teach my 12 week old puppy to sit, potty in correct spot, and sit using these. I put them in a stuffable chew toy and she plays for hours. Recommended by my vet for puppies. Thanks for the affordable price and fast shipping.

These little links are great.  Very healthy and delicious. Great shelf-stable non-meat protein source!  I'm not even a vegetarian and I prefer the taste of these over meat sausages.  Amazon had the best price of anywhere.  I'm so frustrated that they are rarely available here anymore.
Man, these are great. Unreal with maple syrup and pancakes. We have enjoyed them for over 15 years.
These would be better with a lot more seasoning. I can think of several other vegan breakfast sausages that taste better.
Great vegan product.  A core in our vegetarian diet.  Hubby and I get 3 breakfasts out of one can.

I prefer the Saucettes but as they appear to be no longer available I tried these and have come to enjoy them just as much. These have a little better flavor but the Saucettes had a better texture. These taste much better than meat.

These are edible.. I bought a case of them because I liked other loma linda products.  These are bland, and remind me of soggy cornflakes. If you like soggy cornflakes I would recommend buying them.  If not, stay away.  Maybe my opinion will change after I've finished the case.  (I'm going to force myself to eat these because a case is expensive)

column9: tasty and high protein, not tough
column10: When I needed something reasonably soft but high protein due to a dental problem, these Little Links really helped me out a lot. A few could give me half my protein requirement for the day without loads of chewing. I just sliced them up and heated in a convection/toaster oven for a few minutes, so it was easy to chew them on one side of my mouth. I imagine this would be a plus for little kids as well. Try them with sliced bananas ... Really! Bananas make a good side dish for savory items.  Anyway, I'll try to always keep them in stock from now on via Subscribe & Save. Oh, they're tasty even if you don't have any chewing problems!If they're not spicey enough for you - try getting some sausage type seasoning and cook them up with that. I like them the way they are from the can, though. The advantage of not being too spicey is that you can always add spice but you can't subtract it... Many times I don't want spicey because it can trigger a cough during the wrong season.I hope Worthington never messes up the Loma Linda line by adding egg whites as it does to much of the Worthington products. It's so hard to find egg-free items of this sort, but these are egg-free and dairy-free (vegan). I'm allergic to both dairy and egg.

These are amazing.  I dont know what else to say.  I love them, my kids love them. I am a life long vegetarian and these have always been a staple at the breakfast table.  I do not like any other product but this one for veggie sausage.  GO LOMA LINDA!! YAY!Mike
I buy other Loma Linda products off Amazon that are no where near as expensive. Why are these so over-priced? I buy these at the health food store by the case for almost half the price....

column9: Yummy yummy yummy in my tummy tummy tummy
column10: I LOVE these breakfast links. I grew up eating them & have introduced them to my family, my 2 yr old LOVES them! They are healthy & delicious & a great replacement for the other breakfast links on the market.

One word to describe. Awesome.I buy these little links regularly. They are not only healthy but very very tasty as well. Precooked. Just heat and let them turn brown in a pan.(I do it in portable grill) and they are ready to eat..

I was raised a vegetarian & grew up on these breakfast links. As an adult & mother I LOVE these! My meat eating husband even likes them. They are delicious & much healthier than the other breakfast links on the market. Thank you amazon for carrying this product & making it easy for me to feed my family healthy!

column9: One of the best of the canned soymeats
column10: Granted, I grew up eating Worthington and Loma Linda products so I have a bias.  However my wife didn't taste any of the products until after our marriage a few years ago.The LL Little Links are among both her and my favorites (as well as our two boys).  As a matter of fact we had some for breakfast this a.m.We also like the Fri-Chik and Redi-burger when mixed into recipes.

column9: Eggless Vegetarian Breakfast Links from Loma Linda
column10: Another great meatless product from Loma Linda.  These links can be sauteed soft or crispy in a little oil, added to pasta dishes or eaten right out of the can in a pinch. (About 16 links in a can). Great snack for kids. A must for our eggless vegetarian pantry.

very tasty, I usually wrap them in crescent rolls & bake them to make little pigs in blanket type  hors d'oeuvres ,  they also so work well in mac'& cheese, or served on small rolls to make kids size meals.
These are yummy and good for you!  They are a bit pricey, but worth the money.  They really add flavor to dishes!  Amazon had a fantastic price, but the free shipping makes it an amazing deal!!

The first time I had Cotswold cheese was in London when I visited decades ago.  I haven't been able to find it in the United States since then, though to be honest I haven't looked hard until now.  But now that I found this cheese on Amazon I'm overjoyed.  It's the same addictively delicious taste I remember from my time in London -- and infinitely easier to purchase!The cheese is scrumptious, and was shipped very carefully with ice packs to keep it fresh.  I recommend both the Cotswold and the vendor very highly.

i was skeptical when first ordered, but when i prepared it i really liked it. the best thing for me, as a rice lover, is that I im getting much more nutrients from this rice than white rice. highly recommended.
We love this in rice pilaf, or mixed with brown rice.  We have no complaints with the taste.  As with all Bob's Red Mill products we have purchased, we are completely satisfied.
IT TASTED BAD HOW CAN I RETURN IT ONLY USED ONE OF THE PKGS. IF I CAN'T RETURN IT I WON'T BUY IN BULK AGAINSO PLEASE CALL ME
the first ingredient is apple, second pears, and THEN grapes. good substitute for grape jelly, though. tasty. will probably buy again.

column4: R. Mastromauro "Loving life as a Mom"
column10: I love these mash up s and fruit packets... My son loves the packaging and the flavor, I love the convenience and the health factor.  It is just not possible to constantly have fresh fruit on hand and for outdoor trips or playdates these are a godsend. They keep my son busy and full, when I'm out of other options...

First had this at the tea house inside Portland's Chinese Garden.  Normally prefer full-bodied toasty-flavored oolongs, but this lighter one has a complex refreshing flavor that has brightened many a gray drizzly day.  Recommend it to anyone that appreciates quality tea.

When I opened the container, the first thing I noticed were the stems mixed in with the tea leaves. By the time I had sorted through the tea, I had thrown away two hand fulls of stems. The tea itself tasted fine, but I thought I was paying for tea leaves not a bunch of stems. I will go back to ordering from Rishi Tea in the future.
Good stuff. It has a better, more natural flavor than the Kraft version in my opinion.

I was thrilled to find a way to buy Marshmallow Fluff! The stores in So. Cal. don't sell it. I have loved this since I was a little girl on the East Coast. It is far superior to the marshmallow cremes on the market. The bad thing was the cost of the shipping was outrageous and you have to buy a whole 1 dozen case to purchase on Amazon. You can go to [...] to buy smaller quantities at better prices direct from the manufacturer. The 5 star rating is for the product, not the price. Although the seller was quick on shipping.

My 5 year-old son has multiple, severe food allergies...peanuts and treenuts are biggies.  He's NEVER had peanut butter or anything with peanuts/tree nuts for that matter as he's been so allergic to things since he was about 12 months old.I found this product doing a Google search on "soy nuts".  He loves steamed edamame so I had to give this stuff a try.  I went to Shoprite last night to buy the soynut butter, gave it to my son for snack when I got home and he absolutely LOVES it!!  He's eating little SB & J sandwiches on rice crackers as I type.  (He also can't have gluten.)I bought the original creamy type.  It "sounds" like peanut butter when you break the seal, it smells just like peanut butter (honest to God!), has the same consistency of creamy peanut butter and tastes like it, too.  It has an ever so slightly different taste to it. I can't even tell you how excited I am about this stuff! I LOVE peanut butter but haven't had it in 3 years as a result of my son's allergies.  I would not hesitate for one second to put this on an english muffin with some jelly for my own breakfast.  It's delicious and a must have for little one's with peanut/tree nut allergies.

We have been eating I.M. Healthy soynut butter for almost 9 years now since my oldest son found out he had peanut allergies and I love it.  I love peanut butter also and was so happy to find something similar to give my son.  It's great by itself, in sandwiches, on apples, carrots and even baked in cookies.  It's not exactly the same taste as peanut butter, but it is just plain good in it's own right.  We love it.  You've got to give it a try if allergies are an issue for anyone in your family.

Anyone tired of peanut butter but want the same convenience will enjoy soy butter. Tried it on a whim and now order the money saving 6 pack with free shipping. Outstanding tasting product that stays fresh (doesn't require refrigeration). Easy eating. Recommend.

column9: One of the best soy butters out there
column10: As many commercial vendors (Trader Joe's, Whole Foods, etc.) stop carrying any type of soy butter at decent prices, it was great to see this available on Amazon.  Tried this for lack of any other available soy butter locally, and I am impressed.  The taste is one the best soy butters I've had, the price is competitive, and the separation factor is not so bad that it requires constant restirring like some soy butters.NOTE:  Those who are critical of the taste of any brand of soy butter and were duped into thinking the product is a "substitute" for peanut butter need to change their perspective.  Realize that if you do not like the taste of soy you will not like this any better.  But if you appreciate the unique taste and texture of soy products, you'll like I.M. Healthy as well or better than any other soy butter out there.
I cant eat peanuts.  This stuff is a great substitute.Try it. You'll like it.

column9: I.M. Healthy Soynut Butter, Original Creamy, 15-Ounce Plastic Jars (Pack of 6)
column10: I have to say I was rather scared to try this not really knowing what I was going to get but I am so glad that I took the risk and tried this product. It tastes just like peanut butter only not as sweet or rich.  I loved its mild flavor so much, it has a great texture and the smell is so inviting.  Before buying online I would check your local health food stores first, just to make sure you like it, everyone has different tastes but all I can say is I am going to use this instead of peanut butter from now on.  YUM!  The nutrition facts are off on this product though, I have the same jar at home and for 2T it has 200 calories and 14 grams of fat, so thats a little confusing but I am going to trust what is on the actualy jar then what amazon is telling me here.  FYI

column9: 5 year old peanut butter addict likes this better!
column10: My 2-year old was recently diagnosed with a peanut butter allergy.  My five year old eats pb&j almost every single day and LOVES peanut butter.  I was worried about having to make him stop eating peanut butter.  We tried a couple brand of soy butter -- one of which was really disgusting the others were so-so.  We tried this and my son says he actually likes it better than peanut butter.  I also love peanut butter and honestly can't tell the difference.  It is great!
Love all falvors!  Best to eat on sandwiches, on a spoon, with fruit, and when baking.

column9: (For some) tastes better than peanut butter
column10: My son has had children in his preschool classes for the past couple of years who have had peanut allergies, and we weren't permitted to pack lunches with peanut butter.  This product has been a very good alternative.  For me, I can take it or leave it, preferring real PB, and insofar as alternatives are concerned, I prefer cashew butter or sunflower butter.  It spreads like peanut butter, and has a stronger toasted flavor than PB.  I can't speak to the other varieties, but this one is pretty good.My son, however, requests this stuff over peanut butter when we're at home.  All.  The.  Time.  He's compartmentalized the taste as one that isn't a replacement for PB, but that is its own unique flavor.Our local grocers are raising prices to upwards of $7/bottle, so I'm very happy to see these multi-paks offered.

My girls started eating this soybutter around age 1 because i heard they should not have regular peanut butter until they where 3 due to so many peanut allergies. We have not stopped using it since. They are now 5 and rather have this than anything else. For some others it may be something to get use to, but we think it tastes great(including me) and want a healthy alternative to some of the other products on the market.

This product is nice because it has the consistency of PB and you don't have to stir the oils in.My son thinks it's great.A few of the jars I ordered were a tad bit dry, however--if not careful, the bread would tear trying to spread it.I do, however, plan to buy it again for my son who is allergic to peanuts.

column9: Lots of soy taste ; far inferior to Wowbutter
column10: We've tried several brands of soy butter when our daughter was flagged as being sensitive to peanuts. I'd pass on this soy butter in preference for Wowbutter Wowbutter (2 Pack). The I.M. Healthy has a LOT of soy taste that is unpleasant and unexpected for me, a lifelong peanut butter eater.The Wowbutter flavor profile is just a lot more similar to "real" peanute butter and is great for sandwiches. I don't know how the I.M. Healthy and Wowbutter would fare relative to each other when cooking with them.

column9: I.M. Healthy Soynut Butter Original Creamy, 15 ounce Plastic Jars
column10: Excellent product.  Good price, low cost delivery.  I switched to Soy butter because I found out PEANUTS and other NUTs make me break out with cold sores and sometime SHINGLES.  I don't eat peanut butter any more because I like the SOY better and it doesn't cause me any problems.  Try it, you'll like it!
I haven't tried any other soy butter brands. I like this brand. It is a little dry and thick, but it isn't real peanut butter. It has a good flavor. Works good on crackers and bread.

If you are looking for a substitute for peanut butter that really tastes great, do yourself a favor & try this product.  After trying several non-peanut spreads, the IM Healthy SoyNut Butter is by far the best.  It has a great mild flavor & is creamy and delicious.  My kids have become fans, even though they ARE able to eat peanut butter. You don't have to purchase the 6-pack - it is available in singles, but you'll certainly come back after the 1st jar & buy the 6-pack.

Bought this item at a local grocery store where they only sell organic stuff. My little one is allergic to peanuts, so i was on a quest to find a substitute. This is the first time I've heard that such product exist... and I LOVE IT. The consistency is dead on like peanut butter, the taste is pretty similar to peanut butter, but less nutty? By far i think this is a great alternative for those who are allergic to pb, and wants that pb&j sammie craving.

This brand has been consistently fresh, high-quality, and tasty.  My family has tried this variety, plus the unsweetened creamy and chocolate flavors.  Sugar vs. protein amounts are reasonable, so give it a try.  Usually we see this at the supermarket for ~$5.29 each, so $24-$25 per six-pack is a nice savings.

My daughter has a severe peanut, tree-nut allergy and after trying sunflower butter (very overpowering taste!) I was reluctant to experiment with another NON-peanut-butter. I'm so glad that I bought this. We all love it! Texture is the same as peanut-butter and the flavor is very similar, yet obviously not so peanut-y. Thankfully, it doesn't taste like soybeans (nothing against them but that isnt' what I think of when I'm craving the old peanut-butter!) Also, even though it's a "natural" product, we've only noticed quite a bit of seperation in just one jar. All the others (we buy these in packs of 6) are perfectly blended and stay that way. I've also used it in desserts and made some soybutter cups (think of the peanut-butter cups you can buy) using nothing but real chocolate and this soybutter and they turn out amazing! I am not a health-nut and only tried this soybutter for allergy reasons but I have to say that this stuff is good enough to eat right out of the jar!

column9: Excellent value for a product essential to a peanut-free home
column10: Due to an allergy in the family, we use soynut butter instead of peanut butter.  The I.M. Healthy brand is indeed peanut free (you'd be surprised at how many soy nut butters actually include peanuts, are processed in the same facility as peanuts, etc).  The prices the local grocery stores charge for this product individually are outrageous.  The six-pack product on Amazon is a great deal - we go through it quickly enough that we don't have to worry about it going bad, etc, when we buy in quantity.
We LOVE the IM Health soy nut butter.  It's tasty, creamy and it's difficult to purchase elsewhere -- thank you, thank you!

One of my kids is allergic to peanuts, and in his 12 years we've tried all the substitutes.  My kids greatly prefer IM Healthy over other brands of soy nut butter, or sunflower butter.  They like all the flavors equally, creamy/chunky, with or without honey, and chocolate.  I can not purchase it locally for under $5/jar so this is a good deal.  For anyone looking to sub for PB in recipes, I have tried it with mixed results.  For recipes where the PB is just a little bit of texture or thickener (chili, egg rolls) it works fine.  For recipes where the peanut flavor is integral (PB cookies, etc) it obviously falls short for those of us who enjoy the actual taste of peanut butter.  But for making a substitute for someone with allergies who has never tasted the real thing...it's perfect!

I dont have a severe allergy to peanuts, but they do cause me break out badly, and i get painful cysts on my back that take ages to go away. I gave up on peanut butter altogether about 5 years ago. I was very pleased to finally find an acceptable substitute (Thanks to my wonderful GF!). Alone, honestly, doesn't taste exactly like peanut butter (still, tastes good). But, with grape jelly, oh man, i cant even tell the difference. SB n' J sandwiches are FTW! Great stuff, I love it, thank you for making it IM Healthy! Im going to try their other flavors soon!

column9: Really good! Has a GREAT nutty taste!
column10: I bought some of this yesterday at a rather large Kroger. This morning for breakfast, I had some coffee, a bowl of cereal, and some toast with this brand of soy nut butter. It looks like peanut butter, smells like peanut butter, and even tastes like peanut butter. In fact, I think this tastes better than any garden variety peanut butter you see in the store. It has a GREAT nutty taste. And it's not overly sweet. This is a winner!

column9: Great replacement for P.Butter for school lunches
column10: I came across this product as I needed an alternative to peanut butter for my daughter in school.  She is 18 mos. old and a very picky eater.  She will only eat school (daycare) lunch 2 days out of the week so I was looking for an alternative to send to a peanut-free classroom.  From the first taste, there were no complaints or issues and she eats this on crackers, waffles and bread.  We actually switch back and forth btwn this and p.butter at home with no issues.  My 4-yr old son also has eaten the soynut butter and thinks it is p.butter.  I give this product 5 stars as a great alternative to peanut butter!!!
This product arrived sooner than expected and was significantly cheaper than anywhere else. It's a nice find having children with food allergies.

I have loved this specific brand of soynut butter for several years! I'm lucky to be able to buy it through multiple stores. Great choice for those who can't eat peanuts. Actually, who says you must eat peanut butter? No no, choose this soynut butter as your first choice.

column9: A safe, healthy, and tasty alternative to peanut butter
column10: I grew up eating peanut butter and loved it, but when my son was still a baby, we made the frightening discovery that he has a very severe peanut allergy. Needless to say, our family immediately, completely, and very happily dropped all forms of peanuts from our life.A couple of years then went by when I came across IM Healthy Soynut Butter at the supermarket. I bought a jar, figuring only that it might be nice to have this particular product among our snack food choices at home because it was so convenient and nutritious. I didn't at all, however, expect it to actually fill in as a complete substitute for how I'd enjoyed peanut butter my whole life previously -- but it has. Yes, the taste of soynut butter is different from peanut butter (Go figure...One's made from soynuts; the other, from peanuts :-D), but I can honestly say that I enjoy the taste of soynut butter equally. I now eat soynut butter the same way I'd always eaten peanut butter (in sb&j sandwiches, sb & bananas, sb & apples, sb & crackers, spoonfuls of sb right out of the jar, etc). Because my family eats it up so much, I regularly buy IM Healthy Soynut Butter as often as I used to buy peanut butter, too.It's nice to once again enjoy a nut butter and *know* that my son isn't being put at risk in the least.
My kids, ages 6 and 3 love this product.  They prefer it over peanut butter.  I gave only 4 stars because I do not like the taste of it.
I picked this product because of my wife's allergies.  She loves it.  So do I.  Exceptionally fast processing and delivery by Amazon was a bonus s well

My 2 1/2 year old has a peanut allergy and this is by far the best soy butter we have found. It has a sweet, creamy consistency like peanut butter. Since we have a nut-free home, I also eat it as a peanut butter substitute and I can say I hardly notice the difference. Buying in bulk from Amazon is also the lowest per-unit cost I have found so far (this retails at my local grocery store for about $5.79/jar).
This is a great product... healthy - and actually tastes good! My kids love it - no downside.

column9: OK PB Sub....Does not taste like PB
column10: I.M. Healthy Soy butter is a great alternative for children who have allergies or whose classmates have allergies.  Our 17 month old is in a class at daycare with another child who has nut allergies so we cannot send peanut butter.  This was a HUGE setback for us since that is our staple lunch.  After reading reviews we ordered a case of this.  We opened a jar upon delivery and it really does smell like PB.  The color is a little off, but the smell is right.  It does not separate or need to be put in the fridge, which was great.  My husband and I made a sandwich.  The initial taste is very much PB, but the finish is not.  It says with a hint of caramel, it should say a hint of broccoli.  The taste is very much vegetable.  Not bad, just vegetable.  Did the baby eat it????  Yes he eats it.  It took a few sandwiches before he got used to it, but he will eat it.  We have gone through about 3 of the 6 jars.  Do I ever make myself a Soy butter sandwich....not on your life!  So, for the undiscerning tastes of my 17 month old, he will eat it.  Do I want a sandwich...um No thanks, pass the JIF!
My son has multiple food allergies, and this is the best peanut butter alternative I have found.  The whole family eats it, and it's great to know it is made in a peanut free facility.

with all the great reviews I though maybe this would be worth a try...Well, Not so much.If your looking for something that has more of apeanut butter taste spend the extra few dollars on Sunbutter made from sunflower seeds.  my Hubby who loves real PB but gave it up after we found out our daughter is allergic to peanuts would not touch this stuff but he really enjoys Sunbutter.It's just not worth the money.

column9: Ok- does not taste like peanut butter
column10: I don't know if other people have forgotten what peanut butter tastes like, but this does not taste anything like peanut butter. This taste exactly like crushed soy nuts, which is exactly what it is.  Its not a bad product, it has the same consistency as peanut butter and looks like peanut butter, but tastes like soy nuts.  Which, by the way, do not taste like peanuts.  (soy nuts are baked soy beans if you aren't aware) It is a fairly strong soy nut taste, you can taste the soy nut taste even with jam.  I like soy nuts ok, but I think I will go back to almond butter or peanut butter.

column9: One word for I.M. Healthy SoyNut Butter: Disgusting
column10: One word for I.M. Healthy SoyNut Butter: Disgusting.  We got the honey-flavored stuff, and it was truly gross. It looks like peanut butter, but is no substitute.  It went straight in the trash.
I have tried tons of different peanut butter substitutes and this one is the best.  Great taste and texture.

My friends and I finally tried this last night, and it was a huge hit. We put it over mudslides and it was delicious! The cream tastes fantastic and at 30 proof it's strong enough to compliment your drink. It was all I could do to keep my guests from eating the cream straight after they tried it. The chocolate flavor is actually very good. I was afraid it was going to be "whipped cream with a hint of chocolate and alcohol" but it's really not! It looks like chocolate mousse almost when you serve it and the flavor is just divine. Definitely going to get more of this!

column9: My pit bull won't eat these
column10: My first review didn't show up, so am trying again. These look and feel like plastic and my pit bull that will eat anything will not eat theses. Thirty bucks lost as I had to order regular pig ears

column9: My dogs can't get enough of these.
column10: My Mastiff and beagle love these. They last longer than normal pig ears, and seem to be less fatty. Great product!
My dogs love these! They smell great and my guys will do anything for them.  The ingredients are first rate and they are perfect for treating and training (or just plain spoiling!).
Ordered these for Hallowe'en gives. I think they'll be perfect - a nice size, a unique candy, and I like the container they come in. Best of all, the price is right.

While marketing for healthy breakfast fare,I tripped across this tin of' Mc Cann's, Steel Cut, Oatmeal several years ago and decided to give it a try. I did and now I am all but addicted to it! I followed the directions to have  perfect oatmeal. It was perfect but the drawback was the 25 to 30 minutes to cook it, and to do this daily! I like mine 'al dente' so I fast cook it on high temperature until most of the water has boiled out about 10 minutes, then cover it to simmer it the remainder of the cooking time. However with this method, one has to stir the oatmeal very often while it is simmering. Then along came a friend who suggested that I make a full batch, 1 cup of this oatmeal to 4 cups of water, and put the remainder of what wasn't eaten in a covered bowl in the frig. This I did, and still do. Now I scoop out the amount I want to reheat, place it in a bowl stirring in a little water to loosen it up, microwave it for 2 minutes or less depending on the amount I am reheating, and  I have almost an instant breakfast! Since it so crunchy and so delicious all by itself ( it doesn't even taste like oatmeal!) that it really  does not need any extras!Try it and enjoy!!!

I always buy this oatmeal from Amazon. 4 cans for around $23. When I went to reorder, Amazon redirected me to another vendor. I did not notice the trap I had fallen into. I thouht I was getting 4 cans as always. I ended up getting 1 can for $17. This is a ridiculous price for one can of oatmeal !

Oatmeal gets a bad rap these days.Most people have their first experience with the quaker instant oatmeal, loaded with sugar and artificial flavoring, with the consistency of mush. After eating it, you just feel dirty for the next few hours, like you ate candy for breakfast. The rest of their lives, people never go back. John McCanns's oatmeal will convert anyone back.The flavor and consistency is everything you could ask for in a warm breakfast cereal. Once you try it, you can never go back to regular oatmeal. It's chewy and delicious, not like the quaker slime you might remember. Sure, it takes 30 minutes to cook, but after you've done it once, it's easy. I wake up, throw some water on the stove, make my coffee, drink my coffee while I wait for it to boil, throw in the oats, set the dial to 3, give it a stir, and take a shower. When I come out, breakfast is almost ready. I could understand if you don't have the extra time, but this stuff is worth it.The only thing is that this oatmeal is about 5-6 times more expensive than Steel-Cut oatmeal you can buy in bulk at the grocery store. That isn't to say that you can't taste the difference in quality, but at some point, they're both steel-cut oatmeal.So if you want the very best, go with John McCann's. I highly recommend buying a tin if it's your first time trying steel-cut, since it takes a few times to figure out how to cook it and the tin provides instruction. It also looks very cool and gives you a place to put the oats you might buy in bulk later.

Saw this product in a local grocery and was lured by the tin can and decided to try it for myself. I must say it does in fact have a nutty taste to it unlike traditional oatmeal. I found myself buying another can just days later only halfway through the first can. I am now a devoted McCann oatmeal lover!

column9: What?  All These Folks Are Right?
column10: I read the nine reviews that preceded me and wondered how a product depending on a person's taste could consistently receive five stars.  Is something suspicious here?Nope!  Here's the tenth five-star rating in a row, and I'm tough.  This is the best sauce of its kind (or any kind) I've ever had; and I'm an old guy who's been around.  Just the right sweetness, just the right hotness.  I'd love to soak a chicken in it, as well as dip egg rolls and chicken nuggets.These big bottles won't last and I'll be back for more, fer shure.  Absolutely more than worth worth the little price, this stuff should be standard in every home, along with plumbing.And my sincere apologies to those other reviewers for doubting you.

This stuff is good. My mom gave me a bottle to go with some eggrolls and we were hooked upon first dip. The perfect blend between sweet and spicy, this stuff is so yummy that even people who claim to dislike "spicy" or "Asian" or any other kind of exotic fare find it delicious!

This goes down in my Self Proclaimed Condiment Queen Nation as a "keeper" I saw it in the asian market i go to for 2.50, a huge bottle, i looked at the ingredients, no preservatives or added colors, good, good, said it went with everything, also good, got it home and WOW, its amazing! Garlic, Hot, Sweet, I am a dippin fool now.

column9: An Adventure for the American Taste Buds
column10: You can't find this flavor anywhere else in America to my knowledge, or at least not easily, and to be sure it won't appeal to everybody, but I am the type of American that prefers salty flavors to sweet. In fact, I don't like most candy because it is too sweet for me.To my surprise, the nutrition information for this product claims zero sodium. Apparently, ammonium chloride is not metabolized as sodium in the human body. So the "salt" label is a bit of a misnomer. Yes, technically ammonia chloride is a salt, but not table salt and not sodium. I guess I will find out in a couple of hours how this stuff agrees with my digestive system. But if I'm allergic to it, that's my bad, not the fault of the product. Prior to K & H's Double Salt Licorice, I tried the Diamond (Zout) salt licorice by Gerrit Verbourg, which was also yummy, so I know already I am not very allergic.I like the taste, but it's not mind-blowing. I don't feel overpowered by the saltiness at all. I can pop three in my mouth at a time and chew with no problem. However, I have learned not to chew. I recommend sucking on the tokens instead until they slowly dissolve. This way a more intense licorice flavor is achieved, and less candy sticks to one's molars.One cautionary note, this coming from my Mother, that I would like to add for all licorice aficionados like myself. Consume licorice in MODERATION. Why? No, not because of tooth decay, although that's a good reason too, this candy being gooey and sticking to teeth. Not because of the calories, although calories is a valid concern. Not even because of the ammonia chloride, although that may have certain negative effects on human digestion in large quantities... Really the chief concern is that the licorice itself, and licorice extract, interferes with the human body's absorption of potassium and also has many other complicated interactions with the body. If you like licorice, a good idea would be to add bananas to your diet as well, because bananas are cheap, delicious and rich in potassium. But do not eat large quantities every day. If you find yourself bruising easily and taking a long time to recover from bruises, your licorice habit could be the cause. Word to the wise. Everything in moderation, dontcha know?Five stars because the product was just what it said it was, was manufactured 02-2012 and doesn't expire until 2014. All in all, an excellent value considering the price, and Amazon had it on my front porch less than two days after I ordered it. Maybe there is better salt licorice for sale somewhere on the Internet, I don't know, but I know for sure there isn't cheaper licorice. Note to other reviewers: no fair dissing the product because you don't like ammonia chloride. Don't buy it if you don't know what it is.

column10: My husband and I are connoisseurs of Indian food and this is pretty good for ready to eat food in a package. Its nicely spiced, low in calories and sodium. I highly recommend this brand and the rajma in particular.

We originally found these Indian meals in a few of our local grocery stores some years ago. Unfortunately they have been growing increasingly hard to find locally. I was very happy to find them here on Amazon, and it's especially nice that they qualify for free shipping.  Our family loves them - they are spicy, but not overly, and we find them rich with flavor and quite filling. They're quick to prepare in the microwave, just 2 minutes, so they're great for an evening when we're short on time to cook (they are best served over rice or quinoa, so that does add to the prep time). They are by no means a diet meal, so we consider them a special treat from time to time. They're shelf stable and keep for months, so we keep a supply of several varieties of these Kohinoor meals in our emergency pantry for weather or other emergency use (they're fully cooked, so they can be eaten cold if necessary, and we think they're quite good that way as well).  We've even taken them on trips when renting a cabin.  I prefer the whole meal packs that include the pre-cooked rice in the package, particularly for use in our emergency pantry, but those can be even harder to find.

Con: My only problem with this is it contains 3 grams of sugar.  Low, but the natural refrigerated one I buy only has 2 grams of sugar.  In fact the only ingredient it contains is peanuts.  I find peanuts to be naturally sweet on their own so I personally don't even need the sugar. I have grown accostomed to my PB less sweet.  Believe it or not a gram of sugar is a noticeable difference.However, I realize I am probably not the norm so I understand why JIF added sugar.Due to my personal preference I took off one star for the sugar factor, but again it is just my personal opinon.  I will continue to purchase unless I find another natural no-stir type with less sugar.All in all it does taste fantastic and I praise JIF and other PB companies for removing the horrible trans fats!

I am a lover of tea, like many. Unlike many, however, I am also a lover of all things rose-flavored. It is very difficult to find a good rose tea, and even more difficult to find a rose tea that is caffeine free. This one is perfect, though. It has a lovely, authentic rose flavor and scent with all the benefits of caffeine free rooibos tea. I taste the rose more than the lavendar in this tea. If you like a floral tea, definitely worth a try.

My first impression of this tea is really good. Sometimes I get anxious or upset, and it is hard to break out of it. I started today rather agitated, and this seemed to really help. For me, chamomile and passionflower are really useful for calming nerves on occasion, so this tea is a good combo (whereas, valarian root has an opposite effect of calm for me). I like a lot of teas, but for me, the flavor and smell weren't the most appealing. But medicinally, I could tell that it was actually working and I felt quite a bit more pleasant and less stressed by mid-day, which helped me to deal with the day better. Depending upon your body, it may cause a bit of sleepiness as well. With most teas (even the other Republic of Tea blends), I use 2-3 bags during the day (often steeping twice to get the most out of each), but with this tea, I could only use 1 bag. After the first cup, I realized that refreshing my cup with a second tea bag might be a little too calming! The same things don't usually work for everyone, but if you are looking for something calming, hopefully it will help you as well... Republic of Tea seems to be good-quality tea in general, and with the number of bags, though expensive, it tends to last a while.

I would recommend the Tazo Calm tea over the RoT Get Relaxed tea. The Get Relaxed tea does help, but as someone who suffers from anxiety attacks I find that the Tazo Calm is a little more relaxing (and tastier) than the RoT counterpart. You can get the Tazo Calm on Amazon.com too.

I've tried 4 other kinds just this week. They truly do SAY what they are going to do. This one truly is so relaxing. I also recommend the Get Clean, Get Gorgeous and Get ZZZ's. I can't wait to try more of them! Spend the $10, you WILL NOT be disappointed.

I love the be well tea line that Rebublic of Tea has come out with.  Let me preface this review by saying that at first I was skeptical, but all of the teas from this line that I have tried are surprisingly true to their claims; none of them are simply a marketing gimmick.  So far, I have purchased "Get charged", "Get relaxed", and "Get Smart".  But I digress, on to "get relaxed".  This tea is somewhat calming.  If you are prone to panic attacks, then this isn't exactly a miracle tea.  Also, a lot of the relaxation I have found with OTHER calming teas comes partially from sipping on them slowly with a nice book, savoring the flavor.  However, the taste of this tea is absolutely disgusting (the only one that tastes worse is "Get smart").  BUT that is because although I love the scent of florals, I cannot stand floral flavors, and this tea is dominated by notes of rose and lavender.  I have found that I receive the most relaxation if I do take the time to sip this tea slowly (although painstaking). But usually if I have had a somewhat stressful day, I'll just go ahead and plug my nose and down this quickly and it still does calm me down a bit.  That being said, I dislike the flavor so much that I doubt I will repurchase.  In summation/final thoughts: If you like and/or don't mind floral-tasting things, then I would highly recommend this tea.  It is calming to a point, especially if you take the time to sip slowly and smell the aromas.  However, if you really don't like the taste of lavender, roses, etc, I would say this is a miss.  Also, if you have problems with severe anxiety attacks, I would recommend consulting a doctor before trying to use this in combination with or as a replacement for any sort of medication you might be taking.SIDE NOTE:  Although this has nothing to do with "get relaxed", if you are interested in trying new types from this tea line, I swear up and down by the "Get charged" tea.  I have difficulty focusing, and I've practically stopped taking my ADD medication because the tea (without caffeine!!!) helps me focus almost as well without any bad side affects (but only drink one serving if you try it--any more caused me some stomach pain/light-headedness).  I find the "get smart" tea does almost just as well, but not quite; I ALWAYS end up going for "get charged" because it tastes a million times better.  Also, with "get charged", it really is great for when you know you should go to the gym but just aren't feeling up to it--it really gives you that energy that makes you ready to get up and go!  :)***I find it important to note that my review of "get relaxed" is based upon when I have NOT had "get charged", caffeine, or ADD medication that day.  I do not like the idea of mixing "uppers" with "downers" and will only drink "get relaxed" if I have not had any stimulants and am solely anxious from environmental stressors.

I don't know why but my dogs are not interested in these treats.  They love chewing on other brands of bully sticks but not this one.  I guess they all have their favorites like people do. They don't compare to bully sticks which are meatier and tastier looking.  But who knows, your dog(s) may like them?

My darling dog is a picky eater.  We have given away a lot of snacks because she refused to eat the snack. She paused on it for a little while but she eventually chewed one.  After that, she would eat one every time we put it out for her.  She likes beefy chews and this one meets her criteria.Beefeaters Beef Twists, 5-Inch (Pack of 75 Twists) Its so nice to give her a good treat with a good price.  Of course, I would like to see the price cheaper but it is comparable in price to others and this one meets a picky eater and wins.

I have to cut down on butter so this is wonderful to use it place of it, just put on veggies the flavor is wonderful.  You won't need alot so don't let the price scare you away,  it's worth every penny.  This is much better than just balsamic it is lighter and not so intense.  Magnificent.

column9: You have got to try this!
column10: I was slightly apprehensive at the price but decided to give it a go. I was amazed at how smooth this balsamic is you could drink it straight from the bottle. I use it regularly over salad and hard cheeses and as a dipping vinegar for a fresh warm baguette. It can almost be a guilty pleasure except there is nothing to feel guilty about less the price; there are many health benefits to adding vinegar to ones diet  You have got to try this!

I purchased this item through Amazon. I read the reviews on it, and they were very positive. I tried this product once, and both my wife and I like it very much. It's nice and light, yet adds a wonderful flavor to salads or dipping bread. I highly recommend this oil.
Anyone who has just used mass market Balsamic Vinegar will be blown away by the taste difference. This makes a big improvement in everything from salads to strawberries.
I really cannot detect much of a difference between this product and the far less expensive supermarket variety of this vinegar type.

This is some of the best dark chocolate I have ever tasted! It has the perfect amount of cocoa (not too dark or bitter), and the zestiness of the lemon & ginger gives it the perfect flavor. I highly recommend this for serious chocolate lovers like myself!

This product called "Hot Cereal" came under Instant Oatmeal but I/we saw absolutely nothing that evenremotely resembled an oat.  There was no flavor despite the label and if one is supposed to feast with the eyes first, then I/we must say, without exaggeration, that it looked like pulverized cement mix with no aroma.  The taste?  Completely absent, defying any description in words.  To boot, the shipping fee is greater than the cost of what the manufacturer considers a food.

Oatmeal was very good, but it each package had very little oatmeal in it.  Sometimes I would have to use two packets to equal a normal size instant oatmeal packet.  Taste was good though, and it made you feel full.

As a stand alone cereal it is barely edible.  It is not really sweet enough and has a texture too much like malt-o-meal for my tastes.  Plus you can barely taste any fruit flavoring.  I ended up putting it on toast from Julian'a bakery (making a 5 net carb breakfast) and it pleasantly added to the toasts flavor.  I will not buy this again. If it were less than 25 cents per package I might consider it if I keep the bread around.

column9: Nutro, Natural Choice Tartar Control Biscuit, 21 oz
column10: Nutro, Natural Choice Tartar Control Biscuit, 21 oz is not the product I thought it was going to be, I was looking for Nuto's chicken, brown rice Tartar control biscuit. This product is made with Wheat.I will use these up, but will be more careful in my next order.Thank you
this is really good, very fruity. the only problem is 5 ounces is pretty small. i'd go with the 11 ounces. it's a better value.
The jam from Huckleberry Haven was delicious, and just what I ordered. We received the order within a few days, and will order again from them.
for the tummya nice treat - worth the x-tra calories every now and thenabsolutely!

This was such a fantastic buy!! I really liked them!! I had never eaten Yan Yan before, but I always wanted to try them, I'm SO glad I did!!!! They were great! Though, next time I buy them, I think I'll just buy the chocolate, the Strawberry flavored ones were good, but it felt like I was burping up soda... LOL But besides that, it was really great!

column9: The chocolate had no taste.  Greatly disappointed.
column10: I have had Gorant Chocolate in the past, and remember it to be one of the best chocolate I ever had.  But this box of chocolate had no taste.  It was greatly disappointing.
Is yet another chocolate assortment, dont get me wrong its not bad at all, its just not the best. In other words you get what you pay for.

One of the bins arrived broken and the brine had leaked all over everything else in the box.  The olives are mushy and way too salty!!! I highly recommend going with the Roland Cracked Green Olives from Greece product available via Amazon too.  Don't waste your money on the Peloponnese Cracked Green Olives!!!
I bought these for my girlfriend and she loves them. She got a large tub of olives from amazon before and thinks that the others were to salty and that the peloponnese olives are much better.

This is the best extra virgin olive oil produced! It is an unknown oil in the U.S. but now it is available through Parthenon Foods.  We used to bring it back from Greece. We use this oil for dipping, salads, etc. - anywhere where you can taste the oil.

This product is very much like heavy cream. It is great to use to add it to things to make them richer, or give them an edge above the usual. The best part is you don't have to keep the cans refridgerated, of course, only after opening. I like to use mine for making soups and in batter mixes. I plan to add some in spaghetti sauce today. It is good to add to foods that might be too hot like some prepackaged Indian foods. I love Indian and Mexican foods, but sometimes they are too spicy hot for me. This item will definitely tone that down for you. Here's the only drawback:  The fat and caloric content is high. Don't use too much of it at once. The stuff will kill you. It's great to have on hand, and it's very tasty, good to add to hot chocolate, too. I used to, sometimes, get cream, or heavy whipping cream, but I would forget about it, and it would sour in the fridge. Anyway, this product is of great convenience and I think, everyone would like having it on hand.

I own my own bakery and i am always looking for a bargain.  I purchased this product thinking i was going to get a great deal and a great product.  When i received my packages, the boxes were all messed up and when i open the first can of cream it was spoiled.  i looked at the date and i was current, but the product was spoiled. So i opened another can and the same thing, spoiled.  Are the products not check for quailty before the are sent out???  I was very upset about this!  I tried calling, but till now have not received a response.  I will never buy ediable products from here again.  Another thing is that along with the item I also purchase some other product and it was spoiled also.  So So upset!!!

My husband is Hispanic and introduced me to this "Mexican" cream. WE LOVE IT!! It is so great in many dishes...and has such a unique flavor. It is kind of cross between sour cream and  fresh heavy cream. The great thing is you don't have to refrigerate it! Don't look at the fat content...focus on the taste....tastes richer than regular cream.

I came across this product by raiding my local Japanese deli.The taste is excellent. Strawberry and chocolate flavors fit in seamlessly and complement each other. Fruit cuts the sweetness, while the chocolate eliminates the (possible) sourness. Overall flavor is creamy and pleasant.I find myself reaching into the box for the next bite size candy... until there are none left. Although less gluttonous people may not experience the same issue.

Yummy, oishi---- for serious, one of my favorite  brands of chocolate! (And I eat a LOT of chocolate.)This is over-the-top customer service, and even sent me the chocolate from Japan. I really appreciate it, and will treasure the chocolate. The meltykisses are individually wrapped, and are small, but they are truffle-lilke in their quality. Excellent!
Wish they sold this all year. It is the best strawberry I have ever had! It just melts in your mouth!

column9: Best chocolates ever! - really is a melty in your mouth kiss!
column10: They melt in your mouth and are the most devine mix of strawberry and chocolate.  The center is so soft and smooth and melds with the chocolate perfectly.  I'm addicted to these and frequently buy them for friends just to get more people addicted!

column9: THE BEST CHOCOLATE CANDY ON THE PLANET!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
column10: I have bought this candy every winter for the past 4 years. And I can tell you, i've been through quite a lot of Japanese candy as well. And by far, the MeltyKiss Strawberry is the best, best, best candy in the world! But you have to eat them ssssssllllllllooooooooowwwwwww. Or else the box will be gone in 13.4 seconds. Yeah, they're that good.

I love love love these little chocolates, but I wish they would have them allll the time. Also, if they are going to have them just at winter, why cant they have a huge stock of them...sigh. So frustrating. But am very glad I was at least able to get 3 boxes...proly will be the only ones I can get for a long time. ;P
i orderd this product once Cuz its always out of stock !!! please restock and btw this is amazing <3

This chew in the "wolf-size" lasted my 22lb dog about a minute. He easily broke the bone into large chunks and swallowed them. I would not recommend these as a long lasting treat though they are apparently tasty. Bully sticks last much longer for him and might be a good alternative to these because they are also easier to digest than rawhide treats.

I am elderly and many of my teeth are missing. I loveto munch on crackers. I,ve tried saltines but they arejust too hard and hurt my mouth. I just tried thesecrackers and they are great; not real soft but justsoft enough that I am able to have a nice soothingtreat. I thought if anyone else has the problems I have,they should give these a try(I cant find anything elseon the market that solves this problem)

column9: This batch was undercooked, but good crackers typically.
column10: I use these crackers in place of Ritz and Premium crackers which contain high fructose corn syrup in them.  This particular batch was simply way undercooked so they were pale and crumbly.  I'm waiting for the company to get back to me regarding a refund, and unfortunately it's taking quite a while.
I prefer the Dare Breton cracker but the Cabaret is a good 2nd best cracker for me.

column9: Best Cracker On The Market... Hand Down!
column10: Cabaret's are probably the most delicious cracker that I have ever sinked my teeth into. Cabaret's can be enjoyed as a delicious hors d' oeuvres or a succulent meal. This is probably the most romantic cracker hands down, as I often eat this with my beautiful girlfriend...

Not all New Mexico red chile is the same!  We real New Mexicans know that you'd want Hatch chile for the best enchiladas, Luna County chile for a pot of chile con frijoles, and real nutty, sweet Chimayo chile for the best Carne Adovada on earth.Who knows that this stuff is?  It's a passable generic but if it was the 'good stuff,' Corona Real would at least know that it's illegal to spell chile as 'chili' here in New Mexico.Sure, this stuff makes an OK recipe or molido sauce, but for a true cognoscenti, it doesn't cut it.
This has to remain, it must never leave, this is perhaps the best topping for all icey treats, five stars!!!!, :D

Everything about these treats is great.The ingredients are fantastic, grain-free, not too expensive, (although not exactly cheap), they're easy to split up but don't end up all crumbled at the end of the box. they even *smell* good! and my dog loves them.Ingredients. Lamb Meal, Tapioca, Garbanzo Bean Flour, Carrots, Pork Fat, Pumpkinseeds, Montmorillonite Clay, Natural Vegetable Flavor, Dried Egg Whites, Mint, Guar Gum, Inulin, Mixed Tocopherols with Citric Acid (a natural preservative), Rosemary Extract, Direct-Fed Microorganism(Dried Bacillus Coagulans Fermentation Product).

My 2 shelties (20 and 28 lbs) love these biscuits, I've bought them several times now. I open the bag and sometimes I smell the cinnamon... LOVE (I'd previously bought Natural Balance Sweet Potato and Fish treats and WOW those are FISHY, so the smell of the cinnamon in these Instinct treats is very nice for a change.)  But sometimes I'll get a box that smells more like the duck meal than the cinnamon.  In the box, these Instinct treats are in a resealable bag to keep them fresh after you've opened the bag, but I always transfer treats into a doggie cookie jar.So you know the size, each Instinct biscuit treat is 2 inches long, about 3/8" thick, and 3/4" wide at the narrowest part of the bone shape and 1" wide at the widest part of the bone shape. 25 calories per treat. These Instinct treats are sized so they'll fit into treat puzzle toys - like the medium size Premier Busy Buddy Squirrel Dude toys I have for my shelties. I'll put one or two of these Instinct "cookies" in each of the furry kids' Squirrel Dude toys and they'll be busy for 30 minutes trying to get every last crumb out.  For giving as a reward when they come inside when I call them, I break one of these biscuits in half and give half to each sheltie.  Most the treats were intact in the boxes I received, only a handful of biscuits were broken.To sum it up, they're Made in the USA, they're gluten free and they're priced great! Fantastic for my boy sheltie who can't have gluten because of epilepsy.

Agree with the other reviewer, everything about these treats is great.The ingredients are fantastic, not too expensive, (although not exactly cheap), they're easy to split up but don't end up all crumbled at the end of the box. they even *smell* good! and my dog loves them.Ingredients. Duck Meal, Tapioca, Garbanzo Bean Flour, Sweet Potatoes, Pork Fat, Pumpkinseeds, Montmorillonite Clay, Natural Vegetable Flavor, Dried Egg Whites, Cinnamon, Guar Gum, Inulin, Mixed Tocopherols with Citric Acid (a natural preservative), Rosemary Extract, Direct-Fed Microorganism (Dried Bacillus Coagulans Fermentation Product).

We recently adopted a wire fox terrier and I was concerned about possible allergies.I did some research, and wanted to try some grain-free treats as well as dog food.These smell great and our dog loves them too. They are more pricey then some treats, but the quality and grain-free make for lower vet bills hopefully.

I love these treats, everything about them is good. The ingredients are fantastic, not too expensive, (although not exactly cheap), they're easy to split up but don't end up all crumbled at the end of the box. they even *smell* good! and my dog loves them. 11 oz is a good size.I've tried 3 of the 4 flavors, far as I can tell he likes them all equally.oh, and the reviewer below giving a warning, they are incorrect, garlic is toxic in concentrated amounts, not in a daily treat at the bottom of the ingredient list. If you fed enough of these treats for the garlic to be an issue, garlic would be the least of your problems. lol.

column9: 5 Star Rated Dog Treat by Trusted Websites!!!
column10: I am not sure where the previous reviewer got their information, but if you do actual research, on actual websites (some you have to subscribe to), Nature's Variety is a 5 star dog food - INCLUDING the Instinct treats.  This is why I feed NV food and treats to my purebread dog and cat.  I would much rather feed my pet human grade food that is made as nature intended animals to eat...it's worth every extra penny I spend.Here is an excerpt from Petsumerreport.com, which is one of the websites that gave this treat 5 stars:  "Plus: The Nature's Variety representative told me the ingredients are human quality/grade. This food contains friendly bacteria (benefits the intestinal system and in turn the immune system of the pet); included in Guaranteed Analysis (company guarantees viable bacteria).  Minus: Contains Garlic - controversial ingredient."While they did mention the use of garlic, the product was still rated 5 stars, and my dog has NEVER gotten sick off these biscuits (I only give him NV biscuits).  They smell like actual food and have a nice consistency - not "cardboard" like some pet treats made of ingredients you don't even recognize.  You can easily break each treat into 3-4 pieces if using for training purposes.I feel the product should actually be used by the reviewer in order to make a credible review of the product.  I HIGHLY RECOMMEND THIS PRODUCT AND ALL NATURE'S VARIETY PRODUCTS, based on ACTUAL use!!!!!  Give them a try, your dog will thank you :-)

We're careful about what we feed our dogs so it was nice to find a grain free treat that they really love.  We've also gotten the lamb and mint version and they loved that too.  It's also great that this is on subscribe and save so we never run out of treats that have our dogs running into their kennels for their "kennel treats"!

The biscuits seemed to be of good quality, the dogs loved them. The delivery was timely. I subscribed to this product, receiving it every month until I cancelled. The problem with the biscuits was that many were broken. At least one half of each box was broken or crumbled biscuits. The only boxes that weren't broken were the ones delivered a few days after I cancelled. Had they been delivered in good condition, I would have continued to buy these biscuits, but they were not in the condition they should have been.

My Akita loves the Instinct Grain-Free Duck Meal, Sweet Potato and Cinnamon dog biscuits for what it is.  Tastee, smells good, and solidly made with all the natural incredients as discribed in the package and by other reveiewers.My dog is real finicky about her treats and would not touch the expensive brands I bought before. We tried Natural Balance Duck, sweet potato combintation for 2 years, but those biscuits got smaller and crumble easily. I switched over to Natures Instinct for past year & half, and she loves them, BEGS for them.  I knew I found a winner.  Then, knowing I could get these combo-packs online at a good price, sealed the deal for me(us). I just completed my third 2-2combo order with this seller.  They shipment arrives on time, no problems with the product (sealed fresh and way under the indicated expiration date).If you have a finicky dog, get this product.  If you don't have a finicky dog, get this product anyway.
My dog Alli Ray loves these treats -- An awesome price for a grain-free treat that is actually healthy for her and NOT made in China!

These dog biscuits are just the right size for a dog treat and my dogs love them.  I feel good that they have healthy ingredients and are grain free.  My only complaint after ordering several boxes and several orders, is that sometimes the biscuits arrive in the box whole and unbroken, and sometimes they arrive totally broken up into little pieces.  If another shipment arrives in broken up little pieces, then I probably won't order them again.
My dog loves all food but especially these biscuits! He has a wheat sensitivity/allergy so it is hard to find biscuits for him. I also feed him the instinct kibble.

column9: Yummy grain free biscuit that's priced great
column10: My 2 shelties (25 and 30 lbs) love these biscuits.  I open the bag and smell the cinnamon... LOVE.  (I'd previously bought Natural Balance Sweet Potato and Fish treats and WOW those are FISHY, so the smell of the cinnamon in these Instinct treats is very nice for a change.)
