The only reason I did not give it five stars is because the treats are smaller than what my seventy-five pound fur baby is used to. She loves them though, and I love the smell! You can tell they are quality just by the scent alone. They smell like cinnamon and sweet potato! I love the fect that they came with three boxes as well. We are going grain free with our baby so these treats are just what we were looking for ingredient wise.
Did research and 2 out of 3 sites warned the following:There are some ingredients including raisins, chocolate, grapes and garlic that can be toxic to dogs.

My husband and I are coffee drinkers from way back. We pride ourselves on having good taste, as well as an eye for price for the pocketbook, We have found a coffee that is wonderful to drink, especially in the evening, and easy on the pocketbook. That coffee is Folgers Chocolate Silk and we purchase it 6 cans at a time, or more if they have it available.I never want to run out of this flavor. It is hearty, bold and sensuous. I have never tasted a coffee so smooth as this one and once you try it you'll be hooked. If you love flavored coffee, and chocolate, this is your coffee, you'll be thrilled.

column9: Folger Coffee was Cheaper on Amazon
column10: I normally order coffee directly from Smucker's (owner of Folgers Coffee).  Amazon was much cheaper and arrived sooner than ordering from the factory!  I saved about $13 for a six pack of coffee.  The coffee was fresh and in good order.
First of all, the price of this for 6 cans is an excellent deal. The chocolate taste isn't as strong as their gourmet chocolate truffle coffee, but this is still great.
This coffee is just excelent and I always have trouble finding it in the stores.  This was so easy and painless.  I will order again when my stock is depleated.  Thanks for the quick mailing.
This is the only chocolate flavored coffee that tastes like chocolate!  I mix it with half regular coffee and it's AWESOME!
I've tried the several Folger flavored coffees. This one is my favorite.
We think Folgers Chocolate silk is the best...we have it every morning...it is mild, smooth and starts your day off great !!!Folgers Flavors Chocolate Silk Ground Coffee, 11.5-Ounces Tubs (Pack of 6)

I love this coffee, but I am having trouble finding in the stores lately.  This smells fantastic while brewing and is not overpowering to the taste.  The coffee is rich and flavorful with just a hint of chocolate.  Only thing that would make this better would be if they sold it in K-cups.

I bought this for something new to try at work, as me and my coworkers usually take turns bringing in coffee and they don't mind trying something new now and then. First, after making it, the whole office smelled of burnt chocolate and coffee. The smell was really nauseating. Most of my coworkers were brave enough to try it out despite the smell, and none of us enjoyed it. To me it tasted like hot water and a hint of burnt chocolate. Pretty much no coffee taste. Out of the 7 or 8 of my coworkers who tried it, I could not find one person who enjoyed it. I could not even give this coffee away, ended up tossing the whole canister. I definitely do not recommend this.

I love this coffee. Even though it is not "gourmet" it has a pleasing taste that is unique.In February I was pleased to see it offered in a six pack at a cost of just over $28 with free shipping, fulfilled by Amazon.Today it is being offered by a marketplace seller at a cost of $54.95, with additional shipping at $9.68!Seriously, who would pay that?They would be better off selling whatever it is that they have been smoking at that outrageous price...

column9: Real good for after dinner coffee
column10: I find this a good coffee for after dinner. I do like a sweet coffee, and this meets all I was looking for. I do hope Amazon keeps selling this. This is the best Chocolate Coffee that I've tasted in a very long time. I will buy this again.

Have been buying this flavored coffee for many years and the past two years ordering from Amazon because we can't find it locally in Western New York.  The last two shipments tasted awful and we wonder just what Smuckers has done to this once great flavored coffee.  The last pot tasted like motor oil and gave us an upset stomach.  Sorry, we won't be buying this anymore, we'll find some new flavor in the supermarket instead.  What is happening to our food?  We had to dispose of all six cans.......what a waste of precious coffee.

After reading all of the favorable review of this product, I decided to order it. My wife and I brewed a pot of the coffee this morning. It was terrible! It taste artificial and leaves a bad aftertaste that is hard to get rid of. This coffee taste NOTHING like mocha. Very disappointing.
This coffee is so good. has the whole house smelling like chocolate and coffee..The flavors fuse together and its so gourmet. I love it. and you will too..
use to buy this stuff all the time at walmart, but they don't sell it anymore. Thank god I found it on amazon. Love this stuff!!!!
Very pleased with purchase, thank you! Hope price of coffee has fallen by the time I place my next order!

I am accustom to a more bold flavor. This is the smallest can and you cost per potis slot more expensive.  Has a wonderfull aroma when brewing! Not much of a chocolate flavor.  Was expecting better, but is not bad by any means.  I will just not be reordering.

that is what my wife said when the first shipment arrived. chocoate being her favorite flavore in coffee is the reason i opted for the auto ship. can't go wrong with something she likes!! besides, it is a lot more economical than in our local market.win-win

Folgers - "Chocolate Silk"When I was able to stop smoking, years ago, I stopped drinking coffee because the two were associated for me. After years of avoiding coffee I was intrigued when seeing the combination of chocolate and coffee and bought and tried some.Now, I have it delivered regularly by Amazon because the smell of the chocolate and coffee brewing in the morning is marvelous. I've tried some French Vanilla cream in it but the flavor of the coffee stands out. It is great, alone or with someone!

column9: Wishing it was more available . . . too delicious to go without!
column10: Nice change from the bitter taste of some coffee . . . it's not for everyone's palette but it is made for me and my beau.  Instead of cream, I use Silk Choc. Soy Milk as a creamer.  Perfect blend.

I love this coffee! I used to be able to buy it in the store, but for the last 6 months or so this flavor has not been available at any of the stores. I bring it to the office, and everyone here really enjoys even walking by the lunchroom, as the chocolate aroma is delicious.

I have found most chocolate flavored coffee to be bitter, but this coffee is not. I don't notice much chocolate flavor in it, but I do like it. And as always, Amazon kept track of its delivery and helped me discover an error in delivery as to my local post office!
Chocolate lovers, first thing in the morning get your fix with Folgers Chocolate Silk. Its great with Splenda and a little half & half, or mysometimes favorite (Coffee Mate-Creamey Chocolate)

This has to be the best coffee I've tasted in a long time.  I was paying twice as much for a different brand that didn't have anywhere near as nice a flavor as Folger's Chocolate Silk.  As a matter of fact, I almost didn't buy the Folger's because the price was so much lower than some other flavored coffees.  I'm glad I put my coffee-snob attitude aside long enough to try it.

column9: My favorite coffee of all time!
column10: This is simply the best coffee I have ever had!It has saved me a fortune not going to Starbucks!

Tastes like watered down cheap hot choclate with instant coffee thrown in.  Tossed it down the sink.  Now I have 5 unopened tubs and 1 with one pot made out of it.  Very dissapointed I really like the french vanilla.  This is very sub-par.  Wish we could return grocery items.
I like Folgers coffee, I like chocolate.  How bad could this be?  Turns out very bad.  An overwhelming flavor of cheap hot chocolate drowns out whatever coffee flavor there is.

My 20 month old son loves this juice.  He drinks about 4 a day when I put it into his sippy cup with equal parts organic whole milk.  He likes it best alone but it is a good way for me to get him to drink more of his milk which has DHA in it.  The only thing I don't like about it is they don't make a big jug of it.  These are great for the diaper bag though.

My 9 month old little boy loves this yogurt juice.  He has one a day as a snack bottle.  I like it because it's convenient and more nutritious than just juice alone.  The bottles are small, 4 ounces, but that's perfect for my little guy for snack time.
My daughter has been drinking these since about 10 months old, she's 14 months old and still loves them at snack time.  Healthy and delicious and they are a great addition to her menu.

After my daughter turned one she lost interest in nursing and she refused whole milk.  I saw Gerber Yogurt juice and decided to give it a try.  The first time I gave it to my picky daughter she wasn't sure about it; but then she began to love it.  I soon began diluting a 4 oz bottle with whole milk.  Now, a 4 oz bottle will last us 2 days because I barely add any to her sippy of whole milk, just enough to give it the flavor of the juice.  I am glad that amazon sells this in bulk because we have really gone through the yogurt juice since my daughter turned one.  Now that my stock is about up in the cabinet I am going to try to give her plain whole milk.  I am glad that I found this juice to get her to drink something.

I was looking for an alternative to fruit juice for my son as a treat. I bought some of these for him to try. He's 10 months old and totally inhaled them. Problem is, I can't find them locally--I have to get them on Amazon!

column9: Best Swiss Choclate Bar in the World
column10: Best Swiss Choclate Bar in the World!  I can not live without.  Smoothest, tastiest chocolate in a regular bar form.

seriously, i was a bit skeptical about how good they would be since i was unsure if the gummys would be off brand or the real sour patch ones, and i couldnt tell either way. they were super delicious, and the package came in about a week earlier than it was scheduled. i will deff be repurchasing this again when mine run out.

I'm from Holland and have never gotten used to drinking the watered down, light coffees. So was happy to find the Senseo machine and was used to drinking the Senseo Hazelnut pods until they stopped smelling and tasting like hazelnut. I used to subscribe to get the lower price so either I received several bad batches (several boxes of 6 packages) or the Senseo coffee just isn't what it used to be. So, tried the Baronet and I'm hooked. The aroma that comes from the bag as soon as I open it: wonderfully hazel-nutty and the taste is excellent. Changed my subscription to Baronet.

We buy this coffee all the time! we used to use the Senseo pods, but these are a far better quality of coffee, stronger and the price is better!I have switched over to ONLY Baronet brand anymore... I buy the hazelnut, the cinnamon, the french vanilla and the only one I did not like was the Almond.The super pods are great! I only need ONE for a full cup of coffee in my Senseo machine! I love this brand and highly recommend it to anyone who likes really strong coffee in their senseo machine!

column9: Baronet doesn't take the place of Senseo
column10: Being addicted to Senseo Vienna Waltz Hazelnut Coffee, I've been desperate to find a replacement since Sara Lee decided not to continue making it.  I was delighted to find Baronet Hazelnut Medium Roast on Amazon and ordered some immediately.  The first cup I made was the most bitter coffee I'd tasted in years.  I made another cup today using the 2-pod holder and the coffee was less bitter, but definitely doesn't taste nearly as good as Senseo.  I'm hoping they'll bring back Senseo Vienna soon so I won't have to give up drinking coffee!

I thought I would try this other coffee pod. I usually buy Senseo Hazelnut. I was very disapointed in these pods. When I opened the package many of the pods had fallen apart. I had bought 3 packages and all of them were messy and coffee falling out of pods. Waiting for Senseo Haselhut to come back. I will by them instead. The old saying. You get what you pay for !!

I love my Senseo coffee one cup brewer and when I could not find the pods to brew my perfect cup of coffee I was really concerned. My husband found these and we ordered them. They are delicious and I was very pleased with the quality of my one cup of coffee that I drink.
Was looking for a brand other than sense and came across Baronet, could not be more pleased.  Great flavor, rich and tasty each and every time.  Will reorder again that is for sure.
This coffee taste terrible and smells terrible. Does not taste or smell nothing like hazelnut. AWFUL! I wanted to give it a 0 star rating but have no choice but to give it a 1 star rating. TERRIBLE!

Received this order today and used a pepper and garlic clove in my pasta sauce to add a new flavor. The peppers are well roasted, seeded and skinned, with a few garlic cloves in olive oil.  Looks like whole peppers since the one I pulled out of the jar was whole, it looks like the others in the jar are whole, also. This is Made In PERU.  If you want to add a nice flavor and surprise, add a little of this to your tuna, salmon, potato or macaroni salads.  It added another dimension to my pasta sauce along with 'Polar anchovies' and 'Chicken of the Sea chopped clams', it didn't taste fishy at all, just gave it an upscale nuance.  A bit pricey but I can get about 3 uses from this size jar.  Will purchase again.

These jars of roasted red peppers are absolutely the best brand I've ever tried, and I've had at least 5 different brands over the years.  The peppers are firm, not mushy like so many other brands, the inside of each pepper is amazingly clean and there are very few charred spots on the outside.There is just enough olive oil to make these peppers perfect for salads as well as in cooked dishes and the garlic definitely does not overwhelm the flavor. We use roasted red peppers in place of tomatoes in tuna salad, veggie salads, soups, stews, chili, etc. and these peppers add not only color but extra flavor and texture that are lacking in other brands.......plus being in glass rather than in cans means you do not have to worry about the BPA that is in most can liners.I had a case of these DeLallo peppers with garlic and oil a couple years ago and was delighted to find them on Amazon again.  They cost more than a lot of other brands but are worth every penny.  I can't remember the country of origin of the last case, but these are from Peru and according to the web site whatsonmyfood.org, imported vegetables (and fruit) have MUCH lower pesticide residues on them than the same products from the USA, which is good news if you care about eating healthy food.The packaging was superb, with an extra heavy box stuffed with foam peanuts, and the product arrived in perfect condition.  This is Amazon at its best!

This is an unusual and amazing tasting jam.  I love the pear with vanilla overtones.  Great on toast and my wife loves it for an unusual PB and J.  The only issue is that the supplier doesn't have anymore and doesn't know when they will get more.  If they had a case of it, I would buy it all- it's that great.

Ordered these as cake toppers for individual slices on a sheet cake.  They arrived very well packaged and not one of the 70 was broken.  They were very well make, seemed airbrushed, and they were a hit.

The sticky rice is perfect, just microwave it in the container it comes in for 2 min.  The paper thin wraps are very small and it is a bit difficult to roll.  The result is a bit of a mess but tastes great.  I put a small amount of crab meat next to the rice.  Each pack comes with 10 wraps, a container of rice, and one soy sauce pack.  The calorie count is 340.  But with 1/2 it is a reasonable 170 and is enough for a lunch.  I bought it when it was a gold box item for $10.  It is worth that, but I will not purchase again for a higher price.  Overall it is easy to make, tastes great and is a great option to have around since it does not require any refrigeration.

My kids love this meal! It's easy for them to cook - just pop it in the microwave (caution rice is hot!) - and they then have fun rolling up the rice in the small nori sheets. A healthy, simple, tasty and fun lunch.

This is the best stuff ever! My attempts at sushi rice at home failed, never sticky, not seasoned right, etc.. This takes that step out, and with the just a few more things (california rolls-avacado,cucumber, crab) you have perfect sushi. The nori is also cut-up into easy to manage strips. The only thing that I thought was included, or at least should be, is a little spoon or paddle to scoop the rice.

The rice turns out excellent, which is quite a surprise considering how easy it is to make.  Granted it is very sticky, but they do call it sticky rice now don't they?  Throw some cucumber or something else in, and you have sushi.  For best results, spring for some real nori, such as Eden Sushi Nori, Toasted Sea Vegetable, 0.6-Ounce Packets  (Pack of 6), as what's included are small strips of very thin seaweed.

I grew up in the military and when we lived in Germany, my babysitter was Asian.  She used to make sticky rice for us and serve it with seseame toasted seaweed.  We would place some of the rice in the seaweed and eat.  It was great!  I saw these wraps in the store today and decided to try them....I loved it.  It took me right back to Germany.  The sticky rice turned out fabulous...especially coming from a microwave.  I loved it and plan on buying many more kits.

column9: the best meal on the go!
column10: I was a little skeptical about this, after many bad microwavable rice meal experiences, but this was really good!  The rice is very tasty, the wrappers are delicious.  Since I've started taking college courses on top of my regular work week, I've tried a lot of refridgeration-free microwave meals, and these are the best yet.  Planning on keeping them at home, work, and in my backpack.

I bought these because they were rated so well.  Our family loves them, especially my 6 and 9 year old daughters.  I just heat up the rice and they take it from there.  I've cut-up some vegetables to add some variety to them.  I recently bought my second case and bought 2 extra cases to bring to friends over the summer.  If you like sushi rolls, give them a try.

As soon as I tried this for the first time, I promptly ordered three more cases. The rice is exactly like that in sushi bars - and this is coming from someone who spent many years living in Japan. Not sure why others feel it needs to be seasoned more. The nori sheets are small but I ended up cutting them lengthwise and using them to wrap around a larger portion of rice and my additive of choice (in this case tamago). These kits couldn't be easier to use and anyone, including teens and kids, can do it. Yes, you can assemble your own ingredients separately to make sushi, but for those of us that don't have the time or inclination, these kits are awesome. My only comment is that each kit is supposed to serve two people but realistically it is a meal for one.

I bought this sushi making package with a lot of hesitation. How could this really be good?  I am happy to report that I still don't know how but that it is really good.This package contains a bowl of sushi rice (for microwave use only) that's ready in 1 minute.  The rice tastes good straight out of the bowl and there is plenty of it so no need to skimp. You need to provide any additional filling and the wrappers stick to themselves easily.  They also include a packet of seasoned soy sauce.  No other condiments were provided.  A bonus is that it does not need refrigeration and is great in a clutch for a light meal.Although it is not a complete package (excludes fillings), adding your own food to the sushi rolls is what makes this kit a true gem.  My picky kids can add anything they like to make their own personalized sushi rolls.  They also love helping!  It's a great way to sneak in some veggies (cucumbers & carrots) too.The only problem I had with this sushi roll kit was the length of the wrappers; they are a little too big to be bite size, especially for the younger crowd.  It's minor compared to the rest but it's good to know exactly what you are getting before buying.

I had purchased these at Walmart before and loved them. But when I used the first one the rice was quite a bit dryer then the walmart purchase. I don't know whether since they were bought in bulk they sat in a warehouse or what happened. I probably won't purchase them this way again. Sorry.

column4: ChibiNeko "Sooo many books, so little time!"
column9: Great for having sushi on the go
column10: I skeptically purchased this kit at my local grocery store. I was curious since I loved sushi, but I figured that it would end up being a bland & unpalatable mess that I would regret having spent money on. When I made it I was pleasantly surprised. The rice came out incredibly well, especially for microwave rice. (If I were to serve it to someone out of the package they probably would not be able to tell it was microwaved.) The seaweed is seasoned, which is good because it would otherwise had ended up as a rather bland dish. The soy sauce is ok. I can't really tell the difference between the packet it came with & soy sauce in a bottle.My only complaints would be that the seaweed strips are too thin to roll anything decently. I know that they are supposed to be thin, but they are not supposed to have little holes in them because the factory tried to use as little seaweed as possible to make the nori. It's still rollable & enjoyable, but you will need to use a little bit of caution in making it. My other concern would be that the soy sauce is the only condiment offered. It would be nice to have a tiny packet of wasabi to go with it.Ultimately I will buy this again & often. It is fun to make & yummy to eat!

column9: Fantastic taste, but a little messy
column10: We were really surprised at how good the sushi wraps tasted.  They tasted just like the ones we get at the local sushi bar.  The only problem is being able to roll them like they do in the restaurants.  The sticky rice is REALLY sticky, so it's a little hard to spread on the small pre-cut seaweed paper and roll up.  However, if you can get past that, you will love the taste and the fact it only takes about 5 minutes to prepare.
Annie Chun's Rice Express Sushi Wraps and Rice Bowl is a wonderful product, tastes great, and the most of all, the kids love it!

This is the best home style sushi kit. You get the basics, excellent rice, sushi wrap sheets, & soy sauce.  I made these & added thin sliced cucumber & smoked salmon in the rolls as I assembled them.  The best!!!!  The possibilities are endless!!!!  Try it & you'll see.  Sometime I can be all thumbs, but this was very easy & the quality of the food was excellent.

column9: Yummy ! if not actually sushi rice
column10: Quite tasty! No  flavorings in the rice but still a very nice light lunch. Can be a bit messy for those of us who are not skilled sushi roll wrappers. I have been making this a regular part of my pantry. My kids love it  and it is easy to add seasoned vinegar if we want traditionally flavored sushi rice. The seaweed wrappers are small and occasionally have a few holes but are quite good. This company also sells small bowls of the sticky rice alone  if you don't want the seaweed and soy sauce.  both are great and very easy to prepare.

column9: Sushi for the Rest of Us
column10: Easy to eat, these sushi wraps are a delight. They are natural with no preservatives and don't you know, healthy is now. They contain white rice, seaweed wraps, and soy sauce for a great combination. Anyone could go for these. I always feel like having them. They're just a delight. Have them whenever you want as they come ready to eat, in an 8.1 ounce package. Take a different kind of cuisine home with you, try for something knew. You won't be disappointed.

column9: No easier than regular sushi, just more packaging
column10: I suppose if you're really on the go and feel like packing all your sushi innards and taking them to work is easy, this could be helpful...  But the tiny seaweed paper trips were too small, and it really didn't feel like it was much easier than just doing regular sushi.  There is a lot of packaging for all the little pieces.I can see how it could be fun for a bunch of little kids to make a mess, but not for two adults to sit down and have a meal together.

This is a great product.  So easy a kid can make it, and it needs no refridgeration.The rice tastes wonderful, and its good for you!  I only have one warning - get more nori.  You only get a packet of tiny strips, and there isn't enough to go with all the rice.  I didn't like the nori quality either.  It was very thin and had lots of holes in it.  It tastes fine, but looks low grade.  We buy an extra pack of nori sheets with them now, and problem solved. Perfect for those late night sushi cravings!

I love eating sushi, but ordering from my local sushi place is just too expensive! Also, I'm a vegetarian, so it's hard to find places with a plethora of options, other than the standard avo-cucumber rolls. I decided I wanted to try my hand at making my own sushi, but I was a little nervous about buying the right type of rice, nori, inside ingredients and wasn't sure I wanted to buy a full out kit if I wasn't going to use it very often. I decided this would be a good product that would be that intermediate step - not doing all the work myself, but trying it out nonetheless.Pros:- You can put whatever you'd like inside (I like sweet potato or banana rolls myself!).- Easy to make! Just pop the rice bowl in the microwave, spread some rice on the nori, throw a couple ingredients inside, and you're good to go.- You don't have to have just one type of sushi! I'd rather have 10 pieces, each with slightly different contents than 8 pieces that are exactly the same. This allows me to do such.- Easy to bring for work, and like an earlier reviewer mentioned, a fun conversation starter at lunch! Just chop up a couple veggies, throw them in a zip-lock and ta-da, lunch!Cons- No wasabi. This isn't a big deal for me, as I like my sushi rolls condiment free, but my partner likes his sushi doused in soy sauce and wasabi. It does come with a little soy sauce packet, but that's it.- It's not so much a "roll" as a little packet that you delicately have to put together, then shove in your mouth as quickly as possible to prevent it from falling apart. This may be my own ineptness, but I find it a bit tricky to keep together.- I'm not sure you can make inside out rolls (rice on the outside) with this kit. I don't always love the taste of seaweed, but putting a bit of rice on the outside of my "packet" and putting that side in my mouth first works a little.Overall, this is a fun lunch. It's a good size for one person, or for two to share alongside a more substantial meal :]

I'm obsessed with sushi... LOVE it.  These do-it-yourself wraps have that sushi flavor I need - and you can put whatever fillings you want inside.  I made my own California rolls and they were amazing.

My kids(3 & 4 years old) just got finished having this for lunch, and can I say it was an instant hit!  They loved rolling their own sushi.  I had a few rolls too, and it was very tasty.  I ordered this on a whim when it was a "Gold Box" special, and I am so glad I did!

column9: Sushi Making One Bite At A Time
column10: I purchased this product (3 packs) to make Sushi for our family of four.  The Nori or Seaweed Wrap is very small, a little less than 2" x 4" which makes it very hard to make a simple California Roll with crab, cucumber, and avocado.  Once rolled it wasn't quite big enough to cut, but also made a much bigger single piece of sushi.  The sticky rice was exremely sticky and we had more rice than what the 10 sheets of Nori could take.  Don't recommend for family dining unless your family is looking for a snack and some sticky fun, however, may be perfect for the single person with time to play or only likes a single item in their sushi.  I'll buy the bigger sheets for sushi next time...

The rice is wonderful and the seasoned seaweed is great.  When I get home from work I put this in the microwave and in 2min I have great sticky rice.  usually eat something with it like fish or chicken.

This product is AMAZING!  My daughter and I split this package as a fun make it yourself lunch!  I didn't even get to the chicken I had planned to put in this!  I used cucumbers and a broccoli slaw mixture.  They were messy but SO good.  Highly recomend.  The removal of the MSG is an awesome thing!  Thanks Annie Chun's.

Our area grocery stores stopped carrying these, and thank goodness Amazon has them, because I have been craving them like crazy. The kit comes with mini sushi wraps, which at a few inches long and a couple of inches wide are a little small but very delicious. The kit also comes with a little bowl of sticky rice which microwaves in a minute and tastes heavenly. The rice bowl is just enough to cover all of the included sushi wraps well. There is also a little packet of soy sauce that is quite tasty. I go to my local grocery store and get some ordinary imitation crab sticks and an avocado, slice them up, then throw them on the mini nori strips with about a teaspoon of the rice. My finicky family loves these kits too. I just ordered six and I don't think they're going to last long in this house! The kit is soooo much cheaper (and, in our area, tastes better) than going out to a sushi bar. Just be sure that the rice is cooled down before you try to make the rolls or you will burn your fingers and the nori will fall apart.

My family loves sushi. These little kits seemed like a nifty solution to the problem of not having any sushi restaurants nearby. The rice, soy sauce and nori wrappers are all excellent quality and very tasty. The reason I cannot give this product five stars is due to the tiny nori sheet issue. The nori sheets you get with this kit are stupidly small. It's near impossible to make a decent roll with a single nori sheet. I have been 'gluing' a few nori sheets together with a little water on the edge of each sheet, width-wise, to create a better size roll. My whole family love this product, and will continue to use it. It's the easiest way I've found to make great tasting sushi without much fuss. I'd really love to see Annie Chun's come out with a sushi kit that has larger nori sheets, but until that happens this kit is a nice stop-gap for when you want a quick, fuss-free sushi snack.
I am so glad I took a chance I buying this. It was super easy to make. Gret to have when you need that craving fixed bt do not want to spend big bucks to get it.
The item is perfect for the first time sushi maker.  It was extremely easy to use but I would suggest purchasing a sushi mat for rolling.
My children love these wraps!  This is by far the lowest price I have seen for them too.  I scramble some egg for the filling and this is a very easy quick dinner.

I bought this product in June and my children and I love it very much! It is so easy and fun to make that, although it isnt what I would call cheap-I do enjoy being able to order from time to time.When I last ordered this product from Amazon, the shipping was free, which is very important to me. If you are going to pay a little more for a product, it is good to be able to compensate by getting free shipping. I was sad to see that as of today, the shipping is $10.58. I just can not afford to pay so much for this product, even though we do love it. I am giving the sushi wraps a solid 5 star rating but the price plus the shipping 0 stars.

I love to bring these to work because they don't need a fridge or freezer and they heat up quickly (1 minute!). They are easy to put together, and you can add in veggies easily to make it more filling. My favorite things to add in are avocado or cucumber. The rice doesn't taste like typical sushi rice with rice vinegar, but it is the perfect consistency.I think these are the perfect portion size for a lunch.

Great product!  The  rice is nice and sticky and the nori is crispy and delicious.  The rice isn't technically sushi rice (no flavoring), but it works well.  I didn't find it messy at all.  Get a fork full of rice, grab your nori and smooth the rice down the nori.  Next pick whatever you want  and throw in it and wrap it up.  The picture on the box is deceiving because I doubt you could really get that much stuff in the roll though.  This is a single serve type of thing, not making sushi for your family.  But it's great for some veggies, or crab or a piece of fish.  I think I have found my perfect lunch from now on.

My nine year old daughters love the rice and seaweed wraps. Microwave the rice and you're good to roll. They're vegetarians and recommend carrots, cukes, and radishes for their sushi rolls.This is good, convenient food, albeit pretty expensive for sushi rice and seaweed wraps. Still, the convenience is mighty nice.
Love these wraps.  They are a snap to make, even my kids can make them with no problems.  They are very hard to find in the grocery stores so I am very glad Amazon sells them!!
If you love sushi you will love this product. I was suprised good the rice is, I can make sushi for a quick lunch.
A quick way to make good sushi at home. All you need is the vegetables and meat, everything else is in the kit. Fast to prepare.

column9: Adds some fun to lunch at work
column10: I bought this product last summer when I was experimenting with buying in bulk while I was living at college over the summer and working for Admissions. I brought in the sushi kit one day and had so much fun surprising all of the counselors with sushi. The sticky rice adheres to the seaweed after it is cooked. The kit is "beginner-friendly" to rolling sushi. At first, I didn't really know what I was doing. The product tastes great even if you don't add meat or vegetables. It's surprisingly filling.

I was hesitant to purchase this, despite the outstanding reviews, because of the price. I mean, what could be cheaper than rice and toasted seaweed?With that perspective, I was very pleased with these meals/snacks. The rice was more delicious than the freshly made white rice served in many places (possibly even better than the rice in my house) and the wraps are super delicate and with a nice lightly crispy texture that is most enjoyable.If you like sushi wraps and rice, I highly recommend you try these.

This kit is great for making your own sushi at home.  Making sushi at home is a little daunting at first, but Annie Chun's makes it less intimidating.  After trying this out a few times, I went ahead and got a rolling mat so I can really make my own.  Fast and tasty!

I bought this product at the store rather than online and I enjoyed it a lot. It tastes a lot less vinegary than the real sushi and the major turn on is you can add whatever you want as the filling. I am glad this really doesn't take that much effort to cook. All you have to do is put the rice in the microwave for 1 minute and you are done with the cooking part. Now, the wrapping is a different story. It's not difficult but it's messy and the wraps are brittle, but still usable to wrap, to me but I have fun making them. It also comes with soy sauce but I really didn't need it at all. This product is really easy to make, is a great alternative when you don't want to cook anything or dirty, hardly, any dishes, and you are in control of it. I really like this product a lot and I will definitely buy it again.

If you are a true sushi fanatic, these will probably be incredibly disappointing for you.  The rice is excellent, but the precut nori is dry and crunchy and cut too small to roll much more than a single piece of avocado.  Save the money and buy your own mat.  Wish I had!

column9: Next Best Thing to Real Sushi
column10: Living in the Midwest, 120 miles from any large metro area, we are unable to indulge our Sushi cravings as often as we'd like. These kind of fit the bill and are easy and portable. I bring along some pickled ginger, meat and veggies and this makes a substantial lunch.
Lots of fun, and the potential is endless.  Great way to get ready to go out and get all the supplies for a sushi dinner.  It's perfect for a friend to join in and make some fun snacks.

I love sushi.  It's my favorite food and these are really good for convenience sushi!  I am amazed at the quality of sticky rice ready in two minutes in the microwave.  My Japanese friend makes these plum paste balls that you wrap in the kind of salted seaweed included and these are reminiscent of those.  My husband and my three year old son were also impressed and I had to fight them over the last few.  Delicious!

I ordered this when it was the gold box deal and I would order again even at the higher price. Reading the reviews just reaffirms the old adage that you can't please everyone. I'm happy that there is no added flavor in the rice. The rice is quite tasty as it is. Have we gone to a culture that has to modify everything? In today's world we don't taste what we prepared to eat. We only taste the condiments we pour onto or into it. I thought the wraps where big enough. How hard can it be to roll sushi for goodness sakes. I thought the salt taste in the wraps added a little rush to the flavor when I bit into the sushi. All in all I think this is a great option to lunch and a good value. Having to roll your own helps you to slow down your eating and allows to feel full just about the time you munch on the last bite. Tomorrow, I think I'll add some tuna! Yummy!

column9: Good if you enjoy making one at a time
column10: The seaweed is excellent quality however you only get to make one piece at a time because the Nori is very small. It's awful if you're making a lot of sushi at once. I prefer larger sheets so I can roll and cut many pieces of sushi. I will not be buying this product again because of this. It was however delicious Nori and good quality rice and very quick to do. It's just no good if you're looking to make more then 10 pieces, plus that causes it to actually take more time then it should.

The salt had separated from the rice, or something weird happened to this product.  The salt is just sitting on top and so the rice tastes wickedly terrible.  Either the other folks here who enjoyed this product don't know what sushi is supposed to taste like, or my shipment got ruined enroute to me.  I won't order this ever again.
Really tasty, top quality stuff. Easier to make than expected. My 13yr old enjoys preparing it, and looks forward to being the "chef" every time we have it on the menu.
Trying this, it was very good because you got a sense of what it is really like to make sushi instead of going to a restaurant.  What is even better is that you can have fun when you make it.
It's a quick, fun way to have sushi your way.  You put the 'stuffing', anything you like into the roll.  The rice is perfectly sticky, wish the wraps were just a little more sturdier.
Taste fine. It comes with sushi rice and wrap. You still need to prepare other ingridents. Don't pay original price for it. I got it for 50% off.

Although the product is very easy to use and the rice sticks together perfectly to make a sushi roll-----the rice is tasteless because it has neither mirin vinegar nor sugar nor salt in it (commonly called sushi vinegar)--------the nori wrappers are too small to make any decent sized roll and too thin to withstand any handling-------I have had better sushi rolls at the worst japanese restaurant---------the soy sauce is OK but without wasabi mustard you cannot achieve the taste of real sushi

I actually went to the store looking for some rice so that I could make a meal with fried rice. The store I went to had tons of Asian foods, and this was one of them. Now, I have never had Sushi before, but I've been getting really into Japanese culture and that includes food, so I thought I'd try some. I figured this was an easy way to at least try the Nori with the rice and soy sauce so that I could figure out what to add to customize it to my taste. I'm not real adventurous when it comes to food, so for me to get this was a big deal.The sticky rice really does cook up well, and quite frankly, I love rice, so I'd buy this just to get the nice bowl of rice. It really steams up well in the microwave, and it takes so little time that you will really be amazed. I know it sounds like I'm going on too much about the rice, but the rice that they make for microwaves now tastes like it came out of a microwave, and this did not. After heating the rice, I pulled out the Nori (seaweed) and placed a nice size ball of rice onto the middle of it [Nori] as the packaged says; that's where my experience went bad. I eat by smell, which many people do, and the smell that the hot rice combined with the Nori gave off was horrible and totally ruined the experience for me. I don't know if it was supposed to smell like that or not, but I do know that it wasn't going in my stomach. I did try to finish the rice, and mixed the Soy Sauce with it in the bowl, but the experience was ruined. I really think this is more for those who have eaten Sushi before, and would stay away and hold out for something better if you're looking for a first-time new experience.
I love these jellies.  I received flavors that I normally could not buy in a grocery store.  Delicious!

column9: Trappist jellies & jams are great stuff!
column10: They taste great.They're pretty!They're made in an intriguing and enviro-friendly way. (My first sight of the monastery where they're made - a replica of the mother-house in Europe, on a picturesque hilltop in Massachusetts - swept me into a historical reverie that was interrupted when I realized what the habited monk on the red tile roof was doing: fixing one of the solar panels powering the jelly factory. You can read more about some unique features of the process on the Amazon site.)And the money you spend actually goes to support the life and work of the monks.

We were dismayed to find that we couldn't get Trappist Preserves at the local grocery store.  No problem, Amazon has it!!!  If you've never had it, try it and you will love it.  If you've had it, you know what I mean!!  Great flavor selection too.  Alot of other flavors are available (28 total), just do a "Google" on "trappist preserve".

I grew up as a vegetarian, and this is my favorite of the many soy-products out there. The stakes come 4 to a can, submerged in thick, flavorful brown gravy, and are simple to prepare--just heat and serve. I usually accompany them with macaroni and cheese and whatever vegetable I'm in the mood for. However, they are also good in sandwiches or with mashed potatoes or rice. If you are not a vegetarian, you will probably find the flavor closest to Salisbury steak, though the texture is very different. That said, I recommend that those who are not familiar with vegetarian soy-products think of them as something totally other, rather than the meat product they are meant to replace, and enjoy them for their own merits. Other soy-meat favorites: Worthington Prosage, Morningstar Grillers, Worthington Chili, and Loma Linda Fried Chik'N with Gravy.

this is by far my favorite loma linda product. if you are missing meatloaf  and dont want to take the time to make a vegetarian substitute, this product is amazing! only 5 WW points for 2 patties. i could eat this every day!!

I have been a vegetarian for the past 16 years and have purchased Loma Linda swiss steak by the individual cans in health food stores dozens of times. I was delighted to find it available by the case on Amazon.com. It is hands down my favorite veggie meat substitute. It is delicious and filling and you only need to nuke it in the microwave and add some veggies to make a full, satisfying meal. This is a huge plus for a commuter who works full time like I do. I really can't say enough about the product. I eat it often, and always keep some cans on hand. The gravy is delicious!

This is the first Loma Linda or Worthington meat analog that was not thrilled with. I love most of their products and use them all the time, so I didn't hesitate to order a case of Swiss Stakes. For my taste, they are bland, blah and boring. As a stand-alone Swiss-style "steak", they just were pretty tasteless. The gravy is OK, but nothing to write home about. I'm using up the remaining cans by cutting the "stakes" up and putting them in Chinese dried noodle soups. I'm also thinking I can make them into burgers, as long as I load lots of ketchup and mustard on them.

I'm a vegetarian and enjoy all kinds of fake meat products and will not buy this one again.  Texture is a little soggy and flavor is not that great.  It's OK but there are better products out there.  Try Worthington's frozen Stakelets or Morningstar's Grillers Prime instead.

column4: Donna's Reviews "I Love Shopping on Amazon!"
column10: My favorite so far...Good but not great........Loma Linda Swiss Stake with Gravy, 13-Ounce Cans (Pack of 12)....I paid $58.97  for 12 of these I also bought several of the other products from this brand....They are Heavy ALL were shipped in On large box...SEVERAL cans have HUGE dents in them...

column4: Phyllis L. Fischer "church of the angels"
column10: with hains brown gravy, and peas and corn and potatoes, you can make a great stew! or open a can and grab a slice and have a sandwich ! good stuff, good feeling knowing you are helping the animals by not eating them.

column4: April "Bajo el sol hay bastante lugar para to...
column9: Great for vegs and non-vegs alike
column10: If you are a vegetarian in a household of semi-vegetarians, this product might be able to satisfy everyone.  It's texture and taste reminds me of Salisbury steak, but not as salty.The product is in a thin "gravy," which also has a great flavor, and can be stretched into more with a little water and corn starch.We've served it over rice, on a sandwich, and with potatoes--all worthy!Even non-vegetarians won't think twice about enjoying this, and may not know until later that it was all veggies!

I am a vegetarian and have found it difficult to find meat alternatives in my area.  Amazon has been the best thing since sliced bread when I'm looking for hard to find products.  So far they have never let me down and I've always been very pleased with my purchases.  Loma Linda Swiss Stake is delicious and a great addition to a meatless diet.

I've been a vegetarian for 38 years and have used Loma Linda meatless products for many of those years. I love them. My kids grew up with them. I now live in NC and cannot buy them anywhere local. Being able to order them from Amazon is wonderful.

column9: Meat substitute with wonderful texture and flavor.
column10: I am so impressed with this product! Loma Linda Swiss Stakes are a flavorful high-protein meat substitute with delicious savory gravy and they're even great right out of the can, which makes it a wonderful option if you travel or go camping. I just ordered Loma Linda Fried Chik'N with Gravy, 13-Ounce Cans (Pack of 12) based on all the 4- and 5-star reviews and hope I love it as much as the Swiss Stakes. I'm so happy these products are available on Amazon!

I like the convenience and taste. They are a little soft compared to some of the frozen type but the gravy and flavor more than make up for that. In fact, last time I ate one of the frozen brand veggie burgers, I thought it was hard and tasted bland. Not buying frozen any more.
This is an excellent product both by taste and texture. It has a gravy addition which goes well with potatoes.

column9: we have a stake in this!
column10: As long time vegetarians, my wife and I have always enjoyed this product. It is tasty, easy to prepare and enjoyable.This shipment was delivered as promised in a timely fashion.
I ordered this by mistake instead of Prime Steaks.  This is a good product, and we enjoy it with our meals.  I think I like Prime Steaks better, but my husband really likes this product too.

I was raised eating meat substitutes as my mother, now 86 with no cardio vascular problems, has been a vegetarian from birth.  This product is delicious.  I like it because it does not try to taste like real meat.  It has a delicious savory flavor all it's own.  For someone just starting out as a vegetarian and wanting something easy to use and tasty, this is it.  My son, who is an avid meat eater, loves this just as much as I do. When I have this for dinner he does not mind going meatless.  I just wish it came with more gravy for putting over noodles or rice.

First off, you must know that I am a vegetarian.  These are great tasting, and so easy, even non-vegetarians would love them, I would think.  They even come with their own gravy.  All you have to do is open them up and warm them!  Give them a try!

The transaction was effortless and the delivery was exactly as promised. The Loma Linda Swiss Stakes are delicious, with really tasty gravy. The price was also reasonable. I would gladly purchase from this company again. It makes shopping online a pleasure.
Loma Linda Swiss Stake is a perfect hurry up entree that only needs reheating.  It has a substantial meaty texture with a luscious gray.  I like it best served with potatoes, peas, and a salad.

I don't why it's labeled as "Swiss Stake", because it really isn't anything of the sort.  I was expecting something with roughly flavor of Swiss Steak as I have known it to be.  As I have always understood it (and have made it), Swiss Steak has a tomato-based sauce with onions and generally bell peppers and garlic, etc.  This product is NOT that at all.  Given the "Swiss Stake" product title. I couldn't even given this 1 star.  This is more of a "Salisbury Stake" in a standard brown gravy, that has no vegetables at all in it and tastes nothing like a Swiss Steak sauce would. This basically a soy "hamburger" patty in a smooth brown gravy.  Given that vegetarian "meats" have never really resembled the texture of their namesakes anyway, I didn't really expect (but WAS hoping) that the texture would resemble that of flank steak or round steak that Swiss steak is made with, but I DID expect the sauce flavor and components to resemble Swiss Steak.  It doesn't.  With a title of "Salisbury Stake", I'd give it 3 stars at best.
Some of the best pre-cooked vegetarian food I've ever bought ~ my 3 teenage daughters LOVE these!!  Very convenient after school snack for our life-long vegetarian family :)

These are good tasting but I sure wish they would stop using EGG WHITES IN THEM.  Loma Linda has a limited number of people who are going to buy this product.  Why would they choose to exclude all vegans.

For a tasty entree with lunch, supper, or dinner, Loma Linda Swiss Stake is an excellent choice. The stakes are tender and delicious; the gravy is seasoned nicely with just the correct amount of spices to spooned over mashed potatoes. This swiss stake is even better than the swiss steak that I made with my mother.No animal was hurt in the manufacture of this product.Loma Linda Swiss Stake with Gravy, 13-Ounce Cans (Pack of 12)Loma Linda, Swiss Steak With Gravy, 13-Ounce

I just love these stakes.  There is no substitute for them, in my opinion. I've been eating LL's Swiss Steaks for years and have not been able to find them at my local grocery store after relocating.  So glad to find them on Amazon at such a great deal. Simply love them!  Makes a great dinner with pasta or mashed potatoes and the gravy is divine with added sauteed mushrooms, onions and mixed bell peppers in olive oil. Really "beefs" up my weekly menue, LOL. Highly recommend this product, enjoy, enjoy, enjoy.  Amazon's delivery was super fast. Will definately keep the automatic reorder going.

Swiss steaks are really good cut up and mixed with green beans or peas, a can of mushroom soup and the gravy...add mashed potatoes on top and you have shepherds pie! Better than the real meat version in my family's opinion!

My husband and son are vegetarians. I am not and we all love it. My son is 2 yrs old and a picky eater. He will eat this out of the can... no questions asked. We usually serve it with mashed potato. I recommend this as well as the chili- that's my favorite.

This is great meat substitute. Serves 3 people. Fix with potatoes and veggies and you have a meal. If you are not used to eating a soy meat product you'll be disappointed. I like because I'm a veggie so I'm partical to Loma Linda products, that I greww up on.

I like hot dogs and hamburgers as much as the next person but these Swiss stakes and veggie dogs are my most favorite in the world.They taste absolutely wonderful and I never get tired of them. I've have these since I was a kid so I've been eating these for over 20 years now. The only thing that sucks is that they don't sell them where I live. Luckily my grandmother sends my family a case of them from time to time but they don't last long at all. I would recommend these to not only veggie lovers but anybody.

If you like Salisbury steak and mashed potatoes then this is a great alternative. The gravy is included. It actually tastes good! Unlike most "cardboard" as some of you out there call it, this is full of flavor where a lot of your "Fake" meats don't. And of course if you dont like things real salty this is also a good choice. Great also if you add a green pepper to the mix.

This is pretty good. Not sure why the high price, but I could never make something like this out of TVP. So, I don't mind paying so much. It goes great topped with mushrooms. It doesn't fool us into believing that it's meat, but it comes close enough and serves to give variety to our meals.
Brown in a bit of vege oil and top with sauteed mushrooms.  Top with a bit of the gravy.
same great product and a better price than the health food store...delivered to my door

column9: Contents fine, but every can dented

Easy to fix and serve.  Good for pot lucks.  I make noodles or rice to serve with the patties.  Also, good fixed like a burger.  My husband is a meat eater and he loves these.

The Loma Linda Swiss Stake product is great. If you are in a hurry you can just open can and heat for a hearty meal with mashed potatoes and vegetable or salad.  I like to use them, however, in recipes that call for other items to stretch them and make more patties in a casserole dish to bake for fellowship meals after church.They work quite well when using them as the base for "Manhattan meatless Meatballs or Patties".
horrible freakin' taste. i'll probably end up giving it to my dog. this company/brand usually has awesome tasty products, but not this one. don't waste your money

It is appalling to me that anyone would produce this product and sell it as food. What's more appalling is that people eat it and not only support the misguided notion that this is something that could be considered food, but even go so far as to say that they ENJOY eating it, AND DO SO ON A REGULAR BASIS. If this product were made of meat, I would be faced with no other viable conclusion than to think that it was made from the meat products rejected by a dog-food factory. But since it is not meat of any kind, what am I to think. . . ? Is this some kind of weird joke. . . ? What IS this THING in this can? And WHAT IS THAT SMELL? And this gravy of which they spake on the label, do they mean this slime? The slime that is more gross than spam slime? SO MANY QUESTIONS. . .
i didnt think they were that great. i have had better. received as a gift.the bags were neat.my friend said the more spots the less fresh they are.

As promised, it is definitely crunchy, but I actually found it a bit too crunchy--my jaw started to ache after just a few spoonfuls!  However, I found that if I gave the cereal some time to soften a bit in the milk first, I could enjoy it much more.  Recommended as a healthy, tasty way to start your day.

I happened upon this bag in Costco.  The sprouted combo is extremely nutritious and easy to digest, plus it has great flavor.  I needed something quick and simply added some garlic, turmeric, and paprika for flavor and added cooked rice.  Next time will add some other vegies like celery, onions, carrots, maybe even a few potatoes.  The possibilities are endless.  I even think it would make good taco or burrito filling.
No matter how long I cook these, the lentils never get soft, while the rest turns to mush. Sad because really wanted to like this product but I think there is something wrong with it.

column9: Takes longer to cook, but good
column10: The first time, I cooked these beans as instructed and the green beans (not sure what they are) did not cook.  I was eating and thought there were pebbles in my salad.  It depends on how you like your beans, but I do 20+ minutes simmering at low heat, and let it set 10-15 minutes.  They're tasty enough, but after cooking, they look completely dull and not that appetizing.  Other than looks, they make a great topper for salads.

LOVE THIS PRODUCT.  I MIX IT WITH CUCUMBERS, BLACK BEANS, CHERRY TOMATOES ONIONS AND PAUL NEWMAN'S WED WINE VINAIGRETTE--LOVE IT!

I absolutely love this stuff.  I mix it with a bunch of other ingredients - roasted corn, edamame, black beans, quinoa, and scallions. I add a little olive oil and some salt and pepper.  Generally, I heat it and add just a tiny bit of low-fat shredded Mexican blend cheese and a tablespoon of sour cream.  I mix it all up and enjoy!

After cooking, the unsprouted ones will be more brightly colored and smaller than the sprouted ones, since they are nowhere near cooked through.  The unsprouted ones are like rocks; they might damage your teeth. My recommendations is that you eat these carefully, even after sorting out the unsprouted ones.

column9: Good Product, does not fully cook in under 15 minutes
column10: I am a distance runner and depend on beans and corn for my main source of carbs as I have insensitivities that causes body inflammation when I eat rice or gluten (wheat).PROS:These beans are great, organic, sprouted, tastey and I have no food insensitivities with them.They are very versatile.  I can make soups, chili, or eat them without any additional spices.I also make desserts with shaved ice and fruit and use these beans instead of sugary red bean paste.Cons:These beans DO NOT thoroughly cook within 15 minutes when following directions.  I am not sure which bean doesn't fully cook, but it remains hard as a rock so be careful if you have weak teeth.I would suggest using a rice pressure cooker to cook these.  The rice cooker cooks these in about 20 minutes and I did not notice any hard beans when cooked in the pressure cooker.**This same 3lb bag goes for under $10 at Costco.

column9: Easy To Make, Great For You
column10: Bought a big bag at Costco (though they appear to no longer sell this item) and loved the convenience of it for healthy meals. Good taste and perfect for "filler" with other beans or sauces/stews.

I love this product. I am currently eating the last of my 3lb bag. I'm now panicking to replace them. I agree they do take much longer than the 15 minutes states to cook them, but once you have that figured out,hey are great. I can't believe how good they taste. I just added a diced onion, some garlic, a can of tomatoes with a bunch of water and a little salt and pressure cooked them (maybe a cup and a half?) for 10 minutes and voila the fastest, healthiest meal with left overs! And it happens to be vegan. (I'm finding myself to be more and more of an accidental vegan these days.)The possibilities are endless and the TruRoots website has lots of ideas and recipes to inspire.

I bought this at a local store and thought I would try something new.  I don't have a lot of experience cooking with beans other than chili.  I looked up lentil soup recipes and tried this cooked in chicken broth and made like a soup.  I sauteed onions and garlic in olive oil. Added chicken broth, beans, carrots, curry powder, ketchup, and cooked for about 35 minutes.  Then processed in the blender to make smooth.  Added lemon juice and olive oil and this made a great soup.  If you don't like the texture of beans, the blender fixes that nicely.  You can also do these with chili powder and make it have a mexican/refried bean flavor.  great product.  very versitile.

My husband got a bag from a large warehouse club.  The beans took 3X longer to cook than as stated in the directions.  However, they were very tasty in a lamb stew.  Even my carnivorous son asked for seconds.  There are certain beans with thick tough skin that I avoid.  The skin on these sprouted beans are very thin and thus did not have this issue.  It may be a bit pricey but the taste, nutritional value and the relative ease of cooking is worth it!
I HAVE SUCH A DIFFICULT TIME FINDING SMALL TREATS THAT MY HAVANESE CAN CHEW AND THESE ARE JUST PERFECT.  HE LOVES THEM!!

After trying and trying to make a gluten free cake without a mix (All which turned into really strange hard gelatin like things.) we finally gave up and bought some mixes. This one was by far the best of all the mixes we tried.

I tend not to get too caught up in the hype around celebrity deaths.  Tim Russert's death was big news.  That's a special perk of being part of the machinery that decides for the rest of us what is and what isn't news.  But it was also a story because he really does seem genuinely well liked.I liked the guy.  I didn't know him but I saw him once riding the T in Brookline.  He was talking on the cell phone and had that big friendly smile that people found so disarming.  Seemed like a good guy.  This idea that he asked the tough questions bothers me though.  Maybe he did ask tougher questions than your average news man, but nobody has been tough enough on these brazen gonifs that currently run the country.  They couldn't get away with half of what they do if the news media wasn't at least passively complicit.But I like Tim Russert.  He went from Buffalo to the East Coast, a trajectory I know, and I recognize that temperament he portrayed.  East Coast keenness softened by that charming Midwest salt-of-the-Earth spirit.  And, though I sometimes resent the narcissism of baby-boomers working out their father issues in the public, Tim Russert's devotion to his working class dad appears to come from a place of such wholesomeness and decency that it is hard to be critical.Buffalo is an underrated city, by the way.  Like many an unsung medium-sized city, you have to know where to look, but it has its own kind of hipness.  Buffalo wings really do come from Buffalo, in much the same way that french-fries really don't come from France.  Frank's hot sauce is the real deal, the original formula, and you can get it anywhere.  I can stake my entire fictional on-line reputation on this because I have high level informants in Buffalo who tell me this is true.  Frank and Teresa's hot sauce, in 1964, at the Anchor Bar in Buffalo, New York, was the secret ingredient for the first wings.  Yep.  The same one, right there on North and Main by the General Hospital.  They also make a jambalaya with Frank's hot sauce and kielbasa.Good sauce.  Hot enough to spice things up but not to the point where the heat masks the flavor.  You can use it for wings or you can splash it on your eggs in the morning.  Know what I did the other day?  I was at the bottom of the bag of chips, where you get just those tiny fragments and the greasy pulverized chip residue.  I poured everything into a bowl, covered it in blue cheese particles and threw in some Frank's hot sauce.  Microwaved it and ate it with a spoon.  Really uncouth, I'm glad nobody saw it.  But, seriously, not bad.

This is by far the best of their flavors that I have tried. I have had the Mamma-Mia and the Thai-Dyed. This has a good jalapeno taste along with the cheddar. Other that the powder goo you get on your fingers from the flavoring, these are good eats.

column9: What more could you ask for?
column10: Cheddar cheese and jalapeno, the perfect combination on a peanut! Its great with a beer and ballgame. Love the bite!

I tried this decaf - in words it was OK, not really good.  It tastes like a very mild blend, which is probably why I can't say much for it.  It froths up in the Senseo, just like any other pod, so it salvages a couple of stars, anyway.
Product is excellent. Full flavored cup of coffee that makes you treat yourself to more than one cup.
The decaf is fine and I use it with a pod of dark roast to create a half-caf 8 oz cup. Low rating for current price gouging. Should be 25% of the cost. Ouch!
I don't know why anyone would pay 3 times the price for this coffee. don't be fooled, there are other brands that will work with your coffeemaker just as well without the price gouging.......

column9: Was this dealer really an Amazon site?
column10: We like Senseo Coffee Pods very much; however, when my order arrived, I realized that I had paid as much for one bag of 18 pods as I normally pay for a whole box of packages.  I filled out a return slip and mailed the one bag back for a refund--which I have not received.  I have ordered several times from Amazon and in the past was always satisfied--until this order.  I didn't believe my computer when it flashed that this was a fraudulent site!
This is a light breakfast brew.  It is not for those who drink dark, black coffee. It works perfectly for me. No bitterness.

Love this hickory liquid smoke!  It has a smooth and rich flavor.  I used it on premium tiger shrimp last Saturday. I seasoned with salt, pepper, garlic and added about 8-10 drops of liquid smoke to about 12 shrimps and let it set for about 15 minutes. I sauteed the shrimp in a pan and the aroma was wonderful...just like grilling on an open fire.  The shrimp had a rich authentic hickory smoke flavor from the liquid smoke.  I'm looking forward to using this liquid smoke on halibut and may even try using it the next time I make beef jerky.  I;ve tried using colgin liquid smoke bought from the store, and this CedarHouse liquid smoke is absolutely more flavorful.
This is great stuff.  We like it better than Colgins and the fact that CedarHouse is all natural. We tried it on brisket and it was absolutely delicious!
CedarHouse liquid smoke is fantastic.  My husband uses this for his jerky and used this liquid smoke and a dehydrator.  The jerky was full of flavor without the need to put the meat in a BBQ smoker."
Great rich smoke flavor.  Giving it 4 stars instead of 5 because I wish it was in a plastic bottle instead. Plastic would be much more durable when cooking outside when camping.

column9: The real deal- read the ingredient label
column10: One of the reasons this liquid smoke is so good is that it has no added fillers or coloring.  Read the label on Stubbs or Colgin.  They contain molasses and spices and other stuff.  This just waters down the smoke flavor.  You end up needing to use less of Cedarhouse because you are getting more smoke flavor in each drop.  I had to come to Amazon and order online because, here in the deep south of Columbus GA I could not find a single store selling pure liquid smoke.
Love this liquid smoke!  It's very smooth and is not bitter like the others I've used. It captures the true taste of hickory smoke on the BBQ.

I read the other reviews and decided to give CedarHouse Liquid Smoke a try.  I'm typically a loyal fan of Stubs.  I was amazed at this product.  Kudos to CedarHouse.  Their liquid smoke is extremely smooth and has a rich smoke flavor.  This liquid smoke is awesome.  I added about 10 drops of liquid smoke to about 8 oz of water and put that into a squirt bottle.  I heavily sprayed my halibut and seasoned with garlic salt and pan fried the fish.  Simply amazing!

This liquid smoke is awesome. I added a few drops to a spinach dip, and everyone raved about the dip. My guests could not figure out how I got a smokey flavor into the dip.  I'll keep this liquid smoke gold as a secret.  The smoke flavor was really really good.

Okay-Liquid Smoke is THE BEST! I've tried other brands like Stubb's...& Liquid Smoke is much-much-much better! I'm from Texas and though we like to smoke meats on the BBQ pit- sometimes because the rain or the Texas heat, you just don't get the chance! Liquid smoke really did the trick with my cajun chicken! Delicious!!! Full bodied hickory smoke flavor-Thanks CedarHouse! I marinaded the chicken for about 2 hours with Lawry's marinade plus the CedarHouse natural hickory liquid smoke & then cooked the chicken on a gas grill. It was perfect with the right amount of hickory smoke flavor! I highly recommend purchasing a bottle!!!

column9: Amazing flavor!! No messy charcoal or wood chips...
column10: I love the flavor of this hickory liquid smoke. It's really really good.  We have a gas grill, and you don't get the charcoal or wood smoke flavor from gas grills.  Adding the liquid smoke to our fajita marinade brought a whole new dimension of taste and aroma to our fajitas.  No more smoking chips for us...we're using CedarHouse liquid smoke from now on.  I also like the fact that this is an all natural product with no additives.

column9: You won't find anything else like this!
column10: Kasugai Kiwi Gummies are a shear delight.  Each piece is like a bite of fresh kiwi fruit, without the bother of having to take off the skin.

column4: M. B. Evernham II "The Working Foodie"

Then he put the spoon down on the plate next to the food. We really didn't think much of this until we tried our first bites. WOW! Needless to say, we each grabbed for the spoon. column10: they looked cute on the cupcakes but the kids couldn't wear them.  (all kids were 8 and under)Most rings have the section you could snap to adjust them but these are a sold piece so you can't

column9: Sooo good! Great for salads, pitas, fajitas...
column10: Yep. If you're vegan, vegetarian or just want to try some meatless chicken, this product will do just great. I bought this and found it to be a great alternative to buying the fake chicken for $4 a bag every week at the grocery store. For under $30, you get a huge bag of faux chicken. Big ol' bag.Although it it pre-seasoned, it's not too salty or spicy. I highly recommend juicing some lemon juice over it if you're frying or sautéing it. Tangy delish. Use this in pitas, salads, tofu scrambles, fajitas, faux chicken salad or with peppers on a hot dog bun. Great buy for the holidays to feed the veggie masses. column9: Trehalose is basically 2 glucose molecules = safest form of sugar
column10: Trehalose is a tasty sugar substitute (tastes like a powdered version of Marshmallow Peeps) made from 2 joined glucose molecules.I've been consuming the Trehalose I purchased over the past few weeks without suffering any ill effect or any signs of indigestion.I ordered another 5 jars of Swanson's Trehalose just this week.I am still playing around a bit with cooking techniques to master the best properties of Trehalose while minimizing the slight reduction in sweetness.  Trehalose can convert into a glass phase (think hard candy) just like sugar with much less caramelization (it tends to be clear like glass rather than browning like sugar).It is only about 45% as sweet as regular sugar, but has some very interesting cooking and preservative properties.  Plants like the Resurrection Fern can survive freezing and drying out of 97% of its water mass and still robustly return to life in the presence of water.  A very novel sweet molecular pair indeed.  Don't be mistaken in thinking that Trehalose is a "fake sugar" because humans can digest it back into 2 glucose molecule (the human body's energy reserve molecule) in the lower intestine for energy with the enzyme Trehalase, but at a much slower rate which does not cause rapid blood sugar spikes like High Fructose Corn Syrup does.Only recently have some wonderful scientific manufacturing companies have been able to mass produce Trehalose in large quantities for sale.I expect it won't be too long in the near future when Trehalose is as inexpensive as sugar, but that will only happen when larger demand levels allow a price reduction as an economy of scaling up the production.I invite you all out there to take a taste of this wonderful sweet human-safe alternative to sugar.(Addition on April 18th, 2011 to my January 16, 2010 Amazon review)Okay.  It's been over a year and I have some new stuff to add.  Still a great product, additional suggestions on usage for baking and consumption.  A teaspoon-full of the standard granulated Trehalose (what you get when you purchase this product) added into baking batter acts a bit like baking soda in that baked goods will be a bit softer and rise higher, yet also slightly enhances the normal flavors of the baked goods.  For better food usage, you can put dry Trehalose into an empty blender (not adding liquids and filling above the blending blades) dry blend-grinding granulated Trehalose to a superfine powder for 2 minutes.  This increases the surface area, reduces some of the "powdered marshmallow" flavor, and increases absorption for other uses.  The best dietary cellular absorption I've found is by adding powdered Trehalose to melted chocolate candy squares (to your preferred taste of course).  I suspect that Trehalose is incorporated easiest into human cells by natural semi-solid fat oil-suspension over watery suspension.  Superfine powdered Trehalose does not substitute for confectioners sugar when dusting baked goods.As for other uses, I've added powdered Trehalose to liquid soap for an energizing showering experience which leaves the skin feeling young and the powdered Trehalose is absorbed better when added to skin moisturizers.  Again, no negative side-effects or any "sticky residue" as would occur with sugar or other sugar substitutes.  I have not done very much home-testing on the value of Trehalose as an additive for plant food yet (it should help I'd think given nature's usage in the Resurrection Fern and in cold-surviving & desert-surviving creatures).

column9: All it takes is one death, and these will be pulled from market
column10: We're pretty avid Whole Foods shoppers now, and have felt pretty good about purchasing organic baby food for our now 9.5 month old son.  Earth's Best brand has been popular with him, so we bought these teething biscuits recently.  Today, he could have died eating one.Although I'm an anesthesiologist, and half of my job is to "protect people's airways", one needn't be a medical professional to realize why these biscuits are dangerous.  Most babies get their front teeth (upper and lower incisors) first, long before molars arrive.  So, they're limited to biting with their front teeth, and only mashing with their gums (where their molars will someday erupt).  These biscuits are great for the first 5 minutes, baby happily chomping away on the hard surface.  Then, they soften.  Pretty soon, baby bites clean through the biscuit with their front teeth (size of chunk depending on how far they had inserted it into their mouth at the time), and the chunk that remains in their mouth is WAY too hard to mash with gums.  Baby has nothing to do but try to spit it out (difficult at this age), or swallow it whole (if lucky enough for it to be a small piece), or have it completely occlude their airway.  We were able to quickly fish one large chunk out with our fingers, but our poor soon started gagging, tearing, and wretched once before something resolved (still don't know if he swallowed a large piece or if it ended up on ground), but not before we scooped him up and tried to knock it loose with some back blows.In any case, although the kids may love these, all it would take would be one infant death from choking to prompt a recall or something.  Why risk your own kid?
