Kind of expensive but if you get them at the $1 per bag rates you are getting a big bargain even with the shipping and handling. I actually ordered some treats from a different business that sells bunny treats and found it was this same product repackaged, a smaller amount in the bag and a bigger price. So I checked Amazon and found that the identical items were sold as doggie treats in a bigger bag and less cost. On top of that nice savings (I don't have a car at the moment so I can't drive to the pet store)the animals fight each other to be first in the handout line. I wish I could get the recipe for them. And, I'd like to buy them in a 5lb bag. Does anyone sell them that way? They'd make a nice doggie Christmas present.

Can't say enough good things about this product.... We've tried 3 Fruitables varieties - pumpkin/apple, pumpkin/cranberry, and pumpkin/blueberry - and the pooch craves them all. As he has kidney disease, it is very important that his treats are low in protein and fat, and these treats follow the specifications of what we should be feeding him perfectly! As other reviewers have mentioned, they smell so good it's hard to believe they're not meant for human consumption... I haven't had the nerve to actually try one... yet. I would highly recommend them!

column9: Healthy and my dog loves them!
column10: My veterinarian sister recommended these and I'm so glad she did! My dog loves them and the ingredients make me feel great about giving them to him. Awesome dog treat!

column9: Great treats! A hit for humans and animals alike!
column10: Finding treats for my aging dog has been a challenge. She has dietary restrictions which include no salt and low protein. She won't eat some of the obvious, more common snacks (sweet potato strips for example) and finding Fruitables has been great!!! They actually stimulate my 16 year olds appetite.  And, they are so inexpensive!!! After spending a fortune at the boutique stores, Fruitables are quite a find.

My GSD loves these treats.  It's getting to the point where she hears the bag crinkle she comes running and shows me all the tricks she knows!I like these because I can grab a few without getting stinky hands!!!

column9: Awesome ingredient list, dog loves them.
column10: Ingredients:Pumpkin, Organic Oatmeal, Pearled Barley, Whole ground potatoes, Oat Fiber, Apples, Canola Oil (with mixed Tocopherols, a natural preservative), Organic Cane Molasses, Cinnamon, Vanilla.Dog loves them, I love their ingredients.

I don't have terribly picky eaters, especially when it comes to treats, but I wasn't sure they would like the Fruitables.  I got them the Pumpkin Banana & they love them...I will probably get them the other flavors to try.

These treats are low calorie, which my slightly full-figured Cockapoo's appreciate.  If you're one of those people that "reward" a lot during the day, it is amazing how fast the calories can add up.....these are all-natural treat, and the dogs like them too!
All four of my dogs, ranging in age from 1 to 14 years old, love the fruitables products.  I highly recommend!
I have two dogs who LOVE this stuff!  It is a healthy, low calorie treat that smells great.  My babies can get as many treats as they deserve:-)
My Golden Retriever loves these treats. He knows where I keep them and sits by the closet waiting for me to give them to him.

I bought a package of each flavor of the Fruitables treats and my dogs love, love, love them! They're definitely crunchy but no different than any other crunchy-type biscuit. While two of my dogs would eat garbage, one is a bit more persnickity. Even he gobbles these down! Between Fruitables and Zuke's, we're done with grocery treats forever!

My dog thoroughly enjoys these treats.  The smell is very enticing (even to his human master!!), the size of the treat is very manageable, he enjoys the texture which is nice and crunchy and I'm sure it tastes really good because he keeps coming back for more when I show it to him!!
Both of our dogs just love all three flavors of Fruitables!  They have become a wonderful training tool and general reward favorite.

column9: Fruitables - All-Natural Pumpkin & Blueberry Dog Treats
column10: We have a Newfoundland that we like to pamper. He also has a sensitive stomach. These treats were recommeded by our vet. The treats are human grade quality - and each piece is about 7 calories. I use them as training treats and "just because your a good dog" treat - he loves them.

In Alex's (my dog) opinion, they don't quite compare to liver treats, but he readily accepts them.  Since he is supposed to be losing a few pounds, they help cut back on his daily caloric intake without depriving him of a little snack now and then.

Our dog has a sensitive stomach and often doesn't chew his food completely. We have searched for healthy treats he'll actually chew and that won't bother his stomach. He LOVES these treats! They crunch satisfactorily, smell good and don't bother his stomach. His tail wags like crazy the second he sees the cookie jar come down filled with these!
My boy loves these treats, they have healthy ingredients, and are low-cal. I've bought all the flavors and I highly recommend.(They're wheat free!)
My dog loves these - and they smell delicious.  A healthy treat I don't feel guilty giving to him.

This is the best applesauce I have ever tasted!  It has wonderful texture, taste, and isn't sugary like so many other sauces out there.  Leroux Creek also has 5 other flavors that I buy from a local store.  They are all as tasty as this one.  I would recommend this product to anyone who want applesauce that tastes like apples.

I'm crazy about this applesauce.  I have these wonderful knishes and Coney Island Squares that I order from Gabila's deli in NY-and this applesauce is the perfect thing to go with them.  The mango taste is mild, just makes the applesauce a little more interesting.  (sorry if this review sounds idiotic, I'm in an allergy fog today)  I have one of these cups for lunch every day.  I like the berry ones too, but the mango is my favorite.  Thanks Amazon for carrying these!

I've tried over 20 different white chocolate bars and this is my favorite by a good margin. My search for good white chocolate began years ago when I realized the caffeine in dark chocolate would sometimes give me a migraine. White chocolate has much less caffeine that dark chocolate but its also a struggle to find a tasty white chocolate bar--they just don't get the same love dark chocolate does. Most white chocolate doesn't taste like chocolate (rather they taste like vanilla and sugar) but this white chocolate has a distinct, rich chocolatey flavor. Its not the same flavor as dark chocolate but its a great flavor in its own right. Its my favorite white chocolate so far.
About equal to the Lindt white chocolate bar available at Walmart for less. Not as good as the Lindt white chocolate truffles.
The recipient loved the white chocolate -- best he'd ever had. Fast delivery too :)
Arrived well packed, and expiration far off.  Better Tuna for lower price.  What can be better?

This is bad tuna, can't say it any better. It's flavor and smell tend to be very strong, not what you expect from the top of the line tuna they make. The chunk light they make is slightly better. 1 in 4 cans actually are solid albacore, the other 3 are made up of mush, I can't even call it chunk style. I don't eat tuna in salads or sandwiches, I eat it out of the can. When I buy solid albacore, I expect that, this brand can't be trusted to give quality time after time. DON'T BUY.

Legendary Chicken of the Sea quality continues. I like tuna and their quality converted me over from another brand and I'm eating more tuna in a healthier diet. Excellent quality at an excellent price. You can't go wrong. I highly recommend this brand.
These are very good. Definately my favorite out of the different kinds I have tried. I have heard they are even better warm!

These peanuts have a crispness and flavor it is remarkable. You can almost snap them. Their flavor is clean and sharp. I would highly recommend these peanuts to anyone that would like to taste what a great roasted peanut should be.

I buy these on a regular basis. I prefer the smaller cans so the nuts stay fresher. I tried storing larger cans in the refrigerator to keep them fresher longer, but cold nuts lose some of their flavor.

column9: The best gal danged goobers in the whole dang world!
column10: I've been buying Virginia peanuts for twenty years, mostly from Virginia Diner and these Royal Oak peanuts are vastly superior. Why? They are FRESH. They are so crisp that, if all you've ever tasted are grocery store peanuts you'd better get ready for a shock to your taste buds that will knock your socks off. They say they grow em, cook em and ship em and I believe em. Wow.

These Virginia jumbos are awesome.  Super crispy and great tasting.  You cannot go wrong when you order this product.  They are open all year round. Amazon made a great choice when taking this family farm as a vendor!

I bought these for my husband (I can't eat peanuts) so I have to go by his observations.  He said they were fresh, large, and very tasty.  Just the right amount of salt so I guess he liked them.  Would I buy them again?  Probably not because the price was a little high and I can get them in bulk cheaper at the store that are just as good.

column9: Very poor customer service from Royal Oak
column10: I would agree with the other poor ratings for Royal Oak - very poor customer service from Royal Oak. We ordered, this year, the exact same product as last year. When it arrived, the nuts were not the same product, and they would not refund or pay shipping for the return. Also, they only operate the few weeks that peanuts are 'in season.' Otherwise, emails and phone calls are not even acknowledged.
Actually pretty good, not sure if it's worth the money, but honestly I have been a huge fan of Tabasco sauce my entire life, and this is pretty good stuff, more potent, and flavorful!!!

It is delicious.  Just what you'd expect...they picked the very best peppers and aged them longer.  The sauce is a little thicker than the traditional Tabasco.  It really is magnificent, but not at this price.  I'm embarrassed to say that I've consumed $25 worth of hot sauce in a little over two weeks (5 ounces).  I would spend another $25 for a special occasion, or another keep sake/display item for my kitchen, but it's not priced for ongoing consumption.  Perhaps there's a middle ground?  Something a step or two above the original version?  But then again, I'm very happy with the original.  I would surprised to find someone who loved Tabasco more than I do.P.S.  I just realized that you can get the "undressed" 5oz bottle (without the wax seal and chain around it) of the reserve for $10 at the tabasco website.  Well worth it.  I wish I had know before I ordered 2 of the wax/chain versions on Amazon (one for consuming and the other for display and consumption years from now).

Being a hot sauce aficionado I had to try Tabasco's specialty version of it's venerable sauce.  Yes, I go and try dozens  of sauces a year - based on mango, carrot, tomato.... including jalapeno, serrano, cayenne, ghost, jolokia, habanero... but there is something about original Tabasco that keeps it a staple in the fridge next to all my exotic sauces.  So, again, I saw this version of Tabasco and jumped, despite the price.  It was worth trying but I was somewhat disappointed that it had only the most subtle difference in taste from original, mainline Tabasco.  It is a nice difference - a sort of mellowness behind the vinegar bite.  I'm glad I tried it, but after it runs out I'm back to original.

I got this for my brother in-law (a man who has everything) for his birthday and it was a huge hit. Just ordered another for him for Christmas based on how much he loved it and will likely make this a regular gift for him as long as it's available.

i am a fan of the tassimo machine, and many of the t-discs.  however the signature blend should be retitled the signature bland.  perhaps i just look a fuller bodied coffee particularly in the morning, but this one was exceptionally disappointing to me... take note of the different roast levels posted on tassimos website before buying discs that cost about $.50-$.75 per cup...

Try the Tasimo coffee maker and the T-Discs and you will love it! The selections of coffees and creamers, and the great service you receive from Amazon is fast and stays up to date with each delivery. Thanks Amazon!!

column9: Not the best licorice I've had
column10: I purchased this fas a gift for someone who likes licorice and had high expectations based on some of the reviews.  It had a nice tart apple aroma but unfortunately the taste did not live up to the smell.  Not particularly sweet or tart and we both found it had a chalky mouth feel as it dissolved with a little bit a a chemical aftertaste.  I personally found that my tongue stung a little bit after I ate the piece.  Of course, taste is a subjective thing, so to each their own but I am sending it back.  Also, the bag had a tiny hole which I discovered after the fact, so the product may also have been a little stale.
I am not a fan of licorice but my dad talked me into trying these.  I thought these tasted really good.  I will be buying more of these.

I have never been a fan of anything but milk chocolate.  Having embraced a low-carb lifestyle, however, I decided to try dark and bittersweet varieties since they have a much lower sugar content.  I went through quite a few brands, and many dollars, and most were just TOOOO bitingly bitter for my tastebuds - until I happened upon the Perugina at, of all places, my local produce market, owned by some very nice Korean folks.This is the best dark variety of chocolate I've eaten at ANY price.  I break off two squares (it's conveniently scored) which amounts to approx. .3 ounce, and let each one melt in my mouth.  The texture is silky smooth and the bittersweet is not TOO bitter!There may be more discerning tastebuds out there but for my taste this is perfect.

column9: The best wasabi peas I've tasted!
column10: I've tried various kinds of wasabi peas, some have been too hot, others with little or no flavor.  This brand is a nice middle ground with a pleasing texture.  I have purchased other Woodstock products and have always been pleased with the quality.

organic... non-gmo... and hot. some of the peas were borderline rock hard though, but not many. my only beef with these peas is that they are a product of malaysia. kinda sad that woodstock farms cant get any peas grown in the usa that arent GMO. good snack!

If you love wasabi and you want lots of it on your green peas then this is the product for you. I used to get my wasabi green peas from the local asian/oriental store. Yet, not only are they more expensive in the Asian store since they're imported, they do not have as much wasabi as this product

Just received my first order and consumed half a bag - couldn't put them down.  Not as hot as the last purchase I made at Clark's Nutrition and Natural Foods but I like them better this way.  My wife says she got a good wasabi kick in the back of the head.  Important is that I have NOT bitten into any rock hard peas - I was afraid of cracking a tooth with those from Clark's.  Glad I signed up for Subscribe and Save: delivery was only a day slower than using Prime and 15% less.  Definitely an item I will have shipped again.

Cinnabon Cereal is the most delectable item of consumable goods I've ever had the joy of masticating, let alone digesting! Every sickeningly sweet morsel is like a tiny bit of heaven for my taste buds, and now that they've been bathed in its cinnamon goodness, they can enjoy no other brand equally. My wife and I have started substituting `meals' for `rounds' of Cinnabon brand cereal. I mean, we could quit at any time but why would we? It's high in fiber!! Fiber is great because it speeds up your movements making room for more Cinnabon Cereal! It's a win-win!

This is my absolute new faaavorite cereal!!... SOOOOO good.. I've already eaten 2 boxes by myself.. In my opinion it is WAAY better than cinnamon toast crunch bc I feel like once you add milk to cinnamon toast crunch, it loses a lot of its cinnamon flavor whereas the cinnabons dont lose any flavor at all.. YUMMM :)

Cinnebon has an ultra-sweet cinnamon flavor in a cinnamon roll shape.  The texture is different than what I'm used to in a cereal.  When eaten dry, it practically disintegrates with the first bite.  I don't care for that, but it's only 12 grams of sugar per 1 cup serving.  Considering the sweetness, I thought it would be much more.

Does it taste better than cinnamon toast crunch? Honestly probably not. Does it taste amazing in milk? YES, it is the best waffle crisp imitation in milk that we have. For someone who has been missing waffle crisp for years, this is something great.It is hard on the roof of the mouth if you do not let it get wet first, so be sure to let it get as soggy as you can stand first.Since eating this more, I have to add that I think this tastes a lot better with soy milk (plain flavor) than real milk. It mixes a lot better that way in my opinion, and I like soy milk and "real" milk about equally just drinking either.

I was looking here for this cereal as it's been unavailable for weeks in our local grocery store. My husband loves this cereal and so do my grandkids. For what you charge for 1 box I could buy 3 boxes here. (yes, if it were available) Don't you have a conscience? It's appalling what you are charging.

I agree with the other review, cinnamon toast crunch is way better.  I was so excited when I found this cereal, and was excited to give it a try.  It doesnt have a very strong sweet cinnamon flavor at all, it is very bland.  Its ok but if I were to choose between cinnamon toast crunch and cinnabon cereal, I would go with the taste you can see lol  Cinnnamon toast crunch for those who dont know.  120 calories in one cup is not bad at all for a nice mild snack, but it just isnt my bowl of cereal.

This cereal has the heavenly aroma of Cinnabon cinnamon rolls when you open it, but the flavor when eating it is nothing special. It leaves a waxy, sugary film on the inside of your mouth. It seems to have the same extruded grain makeup as Cap'n Crunch Original Cereal, 16oz Boxes (Pack of 4), but not as hard (thank goodness-I haven't eaten Capn Crunch in years because it tears up the roof of my mouth). It really reminds me of Cookie Crisp Cereal, 11.25-Ounce Box (Pack of 6). Cinnamon Toast Crunch Cereal, 17-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 5) still has the best cinnamon flavor. It's pretty expensive, too. I probably won't buy it again.

This cereal taste great and has the perfect texture, some cereals taste great but the texture ends up hurting the roof of my mouth.  This one is crunchy, tasty, and just all around perfectly made, but it is very difficult to find.  I love it!!!  = (

column9: Doesn't taste like Cinnabon; tastes like Waffle Crisp
column10: The texture is really unique, it's rather hard and very crispy. Is it better than cinnamon toast crunch? The two can't even be compared. They're not very similar. It does taste a LOT like Waffle Crisp, though.

column9: Just right for more than salads!
column10: Superb on salads but also good for sandwiches and more.

I use this for making lavender bread which turns out amazing every time. (I also use it on chicken, making my own Herbes de Provence blend). It's just a nice consistent flavorful lavender, from box to box. I like that it's organic but especially that  Spicely owns all of its own facilities, so there's no chance of cross-contamination (with nuts, soy, or gluten, for example).The boxes are pretty small, so I go through a lot of them. (A larger 8-16 ounce container would be MUCH APPRECIATED to reduce the wasteful packaging) But excellent quality is never cheap. I'm glad to pay extra for a very good product. I used to live near near lavender fields where this sort of product was easily purchased in small family-owned shops. It's harder to find in stores or over the internet. So I'm thrilled to have discovered Spicely.Highly recommended.
This is fantastic for an office or reception area.  You can refill it with whatever you want- gumballs, peanuts, or M&Ms.  Provides a nice snack and it's fun for kids to use too.

column9: Dubble Bubble Gumball Machine well worth the money
column10: Bought this item for my 5 and 8 year old kids for Christmas.  They love it.  It was a good price and it arrived quickly.  I was a little concerned since it was plastic, but thus far it has held up well.

We use pretzel M&Ms in this for our three year olds during potty training.  It works 85% of the time.  Sometimes the M&Ms get stuck in the spiral.  The problem is that there is no way to get into the spiral part of the machine to get them loose.  There were a couple times where the M&M got stuck and we thought it would render the entire machine useless but we played around with it and luckily, it came out.  The coin mechanism is also inconsistant.  85% of the time, when you put a coin in it works.  Sometimes though, you have to turn it twice.
The gumballs get stuck constantly. Coins go into the spiral and get stuck as well. I have to constantly take it apart to fix problems. Don't waste your money!
This coffee is delicious and has great flavor!  The only downside is that it costs as much for the shipping as the coffee itself.

column9: that is the only coffee we drink
column10: Being German,and after 35 years in the U.S.,we are still drinking only Jacobs coffee.There is absolute no bitterness,the grind is perfect(no waste there) and no upset stomach due to much acid.Both of our children are active duty military,we have no problem with the supply,but if they are on deployment I order it from Amazon.com with free shipping.A morning without Jacobs coffee..... a nightmare  Chris  (PA)

column9: Wonderful coffee.  Watch for free shipping
column10: I have loved Jacobs coffee since visiting Germany in the 70s.  I always asked the service people I knew to get it from the commissary or the PX when they went.  They have trouble keeping it in stock.  With free Super Saving shipping, it is cheaper than buying good coffee at the store.This is a medium roast coffee with a rather low acid content. Just wonderful!

I was too young when my father was in the military to try this coffee. But, finally, I did. A very smooth, non-acidic coffee with no trace of bitterness and a lovely aroma and taste. I still prefer my Peet's Aged Sumatra but this one comes in second. Will definitely be buying more.

column9: Some of the Best Coffee out there
column10: Prices online are a bit steep, but I live in the Chicago area which has a sizable european immigrant population so I can find this coffee at many places at about $6 (plus tax)... The coffee itself is one of the best I have had, it is  ground very fine so using it in a french press may be a bit tricky, but works well in an drip machine. Everyone should give it a try!!

column9: I am addicted to this animal
column10: When I was working for AAFES I came across this in the Base Exchange. Later I joined the reserves and lived on this stuff. I had withdrawal symptoms when my reserve time came to an end.There is just no substitution. It does not taste burnt like Starbucks. The vacuum pack seems to last forever. When you open the pack you have to restrain you self from sniffing it up your nose. I keep the open pack in the frig; not like I have to as the family plows through a pack a week. For store bought coffee this rivals some of the more exotic sourced coffee.

Very avid espresso drinker. We have a DeLonghi super automatic espresso machine and these are our favorite beans so far: best flavor for the price. Smooth, rich, non-acidic, great crema. Usually drink shots, not mixed, so the pure espresso flavor is important. I have tried some beans from small roasters that I like a bit better, but they are MUCH more expensive than these and not worth the extra cost on a daily basis.

This espresso is good tasting and a good deal. I bought this because Green Mountain stopped selling my favorite espresso in the world (even better than Illy!).  So, I figured I would give this a try. IMO, it's not as great as the Green Mountain espresso (but then again, nothing is), but it is definitely a good tasting espresso, and I'll order it again.

Why oh why did Campbell's ever change this recipe?? The new recipe is NOTHING like the new one. The carrots & extra cheesy flavor makes this new recipe way too sweet rather then mild and salty like the old recipe.

I'm a chamomile tea fan--I drink it every night--and these tea K-cups are super delicious and convenient. I re-use the same K-cup for several tea cups' worth, though the resulting tea gets significantly weaker with each re-use. Tastes like real chamomile, though I have to admit, it's not QUITE as strong as a real tea bag. Nevertheless, I wouldn't trade this K-cup for another. Cheers!

The tea meets my expectatons for Twinnings.  The flavor was full and smooth.  I do wish that the one could make a larger cup of tea from the k-cups.  Tea servings over 6 oz. are a little weak for my taste.
This is the best Camomile tea for Keurig.  We have a cup every night... LOVE IT!!!!

I originally bought Timothy's camomile tea and really liked it, but the price has doubled since then. I found this to be a great bargain and is just as good. I stocked up on it as the k cup prices seem to be getting out of control now.

column9: OK, but not as good as the Timothy's version
column10: I purchased this for my wife, a dedicated tea drinker.  She reported that it is "OK" but not as good as the K-Cup version packed as Timothy's Camomile.  Won't get this one again

column9: Okay, but this tea is missing something
column10: This tea is not bad, but far from really good.  Sleepy time is wonderful, but this is just the base for that tea with a lot better stuff put into it.  If you want a really good tea, this is not it.

A great full flavored tea...not flavored sawdust or imitation. It's the real deal. Great for colds, flu &/or sinus congestion. This is 100% the real stuff. In the K Cup, it's ready in a minute or less.

column9: OK, but lids on few cups were glued on slightly off and they overflowed; taste is off
column10: I would not buy again.  In fact, after my bad experience with their English tea [burst cups], I would not buy another Twinings K-cup, any flavor.Chamomile taste was off, something was bothering me.  Could not knock off the weird smell even with sugar and honey.  Tried cold too, same problem.

It's hard to find pure chamomille tea in K-cup form.  I do like Twinings brand, and I am glad to have found it.  I found one other brand, but it doesn't taste as 'clean' as the Twinings. I recommend it for true Chamomille lovers!
This product is great!!!!! I drink it every night before I go the bed, and I just love it....even cold on ice is great!

I have a glass of this tea every night before bed. It tastes great and is calming like most Twinings teas I have tried. I can usually get two small glasses of tea out of one K-Cup- Still tastes good and strong ;)

My family and I have been adding Chia seeds to our diet for sometime.  We decided to spend the money on some healthy snacks and these babies take the cake.  Our two boys love them, and they make a fine breakfast bar, along with some raw seeds.
These FruitChia bars are delicious & nutritious!  We have ordered them a few times, and share them with friends.  They like them as well.

I'm training for a half marathon and I've just discovered these bars as a source of natural fuel for before my workouts. I had half a bar before my run tonight and half a bar after and it felt light on my stomach and I had steady energy throughout.So many energy bars out there are full of junk (and things I'm allergic to) and this is natural, portable and is nicely sweet - like the fruit that it is. Very minimal ingredients - fruit and chia seeds. A GREAT option for anyone trying to keep with whole foods. I also love the chia in it  - the crunch is nice and I feel good eating chia, so it's a bonus for me.Drink a little water with anything with chia in it as they absorb water. A great product - I will be taking a whole bunch of these with me for the marathon and to have handy for training! Seems like a healthy option for kids, too - softer than a fruit leather and not too sweet. Grateful to be finding more healthy products out there like this.

I love these things. I have tried the strawberry and raspberry. They are just great. I get them from Whole Foods for $1.99 per bar. Sometimes they go on sale for $1.19 per bar, but sadly, they do not go on sale often enough! Next time they do, I am going to load up on them. I really wish that I could find them cheaper so that I can buy them in bulk. However, I will continue to buy them. Really really good for me.

I love this product. When I'm hungry and dragging and don't have time to stop and eat I just grab one of these fruit bars and I'm good for hours.I keep then in my purse and desk at work and stashed in my car. They are great and so yummy.

DISCLAIMER: Since I am not anaphylactic to corn, I cannot say whether they are safe enough for someone who is.I recently found these FruitChia Bars at Whole Paycheck for just under two bucks a bar and decided to buy one of each flavor to test them out.  These are pretty tasty bars with a little crunch from the chia seeds.  If you have some gaps in your teeth or a lot of dental work, these little chia seeds may get stuck and you might find yourself digging them out afterward.  Chia seeds are similar in size to poppy seeds.I am intolerant to corn and all its derivatives.  I have found I feel better when I also avoid all grains, dairy, yeast, soy and other legumes, (chicken) eggs, potatoes, and refined sugars.  That makes finding any prepackaged food that is also safe for me, a rarity.  I'm currently trialing these and haven't noticed any reaction, but I'm not as reactionary as many other of my corn allergic friends.  For now, I would say if there are any corn derivatives used in the manufacturing, processing, or packaging, it's minimal, so anyone who calls themselves "corn light" (able to handle some small traces and cross contaminations) would probably be okay trialing these.  My son reacts to gluten more so than any of his other multiple food intolerances, and he has been fine with these as well.

Love all the flavors. These bars have great taste and texture. Pefect instead of a peice of fruit for traveling. The seeds give them a nice crunch. Everyone that I have let try one of these has loved them as well.

Great idea to add L-Theanine, Lemongrass extract, Ginseng, and Gingko Biloba into a tasty carbonated drink. L-Theanine is derived from tea leaves, and seems to be the newest trend for people that want to just chill. The price is a little expensive to drink on a regular basis, but the 4 pack is more reasonably priced (I'd buy cases if I were a millionaire). I've only tried the Tropical Chill flavor, and can tell you that this is dabomb. I'm pretty positive though that one day this formula will be mainstream, and replicated like the energy drinks have been. This drink really will take the edge off, and make you feel less anxious. The Chill Group out of California will always be remembered by me as the pioneers of this refreshing drink that helps you "just chill".
I thought I was buying a two-pack of this item because of the picture. But it's a single bottle even though the description doesn't say that.I rate the product 5 stars and the vendor 1 star.

Check with your Vet, but start your dogs off right and keep their joints flexible.  You will sure be glad you did as you watch your loved pet enjoy the latter stages of their lives with more mobility.  Worth the cost.  Check with your Vet before you begin giving these supplements to your dog on a daily basis.

I needed a very good product for my dogs in the Vetri-Science Glyco-Flex Stage II joint support.  This product came highly recommended from my Vet.  I reviewed the Amazon site for what I thought was a good price when the Ad showed 2 bottles of the product.  I thought I was getting two bottles for the price.  I only received One bottle.  I wrote the company customer Services who agreed that the two bottles was misleading and they would get back to me the next day after she talked to her supervisor.  That was on December 13 and today is December 23 and still no response, even after 3 other emails from me.  This company is very, very poor in customer service as well and misleading in their ads.  I believe that Amazon is partially at blame for this problem and that this company should no longer be able to sell their products from Amazon Market.  Avoid PetFoodDirect.com because you will get taken.
Don't order this product if you think you're getting two bottles.  Only one bottle arrived and I'm having a wonderful time trying to get my refund.  Fool me once, shame on you.

The gum is great, the flavor is very intense. The only downside to this gum, and the reason for 4 stars, is its juiciness only lasts for about 10 minutes. The flavor remains, but this is definitely a gum thats only worth about 30-60 minutes, and probably why I enjoyed it so much as a kid before spitting it out or sticking it to a desk <.<

This product was very fresh...Much fresher than I have been able to get at local retail stores...It was very flavorful and met my expectations.  I would definately recommend this product to anyone who loves grape flavored candy products...Great Product.

It's just like it was when I was little. You really can't find grape gum anymore like this. I bought the gum, and it came early. The overall case of 18 packs is wrapped in clear plastic. The gum was well packed and fresh.
We have been searching for grape gum in this area for a long time.  Gave it to a friend as a Valentines gift.  Thanks!
This gum still has all the "grape-like flavor" I remember from my childhood.  The box was shipped inside a sealed cellophane over-wrap.  So, if you want to get more than 1 box it will stay fresh.
The gum was great and fresh.  Delivery was faster than i expected. I am very satidfued with this purchase.

Spices from this company have all been fresh and delicious. Delivery was timely and as promised. I'm sorta pasting the same review for all the spices I bought from this company because all have been of outstanding quality.

I was pleasantly surprised at the quality of the product. The freshness is nothing compared to what you would find in the grocery store, and my kitchen was filled with the fragrance when I ground a tablespoon in a mortar and pestle for a dish I was preparing. I also ordered several other herbs and spices from this company and was not disappointed in any of them.
I couldn't find  this spice in regular stores, so it was nice to be able to order it online.  The package provided more than I will probably use.  I should have ordered a smaller package.

The Cumin seeds are of exellent quality, much better than what I have tried in the spice section of the grocery store. I recommend ordering spices in large quantities, they are more fragrant, the price was good also.
I cook a lot and find buying Spices in bulk the way to go. It is much more economical than the small jars in the at the supermarket.

column9: Made my dog sick; $400 vet bill.
column10: I bought these for my 3 month-old lab. I also bought some other treats (dehydrated liver, Kong biscuits, bully sticks). 1-2 days after feeding these to my lab she got violently ill -- vomiting and diarrhea. Took her to the vet and after an overnight stay and IV fluids, the vet had no idea what it was. They decided to x-ray her to see if something was blocking her intestines. Nothing. After antibiotics and rest she was back to her normal high energetic self. I gave her more of these sweet potato fries about a week after her first sickness episode.... and 24 hrs later she was vomiting again.  I was worried, but figured that it must be something I was feeding her. I then examined the package and saw these are made in China.  I threw them out and my puppy has been fine since. Logic points to these treats.... I will no longer buy food items for my dog from China. Nobody else has posted anything about ill reactions to these treats, but search around, lots of dog treats from China are making our dogs sick.

I got a dog from the SPCA a few months ago, and learned that in addition to being slightly overweight, he also requires a grain-free diet due to allergies. He also can't have chicken and a few other things, which makes it hard to find treats I can give him. My vet suggested these, since she gives them to her own dogs. My little guy loves them! They're also low calorie, so I can provide them liberally without worrying. I have since shared some with friends, and their dogs love them, too. I have seen these in my local pet shop for a few dollars more, so I think the price is good. I've gone through a couple of containers by now and my dog still comes running for them when I say "treat!". Highly recommend these.
THESE POTATO FRIES ARE AS HARD AS ROCKS.I KNOW THAT THE SUPERMARKET HAS POTATO FRIES AND THEY ARE SOFT CHEWABLES. THESE POTATO FRIES ARE STALE. DO NOT BUY!!
Ordered this product before and contents were very soft and fresh.  This time contents were hard and dry.I was very disappointed but my little puppy was even more disappointed.

column9: Not the same quality as previous purchases
column10: I used to buy these from Amazon at least 2-3 times a month.  The last 2 shipments were hard as a rock and the potatoes looked like plastic.  I definitely did not give these to my shih tzu. The treats used to be softer and you could tear them into smaller pieces.  The last ones I received I couldn't even cut with a knife.  I won't be buying these any more until I start seeing some positive reveiws.

These are manufactured in China.While my little Maltese absolutely loves these, I can no longer risk his life by buying anything for him to eat that is made in China.  It seems that every couple of months in the news, there is a new set of canine deaths being reported by owners who fed their dog(s) food or treats manufactured in China.  It is really scary.My dog is like family to me.  I'm not going to risk his life or a huge vet bill to save a buck or two on food made in China by a culture of people that lace toys they sell us with lead and other harmful chemicals.

After reading the negative review about the person's dog getting ill from these, I had to add my own 2 cents.  Like that person, I never buy anything made outside of the US for my dogs.  Until I bought these, on accident.  I can sympathize with his dog getting ill -- but I have 7 dogs and they all love these and have never gotten sick.  I keep the jar (love that it's a jar) by the door as a potty treat reward.  They love them.  I have all different breeds and sizes.  Even a bulldog with a sensitive tummy.  She has no problem with these.  These are the only treats I will buy from another country.  They're healthy, low calorie and my dogs will come inside from way back in the yard for these!Update 11/28/11:  Ordered my third jar of these and they were hard as a rock.  Not fresh and pliable as the first two jars.  Contacted Amazon CS, who wanted me to return them for credit.  Too much of a hassle...I tossed them.  Not buying these anymore.  Switching to another brand. Freshness date was many months away so it wasn't a rotate stock issue.  Changed my star rating from 5 stars to 1 star.

Wanted to give my dogs a different type of treat other than the standard dog biscuit and decided to try these. My dogs absolutely love these sweet potato fries.  All I have to do is reach for the jar and  I've got their undivided attention. Will keep buying these as long as Amazon offers them at this price.
My dog has food allergies. She is not supposed to have any beef or chicken products.  This limits the kind of treats she can have.  She loves the sweet potato treats!

My dog loves these treats more than anything else. They are a nice change from the dry biscuit or meat flavored treats. This shipped in a timely manner. The lid has to twist all the way off in order to get treats out.
My dog loves these treats.  The order was received in a timely manner.  I like having the plastic jar as it is much easier for storage than the bags.
Have ordered twice before...first time they were nice and soft, second time, HARD!Hopefully by now the company is aware of this. Gonna try again and if they are hard, I will never order these again.
My dogs weigh about 50 pounds each.  They really like the chewy dried sweet potato.  The pieces are large, and difficult to cut, so smaller dogs may not be able to chew them easily.
i have three dogs and they LOVE these.  i just ordered again and will buy again and again.  great price!
I have a 13 year old pug and he eats EVERYYHING but would not touch these treats.  I tried several times but wouldnt take a bite.  Threw them in the garbage.

Yep, this is yet another winner in my household. All 7 dogs jump for this treat and devour it like I never even gave them a treat in the first place. I get jumps and spins and barks for this winner of a treat! This will be on my staple of list of things to buy!

i'm noticing some people complaining that in recent times the sweet potato treets are coming "hard as a rock"...i too have gotten them that way and frankly don't understand why one shipment can be perfect while another can be so "off", but Ive figured out a way i can still give them to my dogs and they can still enjoy them and they don't go to waste (frankly they're too expensive to) ... have 2 dogs, so i usually give them 2-3 sticks each per serving. i take them put them in a small bowl put enough water in the bowl so they are floating and then microwave them for exactly 22 seconds, then let them sit for about a minute, afterward i swirl them around in the bowl , them drain out the hot water and then put some cold water in the bowl to cool them down, drain again, dry them a little on a paper towel and then give them to the dogs...they actually like them better this way, they're still chewy but warm and softer. You might give it a try.
Got he item in due time .  Mydogs beg for them every morning after they eat their dog food.  Highly recommend the item

column9: Company changed the way these are made for the WORST
column10: My dogs LOVED the former sliced and dehydrated type.The "new" ones are so processed and formed they drop immediately and leave them lay.By the time I opened this container the return time had expired.  DO NOT BUY!The good reviews are for the former type which WERE great treats.
My dog will choose this treat over almost anything else. I like them because she can't devour them in 2 bites, she must actually chew for a bit. Thanks for a great product!

My pitbull has extreme allergies and this is one treat she can actually have. I normally can get this locally at Target, however the sell out quick so I thought I would get them here online. I have order 4 different times and they are always hard as a rock. These treats are suppose to be pliable and soft, not hard and stale.
My dogs love these things. All natural product so they are a better treat for them. The dogs line up every night and can't wait to get the bed time snack !

Our dog really likes these treats. We used to buy another brand of dried sweet potato fries, but they apparently have quit making the sweet-potato only treats.  The Beefeaters brand dried sweet potato fries have the consistency of stiff leather, so our dog actually chews them instead of swallowing them whole.

My dog just loves these treats.  Wish I could buy them locally, I have not found any stores that still carry this product.  Have ordered before with little problems.  This time the seal was broken and the treats were as hard as a ROCK!!!  not worth shipping them back, and will never purchase again!!

My pup has been eating these since she was just 8 weeks old and she LOVES them (she's 5 months now).  I cut them up into bite-sized pieces and that way it lasts forever.  These treats are also very chewy so your dog actually has spend some time to eat these instead of snarfing them down.  That's probably the best part of these, to me.
My dogs loves these and they are so good for them. Everyone should get this product and you will see what I mean.
Lots of treats and for the price they cant be beat !!! I have always liked these because they dont make your hand smell bad after handling them.
This is Bailey's favorite treat.  I tried other brands and he did not like.  The beefeaters are his favorite.  I think they are better for him than many other treats.
My dog has a sensitive stomach so this product helps to control the acid level in his stomach when he is eating his meals.
I thought I would receive a much larger canister for the price. It sure doesn't seem like one pound of sweet potato fries dog snacks.

These cookies are AMAZING and the texture is excellent considering that they're totally vegan. I got turned on to these cookies before I became veg and IMO the pumpkin and lemon cookies are the best. Not a fan of the "chocolate chip", unfortunately, but I had no problem, texture-wise, with the lemon and pumpkin flavors at all.
I am in a baking family...my daughters sell their home baked cookies. We have yet to find a recipe as good as this for Lemon Poppyseed cookies! So happy to find them on-line. Delish!

I love lemon and poppyseed, but this cookie is horrible.  It tastes really horrible.  I couldn't get past a few bites.  Something about the taste, the texture.  It was all bad.  I feel really bad giving low ratings.  I take pleasure in giving good ratings.  But I being honest.

My son want to make bubble tea at home so I ordered this kit.It didn't taste anything like the bubble tea we have had, it justtastes like chemicals. We couldn't even drink it. The tapioca pearlswere very chewey.I am going to return it. Oops, their return policy doesn't allow returns of food.

These are great treats for training as they are small, about the size of a penny/nickle. My dog can't have grain so these are perfect for her. I also love that they are made in the USA. Considering that they are grain free and made in the USA the price is certainly reasonable. I'd say you get about 20 per bag.

column9: Beautiful but hart to keep organized
column10: It is hard to put the capsie in the right position specially if you need to dig one from the lower rows.But when organized, it is beautiful.

column9: Tastes good, salt is WAY too coarse to stick to popcorn.
column10: Gourmet Popcorn Seasoning AssortmentI got some popcorn and seasoning salt in the same package by/from Wisconsinmade.  The popcorn popped up quite nicely in my hot air popper.The seasoning salt was was much too coarse to stick to the popcorn--even when I used vegetable oil spray.  I bought a mortar and pestle to re-grind the salt down to a fine grain like the size of butter-flavored popcorn salt from the grocery store. When I get the mortar-pestle, I will grind the salt down to the size it should have been in the first place.It is an inexpensive product and not worth the hassle to send it back.  The popcorn seasoning salt likely the worst designed/made product I ever bought from Amazon.com.Admittedly, I have only tried one flavor so far.  The grain size was so far off the mark, I have no problems writing this less-than-positive review.  Man has been grinding salt for at least 5000 years, it is not that complicated to differentiate between rock salt, table salt and a finely ground powder.
Now these I reaLLY enjoy.  Popcorn has taken on a whole new flavor.  I would buy thjese again and I do reccomend them.

Re: Twinings Fruit Bliss Cranberry, Raspberry and Elderflower TeaRecently visited with a friend and had a delicious cup of the Twinings Fruit Bliss Cranberry, Raspberry and Elderflower Tea. I have never tasted a tea as delicious as this one so much so that I have decided to order it for my home.I have used Twinings Teas for so many years and would not buy anything other than Twinings. It is so refreshing to unwind from the day with a cup of Twinings tea.Thank you so much for making the most delicious teas.Sincerely,Marsha KimmelmanMarshala@aol.com

column9: Thank you for carrying this product, but...
column10: I was going to visit a friend in a foreign country where fruity tea is a rarity, and since she specifically requested this particular brand and flavor, I started the search in my neighborhood grocery stores. From the very high end to the mom and pop shop, I couldn't find this particular flavor, that's when I turned to Amazon.Fortunately, it is available through a seller store but I was shocked to find that the shipping and handling cost almost as much as the price of the product. In other words, for the price for 3 boxes of tea, you only get 2. But since this is the only place I can find it, I paid the price. My only consolation is that my friend's happiness is priceless.To give the seller the benefit of the doubt, I think the effort was to keep the fragile paper box intact as it arrives. But my friend didn't care for the box, she even suggested that I "discard the box and put the tea bags in a ziplock bag" for easier fit in the suitcase.If I may suggest that the store offer different types of packaging options, such as the highest priced and most sturdy package, or less sturdy (a plastic wrap to prevent the product gets wet in the process of shipping, in a large bubble envelop, for example) but more reasonable price, it would be great.
Works like a charm and does the job. The price is awesome! It's like only a dollar :) it floats my boat!

Torani Salted Caramel Syrup is so delicious. I first got to try it thanks to She Speaks. It was sent to me and and I was very skeptical. We were not sure how it would taste. I first put it in hot chocolate and all I can say is wow! We all really liked the flavor and well it went with hot chocolate and a little cool whip on top. Our next creation was choclate smoothies. Again it was another hit. The flavor is rich, but not overpowering. I now have bought it and it has replaced my want for coffee shop drinks. We really enjoyed it and will keep buying it for our occasional treats.

This syrup is incredibly tasty! I add it to my lattes and the taste reminds me of caramel popcorn. As a fan of all the Torani syrups, I would definitely recommend this one as one of their best flavors.

First of all, one of the reviews was not aware of the type of product this ACTUALLY is.  This is a FLAVORING type of syrup, as with all Torani Syrups...they are additives for other items...hot drinks, recipes, etc.  They are not made to be eaten as a typical type of "pancake" type of syrup.  Clearning this issue up for everyone, since the bad review person wasn't aware of what he/she was purchasing, this is AN EXCELLENT flavor.  I add to coffee, tea, and hot drinks and it adds so much flavor to everything.  This flavor is one of the newest in the Torani line and is absolutely marvelous!  It's sweet, caramel, and with a hint of a salty flavor which makes it an excellent "ADDITIVE" type of syrup (as it was designed to be!).

The picture on theis product makes it look like it really *is* a caramel syrup.  IT IS NOT!!  If you want something that is just caramel colored watery stuff, then go ahead and order it.. but if you are looking for an actual caramel syrup, this product is NOT for you!

I tried some stevia products after I recently went on a sugar-free diet and this was one of the products I bought. I missed having my chocolate milk so I was very glad to find this product. Now I can have a little sweetness without going off of my sugar-free diet :)

column9: Kids LOVED it added to Hot Milk!
column10: I ordered this product to give it a try. I added about 8 teaspoons of the supplement to 4 cups of goat's milk on the stove top, heated to around 105 degrees. (It mixed well around 95 degrees- for a cold drink, I might tend to mix a small amount of liquid with the mix into a paste and then add the rest of the liquid- you know how difficult cocoa is to mix sometimes.)Poured the hot beverage into cups for my 3 boys, and they said "it is great! How often can we have this as a treat?"Now, we love Stevita flavored supplements for our cold milk- some favorites are Toffee, Vanilla, and Chocolate. My oldest makes concoctions with all 3 flavors in his cold milk drinks. I just purchased the Mango, and it is super in my hot tea.

My 2 picky sugar loving boys love this chocolate stevia.  I have not tasted it for myself.  You do have to put a little liquid in the cup, mix it really well and then add the rest of your liquid.  This is a great substitue for chocolate milk and hot chocolate without all the sugar and artifical junk in it. We mix it with rice or hemp milk since they don't drink milk.  It really doesn't take as much as the package says- we use about 1/4 tsp. for 8 oz. and they are happy with that so a little container goes a long way.
This stuff makes AWESOME chocolate milk. Just add 2 tsp (only 13 calories) to 2 cups of milk, and stir. Yum!!! I have seen the future and it is Stevita Delight.

Based on the other reviews I purchased this product. I have been using stevia for over 15 years, so I know the ins and outs of using it pretty well, and I love it.I currently mix droche cocoa powder with stevia powder for a hot chocolate drink and it definitely has a super dark chocolate flavor which i like.So when I saw this product I thought I'd try it...what a complete disappointment. It tasted horrible. It's taste reminded me of what fresh potting soil smells like, and it left gritt in my mouth...so unless i happened to get a bad batch of this and they cut it with soil, don't buy this. Hopefully, me wasting my money saves you from wasting yours. Make your own with cocoa powder.Also this is what the usage directions on the lable read exactly...  "Suggested Use: Blend 2 1 sp in Oz liquid".  Did ya get that?I went by serving size which was 2 tsp.I did order the strawberry and orange mixes also, but haven't received them yet.Hopefully these are better.
I think this product is GREAT! I mix 2 tsp with low fat milk and a couple of ice cubes - it turns out frothy and delicious! Even my 2 year old loves it.

I didn't know what to expect but bought some and put in w/my almond milk (no sweetener) w/fruit and protein powder, added some extra stevia because I like it sweeter and it's great!! Stevia sweetener is the best and only sweetener I will use, other than agave nectar. From the research I've done, it's the only one that is not harmful in any way and wish the FDA would get off their rears and allow companies to add stevia to food. It's alot healthier than sugar in "any" form and alot better than all of those truly chemical artificial sweeteners.

Stevita Co. Inc. ~ DELIGHT ~ Cocoa with Stevia SAVE with free shipping offerThis product is ok. I was disappointed that the chocolate flavor is not very intense. It is quite sweet so if you add more power to get more chocolate flavor, it gets too sweet. It leave a grainy residue in the bottom of the drink too.

This Chocolate drink mix is great.  I drink rice milk and it even makes that drinkable.  So i can only imagine how it would make regular milk taste.  it reminds me of nestles quick from the way it smells to the way it tastes.  no sugar and no calories and no artificial ingredients.  You only need to use a tiny bit,  this thing will last a long time depending on how many people are using it.
Put this in my vanilla flavored coffee and it was wonderful. Tried it in Hazelnut coffee and it was wonderful. I ordered 3 more jars.

I have used this product as a chocolate milk sugar-free substitute for the past 2 years and will continue to buy it!  I have never had trouble with the product mixing into my milk but then I have a bullet that I blend my drinks with so maybe that's the difference.  Satisfies my chocolate craving every time.

I bought some of this a few months back, and tried it. I was so amazed at good it tasted. I thought it tasted like oreos. My husband who hates anything with stevia even liked it. He couldn't even tell it was stevia. I have gone through a couple of jars now. We just love it. My 3 year old also loves it. I use a little less than it recommends 1 1/2 tsp. instead of 2 tsp. for 2- 2 1/2 c.  but we love this stuff, it is awesome!!!!

If you are diabetic like me, and allergic to aspartame ( which I am ), you will miss things like chocolate milk.. This product came to the rescue! I found that just a small amount is needed to make a 12 ounce glass of milk, or a bowl of fat free greek yogurt ( way less than you might think, Stevia is VERY sweet compared to sugar. I found the trick for me, is to put about a 4th of a teaspoon of Stevita in little bit of hot tap water, and mix it well, creating a sort of syrup. Then when you add your milk, it doesn't leave little lumps of Stevita floating on the top of your chocolate milk ( kind of like what happens with Ovaltine, which I also used to love ) I found that if I over do adding it to the milk it is too sweet, and doesn't taste as good as when you use just a little. Of course "Your Milage May Vary(tm)"Personally, I am just happy to be able to have a glass of chocolate milk again. I hope that more companies give us a stevia option instead of the usual sugar, high fructose corn syrup, and aspertame. I will be buying this product again ( but the beauty of it, is you don't need a lot, so the jar lasts a looong time :-)

I love flavored stevia, and this is one of my favorites!  Also, Stevita is an awesome brand.  I buy their product line regularly and am very pleased.This product tastes very good to me with a medium degree chocolate flavor.  I mix it with my protein shakes to turn a vanilla into chocolate, or make a chocolate more chocolaty (I'm a chocolate lover).  What I love about this product is that it is tasty, low in calories (13 calories for two teaspoons I believe), and sweetened with all natural stevia. I make it a point to never consume anything with harmful, poisonous chemicals such as sucralose or aspartame, so the fact that this is sweetened with stevia is extremely important.The container does not come with a spoon or scooper, so be certain you have a measuring teaspoon to use with it if you are counting calories and need to be exact.  Inside the container, it looks and feels similar to cocoa.Taste is personal and particular, but I do so enjoy this and recommend it.  I hope you like it too!

The chocolate flavor is very strong, very nice. The stevia content is high so it was difficult to find the right balance. The directions for use on the bottle are a little vague, but I would suggest starting with 1/4 flat tsp. per 8 oz. cup of liquid (milk, soy milk, coffee, etc.) then work your way up till it tastes as you want. Don't over do or you'll end up with that Stevia aftertaste.

Very chocolatey and not too sweet.  The first time I used it I used way too much (about 4 tsp to 1 liter of water).  It doesn't take very much to add great flavor.  So far I have only mixed it into water, but I can tell it would be awesome in milk, too.  The flavor isn't like qwick or similar chocolate milk mixes, it is more like chocolate made with cocoa.  This is a great way to get a low calorie sweet treat.

I have been looking for a healthy chocolate milk/hot cocoa mix that my family would enjoy.  This product was recommended to me by a friend.  We really enjoy the taste of Stevita Delight.  I find that it works best to mix it in milk with a small wisk.  We also mix it in the Pampered Chef 2 quart juice container with plunger.  Any time we would like to drink some we are able to mix it with the plunger. This way we are able to make a lot of it at one time.
I am trying to eat a low carbohydrate diet.  Mix this with your liquid of choice, some ice and put it in the blender until thick.  It satisfies my cravings and tastes really good.

I really thought that I could make a sugar-free chocolate milk or have something to have in my cocoa since I'm trying to reduce my sugar intake. This product is horrible. It doesn't dissolve into solution (hot or cold) and tastes chalky and not at all sweet. Just breakdown and use the extra calories with the agave nectar. It has calories but is much better than wasting your money on this low-cal alternative.
Not thrilled with this product it doesn't have that great of a taste  I was hoping for a replacement to my sugar free chocolate syrup but this isnt that greta

It seems you either love or hate this stuff, and I fall into the former group. A warning about my preferences, though... I don't care for cocoa that's heavy on the chocolate flavor. Dark chocolate tastes bitter to me. When I was still drinking Quik, I would cut the serving size in half.I use a Back to Basics Cocoa-Latte machine to make cocoa. I've never tried this stuff in cold milk. It's not too sweet, but like all stevia products, you have to be careful about how much you add. If you put in too much, it has a strong aftertaste. Each person's threshold is different, so you may need to tweak the serving size.The only drawback I can think of is it seems to precipitate out of liquid fairly quickly, so if you don't keep stirring or drink it fast you'll end up with sludge in the bottom of your cup.

I was really excited about this and am am left underwhelmed.  It mixed weird and has a strange taste. I have been trying to use more Stevia as opposed to the toxic, chemical artificial sweeteners.  And I love the Stevita brand individual water mixes.  The "better" Crystal Light packets.  Not a huge fan of this product though.

column9: GREAT with raw milk - glad I found this stuff
column10: This is a treat and a half for me --- when I mix it with raw milk.  Fantastic flavor and very close to Nestles Quik in taste in my opinion.  Much better for you too.  Delicious!

I use this primarily for hot chocolate milk and chocolate-flavored coffee, and it's delicious and guilt-free. A heaping teaspoon in a large cup of milk is the amount I use, and gives a good strong chocolate flavor. It does leave a gritty residue at the bottom of the cup but just skip that last sip or two and it's not a problem. I'm ordering another couple of jars.

This didn't have a lot of chocolate taste for the recommended serving size.  Or the right amount of sweetener.  I had to add a spoonful of Hershey's unsweetened cocoa powder and a few more drops of stevia to get my desired taste.  I could have just started with that and left out the fancy product.....

I realize that when it comes to taste, To each his own, but I have to agree with the reviewers who say this tastes terrible. When you mix this with just plain water or milk, it tastes nothing like any chocolate or chocolate drink I've ever had. I've had pure Mexican chocolate in drinks. Perhaps it is good for mixed drinks--Cafe Mochas, flavored coffees... This doesn't beat any chocolate mix that's in the US market. I'm going back to Qwik.
This is some real good coco to use.  My husband is a diabetic and I purchased this for him to try, he liked it and so did our sons.  I recommend this product to anyone wanting cocoa.
THIS WAS THE WORSE STUFF EVER  IT TASTED HORRIBLE AND I BOUGHT TWO AND THEY WILL GO IN THE TRASH  TASTES NOTHING LIKE HOT CHOCOLATE

This is a good Chocolate, Stevia combination. I just wish it came with instructions or a web-site for ideas for using it. I have only used it for cocoa. Caution, it is strong, start with 1 teaspoon, then gradually increase if you need more.
Absolutely delicious is all I can say. I put this in my coffee to make a hot mocha drink. I'm going to start putting it in smoothies. It's very versatile.

I got this because I love stevia, I love chocolate, it sounded wonderful.  IT WAS AWFUL!!! UGH!!!  I tried it like the directions said, tried mixing it with coffee, tried putting it in milk, tried adding sugar, tried it cold, hot, room temp, I just didn't want to admit it was really this bad.  I really really wanted to like this.  But I couldn't.Don't buy it.  Seriously yuck!!!

I had high hopes for this product. I love chocolate milk, and I use stevia to replace sugar whenever I can. Unfortunately, this stuff was just gross. I even tried it a second time hoping that I would like it better, but it was still too gross to drink.

This is terrible and does not meet the expectations.  I thought that I could add to water and it would give it a good taste but it was terrible.  Maybe it would be better with milk but I do not drink milk.

I love the Beaver Brand Chinese mustard.  It is the best and closest to a chinese reasturant mustard. I have tried many other brands and none compare to this.

Yes, the drawback is that this gum doesn't last as long as the Aspartame gums, but the trade off is that it's actually good for you.  Go google Xylitol and see the benefits.  So now I actually give my daughter this gum after meals and usually whenever she wants because it's that good (I consider it like if she wanted to eat vegetables all the time, I would let her). I've tried this flavor, fruit, and peppermint, and they all rock!  Enjoy!

I also like the fact that they label their packaging as to how many grams or milligrams each piece has in its ingredients. The flavor in Xyloburst seems to last a bit longer than most others... and it's fresh. Am looking forward to trying more of what Xyloburst has to offer in candy and gum.

My wife and I recently purchased a bottle while in SW Texas. column9: This product was not properly described.
column10: The product that I received is partly vanillin, an artificial vanilla.  I expected to get PURE mexican vanilla.  Naturally I was disappointed.

Sure, it's not 100% pure vanilla extract.  That's indicated quite clearly in the ingredients.  Molina vanilla is made with a mixture of pure vanilla extract and synthetic vanillin.  Personally I love its strong distinctive flavor, regardless of what percentage pure vanilla extract it is.  For those who feel it's too strong, use half the amount listed in the recipe.  I know a couple of people who do this when using Molina Vanilla.  Again, I like the flavor, so I use the full amount called for in the recipe.  This stuff has a great flavor that really kicks things up a notch.

column9: Delicious and potent!  (Do not use in making home made icrecream - vanillin is a natural agent that increases freezing temp)
column10: I did not purchase this item on amazon, but have purchased several bottles at a local Mexican food market.  It's flavor is phenomenal.  I add vanilla to a lot more than calls for it and have used many different brands of vanilla, including ones bought across the border in Mexico.  This is the best I've tasted thus far.  Do not be frightened away by the "vanillin" content.  Vanillin is natural and occurs during the fermentation process of the beans.  It is not harmful.  The Propylene Glycol in the vanilla increases the freezing temperature of whatever you are making - so if using this for home made icre cream, wait until the VERY end of the freezing process to add the vanilla.  I paid just over $6 for a 33oz bottle at the Mexican super market.  Google-maps it, you may have one near by.  It is delicious vanilla and MUCH cheaper than it's competitors!

column9: Vanillin is NOT artificial vanilla! Read up before you slam!
column10: This is amazing tasting vanilla and contrary to what others are saying it does not contain artificial vanilla. Vanillin is the crystalline substance that forms on the outside of the beans as they ferment. There is also an "artificial vanillin, but that is NOT what is contained here!. The following quote is from "The Joy of Baking": The beans are first plunged into hot water and then the 'drying' and 'sweating' process starts.  The beans are dried in the sun during the day and then wrapped in the blankets at night so they can sweat.  This process can last anywhere from 2 to 6 months until the beans become a very dark brown color and develop a white crystalline substance (or frost) on the outside of the bean, called vanillin.  The vanillin is what gives the beans their wonderful flavor and aroma and these beans are prized. [...]So PLEASE, disregard these other bad reviews and try this. It is a STEAL!

column9: Vanilla Flavor that you cannot Miss
column10: After you try Mexican Vanilla and for the price you will never go back to buying store bought vanilla - it's a rip off. This Bottle of Vanilla is wonderful and it will last you a very long time.

A friend brought me a large bottle back from his trip to Mexico.  I threw out all the other store bought vanilla bottles I had.  They do not compare to this one.  It has a strong, rich flavor.  I add to it everything I can.  My chocolate chip cookies and french toast could not be complete without Molina Vanilla.

In response to those who say this is no different than typical artificial vanilla, Molina Vanilla actually contains both real Mexican vanilla and artificial vanillin. It's much different than the stuff you'd buy in the supermarket. If you don't believe me, do a side by side taste test. You'll immediately notice that the Molina vanilla is much more aromatic, with a fuller range of flavor.  Personally I prefer Molina vanilla over both artificial vanilla and even the typical pure Madagascar vanilla.  I would recommend it to anyone.

A friend brought this back for me from Mexico and now, I can't go back to anything else.  I even bought a very large bottle of 100% pure vanilla extract after my bottle of Molina was gone and could not bear it, I dumped it down the sink. I don't even want to try anything else.

I know it's not pure, but I honestly think it has a much better taste and smell then any "pure" vanilla extract I have had. I always can taste the alcohol in pure vanilla extracts, I can't in this one. It just taste like candy. I use it for baking of coarse but it is equally great in my coffee. It never claims to be pure. Read the label, don't assume!

column9: Have not found a better tasting vanilla yet
column10: This vanilla needs  10 stars!I have tasted a few different vanillas from Mexico but Molina beats them all so far.  Common vanillas sold on the grocery shelves taste like rubbing alcohol.  I have tasted some pure vanillas and they also taste like cheap low grade alcohol.Get this vanilla if you want your baked goods to taste at their best.Thank you for offering this online and at a good price.
My husband and I bake a lot and everyone perfers the taste of the items when we use this type of vanilla. It gives a fantastic taste and smell.  The company shipped the items quickly.
This is the second time I bought vanilla.  It's delicious and makes everything we bake even better.  I would recommend it to every baker!

column9: We love the "blended" traditional form of Mexican vanilla
column10: Friends from Tahiti rave all the time about Tahitian vanilla.  They've given us some and I'll admit, it was pretty good.  Then we brought home Mexican "traditional" blended vanilla from a vacation to the Yucatan. We fell in love with it and started baking significantly more than we ever have in the past!  We started looking exclusively for recipes that included vanilla, and the more the better.  Since that first purchase we always came home from dive trips to Cozumel and the Yucatan with bottles of the stuff to use and give to family and friends.  The vanilla flavor of the vanilla/vanillin blend is superb and oh-so-vanilla-satisfying in everything you bake.We haven't made it back to Mexico in three years or so and recently ran out of our previous stock of traditional blend.  We used the higher alcohol Tahitian pure vanilla for baking recently but the flavor is noticeably different.  With no Mexican trips on the schedule we thought we'd give Molina Mexican Vanilla Blend a try from Amazon.  It arrived, we opened it, and it is absolutely the vanilla/vanillin blend we love.  As I type we have a Ricotta Mascarpone vanilla custard baking in the oven and the aroma of vanilla filling the house is wonderful.I understand that many folks only use pure vanilla.  That's great.  But if "pure" isn't that important to you and you just want incredible vanilla flavor, give Molina Mexican Vanilla Blend a try.

I finally finished the bottle and ordered another but the new one was "the blend by Molina Vainillin."  It does not seem as strong as the one without the "Vanillin." It is still a excellent product for the price.

Vanilla has a good flavor, but it is not the quality or the taste of the same name brand of vanilla that I obtained years ago in Mexico.

column9: New Bags Pop Terrible (Was: Best Microwave Popcorn)
column10: Updated Review: January 31, 2010--------------------------------The original review below was for black Jewel popcorn that I purchased about 6 months ago from Amazon.  After loving that one we bought a second case.In the second case, the popcorn kernels seems the same but the microwave bags are completely different.  The new bags are brown in color and say: "Being conscientious of our environment we have chosen to use unbleached natural paper microwave bags".  (The old bags were white and felt like all other microwave popcorn bags.)The problem is that the new bags are VERY inconsistent in how they pop the corn.  In the same microwave that we used with the previous bags, you now either get half unpopped kernels AND/OR burned popcorn.  This is with the same amount of cooking time and settings as before.  (We tried varying the time/wattage and it is even inconsistent between bags with the same settings.  i.e. It will burn at 2:10 on one bag and on the next bag won't be half-popped at 2:10.)I can't be 100% sure that it is the bags but:1) We didn't have this issue before with the old case.2) Of the kernels that pop without burning they taste the same as before.3) Visually the bags appear to be the only change.We've almost ran thru all 18 microwave bags that come in the case...  (At least 15 of them.)  Getting half popped corn or having to throw the bag of burned corn the rest of the time.  This issue has happened for ALL of the bags we've tried to pop with the new brown bags.I guess we'll try just buying the loose kernels since they ruined the microwave version.NOTE:  Our microwave is not much more than 6 months old...  So I don't think it is that.Original Review (5 stars): January 10, 2010 (Before we opened the new case)-----------------------------------------------------------------Simple Review:  This is the best microwave popcorn we've found.  My wife is a popcorn nut and she's tried everything you can get in the stores and many of the online brands...  (She even likes this better than the kind you pop on the stove.)Microwaving Tip:  If you have a 1200+ Watt microwave cut the power back to 80% or more.  You'll get better tasting and more consistent popcorn.  (An Inverter Microwave is better at this since it cleanly cuts to 80%.  It isn't on 80% then off 20% of the time like old microwaves.)We have a 1250 Watt Panasonic Inverter microwave.  At 100% power it will burn at around 2:10 or sometimes less.  (I won't put any other times in here.  You have to determine the best setting for your microwave.)So cut the power back and find the right time for your microwave...  It makes a significant difference in taste & consistency.

column9: Pedigree Dog Food, why I give if 5 Stars
column10: I have a four year old dog who loves Pedigree Canned Dog food.  We have been using it the last six months.  I have purchased some of the most expensive canned dog foods at a local pet store and he will not eat the stuff.  If I have a bag of high quality kibbles and mix it in with the Pedigree, he will not eat his food.  We tried Wellness, Blue Buffalo, Eagle Pack, Holistic Select, Innova, Merrick, and Natural Balance.  I don't know what is in these higher quality cans of dog food he does not like.  Maybe too many vegetables??  He will even hide and pout if I put that stuff in front of him.  One time I left the food out for 15 min., put it away, and tried the next day.  He just would not eat the food.  He just loves the smell and taste of Pedigree, and he will even eat Alpo on occasion, but he will not eat the expensive dog foods, which I am more than willing to purchase for him.  I talked to two vets about this.  They tell me dogs go by odor.  The worse something smells the more they like it.  This is why many dogs will roll in dead things out of doors.  We do try to balance out his diets with apples, carrots, etc., if he will eat them, plus the dog gets a vitamin with minerals each day.  Of course he will eat cooked meat if I give it to him, and often we will give this to him with some rice or whole wheat pasta mixed in.  If someone can tell me how to get him to eat the better canned or kibble dog food that so many folks think dogs should be on, then I would like to know this.  Also, the reason we started using Pedigree is because we have some friends (and their relatives) who have had many dogs over the years and feed them Pedigree.  These dogs have lived to a ripe old age.  The biggest thing that got them down was arthritis, but the Pedigree never killed them.  So, this dog food may not be high quality, which I agree when compared to Blue Buffalo, etc., but it does not seem to affect their life span.  I am sure there will be folks who will tell me differently, but for those folks I know personally, they have not found any problems with this food for their dogs.  Amen.

column9: MY PUG WONT EAT ANYTHING ELSE
column10: My 9 1/2 year old pug seems to have developed a senesitive stomach as he got older and lost some teeth.. So I had to put him on some soft food that would not upset his tummy.. I bought these for him and Thought he was gonna eat right thru the bowl the 1st time I put it out for him.. Needless to say he absoutly loves his food! and it seems to agree with his tummy.

My two dogs turn their noses up at this flavor dog food.Even Mikey who eats anything when fed with the other dog won't touch it.I don't understand why as the texture of the food looked fine and I hadn't noticed any usual smell to it.There was some left over steak that I cut up into little bits and put in with the food and they managed to get the pieces out and leave the food.Needless to say I am trying something else to feed them.Other than the dogs not touching the food, it was delivered super fast and cans were all in tack.
What can I say.  Its dog food and the dog cobbles it up. It is easy to order and the super saving shipping is great.

NEVER buy Pedigree. I made a huge mistake trying this. It has the nutritional value of a cardboard box. It's full of corn and by-products. Your dog deserves better than this. If I could give Pedigree a -0, I would. My dog's coat is softer and shinier and she's much more energetic on another brand. There's dog food info all over the NET. Please, steer clear of the ugly Pedigree.

This is a great quality tarragon for the price.  I would encourage anyone to try it.  It is so fresh and soft, and, I have tried a lot of dried Tarragon brands.  When it comes to this quality of dried tarragon, combined with the quantity, this is the best deal I've seen so far, even with the postage.
