It does have a pleasant scent, the the absence of directions is mystifying. There is a clear list of ingreients and it is being marketed as a scalp moisturizing balm. The ingredients include, in order of importance: Petrolatum,Mineral Oil, Paraffin, Lanolin Wax Fragrance Palm Oil,Shea Butter,Wheat Germ Oil,Seed Almond Oil, hydrogenated coconut oil, Sunflower seed oil,glycerin, soybean oil, etc., but they do give you a number to call for questions and comments: 1-800-896-952. I used a very small amount after washing my hair and tried as best I could to massage it into my scalp. I have short hair and I am using it to add shine to my hair which it does. with a very pleasant scent. Since it doesn't come with instructions, I am using it as a finishing balm for my hair. I just run my fingers over the goop and rub my two hands together to warm it up and then apply it to my hair. If this isn't correct, I trust someone will let me know. I use it very sparingly and the jar could last a very long time.

I was quite pleased with the Clear shampoo and conditioner, finding that they did not weigh down my hair.  My hair is thin, straight, prone to getting oily and I seem to be losing hair with age.  So I was fearful when I first opened the intense scalp nourishing balm and tried putting it on dry hair.  I first applied it to the hair, then noticed it was for the scalp so worked it in and brushed it through, then went to bed.  There was little sign of actual grease the next morning but my hair did have a sheen that looked a bit greasy.  It was presentable but not great.The second time I used it was after shampooing and conditioning with the Clear products.  In the shower I rubbed a small amount into my scalp, then blow-dried my hair.  I have to report that it looks great, no greasy look or feel. It is important not to overdo the amount used since it is thick.  The jar may last me for 6-8 months. It would have been better if they had actually told you how to use it- the product basically lacks instructions.If you have thick, frizzy or curly hair I think the product would be better for you than for me, although I am pleased with it now that I have figured out how to use the product.  The smell is quite mild and pleasant.  The price is good for something that will last a long time.

This product may work when used as intended; I wouldn't know. There were no directions for use on the jar, and the jar came without a box. I wasn't even told whether it was a leave in or a rinse out product. After reading the ingredients and feeling the texture, I applied it (moderately) to my hair. It was as though I'd coated my hair with petroleum jelly (and, indeed, the main ingredient is "petroleum products.") I ending up having to wash my hair a second time to try removing the product. I couldn't get it all out and will have to wash my hair a third time. Perhaps this product could be used on very dry, very coarse or very damaged hair. Perhaps it is intended for buzz cuts. But it gets a definite thumbs down from me.

Having become a fan of Clear Scalp & Hair Therapy Ultra Shea Smooth & Nourish Conditioner, I was intrigued by this product, too. But guess what? The product has no directions! Is it a leave-in conditioner or the sort you wash out, and if so, for how many minutes do I keep it on my hair? Or is it a balm to use on dry hair? I checked other users' reviews, and they didn't help, because apparently these customers were just as confused and clueless as I am.Manufacturers of this product, please correct this oversight! You've got a good new product line, but this is a huge oversight.

As another review noted, there are no directions for the use of this product on or with the product(or anywhere I looked on the internet). I tested this product in 2 ways:1. Applied the product to dry hair at the end of a day: dabbed a pea size drop or two in my hands..rubbed them together and applied them to hair---got the frizzes out, tamed the hair w/o taking too much body out.2. Shampooed hair, applied product as *conditioner* and ended up with extra greasy hair.Frankly, I dont know how one would apply this  solely to the scalp unless they have hair less than an inch long. I tried to go primarily for the scalp in both my dry and wet applications and neither of the applications seemed to work for me in treating the scalp.Good to apply to dry, frizzy hair...otherwise, confusing for me

column9: A great product for dry scalps
column10: I picked this item up for my mother who lives in a long term care facility and has trouble using her arms and hands.  Because of her limited mobility she has not been able to take care of her hair the way she used to  and has developed a dry scalp in the process. After giving her this product, her hair has become easier to work with and her dry and flaky scalp has almost faded. Also she loves the scent that is left behind witb each use.

I think this product is designed more for Africa American women, as it is more of a heavy scalp treatment product and very oily.  I could see where it would be a good shine product for black hair, but too heavy of a conditioner for other (white women) hair types.  I will probably use this for a foot softening treatment and not on my hair.  It does smell VERY good though!

column9: I also put a giant glob in my hair while in the shower
column10: I put a ton of this on my hair while I was in the shower.  I thought it was a conditioning masque.  It's not! I think I figured out that even though it doesn't say on the label anywhere or have real directions for that matter, that it's for African American hair.  It takes a lot of washing, blow drying and straightening to get it out.  It's still not all the way out but it's getting there.  **Blow drying it in makes your hair super shiny and soft so that was a nice plus to the other wise crappy situation.

I was so excited to try this product.  I have medium length naturally curly hair and the humidity really takes a toll on it.  I was stumped when I couldn't find any directions on the tub, but figured clean my hair, put some of this on, rubbing it into my scalp and then clear through to the ends of my hair. I let it set for several minutes then I washed it out.  Or I thought I did.  My head felt heavier than usual due to the oil that didn't come out in the shampoo.  I waited another day, hoping I would have better success and some of it did wash out, but it was still oilier than normal.Finally, the third day, washing my hair it finally had some semblance of my regular do.  It was silkier and looked healthier, but a word to the wise, use this hair therapy in very small increments.  Will I use it again? Definitely.  I like the end results.  I just need to moderate my use and quantity.  It smells great, by the way!

This product is light and more like "old school hair food" just not as oily/greasy. This is not something I can use regularly during the year's early Texas heat without being a sweaty and dare I say oily/greasy mess. As with the Nourishing Scalp and Hair Oil a little goes a long way so does this product. This will be more of a cool weather product for me.UPDATE 6/14/2012: I do not recommend using this on WET hair. A dab of this balm used sparingly on DRY hair after using the Shampoo and Conditioner will deliver good results. The product is oily, coats the hair and adds shine.

This stuff smells great. Floral and tropical. That was the first thing I noticed when opening the container of Clear's Scalp Nourishing Balm. This is a different animal from their shampoos though. It is meant strictly for scalp nourishment, not as a hair conditioner (at least not for Caucasian hair).  It has a hard consistency but will 'melt' a bit to the touch. And all you need is a little bit.Of course, you don't really know what to do with it because there are no instructions on the packaging. Shame on the designers for neglecting this. It is very greasy and can be difficult to clean from one's hair. What I do is coat the tips of my fingers with it and rub directly on my scalp. It is NOT a hair conditioner or treatment. Some of it will make its way into your hair in any event, but this mitigates overdoing it. I apply it several minutes before my shower then use two applications of Clear CLEAR MEN SCALP THERAPY Anti-Dandruff Shampoo, so my scalp feels great and my hair is soft and manageable.As other reviewers have noted, one can find other uses for this heavy balm aside from moisturizing your scalp. It is effective on everything from rough skin to nail cuticles to squeaky hinges. There is a youtube video that explains its proper use so I recommend seeking that out. The nearly 7oz. jar should last you a long time, but I don't think I'll be getting this product again.~ Kort

My daughter gets dry scalp and so I thought I would have her try this. But there are no directions on the container?? What is up with that? I don't understand why the company would think that everyone knows how to use these products.By the looks of it when I opened it up, it seems more like a balm, so I assume it goes on dry hair, not wet hair in the shower. But we weren't sure whether it is suppose to be rubbed into the scalp, or just smoothed onto hair. My daughter tried rubbing some into her scalp, but wasn't overly thrilled with it, so she just started smoothing a little on her hair. She likes smooth, straight hair, and kind of liked how this balm looked, but not as much as other smoothing products she's used. So I doubt she will continue to keep using this product. We both are still wondering if we are even using it right. I think it's silly for them to not give better directions.

If you like the greaseball look, such as was popular waaaaaay back when, you can achieve that by getting a jar of this super grease from Clear. I got it because I have been using Clear shampoo which is a very good product and I expected this to be good for my hair and scalp as well. I figured that after a Clear shampoo I could just slap a dab of this Clear Balm and my hair would be more manageable and my scalp would benefit from the alleged "Therapy". Not so. This stuff is monumentally greasy. Once applied it defies all removal efforts for weeks. I will addmit that my use of this grease was not aided by any type of instruction, suggestion or comments from the maker. Nor was it packaged in any type of box or carton that might have some type of usage assistance printed on the sides. Nope, just a simple jar of ultimate grease. It does have one attribute in its favor and that is the odor. Not bad at all.Since I am not fool enough to use this on my hair again I tried to find a practical use for it. Recently I had a new garage door installed. The hinges made some noise during opening and closing. The installer said that they would be noisy just during the break-in period and that I should keep the hinges lubricated. I loaded the Clear grease into my grease gun and gave the hinges a shot of this amazing lubricant. My door is much quieter now and, as an unexpected additional benefit, it smells great. Useful and inexpensive - what a deal!

column9: How to use this.. if you are white!
column10: Think of this like lip balm for hair. I use Redken Structure Wax 17 for Unisex, 1.7 Ounce per the recommendation of my hair stylist. She showed me how to use it and said this little 1.7 oz pot would last forever. I'm still using it months later, so she was right. Now I was curious about this product. It seemed like the Caucasian buyers were scooping this up as if it was a hair mask and wondering why their hair was so greasy. This is a great product for white hair if used in very very small amounts, like lip balm. Just run your fingers over the top of the product and then rub your hands together. Smooth your tresses. It's beautiful. Your hair will stay in place, it will have more gloss and shine. It will be easier to manage. I LOVE this product. Structure wax can only really be used on the ends, but I apply this sparingly with my fingertips (applying only the amount that adheres to my fingertips, not scoops of it!) and my hair looks fantastic. It really does lock the moisture in. If you use structure wax, use this in the same way and you'll be so happy to get 4 times the product for 1/4 the price!Also, I apply this to freshly blow dried hair or anytime I want to tame my hair, give it more gloss, and add moisture to my dry hair.

column9: Does what it says it will.
column10: The Clear Scalp & Hair Beauty Therapy Ultra Shea Intense Scalp Nourishing Balm does exactly what it says it'll do; it moisturizes and protects hair, it has a pleasant scent, and the scalp feels better after it's been used.The only thing to warn you about is that this product does not seem made for my particular type of hair; instead, I think if you have much coarser hair than I do, this product would be much better for you than it was for me.  Mostly, I believed this helped me some, but I think it would help someone with very coarse hair far more.But it works, and it does what it says it will, which is why it deserves a four-star rating.Barb Caffrey

i did enjoy this product in my hair.usually i get too greasy or too watery.the product had a nice consistency and the smell was very pleasant.yet like with all products like this, it's difficult to get out of the bottle. My fingers get messed up and once you get to the middle it gets even more difficult.If someone could design a better way to get the product out that is like this, i would love to buy this product more.

column9: Just a little is all it takes
column10: This hair balm is surprising lightweight.  I was expecting this to be a heavy, gooey, greasy experience, however I am pleasantly surprised and happy to report that this actually helps to tame my dry color treated hair.  I color quite often due to the battle of the gray.  I use this on the ends of my hair prior to drying and straightening my hair.  The result, silky smooth healthy looking hair.  Easy to apply, but use sparingly a little goes a long way.

column9: Nice Sheen, does contain Mineral Oil & Petrolatum
column10: This product didn't provide any extra moisture benefits that I could see or any extra nourishment.  The nourishment I think I would have to use for a longer period of time to see the benefit if any. It contains Nutrium 10 but I haven't been able to find out exactly what that is. Dove mentions Nutrium in some of their body washes but doesn't mention exactly what nutrium means. The product has a nice light fragrance, so you don't have to worry about any heavy or "chemically" smells in your hair. I liked the sheen that I got from using it but I can't say that it is a sheen that I can't get from using my other hair products.  The moisture wasn't any longer lasting than any other product that I use.This product can be used on natural or relaxed hair and does contain shea butter. The first ingrediet is Petrolatum, second is mineral oil, followed by paraffin then lanolin wax.  I try to avoid these ingredients but I did want to try the product out. There are some good oils ( sunflower seed oil, weet almond and coconut oil, etc) listed as well. The jar comes in a 6.7 oz size so you get a lot of product.  Overall a light moisutre balm that provides good sheen.

I highly recommend this nourishing balm. It's an excellent product and very helpful for anyone with dry hair and scalp. A friend of mine had commented that it is best for African Americans, but I'm not African American and it worked well for me.

column9: Heavy and quite Greasy as a treatment
column10: Shea butter is great a conditioning skin, may be great for a dry and itchy scalp but is horrendous to wash out.  My hair gpt drier with me trying to rinse the balm out.  The second time I use less of it and was careful about the amount of product used and had nice, soft hair after, buy there is still this caked on greasy feel to my hair.  This may be Clear Scalp's answer to WEN, and like WEN it's not something I personally like.

column9: Oily and Don't konw if it works
column10: Firs to fall, i thought it was going to be a small tub.  I was surprised to see a large tub, which kind of concerned me about the quality.  The cream doesn't absorb very well and it's kind of oily.  I did not see much improvement after using this product for a week. I wouldn't waste your money on this product.

column9: Just a big ole tub of petroleum jelly
column10: This product is made for African-American hair. Unilever (the makers) should just stop tip-toeing around this in their marketing. The model shown in the photo is an African-American woman of light complexion. On their website is African-American hair stylist, Oscar James, who does Tyra Banks' hair.It's a thick kind of pomade, with the pale yellow look, feel, and consistency of petroleum jelly because that's what it is! The first ingredient listed on the label is petrolatum. Next is mineral oil and paraffin. While prominently marketed as being made with expensive and luxurious sounding ingredients like shea butter and argan oil, it's really just a big tub of petroleum jelly with trace amounts of the good stuff in it, with no mention of petrolatum in the advertising. Because of this, the formulation is heavy and it leaves residue on the fingers. My co-worker tried some of this product, but prefers to make her own scalp and hair products from mixing natural oils herself.The ingredients in this product are not particularly high-end, but if you are looking for cost-control, it certainly fits the bill. The good stuff would cost a lot more than this.

This is a great product!  It smells good and works without being too heavy.  I used it as a scalp treatment between shampoos and I also put it on my hair before drying my hair.  It gives the hair shine and my scalp is moisturized without being greasy.Love it!

This item is right up my ally being that I'm African American. It's a light hair grease. It does have some smoothing properties and of course, will make your hair shiny. The fragrance is light and pleasant. As for its promise to give you stronger hair in 7 days, I don't know and probably never will. I use so many products on my hair that I can't attribute any changes to any one. I do like it and depending on price, I'd be willing to buy it again. Again, It's light enough to not over saturate your hair with oil but heavy enough to provide the proper amount of nourishment for you to feel and see the difference. Since I've gotten it I've started applying it to my hair every night. Recommended.

Not ready to like this product.  It is too greasy that it feels very uncomfortable on your head that it is hard not to be bothered by it. Smells fine but what the use if it feels nasty to apply.UuEven difficult to remove.  It feels like it is still there even after repeated washings.

I have to say that I am very pleased with this scalp treatment. This is great dor my braids and will also work on dreads . I have to honestly say that it gives a nice sheen to your hair but not make it to greasey. If you are using this for breads, you only need a little to go very far. I will use this after shampooing my hair as well. It will give it a great sheen. Just a quarters worth in your hand goes a long way.

column9: Very nourishing, but too thick for even my crazy thick hair!
column10: This has a great smell, and the texture is nice, but I had to wash my hair so much to clear it out, that I am not sure if I didn't end up drying my scalp and hair more than it helped overall!

The fragrance is mild but soothing and the ingredients have lots of good stuff like sunflower, almond, and coconut oils, as well as aloe. It's not too heavy or greasy, so application to the scalp doesn't affect the overall appearance of your hair. I've found it helps with dandruff, too.

column9: Good hair product. . . IF USED CORRECTLY!
column10: Perhaps the only real fault of this product is lack of clear instructions on HOW TO USE IT.  I'm familiar with this type of hair care product, so I knew the one simple truth that helps make it wonderful: Use just enough to coat your hair in one layer.  Don't slather it on like it's a regular shampoo or conditioner.  This is a leave-in moisturizing conditioner than is meant to keep your hair slightly moist, thus preventing damage while healing previous damage.It does its job very well, but just make sure you aren't using too much.  If you end up overusing, you'll know it.  Your hair will be lanky, heavy, and uncomfortable, thus defeating the purpose of it.

no matter how I tried to massage this into my dry scalp it ended up all over my hairokay this could be user error but it took some time to wash outIt has a good feel and consistency however just did not work on my hairIt is the consistency of a thick Valvoline --nice scent and my hand felt good after trying to apply it but not for thin hair

I've used other clear scalp and hair products, and been very happy with them.  I do like the smell of this product, and if used very, very sparingly, it does the job on my hair and scalp. Unfortunately, there were not directions, and nothing to indicate that the product was created for ethnic hair.  In fact, I was unaware of the fact until I started looking at the other reviews here.  Hopefully, the company will correct that because it seems to be an excellent product, just not for me.

column9: I Like It but Not for my Hair
column10: I have to say I too was one with quick fingers that chose this product before I was aware it was for ethnic hair.  I'm sure that it's good for the right hair type but after opening the jar I knew there was no way this product would work with my hair but I do have extremely dry skin and had other ideas that it works great for.When the humidity leaves the air in the fall I develop scaly dry patches on my wrist and hand (from washing my hands too much).  A small amount of this rubbed into the area took care of the problem. It leaves a waterproof coating over the area and takes many hand washings to remove it.  It protects the skin really well.I also coat my feet in this and place a pair of socks on overnight and it leaves my feet soft and smooth and its also cheaper than buying foot lotion and smells better.Overall it's a product that can have many uses if you make the mistake of purchasing for the wrong hair type and don't want to waste it.

I didn't realize when I picked this up that this really wasn't for my hair style at all.  I have naturally thik/wavey hair and while I do use a lot of "African American" products on my hair, like relaxers and things of that nature which help quite a bit because I get a natural "fro" going on, this really just wasn't for me as it is just too thick and greasy for my hair texturing.  It's hard to review it past that and saying it's okay and giving it 3 stars for that as I just passed it on to a friend who can and will use it for her hair, she so far has been able to and likes it; but for me this is a no go.  I really didn't read the information enough before picking this up as a free Vine product to review it an this just really doesn't work for me.

I really love the Clear Scalp & Hair Beauty Therapy. Shea Intense Scalp Nourishing Balm. I use this product to help seal the moisture in my hair to keek it from gettin dry and breaking. It is doing a wonderful job. I use this product along with other products in the series and the are all just great. If used properly you will get great results. This product is not too heavy and has a very pleasant smell. My hair looks great and smells great after using.

Wasn't sure how exactly to apply this product since there are no directions, but being that it is for the scalp, I rub it into my scalp over my whole head.  The next morning I had to use Dawn dishwashing liquid to attempt to get it out.  Now my hair is even dryer and still greasy.  It went straight to the trash this morning.

Clear Scalp & Hair Beauty therapy is a nice nourishing balm that helps moisturizes you hair from the root. The product is perfect for African American women such as myself who is constantly battling dry scalp which will then cause breakage and damage to the hair if left untreated. This can be used for women and men because I use this on my son's very low cut hair and this has helped him from getting those annoying dry spots in his head that are clearly visible. This product helps nourishes your scalp without clogging up your hair follicles. I have also used the balm to add on the tips of my hair after washing it so that I can brush it through as I blow dry it and this helps from damaging my already dry and brittle hair.Great Product for your hair and The Therapy Ultra Shea Intense Scalp Nourishing Balm helps combats dry hair and helps prevent your hair from having the frizzes. You will love this nourshing balm,I know I do!

column4: Reader2008 "I write honest reviews; if you do...
column9: This is HAIR GREASE; All the gold container clear products are for black people!
column10: I don't know why CLEAR won't just say that the GOLD LINE is for black people.  At the store, all the gold products are with the black hair products and the other products are with caucasian hair products.Anyway, as for hair grease, it is no better than any other hair grease on the market.  For oiling the scalp, I like this CLEAR product better:CLEAR SCALP & HAIR BEAUTY THERAPY Ultra Shea Nourishing Scalp & Hair Oil, 3 Fluid OunceThis particular product moisturized the scalp well and does not have an overwhelming smell.  I would purchase the Hair Oil over the container grease though.

column9: Adds something that the competition doesn't...
column10: SCALP and HAIR therapy...nourishing balm.  Plenty of products like it on the market.  But this one really adds something.  It nourishes the scalp so much that its overwhelmed with nourishment and becomes dry and itchy.  So, not a great product in that aspect.As far as the hair nourishment - it's designed for African American hair, and it's not a big glop of goo when used appropriately.  It works to soften the hair, but no better or worse than the competition.  (But it doesn't lead to dandruff like the competition, so it hits an average 3-star.If you haven't had success with other hair/scalp treatments, you could give this stuff a try.  But if you're happy with what you're using, this stuff isn't going to provide anything better.

This product is not for White or Asian hair.  It's a very heavy product that stays in the hair for several days.  It leaves the hair a little greasy feeling, but not too bad.  I couldn't stand it in my hair, but that because I'm Asian and I should never have put it in my hair in the first place, but I made the same mistake as many others on here.  There is nothing that says it's an ethnic product.  I wish it did.  Even if they didn't want to advertise it as such, they could have put that vital bit of information in the instructions.  Oh, yeah - what instructions?  There is absolutely no intructions for use on this product.  I know because I looked...without any instructions, I used it like a conditioner and regretted it for the 3 days it took for it to come out of my hair.  After I put it on, I quickly realized it was not what I wanted and washed my hair with shampoo 3 more times, it wouldn't come out.  I kept washing my hair and it still took about 3 days before it finally all came out.  For the right hair - this is probably a good thing.  For me, it was horrible.  I do like the smell - it has a very pleasant smell and probably is a very good product for ethnic hair.  This is why I gave it 3 stars.  I think the product is good - it just obviously needs better labeling and some instructions.
This has made my hair feel great. It smells great and has lasted me a long time. This Balm works great I do use very little each time.

This stuff has as its first ingredient petrolatum, which certainly sounds like a petroleum product. Then comes mineral oil and then paraffin. After that comes palm oil and Shea butter. So ultra Shea would seem like a misnomer. I would call it ultra grease. It is extreme hard to wash out and of you have fine hair like me, the last thing you want is greasy flat hair. Won't use this product, although it might keep my squeaky car door from squeaking.

The mini nerd candies are all stuck to a cherry colored gummy rope. This a long rope you can twist, swing around or hang from the ceiling for a party. Well, OK, it won't last that long but you could possibly use these as Christmas decorations on a tree like a string of popcorn. Sweet, sour, crunchy and delicious. Candy for when you want to feel like a kid again.~The Rebecca Review

column9: One Swell Soup - thanks to Amazon!
column10: Campbell's Cream of Shrimp Soup has been a staple in my pantry for decades.  It was an easy starting point for all kinds of lovely seafood soups and sauces for nights when I was desperate for something fast and delicious.  Over the past few months, one supermarked chain after another in my area stopped carrying it. Totally unavailable, even by special order.  I was getting desperate.  So I tried Amazon.  Not only was it immediately available, the price including shipping was less than I had paid at the market.  Thank you Amazon - there will be shrimp and crab chowder for dinner tonight.

Ordered on a Thurs., shipped out Fri. and I received it Mon. A day ahead of schedule! The packing job was great and all the cans arrived safely without any dings or dents. Cream of Shrimp soup is great in just about any seafood dish, especially casseroles. I use it fairly often, so the subscription option is great! This is a significant savings over buying it at my local grocer as well. $1.99 per can versus $3.29 at the grocery-how great is that!

column9: great way to make newburg sauce
column10: If you used to buy Knorr Newburg sauce, this is the next best thing. The color is the perfect color and it is very tasty and easy to use to make Lobster or Shrimp Newburg.

First of all, I'd placed this order after 1:00pm (PST) and I received it the following day.....INCREDIBLE.  Not only that, it is much cheaper to buy this item from amazon and have it shipped to me every 2 months, considering the store in California (Raley's) sell this for 4.39 a can.  My mother would normally buy this for me in Louisiana and ship to me.  Thanks AMAZON, I'm sure my mom is really glad I have YOU!!!  BESIDES, I HAVE FREE SHIPPING WITH YOU!!!!

I have been purchasing this Campbell's soup for 20 years! For the last 2 or 3 years, it has not been available at the grocery stores I shop at! After searching online, and finding it at Amazon, I orderred a case of it. Same great soup, and at a fair price! I use it as a stand a lone soup, and also as an item to add to other items, such as casseroles, and seafood chowder. When mixed with new england clam chowder, or lobster bisque, it is great! Also added to fish fillet's and baked.

My local grocery stores no longer carry this, as I suppose it wasn't very popular.  It's good, though, and with the addition of some crab meat or fresh/frozen shrimp, it can pass for a gourmet first course.  Hide the can.  Yay for Amazon for carrying it!
I won a cooking contest using Campbells cream of shrimp soup. It is not available in local grocery stores. So glad Amazon sells it. It is delicious and versatile for cooking many different dishes.
Hard to find , at a good price on Amazon is a saver for the descriminating cook.

A very nice cream soup, great for cooking with.  It's not your regular 'cream of mushroom' for casseroles, and adds something just a bit different, so it's good to have on the pantry shelf.  I'll be buying it again.

My order of 12 cans of Cambell's Cream of Shrimp Soup arrived fast but nearly all cans had dents with most cans having large dents and one can was leaking. I sent a pictures and a discription to Amazon but have not yet received a response.

column9: Fairly good soup but could be improved on
column10: This is a fairly decent soup but the shrimp were pretty tiny and broken up. If they improved that it would be much better. Nice tasting however.Glad I got it on sale here.
I did not even know this flavor of creamed soup existed. Tasted great in the bisque I made and really added some nice flavor when used like an Alfredo sauce on pasta. I will order more of this.

column9: Great coffee, what a bad price for a 6 pack
column10: So it's a 6 pack, and they want $79.99.  That's $13.33 a can. Meanwhile if you search Amazon for "illy Medium" you get offered individual cans from various merchants for $11.99.  WTF? You buy in bulk and the price per can goes up? A 6 pack should be about $60, in my opinion, not $80.
We have tried so many different coffees...but none compares to the flavor and smoothness of illy coffee... it is the best to me and my husband.
$13.33 a can plus shipping?  Cheaper by more than a few bucks at my local Stop n Shop!!  Unbelievable!!!
The Everlasting treat will keep your dog entertained while you are busy or away for a few hours.  Really nice way to enrich a dog's life and give them an interesting way to work for their treat.

My tiny little Yorkie was able to chew through these treats in MINUTES.  AND they make a HUGE mess.  I'd give NO stars if that were an option, really.  Everlasting my behind, ugh!  For what they cost, they should last longer than that, and not make a huge mess.

column9: Merrick is one of the best...
column10: I come from generations of veterinarians, vet technicians and professional dog trainers and breeders. Proper nutrition equals fewer vet visits and fewer lower vet bills. Since Vet medicine research in canine nutrition now proves that grain free, multiple protein, or varied proteins are the best nutrition for our furry friends I put my dogs on the grain free long long ago.I find Merrick is one of the very best. I realize a lot of people just present new foods to their dogs all at once. Never do that. Introduce ANY NEW FOOD in small amounts mixed with what the dog is accustomed to eating. Their digestion and their metabolism are unique, so just throwing a new food at them out of the blue they won't like it and can cause digestive distress. ALWAYS mix new food in with what their stomachs have been accustomed to.
This food looks like canned stew.  I'd eat it.  Awesome ingredients and quality.  The dog absolutely loves it.  Mix a little with the dry food as a treat and the bowl gets licked clean.

I was going to order this for my little shihtzu but knowing how picky he is I bought a can from the local pet store first.  Glad I did, because Sheldon would have nothing to do with it.  The chunks in it are huge for a little dog so I cut them up, but he still would only sniff it and walk away.  Disappointing because I see now that they have the smaller cans I would have bought for him.  Not sure if the pieces in those are smaller as well, but it doesn't really matter.  He won't eat it.
My dog didnt like it, she picks out the lil bits and spits them out but likes the larger kibble. Will not buy again.

Merricks is the best, not by products! No bones, wings, legs - food is so good even I WANT TO EAT IT!!!!!I love amazon, they have almost everything. Tracking number included too. Expires 2010, my dogs will be wayyyy finished with the food by then. thanks amazon!My dogs still love Grammy's potpie the best =)

column9: Twizzlers' Black Licorice Bites Are Delicious!
column10: Twizzlers' Black Licorice Bites are delicious but difficult to find in the Northeast.  Fortunately, Amazon carries them!  My father loves these licorice bites (or "nibs" as they are sometimes called), and he was thrilled to receive them as part of his Father's Day gift.  It comes as an 8-pack, so they should last a little while.  Thanks, Amazon!
This is one of the BEST German Potato Salads I've ever tried. I have been eating it since I was a child and still love it 62 years later. I highly recommend this product.

I have been purchasing this German potato salad for years but my local store just stopped carrying it. so of course I looked to Amazon.  My mother, born in Germany, and now living alone, eats this probably a couple times per month. So glad I found it and will subscribe and save!

column9: Once German potato salad, now glop
column10: This potato salad is 50% sauce now. The can I opened today consisted of a few potato slices swimming in an unappetizing amount of sauce. The label should at least warn you to drain this product well. Unfortunately, I was using it for a recipe (featured on the can) that featured smoked sausage and bbq sauce. It came out (per the maker's instructions) like bizarre soup. For three times the price of a can of sliced potatoes this should be better. The upside is maybe this will drive me to make the stuff myself.

column9: The product is very good but the packaging was bad
column10: I like this product, it is very good, very tasty. It is a versatile product that can be served as is or combined with other foods.However, I am very disappointed with the way it was shipped.  Another item by the same manufacturer was shipped together with this one in one box with not enough packaging material to keep them from jostling about.NINE of the twelve cans are dented (two of the 4 bean salad cans are dented).The box had too much free room and one corner was open and had it needed to be shipped further, the contents would have fallen out.As I said earlier, the product is good but order it by itself so a lazy packer doesn't just shove it into a box with other products with ONLY ONE strip of air pillow packaging material which was totally inadequate.I still haven't decided if I will order it again.  I had to discard one of the cans because both the top and bottom were dented so much a can opener could not be used.

I had never even heard of canned potato salad much less tasted it. However, I'm out here in the Arizona desert and things spoil even in refrigerators. I browsed through the Grocery & Gourmet section, found Read German Potato Salad and decided to give it a try. The taste is there but it lacks the mayonnaise texture. Other than that it's great.

column9: It used to be a lot thicker, it is now sweet and sour Potato Soup when heated, as you eat German style heated.
column10: It used to be a lot thicker, it is now sweet and sour Potatoe Soup when heated, you are supposed to eat German style heated...super runny, used to be thick.If I were you, I would boil a couple of potatoes, slice and add to absorb some of the runny sauce and add some real bacon bits to it.I was really disappointed they changed their recipe, that it's now sweet and sour potato soup.

We used to get this at our local grocery store, but they stopped carrying Read's products years ago.  I had tried to order some online 6 or 7 years ago, but it never arrived (I ordered from somewhere else).Was thrilled when this happened to pop up as a suggestion (not sure how, but Amazon really knows what i want).Ordered it, it arrived, and we had a great Christmas and New Years meal and still have some can's left over.

This product is really good.  I often mix it in with my own German Potato Salad to stretch the amount when having company.  It's also my go-to for weekly meals when I don't have time to cook potatoes!

I have tried potato salad while in Germany and here in the Amish county.But this is horrible.First of all it's liquid like soup and extremely sweet !If you are looking for a real German potato salad get one in a Deli or try to make it yourself.But don't buy this one it's a complete waste of money.

column9: They send you dented and damaged cans. Do NOT buy from this place
column10: EIGHT of twelve of the German Potato salad cans were dented and damaged. I am stunned and want a complete refund. I have been using Amazon for over ten years and this is the very first time I have been disgusted with an order. It is horrifying you would send out or ship an order in this condition. A very, very unhappy customer. Elodie' King

I am a frequent purchaser of the Plato Salmon Treats which my dogs (as well as neighbors' dogs) love, but the salmon treats are very fishy on the fingers and can't be put in my pocket.  The Duck Strips are chewy and not smelly, so I don't have to wash my hands each time I handle them and I can keep a few in my pocket for an unexpected reward.  Of course, all the dogs love them, too. I highly recommend both of these treats for their quality.  If you love your dogs, these are the treats for them, not wheat-based biscuits.

I love the Plato line of products as they allow me to just mindlessly pick from the line and know that I am feeding something good to my dog(s). As for "Smart Dog Snacks" with Ginkgo Biloba and DHA...I'd better watch out, because my dogs love these treats so much that the treats just may make them smart enough to figure out how to open the "treat cabinet" take the container down and unscrew the lid to help themselves!While the treats themselves look like beef jerky, they are made with all natural, organic ingredients. The dogs don't care what's in these treats, they just know they love them. As I am typing this they are both sitting at attention, staring at me and whimpering while trying to do the Jedi Mind Trick of "you want to give us more Smart Dog Snacks, pick up your hand from that keyboard and reach in the container and hand us more. Do it. Do it now."There's so much junk out there and plenty of junk food that claims to be natural (just like people food) but this stuff is the real deal. Much like the food that I feed to the humans in the family, I know what each of the ingredients are and love that the first two ingredients are duck and brown rice. There aren't cost cutting fillers in these treats; it's a straight up high quality product. As an aside, I've bought from the seller, The Whole Healthy Pet many times, and I am always impressed with the products they carry. Just as I know that I can trust the Plato brand, I know that if a product is being carried by The Whole Healthy Pet, then it is a high quality product and I feel like a good parent getting it for my dogs.
My beagle loves this treat.The texture is like a cookie and is kind of perfect treat to break into pieces, stuff it in a kong toy etc.

I selected the Plato treats due to the natural ingredients. Wow, my pug Ponch LOVES them! I currently have a bag each of the duck, salmon and chicken. When we get home from our walk he runs straight to the kitchen and runs in circles waiting by the fridge for his treats! These are the only treats I'll buy.

My dog underwent allergy testing a month ago to determine why he's was so itchy and losing hair.  He's now having allergy shots and the vet recommended we limit his diet to duck and potato for now.I bought duck and potato biscuits at the pet store but there was nothing on the package that stated where this product was made; although my dog liked them, I was bothered that a smoke flavoring was obviously used.  Then I found duck jerky at the pet shop but it is made in China.  The store clerk said none of the customers had complained about it and my dog seems OK with them but I decided to look aroundI was relieved to find these duck treats as they are made in the U.S.  They arrived yesterday and as soon as I opened the bag, my dog was right there.  His eyes light up when he sees the blue bag and I call these his duck cookies.  My only wish is that these didn't have salt.Just wanted to alert people planning to order these - the first time I ordered these, I bought four bags and all of the bags were fine - however, the second time, I bought two bags and I just noticed that there were a number of strips in the bottom of the second bag that are covered in mold - I had to chuck the moldy ones in the trash (with my dog watching wide-eyed) - so I'm glad this is now available through the subscribe and save program - I hope ordering one bag at a time will avoid the risk of this happening again

I just received the Salmon, the Duck and the Chicken strips.Our JRT is very fussy and horribly spoiled.She turns up her nose and walks away from many treats I've tried.Most of the "organic" or "healthy" treats I've tried haven't won her over.She just had one each of the Salmon, Duck and Chicken and LOVED all of them!I'm thrilled that they are made in the US and contain ingredients I approve of.Thank you Plato and Amazon!
..my dog has allergies and eats these without reaction!
My Dog loves these, break them in half and make them last twice as long. I highly recommend to everyone, especially those who have dogs that are allergic to chicken.

I purchased these as an alternative to the duck jerky (made in China) that I no longer wanted to feed to my small/medium dogs.  Since one is allergic to chicken my choices are limited.  These arrived today and my 3 dogs sniffed them suspiciously.  I broke them in half for them and they decided to give them a try.  They seemed to like them...they are different then I thought they would be.  They are almost the texture of a soft granola bar and not like jerky at all.  They are about 2" by .5" and the  contents of the bag were not crumbly like some have described.  All in all, I think these will work to replace the  jerky and since they are made and packaged in the US, I feel better about giving them treats.... Oh, and the  cost is pretty good too...

column9: Great product, made in the USA
column10: My boxer has food allergies and I looked all over the internet for duck products. I finally found Platos. She loves them and they are made in the USA. No reason to fear these products. I only buy dog products from the USA, I will not chance my pets life to save a few bucks. Besides, Amazon sells them cheaper than every other site I found them on.

My dog loves these treats and it makes me feel good to know these are made in the USA.  I have made a point to buy dog food and treats that are made here.  In my opinion, better safe than sorry, so if I have to order treats on line I will.
My dogs love these treats and buying them online was much cheaper than retail. However, both bags that I ordered had dry, crumbly treats inside.

Another favorite treat my dogs love.  It is not organic - so I can't give it a 5 star rating - but I am hoping the duck is from a reliable source of humanely farmed U.S fowl.  I care about my dogs health, but I also care about the animals that are the source of protein for my dogs.

Our Boston Terrier loves these strips.  She has food allergies so our vet has her on a strict duck and potato diet.  She doesn't like to have her nails clipped so we reserve these strips as an extra special way of rewarding her for letting us clip her nails.  These strips have worked magic with allowing us to be able to clip her nails.

My border collie adores these. What's not to love? They're more than 90% duck, with brown rice and vitamins. I have to store them out of her reach, otherwise she'd eat the whole bag. They are kind of rich, so it's best to feed them just one or two each day as an extra special treat. Plus, they're made in the USA. Wonderful!

column9: Dog has never jumped this high!
column10: She loves these treats.  The bag seals well and the product seems (smells) fresh. Word one, Word two, Word three?
My dog loves them. He's very picky when it comes to dog food and treats.  He really enjoys them and does all his tricks to get one.

column9: Excellent treats and made in the USA
column10: I've tried all three (and yes, the Salmon is fishy smelling and a bit greasy) and the dogs love them all. It is hard to find dog treats worth buying that are made in the USA that don't cost a fortune. These are reasonable. Don't be fooled by companies that are based in the US but the actual manufacture is in a country not to be named. I also will buy treats made in Canada. I think most pet stores, including ones like Petsmart and Petco are charging way too much for DOG TREATS. I found mine at a human health food store (Fruitful Yield) and was surprised at the cost. Now I see I can order all three from Amazon, shipped for a comparable price. Just wish I could order items in the US and have them shipped from Amazon to say England or Australia. Would love to easily send these to my friends' dogs.
This is a good product to use if you train with a mix of treats. I just break the treats into smaller pieces and add them to my bait pouch. My dogs seem to like them really well.
My dog is absolutely crazy about these treats, and that they are made in the U.S.A. is just icing on the cake.

column9: very good value for organic treats-good for your pupper
column10: These are very inexpensive at this site because they are usually twice the price in all the typical pet stores you usually go to.  They are an awesome deal for organic.  I try to feed my dog only organic food and treats as close to all organic as I can.  I had a dog that was very young, 2 1/2, and he died from cancer and ever since then, I have been very cautious of what I feed my dog now.  Organic does make the difference and these treats are low in calories so they are a good treat to give your dog if you are trying to control his weight.  You don't have to feel guility giving him/her these treats, they are small and as I mentioned low calorie.  I would reccomend these to any dog owner and I have also purchased the chicken, duck and salmon treats made by Plato, all good choices.  The Salmon ones are very very stinky though, beware of those, good for your dog though, lots of Omega 3's in them.
My very allergic dog loves these treats!  She knows where they are kept and goes right to the spot.  Thanks Plato

These treats are GREAT! My dog LOVES them! They are very healthy and a great snack for her. They are made in the USA and that is very important to me in these times of pet (and human) food recalls. Give them a try, your dog will thank you!

My two Chihuahuas loved "Cadet Gourmet Pet Treats Duck Breast Fillets", the 32-Ounce package I had been buying at Costco.  However, I discovered it was made in China and feared this product could make them sick or cause death.  So I started searching for a company in the USA that made dog jerky treats.  I found Plato Natural Duck Strips and ordered a bag.  This product does not look like or smell like duck jerky strips.  My Chihuahuas sniffed it and just walked away.  It doesn't even smell like duck.  Rather, it smells somewhat fishy.  A waste of my money!

column9: These are duck chunks not strips
column10: My darling dog can only eat duck snacks, she is allergic to everything else. I had ordered Plato duck strips before and they are excellent. (Seriously, is there anything a dog won't eat?) But these are CHUNKS, thus the FOUR stars instead of five. They are about 2 inches long and an inch wide, preformed snacks. The Plato strips I bought before were duck strips, not preformed. Of course she loved these but they are covered in a bit of "duck dust" for lack of a better term, so I didn't like to handle them as well as strips. Shipping was quick. The packaging says that these are made in America, important to me. If I am going to pay premium prices for dog snacks, I don't want to kill her with Chinese products! If you asked her, she would give them FIVE stars, because they smell "duckier".

column9: Paws Up for these Pricey Treats!
column10: These are expensive (I would guess the 24 oz pkg contains maybe 20 sticks), but you can cut or break them in half (harder to break smaller pieces off) to make them last longer.  They're a huge hit with our two big guys - have to admit I was shocked at how quickly our big dog consumed one when we first opened the package!  I like varying protein source, so they split one each morning along with a mix of other snacks - it's a real treat for them, and Made in USA is a BIG plus for me as "Mom."
my dog has allergies and this product was a great treat to give him that does not contain by products or preservatives.
Pricey, but my dogs love it and it's a great training aid. I cut them into smaller pieces and use them for blackmail, or training, depending on how you look at it.

I purchased the Plato Duck Strips for my 12 1/2 year old Golden Retriever.  They are chewy, but not hard, for her old worn down teeth and low in calories as she is less active now due to arthritis.  I was very pleased to find them available at a good price through Amazon.  Thank you.
Our dog loves this line of treats.  He tends to be a meat eater and doesnt like cookie based treats.  He loves these treats in all of the flavors but esp duck and salmon.
My dogs love these, I feel good about giving them these treats as they seem to have quality ingredients. If you want to give your dog a special treat, get some!

I got these from my local pet store, where they carry quality items (made in USA, no grain fillers, etc.).  I brought my pooch in one day for his regular food and the shop owner gave the pooch two of these.  Needless to say, I am a sucker for my pooch so of course I bought them.  After my dog had one of his legs amputated due to bone cancer, I switched from the common store brands to higher quality items like this.  I have noticed a marked improvement in my dog's overall recovery.  Even if your dog isn't suffering any kind of terminal illness, I recommend that you consider these sticks.

column9: Have I tried these myself? No...
column10: ...but the way my dogs almost take my hands off when I offer these to them says it all. They like these. They REALLY like these. (I know, dogs will eat anything, but mine are a little fussy. They are INSANE about these.)

Dogs love it. Trying out the Chicken next, but they had the salmon and this too; like clockwork there they are sitting motioning their eyeballs to where it is kept. They never done this for treats before!
but he won't got near these treats. i'm so sad because i have a large package of them. my chuggle/puggle put one in his mouth and spat it out. again, sad.

column9: Niether a ChickenStrip  nor a Chicken Jerky ( or Duck Jerky)
column10: This product is more of a crumbly cookie.  My beagle ate it for a few days and then refused them.  I thought that his digestive system was a bit disrupted by this product, as well.  Of course, I cannot say for sure that these treats were the cause of his upset...perhaps my beagle can.  Anyhow, I will not be repeating this order.

column9: My toy doggies enjoy these rolls
column10: Our family has two Yorkies and a Chihuahua.  They are not aggressive chewers so these treats are perfect.  I just snap each one in half for a serving.  They are a good value.  These treats were very fresh!  I first got them in a specialty pet boutique and I had to saw through them with a sharp knife to break in half!  I thought that was normal until I got the big container from Amazon.  Very fresh and easy to snap for smaller treats.  I will buy these again.

I ordered four containers and two were fine, but the other two were not. The bad treats had  a greasy coat on the sticks and when I tried to split the treats in half, they crumbled and fell apart. I am debating on whether to purchase another container because they are much cheaper online, but prefer the consistent quality of the retail store in my neighborhood.
Dear Sir,I think this product is great and my dogs go crazy for this product and I am just going to order more.Carl

These treats are the worst I have ever encountered. Yes, they are natural, but good? No.  They are dry as hell and I liken them to particle board because of the way they shred and crumble. I would choke if I had to try to swallow these dried up things.  Nothing about them resemble duck meat. My dogs wouldn't eat them, and one of them would pretty much eat anything. Would not recommend these at all.
These are in no way 'strips', they're actually medium size nuggets which are not even chewy but more like biscuits.  My Golden does love them, hence the 3 stars, but the name is extremely deceptive.

The duck sticks were old, greasy and had a rank smell.  The container had a US flag sticker on the lid.  My dog really likes the Tinker duck treats, but I wouldn't give her these.  I hope Amazon finds a different supplier.

This is an easy review because the judgement was made by our two papillons.  They live for their treats and are NOT especially picky about treats.  These items are dried, uniform in size, and although they may be "organic" they smell bad and my dogs would have nothing to do with them.  I threw them out and wanted to share the expensive experience with others so they would not waste their money.

Love the pumpkin Reeses!These Reeses are proportionately more peanutty goodness with a thinner layer of milk chocolate. If Herseys made a dark chocolate version of these, I would stock up on them during Halloween and freeze them for the year.This particular package comes 6 pumpkins per pack and 3 packs in the package. I picked it up for Halloween since my local stores either did not have it, or were completely extorting their price.

This seasoning was definitely best with last year's new year's goose, but for the thanksgiving turkey, it also boosted the flavor. Be careful not to use too much because there is a LOT of salt in it - makes a difference especially if you are making your own gravy.

column9: Never again buy in this unstable glass bottle
column10: The oil was fine but the glass bottle not stable due to small bottom surface with rounded edges. Thus it slipped off its shelf and shattered on the floor. Big waste, big mess. Luckily I like the odor because it soaked in. Big job to clean up with broken glass. Baking soda, I hope, will absorb the bulk of that which remains, staining my floor. And I can go out and buy a product that garages use in oil spill clean up. In the future I will buy only plastic-bottled sesame oil. And hope I remember to check the bottle's bottom for common-sense stability.UPDATE: Now, in August of 2012, I want to reiterate my observation of how unstable this glass bottle is. I wound up with a second bottle of this brand - it was given to me - and the same thing happened. It is simply not stable on the shelf or in the door of a refrigerator where I keep such oils due to their potential to become rancid at higher temperatures; nor would it be stable on a cupboard shelf. There are several other brands of sesame oil available.
the product is great but the price was crazy expensive, it cost me over thirteen dollars for a bag of14oz jelly beans. i will never order from you people again.  Gail S Mateer
For a big jelly bean lover, they taste just like the lifesavers in the roll.Some were slightly sticky on arrival, but that did not hurt the taste.

Ohhhhh.... this is fabulous.  There's a recipe inside the wrapper for some sort of lovely-looking rice salad dish using this tapenade, but we may never get to it -- because the tapenade is so delightful all by itself with just crackers or crusty fresh bread.  I love it with the LU Herbes De Provence Flatbread Crackers, 4.25-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 6).  Great to have both the tapenade and the crackers in the house for an instant appetizer when guests drop by unexpectedly for a meal or a drink.  These little green jars are almost worth their weight in gold (okay, that's an exaggeration, but not by much), and you'll be very glad to have them on your shelf.  Beware:  they won't last long!Shelf-stable until opened; then refrigerate if you're lucky enough to have any leftovers.  :)  Caution:  quite salty, because of the olives -- not appropriate for people medically advised to drastically reduce sodium, but probably acceptable in moderation for most people in combination with something such as the recommended flatbread crackers, which will help offset the salty olives and make the average sodium in the combined appetizer more reasonable.

This olive tapenade was very different, and very good!  It is quite strong, so you will need to mix it with cream cheese or sour cream for a dip or something, but goes well on pasta or over grilled chicken.  Will buy again!

This product is the best Olive Tapenade in the world, according to my wife, an olive Tapenade tasting expert.  It comes in several different styles and they are all marvelous.  The containers are small so it stays fresh.  If you like olives and a simple smear of this Tapenade on a cracker or toast, this is a treat.  Cat Cora knows her olives.
The small jars of green olive tapenade were okay but nothing special in my opinion. Trader Joe's and other stores carry better, tastier tapenades.
In my opinion, this type of olive isn't good for an olive spread.  Of course, I had no way of knowing that until I bought it and tried it.  For this reason, I don't recommend it.

column9: Ass Kickin Kick Ass Jalapeno Hot Sauce
column10: This hot sauce is the best ever that we've tried. And we've tried alot! It's hard to find in the stores so we were very pleased to be able to find it on Amazon at an amazing price. It's so good we bought 2 cases of it just we wouldn't run out right away!

column4: RagenRat "A man's only as good as his word !!"
column9: Frontier Soup, Soup Tortilla South Of Brdr, 4.5-Ounce
column10: Frontier Soup, Soup Tortilla South Of Brdr, 4.5-OunceThis folk's is one of the best soup's I've ever tasted !!!!I just can't get enough of this stuff, Be a great friend and give this for a gift that you will always be remembered for.We always have this stocked and ready for when the mood hits.Buy great product with confidence.RagenRat :0)

My mistake for not spotting the word, "flavored," but this is really awful! I was expecting Blue Mountain coffee and instead got this foul tasting coffee-like brew that has no coffee taste at all. Is it hazelnut? I hope not - I have nut allergies. Whatever it is, it overpowers any weak coffee flavor that may have been present at the beginning!Checking the ingredients on the package, we learn that it includes Arabica coffee and "natural and/or artificial flavors." Digging around the Wolfgang Puck website, we first learn that it's "Light flavored coffee with the essence of the islands (Flavored)" and finally, "Coconut Infusion Flavored Coffee."I never would have guessed coconut.

column4: L. MURRAY "Pleased to share my observations!"
column9: Fabulous coffee, reliable quality, fast and easy
column10: I love this coffee from Wolfgang Puck, it is always fresh, tasty and provides a consistent cup of java, one cup at a time.Best of all, you can taste the flavors that make Jamaica Blue Mountain coffee so famous. Of course, it is not 100% Blue Mountain, but a respectable blend of arabica beans that includes enough of that treasured bean to justify its name. And it is neither under nor over roasted, just done to the point where the flavors are best.

I bought this for use in my Bunn pod brewer, and since I am unable to buy these pods at the local supermarket, I took a chance at buying a 54 unit package without having tasted the product before.  Just opening the pouch releases a pleasant and sweet aroma.  This coffee is light and balanced, with low acidity.  I quickly went through the first 18 count box.
Jamaica Me Crazy is my new favorite. The aroma alone makes me smile. Unlike most flavored coffees, the taste delivers too. Awesome coffee!
Great tasting coffee.  I use two pods because I like it strong.  Pods fit Senseo coffee maker perfectly.

column9: Did not realize these coffee pods would not work in a Keurig
column10: When I attempted to return this item upon finding it would not work in a Keurig, I was especially disappointed to see that I could not return even the second unopened box.

This has become one of our favorite Keurig flavors. The taste is very smooth and the coconut flavor is not over-powering. We drink our coffee black, and some of the flavored coffees have a strong, almost bitter after-taste when cream and sugar aren't used. This one doesn't have that after-taste. I'm on my 4th reorder, and have started buying the larger boxes so I don't have to do without it.
I have tried other pods and have noticed the added flavors are over-powering and leave a chemical after-taste. The pods without the added flavors taste great. I am a pod fan.

I got this 3 pack because I LOVE Jamaica me Crazy K-cups (which is what I thought these would be). But, regardless, when they arrived and I realized they were pods I thought "Oh well, I can still use them in my Kurig."... But these taste nothing like the K-cups! I mean, NOTHING. ...dirty water. I can't imagine any kind of single cup brewer somehow magically making these things taste good.

wolfgang puck jamaica me crazy coffee makes my mother crazy about coffee so i buy it for her all the time and the best deal for these coffee pods has been on amazon so this is where i get them...good coffee...good price and free ship with amazon...glenn

I was also expecting something more akin to the Green Mountain 'Island Coconut' coffee - an aromatic coffee that tastes like coconut - this is NOT remotely close. Doesn't smell or taste very good and the coconut flavor or smell is almost non-existent. Don't waste your money.

column9: amazingly good Dessert Coffee.. LOVE IT.
column10: I received a new coffee maker and  it has the option to use these coffee pods in the single serving side of the machine..Well decided to try a few varieties to see what might be good and what my guests might enjoy. Well I am blown away at HOW GOOD this variety, Jamaica Me Crazy tastes... I am not usually a fan of flavored coffee's but this is just enough of a light coconut flavor and scent to make it a nice variation .. This is particularly pleasant as a after dinner dessert coffee with a light amt of cream.. No sugar is really need.. I like the light sweet smell  that my cup of coffee give me . Such a pleasant experience..  I will definitely be getting more of this variety and it also inspires me to want to try some others that Wolfgang Puck has as well..

column9: Good coffee with a little bite.
column10: This was very good coffee, enjoy the pod style coffee makers the best. Quick and easy no mess to clean up after.

This coffee was a dollar more than most, but I love coconut flavored coffee and just had to pay the price for "Jamaica Me" to give it a try!I"m so glad I tried it! It is without a doubt the best K cup of coffee I've ever tried.

Description said flavored, but what kind of flavor?  I purchased, and I did not like the flavor: it had a cinnamon taste to it.  Description should mention the flavor to expect.  Hawaiian hazelnut is very good and subtle.  Works great with my Senseo

I thought I was ordering K-cups since I found this listing in an Amazon e-mail to me about K-cups. The mistake was unfortunate and Amazon made it right by issuing an immediate refund. I just wish I could have found a way to use the "pods" in my Keurig machine because Wolfgang Puck Jamiacan Me Crazy is my favorite coffee of all.  Thank you Amazon for being the best online merchant of all.

column9: Don't Buy Non-Returnable Items like this on Amazon
column10: I bought these coffee "Pods" to use in my Keurig. Now discover that these are differenct "Pods". Amazon wont't take them back. I am stuck.
I did not know there was a difference between "pods" and K cup coffee.  Very disappointed in the description.  Again, THESE ARE NOT K CUPS!!
This was also Hazelnut just like the K-Cups. This wasn't in the description and smelled awful. It was Wolfgang me crazy.

The Royal never fails, this particular gelatin as the other kind are great. Flavor and texture are nice. Very good qualitity products that Royal makes. I have enjoyed this products for the summer months every year.
They are so yummy it is hard to not eat the entire bag at one time.  Wish the hazelnut was a bit larger.

This is a tasty orange sauce. We buy frozen orange-flavored chicken. The sauce pack included barely coats the meat, with nothing leftover to flavor the rice we serve with it. We used to buy a large size at Costco, but they don't seem to carry it any more. We are happier with the 20.75 ounce size, even though it costs a little more. You don't have a huge bottle open in the fridge for months, and the flavor is fresher. It took a long time to find an orange sauce we liked, and we hope Panda Express keeps making it.
I love this sauce; it is sweet and tangy and makes a quick and easy addition to a chicken dish.

Our whole family loves this sauce! We buy the box of Orange Chicken that is sold in Costco, throw away the sauce that is provided and use the Panda Express Orange Sauce instead. It is wonderfully spicy. We serve it over rice and add peas and chopped carrots. For us, a great meal.
This was packaged nicely, and didn't take long to ship. The sauce is amazing, and worth the price for 6!

column9: Orange you pleased?  I sure am
column10: I bought this orange sauce as a gift for a relative.  They really like it and could no longer find it at Costco.  Sorry that I haven't tasted it myself but they sure like the flavoring.  I can at least share that it arrived here safe and sound, no broken glass etc.  I should have kept a bottle.  It looks as if they'll have enough sauce for a lifetime.  Oops.

I am a huge fan of Panda Express Orange Chicken, but no longer live near a restaurant.  I've tried to re-create the sauce in my own kitchen but never quite got it right--I'm so glad to be able to buy the real thing!  I can now skip the step of breading/deep-frying the meat, as the sauce gives it plenty of flavor and lets you save on the fat and calories of the finished dish.  Definitely recommended!

nothing can compare to knorr stew or sauerbraten package mixes...  the sauerbraten mix is incredible...i wish more people would find out about it and try it...they only troube is... they are hard to find in supermarkets... get 'em while you can.

I used this product many years ago and liked the results.  Recently I decided to use it for a dinner I was preparing for guests.  Unfortunately I tried all our grocery stores (6) and none of them had this Knorr product.  I was so please to find that I could get it at Amazon.  My sauerbraten dinner was a success!

My store quit carrying this product.  I panicked!  But, only for a moment.  I knew I could find it online and I did!  Got Fast service!  I can't do without my German food and this makes the best tasting pot roast around.  I've saved a link to this site for future purchasing.

I learned to use this while in Germany for a year.  My friend showed me how to use it as a base for his recipe (red wine, Lots of onions and vinager) and it makes great Sauerbraten.  It is not available for me in my area so this works great for me.

Using this mix, you can create authentic sauerbraten in only hours instead of days!  To finish, I recommend crushing two or three gingersnaps to fine crumbs and stirring them into the gravy before serving.  For a richer taste, stire in 1/4 c. sour cream.  Either way, it's deliscious!

Unable to purchase the Knorr Sauerbraten Pot Roast mixture anywhere in our shopping area, I discovered the product at a little store called "Betty's" in the vacation town of Helen, Georgia, while visiting my sister, who lives nearby that area.  So delicious and the family raves about the taste.  I feel so lucky to have found the item on Amazon!

My husband and I love German food!This Knorr Sauerbraten seasoning is great! I have looked at recipes online and in books but this is the easiest thing in the world to make it with. It used to be carried in our local grocery stores but I haven't seen it for years. When I found it here with "free super saver shipping" I bought a box of 12! Cooking tip: cook the roast in the sauce until it is nearly falling apart then serve it with spaetzle (or thick egg noodles), pickled red cabbage, dark bread and sweet cream butter. Heaven on a winter's evening!

column9: So glad to finally find this again!!!!
column10: We love Knorr Sauerbraten and have had a hard time finding it. It fabulous over noodles or even mashed potatoes. Now that we know where to get it, we will be enjoying it regularly!

Knorr Pot Roast, Sauerbraten Mix, CASE 12x2ozFor a really different and delicious way to cook a roast, you can not beat this product. I have been familiar with it and have been using it for years. I always serve it for Christmas dinner.

I followed the instructions exactly and the result was a marginal pot roast. It had no "sour" taste and was no like any Sauerbraten I have ever had. It was terrible! We ended up throwing away the meat and I am stuck with 11 packets of sauce mix. It is wildly inconsistent with the rest of the reviews. I will send a note to Amazon and Knorr to see if they had a bad batch. Any suggestions would be appreciated.
This is the best Sauerbraten mix ever ... and the gravy it makes is wonderful!  Very difficult to find in stores ... so glad to find it on Amazon.
I grew up with this spice and missed it. I enjoy ist everytime. Goulash or Beef Stew is also excellent.

My mom and I have tried to make homemade (and we're homemade fans for most everything) but this just can't be reproduced the same, especially for the cost. It's delicious and I don't have leftovers when I use this product.

We absolutely love the flavors of this item. I use beef chunks or a pot roast depending on the mood. I do not add potatoes or carrots to the mix but serve them with this product. I love keeping thing seperate and serving the wonderfull gravy with the flavored meat. Its a winter weekly stable at our house.Please try and enjoy, you will LOVE IT.
i add two packages to my crock pot for stews and pot roasts, it adds nice flavor and thickens into a nice gravy, been using for years and super market was outrageous at 2.99 each.
We cannot buy this product locally.  The mix is easy to use and tastes great.  I would recommend highly.  Makes a good tasting sauerbraten.

This is great coffee and very affordably priced.  Jacobs is very rich but smooth and mellow, not bitter like so many coffees.  Some friends sent it to me from Belgium years ago and I have been hooked ever since.  Not available in grocery stores the price on Amazon is great.  My son is in the military and can get it at the commisary and the Amazon price is the same.

column9: A RARE GREAT tasting TEA all day long ;)
column10: Love, love love this tea. What an amazing flavor. I enjoy this as my pick me upper. I love knowing that it is grown from an old european family estate for over a century! You can definetly taste why this tea is a rare tea! Try this tea and let me know if you love it as much as I do. I love opening my tin and smelling the tea..mmmmmm now thats european tea!

column9: european pleasure in a tea cup
column10: This is the best tea brand I have ever drank!! WOW..I tried some samples that were given to me as well. I did not think that the tea would taste so fresh and amazing. This tea has no after taste..NO AFTER TASTE..I have had many teas that after you drink them leave a bad taste in your mouth..this is what tea should all taste like. I will for now on only serve the best teas to my guests, and that means Gorreana teas..the smell = EXCELLENT..What a pleasure to know that this tea has been family owned for since the 1800's. I hope that more stores start carrying this tea in retails stores in San Jose, Calif. mmmmm
I love these, my daughter loves taking these to school for snack time. I take them to work, all my co-workers love them plain or with milk.

I ordered these and my kids used them as their Valentines... the bag is a good size and the contents fill it up. My kids have been loving these as a snack to grab out the door for breakfast or when their friends come over, they open them up and eat them. Great value and great taste!! It is the cereal in a bag. YUMMY!!

I've seen people offering these to their cats at cat shows, so I thought I'd try them on my cats.  I learned right away that I have several issues with them:  (1) They have kind of an off-odor, almost like turpentine.  (2) My cats weren't impressed.  They sniffed the treats, sort of chewed on them, then walked away. (3) The treats must be refrigerated after opening, which is not a huge problem but can be inconvenient at times. Try the chicken flavor instead -- the cats love it!

My cat adores these.  I crumble some over his (Halo salmon) dry food and he is in cat heaven.  He loves the chicken version, too.  These can also be "reconstituted" by adding a little water, as an alternative to wet food.  I love that the ingredient list contains a single item:  Freeze-dried wild salmon.  Simple and perfect.

column9: Brilliant for Dogs with Sensitive Skin
column10: Halo Salmon Treats are great for dogs with allergies (gluten free/no meat/allergies).  I just wish these treats weren't so difficult to find.
Shake the container and they come running. Even my boy cat, who isn't big on ANY food, loves these! A winner in our house! Two paws up!
I normally get the chicken which both my dogs like.  I gave some to the cat who gobbled it up and then beat the dogs off to get theirs.  I decided to try the beef.  Everyone loves it.

My dog goes crazy for these treats!  Also, I noticed that the price fluxates, so if you are on a budget, you can check daily to see if the price goes up and down. When the price lowers, I usually order a few, as this dehydrated light-weight yummy treat does not get hard.  My dog is very old, and only has a few teeth.  Even when this product isn't fresh, my dog has no problem eating them.  This is one of the few treats that she loves.  I even keep them in the car so that she gets a treat when she's riding.  That's how fresh they stay.I haven't been able to find these in the store. Only similar items, but nothing comes close. Also, if your dog is picky, don't be discouraged if you try different flavors and your dog only likes one flavor. My dog kind of goes back and forth, but always comes back to the beef.  The chicken flavor is very messy, but the beef flavor is easy to even break parts smaller without any crumbs dropping on your clothese.Excellent products.  Thanks Amazon!
Very tasty treats. A little expensive.  We use them for dog training class. No extra added ingredients. Your hands don't get messy. Our dogs both love them.

column9: Good, but not as good as Chicken.
column10: I think this is a good product, but my cats do not like it as much as the chicken flavor.  But otherwise, Liv-a-Littles are a hit.
We have two barn cats that we can't touch. But each evening they visit our back porch to receive their cat treats.
Too hard- my cats are not happy with them @ all- they are like shoe leather.  They loved the chicken treats, but these are not comparable.
My wife and I have given our dogs liv-a-littles treats for years. We were very pleased to be able to find them at Amazon.com as the treats are sometimes hard to find in retail stores.

I bought these as treats for my cat, and he absolutely loves them. In fact he likes them soo much I don't know where the container is as he has stolen it and hidden it somewhere.I should also mention not to give too many of these to a cat at once, they seem to expand in the stomach, and after I gave him 5 in a short period, he threw up a HUGE amount of the stuff. But I have never had a problem with one or two treats at a time.They also do not have much of an smell, I've had some dehydrated fish in the past that smelled horrible, that is not an issue with these.

column9: Kitties need their fix-- Like crack for cats
column10: Halo Liv-a-Littles Whole Beef TreatsWe have purchased the beef, chicken and salmon for our kitty.  She goes crazy over all of the flavors.
