After I did a bit of homework on all salmon jerky available on market, I decided to give this one a try.  Today, I just received it and tasted it.  It is very yummy.  It is chewy but definitely not dried out and brittle. It is also a very good protein source, from the package, I see that out of 1 oz (28 gram), it has only 1 g of fat, 2 g of sugar, but has 16 g of protein - a super healthy food. This one is of original flavor.  I wish they have other flavor (like super spicy one so that it can last longer).  Anyway, I will reorder the salmon jerky after I finish this package.
Great flavor although the majority of the pieces were a little dry and brittle when I was expecting a more moist consistency.  Overall, pretty good product that I would buy again.
I had enough for myself and my two neighbors.We have all enjoyed it.  I recommend it highly.

I began buying salmon jerky after a trip to Canada a few years back. This salmon jerky is indeed chewy, so I would only recommend it to people having nice jaw muscles and enjoying chewing. For me, 20 minutes after receiving it, I already finished almost half a pack with no problem.Interestingly, after reading 'The Road' by Cormac McCarthy, I started to have the urge to have some non-perishable food at hand. But this is just a tasty snack in my opinion. It will not last you through the seemingly endless nuclear winter. The $10 discount code for $50 Grocery purchase makes it tastier for sure.
Tastewise, it is not bad. Although it is very hard as candy, it could be chewed a bit easier if bitten along texture. However, I am not sure whether I would buy another once this box is gone.

Although I was a little put off by a prior review that indicated this product was nearly inedible, we had purchased this salmon jerky at Trader Joe's in smaller packets and really liked it, so we decided to purchase here at Amazon much less expensively.  Yes, this product is very dry, but it also has none of the preservatives included in some of the more moist jerky products out there.  My family liked it, and we are placing a second order.  That other reviewer should send her inedible seven extra packages our way!

This salmon jerky is definitely tasty.  It has a slightly strong peppery taste to it, which I really like.The previous reviewer was correct in thinking the jerky was a bit too dry and hard to chew.  It'll take you a while to bite a piece off and chew it.  My jaws were too tired to even eat a whole serving.Nonetheless, the jerky is quite tasty so I'm not dissapointed.These come in eight resealable pounches, each with 2 ounces of salmon jerky.  I'm sure these will last a while since it'll take a while to chew them all up.
I always buy this brand of jerky from whole foods and it's always great. I love the salmon jerky, it tastes great and is very full filing.

column9: Perfect base for making your own Puttanesca!
column10: I bought these 2 sealed bags last year during a sale, and I will do that again once I will have used up the huge supply I got with them. You only need a tiny portion (few spoon fulls of content) to make a good recipe.To make a good Puttanesca you will need crushed/pureed tomatoes as base ( I recommend Marzano from Cento, I get them localy for 3,50$ per bottle), onions, garlic, and these dried tomatoes/jalapenos/capers. I actually add more capers from a separate jar into mine, and I sometimes add also (vegetarian) Bacos to give some meat flavour. Then of course you will need good olives with it. I add some from my huge Roland tubs I also ordered last year when they had this big sale for bulk items.Recommended for any cook who really craves pure ingredients to cook with, NOT CONVENIENCE foods. Because you still have to work with these, and I would not eat them in any raw way. These are not meant for snacking out of the bag!

Needless to say this is great coffee, and I'm a coffee snob.Right now I have coffee (both roasted, and not roasted) from several countries, including 100% Kona, and 100% Jamaican Blue Mountain, I like this Tim Horton's blend the best.Also, this is a great grind for the best way to brew coffee ever, percolated in an aluminum pot, (my favorite pot is a Wear-Ever from the 40's/50's).I have every method available for brewing coffee and I do mean that literally, and perked coffee in an aluminum pot makes the best tasting coffee ever.A close second is slow dripping by hand, and third is my Bunn spray/drip maker, all the other methods I have make the worst tasting coffee.  I use them occasionally, and simply wind up throwing out the coffee as I just can't drink it...the worst of the worst tasting coffee is from a vacuum pot, or for that matter any glass pot (for brewing) period!I also have a glass, and a stainless steel percolator but they have become dust collectors, coffee tastes horrible when brewed in either glass, or stainless steel.BTW/ Don't always listen to online opinions concerning either perked coffee, or using an aluminum coffee pot, as people tend to be like sheep following one another, or behave like parrots and simply reiterate the majority opinion. Most people I've talked to that bad mouth perked coffee have never even tasted perked coffee, that's a fact, they simply parrot the majority, christian's tend to follow the others like lost sheep the most.The water does not boil when you percolate coffee, as when using a glass percolator you can see the water percolating way before it starts to boil, also as the water travels up, the water very slightly cools.  What you have to do as soon as it starts to percolate is to monitor the heat. I shut the heat off of my electric stove, if you have gas, just lower the heat, and let it perk for about 2 min. or so. I will admit that you have to monitor the process, but it is so, so worth it.I will say that I don't cook with aluminum, and there's a very scientific reason for brewing coffee in an aluminum pot, but this is not the place to get into it.Grinding the beans to the best coarseness for percolating can sometimes be a pain, (well not that big of a pain), but still I thought I would try this coffee out.Perfect, perfect coffee, at a perfect grind using the best method for brewing coffee and I have a winner.

column9: Baby Gourmet's Juicy Pear and Garden Greens pureed baby food is an excellent way to introduce veggies into a baby's diet ...
column10: I've never really met a baby who didn't make faces or spit back out one sort of food or another.  Everyone's palate is a bit different and the slight tartness, veggie taste may not be to everyone's liking (it isn't to mine).  This is however, an excellent opportunity for parents and caretakers to introduce garden greens into a baby's diet.  I'm sure many grandparents will remember introducing pureed peas into baby's diet and getting a lot of it pushed back onto the spoon or bib.  Same thing.  The decision is whether or not you wish to give Baby Gourmet a try.The food comes in a thickened liquid form in pouches.  These pouches can easily be tossed in a diaper bag, backpack, or stroller.  The Juicy Pear & Garden Greens can either be served warm or cold, but the pouches are not microwavable.  The only drawback is that each pouch has a cap that could prove to be a choking hazard for toddlers.  Simply remember to either replace it or discard it when not in use.  The food can be put in a bowl or the handy "Squeeze Feed" can be used when on the go.  This food can also be used for the elderly who need additional nutrition, but have medical problems that make eating solid foods difficult.PROS:+  100%  Organic+  No filler or thickeners+  No added salt+  Gluten Free+  Nut Free+  BPA Free packaging+  No dairy, egg or lactoseINGREDIENTS:*  Organic Pear*  Organic Broccoli*  Organic Spinach*  Ascorbic Acid (Vitamin C)*  Organic Lemon Juice ConcentrateI do like the packaging and the concept of "disguising" the greens in a pear base.  This may or not work for all babies, but is worth a try.  It can further be disguised in oatmeal or other recipes.  Concerns about a short shelf life are somewhat invalid as it is assumed that you'll be using the product fairly quickly and not stockpile.  There are no preservatives so a quick expiration date is a given.  Not all babies will "love" to eat this product, but it's worth a try.

My baby has had rice cereal for couple of weeks. then before starting her on this pear and garden greens, I let her have sweet potatoes so that her first memories of food are nice instead of ultra healthy greens. But she devoured this too. It is a good choice to be able to introduce greens so early. Just before feeding, I could smell ripe pear and sweet.

Baby gourmet Organic Simple Stage 1 is a quality puree with no sugar and has BPA free packaging (very important for infants).  The all natural, organic product has no added salt or fillers and is gluten free.  The puree is decent tasting, and my 6 year old even willingly eats it!  The organic contents are pear, broccoli, spinach, ascorbic acid (great for digestion and your liver) and lemon juice concentrate.  These are high quality fruits and veggies anyone (never mind baby) should be eating.  I highly recommend this very healthy, organic product.

I tasted this product rather than a baby because there is no better way for me to try it.  I really thought it was wonderful.  It has a very pleasant taste and it is made from organic ingredients.  I think this is a product that your baby will like and you can feel good about giving it to them.  I also really like the containers, although I can see where the lid could be a potential choking hazard if not careful

column10: Wow!  I wish I'd known about this baby food when I was caring for my mom after her second stroke.  She had trouble swallowing, but was very tired of the food offered to elderly patients with swallowing difficulties.  This is not only a great change from pulverized string beans and mashed potatoes, but it's a delicious change of pace.  Here's my take on "Baby Gourmet Organic Simple Purees:"PROS:1.  Taste - as mentioned, this tastes good.2.  Packaging -- a soft plastic pack means no more breakable jars to complicate life for the new parent or the caregiver for an elderly relative.  This is a huge advantage when you're trying to manage care of an elderly with a palate that's tired of hospital purees.3.  Additional uses -- while I often avoid reading the reviews from others, I did read the review from the author who used this pureed pear in Korean barbeque sauce.  Great idea! And great taste for the barbeque sauce -- YUM!CONS:None.  I'm going to purchase other fruits and vegetables to store for quick cooking ingredients.OVERALL:A healthy, tasty product with multiple uses.  Try it! You may like it, too.Five Stars!

My six month old nephew happily ate this, each time it was offered, and although he can't tell us exactly how good it was, we could tell.We eat organic as much as possible so it's nice to offer babies organic food that's good for them.  This is a combination of pear, spinach and brocolli. I tasted it myself and would have no problem eating this.  It tastes like pureed pears and brocolli.  It isn't too sweet and is flavorful.Babies typically don't like any greens but this mixture containing the pear for a bit of natural sweetness is a good tasting mixture.There is nothing artifical in this.  You can know you are feeding healthy organic food to  your baby.It is also a "convenience" food, since you can feed it right out of the package, simply by squeezing it through the feeding tube and into a spoon, or into the baby's mouth if you are out somewhere.  The packages keep the food fresh, and they are spillproof in a bag along with your other baby items.I can highly recommend this.

The baby really likes this one.My wife prefers to squeeze it into a spoon to feed the baby sometimes.  This is useful in some situations like in the car.Other times she just tries to encourage the baby to suck it from the pouch.Still other times she puts a lot on a plate and feeds him old skool style.We've tried all three.Anyway the flavor was a hit, and its organic, so, we are very pleased.

Wow...where were these twenty years ago when we were tortured with glass jars?  Incredibly convenient for the mom and baby that are "on the go".  My first thought was, "Yes, I CAN take these to the pool!"  My 6 month old baby taste tester loved them!  I don't think you can go wrong here!

For an adult, this has a semi-sweet taste likely due to the pears.  The taste of the broccoli or spinach masked by the semi-sweet taste thankfully.  The product tastes and feels somewhat like a light version of apple sauce.  The taste is somewhere in the ballpark of Naked juice's Green Machine.  This product manages to put about every insensitivity/alergy buzz word on the package -- gluten free, nut free, BPA free, etc.  The product has very clear serving instructions and is easy to open.  The cap is a choking hazard which is unfortunate but I don't know of a better solution where you can still have a nice feeding tube present.  I'd rather give up the plastic cap and feeding tube for the environment and use maybe a tear-open package.Feeding this product to a 6+ month old child, the reaction was neutral compared to his other favorite meals.  This was based on his body language and facial reaction -- the best I can do.  :)Note that the item I received in July 2012 also had an expiration date of July 2012.  I'm not sure if these packets normally have such a short shelf life or not.  Perhaps since they don't have so many preservatives in them you have to use the product quickly?

When i received the baby food i had to try it before giving it to my daughters sister..It actually tastes pretty darn good.The consistency is like apple sauce.Its in a foil type pouch and has a spout that has a cap on it.You can warm it or serve it cold,or room temperature.After opening it you need to refridgerate it.You remove the cap and put the tip of it in the babys mouth and squeeze a little into his or her mouth.Its a wonderful design and cleanup is a breeze.I think any mother would love the product and i recommend it highly.

Our grandson, 11 months old, has been consuming this product with great gusto. He will eat a full pouch at a sitting, without fuss or bother, and want more.The product has what I think is a really key advantage: it's not seasoned to adult tastes. This means it is neither salty nor sweet, and that has got to be better for baby.It's also very convenient. It's great "travel food" and the cap closes tightly, should it happen that baby doesn't eat it all (though that hasn't happened as yet). You might argue that there is a bit too much packaging, but the convenience factor is quite high, and I think the tradeoff is worth it.This is an excellent product all-around and baby definitely recommends it.

column9: Useful When You Don't Have Time to Make it Yourself
column10: My daughter-in-law is making most of my grandson's foods from scratch but, as a working mom, sometimes convenience is a lifesaver.When looking for convenience food, we choose organic foods with no unnecessary fillers or sweeteners.  However, greens can be a bit stout for a six month old so we'll break him easy with a little added pear.He seemed to enjoy this flavor baby food. Kept opening his mouth for more. This was a great way to introduce the baby to greens in a puree form mixed in with a sweet fruit but I notice this brand is a little pricey.  Once he starts liking a little texture in his food I would rather make this combo myself.

column9: Twin Boys Seemed to Like It
column10: 9 month old twin boys ate the baby food with no problem.  It had bits of greens in it, and comes in a straw pouch.  The directions said to pour it into a bowl, but I wanted to see how they'd handle the straw.  They promptly squeezed and decorated themselves, so I took the pouches away and put the food in a bowl.  I supplemented with some finger foods, because the twins are all about feeding themselves right now, but it's right in line with what they've been eating lately.I did think the straw aspect would be pretty handy - but the directions also remind parents that the top is a choking hazard for younger kids - so it might be more trouble than it's worth.

Ive been waiting for my pediatrician to give the go ahead with baby foods and she finally did a few weeks ago so I decided to give this a try.I must say that I like tasting any food before I give them to my baby and I hated the taste of this but my baby on the other hand loved it. Well after all it wasn't designed/made for me. The desired serving size is 1/2 packet but she always want a bit more so I gave it to her with absolutely no problem. As long as baby is happy so am I.I love the fact that the ingredients are all food, no fillers but wish the price wasn't so expensive.I'd buy the other organic foods that aren't as expensive but if I had the money I'd definitely get this for her again.

OK, so I'm a Vine reviewer so I figured I'd try this product for fun.First off, the ingredients are simple and organic.  There's no sodium or sugar added.  As a food, it tastes pretty good.  It has about the same texture as apple sauce.I like the packaging and the fact that you can feed your baby by squeeezing the bag.  This eliminates the need for a bowl and spoon and reduces the amount of mess.Whoever came up with this product did a good job.I took off one star because mine came in July 2012 with a July 2012 expiration date.  Seriously?

I love this stuff, as does my nephew!  It's great, convenient, easy to open and serve, easy to store, and doesn't make a mess.  If you get it on sale, it's definitely a great deal!  I will absolutely continue to buy this and have already recommended it to my sister-in-law.  (She was impressed with it, too!)Also love that it's organic, that's always a huge plus!  Great product!
I didn't personally taste this, but my son did and he likes it so that's a winner for me!  I like that it's organic and I also like the container, easy to throw into a diaper bag.

column9: Yummy - good enough for me to eat, let alone the baby!
column10: Very good baby food, good taste and texture.  The baby gobbled it down and I snuck a taste to find it was really good.  I like the organic nature of it - I feel good feeding him something that I feel is better than processed food.

column9: a healthy hit with babies, but not toddlers
column10: First off, the ingredient list of this baby food (Organic pear, organic broccoli, organic spinach, ascorbic acid, organic lemon juice concentrate) earns no complaints from me. Obviously, use your discretion about when to introduce these foods, and how they fit into your baby's complete diet. I personally wait until at least 8 months to introduce broccoli and spinach, since they can be a bit harder to digest than some others. But certainly a blend of organic fruit and veggies has a good place in a baby's menu.The packaging is also nice in my opinion: it's portable, convenient, resealable and BPA free. I make most of my own baby food, but this would be highly convenient if I'm on the go. A parent could even squeeze directly into a spoon for feeding if you didn't want to tote and clean a bowl. If leftover portions haven't been in contact with a dirty spoon, you can reseal and refrigerate for a day or so.My only other criteria for evaluation is taste preference. Obviously this is going to vary from child to child, but I offered this to several young guests in our home and the consensus seemed to be that babies liked it, but toddlers didn't. I realize this is baby food, so that makes sense, but I'd hoped my toddler would also enjoy it. Squeeze pouches of blended fruit are usually popular with that age, a convenient snack, and this particular blend would have been wonderful for relieving occasional "regularity issues." Alas, several toddlers turned this down, even though mine does like all these ingredients separately. It was a hit with a 12-month-old guest,  however.All in all, this seems to be a solid choice if you're looking for a fruit/veggie baby food in a convenient, packable container. It does make sense to buy a smaller amount first if you can to be certain that your child likes these flavors together.

Really good and the baby loves it. I thought the combo of pear and greens might not be that tasty, but I even tested it myself and it's quite good! Love the pouch for easy travel, great ingredients as well. Definitely a must!

column9: Mom loves the ingredients & packaging but toddler doesn't love flavor
column10: I don't even want to admit how many of these types of pouches my 2yr old goes through in a week, she has some issues with food textures and I have a really hard time getting her to eat the veggies I cook for the rest of the family (she does happily eat most fruits though), so in an effort to make sure she was getting enough veggies I turned to this type of pouch and found out she LOVES them. They are especially great for traveling in the car or packing for snacks while at the park, instead of a junky granola bar or sticky fruit snacks she'll happily suck down an all natural pouch.That said she wasn't a huge fan of this flavor, I tried it and thought it was on par with the other brands she likes but she always skips over these when picking out her flavors from the big box I keep them all in.Definitely worth a try to see if your little one likes them, and don't give up just because they might not like one flavor. I usually try to buy in grocery stores so she can try one before committing to a case!

It is so commendable that we are seeing more high quality organic products like this one available on the market now.  I really appreciate Baby Gourmet's efforts with the 100 percent organic, unsweetened Juicy Pear and Garden Greens.The taste, quality, and texture are excellent.  This is good baby food.  The packaging is very convenient to use, but it really should be further developed to be either recyclable or even biodegradable (such as corn-based plastic?) in the near future.  As others have mentioned, be careful with the caps.

Gourmet food for growing taste buds. In today's age we can't seem to get any kid to eat veggies, let alone enjoy them. These little packets are not only tasty but give little taste buds an excellent introduction into good eating habits.

I used to make my baby food from scratch using freshly cooked veggies and fruits using as little salt as possible.  I was frequently disappointed in the flavor of the pre-made baby foods I bought from the grocery store and tried.  I made all sorts of different items for my kids from black-bean/eggplant combo to sweet potato and plums combo and everything in between.  I added real butter too just because it made the food taste so good and the babies loved it!This product is not as good as what I made, however, it comes pretty close.  I only have the green bean/pear flavor to review, but I am impressed with it's flavor and texture.  It's a little thinner than what I made, but it's not watery at all.  I have tasted this product myself and can taste the green beans and the pears.  The pear flavor is stronger but not overwhelming.  The color is light to medium brown with a hint of green.  And the slight, gritty texture of pear is apparent, but should be easily tolerated by a baby.As a mom, I would be willing to incorporate this into my baby's diet as needed, but I'd still go the homemade baby-food route for the long-haul.  I think that the packaging is good in that I feel less air gets into the package when stored in the refrigerator after opening.  I remember the baby food jars having discolored food from oxidation in the jars after opening.  This product must be kept cold after opening or it will spoil just like any other food.  It tastes good, I think the green-bean/pear combo is a healthy one and you don't have to worry about the jar breaking if you drop it since it's in a nice squeezable package.
Our 2 year old and infant both LOVE these and the design of the pouch spout on the side seems to result in less accidental squeeze-n-squirt disasters than the kind with the the spout at the top.

Feeding my great nephew while babysitting is a joy. I adore him.But getting him to eat green vegies has been a challenge. When Ihad the chance to try this, I jumped at it for my sake as much as for his!First time out, Baby Gourmet Organic Simple Puree got his seal of approval.I wish I could have posted the picture I have of his enthusiastic endorsementof the product.Of course I had to taste it myself, and I have to say that I agree. This is atasty choice for your little one, and if Owen could talk ( or type )  I am pretty sure thathe would add his recommendation to mine.One last thing, the packaging is brilliant, space saving and simple. Veryeasy to toss into a travel or diaper bag. Well done Baby Gourmet!ETAI put this food into a bowl and feed him with a spoon.

gave this to the daughter that has the 5 month old grandson.  the next day she gave him one of the fruits and he scarfed it down and wanted more she said.  she really likes this stuff.  she likes the fact that it is organic.  the puree is thick enough to satify the tyke but yet thin enough for the boy to get the full spoonful she says.  she also likes the fact that it has a cap and you can pour the amount desired and then recap for later use

The Baby Gourmet Organic simple purees offers parents an easy way to travel with healthy organic baby food that your baby will love. This organic puree is a convenient and healthy way to feed your baby and the taste is extremely tasty. There are no chemicals or preservatives which is great but that also means that the baby food expires in about 6 months, so you can't store it for long periods of time. The nozzle is perfect if you make a thick bottle as I do for my little niece and add some of the baby puree into a bottle with some of the milk to create a hardy meal for your baby. My niece loves this so much she gobbled it up so quickly that I had to taste it myself to see what this was all about and I loved the taste and the texture.This package is amazing and allows you to take this with you anywhere without worrying about if the food will break inside of your baby bag. I love this product and I'm happy that this is extremely healthy as well as tasty.

Baby loves the taste, and so do I! It's not overly sweet like some dessert baby foods can be; you can taste the veggies, which seems like a good way to associate them from an early age. The ingredients are wholesome, organic, and don't have anything artificial. This is a great product!

column9: Great packaging, but two kids said "Blech!"
column10: This is a great idea and the packaging could not be better.  These are actually quite large.  Stage 1 is 6 months plus, but the seven month old who tried this for me couldnt hold it on his own.  The top has a safety ring, and then unscrews.  It can be rescrewed back on.  I'd be careful with the top since it seems like it might be a choking hazard if left on a highchair tray.I tried it and I thought it tasted terrible, but I generally dont like these overly sweet baby foods.  However, two other kids - one seven months old and a four year old both also gave the taste a thumbs down.  Both would only take one mouthful before refusing to eat any more.

column9: Handy Way to Feed Baby On-The -Go
column10: This is a really handy way to be able to feed a baby on the go.These 4.5 oz pouches do not need refrigeration until opened making it a great thing to toss in the diaper bag. This means the food is room temperature which usually suits a baby over cold from the fridge baby food.The screw top lid allows you to feed your baby and if not completely eaten, the lid screws back on and can then be refrigerated and then used for up to 24 hours.The squeezable pouch with a mouth sized tube opening means no spoons needed and no dirty spoon to clean up. Again very handy for travel. And babies have the sucking reflex so kind of drinking the fruit and vegetable food from a tube rather than using a spoon makes the transition from milk only to pureed food a lot easier.My six month old grandson ate half his pouch and then we put it in the fridge for his next feeding. The next feeding we squeezed the pear and garden greens baby food into a bowl since we were home and just used a spoon.This baby food is organic, so only the best ingredients are used.

column9: Both of my girls love this food!
column10: This was a great product for several reasons. One, it was my first introduction to this type of travel worthy pouch - I'm a fan now. Two, both my children love this food. I have a toddler/almost preschooler an infant/almost toddler and both of them gobble this down and ask for more. It's an interesting twist of flavor and ingredients, but healthy and I'm delighted to have something they like and want more. Love the natural, love the organic. I'll be looking for Baby Gourmet in the future.

5 stars for being organic because we want our babies to have the most natural good food we can give them. Also 5 stars for being tasty and sweet. Even picky eaters should like this! It can be served warm or cold, but cold tastes better in my opinion. The pouch keeps it really fresh. I can see this being a big seller.

I have been seaching for a vegatable that would not cause a struggle for my lil man to eat and have been failing misably for all involved. Problem is now solved!! He loves the flavor, and I love that he is eating broccoli, spinach and a ton of other healthy greens! I am not sure if it is beacause of the pear juice mixed in but this has now become a favorite in our house and we both are happy that he can get his snack whenever demanded. The only downfall I see is with the design of the nozzle. The cornered/angled spout was a little troublesome for negotating his hands and he needed help eating after the pouch was halfway emptied. None the less this is not a deal breaker in the least for this very appreciatative mom!

column9: A good way to get finicky little ones to eat their greens.
column10: I love the fact that these are bpa, sugar and gluten free and also organic.  They're easy to transport, easy to open and easy to feed.  Toddlers can eat them directly from the pouch if you're traveling.As far as taste goes, I tried them myself and all I really noticed was the pear.  My little one didn't seem to notice the taste of the greens at all and she's quite finicky.

My nearly year old niece loves the Baby Gourmet organic food.  I don't know much about baby food, other than it is pretty unappetizing to an adult palate, but she sure gobbles this stuff up when she is visiting me.  I also like the environmentally friendly packaging that it comes in.

This is a new type of baby food that is becoming very popular. Our youngest turned 6 months old when we tried this. She loved it. Although I am not sure I would trust her yet as a food critic. Although when my wife and I tasted it, we also thought it was pretty good.This is an organic baby food. Organic is one of those buzz words that is all the rage right now. And while that is good, they are not inexpensive to purchase. Currently they cost about $28 for 12. That is about $2 each. When considering if this is the ideal food for your baby, price should definitely be factored in. And I am not sure if this is worth the price. Typically we make our own baby food (mashed bananas, sweet potatoes, carrots, etc)I will say that the greatest use we found for these was to take them when we went out and mashing up food was not an option. The resealable lid is also handy. But even at the price, I still wonder if it is worth it.So why 4 stars then? Well, obviously if you purchase it, you are aware of the price. If you still purchase them, you won't be disappointed in them based on taste, use or connivence.

column9: Healthy food for a healthy baby!
column10: I really was impressed with this product.  If you are an adult and you try it before giving it to your baby you have to remember that they have not been used to the salt (sodium) and sugar flavors we are used to so just because you may think this is bland, your baby will  probably still like it just fine.  I did think it was an odd combination of flavors and for an adult I would say the veggies and fruit should be seperated but  I appreciate the fact that it has two of the healthiest vegetables you can eat, spinach and broccoli and the great fruit flavor of pear and a bit of lemon.  That is it! It  is all organic.  I like the packaging and the resealable top as well as the fact that you can heat it or serve it cold.  I think it is a great product and it seems like a very good way to keep your baby growing strong!

column9: an asset for the family on the go.
column10: My family has a lot of time spent traveling and I have found that the Baby Gourmet Organic Purees are a fantastic treat to toss into the diaper bag so the kids can have a healthy treat without the mess. My toddler (15 months) could eat this with ease only making a mess when he squeezed a full package, after he learned that was not the point we had no further issues. My 3 year old also enjoyed this even though he is over the suggested age, it was a convenient snack that is also healthy, checking out the nutrition facts I was satisfied with the ingredients and nutrition. The only thing that I did not care for is the flimsy box that the pouches come in, they just aren't meant to sit well on a shelf, they are thin and not as compact as I would have hoped.

column9: Organic baby food pouches with all the good stuff and nothing that isn't...
column10: If you are a fan of the baby food pouches on the market today, you are going to love these.  The Baby Gourmet Organic Simple Purees contain organic fruits and veggies.  Like many pouches on the market, they have a great design and are the perfect solution for your active baby.  They are easy to transport...no need for a dish and spoon and your baby can find him or herself.  This pouch is bpa free so you gotta love that.  These pouches contain less sugar than many pouches on the market today so for moms watching the sugar intake of their little ones, this is a step up on other pouches.Each Juicy Pear and Garden Greens pouch contains:80 calories for 4.5 ounces0 fat or trans fat0 sodium18g of carbs4g of dietary fiberless than 2g of sugar0g protein4% DV Protein50% Vitamin A140% Vitamin C0% Calcium4% IronThe absolute only complaint I can think of with this product is the price.  Even on amazon, they are a little over $2 a pouch, but the quality of the ingredients explains the cost over other brands.  Choosing organic for your little ones insure that they are getting the best products for their developing minds and bodies.

My grandson loves baby gourmet! My son and daughter-in-law love it too. The packaging is convenient, the food is much tastier than other varieties of baby food they have tried and it's organic. Its slight natural sweetness makes it ideal to mix with blander items to make them more palatable as well. Thumbs up all around!

column9: I don't like it, but my daughter does
column10: My daughter is seven years old, but because of her cerebral palsy has difficulty eating any food that hasn't been puréed.  However, her taste buds are more mature than a baby's, so when I saw this food advertised as sounding like something adults would want for dinner, it seemed right up our alley.  Well, I didn't really like it myself.  Despite liking both ingredients separately, the combination was just a bit weird for me.  However, my daughter likes it, and that's what's important.  I'd like to try some of the other flavors.The pouch it comes in is something I haven't seen before, so I'll comment on that as well.  It was much easier to open than a baby food jar, especially when your hands are a little wet.  It's easy to get all the food out, and it doesn't feel as wasteful when you throw it out as does a glass jar.  Well worth needing to provide your own bowl.

column9: Good healthy meal, pleasant taste, convenient no-mess packaging
column10: I like that this Baby Gourmet Juicy Pear and Garden Greens Baby Food has no added salt or sugar, and is gluten free.  I consumed one of the 12 pouches I received to get a feel for what it might taste like.  I thought the overall taste was pleasant, with the pear and lemon juice making a more palpable contribution to the overall taste than the broccoli and spinach.  My baby boy likes it.Each pouch has a cap that is easy to unscrew.  Once you've unscrewed the cap, just squeeze the pouch a few times until you get the desired amount of contents into a bowl.  To reseal the packet, just screw the cap back on.  A simple and no-mess delivery system!The product is a bit pricey compared to what's available in the local supermarket, but it's a good product, in my opinion.

column9: 3 year old boy loves these, but way overpriced
column10: My boy is almost 3.5 years old so probably he's not the target audience for this product, but that doesn't stop him from loving these.  The ingredients are high quality and there is good solid nutrition here.It is fun for my boy to eat these himself, squeezing the pouch into his mouth, but I agree that the pouch design is not a huge selling point for me.  I think it's a little bit of a myth that these are so much more convenient than jars/tubs.  Back when my kid was still eating a lot of baby food, I never felt inconvenienced having to carry along jars/tubs if we were going to be eating on-the-go.  Plus this packaging has the flaw of being not recyclable whereas we always recycled the jars/tubs.All in all, I would have to say that I would probably not buy these again because the price is outrageous.  Other brands of similarly high quality are substantially less expensive, like a whole dollar per pouch less expensive.

I just received the Baby Gourmet Organic Simple Purees Stage 1 Juicy Pear and Garden Greens and I had to try it immediately. I was very impressed with the handy 4.5 ounce pouches that hold the purees. My grandchildren love the taste of the juicy pear and garden greens. I was surprised to see the expiration date to be July, 2012 since I  received them in May. We will use them up by July, but it does seem to be a short expiration date. I love the fact that the puree is organic and gluten free. I warm the pouch by standing it in hot water and then serve. I am sure all moms will agree that this is very good for their babies.

Our granddaughter seemed to like this organic baby food. It is in a convenient pouch, which will be handy to take along for meals away from home.  Today's babies certainly have some wonderful products to enjoy!

I really like that this product is organic.  The packaging is great, pour out a little or a lot, if you want more, you can pour out more.  Great flavor choices.  I love the combinations of fruit and veggie.  Babies like the sweetness of the fruit with the veggies, helps to get picky eaters to get their veggies.  Great product.

column9: Taste great- very convenient - great snack for all ages!
column10: Pear with spinach.Pouches can go in the fridge & have straw-like "delivery system", like some apple sauce "on-the-go" packets.Says it's "baby food", but great for adult snacks as well! Especially if you like applesauce & don't get your fruits & veggies with your regular diet, have a sensitive stomach or want on-the-go healthy snacks.No mess, easy to open unscrew packets.A good way to have a snack on the go without the mess!I can see where a baby could transition from breast or bottle to these fairly easily.Great to have in an earthquake kit or for camping trips.

So far, this baby food has worked put well for us. My son enjoys it and I feel good knowing it is  organic and comes in chemical free packaging. I mix it with some baby oatmeal to stretch it out between feedings. Good product!

column9: My grandson would give it two thumbs up if he knew how
column10: My grandson sucked this down so fast I thought he was going to get a headache.  He loves it and my daughter has started buying them regularly now.  She said they travel well and she doesn't have to worry about breaking jars to get veggies into her baby when they travel.  Actually he has these mostly at home.

column9: Baby really likes this unconventional combo
column10: When I got this Juicy Pear and Garden Greens baby food for my daughter I wasn't sure if she would go for a pear/spinach/broccoli.  The puree is mostly pears with flecks of spinach and broccoli in it.  I'm not a fan of the smell of this food, but my daughter can't get enough of it.  She really likes it and gets quite upset if I don't feed it to her quickly enough.  I was ver concerned that it wasn't going to be palatable, but her eagerness to eat this makes me think it must be pretty tasty.The pouch is convenient if you are only going to serve a portion of this to your baby.  Simply squeeze out what you're going to use and then cap it and pop it in the fridge.

column9: Baby loved it and less mess.
column10: These packages were resealable and easy to use.  I heated the food as well as served it cold and my grandson loved it either way.  It just seems natural to warm peas a little but he didn't mind if I didn't.  The nutrients were excellent in this baby food and I would easily recommend to any new mother.  Other than making it yourself you can't go wrong with this product.  I also purchased the Baby Gourmet Organic Simple Purees Stage 1 (6 Months+) Orchard, Apple, Carrot and Prune Baby Food, 4.5-Ounce Pouches (Pack of 12) and he LOVED it!

My kids are teenagers, but my sister and her baby are visiting this week so I picked up this case of Baby Gourmet Organic Simple Purees Stage 1(6 Months+) Juicy Pear and Garden Greens Baby Food, 4.5-Ounce Pouches (Pack of 12)for my nephew.First of all, I love the pouches!  So much more convenient than jars (easier to pack,  easy to dispense; can even be dispensed right into the mouth!).  I also like that these are organic and gluten free, with no added sugar or salt.Taste?  Well my 7 month old nephew gobbled them up.  I tried a little taste and was not a fan, but I don't think I'm the target demographic.One star off because the cap comes all the way off and could become a choking hazard.  They should make it so the cap retracts or flips up, or in some way doesn't come off.BOTTOM LINE:  Healthy, convenient, and popular with the babies = win.  I will buy these when he visits again.

My baby son loves the food, but the design is not great. He is really too young to self feed yet, but my other son used to love to eat out of these packages himself. With the new design, it makes it much harder to self feed.Bottom line: Food's great, your baby will love it - just don't expect your baby to self-feed with this product.

For our child, we typically produce our own baby food.  I'm not a big fan of all the "extras" baby food companies stick in their foods, so I use a baby food processor to make whatever pure foods I want to give my baby.However, I saw the opportunity to give these organic purees a shot and decided to give it a shot because the flavours just sounded amazing: For the Juicy Pear and Garden Greens, it was quite good and the baby (and, admittedly, I) enjoyed it quite a bit.  Since it doesn't have all the flavour add-ins that other baby foods have (especially the sugars), it's not going to have the junk food flavouring.  Therefore, it will ACTUALLY taste like the foods the label says.  This one is a bit on the sour side, but that's because I'm not a huge fan of pear.  My baby liked it quite a bit and didn't fight in the slightest.I also like the pouch design (instead of the jars with those hard to reach corners).  You can just pour a bit into your baby's favourite bowl and let him or her enjoy!Overall, it's a good product that most babies should enjoy.  There are other flavours that you can also give a shot!

column9: Yummy snack and oatmeal topping! Kids like it too
column10: These packets are easy to store and squeeze, and the caps make them easy to reseal.  The pear-spinach puree makes a great, low-calorie, no-added-sugar topping for plain oatmeal.  And my kids like it as a snack!  It's convenient and better for them than fruit roll-ups.

These are really great to have on hand to just grab and take with you if you are on the go.  My 1 year old loves these.  He has also just learned how to drink from a straw and just hold this in his mouth and sucks most of it out(you have to help with the last little bit).  The taste isnt too bad(Had to try it out for myself).  You get a mix of fruit and vegetable in one serving which is really great.  My only problem is that they seem to be a little pricey for the size but they are convenient.

column4: Wendi Barker "Wendi's Book Corner & What Wend...
column9: Yummy Feel Good Food For Your Baby or Toddler
column10: I absolutely love baby food pouches.  I try to keep one or two in my purse or car at all times for our toddler, who tends to get cranky VERY fast when he decides he's hungry.  The Baby Gourmet Juicy Pear and Garden Greens Pouch is great for all purposes, and as a parent, I can feel good giving it to my toddler (who scarfs these down and asks for more... which is all the proof I need that they are good).Now, I wasn't sure about my son's taste in food, so I decided to give a pouch a try myself while we were waiting for some friends.  It was actually quite good.  It has the perfect amount of pear to make the spinach and broccoli a little sweeter, and the only other ingredients are asorbic acid and organic lemon juice concentrate, so I know these pouches are nutritious.Pluses:100% OrganicUnsweetened (well, that is what the package says, but it IS naturally sweetened by the pear)UnsaltedGluten FreeNut FreeBPA Free PackagingNo dairy, egg or lactoseTastes goodThis comes in two 6-pack boxes, and is suggested for children ages 6 months+.  My 2 year old loves these as a snack or supplement to his meal (especially if we eat out), and I will on occasion eat one for a snack myself.

column4: Penny Pinching Polly "Check out my website fo...
column10: I watch a 2 year old, and this is her favorite snack! I admit, I was skeptic.  It honestly doesn't SOUND appealing, but they taste surprisingly good!  I have had it as a snack a time or two, as has my 6 year old.  I cannot wait to try other varieties!

column9: My niece loved them!  Healthy convenience food.
column10: Got these for when my niece visits and really happy with it.  No additives, no BPA, no waste; great taste, good ingredients, portable.  I'd definitely buy this using subscribe & save since it brings the price down 15%.  Honestly, I think this makes a great addition to baby's food pantry for travel, days when you're too busy to prep a lot of food, or when the baby is sleeping over grandma's (or auntie's) house. A++++

With my first child I made all of my baby food from scratch.  I was a stay at home Mom and had the luxury to do this, but I know that it's not always possible for parents. I think that if you can't make it yourself, then a product like this is the next best thing. I liked several things about Baby Gourmet Organic Simple Purees; the simplicity and minimal processing of the ingredients, the packaging and the flavor combinations. Of course the true test is what baby thinks and not wanting to feed a child some thing I wouldn't be willing to eat myself I sampled it first.  The texture was right for the age, not to thick or runny. The flavor was pretty good too, I liked the addition of pear to add a little sweetness. As for the kids, three visitors to my home have now tried this and 2 out of 3 liked it.  The baby was 7 months and gobbled it down, there was a 12 month old that after a few tastes turned his nose up at it and surprisingly the 3 year old took the pouch and sucked it down.  Her Mom said she gives her HAPPYTOT Organic Superfoods for Tots, so she was very familiar with the packaging. The only thing left to consider is the price.  While it is more expensive than some of the longstanding jarred brands out there, I think that it is worth the extra cost for your child.

column9: Perfect first foods that babies like
column10: These purees are great first foods for babies. They are easy to swallow and easy to digest, and it's gluten free, contains no dairy, no eggs, no nuts, no fillers, sweeteners or salt.  It was even enjoyed by one fussy baby who is particular about what it likes to eat.The packaging is perfect for travel; it's easy to open and dispense. The food is both tasty and nutritious. No refrigeration required unless opened. We think it's the perfect food to take along for babies when traveling or visiting. TRY IT.

Having my grandson over every weekend I thought I would give this product a try. Very glad I did he really likes it and it so easy to serve and dispose of the packaging. He really seems satisfied and full after eating.

Baby Gourmet's Juicy Pear & Garden Greens comes in a BPA free "spout pouch" package that is becoming more and more common on grocery store shelves. I like the convenient, easy-to-store nature of these pouches and their other benefits. The pouches themselves are not recyclable, but they supposedly have a far smaller environmental impact than glass jar alternatives. The cap and nozzle are recyclable plastic, so I recommend just ripping them off the empty pouch and dropping them into your recycling bin.Getting back the most important thing -- the food. I suggest you visit Baby Gourmet's website to see the philosophy behind their product. It is organic, has no fillers, and is unsweetened. Taste is as important and nutritional value. A pouch contains two servings and in the case of this one, that's 40 calories a serving along with the other healthy nutrients.My wife and I don't have a 6 months+ infant, but a neighbor's baby is a little less than a year old and she seemed to like it well enough. In fact, it was hard to pry the empty pouch from her pudgy little fingers. My two kids (7 & 11) tasted and and wrinkled up their noses. No pouches in their school lunches I guess. To be fair, they are far from the target market.My wife and I tasted it and found it to actually be pretty tasty. To us, chilled pouches taste better than room temperature or warmed ones. I would describe it as having an apple sauce like consistency with the predominant fresh flavor of pear purée and a dash of greens (broccoli and spinach) making a subtle appearance. I wouldn't serve this to company at a dinner party (unless they were all toddlers), but I don't mind throwing a pouch in my lunch bag and having it as a snack for work. I don't even mind the odd looks I get from my coworkers, hah!If you are looking for a healthy food for your little one(s), you could do a lot worse than Juicy Pear & Garden Greens. In a pinch, it'll even do as a snack for open minded adults. My thanks to Baby Gourmet for producing this healthy and environmentally friendly product.~ Kort

These purees are great, and the pouch thing is exceptionally convenient! This flavor, juicy pear and garden greens, tastes like a lovely pear puree to me - no hint of the greens. For a child who dislikes veggies, I believe this would be a nice way to sneak some in.The pouch is a thick foil and it features a plastic tube with a re-closeable, plastic top. My almost 2 year old granddaughter had no problem using the pouch and she LOVED the flavor. In fact, she finished it and asked for another one. When I pulled it out of the carton, her eyes got wide, her smile got wider, and she said "All for ME"?We were at the park that day and the pouch was such a great way to give her a yummy snack without needing utensils or having any clean-up. Also, the pouch is perfect for a toddler on the go, who is loathe to slow down for a minute to eat something. My daughter-in-law was very enthusiastic about keeping some on hand for car trips and other times when a snack is in order.I intend to purchase other varieties as well, but this flavor will be one I regularly keep on hand for my granddaughter's visits.

I am very impressed that there isn't any type of sweetener or salt in this Baby Gourmet Organic baby food.  It is surprisingly difficult to find baby food without salt and some type of sugar.  The ingredients in this formula are:  Organic pear, organic broccoli, organic spinach, ascorbic acid, organic lemon juice concentrate.The packaging lists it as 2 servings, but I think most babies can/will eat the entire package.  This is not always the case, though, so the twist on/off lid makes it very convenient for storing in the refrigerator.  The one thing I don't like is that it's difficult to see/feel if you've really gotten all of the food out of the pouch.  The food is quite expensive, and I don't like the thought of not being able to get every little drop out of the packaging.All in all, this is a great food -- tastes great, has wonderful ingredients, doesn't have unnecessary additives, and is very convenient.

column4: Shana "That's my opinion- I could be wrong!"
column10: My husband and I sometimes take care of my baby niece and so I ordered this to try. All I can say is that she loved them. She ate all her food and she is sometimes a very picky eater.The only gripe I have is that sometimes the containers I find to be a pain, it's easier just to open up a jar and take what you use out. Though the disposal of these containers is much easier than the jars.Overall, I'd highly recommend.

column4: B. McCarthy "Engineer, CERT, Amateur Radio Op...
column10: These are great...very healthy and kids love them. It is so much more convenient to feed them like this and not have to carry around little jars or tubs and spoons. They are natural and have only good things in them. Good for a baby or even a slightly older kid to get their vegetables.

column9: No artificial ingrediants and nice looking container
column10: First off I love the container. Easy to squeeze out the contents and no spoons needed. Item can be served warm or cold. It is unsalted and unsweetened. There is a mix of Pear, Broccoli, and Spinach. And of course it is certified Organic. A bit pricey but high quality and convenient for your baby.

column9: Baby loves it and his tummy takes it well!
column10: My infant loves it!  Juicy Pear and Garden Greens is at first an off putting combo but it actually tastes nice. (Yeah, I tasted it. I taste everything I give to my infant to be sure it isn't poisoned.  Haha, not really.  But it's good to have an idea of what, exactly you are giving to your child, I think)The packaging is very convenient. A pouch with a screw top for easy access and reseal to keep the contents fresh.Great taste, great packaging- you've got a winner!*** UPDATE ***Baby (almost 6 months old) has been eating this Juicy Pear and Garden Greens for over a week now.  No problem digesting it and still able to poo regularly (color will be kind of green instead of yellow though but no worries!)  If you're going to start your baby on solid, I highly recommend this product as a start (perhaps on top of iron fortified rice cereal).  I was told to start with veggies, then fruits but why not do both at the same time with this Juicy pear and greens purees! :)  He eats 2 - 2.5 oz of Baby Gourmet in the morning then rice with milk in the evening.I'm so very happy with this product and highly recommend it.  GROW baby GROW!

To me, these taste like turnip greens and pears mixed together. I know the name of this flavor involves garden greens, but I thought the "greens" would be pretty tasteless, for some odd reason. You can very much taste them! I didn't care for this flavor at all. My 3 year old looked at me like I was the worst mother ever for daring to let him taste it. My 1 year old LOVES them, though! He's the closest to the target age, so I guess he would be the best judge in this case. Little ones don't exactly have the same taste "likes" as the older generation. (Have you ever tasted formula?!)I will say that the turnip green flavor wasn't as strong to me after these have been refrigerated, even if my husband disagrees.I know that there's the whole argument against these pouches because they aren't recyclable. I DO wish that they could be recycled, but otherwise, I LOVE these pouches! They are just so handy, especially with traveling.Overall, my youngest gives these a big thumbs up. If you're buying them for an older child, I'd probably try one before buying a whole case!

I figured that in order to truly review this product, I was going to have to taste it.  I wasn't excited about that.  However, I was pleasantly surprised; it actually tasted like food!  It has this nice, fresh, slightly sweet flavor and a texture that isn't slimy or gummy at all!My babysitting charges like it too; all around, Baby Gourmet is a big hit!

They really made this baby food easy to use, can be cold, room temp or warmed in a bowl of hot tap water, travels well and no glass to break or throw away, although that big green screw cap needs some work, its a lot of plastic. Little kids can squeeze straight into their mouths with a little practice, but very messy for one with no control. Tastes like well, pears.

I fed this to my grandson and he ate the whole pouch. I couldn't believe it. When I read it was garden greens and pear juice I thought it sounded nasty but my grandson loved it. Of course I have never found anything he doesn't like but he seemed to really eat this up much faster. and its nutritious :)

I tried a little bit before handing it over to the baby (20 months old), and I was surprised at how tart it was.  The first ingredient is pear, so I expected it to be a little bit sweeter.  But, the little guy didn't even seem to notice.Not sure if it is the novelty of eating from a pouch, or if he didn't notice the tartness, but it was gone in under 2 minutes.I like the pouches as they are easy for babies to self-feed (less messy!) and good for times when we are out.The current price (at nearly $2/pouch on S&S) is a bit high for my budget.  I've compared to the varieties at the store, and they tend to be cheaper, even for the organic ones.However, I felt good knowing that there were no "funny" ingredients in these pouches.  I would certainly recommend them.

column9: Snuck Veggies on my older kids!
column10: I have extremely picky little boys. I give them vitamins every day, but I would prefer they get what they need from their foods. I passed this off as "pear sauce" with dinner and both children ate every bite of it. The 5 year old said it was great and the 2 year old declared it delicious! They both dipped french fries in at and said it was great that way.I tested a couple of spoon fulls. The color was kinda greeny brownish and that was a little off-putting. I don't know how neither boy noticed the green flecks in it. I couldn't tell if that was the spinach or broccoli. Didn't matter though. The overwhelming flavor was the pear. It was sweet enough to cover the veggie flavors, but it didn't completely mask them.I consider it a success. And no, I don't feel bad about giving them baby food. The product is organic, gluten free (we may have an allergy), unsweetened, natural and full of good stuff. This flavor has no fat, sodium or calcium. It does provide (1/2 package is serving size) 2% DV Protein, 25% Vitamin A, 70% Vitamin C, and 2% Iron in each serving.Just a note, we served it room temperature, but I've put a pouch in the fridge for going with breakfast tomorrow.UPDATE: We tried it cold and they both thought it tasted better. I didn't notice a difference, but the kids ate more of it when it was cold. They dipped tortilla chips in it this time and said it made them "taste fancy".

After figuring out how to open these little pouches I have discovered that our baby seems to love them. While some people say they can "drink" them right out of the package, I squeeze mine into the bowl and use a spoon. Either way he loves them. I don't know that they are any different from baby food in a jar, but they are convenient for on the go and disposal.

column9: Tastes great, Me and Baby agree!
column10: I am not usually a fan of green vegetables, personally.  In fact, it is a joke around our house that I will not eat anything green.  I tried this product first, myself, before feeding it to a friend's little one.  It actually tastes great!  No sugar, all organic, lots of vitamins and babies like it too!My only complaint is with the cap.....it's small enough to be swallowed, so pay attention when feeding.  Maybe the company will find a way to keep the cap attacned to the package, by a tab or something, to make it safer.Tastes good, good for you both.  Can't ask for more than that

I work in a special needs clinic, and sometimes our babies/toddlers are really picky, have massive food allergies. A lot of the parents are now ONLY feeding kids Organic to make sure there isn't any processed nonsense and pesticides in the food.Most of the kids have not turned down this baby food, and its so easy to just squeeze a bit out, replace the cap and send it home with the parents if they love it. I have even seen kids carrying it around like a sippy cup and just squeezing away!It doesnt have to be refrigerated until you open it. And also make sure to check the expiration date because the batch I got was only good till June.

Baby Gourmet has come up with a wonderful, healthy, delicious way for my baby to get the nutrients she needs with none of the artificial additives that she doesn't need. It is organic, unsweetened, unsalted, gluten free, nut free, BPA free, dairy, egg and lactose free, and has no fillers or thickeners. The pear makes it taste slightly sweet and masks any bitterness from the broccoli and spinach.The packaging is convenient if you want to serve just a portion and save the rest for another time. You can squeeze the amount you want out of the 4.5 ounce package and screw the lid back on. I do worry that the lid could come loose or the package get punctured in my diaper bag, but I tend to put all soft foods and liquids in a Ziploc bag for extra protection in the event that happens. I do not have that concern so much with Gerber jars, but this Baby Gourmet packaging seems less likely to lose its lid than the common plastic Gerber containers do.My baby enjoys the flavor of the Juicy Pear and Garden Greens food and will usually eat the whole package in one sitting. An added bonus, my five year old thinks they are Crushers and eats them too. So it can be a healthy snack for older kids as well. This is a baby food I feel good about feeding to my kids.

I have to say that this baby-food was a nice surprise. It smells like real food and babies love it. I like that it is easy to feel a bowl, take how much you need,then put the cap back on into the fridge. My daughter loves the Garden Beans as well. Really nice surprise because she is a finicky eater.I really liked that its easy to heat up as well take on the go. I am always out so this fits great when out to the park or friends house. Really good product for babies.
Good garden greens for baby, purees and organic without being too sweet.  I like the packaging design on these as well and they're great for on the go!  Highly recommended!

When it comes to our little ones, we want to make sure they're getting the best. This Baby Gourmet product is a high-quality product, manufactured in Canada, and certified organic by QAI and USDA, it is made from organic, all-natural ingredients (organic pear, organic broccoli, organic spinic, ascorbic acid (Vitamin C), organic lemon juice concentrate). There are no added fillers, added sugars, or any artificial additives. The taste is good, with about the consistency and color of apple sauce. It's got enough sweetness to make the blend palpable. The broccoli does have an overcooked taste to it however.The soft pouch is durable, compact, and portable. It's ready to serve warm or cold. To serve warm, stand in some hot water for a few minutes, or microwave the contents in a separate bowl. The pouch itself is not microwavable. Nutritionally, this product doesn't contain much besides Vitamin A (25%) and Vitamin C (70%). Protein is 2%, Iron 2%, Calcium 0% of the recommended daily value.It is gluten-free, nut-free, daily/egg/lactose free, and kosher. As the cap is a choking hazard, parents need to keep it away from baby. Additionally, the edges of the pouch are very stiff, which may poke sensitive baby parts.

column9: Awesome! Not Just for Babies, Also for those ordered by Doctors to be on Soft Diet
column10: This is truly amazing, once this arrived; opened box, found them in nicely stacked foil pouches. Small enough for a baby's mouth and yet at the same time is fitting for an Adult likewise who have been ordered on soft food diet (Stage 1 - Puree) or depending on what the Physician has instructed.  I am already on well-known brand name products but there is no comparison with this Baby Gourmet Organic Simple Purees Stage 1. Literally had to grab the boxes to compare what's in there and was literally shocked to find out so much of artificial and natural, plus fillers, and concentrate, and yadda, yadda, yadda ... on these brand name products. Not only that, the label on the Baby Gourmet Organic Simple Purees Stage 1 was very simple; while the shelf life itself will be short because it is all natural.All in all; it is fitting not just for babies, but also for those who have been instructed by Surgeons to Physicians on Soft Food Diet - who are literally sick of this canned repetitive "Broth, Liquids, and Jell-O" when one has a craving for "REAL FOOD", like Steak, Lobster, Salad, Cheesecake, for example ... stuff "Big People can eat".The differences was remarkable! It was not watered down, but yet, was very tasty and addicting. It neither upset my stomach or digestive system even after the harsh medications after taking it, was very soothing.  The other brand names, were kind of frustrating for me (due to nature of injury and then having fallen on Sunday, the day before this arrived from my walker which result more injuries as if I needed it - which result a trip to the hospital that which the photo image shows the Hospital tags) also was instructed to continue on the medications and stay on the soft diet since not able to handle solid foods yet.My elderly mother went out to look for more of these, later then informed me that she wasn't able to find them anywhere only then I noticed they hailed from Canada. Oh Canada, can you teach America to make great foods like these? For not only they are delicious but I will be upfront and first to admit... I was unsure about having Pears, Broccoli, and Spinach all mixed together - I love them all, but together? I wasn't sure what to make of it at first, but really, it is very, very good.In my humble opinion - this is excellent for people not just restricted to soft diet with the Doctor's approval, but those with specific medical conditions but not in the late stages where choking is a hazard.It needs no refrigeration unless you had opened it and didn't use it all, it can be closed and used up within 24 hours. It also can be served at room temperature or cold.All in all - I strongly recommend this, the bad thing about it is, I wished this was around when my son was a baby nearly 28 years ago - for this would be the proper food for babies, after having read the packaging and what's all in there, scared me; I never did pay heed to it at all, for I only stuck to the brand name I trusted because it was the same ones that my parents fed my sister and I or have times changed?I also asked my married son to pull out his baby spoon, while he knew not why I asked for it; but what I did was a comparison between the brand names and this on that spoon.  After I squeezed this into the spoon, The looks of it was very appealing to a baby (I know because I have often fed my granddaughter when she was a baby), the other brand names, were so watery, that I found myself constantly having to wipe the spoon which then gave me flash back memories of how many times I had to wipe my granddaughter's face with a spoon, the leakage, and same way with my son when he was a baby. But once I put it into my mouth, each one, there were no differences, the only differences here was that Baby Gourmet Organic Simple Purees State 1 Juicy Pear and Garden Greens was very tasty over the others where if I were a baby, I would want more.As an Adult on soft food diet, this is a huge relief - where Pears tastes like you just chomped on a fresh Pear, and Broccoli - tastes fresh like one just boiled it fork tender just for you, and Spinach tasted exactly like cooked spinach. Not acidity, no salt, pepper, or any seasoning. It's the way Mother Nature intended it to be; the Pear's own sweetness makes it all the more desirable.All I can say is - elaborately well done and well rounded meal.

column9: Side spout works better for little hands -- less squirting
column10: I'm not sure why, but this side spout design seems to handle little hands squeezing it better than the other ones that have the spout in the top center. That in itself is enough reason for me to buy these again! Beyond that, all the ingredients are good and organic. Getting greens in babies couldn't be easier. These pouches are great for a diaper bag. It makes it much easier to pack food and take on the road. The best part is the baby loves them and enjoys feeding herself. It's far superior to jarred food. Let the baby feed themselves! Love it.

I was reluctant to try this since Most green babyfood comes back out one way or the other in my household by the babies around here. However I was surprised when this was delightedly swallowed and kept down without a frown by my nephew. He is just 6 months and this was his first solid. I expected him to spit it out period being a first offering. But he loved it and smiles now when he sees the package coming his way. I even tasted it myself and it was not half bad.

Not only does this product taste great, it is good for baby.  These are very handy to carry in a diaper bag, and can be eaten without a spoon.  Remember to keep an eye on the expiration date because their shelf life is relatively short due to the fact that they are organic.  I just rec'd this last week and it expire in July -- only 2 months. I would highly recommend this for anyone interested in organic baby food, but it is rather expensive.

column9: The only thing my son will eat so far
column10: I have had a hard time with my 6 month old so far trying to get him to eat solid food.  I have been making my own at home and he seems just not interested.  I got a batch of these to try and to my surprise....he ate it! It has a great consitancy and a great taste (I like it) and you could seen the garden greens in the food.  I really like the pouches! They did not have these around when I had my daughter and make it so easy to travel with little ones (the glass jars can be heavy).  The screw on top is nice and does not leak.  A friend's son who is 1 acutally sucks the food out of the pouch! I would recommend this to everyone!

column9: Delicious and nutritious...yes, we tried it ourselves!
column10: We frequently have young visitors so thought it would be nice to have some of this around but before giving it to anyone, tried it ourselves.The first thing you should know is this tastes really good! We had the pear and green puree and it was a nice blend between a bit of sweet but also obvious garden greens. Perfect for babies/toddlers or even elderly persons with a sensitive stomach.All organic, no BPH, nothing bad to worry about so you have the full confidence that what you are feeding is healthy. It comes in an odd little pouch type container with a knob that is fairly odd/new to use but quite useful once used.All in all - a superb baby food!

This was the first mixed baby food I gave to my seven month old daughter and I was unsure if she was going to like it, but she loved it!  She had no hesitation in eating it and eagerly opened her mouth for more.  I loved that it was healthy and all organic.  The only two downsides were, unlike Gerber which can be kept for 2-3 days in the refrigerator, this has to be used within 24 hours of opening, and also unlike Gerber, it does not come in a container which you can feed out of.  You need to squirt the baby food into another container which you can then spoon it out of to feed your baby.  Those are two minor quibbles though, and overall I am very pleased with this food.

column9: Passed the baby and adult taste test. Also, best occasions to use it
column10: I have to start off by noting that I am not a fan of packaged or jar forms of baby food. Fresh and homemade is my preference.But having noted that, Baby Gourmet is a winner and the major plus for us is that it is so portable and light. Each pouch is only 4.5 ounces and a pouch or two is all that is needed for even a relatively long day trip, although you'll probably want to bring along some extra snacks from the other food groups.  Depends on how long you'll be gone. Even the standard box of 12 is simple to tote along.Of course, any baby food has to pass the taste test and the Pear and Garden Greens was eaten eagerly, not only by a baby but a pouch was consumed by an older child (poured over some sliced bananas). So it will be  a staple for a 6 month old and a snack for the older child - when carrying along homemade food isn't possible.Unlike baby food in jars, young fingers can grasp the Baby Organic package, although parental supervision may be necessary to help aim the spout into the mouth. Of course, you can always squeeze the puree out of the pouch and into a bowl and serve it that way.Baby Gourmet doesn't need refrigeration until opened and an entire box isn't the least bit heavy. A shelf stable product is a major advantage when refrigerator space is at a premium. It always is at our home.Since Baby Gourmet encourages parents to taste the product, I did. It was appealing and not overly sweet. This made sense because the Pear and Garden Greens is noted to be unsweetened. I could definitely taste both vegetable and fruit flavors and to my adult taste buds it had a slightly sweet but mild flavor.It didn't knock my socks off but I'm not the important user here...the baby is. He loved it! We did taste test this on a friend's baby. Also a success. She plans to get more Baby Gourmet as her baby is normally a picky eater.What about nutrition? Each pouch has 80 calories (40 per half pouch) and hefty amounts of Vitamin A and C. The package needs to be refrigerated and thrown out after 24 hours, presumably because of the lack of preservatives. There are also no fillers or thickeners and this seems safe for those babies who are prone to allergies...no gluten, nuts, dairy, egg, lactose, etc. The packaging is BPA free. It also meets the USDA and other organizations' standards for being an organic product.Maybe I didn't look hard enough (and would appreciate the info if anyone else has it) but I couldn't find a recyclable symbol on the individual pouches. Does anyone know if they can be recycled? I assume the cardboard box can be recycled. I am knocking one star off because I wish the recycling info was more prominent. I'm winging it on that and not putting the pouches into our recycle container. Odd as it may seem, we have had packages of other foods which have a similar plastic feel and appearance and which ARE recyclable.One tip: Pay attention to the expiration date as the new box I received notes that the product expires in July - and this is May. I'm actually comforted by the fact that Baby Gourmet doesn't last for months and months because many baby foods which do have added preservatives and chemicals. The list of ingredients is relatively short: organic pear, broccoli, spinach, Vitamin C, Lemon Juice. Only the lemon juice is in concentrate form.I'd highly recommend this product for convenience, portability, ease of storage and nutritional value. We'll still primarily make baby food used but this is a wonderful option when we can't have our own on hand.

column9: My Whole Family Fights For These!
column10: Although I do prefer baby food products in jars, because I reuse them for many things, I have to say that the Baby Gourmet Organic Simple Purees Stage 1 Juicy Pear and Garden Greens Baby Food is one that I will buy despite the lack of jars.The texture is just right- not too runny, not too thick, and the color is very natural- shows a lack of manipulation or alteration.  The taste is absolutely perfect.  The food is very sweet like fruit is but not artificially so.  The greens are in the perfect balance.  Not too much to be overbearing, but the pear fruit taste balances it out perfectly. It was gobbled right up!The container is very interesting- it is flat with that screw on top.  The top has a seal on it, and is very easy to remove, but not so much that it will come off if you have to transport it.  Once you open it, the spout is easy to get the food out of, and then if you need to re-cap it, you can do so and keep the rest until the next day.I doubt that this food would last that long, however. It is so delicious that it will be finished most likely.  The packet is also fairly easy to get most of the food out of too, leaving little waste.This food is so good that my entire family right up to Daddy kept trying to eat it all instead!  It would make a great snack for traveling even for plder kids on the go (even moms).  Just enough for an energy boost and a great little snack.I can not recommend this food highly enough. It truly is fantastic.

These organic pouches I believe are less sweet than others. They are on the pricier side but I got them on sale when they offered a coupon on Amazon so they were affordable. if they were not so expensive I would get more of them. I do not like that the pouch opening is on the side but I think that they are not meant to be eaten out of the pouch like the other types like earths best or plum organics which have spout on top which my daughter is use. They are also bigger pouches than most other types. My daughter is a pretty picky eater but she seemed to love them. She was hesistant at first of eating them but after a couple times she went for them when she saw them.

column9: Baby Gourmet Pear & Garden Greens - Great Tasting Quality Product, But Packaging Could Be Improved
column10: Baby Gourmet Organic Simple Purees Stage 1(6 Months+) Juicy Pear and Garden Greens Baby Food, 4.5-Ounce Pouches (Pack of 12) is a great tasting product that has been well-thought out.  The product is mostly pears, and tastes that way.  But the included vegetables is enough to cut the sweetness slightly and add nutritional content.  The texture can be a little gritty.  That doesn't bother me, and it shouldn't bother the average baby.  There's enough sweetness to get them to swallow the pill, so to speak.The pouch is rather large, with enough for 2 portions.  But it is resealable, so you can refrigerate what is left.The only real disappointment I have with this product is the packaging.  The pouch has enough corners in it that it is impossible to get all the baby food out of it.  And the cap, while large, is not so big that babies can't get it into their mouths.  So I think they could improve the packaging somewhat.It should be noted that because these pouches have metal foil in them they can't be heated in the microwave.  You have to heat them in warm water.  That's pretty standard for this kind of product.CONCLUSIONThis is a high quality product that tastes good.
